papers.title: Integrating predicted gene expression into genomic selection: an evaluation in partridge chickens under realistic breeding scenarios
papers.abstract: Background Genomic prediction (GP) has enhanced breeding value prediction using genome-wide markers and genotype–phenotype associations. Integrating transcriptomic data, which are closer to phenotypes, may improve breeding value prediction accuracy. While multi-omics integration in livestock is cost-prohibitive, resources such as FarmGTEx enable large-scale SNP-based prediction of estimated breeding values (EBVs) for gene expression. However, utility of these predicted EBVs for enhancing GP accuracy remains underexplored. We evaluated the integration of observed gene expression and gene expression EBVs into genomic prediction models for live, dressed, and eviscerated weights in 350 Tiannong Partridge Chickens. Whole-genome resequencing and pectoral muscle transcriptomes were generated, and multi-omics models were assessed across three scenarios: (I) both reference and validation populations have transcriptomic data; (II) only the reference population has transcriptomic data; (III) neither has transcriptomic data—requiring cross-population prediction using the ChickenGTEx reference panel. We compared genomic–transcriptomic best linear unbiased prediction (GTBLUP) models incorporating gene expression EBVs predicted via best linear unbiased prediction (BLUP) or elastic net (ENET) (GTBLUP_pred_BLUP and GTBLUP_pred_ENET, respectively), genomic-feature BLUP (GFBLUP) based on expression quantitative trait loci, and standard genomic BLUP (GBLUP). Model prediction accuracies were compared using t -tests followed by Holm correction. Results In Scenario I, integrating observed expression data significantly improved phenotype prediction accuracy over GBLUP (adjusted p < 0.05; reference-only). Subsequent comparisons are genomic prediction accuracy. For Scenario II, the GTBLUP_pred_ENET model (using genes with h 2 > 0.7) showed modest numerical gains over GBLUP when using gene expression EBVs of the validation population, although the differences were not statistically significant (adjusted p > 0.05). Furthermore, using the cross-population ChickenGTEx reference panel for expression EBV prediction (Scenario III), GTBLUP_pred_ENET ( h 2 > 0.3) again yielded consistently higher prediction accuracies than GBLUP, albeit without statistical significance (adjusted p > 0.05). In contrast, GFBLUP showed minimal or negative gains, especially when regulatory signals were extrapolated from external populations. For expression EBV prediction, ENET generally outperformed BLUP in Scenarios II and III. We found a low-to-moderate positive correlation between gene expression prediction accuracy and its cis-heritability, although overly stringent heritability filtering reduced genomic prediction accuracy. Conclusions These results highlight the potential of predicted expression EBVs for GP, pending validation in larger, more diverse populations and traits, alongside methodological refinements.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：基因體預測（Genomic prediction, GP）利用全基因體標記與基因型-表現型關聯，提升了育種值預測的準確性。整合更接近表現型的轉錄體資料，可能有助於提高育種值預測的準確性。雖然在家畜中進行多體學整合的成本高昂，但如 FarmGTEx 等資源能夠實現基於大型單核苷酸多型性（SNP）的基因表現量預估育種值（EBV）預測。然而，這些預測的 EBV 在提升 GP 準確性方面的效用仍未得到充分探討。我們評估了將觀察到的基因表現量與基因表現量 EBV 整合至基因體預測模型中的效果，分析對象為 350 隻天農麻雞的活重、胴體重和內臟重。本研究產生了全基因體重新定序與胸肌轉錄體資料，並在三種情境下評估多體學模型：（I）參考群體與驗證群體皆具備轉錄體資料；（II）僅參考群體具備轉錄體資料；（III）兩者皆無轉錄體資料——需要利用 ChickenGTEx 參考面板進行跨群體預測。我們比較了以下模型：納入透過最佳線性不偏預測（BLUP）或彈性網路（ENET）預測之基因表現量 EBV 的基因體-轉錄體最佳線性不偏預測（GTBLUP）模型（分別稱為 GTBLUP_pred_BLUP 與 GTBLUP_pred_ENET）、基於表現量數量性狀基因座的基因體特徵 BLUP（GFBLUP），以及標準基因體 BLUP（GBLUP）。模型預測準確性採用 t 檢定進行比較，並隨後進行 Holm 校正。結果：在情境 I 中，與 GBLUP 相比顯著提高了表現型預測準確性（調整後 $p < 0.05$；僅限參考群體）。隨後的比較皆針對基因體預測準確性。在情境 II 中，當使用驗證群體的基因表現量 EBV 時，GTBLUP_pred_ENET 模型（使用 $h^2 > 0.7$ 的基因）相較於 GBLUP 顯示出微幅的數值提升，儘管差異未達統計顯著性（調整後 $p > 0.05$）。此外，使用跨群體的 ChickenGTEx 參考面板進行表現量 EBV 預測（情境 III），GTBLUP_pred_ENET（$h^2 > 0.3$）同樣持續產生高於 GBLUP 的預測準確性，但同樣未達統計顯著性（調整後 $p > 0.05$）。相比之下，GFBLUP 僅顯示出極小或負向的增益，特別是當調控訊號從外部群體推廣時。在表現量 EBV 預測方面，在情境 II 和 III 中，ENET 的表現普遍優於 BLUP。我們發現基因表現量預測準確性與其順式遺傳力（cis-heritability）之間存在低到中度的正相關，不過過於嚴格的遺傳力篩選會降低基因體預測準確性。結論：這些結果突顯了預測的表現量 EBV 用於 GP 的潛力，但仍有待在更大、更多樣化的群體與性狀中進行驗證，並需進一步精進方法學。

papers.title: Genetics of energy allocation to growth in Angus cattle: trait derivation, model comparison, and relationships with feed efficiency and body composition traits
papers.abstract: Background Improving feed efficiency while understanding resource-allocation trade-offs remains a challenge in livestock breeding. We defined an energy allocation coefficient to growth ( α ) as the ratio of estimated net energy retained in growth to net energy available after accounting for predicted maintenance requirements and investigated its genetic background in American Angus cattle. We compared a two-step (TS) approach, treating α as a derived pseudo-phenotype in linear animal models, with a one-step (OS) approach, jointly estimating breeding values and variance components through a nonlinear energy-balance model. Genetic parameters were estimated using pedigree- and genomic-based models, and genetic relationships with growth, feed efficiency, and body composition traits were evaluated. Results The derived α averaged 0.77 ± 0.28 and ranged from 0.07 to 3.10. Log( α ) was heritable (h² ≈ 0.13–0.20), with highly consistent breeding value rankings across approaches ( ρ > 0.94). Genetic correlations were 0.63 ± 0.03 with average daily gain, −​0.80 ± 0.02 with feed conversion ratio, −​0.54 ± 0.03 with residual feed intake, and 0.61 ± 0.03 with residual average daily gain, indicating substantial but incomplete genetic overlap with conventional growth and feed efficiency traits. The genetic correlation with dry matter intake was weak (−​0.14 ± 0.04) and close to zero with body composition traits (−​0.13 to 0.04). Conclusions The α is a derived indicator of relative energy allocation toward growth, calculated using a nutritional energy-balance framework, and contains additive genetic variation in American Angus cattle. Despite modest differences in variance partitioning between TS and OS, the underlying genetic signal was largely consistent across model formulations. The TS framework is compatible with standard genetic evaluation procedures and provides a practical approach for genetic analysis of this derived coefficient. The incomplete genetic overlap between α and conventional feed efficiency traits supports further evaluation of α as a complementary indicator of efficiency from a resource-allocation perspective. Future work should evaluate its relationships with health, reproduction, and resilience-related traits to determine whether α provides additional information for investigating resource-allocation trade-offs and future breeding applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：在家畜育種中，改善飼料效率同時理解資源分配權衡（trade-offs）仍然是一項挑戰。我們將生長能量分配係數（$\alpha$）定義為：扣除預測的維持需求後可用淨能量中，用於生長所保留的估計淨能量之比率，並探討了美國安格斯牛的其遺傳背景。我們比較了兩步法（TS）與一步法（OS）：TS 將 $\alpha$ 視為線性動物模型中的衍生偽表型（derived pseudo-phenotype），而 OS 則透過非線性能量平衡模型聯合估計育種值與變異成分。利用譜系與基因體模型估計遺傳參數，並評估其與生長、飼料效率及體組成性狀的遺傳相關。結果：衍生出的 $\alpha$ 平均值為 0.77 ± 0.28，範圍介於 0.07 至 3.10 之間。$\log(\alpha)$ 具遺傳力（$h^2 \approx 0.13\text{--}0.20$），不同方法間的育種值排序高度一致（$\rho > 0.94$）。與平均日增重的遺傳相關為 0.63 ± 0.03，與飼料增重比為 $-0.80 ± 0.02$，與殘餘飼料採食量為 $-0.54 ± 0.03$，與殘餘平均日增重為 0.61 ± 0.03，這表明其與傳統生長和飼料效率性狀存在實質但並不完全重疊的遺傳關係。與乾物質採食量的遺傳相關較弱（$-0.14 ± 0.04$），與體組成性狀的相關則接近零（$-0.13$ 至 $0.04$）。結論：$\alpha$ 是利用營養能量平衡框架計算得出的相對生長能量分配衍生指標，在美國安格斯牛中包含加成性遺傳變異。儘管 TS 與 OS 在變異數分割上有微小差異，但潛在的遺傳訊號在不同模型設定間大致保持一致。TS 框架與標準遺傳評估程序相容，為此衍生係數的遺傳分析提供了實用的方法。$\alpha$ 與傳統飼料效率性狀之間不完全的遺傳重疊，支持進一步評估 $\alpha$ 作為從資源分配角度出發之效率互補指標的潛力。未來的工作應評估其與健康、繁殖及韌性相關性狀的關係，以確定 $\alpha$ 是否能為研究資源分配權衡與未來的育種應用提供額外資訊。

papers.title: A Transformation From Methane Concentration From Sniffers to Methane Production for Implementation in Breeding Programs and Comparison With Tier 2 Equation
papers.abstract: Reducing methane emissions from dairy cattle has gained considerable attention due to its dual benefits of improving feed efficiency and mitigating climate change. Consequently, phenotyping methane emissions in dairy populations has become increasingly important to enable direct genomic selection for lower methane emissions in breeding programs. Sniffer devices are receiving growing attention and are currently being deployed on commercial farms. However, these devices do not measure airflow and therefore provide methane concentration measurements rather than direct estimates of methane production. In this study, a new method is proposed to estimate individual cow methane production from sniffer device data that does not rely on regression on production traits and can therefore be classified as a Tier 3 approach. This novel methane production trait was derived using sniffer measurements collected in two dairy cattle populations: Spain ( n = 1576) and The Netherlands ( n = 2470). The proposed trait was compared with two alternative methane production estimates derived from production traits, representing a Tier 2 and an existing Tier 3 method. Phenotypic correlations between the Tier 3 traits were high ( R > 0.90), whereas correlations between the Tier 2 and Tier 3 methods were substantially lower, ranging from 0.04 to 0.44. Strong agreement was observed between herd‐level averages of the Tier 3 traits, while discrepancies between Tier 2 and Tier 3 estimates were more pronounced. Overall, the Tier 2 equation yielded higher methane production estimates than those obtained from sniffer‐based Tier 3 traits. Heritability estimates for the Tier 3 traits ranged from 0.06 to 0.13, whereas a higher heritability (0.18–0.22) was observed for the Tier 2 trait, with standard errors between 0.02 and 0.03. Repeatability estimates were greater for the Tier 3 traits, with values ranging from 0.54 to 0.58 in Spain and from 0.25 to 0.29 in The Netherlands. The Tier 2 trait also exhibited a high repeatability (0.55–0.80). We propose this new sniffer‐based Tier 3 trait as an alternative methane production phenotype that is not derived from individual production traits, thereby reducing the risk of spurious associations between methane emissions and yield‐related traits. The proposed phenotype showed strong agreement with previously used Tier 3 traits and exhibited comparable heritability estimates. Nevertheless, several limitations must be acknowledged. In particular, this trait provides an estimate of methane production rather than a direct measurement, as current sniffer devices cannot capture the complete expiration or eructation plume. Despite these limitations, the trait enables the estimation of genetic trends and the prediction of breeding values expressed in biologically meaningful units. As such, it represents a valuable tool for supporting mitigation strategies and informing breeding policies aimed at reducing methane emissions from dairy cattle.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Breeding and Genetics
papers.abstract_zh: 減少乳牛的甲烷排放因其具備提高飼料效率與減緩氣候變遷的雙重效益而受到廣泛關注。因此，對乳牛族群進行甲烷排放的表型測定變得日益重要，以便在育種計畫中直接對較低甲烷排放量進行基因體選擇。嗅探器（sniffer）裝置正受到日益增加的關注，目前正被部署於商業牧場中。然而，這些裝置並不測量氣流，因此僅提供甲烷濃度測量值，而非甲烷產量的直接估計值。在本研究中，提出了一種新方法，利用嗅探器裝置的資料來估計個別乳牛的甲烷產量，該方法不依賴產乳性狀的迴歸，因此可被歸類為第 3 階（Tier 3）方法。這項新穎的甲烷產量性狀是利用在兩個乳牛族群中收集的嗅探器測量資料推導而得：西班牙（$n = 1576$）與荷蘭（$n = 2470$）。本研究所提出的性狀與另外兩種源自產乳性狀的替代甲烷產量估計值進行了比較，這兩種替代方法分別代表第 2 階（Tier 2）方法與現有的第 3 階方法。第 3 階性狀之間的表型相關性很高（$R > 0.90$），而第 2 階與第 3 階方法之間的相關性則顯著較低，介於 0.04 至 0.44 之間。第 3 階性狀的牧場平均值之間觀察到高度一致性，而第 2 階與第 3 階估計值之間的差異則較為明顯。總體而言，第 2 階方程式產生的甲烷產量估計值高於基於嗅探器的第 3 階性狀所獲得的估計值。第 3 階性狀的遺傳力估計值介於 0.06 至 0.13，而第 2 階性狀則觀察到較高的遺傳力（0.18–0.22），標準誤介於 0.02 至 0.03 之間。第 3 階性狀的重複力估計值較高，西班牙的數值介於 0.54 至 0.58 之間，荷蘭則介於 0.25 至 0.29 之間。第 2 階性狀也展現了高重複力（0.55–0.80）。我們提出此種基於嗅探器的新型第 3 階性狀，作為一種替代的甲烷產量表型，它並非源自個別的生產性狀，從而降低了甲烷排放與產量相關性狀之間產生虛假關聯的風險。所提出的表型與先前使用的第 3 階性狀表現出高度一致性，並具有相當的遺傳力估計值。然而，必須承認幾個限制。特別是由於目前的嗅探器裝置無法捕捉完整的呼氣或打嗝氣團，該性狀提供的是甲烷產量的估計值而非直接測量值。儘管存在這些限制，該性狀仍能用於估計遺傳趨勢，以及預測以具生物學意義單位表示的育種值。因此，它代表了一項支持減緩策略並為旨在減少乳牛甲烷排放的育種政策提供資訊的寶貴工具。

papers.title: Dietary Isoacids Improve Early-Life Feed Efficiency, Reduce Abdominal Fat Deposition, and Modulate Intestinal and Metabolic Responses in Broiler Chickens
papers.abstract: This study evaluated the effects of increasing dietary inclusion levels of branched-chain volatile fatty acids, also called isoacids (ISO), on the growth performance, carcass traits, intestinal health, and breast muscle metabolomic profile of broiler chickens. A total of 700 one-day-old male Cobb 500 chicks were assigned to five corn–soybean meal-based diets with 10 replicate pens (14 birds/pen) in a completely randomized design: A Positive Control (PC) diet formulated to meet nutritional requirements was supplemented with 0.0, 0.10, 0.20, 0.40, or 0.60% of ISO (supplied as a blend of isobutyrate and 2-methylbutyrate). Data were analyzed using General Linear Models with orthogonal polynomial contrasts, PERMANOVA for microbiome beta diversity and ANOVA with FDR correction for metabolomics. Growth performance was monitored across feeding phases. At day 42, carcass traits, breast meat quality, intestinal permeability, cecal short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs), and cecal and ileal microbiota were assessed, alongside liquid chromatography coupled to high-resolution mass spectrometry (LC-HRMS) metabolomics of the Pectoralis major muscle. Dietary ISO significantly improved average daily weight gain (p < 0.0001) and feed conversion ratio (p < 0.0001) during the first 21 days (early-life), with an optimal inclusion level of 0.40%. While overall carcass and breast yields were unaffected, ISO supplementation significantly and quadratically reduced abdominal fat deposition (p < 0.0001), with an optimal inclusion range between 0.10% and 0.40%. ISO did not compromise intestinal permeability or alter microbial alpha diversity, but it significantly restructured the cecal microbiota (beta diversity; Bray–Curtis p = 0.0213) and linearly increased cecal isobutyric acid accumulation in the cecal content (p = 0.0443). Breast muscle metabolomics revealed a dose-dependent, nonlinear response; the 0.40% inclusion level maximized the relative abundance of galactolipids, whereas the highest dose (0.60% ISO) upregulated sphingomyelins, lysophospholipids, and acylcarnitines. In conclusion, a specific dietary ISO supplementation dose of 0.4% serves as an effective nutritional strategy to boost early feed efficiency and reduce abdominal adiposity. Doses exceeding this optimal level, such as 0.60%, offer no further productive benefits and may trigger cellular stress.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究評估在肉雞飼糧中提高支鏈揮發性脂肪酸（亦稱異酸，ISO）的添加水準，對其生長性能、屠體性狀、腸道健康及胸肌代謝體學特征的影響。總共 700 隻一日齡雄性 Cobb 500 肉雞採完全逢機設計，隨機分配至 5 種以玉米－大豆粕為基礎的飼糧中，每種飼糧設 10 個重複欄（每欄 14 隻雞）：正對照組（PC）飼糧依營養需求配製，並分別添加 0.0、0.10、0.20、0.40 或 0.60% 的 ISO（以異丁酸和 2-甲基丁酸的混合物形式提供）。數據分析採用具正交多項式對比的一般線性模式、用於微生物群落貝塔多樣性的 PERMANOVA，以及結合 FDR 校正的變異數分析（ANOVA）以進行代謝體學分析。在整個飼養階段監測生長性能。於第 42 天評估屠體性狀、胸肉品質、腸道通透性、盲腸短鏈脂肪酸（SCFAs）、盲腸與迴腸微生物相，並對胸大肌（Pectoralis major）進行液相層析高解析度質譜（LC-HRMS）代謝體學分析。飼糧添加 ISO 顯著改善了前 21 天（早期生命階段）的平均每日增重（$p < 0.0001$）與飼料增重比（$p < 0.0001$），最佳添加水準為 0.40%。儘管整體屠體率與胸肉率未受影響，但 ISO 補充顯著且呈二次方關係地降低了腹脂沉積（$p < 0.0001$），最佳添加範圍介於 0.10% 至 0.40% 之間。ISO 未損害腸道通透性，亦未改變微生物阿爾法多樣性，但顯著重構了盲腸微生物相（貝塔多樣性；Bray–Curtis $p = 0.0213$），並呈線性增加盲腸內容物中異丁酸的累積（$p = 0.0443$）。胸肌代謝體學顯示劑量依賴性的非線性反應；0.40% 的添加水準使半乳糖脂的相對豐度最大化，而最高劑量（0.60% ISO）則上調了神經鞘磷脂、溶血磷脂及醯基肉鹼。總結而言，適當的飼糧 ISO 添加劑量（0.4%）可作為提升早期飼料效率及減少腹部脂肪蓄積的有效營養策略。超過此最佳水準的劑量（如 0.60%）則無法帶來額外的生產效益，並可能引發細胞壓力。

papers.title: Expanding the pig metabolomics QTL catalog
papers.abstract: Background Understanding the genetic regulation of metabolism is essential for improving animal health and productivity and for strengthening the use of pigs as translational models for human metabolic diseases. Metabolomics, when integrated with genomic data, provides a powerful framework for identifying genetic factors that influence intermediate molecular phenotypes closely linked to physiology. While large-scale metabolomics genome‑wide association studies (GWAS) have been extensively performed in humans, comparable studies in pigs remain limited. Among omics disciplines, metabolomics, the systematic study of metabolites central to physiology, represents the omics layer most closely linked to end-point phenotypes in mammals, such as health and production traits (e.g. growth rate). Metabolite levels are influenced by genetics, diet, and microbiome composition, with human studies showing high heritability and identifying numerous metabolite quantitative trait loci (mQTLs). While such findings have advanced our understanding of disease biology in humans, comparable studies in pigs remain limited. Results We performed GWAS of the serum metabolome in 213 three‑way crossbred pigs [(Landrace × Yorkshire) × Duroc], analyzing 248 metabolites and 30,628 metabolite ratios. We identified 41 significant metabolite–variant associations, which were consolidated into 18 mQTLs based on linkage disequilibrium (LD). Several regions were associated with multiple, biochemically related metabolites, while others showed highly specific effects. Cross-species comparison with the human GWAS catalog revealed candidate genes within seven mQTLs. Through an integrative prioritization strategy, putative causal genes—predominantly enzymes and transporters—were identified for 14 of 18 mQTLs. Conclusions Our results expand the catalog of genetic loci influencing serum metabolite variation in pigs and highlight both conserved and pig specific components of metabolic regulation. These findings provide a foundation for incorporating metabolomics into pig breeding programs and reinforce the value of pigs as a translational model for studying metabolite-associated traits and diseases in humans.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：理解代謝的基因調控對於改善動物健康與生產力，以及加強豬隻作為人類代謝疾病轉譯模型的應用至關重要。代謝體學與基因體資料相結合時，為識別影響與生理緊密連結的中間分子表現型的遺傳因素，提供了強大的框架。儘管大規模的代謝體學全基因體關聯研究（GWAS）已在人類中廣泛進行，但豬隻的相關研究仍屬有限。在各體學學門中，代謝體學——對生理核心代謝物進行的系統性研究——代表了哺乳動物中與終點表現型（如健康與生產性狀，例如生長速率）連結最緊密的體學層次。代謝物濃度受遺傳、飲食和微生物相組成的影響，人類研究顯示其具有高度遺傳性，並已識別出許多代謝物數量性狀基因座（mQTL）。雖然這些發現增進了我們對人類疾病生物學的理解，但豬隻的相對研究仍相當有限。結果：我們對 213 頭三元雜交豬 [（藍瑞斯 × 約克夏）× 杜洛克] 的血清代謝體進行了 GWAS，分析了 248 種代謝物和 30,628 種代謝物比值。基於連鎖不平衡（LD），我們識別出 41 個顯著的代謝物－變異關聯，並將其整合為 18 個 mQTL。數個區域與多種生化相關的代謝物相關，而其他區域則表現出高度特異性的效應。與人類 GWAS 資料庫進行的跨物種比較，揭示了位於 7 個 mQTL 內的候選基因。透過整合性優先排序策略，為 18 個 mQTL 中的 14 個識別出可能的因果基因——主要是酵素和轉運蛋白。結論：我們的結果擴展了影響豬隻血清代謝物變異的遺傳基因座目錄，並凸顯了代謝調控中保守性與豬隻特異性的成分。這些發現為將代謝體學納入豬隻育種計畫奠定基礎，並強化了豬隻作為研究人類代謝相關性狀與疾病之轉譯模型的價值。

papers.title: Resequencing‐Based GWAS Highlights SNP and Indel Loci and lncRNA Candidates for Carcass Yield and Meat Quality in Yellow‐Feathered Broilers
papers.abstract: Carcass and meat quality traits are economically important in poultry breeding. To investigate their genetic architecture and identify potential candidate regulators, we performed whole‐genome resequencing (WGS) and an integrative genome‐wide association study (GWAS) on 315 breast muscle samples from yellow‐feathered broilers, jointly analyzing SNP and Indels across 14 carcass and meat quality traits. We identified about 13.5 million SNPs and 1.24 million Indels. Across 14 carcass and meat quality traits, 364 significant SNPs ( p < 1.0 × 10 6 ) and 52 significant Indels ( p < 1.0 × 10 −6 ) were detected, clustering into nine genomic regions. Key candidate genes included CNTN5 for leg muscle percentage, SORCS1 for crude fat (CF), CNN3 for shear force, and APOB and SQLE for total cholesterol. We further used tissue‐specific transcriptome‐derived lncRNA annotations to identify candidate lncRNAs located within ±100 kb of significant GWAS loci. These lncRNAs were prioritized as genomic‐proximity‐based candidates for future functional validation. Functional enrichment analysis indicated involvement of PI3K‐Akt and Wnt signaling pathways, lipid metabolism, and cytoskeletal regulation. These findings provide new insights into the genetic basis of carcass yield and meat quality traits in yellow‐feathered chickens and offer molecular markers and regulatory candidates for future molecular breeding strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 胴體與肉質性狀在家禽育種中具有重要的經濟價值。為探討其遺傳結構並識別潛愛的候選調節因子，我們對 315 個黃羽肉雞胸肌樣本進行了全基因組重測序（WGS）與整合性全基因組關聯研究（GWAS），聯合分析了 14 個胴體與肉質性狀的單核苷酸多態性（SNP）與插入缺失變異（Indel）。我們共識別出約 1350 萬個 SNP 和 124 萬個 Indel。在 14 個胴體與肉質性狀中共檢測到 364 個顯著 SNP（$p < 1.0 \times 10^{-6}$）與 52 個顯著 Indel（$p < 1.0 \times 10^{-6}$），並聚類於 9 個基因組區域中。主要的候選基因包括控制腿肌率的 CNTN5、控制粗脂肪（CF）的 SORCS1、控制剪切力的 CNN3，以及控制總膽固醇的 APOB 與 SQLE。我們進一步利用組織特異性轉錄體衍生的 lncRNA 註釋，識別出位於顯著 GWAS 位點 $\pm 100\text{ kb}$ 內的候選 lncRNA。這些 lncRNA 被優先選為基於基因組鄰近性的候選分子，以供未來進行功能驗證。功能富集分析顯示其參與了 PI3K-Akt 和 Wnt 信號傳導路徑、脂質代謝及細胞骨架調控。這些發現為黃羽雞胴體產量與肉質性狀的遺傳基礎提供了新的見解，並為未來的分子育種策略提供了分子標記與調控候選者。

papers.title: Multi-omics prediction of swine production traits with linear mixed models
papers.abstract: Background Current prediction of phenotypes often relies on single-nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) data from DNA microarrays. Advances in biotechnology now enable large-scale collection of complementary omics data, such as transcriptomics and epigenomics. How much these additional molecular layers improve prediction accuracy, compared to SNP-based models, merits investigation. We evaluated whether using RNA transcript abundance and DNA methylation levels from loin muscle biopsies increased phenotype prediction accuracies for four traits in swine: average daily gain (ADG), backfat thickness (BFT), residual feed intake (RFI), and strength score (STR). We obtained transcriptomic (RNA sequencing) and epigenomic (reduced representation bisulphite sequencing) data of 443 boars representing the Duroc, Landrace, and Yorkshire breeds. We fitted linear mixed models incorporating genomic, transcriptomic, and epigenomic effects, and evaluated predictive performance by the correlation between preadjusted and predicted phenotypes obtained through cross-validation. Results When animals from all breeds were used, the predictive accuracy (measured by the correlation between predicted values and preadjusted phenotypes in leave-one-out cross-validation) for ADG ranged from 0.12 with genomic best linear unbiased prediction (GBLUP) to 0.37 with transcriptomic–methylomic BLUP (TMBLUP) and genomic–transcriptomic–methylomic BLUP (GTMBLUP). For BFT, accuracies ranged from 0.18 with methylomic BLUP (MBLUP) to 0.39 with genomic–transcriptomic BLUP (GTBLUP) and GTMBLUP. For RFI, accuracies ranged from 0.19 (pedigree BLUP, GBLUP, MBLUP) to 0.58 (GTBLUP). For STR, accuracies ranged from −0.27 (MBLUP) to 0.11 with transcriptomic BLUP (TBLUP), TMBLUP, GTBLUP, and GTMBLUP. Genomic–methylomic BLUP (GMBLUP) models exhibited intermediate predictive performances. Conclusions Incorporating transcriptomic and epigenomic data from loin muscle biopsies increased the accuracy of phenotype prediction relative to standard GBLUP, with transcriptomic information serving as the primary driver of these gains. Among the single-omics models, TBLUP attained the highest accuracies, while MBLUP exhibited the lowest performance. The combined GTMBLUP model was among the best-performing models overall, although gains relative to GTBLUP or TMBLUP were modest when present.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：目前對表型（phenotypes）的預測通常依賴DNA晶片中的單核苷酸多型性（SNP）資料。生物技術的進步現在能夠大規模收集互補的體學（omics）資料，例如轉錄體學與表觀基因體學。與基於SNP的模型相比，這些額外的分子層級能在多大程度上提高預測準確度，相當值得探討。我們評估了使用背肌活檢組織的RNA轉錄本豐度與DNA甲基化水準，是否能提高豬隻四種性狀的表型預測準確度：平均日增重（ADG）、背脂厚度（BFT）、殘餘採食量（RFI）及體力評分（STR）。我們獲取了代表杜洛克、藍瑞斯與約克夏三個品種共443頭公豬的轉錄體學（RNA定序）與表觀基因體學（減表徵亞硫酸鹽定序）資料。我們擬合了納入基因體、轉錄體及表觀基因體效應的線性混合模型，並透過交叉驗證所得之預調整表型與預測表型之間的相關性來評估預測效能。結果：當使用所有品種的動物時，日增重（ADG）的預測準確度（以留一法交叉驗證中預測值與預調整表型之間的相關性衡量）從基因體最佳線性不偏預測（GBLUP）的0.12，到轉錄體－甲基體BLUP（TMBLUP）與基因體－轉錄體－甲基體BLUP（GTMBLUP）的0.37不等。就背脂厚度（BFT）而言，準確度從甲基體BLUP（MBLUP）的0.18，到基因體－轉錄體BLUP（GTBLUP）與GTMBLUP的0.39不等。就殘餘採食量（RFI）而言，準確度從0.19（譜系BLUP、GBLUP、MBLUP）到0.58（GTBLUP）不等。就體力評分（STR）而言，準確度從−0.27（MBLUP）到轉錄體BLUP（TBLUP）、TMBLUP、GTBLUP及GTMBLUP的0.11不等。基因體－甲基體BLUP（GMBLUP）模型展現了中等的預測效能。結論：相較於標準的GBLUP，納入背肌活檢組織的轉錄體與表觀基因體資料提高了表型預測的準確度，其中轉錄體資訊是這些提升的主要驅動力。在單體學模型中，TBLUP獲得了最高的準確度，而MBLUP的表現最低。綜合的GTMBLUP模型整體而言是表現最好的模型之一，儘管相對於GTBLUP或TMBLUP的提升幅度（若有顯現的話）相對較小。

papers.title: Estimation of Genetic Parameters for Semen Quality Traits in Large White and Landrace Boars
papers.abstract: Artificial insemination is used widely in the swine industry, resulting in increasing focus on the traits of boar semen and methods for their genetic improvement. This study analyzed 21,160 phenotypic records of fresh semen derived from 492 Large White boars and 231 Landrace boars. The semen traits included the semen volume (VOL), sperm concentration (CON), sperm motility (MOT), and abnormal sperm rate (ABN). Single-trait and multi-trait repeatability models were used to assess the overall genetic parameters of semen traits, while random regression models were applied to examine trends in heritability changes over the collection period. In addition, multi-trait repeatability models were also used to estimate genetic and phenotypic correlations among the traits. The single-trait repeatability model indicated heritability estimates of VOL, MOT, CON, and ABN of 0.23, 0.09, 0.22, and 0.07, respectively, for Large White boars, with corresponding values for Landrace boars of 0.42, 0.06, 0.16, and 0.17. The respective values calculated by the multi-trait repeatability model were 0.23, 0.08, 0.22 and 0.09 for Large White boars and 0.43, 0.06, 0.20 and 0.17 for Landrace boars. Sperm motility, sperm concentration, and abnormal sperm rate showed low-to-moderate heritability. Semen volume showed moderate heritability in Large White boars and high heritability in Landrace boars. The random regression results indicated heritability estimates for VOL, MOT, CON, and ABN of 0.24–0.53, 0.05–0.08, 0.13–0.23, and 0.03–0.31, respectively, for Large White boars and 0.08–0.31, 0.02–0.15, 0.26–0.53, and 0.12–0.17 for Landrace boars. Significant negative genetic correlations were found between VOL and CON in both breeds (−0.54 for Large White and −0.73 for Landrace), and between VOL and MOT in Landrace. These findings will facilitate more precise selection to improve boar semen quality and reproductive efficiency in the swine industry.
papers.abstract_zh: 人工授精技術在養豬產業中被廣泛應用，使得公豬精液性狀及其基因改良方法的關注度日益增加。本研究分析了來自 492 頭大白豬和 231 頭藍瑞薩豬的 21,160 筆新鮮精液表現型紀錄。精液性狀包括精液量（VOL）、精子濃度（CON）、精子活力（MOT）及異常精子率（ABN）。本研究採用單性狀與多性狀重複力模型來評估精液性狀的整體遺傳參數，並應用隨機迴歸模型來檢視整個採精期間遺傳力變化的趨勢。此外，亦利用多性狀重複力模型估算性狀間的遺傳相關與表現型相關。單性狀重複力模型顯示，大白公豬的 VOL、MOT、CON 和 ABN 遺傳力估值分別為 0.23、0.09、0.22 和 0.07，藍瑞薩公豬的對應數值則分別為 0.42、0.06、0.16 和 0.17。透過多性狀重複力模型計算的相應數值，大白公豬分別為 0.23、0.08、0.22 和 0.09，藍瑞薩公豬則為 0.43、0.06、0.20 和 0.17。精子活力、精子濃度和異常精子率表現出低至中等的遺傳力。精液量在大白公豬中呈中等遺傳力，在藍瑞薩公豬中則呈高遺傳力。隨機迴歸結果顯示，大白公豬的 VOL、MOT、CON 和 ABN 遺傳力估值範圍分別為 0.24–0.53、0.05–0.08、0.13–0.23 和 0.03–0.31，藍瑞薩公豬則分別為 0.08–0.31、0.02–0.15、0.26–0.53 和 0.12–0.17。兩個品種的 VOL 與 CON 之間皆存在顯著的負遺傳相關（大白豬為 −0.54，藍瑞薩豬為 −0.73），藍瑞薩豬的 VOL 與 MOT 之間亦然。這些研究結果將有助於更精準地進行選育，以改善養豬產業中公豬的精液品質與繁殖效率。

papers.title: Impact of chronic cyclic heat stress on breast muscle proteomics in broiler chicken
papers.abstract: 1. Previous work has demonstrated that chronic cyclic heat stress (HS; 33°C for 8 h/day) resulted an 18.2% reduction in broiler breast muscle compared to a thermoneutral cohort (TN; 23°C). Given the deleterious impact of HS on broiler breast muscle mass, mass spectrometry (MS)-based proteomics was employed in the following trial to compare muscle protein expression in broiler chicken kept under HS or TN conditions. This investigated molecular mechanisms involved in HS-induced reduction of breast muscle mass.2. The experiment ran in broilers aged days 15–35. Acclimation occurred from day 15 to day 21, when birds in the HS group were exposed to a stepwise increase in temperature from 28°C to 33°C (8 h/day), achieving 33°C by day 21 which was maintained until day 35.3. On day 35, male birds were selected randomly (n = 10/treatment; total n = 20) and euthanised for breast muscle proteome profiling. Proteomic analyses were performed using pen-level biological replication (n = 4/treatment group) to identify proteins differentially abundant in response to chronic cyclic HS. The LC-MS/MS proteomics combined with bioinformatics was undertaken to identify proteins in breast muscle with significant changes in abundance in response to HS exposure.4. Bioinformatics confirmed that 116 proteins were differentially expressed, with the majority downregulated (88%) under HS, as determined at a significant fusion score ≤ 0.05. The KEGG pathways related to extracellular matrix organisation and structural integrity, including cytoskeleton in muscle cells, extra-cellular matrix (ECM)-receptor interaction and focal adhesion, were significantly enriched. The majority of associated proteins in these pathways were downregulated in breast muscle of HS-challenged broilers.5. Gene Ontology Cellular Component terms, including extracellular matrix and external encapsulating structure were enriched, likely indicating HS-induced impairment of muscle structural stability and cell–matrix interactions in broiler breast muscle.
papers.abstract_zh:
1. 先前研究顯示，與適溫對照組（TN；23°C）相比，慢性週期性熱緊迫（HS；33°C，每天 8 小時）導致肉雞胸肌減少了 18.2%。鑑於熱緊迫對肉雞胸肌質量的負面影響，本試驗採用基於質譜（MS）的蛋白質體學，比較飼養於熱緊迫或適溫條件下肉雞的肌肉蛋白質表現，以探討熱緊迫導致胸肌質量減少所涉及的分子機制。

2. 本試驗使用 15 至 35 日齡的肉雞。馴化期為 15 日齡至 21 日齡，期間熱緊迫組的雞隻經歷溫度自 28°C 至 33°C（每天 8 小時）的逐步升高，於 21 日齡達到 33°C 並維持至 35 日齡。

3. 在 35 日齡時，隨機選取公雞（每處理 n = 10，總 n = 20）並安樂死，以進行胸肌蛋白質體譜分析。蛋白質體分析採用欄舍層級的生物學重複（每處理組 n = 4），以鑑定因應慢性週期性熱緊迫而表現量有差異的蛋白質。本研究結合液相層析串聯質譜（LC-MS/MS）蛋白質體學與生物資訊學，以鑑定因熱緊迫暴露而使胸肌中蛋白質表現量發生顯著變化的蛋白質。

4. 生物資訊學證實有 116 種蛋白質有顯著表現差異，在顯著融合分數 $\le$ 0.05 的標準下，熱緊迫下絕大多數蛋白質（88%）表現量下調。與細胞外基質組織和結構完整性相關的 KEGG 通路顯著富集，包括肌細胞中的細胞骨架、細胞外基質（ECM）-受體交互作用以及細胞黏附。這些通路中多數相關的蛋白質在熱緊迫處理肉雞的胸肌中皆表現量下調。

5. 基因本體論（Gene Ontology）細胞組分術語（包括細胞外基質和外部包被結構）顯著富集，這可能暗示熱緊迫導致肉雞胸肌的肌肉結構穩定性及細胞與基質交互作用受損。

papers.title: Genotype × Nutritional Environment Interactions in Grazing Beef Cow-Calf Systems: Evidence for Crossbreeding and Reproductive Efficiency from Breeding to Weaning
papers.abstract: Reproductive efficiency determines the biological and economic sustainability of grazing beef cow–calf systems, yet the extent to which nutritional conditions modify genotype-associated reproductive performance remains unclear. This review critically examines the relationships among crossbreeding, heterosis, herbage allowance, and reproductive outcomes across the breeding-to-weaning continuum. A structured narrative synthesis evaluated 36 publications, classified as direct reproductive genotype × nutritional environment (G × N) evidence (Level I, n = 2), genotype and crossbreeding evidence (Level II, n = 14), nutritional evidence (Level III, n = 9), and mechanistic or supportive evidence (Level IV, n = 11). Across the reviewed studies, crossbreeding was frequently associated with favorable reproductive and maternal outcomes, although the magnitude and consistency of these associations varied among breed combinations, production environments, and reproductive endpoints. Greater forage availability and more favorable nutritional status were also associated with improved body condition and reproductive outcomes in some studies, consistent with established metabolic and endocrine mechanisms. However, these genotype- and nutrition-associated patterns do not, by themselves, establish causal effects or G × N interactions. Only two publications directly evaluated reproductive G × N within an analytical framework, both originating from a shared grazing research program. One reported stage-specific interaction evidence, particularly during the calving-to-weaning period, while the other included an interaction term without separately reporting its estimate. Nutritional effects varied with physiological stage, parity, body condition, and previous nutritional exposure. These findings emphasize that pregnancy rate alone incompletely represents reproductive efficiency because subsequent reproductive and calf losses influence cumulative productivity. Calves weaned per cow exposed, supplemented by calf weight weaned, provides a more comprehensive endpoint. Independent, longitudinal factorial studies across diverse genotypes and grazing environments are needed to establish the reproducibility, biological significance, and management implications of reproductive G × N interactions.
papers.abstract_zh: 繁殖效率決定了放牧肉牛母子牛系統的生物學與經濟永續性，然而營養狀況改變基因型相關繁殖性能的程度仍不清楚。本篇綜論批判性地檢視了從配種到斷奶連續過程中，品種改良雜交、雜種優勢、牧草容許量與繁殖表現之間的關係。透過結構化敘述性綜合分析評估了 36 篇文獻，並將其分類為直接的繁殖基因型 × 營養環境（G × N）證據（第一級，n = 2）、基因型與雜交證據（第二級，n = 14）、營養證據（第三級，n = 9）以及機制或支持性證據（第四級，n = 11）。在所審視的研究中，雜交通常與良好的繁殖及母性表現相關，儘管這些相關性的大小和一致性在不同品種組合、生產環境與繁殖終點之間有所差異。在部分研究中，較高的牧草可利用率與較佳的營養狀態也與改善的體況及繁殖表現相關，這與既有的代謝與內分泌機制一致。然而，這些與基因型和營養相關的模式本身並不能確立因果效應或 G × N 互動作用。僅有兩篇文獻在分析架構內直接評估了繁殖 G × N，兩者皆源自同一個放牧研究計畫。其中一篇報告了具分階段特異性的互動作用證據，特別是在分娩至斷奶期間；另一篇則包含互動作用項，但未單獨報告其估計值。營養效應隨生理階段、胎次、體況及先前的營養暴露而異。這些發現強調，單純的受胎率無法完整代表繁殖效率，因為隨後的繁殖與仔牛損失會影響累積生產力。以每頭配種母牛斷奶仔牛數（配合斷奶仔牛總重）作為終點指標，能提供更全面的評估。需要在多樣化的基因型與放牧環境中進行獨立、縱向的析因研究，以確立繁殖 G × N 互動作用的可重複性、生物學意義與管理意涵。

papers.title: Effects of Feeding Sunflower Meal and Superdosing Phytase on the Production Traits and Nutrient Digestion of Broiler Chickens
papers.abstract: Sunflower meal (SFM) is an alternative protein source for poultry. It is locally available and cheap, and its protein is rich in methionine and cystine. The high fibre and phytate content of SFM are, however, limitation factors. The aim of this study was to examine the effects of feeding SFM and using superdosing phytase (1500 FTU) on the production performance and nutrient digestibility of broiler chickens. A total of 576-day-old male Ross 308 broilers were fed four iso-nitrogenous and iso-caloric diets: control (C), C with superdosing phytase (CP), SFM, and SFM with superdosing phytase (SFMP). SFM was included at 20% and 30% in the grower and finisher phases, respectively. Neither SFM nor phytase superdosing affected the production traits in the grower phase. However, in the finisher phase, SFM significantly increased body weight gain (BWG) and decreased the feed conversion ratio (FCR). This positive result was also true for the cumulative performance of birds. On day 42, feeding SFM increased fat digestibility and the AMEn content of diets, but decreased the digestion of starch. Superdosing phytase increased both fat and starch digestion, as well as the AMEn and the N-retention of chickens. SFM was found to have no effect on the apparent ileal amino acid (AA) digestibility. Conversely, the phytase treatment significantly increased the absorption of several essential AAs. In conclusion, not only is fibre SFM tolerated by broiler chickens, but it can also improve production traits. Although superdosing phytase positively affects the digestibility of nutrients, it fails to cause changes in the BWG or FCR of chickens.
papers.abstract_zh: 葵花籽粕（SFM）是家禽的一種替代蛋白質來源。它在地易取得且價格低廉，其蛋白質富含甲硫胺酸與胱胺酸。然而，SFM的高纖維與植酸含量是其限制因素。本研究旨在探討餵食SFM及使用超劑量植酸酶（1500 FTU）對肉雞生產性能與營養分消化率的影響。總共576隻一日齡Ross 308公肉雞被餵食四種等氮、等能的飼料：對照組（C）、添加超劑量植酸酶的對照組（CP）、葵花籽粕組（SFM），以及添加超劑量植酸酶的葵花籽粕組（SFMP）。在生長前期與育肥期，SFM的添加比例分別為20%與30%。無論是SFM或超劑量植酸酶均未影響生長前期的生產性狀。然而，在育肥期，SFM顯著提高了體重增加量（BWG）並降低了飼料轉換率（FCR）。此正向結果也體現在雞隻的累積生產性能上。在第42天，餵食SFM提高了脂肪消化率與飼料的代謝能（AMEn）含量，但降低了澱粉的消化率。超劑量植酸酶則同時提高了脂肪與澱粉的消化率，以及雞隻的AMEn和氮滯留率。研究發現SFM對表觀迴腸胺基酸（AA）消化率無影響。相反地，植酸酶處理顯著提高了數種必需胺基酸的吸收。結論是，肉雞不僅能耐受富含纖維的SFM，它還能改善生產性狀。儘管超劑量植酸酶對營養分消化率有正向影響，但未能引起雞隻BWG或FCR的改變。

papers.title: Heritability of Productive, Reproductive and Carcass Traits in Pure‐Bred and Cross‐Bred Pigs: A Systematic Review and Meta‐Analysis
papers.abstract: Heritability ( h 2 ) is a key parameter in animal breeding, but its magnitude and consistency across pure‐bred (PB) and cross‐bred (CB) pig populations remain poorly understood. This study aimed to compare heritability estimates between PB and CB populations for economically relevant traits through a systematic review and meta‐analysis. A total of 28 studies (75 independent h 2 estimates) were identified through searches in PubMed, Mendeley, Springer, ScienceDirect and Google Scholar (2000–2024). Multilevel random‐effects models with logit transformation were applied. Traits were grouped into reproductive, growth, conformation and carcass categories. Reproductive traits showed low heritability (e.g., litter size: 0.06 in PB and 0.20 in CB; number born alive [NBA]: 0.07 in CB), whereas growth and carcass traits exhibited moderate values (e.g., average daily gain: 0.21 in PB and 0.31 in CB; intramuscular fat: 0.31 in PB and 0.29 in CB; pH: 0.23–0.26). Meta‐regression did not detect a significant effect of population type ( β = 0.124, p = 0.630), whereas studies accounting for non‐additive genetic effects showed significantly different heritability estimates (QM = 4.35, p = 0.037), and high heterogeneity was observed across traits ( I 2 > 90%). These results indicate that cross‐breeding does not systematically increase additive heritability. Instead, differences depend on trait type, likely reflecting differences in genetic architecture and the relative contribution of additive and non‐additive genetic effects. Overall, these findings highlight the importance of population‐specific genetic evaluations and context‐dependent breeding strategies in pig production, supporting the complementary interpretation of heritability and pure‐bred–cross‐bred genetic correlation (rPC) within Combined Cross‐bred and Pure‐bred Selection (CCPS) programmes.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Breeding and Genetics
papers.abstract_zh: 遺傳力（$h^2$）是動物育種中的關鍵參數，但其在純種（PB）與雜交（CB）豬族群中的大小與一致性仍所知有限。本研究旨在透過系統性文獻回顧與統合分析，比較純種與雜交族群在經濟重要性性狀上的遺傳力估計值。透過檢索 PubMed、Mendeley、Springer、ScienceDirect 和 Google Scholar（2000–2024年），共識別出 28 項研究（75 個獨立的 $h^2$ 估計值）。本研究採用具羅吉特轉換的多層次隨機效應模型。性狀被分為繁殖、生長、體型與屠體等類別。繁殖性狀顯示出低遺傳力（例如：總產仔數在純種為 0.06、雜交為 0.20；存活仔數 [NBA] 在雜交為 0.07），而生長與屠體性狀則呈現中等數值（例如：平均日增重在純種為 0.21、雜交為 0.31；肌內脂肪在純種為 0.31、雜交為 0.29；pH 值為 0.23–0.26）。統合迴歸分析未檢測到族群類型具有顯著效應（$\beta = 0.124$、$p = 0.630$），然而納入非加成性遺傳效應的研究則顯示出顯著不同的遺傳力估計值（$QM = 4.35$、$p = 0.037$），且各性狀間觀察到高度的異質性（$I^2 > 90\%$）。這些結果顯示，雜交並不會系統性地增加加成性遺傳力。相反地，差異取決於性狀類型，這可能反映了遺傳架構以及加成性與非加成性遺傳效應相對貢獻的差異。總體而言，這些發現突顯了豬隻生產中進行族群特異性遺傳評估與情境依賴育種策略的重要性，並支援了在結合雜交與純種選育（CCPS）計畫中對遺傳力及純雜交遺傳相關（$r_{PC}$）的互補性解讀。

papers.title: Marker Prioritization With Different Fine Mapping Strategies Improves Genomic Selection Performance
papers.abstract: Feature reduction of genetic markers and its impact on genomic selection has been studied extensively. Prior information borrowed from genome‐wide association studies (GWAS) can improve genomic selection accuracy. However, the effect of integration of posterior inclusion probability (PIP) information from fine mapping algorithm and linkage disequilibrium (LD) on genomic selection remains less studied. Here, three marker prioritization strategies—genome‐wide fine‐mapping (GWFM), LD pruning (LDFM), and GWAS–informed LD pruning ((GWAS + LD)FM)—were evaluated, using Bayesian fine‐mapping integrated with linear and nonlinear genomic selection frameworks, across 12 traits for three species. A consistent ranking of prediction performance (GWFM < LDFM < (GWAS + LD)FM) was observed across species and statistical models. Moreover, (GWAS + LD)FM achieved prediction accuracy (96% of maximal accuracy) with markedly minimal number of marker subsets. Gene ontology enrichment analysis showed that prioritized loci could converge on functional modules of biological importance. Independent validation using another fine mapping algorithm (FINEMAP) replicated the identical performance ordering. Genetic variants prioritized by LD and fine mapping reduced dimensional complexity and only were minimal number of marker subsets required for improved genomic selection accuracy. Fine mapping‐informed dimension reduction provides novel insights and avenue for the enhancement of genomic selection performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 基因標記的特徵縮減及其對基因體選拔的影響已被廣泛研究。借用來自全基因體關聯分析（GWAS）的先驗資訊可以提高基因體選拔的準確率。然而，整合來自精細定位演算法的後驗包含機率（PIP）資訊以及連鎖不平衡（LD）對基因體選拔的影響，目前的研究仍較少。在本研究中，評估了三種標記優先排序策略：全基因體精細定位（GWFM）、LD修剪（LDFM）以及GWAS資訊結合LD修剪（(GWAS + LD)FM），並在三個物種的12個性狀中，使用結合線性與非線性基因體選拔框架的貝氏精細定位進行評估。在不同物種和統計模型中，觀察到一致的預測效能排序（GWFM < LDFM < (GWAS + LD)FM）。此外，(GWAS + LD)FM僅使用顯著極少數的標記子集，即實現了預測準確率（達到最大準確率的96%）。基因本體富集分析顯示，被優先排序的基因座能匯聚於具生物學重要性的功能模組。使用另一種精細定位演算法（FINEMAP）進行的獨立驗證，複製了相同的效能排序。透過LD和精細定位所優先排序的遺傳變異降低了維度複雜性，且僅需極少數的標記子集即可提高基因體選拔準確率。精細定位資訊指導的維度縮減，為提升基因體選拔效能提供了全新的見解與途徑。

papers.title: Genetic parameters and pedigree–based selective breeding outcomes for productivity traits in industrial black soldier fly (hermetia illucens L.) production systems
papers.abstract: Background Selective breeding in mass-reared insects has progressed rapidly in recent years, and the black soldier fly ( Hermetia illucens L. - Diptera: Stratiomyidae), the most widely cultivated insect species for animal feed, is emerging as a strong candidate for genetic improvement. Estimation of quantitative‑genetic parameters and implementation of pedigree‑based selection schemes are essential to increase genetic gain while controlling inbreeding under industrial rearing. Here, we report a pilot‑scale breeding experiment conducted under family group‑mating with partial pedigree uncertainty, designed to assess the genetic parameters of key growth and reproductive traits in H. illucens and to evaluate the feasibility of pedigree‑informed selection in an industrial context. Genetic parameters were estimated using multivariate REML animal models and breeding values were predicted using Best Linear Unbiased Prediction. The feasibility of systematic genetic improvement under industrial rearing conditions was assessed through seven generations of family selection. Results A total of 15 179 individuals from 266 full-sib isofamilies were phenotyped. Heritability estimates (± SE) were: larval weight at stage 1 (LW1, h 2 = 0.12 ± 0.08), stage 2 (LW2, h 2 = 0.13 ± 0.04), restricted-feed LW2 (LW2R, h 2 = 0.58 ± 0.03), female body weight at emergence (FEMBW, h 2 = 0.006 ± 0.005), pupal perimeter (PERIM, h 2 = 0.06 ± 0.09), oocyte number (OOCY, h 2 = 0.43 ± 0.09), and thorax size (THOR, h 2 = 0.40 ± 0.09). Several traits exhibited substantial environmental variance. Larval body-weight traits (LW1, LW2, LW2R) exhibited positive genetic correlations with thorax size and oocyte number, while female body weight at emergence was negatively correlated with larval body weight. In this pilot‑scale programme, seven generations of selection for larval body weight yielded indicative genetic improvement, tempered by design constraints and a detectable risk of inbreeding. Conclusions These multi-trait genetic parameter estimates indicate that several economically important traits in H. illucens are moderately to highly heritables. Although genetic correlations were generally trait-dependent and could be either positive or negative, supporting the potential for genetic improvement through appropriately designed multi-trait breeding strategies. Patterns observed for larval body weight are indicative of a genetic response under industrial conditions, although environmental contributions cannot be fully excluded in the absence of a control line. Together, these results suggest the potential for genetic improvement in H. illucens populations, provided that inbreeding is carefully managed through adequate selection nucleus size and pedigree organisation.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：近年來，大規模飼養昆蟲的選擇育種進展迅速，而作為動物飼料最廣泛養殖的昆蟲物種——黑水虻（*Hermetia illucens* L. - 雙翅目：水虻科），正逐漸成為遺傳改良的有力候選者。估計數量遺傳參數及實施基於系譜的選育方案，對於在工業化飼養下提高遺傳獲益同時控制近親交配至關重要。在此，我們報告了一項在家族群體交配且帶有部分系譜不確定性情況下進行的小規模育種實驗，旨在評估黑水虻關鍵生長與繁殖性狀的遺傳參數，並評估在工業環境中基於系譜選育的可行性。遺傳參數係利用多變量REML動物模型進行估計，育種值則透過最佳線性不偏預測法（BLUP）進行預測。透過七個世代的家族選擇，評估了在工業化飼養條件下進行系統性遺傳改良的可行性。結果：總共對來自 266 個全同胞同源家族的 15,179 個個體進行了表型測定。遺傳力估計值（± 標準誤）分別為：第 1 階段幼蟲體重（LW1，$h^2 = 0.12 \pm 0.08$）、第 2 階段幼蟲體重（LW2，$h^2 = 0.13 \pm 0.04$）、限食 LW2（LW2R，$h^2 = 0.58 \pm 0.03$）、羽化雌蟲體重（FEMBW，$h^2 = 0.006 \pm 0.005$）、蛹周長（PERIM，$h^2 = 0.06 \pm 0.09$）、卵母細胞數（OOCY，$h^2 = 0.43 \pm 0.09$）以及胸部大小（THOR，$h^2 = 0.40 \pm 0.09$）。多個性狀表現出顯著的環境變異。幼蟲體重性狀（LW1、LW2、LW2R）與胸部大小和卵母細胞數呈正向遺傳相關，而羽化雌蟲體重與幼蟲體重呈負相關。在這個小規模育種計畫中，針對幼蟲體重進行七個世代的選擇取得了指示性的遺傳改良，但受到設計限制和可檢測到的近親交配風險所調控。結論：這些多性狀遺傳參數估計表明，黑水虻的幾個經濟重要性狀具有中等到高度的遺傳力。儘管遺傳相關通常具性狀依賴性且可能為正向或負向，但這支持了透過適當設計的多性狀育種策略來實現遺傳改良的潛力。幼蟲體重觀察到的模式顯示了工業條件下的遺傳反應，儘管在缺乏對照品系的情況下無法完全排除環境貢獻。總體而言，這些結果表明黑水虻族群具有遺傳改良的潛力，前提是透過足夠的選擇核心群規模和系譜組織來仔細管理近親交配。

papers.title: Dietary pequi oil ( Caryocar brasiliense Camb.) improves feed efficiency and oxidative stability in broiler chickens
papers.abstract: 1. The effects of increasing dietary levels of pequi oil (PO) on growth performance, oxidative status, and meat quality of broilers over a 42-d production period were evaluated. A total of 1,440 one-day-old male Cobb 500 broilers were randomly allocated to one of six dietary treatments with eight replicates and 30 birds per pen. These included a positive control diet supplemented with Avilamycin (0.05 g/kg; AGP), a negative control diet (without treatment; CON) or CON supplemented with 1.5, 3.0, 4.5 or 6.0 g/kg PO.2. During the starter phase (d 1–21), increasing PO levels reduced body weight (BW) and average daily gain (ADG; p 0.05).3. There was no effect of diet on blood biochemical parameters, leukocyte profiles, or relative organ weights, although PO supplementation reduced plasma lipid oxidation (p < 0.001). Meat quality data showed that PO supplementation caused reductions in redness (a*), cooking loss and shear force (p < 0.05). Malondialdehyde content in breast meat decreased in line with PO inclusion in tests covering over 90 days of storage (p = 0.049).4. Supplementing diets with PO improved FCR and oxidative stability without adverse effects on bird health or carcass traits. The data support the use of PO as a natural feed additive to enhance performance and meat quality in broilers.
papers.abstract_zh:
1. 本研究評估在為期 42 天的生產週期中，增加飼糧中貝基果油（pequi oil, PO）添加量對肉雞生長性能、氧化狀態及肉質的影響。試驗共選用 1,440 隻一日齡 Cobb 500 公肉雞，隨機分配至六種飼糧處理組，每組八個重複，每欄 30 隻雞。處理組包含添加安維黴素（Avilamycin, 0.05 g/kg）的正對照組（AGP）、陰性對照組（無添加；CON），以及在 CON 中分別添加 1.5、3.0、4.5 或 6.0 g/kg PO 的試驗組。
2. 在前期階段（第 1 至 21 天），提高 PO 添加量會降低體重（BW）與平均日增重（ADG；p < 0.05）。
3. 飼糧對血液生化參數、白血球相或相對器官重量均無顯著影響，但 PO 添加降低了血漿脂質氧化（p < 0.001）。肉質數據顯示，添加 PO 導致紅度（a*）、調理損失及剪切力下降（p < 0.05）。在超過 90 天的儲存測試中，胸肉中的丙二醛（Malondialdehyde）含量隨著 PO 的添加而降低（p = 0.049）。
4. 飼糧中添加 PO 改善了飼料換肉率（FCR）與氧化穩定性，且對肉雞健康或屠體性狀無不良影響。此數據支持將 PO 作為天然飼料添加劑使用，以提升肉雞的生產性能與肉質。

papers.title: Beef-on-Dairy Crossbreeding: A Multidimensional Analysis and Gaps for Pasture-Based Production Systems
papers.abstract: Beef-on-dairy (BoD) crossbreeding, defined as the planned use of beef sires on dairy dams, has expanded as a strategy to increase the value of dairy-origin calves while maintaining herd replacement requirements. This review critically synthesizes research published since 2016 across six interconnected dimensions: genetics and genomics, management and productive efficiency, carcass performance and meat quality, farm economics, environmental sustainability, and animal welfare. The available evidence indicates that BoD can increase calf market value and improve selected growth and carcass traits, although the magnitude of these effects varies with sire genetic merit, dairy breed, reproductive performance, calf management, and finishing conditions. Genetic selection involves balancing calving ease and other functional traits against postnatal growth and carcass merit. Economic outcomes depend not only on calf prices but also on semen costs, reproductive efficiency, replacement requirements, and rearing and finishing expenses; therefore, improvements in individual production traits do not necessarily translate into greater whole-farm profitability. Environmental performance is similarly context-dependent and requires explicit consideration of system boundaries, functional units, emissions intensity, and potential soil carbon sequestration. Animal welfare must also be evaluated throughout the production chain rather than inferred from productive performance alone. A major limitation of the available evidence is its concentration in intensive and semi-intensive production systems, which restricts its transferability to permanent-pasture environments. Further research should prioritize longitudinal, farm-level evaluations from birth to slaughter under defined pasture-based conditions, integrating genetic and management decisions with productive, economic, environmental, and welfare outcomes.
papers.abstract_zh: 肉牛與乳牛雜交（Beef-on-dairy, BoD）是指刻意將肉牛公牛配種至乳牛母牛的繁殖策略，近年來其規模不斷擴大，旨在提升乳源犢牛的價值，同時維持牛群更新的需求。本篇文獻綜述批判性地綜合了自2016年以來發表、涵蓋六個互聯維度的研究：遺傳與基因體學、管理與生產效率、屠體性能與肉質、農場經濟、環境永續性以及動物福祉。現有證據顯示，BoD可以提高犢牛市場價值並改善特定的生長與屠體性狀，儘管這些效應的大小隨公牛遺傳價值、乳牛品種、繁殖性能、犢牛管理和育肥條件而異。遺傳選擇涉及平衡分娩難易度與其他功能性性狀，以及生長後期的表現與屠體優勢。經濟效益不僅取決於犢牛價格，還取決於精液成本、繁殖效率、牛群更新需求以及飼養和育肥開銷；因此，單一生產性狀的改善並不必然轉化為更高的全場獲利能力。環境績效同樣取決於具體情境，需要明確考量系統邊界、功能單位、排放強度以及潛在的土壤碳匯。動物福祉也必須在整個生產鏈中進行評估，而不應僅從生產表現來推斷。現有證據的一大限制是其集中於集約與半集約生產系統，這限制了其對永久牧場環境的適用性。未來研究應優先進行從出生到屠宰、在特定放牧條件下的縱向農場層級評估，將遺傳與管理決策整合至生產、經濟、環境與福祉等各項結果中。

papers.title: Neither Invasive nor Unprotected: The Legal Status of Muscovy Ducks in the United States
papers.abstract: Muscovy Ducks (Cairina moschata), one of the world’s oldest domesticated waterfowl, inhabit nearly all continents. Considered non-native across most of the United States, Muscovy Ducks are often described as “unprotected” or “invasive,” terms that may be used to justify harmful actions. The question is whether these descriptions accurately reflect their legal protection and wildlife classification. This study addresses that question through the first nationwide analysis of anti-cruelty statutes and invasive-species classifications at the federal and state levels. Results show that every state prohibits intentional cruelty toward Muscovy Ducks, subject to exemptions. While considered “unprotected” for conservation purposes, they remain protected under anti-cruelty statutes. No federal agency formally classifies Muscovy Ducks as “invasive.” Although two of the 50 states list Muscovy Ducks as invasive, each listing lacks science-based substantiation of harm in the state. This study corrects claims that Muscovy Ducks are legally unprotected or invasive. Misuse and misinterpretation of terms can obscure the reality that intentional cruelty against Muscovy Ducks is unlawful nationwide.
papers.abstract_zh: 番鴨（Cairina moschata）是世界上最古老的馴化水禽之一，棲息於幾乎所有大洲。在美國大多數地區，番鴨被視為外來種，常被形容為「不受保護」或「具侵入性」，這些用詞可能被用來合理化傷害行為。問題在於這些描述是否準確反映了牠們的法律保護與野生動物分類。本研究透過對聯邦及州層級之反虐待法規與外來入侵種分類的全國性首次分析，來探討此問題。結果顯示，扣除相關豁免條款後，美國每一州皆禁止對番鴨蓄意虐待。雖然基於保育目的牠們被視為「不受保護」，但在反虐待法規下牠們依然受到保護。沒有任何聯邦機構將番鴨正式歸類為「入侵種」。儘管在全美50個州中有2個州將番鴨列為入侵種，但每項名單皆缺乏該州具科學依據的危害佐證。本研究更正了關於番鴨在法律上不受保護或具侵入性的說法。對這些詞彙的誤用與誤解，可能會掩蓋蓄意虐待番鴨在全國各地皆屬違法的事實。

papers.title: Microbiome‐Informed Genomic Prediction of CH4:CO2 Ratio in Holstein Dairy Cattle Using 16S rRNA Profiles and SNP Markers
papers.abstract: Ruminant animals produce methane as a by‐product of microbial fermentation in the rumen, with cattle being the largest contributors among ruminants. Methane emissions may be influenced directly by the host's genetics and indirectly through host‐mediated effects on rumen microbiome composition. In this study, we investigated whether modelling both direct and indirect genetic effects could improve the genomic prediction of breeding values for methane emissions. We used genotype, methane CH 4 :CO 2 ratio and 16S rRNA gene amplicon sequencing data (16S), including 16S genus (16S‐G), 16S species (16S‐S) from Danish Holstein cows. A conventional genomic best linear unbiased prediction (GBLUP) model was used as a benchmark and compared with a microbiome‐informed GBLUP approach based on three linked linear mixed models for the prediction of breeding values. In GMBLUP, the first model regresses methane emissions on three random animal effects (archaeal 16S, bacterial 16S and polygenic effects) using corresponding microbiome and genomic relationship matrices. The second and third models separately regress archaeal and bacterial 16S on random animal effects defined by the genomic relationship matrix. We evaluated prediction accuracy using five‐fold cross‐validation. The GBLUP model, which used only genomic marker information, achieved a mean accuracy of 0.20 across the five folds when evaluated in the animal subsets corresponding to the 16S‐G and 16S‐S datasets, while GMBLUP showed higher accuracy, particularly for the 16S‐G dataset, with a mean accuracy of 0.48. These results highlight that incorporating microbiome information into genomic prediction models may improve predictive performance for the CH 4 :CO 2 ratio, although further validation in larger and independent populations is required before practical implementation in breeding programmes.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Breeding and Genetics
papers.abstract_zh: 反芻動物在瘤胃進行微生物發酵時會產生甲烷作為副產物，其中牛隻是反芻動物中最大的排放源。甲烷排放量可能直接受宿主基因型的影響，亦可能透過宿主對瘤胃微生物相組成的影響而間接受到調控。在本研究中，我們探討同時建模直接與間接遺傳效應是否能改善甲烷排放量育種值的基因體預測。我們使用丹麥荷斯坦乳牛的基因型、甲烷 $\text{CH}_4:\text{CO}_2$ 比值以及 16S rRNA 基因擴增子定序資料（16S），包含 16S 屬級（16S-G）與 16S 種級（16S-S）資料。本研究以傳統基因體最佳線性不偏預測（GBLUP）模型作為基準，並與基於三個相連線性混合模型、納入微生物相資訊的 GBLUP 方法（GMBLUP）進行比較，以預測育種值。在 GMBLUP 中，第一個模型利用對應的微生物相與基因體親緣關係矩陣，將甲烷排放量對三個隨機動物效應（古菌 16S、細菌 16S 及多元基因效應）進行迴歸；第二與第三個模型則分別將古菌與細菌 16S 對由基因體親緣關係矩陣所定義的隨機動物效應進行迴歸。我們利用五折交叉驗證來評估預測準確度。僅使用基因體標記資訊的 GBLUP 模型，在對應 16S-G 與 16S-S 資料集的動物子集進行評估時，五折的平均準確度為 0.20；而 GMBLUP 則展現出較高的準確度，特別是在 16S-G 資料集上，平均準確度達到 0.48。這些結果突顯出，將微生物相資訊納入基因體預測模型中，可望提升 $\text{CH}_4:\text{CO}_2$ 比值的預測效能，儘管在實際應用於育種計畫之前，仍需在更大且獨立的族群中進行進一步驗證。

papers.title: Extended-spectrum β-lactamase-producing Escherichia coli in chickens: prevalence and genetic diversity: a systematic review and meta-analaysis
papers.abstract: 1. Extended-spectrum β-lactamase-producing Escherichia coli (ESBL-EC) is an important antimicrobial-resistant pathogen in poultry that threatens animal health, food safety and public health. This study reviewed the global prevalence and genetic diversity of ESBL-EC in chickens and compared prevalence across continents and chicken production systems.2. A meta-analysis was conducted following PRISMA guidelines. Forty-five studies published between 2014 and 2023, comprising 13 761 E. coli isolates from broiler, layer and mixed-breed chickens, were included. Random-effects meta-analysis estimated pooled prevalence, while subgroup and meta-regression analyses explored heterogeneity. Any ESBL-associated genes were summarised.3. The pooled prevalence of ESBL-EC in chickens was 31.44% (95% CI: 23.81–39.07). Prevalence was highest in Asia (36.22%) and Africa (26.66%) and lowest in North America (5.20%). Broiler chickens showed substantially higher prevalence (33.13%) than layer chickens (8.79%).4. Genetic analysis demonstrated that CTX-M-type β-lactamases predominated, with blaCTX-M as the most frequently detected ESBL gene, followed by blaTEM and blaSHV. The higher prevalence in broiler chickens reflected intensive production systems, shorter production life spans and greater antimicrobial exposure. The lower prevalence in layer chickens reflects longer production life spans and comparatively lower antimicrobial usage.5. The resistant E. coli ESBL strain is widely distributed in poultry, particularly in production systems and in Asia and Africa. Strengthened antimicrobial stewardship, improved farm biosecurity and integrated ‘One Health’ surveillance are required to reduce the dissemination of ESBL-producingE. coli and mitigate associated public health risks.
papers.abstract_zh:
1. 產超廣效β-內醯胺酶大腸桿菌（ESBL-EC）是家禽中重要的抗生素抗藥性病原菌，對動物健康、食品安全和公共衛生構成威脅。本研究探討全球雞隻中ESBL-EC的流行病學與基因多樣性，並比較不同大洲與雞隻生產系統間的盛行率。

2. 本研究遵循PRISMA指南進行統合分析。納入了2014至2023年間發表的45篇研究，包含來自肉雞、蛋雞和混種雞的13,761株大腸桿菌分離株。採用隨機效應統合分析估算合併盛行率，同時透過次分組與統合迴歸分析探討異質性。並對所有ESBL相關基因進行了總結。

3. 雞隻中ESBL-EC的合併盛行率為31.44%（95% CI：23.81–39.07）。亞洲（36.22%）和非洲（36.22%）的盛行率最高，北美洲（5.20%）最低。肉雞的盛行率（33.13%）顯著高於蛋雞（8.79%）。

4. 基因分析顯示，CTX-M型β-內醯胺酶占主導地位，其中 $bla_{\text{CTX-M}}$ 是最常檢測到的ESBL基因，其次為 $bla_{\text{TEM}}$ 和 $bla_{\text{SHV}}$。肉雞盛行率較高，反映出其集約化生產系統、較短的生產週期以及較高的抗生素暴露量。蛋雞盛行率較低則反映其較長的生產週期與相對較低的抗生素使用量。

5. 抗藥性大腸桿菌ESBL菌株在家禽中廣泛散布，特別是在特定生產系統以及亞洲和非洲地區。必須加強抗生素管理、改善農場生物安全，並落實整合性的「健康一體」（One Health）監測，以減少產ESBL大腸桿菌的傳播並降低相關的公共衛生風險。

papers.title: FBLN1 Regulates Embryonic Myoblast Proliferation and Differentiation in Geese: Functional Characterization of a Meat Quality‐Associated Candidate Gene From Prior Multi‐Omics Screening
papers.abstract: Meat quality is a vital economic trait in geese and is largely determined by embryonic muscle development. Building on previously reported whole‐genome resequencing and breast muscle transcriptome data from Xianghai Flying (XHF) Goose and Zi Goose, two breeds with divergent meat quality, f ib ulin ‐ 1 ( FBLN1 ) was identified as a candidate gene showing both strong selection signals and significant differential expression. FBLN1 was overexpressed and knocked down in primary goose embryonic myoblasts. Because no goose‐specific antibody is commercially available, all readouts were obtained at the mRNA level. FBLN1 was found to promote myoblast proliferation and to accelerate the G1/S cell cycle transition, with increased expression of CCND1 and CDK2 . Apoptosis was concurrently suppressed, accompanied by downregulation of Bax and upregulation of Bcl‐2 , whereas transcript levels of Caspase‐3 and Caspase‐9 remained unaltered. The mRNA levels of the myogenic differentiation markers Myomaker , MYOD1 , and MYF5 were correspondingly affected. Bioinformatic analyses predicted FBLN1 to be an extracellular matrix protein that interacts with proteins implicated in muscle elasticity, tenderness, and juiciness. These findings suggest that FBLN1 plays an important role in embryonic myoblast development and represents a valuable candidate gene for improving goose meat quality, thereby offering new perspectives for poultry molecular breeding.
papers.abstract_zh: 肉質是鵝隻至關重要的經濟性狀，主要由胚胎期肌肉發育所決定。基於先前報導之向海飛鵝與仔鵝（兩種肉質差異顯著的品種）的全基因組重定序與胸肌轉錄體數據，fibulin-1 (FBLN1) 被鑑定為同時具有強烈選擇訊號及顯著差異表達的候選基因。本研究在鵝胚胎原代成肌細胞中對 FBLN1 進行了過表現與基因敲減。由於市面上缺乏鵝專屬抗體，所有檢測數據皆於 mRNA 層面取得。研究發現，FBLN1 能促進成肌細胞增殖並加速 G1/S 細胞週期轉換，同時伴隨 CCND1 與 CDK2 表達量增加；細胞凋亡則同時受到抑制，表現為 Bax 下調及 Bcl-2 上調，而 Caspase-3 與 Caspase-9 的轉錄水平則保持不變。肌源性分化標記物 Myomaker、MYOD1 及 MYF5 的 mRNA 水平也受到相應影響。生物資訊學分析預測 FBLN1 是一種細胞外基質蛋白，會與涉及肌肉彈性、嫩度及多汁性的蛋白質相互作用。這些研究結果表明，FBLN1 在胚胎成肌細胞發育中發揮重要作用，是改善鵝肉質的珍貴候選基因，從而為家禽分子育種提供了新的視角。

papers.title: Using a random regression model to estimate additive and non-additive genetic variance components for body weight traits in Japanese quail
papers.abstract: 1. Estimating genetic parameters accurately is crucial in breeding programmes. Random regression models (RRM) are used to analyse longitudinal data or repeated records over time. The following study genetically evaluated body weight traits of quail using different regression models that considered dominance effects, as well as direct additive genetic effects, maternal effects and the bird's permanent environment.2. For this purpose, 30 363 body weight records from 3836 quails aged between 1 and 45 d were used with a 5‑d recording interval. After editing, the data were analysed using various random regression models (RRM), each varying in terms of the number of effects and the order of Legendre polynomials. The appropriate model was selected using the log-likelihood, Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC), Akaike Information Criterion (AIC), variance components and genetic parameters of body weight traits at different ages were estimated.3. The results of the model comparison showed that the model containing direct additive genetics (4th order), maternal genetics (3rd order), the bird's permanent environment (1st order) and dominance (1st order) was deemed suitable. Maternal permanent environment did not have a significant effect on body weight. The increasing trend of variance components was observed with bird age, although they were different in terms of relative increase.4. Heritability of body weight traits was estimated to range from 0.151 to 0.639. The ratio of maternal genetic, bird's permanent environment and dominance to the phenotypic variance of body weight traits was high in early ages, but decreased in later ages. Estimated correlations for ages older than 20 d were higher than those for younger birds.5. The results indicated that permanent environment, maternal genetics and dominance effects should be considered in the model to accurately estimate genetic parameters. Additionally, body weight at 20 d of age can serve as a selection criterion to enhance body weight at older ages, given its strong correlation with later body weight traits and high heritability.
papers.abstract_zh:
1. 準確估計遺傳參數對育種計畫至關重要。隨機迴歸模型（RRM）可用於分析縱向數據或隨時間重複的記錄。本研究利用不同的迴歸模型，對鵪鶉的體重性狀進行遺傳評估，這些模型同時考慮了顯性效應，以及直接累加遺傳效應、母體效應和個體永久環境效應。

2. 為此，本研究使用了 3,836 隻、年齡介於 1 至 45 日齡間的鵪鶉共 30,363 筆體重記錄，記錄間隔為 5 天。經過資料篩選後，使用多種隨機迴歸模型（RRM）進行分析，各模型在效應數量和勒讓德多項式（Legendre polynomials）階數上有所不同。根據對數概似值（log-likelihood）、貝氏資訊準則（BIC）與赤池資訊準則（AIC）選出適當的模型，並估計不同日齡體重性狀的方差組分與遺傳參數。

3. 模型比較結果顯示，包含直接累加遺傳（4 階）、母體遺傳（3 階）、個體永久環境（1 階）和顯性（1 階）的模型被認為是最合適的。母體永久環境對體重沒有顯著影響。雖然方差組分隨鳥隻年齡增長而呈上升趨勢，但其相對增長的幅度有所不同。

4. 體重性狀的遺傳率估計值介於 0.151 至 0.639 之間。母體遺傳、個體永久環境和顯性佔體重性狀表現型方差的比率在早期年齡較高，但在較晚期年齡則下降。大於 20 日齡的估計相關性高於較年輕的個體。

5. 結果表明，在模型中應將永久環境、母體遺傳和顯性效應納入考量，以準確估計遺傳參數。此外，鑑於 20 日齡體重與較晚期體重性狀具有強相關性且遺傳率高，該日齡之體重可作為一項選擇標準，以提升較晚期時的體重。

papers.title: Establishment and validation of porcine embryo genomic selection system through SCNT technique
papers.abstract: Background Embryo genomic selection (EGS) refers to the technique of performing genotyping and genomic prediction at the preimplantation stage. When combined with in vitro embryo production method, EGS enhances selection intensity and offers the potential to prevent the birth of offspring carrying genetic defects or an undesired sex. Given that the somatic cell nuclear transfer (SCNT) technique can copy the genetic information from donor pigs into early embryos, this study aims to establish and validate a complete porcine EGS workflow by integrating SCNT with genomic selection methodology. Results First, porcine SCNT embryos were constructed using donor cells collected from candidate pigs with known genotypes and phenotypes. Cell biopsy performed in SCNT embryos revealed that collecting approximately 9.5 trophectoderm (TE) cells from blastocysts had the least impact on subsequent development. Next, a whole-genome multiple displacement amplification protocol was optimized for TE biopsy cells to conduct 80 K single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) array analysis. The SNP call rates ranged from 94.44% to 99.77%, with genotype concordance between SCNT embryos and their donor pigs mostly exceeding 95%. Finally, genomic estimated breeding values (GEBVs) for three production traits were calculated using the GBLUP and Bayesian methods, and strong positive correlations ( r > 0.90) of GEBVs were observed for each embryo and its donor. Conclusions This study establishes and validates a complete EGS workflow for pigs, including embryo biopsy, whole-genome amplification, SNP genotyping, and GEBV prediction. The workflow provides a technical foundation for applying EGS in pig breeding and has the potential to accelerate genetic improvement through early embryo selection. Additionally, the results demonstrate that SCNT can be used to replicate elite genetic resources for the pig farming industry.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Science and Biotechnology
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：胚胎基因體選擇（Embryo genomic selection, EGS）是指在著床前階段進行基因型鑑定與基因體預測的技術。當結合體外胚胎生產方法時，EGS 可提升選拔強度，並具備預防帶有遺傳缺陷或非預期性別後代出生之潛力。鑑於體細胞核移植（somatic cell nuclear transfer, SCNT）技術能將供體豬的遺傳資訊複製至早期胚胎，本研究旨在透過整合 SCNT 與基因體選擇方法學，建立並驗證一套完整的豬隻 EGS 工作流程。

結果：首先，利用從具有已知基因型與表現型之候選豬所採集的供體細胞，建構豬隻 SCNT 胚胎。對 SCNT 胚胎進行的細胞切片顯示，從囊胚中收集約 9.5 個滋養外胚層（trophectoderm, TE）細胞對後續發育的影響最小。其次，針對 TE 切片細胞最佳化全基因組多重置換擴增（multiple displacement amplification）協定，以進行 80K 單核苷酸多型性（SNP）晶片分析。SNP 判讀率（call rate）介於 94.44% 至 99.77% 之間，且 SCNT 胚胎與其供體豬之間的基因型一致性多數超過 95%。最後，利用 GBLUP 與貝氏（Bayesian）方法計算三項生產性狀的基因體預估育種值（GEBVs），並觀察到每個胚胎與其供體之間的 GEBVs 具有高度正相關（r > 0.90）。

結論：本研究建立並驗證了一套完整的豬隻 EGS 工作流程，包含胚胎切片、全基因組擴增、SNP 基因型鑑定及 GEBV 預測。此工作流程為 EGS 應用於豬隻育種提供了技術基礎，並具備透過早期胚胎選拔來加速遺傳改良之潛力。此外，研究結果證明 SCNT 可用於為養豬產業複製優秀的遺傳資源。

papers.title: Genetic Parameters and Genome‐Wide Association Analysis of Reproductive Traits in Egyptian Buffalo
papers.abstract: Reproductive efficiency is a crucial factor in the sustainability and profitability of buffalo production systems. However, genetic improvement of reproductive traits is challenging due to low heritability, environmental sensitivity, limited recording, and shrinking reference populations caused by crossbreeding. This study aimed to estimate genetic parameters and detect the genomic architecture of key reproductive traits in Egyptian buffalo using pedigree‐based analyses and genome‐wide association studies (GWAS). Over a 44‐year period (1980–2024), reproductive records from five Egyptian experimental herds were analysed. The dataset comprised 2843 buffalo cows, sired by 140 bulls and out of 1328 dams. In total, 2359 records were available for age at first calving (AFC), 10,478 for gestation length (GL), 7966 for calving interval (CI), 6705 for days open (DO), and 12,909 for calving ease (CE) and stillbirth (SB). For genome‐wide association analysis, 275 Egyptian buffaloes were genotyped using the Affymetrix Buffalo 90 K array, and 66,295 high‐quality SNPs were retained after quality control. De‐regressed proofs derived from pedigree‐based genetic evaluations were used as response variables in a mixed linear model implemented in the rMVP package. Genome‐wide association analysis identified putative genomic regions associated with GL, CI, CE, and SB, whereas no genome‐wide significant associations were detected for AFC and DO. Functional annotation and QTL enrichment analyses were subsequently used to provide exploratory biological context for the identified genomic regions. Heritability estimates were generally low: 0.16 for AFC, 0.06 for GL, 0.02 for CI, 0.02 for DO, 0.18 for CE, and 0.06 for SB. Manhattan plots revealed that 15 genomic regions containing significant SNPs were identified on chromosomes 2, 4, 10, 12, 13, 15, 19, 20, and 25 for the reproductive traits of GL, CI, CE, and SB. These findings provide preliminary evidence of genomic regions potentially contributing to variation in reproductive traits in Egyptian buffalo, although the relatively small number of genotyped animals limits the power to detect and validate small effect loci. Seven significant genomic regions on chromosomes 10, 13, 15, 20, and 25 were associated with the GL trait. Additionally, three suggestive SNPs mapped to chromosomes 2 and 19 were associated with the CE trait, and three suggestive SNPs mapped on chromosome 12 were significantly associated with the SB trait. The results of KEGG enrichment analyses and QTL classification analyses for reproductive traits in Egyptian buffalo suggest that candidate genes within known QTL may be involved in complex biological networks involving immune competence, cellular homeostasis, and systemic physiological resilience. Among the enriched pathways, Fc gamma R‐mediated phagocytosis, protein export, viral myocarditis, and arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy (ARVC) were highlighted. Most annotated genomic regions (QTL) were related to reproductive traits (63.4%), followed by 17.3% for milk production traits, 9.95% for general production traits, 3.47% for meat and carcass traits, 3.71% for body conformation and robustness exterior traits, and 2.08% for health traits.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Breeding and Genetics
papers.abstract_zh: 繁殖效率是水牛生產系統之永續性與獲利能力的關鍵因素。然而，由於遺傳力低、環境敏感度高、記錄有限以及雜交導致參考群體縮小，繁殖性狀的遺傳改良深具挑戰性。本研究旨在透過系譜分析與全基因組關聯性研究（GWAS），估計埃及水牛關鍵繁殖性狀的遺傳參數並探討其基因體結構。分析了五個埃及實驗牛群涵蓋 44 年期間（1980–2024 年）的繁殖記錄。資料集包含 2,843 頭母水牛，由 140 頭公牛及 1,328 頭母牛所繁殖。總計獲得初產日齡（AFC）記錄 2,359 筆、姙娠期（GL）10,478 筆、分娩間距（CI）7,966 筆、空懷天數（DO）6,705 筆，以及分娩難易度（CE）與死產（SB）12,909 筆。在全基因組關聯分析中，利用 Affymetrix 水牛 90K 晶片對 275 頭埃及水牛進行基因型鑑定，經品質控制後保留 66,295 個高品質單核苷酸多型性（SNP）。將源自系譜遺傳評估的去迴歸育種值作為反應變數，並在 rMVP 套件中實施混合線性模型進行分析。全基因組關聯分析識別出與 GL、CI、CE 和 SB 相關的假定基因體區域，而 AFC 和 DO 則未檢測到達到全基因組顯著水準的關聯。隨後利用功能註解與數量性狀基因座（QTL）富集分析，為所識別的基因體區域提供探索性的生物學背景。遺傳力估計值普遍偏低：AFC 為 0.16、GL 為 0.06、CI 為 0.02、DO 為 0.02、CE 為 0.18，以及 SB 為 0.06。曼哈頓圖顯示，在染色體 2、4、10、12、13、15、19、20 和 25 上識別出 15 個包含顯著 SNP 的基因體區域，分別與 GL、CI、CE 和 SB 等繁殖性狀相關。這些發現為可能促成埃及水牛繁殖性狀變異的基因體區域提供了初步證據，儘管基因型動物數量相對較少，限制了檢測與驗證小效應基因座的統計效能。位於染色體 10、13、15、20 和 25 上的七個顯著基因體區域與 GL 性狀相關。此外，對應至染色體 2 和 19 的三個提示性 SNP 與 CE 性狀相關，對應至染色體 12 的三個提示性 SNP 則與 SB 性狀顯著相關。埃及水牛繁殖性狀之 KEGG 富集分析與 QTL 分類分析結果顯示，已知 QTL 內的候選基因可能參與涉及免疫能力、細胞恆定性及系統性生理韌性的複雜生物學網路。在富集的路徑中，突顯了 Fc γ R 媒介的吞噬作用、蛋白質輸出、病毒性心肌炎以及心律不整性右心室心肌病變（ARVC）。多數註解的基因體區域（QTL）與繁殖性狀相關（63.4%），其次為乳產量性狀（17.3%）、一般生產性狀（9.95%）、肉品與屠體性狀（3.47%）、體型外貌與強健性狀（3.71%），以及健康性狀（2.08%）。

papers.title: Genomics-Informed Monitoring and Management of Genetic Diversity in a Small and Endangered Livestock Population: A Case Study of the Slovak Askanian Merino Sheep
papers.abstract: The Slovak Askanian Merino is a small, endangered sheep population maintained on two farms in Slovakia. This study assessed its genomic diversity, population structure and the value of genomics-informed management. After quality control, 491 individuals and 45,695 SNPs were retained for within-population analyses, while 927 individuals and 18,143 SNPs were used for comparisons with other Merino and Merino-derived breeds. Observed and expected heterozygosity were 0.411 and 0.412, respectively, while genomic inbreeding based on homozygous-by-descent segments and runs of homozygosity was 0.025 and 0.019. Segments longer than 16 Mb contributed most to inbreeding, indicating recent inbreeding. Effective population size estimates ranged from 46 to 112. Population structure analyses separated Slovak Askanian Merino from other Merino-derived breeds and revealed farm-related subdivision. Forward simulations showed that optimized mating allocation slowed inbreeding accumulation over ten generations. By generation 10, optimized scenarios reached genomic inbreeding values of 0.042–0.044 based on homozygous-by-descent segments longer than 4 Mb, compared with 0.069–0.072 under random mating. Restricting each used ram to 15–50 ewes provided the best compromise between reducing inbreeding and practical feasibility. These findings show that genomic monitoring combined with optimized mating can support the long-term conservation and sustainable management of small endangered livestock populations.
papers.abstract_zh: 斯洛伐克阿斯坎尼亞美利奴綿羊（Slovak Askanian Merino）是一個小型且瀕危的綿羊族群，目前飼養於斯洛伐克的兩個農場中。本研究評估其基因體多樣性、族群結構以及基因體資訊導向管理的價值。經過品質控制後，族群內分析保留了 491 個體與 45,695 個 SNP，而與其他美利奴及美利奴衍生品種的比較則使用了 927 個體與 18,143 個 SNP。觀察到的與預期的 heterozygosity（雜合度）分別為 0.411 與 0.412，而基於同源繼承區段（homozygous-by-descent segments）與連續純合片段（runs of homozygosity）的基因體近親交配係數則分別為 0.025 與 0.019。長於 16 Mb 的區段對近親交配的貢獻最大，顯示近期有近親交配情形。有效族群大小（effective population size）估計值介於 46 至 112 之間。族群結構分析將斯洛伐克阿斯坎尼亞美利奴綿羊與其他美利奴衍生品種區分開來，並揭示了與農場相關的亞群結構。前瞻性模擬（forward simulations）顯示，最佳化配種分配減緩了十個世代中近親交配的累積。到第 10 世代時，基於長於 4 Mb 的同源繼承區段，最佳化情境下的基因體近親交配值達到 0.042–0.044，相較之下，隨機交配下的數值為 0.069–0.072。限制每隻使用的公羊配種 15 至 50 隻母羊，在減少近親交配與實際可行性之間取得了最佳的平衡。這些發現表明，結合基因體監測與最佳化配種，能夠支援小型瀕危家畜族群的長期保育與永續管理。

papers.title: Fertility and Regional Post-Insemination Cytokine Responses in Hens Following Use of Avian β-Defensin 1 or Kanamycin in Rooster Semen Extenders
papers.abstract: Successful artificial insemination in poultry depends on both sperm functional competence and an appropriate immune environment within the female reproductive tract. This study investigated whether supplementing rooster semen extenders with kanamycin or avian β-defensin 1 (AvBD1) affected reproductive performance and regional post-insemination cytokine responses. Semen from 30 Thai native roosters was pooled and diluted in IGGKPh extender without antimicrobial supplementation (Control) or supplemented with kanamycin (31.2 µg/mL; KAN) or AvBD1 (7.5 µg/mL). Thirty-two Thai native hens were assigned to the three semen-inseminated treatments or a sham-inseminated NaCl group. Fertility and hatchability of fertile eggs were evaluated over 10 weeks. At 24 h after the final insemination, four hens per treatment were sampled for analysis of TNF-α, IL-1β, IL-6, IL-8, and IL-10 mRNA expression in the vagina, uterovaginal junction (UVJ), and infundibulum. Fertility was higher in the KAN and AvBD1 groups than in the Control group (70.23% and 72.81% vs. 65.27%; p < 0.05), whereas no significant difference was detected in hatchability of fertile eggs. No significant treatment effects on the measured cytokines were detected in the vagina. Treatment-associated differences in selected cytokines were observed in the UVJ and infundibulum, with most significant pairwise differences involving the NaCl sham group. AvBD1 showed lower IL-8 expression in the infundibulum than the antimicrobial-free Control. No significant difference in fertility was detected between KAN and AvBD1; however, the study was not designed to establish equivalence or non-inferiority between these treatments. These findings support further evaluation of AvBD1 as a candidate antibiotic-sparing component of poultry semen extenders.
papers.abstract_zh: 家禽人工授精的成功取決於精子的功能活性以及雌性生殖道內適當的免疫環境。本研究探討在公雞精液稀釋液中添加康黴素（kanamycin）或禽類β-防御素1（avian β-defensin 1, AvBD1）是否會影響繁殖性能及授精後的局部細胞激素反應。將30隻泰國本地公雞的精液混合，並以不含抗菌劑的IGGKPh稀釋液稀釋（對照組），或分別添加康黴素（31.2 µg/mL；KAN）與AvBD1（7.5 µg/mL）。將32隻泰國本地母雞隨機分配至三個精液授精處理組或假授精的NaCl組。評估超過10週的受精率及受精卵孵化率。在最後一次授精後24小時，每個處理組採樣4隻母雞，分析陰道、子宮陰道結合部（UVJ）及漏斗部中TNF-α、IL-1β、IL-6、IL-8和IL-10的mRNA表現量。KAN組和AvBD1組的受精率高於對照組（分別為70.23%與72.81%對比65.27%；p < 0.05），而受精卵孵化率則無顯著差異。在陰道中未檢測到各處理對所測細胞激素有顯著影響。在子宮陰道結合部與漏斗部觀察到與處理相關的特定細胞激素差異，多數顯著的成對差異皆涉及NaCl假授精組。在漏斗部中，AvBD1組的IL-8表現量低於不含抗菌劑的對照組。KAN組與AvBD1組之間的受精率無顯著差異；然而，本研究並非旨在確立這些處理之間的等效性或非劣性。這些發現支持進一步評估AvBD1作為家禽精液稀釋液中可減少抗生素使用之候選成分的潛力。

papers.title: Biological functions and mechanisms of boron in poultry
papers.abstract: SUMMARYBoron has attracted increasing attention in poultry nutrition because of its potential biological and metabolic effects, although it is not currently recognised as an essential trace element. This review critically evaluates evidence on the effects of boron supplementation on growth performance, skeletal integrity, eggshell quality, reproductive traits, metabolism, antioxidant status, and health in poultry. Available studies indicate that boron may improve feed efficiency, bone mineralisation, and mineral utilisation, particularly when calcium (Ca), phosphorus (P), or vitamin D3 supply is marginal. Studies on laying hens and pullets reported changes in eggshell characteristics, bone strength, selected serum biochemical indices, and egg yolk lipid composition following boron supplementation. Evidence from breeder flocks and other poultry species, including geese and quail, suggested potential effects on follicular development, fertility, hatchability, and reproductive physiology. Mechanistically, boron may influence mineral metabolism, endocrine signalling, redox balance, and metabolic regulation through interactions with the Ca–P–vitamin D3 axis and related pathways, although direct molecular validation in poultry remains limited. Responses are dose-dependent: supplementation levels in the lower nutritional range commonly examined in poultry studies (approximately 5–75 mg kg−1, depending on species and dietary context) are associated with beneficial effects or no significant change in measured outcomes, whereas studies using much higher experimental exposures (≥200–400 mg kg−1) reported impaired growth performance, reduced feed intake, decreased egg production, or metabolic disturbances. Poultry boron studies generally use conventional experimental designs comparable to those used for other trace elements; the main challenge for synthesis is the broad range of boron inclusion levels and nutritional contexts evaluated. Accordingly, boron should be regarded as a potentially functional, context-dependent dietary component for which an essential requirement has not been established in poultry. The broad range of boron doses evaluated limited molecular characterisation of underlying mechanisms and scarce data on long-term safety.
papers.abstract_zh:
摘要
雖然硼目前尚未被公認為必需微量元素，但因其具有潛在的生物學與代謝效應，在家禽營養學中日益受到關注。本篇文獻綜述批判性地評估了補充硼對家禽生長性能、骨骼完整性、蛋殼品質、繁殖性狀、代謝、抗氧化狀態及健康影響之證據。現有研究顯示，硼可能有助於改善飼料效率、骨骼礦化及礦物質利用率，特別是在鈣（Ca）、磷（P）或維生素 D3 供應處於臨界值時。針對產蛋母雞與生長母雞的研究指出，補充硼後，其蛋殼特性、骨強度、特定血清生化指標及蛋黃脂質組成皆有改變。來自種禽群及其他家禽物種（包括鵝與鵪鶉）的證據表明，硼對卵泡發育、受精率、孵化率及生殖生理具有潛在影響。在機制方面，硼可能透過與 Ca–P–維生素 D3 軸及相關途徑的相互作用，影響礦物質代謝、內分泌信號傳遞、氧化還原平衡與代謝調節，儘管在家禽中的直接分子驗證仍相當有限。反應具有劑量依賴性：在家禽研究通常檢視的較低營養範圍內（約 5–75 mg kg−1，取決於物種與日糧背景）之補充濃度，通常與測定指標的有益影響或無顯著變化相關，而使用高得多的實驗暴露量（≥200–400 mg kg−1）的研究則報告了生長性能受損、採食量下降、產蛋量減少或代謝紊亂。家禽的硼研究通常採用與其他微量元素類似的傳統實驗設計；綜合分析的主要挑戰在於所評估的硼添加水平與營養背景範圍廣泛。因此，硼應被視為一種具潛在功能性、且取決於背景的日糧成分，目前尚未確立其在家禽中的必需需求量。所評估的廣泛硼劑量範圍限制了對潛在機制的分子表徵，且關於長期安全性的數據亦相當匱乏。

papers.title: Estimated Breeding Values for Monetary Earnings and Cutting Points in Brazilian Quarter Horses
papers.abstract: In the Brazilian Quarter Horse (QH), cutting points (CP) and monetary earnings (ME) are key success indicators, yet their genetic parameters remain unestablished. This study estimated heritability and breeding values for these traits to guide breeding decisions. Performance data from 1661 QHs competing in official Brazilian cutting events between 1981 and 2020 were analyzed for three traits: total lifetime cutting points (CPt), cutting points at four years of age (CP4), and lifetime monetary earnings (ME). Variance components and genetic parameters were estimated using single-trait Bayesian animal models. Heritability estimates were 0.110 ± 0.038 for CPt, 0.110 ± 0.048 for CP4, and 0.288 ± 0.091 for ME. Although overall genetic trends were positive, in the last decade CPt registered the highest annual genetic gain (0.116). The findings suggest that both CP and ME could be considered as potential selection criteria, and evaluating performance at four years of age (CP4) may favor early genetic progress. While ME shows greater potential for lifelong phenotypes due to its moderate heritability, both traits exhibited comparable selection accuracies; therefore, definitive recommendations require further studies on genetic correlations and expected responses.
papers.abstract_zh: 在巴西夸特馬（QH）中，競賽分割積分（CP）與獎金收益（ME）是衡量成功的關鍵指標，然而其遺傳參數尚未確立。本研究旨在估算這些性狀的遺傳力與育種值，以指導育種決策。本研究分析了 1981 年至 2020 年間參加巴西官方切割賽事之 1,661 匹夸特馬的表現數據，針對三個性狀進行評估：終身切割總積分（CPt）、四歲時的切割積分（CP4）以及終身獎金收益（ME）。利用單性狀貝氏動物模式（Bayesian animal models）估算變方組成分與遺傳參數。遺傳力估算值分別為：CPt 為 0.110 ± 0.038、CP4 為 0.110 ± 0.048，以及 ME 為 0.288 ± 0.091。儘管整體遺傳趨勢呈正向，但在過去十年中，CPt 記錄了最高的年度遺傳進展（0.116）。研究結果表明，CP 與 ME 皆可被視為潛在的選育標準，而評估四歲時的表現（CP4）可能有助於促進早期的遺傳進展。儘管 ME 因其具備中等遺傳力而對終身表現型顯示出較大的潛力，但這兩個性狀表現出相當的選育準確度；因此，明確的建議仍需進一步研究遺傳相關性與預期反應。

papers.title: Effects of a low dose of 3-nitrooxypropanol and a combination of direct-fed microbials on methane emission, oral swab bacterial community, and performance in dairy cows
papers.abstract: Background 3-Nitrooxypropanol (3-NOP) can inhibit ruminal methane production by inactivating the key enzyme during methanogenesis. Combining 3-NOP and direct-fed microbials (DFM) can potentially provide a dual-action approach to reduce ruminal methane production. The objective of this study was to investigate the effects of supplementation of a low dose of 3-NOP and a mixture of DFM, on methane emissions, performance, and rumen microbial community of dairy cows. Results Forty-eight Danish Holstein dairy cows were used in a 14-week randomized complete block design. Due to a mixing error, 3-NOP was included at an unexpected low dose (6.0 mg/kg DM). Cows were fed with one of four experimental diets: (1) control diet, and other treatment diets were control diet supplemented with (2) 3-NOP, or with (3) DFM (12 mg/kg P. acidipropionici strain P169 and 120 mg/kg Bacillus subtilis and B. licheniformis mixture), or with (4) a combination of 3-NOP and DFM. 3-NOP inclusion did not affect DMI, feed efficiency, or milk yield and composition. DFM supplementation reduced partial mixed ration intake and total DMI. 3-NOP supplementation significantly reduced CH 4 production (g/d) (8%) and CH 4 intensity (g/kg ECM) (9%) but did not affect CH 4 yield (g/kg DMI).
