Furthermore, 3-NOP supplementation increased H 2 production, yield, and intensity. DFM supplementation reduced milk yield from weeks 3 to 8 and ECM yield from weeks 3 to 7, but these effects diminished over time. 3-NOP alone or in combination with DFM resulted in higher abundance of Megasphaera and Prevotella genera in oral swab samples. DFM supplementation had no effect on gas emissions, and it only tended to improve feed efficiency (ECM/DMI, kg/kg) during the later stage of the experiment. DFM supplementation led to higher abundance of certain species within the Lactobacillaceae family particularly at later stages of the experiment. Conclusions An unforeseen reduced dose of 3-NOP supplementation still can effectively mitigate methane emissions (both production and intensity) and increase H 2 emissions without affecting DMI or performance. DFM supplementation reduced DMI and milk yield at the onset of the experiment, but the effects subsided over time, resulting in an increased feed efficiency by the end of the experiment.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Science and Biotechnology
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：3-硝基氧基丙醇（3-NOP）可透過去活化產甲烷過程中的關鍵酶，來抑制瘤胃甲烷生成。將 3-NOP 與直接飼喂微生物（DFM）結合，可能提供一種雙重作用的方法來減少瘤胃甲烷生成。本研究旨在探討補充低劑量 3-NOP 與 DFM 混合物對乳牛甲烷排放、生產性能及瘤胃微生物群落的影響。結果：本研究使用 48 頭丹麥荷斯坦乳牛進行為期 14 週的隨機完全區集設計。由於混合錯誤，3-NOP 的添加量為意料之外的低劑量（6.0 mg/kg 乾物質 [DM]）。乳牛被飼餵四種實驗日糧之一：（1）對照日糧，其他處理日糧則為對照日糧補充（2）3-NOP，或（3）DFM（12 mg/kg 費氏丙酸桿菌 P169 菌株及 120 mg/kg 枯草芽孢桿菌與地衣芽孢桿菌混合物），或（4）3-NOP 與 DFM 的組合。3-NOP 的添加不影響乾物質採食量（DMI）、飼料效率或乳產量與乳成分。DFM 補充降低了部分混合日糧的採食量及總 DMI。3-NOP 補充顯著降低了 $\text{CH}_4$ 產量（g/d）（8%）及 $\text{CH}_4$ 強度（g/kg 能量校正乳 [ECM]）（9%），但並不影響 $\text{CH}_4$ 得率（g/kg DMI）。此外，3-NOP 補充增加了 $\text{H}_2$ 的產量、得率及強度。DFM 補充在第 3 至 8 週降低了乳產量，在第 3 至 7 週降低了 ECM 產量，但這些影響隨時間而消退。單獨使用 3-NOP 或與 DFM 併用，會導致口腔拭子樣本中巨球形菌屬（Megasphaera）和普雷沃氏菌屬（Prevotella）的豐度增加。DFM 補充對氣體排放沒有影響，且僅在實驗後期傾向於改善飼料效率（ECM/DMI，kg/kg）。DFM 補充導致乳酸桿菌科（Lactobacillaceae）內某些物種的豐度增加，特別是在實驗後期。結論：未預期之低劑量的 3-NOP 補充仍能有效減緩甲烷排放（包括產量與強度）並增加 $\text{H}_2$ 排放，且不影響 DMI 或生產性能。DFM 補充在實驗初期降低了 DMI 與乳產量，但這些影響隨時間消退，並在實驗結束時提高了飼料效率。

papers.title: Salmonella Phage X5 Alleviates Salmonella pullorum-Induced Growth Impairment in Chickens: Associations with Reduced Salmonella Burden, Modulated Intestinal Microbiome and Attenuated Inflammatory Responses
papers.abstract: Salmonella infection of chickens can cause persistent intestinal inflammation, intestinal microbiota disorder, and growth obstruction, which is an important bacterial disease causing significant economic losses in poultry farming. Phages, as an alternative to antibiotics as biological control agents, have advantages such as precise killing and no residue. This study aims to explore the effect and mechanism of the lytic Salmonella phage X5 in alleviating the growth impairment in chickens caused by S. pullorum. Oral administration of phages effectively prevents and controls S. pullorum infection in chickens. Phages can alleviate growth impairment caused by Salmonella, reduce Salmonella levels in the liver and ileum, lower serum concentrations of IL-1β, IL-6, and TNF-α, and decrease mRNA expression of inflammatory cytokines IL-1β and IL-6 in the ileum. They also enhance mRNA expression of tight junction proteins Claudin-3 and ZO-1 in the ileal mucosa, helping maintain intestinal barrier integrity, and modulate the microbial community composition in the cecum. In the context of reduced and restricted antibiotic usage in livestock production, this study initially verified the protective effect of phage X5 against Salmonella pullorum infection in chickens, providing an experimental basis for the application of phages in the prevention and control of this bacterial disease, and offering new clues for analyzing the potential pathways through which bacteriophages confer host protective effects.
papers.abstract_zh: 雞隻感染沙門氏菌會引起持續性腸道發炎、腸道菌相失調以及生長受阻，是造成家禽養殖業重大經濟損失的重要細菌性疾病。噬菌體作為抗生素的替代性生物防治劑，具有精準殺滅且無殘留等優勢。本研究旨在探討裂解性沙門氏菌噬菌體X5減輕雞白痢沙門氏菌引起雞隻生長受損的效果與機制。口服投與噬菌體能有效預防與控制雞隻的沙門氏菌感染。噬菌體可減輕沙門氏菌引起的生長受阻，降低肝臟與迴腸中的沙門氏菌濃度，降低血清中IL-1β、IL-6和TNF-α的濃度，並減少迴腸中發炎細胞激素IL-1β和IL-6的mRNA表現量。牠們也能增強迴腸黏膜中緊密接合蛋白Claudin-3和ZO-1的mRNA表現量，有助於維持腸道屏障的完整性，並調節盲腸的微生物群落組成。在畜牧生產減少和限制使用抗生素的背景下，本研究初步驗證了噬菌體X5對雞白痢沙門氏菌感染的保護效果，為噬菌體在該細菌性疾病防控中的應用提供了實驗依據，並為解析噬菌體賦予宿主保護作用的潛在途徑提供了新線索。

papers.title: Metabolic Signatures of Refrigerated Storage Linked to Quality Deterioration in Thai Native Chicken Meat: An Integrated 1H NMR-Based Metabolomics and Meat Quality Assessment
papers.abstract: Refrigeration is essential for preserving meat quality; however, understanding the biochemical mechanisms underlying deterioration during storage is crucial for extending its shelf life. This study examines the impact of refrigerated storage on the quality, metabolite profiles, and microbiological characteristics of Thai native chicken meat using physicochemical analysis and 600 MHz 1H NMR-based metabolomics. The samples were individually wrapped and stored at 4 °C and analyzed on days 1, 3, 5, 7, and 10 to evaluate pH, drip loss, cooking loss, microbial characteristics, texture, and metabolic profiles. Physicochemical assessments showed that pH and drip loss increased significantly over time, whereas color, texture profile, chemical composition, and lipid oxidation remained relatively stable. Coliform counts remained stable through day 7 before peaking on day 10. Metabolomic profiling identified 26 metabolites, primarily associated with amino acids, nucleotides, bioactive compounds, organic acids, and sugars. Chemometric analyses, including principal component analysis (PCA) and orthogonal partial least squares discriminant analysis (OPLS-DA), demonstrated continuing metabolic changes, distinctly separating day 10 samples from earlier time points. Furthermore, glutamine and N-methylhydantoin were identified as potential storage-related biomarkers. These findings indicate that day 10 represents an advanced storage phase, demonstrating the usefulness of metabolomics in evaluating freshness and elucidating shelf-life dynamics in chicken meat.
papers.abstract_zh: 冷藏對於保持肉品品質至關重要；然而，理解儲存過程中劣變背後的生化機制對於延長其保存期限至關重要。本研究利用理化分析與 600 MHz $^1\text{H}$ 核磁共振（NMR）代謝體學，探討冷藏儲存對泰國土雞肉的品質、代謝物分佈及微生物特性的影響。樣品經個別包裝後儲存於 4 °C，並於第 1、3、5、7 和 10 天進行分析，以評估 pH 值、滴水損失、蒸煮損失、微生物特性、質地與代謝分佈。理化評估顯示，pH 值和滴水損失隨時間顯著增加，而顏色、質地分佈、化學成分和脂質氧化則保持相對穩定。大腸桿菌群數量在第 7 天前保持穩定，隨後在第 10 天達到峰值。代謝體學分佈鑑定了 26 種代謝物，主要與胺基酸、核苷酸、生物活性化合物、有機酸和糖類有關。化學計量學分析，包括主成分分析（PCA）與正交偏最小二乘法判別分析（OPLS-DA），展現了持續的代謝變化，將第 10 天的樣品與早期時間點明確區分開來。此外，麩醯胺酸（glutamine）和 $N$-甲基海因（$N$-methylhydantoin）被識別為潛在的儲存相關生物標記。這些發現表明，第 10 天代表了進階的儲存階段，證明瞭代謝體學在評估雞肉新鮮度和闡明保存期限動態方面的效用。

papers.title: Improving quail production efficiency: a global perspective
papers.abstract: SUMMARYJapanese quail (Coturnix japonica) are among the most widely studied and commercially utilised quail species for egg and meat production in many regions because of their rapid growth, early sexual maturity, high reproductive performance, and relatively low feed and housing requirements. This review synthesises global literature on quail production efficiency, with emphasis on genetic potential, nutrition and feeding strategies, housing and environmental management, health control, animal welfare, and climate adaptation. A comprehensive narrative review was conducted by searching peer-reviewed literature published between 1970 and 2026 in Scopus, Web of Science, PubMed, and Google Scholar. Evidence indicates that quail productivity is strongly influenced by interactions among genotype, dietary protein and energy balance, microclimatic conditions, and management practices. In quail, particularly under tropical and arid production conditions, heat stress reduces feed intake, laying performance, eggshell quality, fertility, and immune responsiveness, thereby necessitating climate-responsive housing and targeted nutritional interventions. Welfare-oriented management practices, including optimised stocking density, lighting programs, and environmental enrichment, are increasingly recognised as integral to sustainable productivity rather than as constraints. Although quail production offers advantages in feed efficiency and environmental footprint compared with conventional poultry species, challenges related to feed cost volatility, lack of standardised nutrient requirements, limited welfare guidelines, and climate resilience persist. This review identifies key knowledge gaps and proposes an integrated framework linking genetics, nutrition, housing, welfare, and climate adaptation to improve quail production efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh:
摘要
日本鵪鶉（Coturnix japonica）因其生長迅速、性成熟早、繁殖性能高，且飼料與房舍需求相對較低，在許多地區成為蛋肉生產中研究最廣泛且具商業利用價值的鵪鶉品種之一。本篇文獻綜述綜合了全球關於鵪鶉生產效率的文獻，重點探討基因潛能、營養與飼糧策略、房舍與環境管理、健康控制、動物福利及氣候適應。本研究透過搜尋 1970 年至 2026 年間發表於 Scopus、Web of Science、PubMed 及 Google Scholar 的同儕審查文獻，進行了全面的敘述性文獻綜述。證據顯示，鵪鶉的生產力深受基因型、日糧蛋白質與能量平衡、微氣候條件及管理實務之間交互作用的影響。在鵪鶉生產中，特別是在熱帶與乾旱生產環境下，熱緊迫會降低採食量、產蛋性能、蛋殼品質、受精率及免疫反應，因此必須採取因應氣候變遷的房舍設計與針對性的營養介入措施。以福利為導向的管理實務，包括優化的飼養密度、光照計畫及環境豐富化，日益被視為永續生產不可或缺的一部分，而非生產的限制。儘管與傳統家禽相比，鵪鶉生產在飼料效率與環境足跡方面具有優勢，但飼料成本波動、缺乏標準化營養需求、福利指南有限以及氣候韌性等挑戰依然存在。本篇文獻綜述指出了關鍵的知識缺口，並提出一個整合基因學、營養學、房舍、福利及氣候適應的綜合框架，以提升鵪鶉的生產效率。

papers.title: The Effects of a Protected Yeast Probiotic (Saccharomyces cerevisiae) on the Performance and Gut Microbiome of Ross 708 Broilers Grown to 49 Days of Age
papers.abstract: This study evaluated increasing dietary doses of a live yeast probiotic (Saccharomyces cerevisiae) on broiler growth performance and cecal microbiota. A total of 1200 day-old straight-run Ross 708 chicks were allocated to five treatments (12 replicate pens/treatment; 20 birds/pen): a diet with 5% dried distillers grains with solubles and no gut-health additives (negative control, NC); NC plus bacitracin methylene disalicylate at 55 mg bacitracin activity/kg (positive control, PC); and NC plus live yeast at 0.25, 0.375, or 0.50 g/kg (LY1–LY3). Body weight (BW), feed intake, and mortality-corrected feed conversion ratio (FCR) were measured from d 1 to 49, and cecal microbiota were profiled by 16S rRNA gene sequencing on d 49. All yeast doses reduced cumulative FCR from d 1 to 35 compared with NC (p < 0.001). LY2 and LY3 also reduced cumulative FCR to d 42, but only LY3 reduced FCR over d 1–49 (1.733 vs. 1.774; p = 0.035), and FCR did not differ among yeast doses. LY2 and LY3 increased BW at d 42 (p = 0.04), but BW did not differ at d 49 (p = 0.77). In cecal samples from three birds per pen, analyzed with pen as the experimental unit, live yeast was associated with greater alpha diversity and differences in community composition, with no difference in within-group dispersion among treatments. Live yeast improved cumulative feed efficiency without a lasting effect on final BW.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究評估在飼糧中增加活酵母益生菌（釀酒酵母，*Saccharomyces cerevisiae*）之添加劑量對肉雞生長性能與盲腸微生物相之影響。總共 1,200 隻一日齡混群羅斯 708（Ross 708）雛雞被隨機分配至五個處理組（每處理 12 個重複欄位，每欄 20 隻雞）：添加 5% 乾燥 distillers grains with solubles 且無腸道健康添加劑之飼糧（負對照組，NC）；NC 添加每公斤 55 毫克桿菌肽活性之次水楊酸桿菌肽（正對照組，PC）；以及 NC 分別添加 0.25、0.375 或 0.50 g/kg 之活酵母（LY1 至 LY3）。測定 1 至 49 日齡之體重（BW）、採食量以及校正死亡率之飼料轉換率（FCR），並於 49 日齡利用 16S rRNA 基因定序分析盲腸微生物相。與 NC 組相比，所有酵母添加劑量均降低了 1 至 35 日齡之累積 FCR（p < 0.001）。LY2 與 LY3 也降低了至 42 日齡之累積 FCR，但僅 LY3 降低了 1 至 49 日齡之 FCR（1.733 對 1.774；p = 0.035），且各酵母劑量組間的 FCR 無顯著差異。LY2 與 LY3 增加了 42 日齡之體重（p = 0.04），但在 49 日齡時體重無顯著差異（p = 0.77）。在每個重複欄位取 3 隻雞之盲腸樣本、以欄位作為實驗單位進行分析，結果顯示活酵母與較高的阿伐多樣性（alpha diversity）及群落組成差異有關，各處理組之組內離散度則無差異。活酵母可改善累積飼料效率，但對最終體重無持久性影響。

papers.title: Carbohydrate and protein adaptation in low-protein diets for livestock and poultry: a nutritional revolution from static balance to dynamic synergy
papers.abstract: Low-protein diet is a pivotal strategy for alleviating protein feed shortage and promoting the sustainable development of the livestock industry. However, the utilization efficiency of carbohydrate and protein nutrients in livestock and poultry remains relatively low, and carbohydrate-protein metabolism asynchrony is the core bottleneck limiting their efficient utilization. Carbohydrate and protein adaptation, based on low-protein diets, makes a shift from traditional static energy and nitrogen balance theories. By precisely aligning the digestive release patterns of carbohydrates and proteins, it enables the synergistic and efficient utilization of energy and amino acids, representing a promising concept in the low-protein diet systems. Nevertheless, current evidence supporting carbohydrate and protein adaptation remains relatively limited and largely based on indirect inference. This review summarizes the patterns of digestion and absorption of carbohydrate and protein in livestock and poultry as well as their key regulatory factors, clarifies the core technology and cutting-edge research methodologies for carbohydrate and protein adaptation, and analyzes the mechanisms by which carbohydrate and protein adaptation influences production performance, meat quality, intestinal health, and nutritional metabolism regulation. In addition, this review proposes future research directions, including quantitative and precise regulation, microbiome-targeted modulation, and multi-omics mechanism analysis, providing a theoretical basis for further research and industrial application of carbohydrate and protein adaptation in low-protein diets for livestock and poultry.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Science and Biotechnology
papers.abstract_zh: 低蛋白日糧是緩解蛋白質飼料短缺、促進畜牧業永續發展的關鍵策略。然而，畜禽對碳水化合物與蛋白質營養素的利用效率仍相對較低，而碳水化合物與蛋白質代謝不同步是限制其高效利用的核心瓶頸。基於低蛋白日糧的碳水化合物與蛋白質適配，使傳統的靜態能量與氮平衡理論發生了轉變。透過精準調控碳水化合物與蛋白質的消化釋放模式，實現能量與胺基酸的協同高效利用，是低蛋白日糧體系中極具前景的概念。然而，目前支援碳水化合物與蛋白質適配的證據仍相對有限，且大多基於間接推論。本文綜述了畜禽碳水化合物與蛋白質的消化吸收規律及其關鍵調控因素，闡明碳水化合物與蛋白質適配的核心技術與前沿研究方法，並分析碳水化合物與蛋白質適配影響生產性能、肉品品質、腸道健康及營養代謝調控的機制。此外，本文提出了未來的研究方向，包括定量與精準調控、以微生物組為標的的調節以及多體學機制分析，以期為畜禽低蛋白日糧中碳水化合物與蛋白質適配的深入研究與產業應用提供理論基礎。

papers.title: Genome-Wide Association Study of Body Conformation and Carcass Composition Traits in Landrace Pigs
papers.abstract: Body conformation and carcass composition are economically important traits in pig production, yet their underlying genetic mechanisms remain incompletely characterized. To dissect the genetic bases of body length (BL), body height (BH), backfat thickness (BFT), and lean meat percentage (LMP), we estimated genetic parameters and performed a genome-wide association study (GWAS) using 50 K SNP array genotypes from 1527 Landrace pigs. Phenotypic variance decomposition revealed moderate-to-high heritability for all four traits, ranging from 0.23 for BH to 0.43 for BL. Genetic correlation analysis uncovered a strong negative correlation (−0.80 ± 0.05) between BFT and LMP, as well as a moderate positive correlation (0.46 ± 0.03) between BL and BH. Our GWAS identified 14 SNP–trait associations involving 10 unique SNPs and two genomic regions with overlapping association signals. On Sus scrofa chromosome 1 (SSC1), overlapping signals for BFT and LMP occurred near ABL1 and QRFP, whereas signals for body conformation mapped to SSC17 near BMP2, PROKR2, SLC23A2, and PCNA. These genes are positional and biologically plausible candidates, and these candidate markers hold potential for genomic selection to simultaneously improve body size and meat-production performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 體型與屠體組成是養豬生產中具有經濟重要性的性狀，然而其潛在的遺傳機制尚未完全解析。為了剖析體長（BL）、體高（BH）、背脂厚度（BFT）與瘦肉率（LMP）的遺傳基礎，本研究利用 1,527 頭藍瑞斯豬的 50K 單核苷酸多型性（SNP）晶片基因型，進行遺傳參數估計與全基因體關聯分析（GWAS）。表型變異分解顯示，這四個性狀皆具有中至高遺傳力，範圍從體高的 0.23 到體長的 0.43。遺傳相關分析揭示背脂厚度與瘦肉率之間存在強烈的負相關（−0.80 ± 0.05），體長與體高之間則有中等程度的正相關（0.46 ± 0.03）。我們的 GWAS 識別出 14 個 SNP 與性狀的關聯，涉及 10 個獨特的 SNP 以及兩個具有重疊關聯信號的基因體區域。在豬隻第 1 染色體（SSC1）上，背脂厚度與瘦肉率的重疊信號出現在 ABL1 與 QRFP 附近，而體型的信號則對應到第 17 染色體（SSC17）上的 BMP2、PROKR2、SLC23A2 與 PCNA 附近。這些基因是位置上及生物學上合理的候選基因，且這些候選標記在基因體選拔中具有潛力，可用於同時改善體型與產肉性能。

papers.title: Leveraging artificial intelligence for livestock genetics and breeding
papers.abstract: The rapid development of artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming modern society including animal genetics and breeding which is essential for meeting global nutritional needs in supplying milk, meat, and eggs among the most complete sources of protein and micronutrients. Although animal breeding has a long history of using data-driven prediction methods, the application of modern AI approaches remains at a relatively early stage and shows substantial potential for wide-ranging applications in animal genetics and breeding. This study aims to review the current use of AI tools in livestock species across three major applications of high interest: AI-assisted phenotyping, AI-enabled dissection of complex-trait biology (focusing on AI-assisted GWAS and AI-for-omics), and AI-assisted genomic prediction. In addition, we discussed emerging methods and tools developed in human genetics that are not yet widely adopted in farm animals but may offer translational potential for future livestock studies. Looking ahead, AI breakthroughs in livestock genetics and breeding are likely to be driven by increases in data scale and resolution, enhanced computational capacities, standardized data infrastructure and benchmarking, and systematic method development and validation. From a livestock genetic improvement perspective, the key value of AI will lie in integrating AI-generated inputs, including improved phenotyping and biological insights, into practical breeding decisions through statistical modeling.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Science and Biotechnology
papers.abstract_zh: 人工智慧（AI）的快速發展正在轉變現代社會，包括對於提供乳品、肉類和蛋類等最完整的蛋白質與微量營養素來源、以滿足全球營養需求至關重要的動物遺傳學與育種。儘管動物育種在應用數據驅動的預測方法方面歷史悠久，但現代AI方法的應用仍處於相對早期階段，並在動物遺傳學與育種的廣泛應用中展現出巨大的潛力。本研究旨在綜述AI工具目前在家畜物種中三個最受關注的主要應用：AI輔助表型分析、AI賦能的複雜性狀生物學解析（聚焦於AI輔助全基因組關聯分析〔GWAS〕與AI賦能的多體學〔AI-for-omics〕），以及AI輔助基因體預測。此外，我們討論了在人類遺傳學中發展、尚未在家畜中廣泛採用，但可能為未來家畜研究提供轉化潛力的新興方法與工具。展望未來，家畜遺傳與育種領域的AI突破，預期將由數據規模與解析度的提升、計算能力的增強、標準化的數據基礎設施與基準測試，以及系統性的方法開發與驗證所驅動。從家畜遺傳改良的角度來看，AI的核心價值在於透過統計建模，將AI生成的輸入（包括改進的表型分析和生物學見解）整合到實際的育種決策中。

papers.title: Estimates of Genetic Parameters for Ewe Longevity and Lifetime Reproductive Performance Traits in South African Merino Sheep
papers.abstract: Ewe's functional longevity impacts flock profitability by reducing annual ewe replacement costs and increasing ewe outputs over the production cycle. In this context, the main objective of this study was to estimate variance components and genetic parameters of five ewe longevity indicators in South African Merino sheep. The traits evaluated included age at the last lambing (ALL), length of productive life (PL, measured as the number of days between the first and last lambing records), total number of litters (TNL), total number of lambs born (TLB) and total number of lambs weaned (TLW). These traits were recorded on a population of 39,011 ewes. Ewe's own birth type (singletons, twins, or triplets), the concatenated effect of birth flock‐year and age at first lambing (3 classes: < 710, 710–743, 744–1095 days) were the fixed effects fitted in the animal models, while the animal and contemporary group (birth flock‐year‐season) were fitted as random effects. Variance components were estimated based on the Restricted Maximum Likelihood method implemented in the BLUPF90+ family of programmes. The sample size and mean (standard deviation) were 38,929 ewes and 1452.1 (559.3) days for ALL; 30,714 ewes and 918.9 (456.5) days for PL; 38,795 ewes and 2.98 (1.51) litters for TNL; 38,842 ewes and 4.26 (2.49) lambs born for TNB; and 19,322 ewes and 3.87 (2.39) lambs weaned for TNW. The heritability estimates were: 0.061 ± 0.0074 (ALL), 0.051 ± 0.0082 (PL), 0.061 ± 0.0073 (TNL), 0.059 ± 0.0072 (TNB) and 0.058 ± 0.0098 (TNW). The genetic correlation estimates ranged from 0.73 ± 0.056 (PL × TNW) to 0.99 ± 0.0023 (ALL × PL), while phenotypic correlation ranged from 0.82 ± 0.0019 (PL × TNB) to 0.99 ± 0.0001 (ALL × PL). Parents of ewes with phenotypic records had estimated breeding value average accuracy above 0.30 for all traits. Positive genetic trends were found for all traits, suggesting genetic gains per year of 0.34 days in ALL, 0.27 days in PL, 0.0082 litters in TNL, 0.0022 lambs born in TNB and 0.002 lambs weaned in TNW. Given similar heritability estimates and high genetic correlation among the traits, TNW is recommended as a selection criterion to improve Merino longevity, as this trait could improve both ewe longevity and reproductive performance.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Breeding and Genetics
papers.abstract_zh: 母羊的功能性壽命透過降低每年母羊的替換成本並提高生產週期內的母羊產出，影響著羊群的獲利能力。在此背景下，本研究的主要目的是估算南非美利奴綿羊五個母羊壽命指標的方差分量與遺傳參數。所評估的性狀包括：最後分娩年齡（ALL）、生產壽命長度（PL，以第一筆與最後一筆分娩紀錄之間的天數計算）、總胎次（TNL）、總產羔數（TLB）以及總離乳羔羊數（TLW）。這些性狀記錄於包含 39,011 隻母羊的族群中。動物模式中擬合的固定效應包括母羊自身的出生類型（單胎、雙胞胎或三胞胎）、出生牧場－年份與第一次分娩年齡的串接效應（3個級別：< 710、710–743、744–1095 天），而動物效應與同期群（出生牧場－年份－季節）則擬合為隨機效應。方差分量是基於 BLUPF90+ 系列程式所實作的限制性最大似然法（Restricted Maximum Likelihood）進行估算。樣本數與平均值（標準差）分別為：ALL 共 38,929 隻母羊、1452.1 (559.3) 天；PL 共 30,714 隻母羊、918.9 (456.5) 天；TNL 共 38,795 隻母羊、2.98 (1.51) 胎；TNB 共 38,842 隻母羊、4.26 (2.49) 產羔數；以及 TNW 共 19,322 隻母羊、3.87 (2.39) 離乳羔羊數。遺傳力估值分別為：ALL 0.061 ± 0.0074、PL 0.051 ± 0.0082、TNL 0.061 ± 0.0073、TNB 0.059 ± 0.0072 及 TNW 0.058 ± 0.0098。遺傳相關估值介於 0.73 ± 0.056（PL × TNW）至 0.99 ± 0.0023（ALL × PL）之間，而表現型相關則介於 0.82 ± 0.0019（PL × TNB）至 0.99 ± 0.0001（ALL × PL）之間。具備表現型記錄之母羊的雙親，其估計育種值（EBV）平均準確度在所有性狀中皆大於 0.30。所有性狀均發現正向的遺傳趨勢，顯示每年每項性狀的遺傳獲得量分別為：ALL 0.34 天、PL 0.27 天、TNL 0.0082 胎、TNB 0.0022 產羔數以及 TNW 0.002 離乳羔羊數。鑑於各性狀具有相似的遺傳力估值且性狀間具高度遺傳相關，建議將 TNW 作為改良美利奴綿羊壽命的選擇標準，因為該性狀可同時改善母羊的壽命與繁殖性能。

papers.title: Part 2: precision nutrition targeting the gut barrier–nutrient transporter interface under heat stress in poultry
papers.abstract: SUMMARYHeat stress (HS) compromises intestinal integrity and nutrient utilisation in poultry, but it remains unclear how nutritional interventions directly restore nutrient transporter function. Building on the mechanistic framework established in Part 1, this review evaluates precision nutritional strategies at two levels: foundational diet formulation (energy, digestible amino acids and dietary electrolyte balance) and functional supplementation (vitamins, trace minerals, phytogenics, microbiota-directed additives, organic acids, medium-chain fatty acids, β-glucans and betaine). Particular emphasis is placed on evidence linking these interventions to intestinal nutrient transporters rather than on repeating HS injury pathways. Trace minerals, antioxidant vitamins, microbiota-directed interventions, organic acids, medium-chain fatty acids, phytogenic compounds, β-glucans and betaine can mitigate heat stress–induced intestinal dysfunction through complementary mechanisms. Their main effects include preserving tight-junction integrity, redox and immune homoeostasis, microbial balance, epithelial hydration, and cellular metabolism. Importantly, improvements in nutrient utilisation are not consistently accompanied by increased nutrient transporter gene expression. Instead, the available evidence suggests that many nutritional interventions preserve absorptive capacity indirectly by maintaining the structural, metabolic and electrochemical conditions required for transporter function. This distinction is particularly relevant because transporter mRNA abundance alone does not necessarily reflect protein abundance, membrane localisation or actual transport capacity. Therefore, future studies should integrate transcriptional data with transporter protein expression, apical membrane localisation and functional measurements such as substrate flux or direct absorption assays. Such studies should also account for differences in heat-stress duration and severity, as well as bird type and production stage. Collectively, these findings support a functional rather than exclusively transcriptional approach to nutritional modulation of the gut barrier–nutrient transporter interface under heat stress.

摘要
熱緊迫會損害家禽的腸道完整性與營養素利用，但營養介入措施如何直接恢復營養素轉運蛋白功能，目前仍不清楚。本篇綜論承襲第一部分建立的機制框架，從兩個層面評估精準營養策略：基礎日糧配方（能量、可消化胺基酸及日糧電解質平衡）與功能性補充劑（維生素、微量礦物質、植物源次生代謝物、菌相導向添加物、有機酸、中鏈脂肪酸、β-葡聚糖及甜菜鹼）。本文特別強調將這些介入措施連結至腸道營養素轉運蛋白的實證，而非重複敘述熱緊迫損傷途徑。微量礦物質、抗氧化維生素、菌相導向介入措施、有機酸、中鏈脂肪酸、植物源化合物、β-葡聚糖及甜菜鹼，能透過互補機制減緩熱緊迫引起的腸道功能障礙。其主要作用包括維持緊密連接完整性、氧化還原與免疫恆定、微生物平衡、上皮細胞水合作用及細胞代謝。重要的是，營養素利用率的改善，並不一定伴隨營養素轉運蛋白基因表現量的增加。相反地，現有證據顯示，許多營養介入措施是透過維持轉運蛋白功能所需的結構、代謝與電化學條件，來間接保持吸收能力。此一區別格外重要，因為單獨的轉運蛋白 mRNA 豐度並不必然反映蛋白質豐度、膜定位或實際的轉運能力。因此，未來研究應將轉錄體數據與轉運蛋白表現量、頂端膜定位及功能性量測（如受質通量或直接吸收分析）相結合。此類研究亦應考量熱緊迫持續時間與嚴重程度的差異，以及家禽品種與生產階段。綜上所述，這些研究結果支持在熱緊迫下，對腸道屏障與營養素轉運蛋白介面進行營養調控時，應採取功能性而非僅限於轉錄層面的方法。

papers.title: Effects of embryonic thermal manipulation and post-hatch synbiotic supplementation on growth performance, gut morphology, skeletal traits and caecal microbiota of broiler chickens under tropical conditions
papers.abstract: 1. This study investigated the effects of embryonic thermal manipulation and post-hatch synbiotic supplementation on growth performance, intestinal morphology, foot health, leg strength and tibial characteristics of broiler chickens reared in tropical conditions.2. A total of 840 fertile Ross 308 eggs were incubated at either the optimal temperature (37.5°C) or subjected to embryonic thermal manipulation (38.5°C from embryonic days (ED) 8 to 14). After hatch, chicks received either a basal diet or a basal diet supplemented with a synbiotic (1 g/kg) until 42 d of age.3. From d 21–28 all birds experienced an outbreak of leucocytozoonosis and received identical antiparasitic treatment, enabling comparisons of treatments under disease challenge.4. Embryonic thermal manipulation reduced hatchability (87.7 vs. 95.7%), starter feed intake and early body weight, but did not affect final body weight. Synbiotic supplementation improved overall feed conversion ratio. Under optimal incubation conditions, synbiotic supplementation increased body weight gain and duodenal villus height, whereas, following embryonic thermal manipulation, it increased tibial phosphorus content but reduced villus height.5. Neither embryonic thermal manipulation nor synbiotic supplementation affected gait score, latency-to-lie or caecal bacteria. Footpad dermatitis and hock burn scores increased only in synbiotic-supplemented broilers incubated at optimal temperature.6. Embryonic thermal manipulation altered the response to post-hatch synbiotic supplementation, shifting the benefits from enhanced intestinal morphology and growth performance to improved tibial mineralisation. These findings underscored the importance of incubation conditions when devising nutritional strategies for broiler production.

papers.title: National genomic evaluation for a novel functional longevity trait
papers.abstract: Background Cow longevity plays a major role in beef cattle industry profitability, reflecting the female’s ability to remain productive in the herd. In this context, longitudinal models as random regression models (RRM) are the preferred method for genetic evaluation as they account for genetic and environmental effects over time. Traditionally, RRM longevity evaluations use binary phenotypes; however, redefining the phenotype as the number of calves could enhance variability, better identify cows with consistent reproductive performance, and penalize irregular calving patterns. To address these limitations, this study aimed to: (1) propose genomic evaluations for a novel functional longevity (FL) definition via RRM; (2) compare model fit using Legendre polynomials (LP) of varying orders; (3) evaluate the implication of FL genetic parameters for selection strategies. Results The dataset included records from 2 million Angus cows and 1.6 million genotyped animals from the American and Canadian Angus Associations. FL was defined as the cumulative number of calvings, measured annually from 2 to 10 years of age. Genetic parameters were estimated with Gibbs sampling without genomic information, and genomic breeding values (GEBV) were estimated using RRM under single-step GBLUP with LP. Models were compared via the deviance information criterion and sire GEBV rankings across ages were evaluated using Spearman correlations and percentage of individuals in common (top 1%). The best fit was with a third-order LP and homogeneous residual variance. Heritabilities ranged from 0.04 to 0.12. Genetic correlations between ages were positive and high, with minimal fluctuations. GEBV rank correlations were consistent across ages, with Spearman correlations following the genetic correlations pattern. The percentage of commonly selected individuals between adjacent years was high. However, percentage decreased with increasing age gap, reaching 53% between ages 3 and 10. Conclusions The new functional longevity definition is feasible for genomic evaluations and has a straightforward interpretation as breeding values represent the number of additional calves when comparing animals. FL heritability estimates indicate sufficient additive genetic variance to allow moderate response to selection. Based on genetic correlations and ranking comparisons, functional longevity at 6 years of age is the optimal age to maximize genetic progress in Angus cattle.
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：母牛壽命在肉牛產業的獲利能力中扮演關鍵角色，反映出母牛在牛群中持續維持生產力的能力。在此背景下，如隨機迴歸模型（random regression models, RRM）等縱向模型是基因評估的首選方法，因其能納入隨時間變化的遺傳與環境效應。傳統上，RRM 壽命評估使用的是二元表型；然而，將表型重新定義為產犢次數，可以增加變異性、更好地識別具有一致繁殖性能的母牛，並懲罰不規則的產犢模式。為了解決這些限制，本研究旨在：(1) 透過 RRM 提出一種新穎的功能性壽命（functional longevity, FL）定義之基因體評估；(2) 比較使用不同階數勒讓德多項式（Legendre polynomials, LP）的模型配適度；(3) 評估 FL 遺傳參數對選育策略的意涵。

結果：資料集包含來自美國與加拿大安格斯牛協會（American and Canadian Angus Associations）200萬頭安格斯母牛的記錄及160萬頭具基因型之動物。FL 定義為累積產犢次數，從 2 歲至 10 歲每年進行測量。遺傳參數係利用不含基因體資訊的吉布斯抽樣（Gibbs sampling）進行估計，而基因體育種值（GEBV）則透過結合 LP 的單一步驟 GBLUP（single-step GBLUP）在 RRM 下進行估計。透過離差資訊準則（deviance information criterion）比較模型，並利用斯皮爾曼相關係數（Spearman correlations）與共同個體百分比（前 1%）評估不同年齡之公牛 GEBV 排名。最佳配適度為三階 LP 與同質殘差變異數。遺傳率介於 0.04 至 0.12 之間。不同年齡間的遺傳相關為正向且偏高，波動極小。GEBV 排名相關在各年齡間保持一致，斯皮爾曼相關係數遵循遺傳相關的模式。相鄰年份之間共同被選中個體的百分比很高。然而，此百分比隨著年齡差距的增加而下降，在 3 歲與 10 歲之間降至 53%。

結論：新的功能性壽命定義應用於基因體評估是可行的，且具有直觀的解釋，因為育種值在比較動物時代表了額外的產犢數量。FL 的遺傳率估計值顯示其具有足夠的加性遺傳變異，足以產生中等的選育反應。根據遺傳相關與排名比較，6 齡的功能性壽命是最大化安格斯牛遺傳進展的最佳年齡。

papers.title: Integrative Multi‐Omics Analysis Identifies Candidate MicroRNA Regulatory Networks Associated With High‐Altitude Adaptation in Tibetan Pigs
papers.abstract: MicroRNAs (miRNAs) are key posttranscriptional regulators of gene expression and play important roles in physiological responses to hypoxia, particularly in the cardiovascular system. However, the regulatory roles of miRNAs in cardiopulmonary tissues during high‐altitude adaptation remain poorly understood. Tibetan pigs are a high‐altitude‐adapted breed with strong hypoxia tolerance, making them an ideal model for investigating the molecular mechanisms underlying high‐altitude adaptation. In this study, we compared miRNA expression profiles between Tibetan pigs and low‐altitude Meishan pigs and integrated multi‐omics data to investigate miRNA‐mediated regulatory networks, with a particular focus on target genes and 3'UTR genetic variation. Small RNA and mRNA sequencing of heart and lung tissues identified 70 differentially expressed miRNAs and 453 candidate target genes associated with hypoxia adaptation, which were significantly enriched in pathways such as vascular smooth muscle contraction. Integrative analysis of whole‐genome resequencing data from 20 Tibetan pigs and 17 Meishan pigs further revealed that genetic variants within 3'UTR regions may contribute to the modulation of miRNA‐mRNA interactions. Notably, we identified a highly differentiated SNP within the predicted miR‐221‐5p binding site in the 3'UTR of RAB17 , suggesting a potential role of this variant in posttranscriptional regulation. Dual‐luciferase reporter assays and functional validation further supported a regulatory interaction between miR‐221‐5p and the RAB17 3'UTR. Collectively, these findings provide an integrative multi‐omics framework for elucidating candidate miRNA regulatory networks associated with high‐altitude adaptation and highlight the potential contribution of miRNA‐mediated posttranscriptional regulation and 3'UTR genetic variation to high‐altitude adaptation in Tibetan pigs.
papers.abstract_zh: 微小核糖核酸（miRNAs）是基因表現的關鍵轉錄後調節因子，在缺氧的生理反應中扮演重要角色，特別是在心血管系統中。然而，miRNAs在高原適應期間的心肺組織中的調節作用仍所知有限。藏豬是一個具有強大耐缺氧能力的高原適應品種，使其成為探討高原適應分子機制的理想模型。在本研究中，我們比較了藏豬與低海拔梅山豬之間的miRNA表現譜，並整合多體學數據來探討miRNA介導的調節網路，特別聚焦於標靶基因與3'UTR基因變異。對心臟和肺部組織進行的小型核糖核酸及mRNA定序，識別出70個與缺氧適應相關的差異表現miRNA以及453個候選標靶基因，這些基因在血管平滑肌收縮等路徑中顯著富集。對20隻藏豬和17隻梅山豬的全基因組重定序數據進行的整合分析進一步顯示，3'UTR區域內的基因變異可能參與調控miRNA與mRNA的交互作用。值得注意的是，我們在 $RAB17$ 基因3'UTR的預測 miR-221-5p 結合位點內識別出一個高度分化的SNP，這暗示了此變異在轉錄後調節中的潛在作用。雙螢光素酶報告基因檢定與功能驗證進一步支持了 miR-221-5p 與 $RAB17$ 3'UTR 之間的調節交互作用。總體而言，這些發現提供了一個整合的多體學框架，用於闡明與高原適應相關的候選miRNA調節網路，並突顯了miRNA介導的轉錄後調節及3'UTR基因變異對藏豬高原適應的潛在貢獻。

papers.title: Comparison of Models Fitting Alternative Contemporary Group Definition and Data Editing Procedures in the Genetic Evaluations of Reproductive Performance and Cow Longevity Traits in Nellore Cattle
papers.abstract: Reproductive traits in beef cattle are strongly influenced by environmental and management factors, making the correct definition and quality control of contemporary groups (CG) a key step for reliable genetic evaluations. Therefore, the main objective of this study was to evaluate the impact of alternative models considering different definitions of CG, minimum CG sizes (MCGS), and standard deviation thresholds for phenotypic outlier removal on the genetic evaluation of cow reproductive and longevity traits in Nellore cattle (Bos taurus indicus). The four traits evaluated included age at first calving (AFC; in days), early pregnancy occurrence (EP; binary), scrotal circumference at 18 months (SC18; in cm), and total number of calvings at 53 months of age (NC53; count). The database comprised 954,216 animals, including 401,885 females and 552,331 males, with 227,447, 401,885, 356,519, and 531,579 records available for AFC, EP, NC53, and SC18, respectively, and a pedigree file comprising 1,348,164 animals. Variance components and genetic parameters were estimated using a pedigree-based animal model implemented in the BLUPF90 software family (version 1.57) for continuous traits (AFC and SC18) and a Bayesian animal model implemented in THRGIBBS1F90 (version 2.108) for categorical traits (EP and NC53). The Linear Regression (LR) method was used to assess model performance based on accuracy, bias, and dispersion of estimated breeding values (EBVs). The main CG criteria included MCGS of 3, 7, and 15 animals, four phenotypic outlier-removal thresholds (±2.0, ±2.5, ±3.0, and ±3.5 SD) for continuous traits, and the presence or absence of phenotypic variability within CGs for categorical traits. We also compared alternative combinations of fixed effects included within or outside CGs and evaluated genetic connectedness among CGs. The definition of CGs and data editing procedures yielded different heritability estimates and EBV accuracies across scenarios and traits. The heritability estimates for the evaluated traits ranged from 0.06 to 0.45, while EBV accuracies ranged from 0.45 to 0.92 across CG scenarios. Continuously-recorded traits, especially AFC, were more sensitive to model specification and CG structure, whereas categorical traits and SC18 were more robust to differences in quality control criteria. Animal rankings showed high consistency among scenarios, with mean concordance of 94.8% for the top 1% of males and top 20% of females and 95.4% for all animals. Our findings indicate that the definition of CGs and data editing procedures for each trait and population are key steps to be carefully performed before genetic evaluation analyses, since parameters such as heritability estimates, EBV accuracy, bias, and dispersion may be affected.
papers.abstract_zh: 肉牛的繁殖性狀受環境與管理因素的強烈影響，因此正確定義當代群（contemporary groups, CG）並進行品質控制，是進行可靠遺傳評估的關鍵步驟。本研究的主要目的是評估在尼爾盧牛（Nellore cattle, *Bos taurus indicus*）中，考慮不同當代群定義、最小當代群規模（minimum CG sizes, MCGS）以及用於移除表現型極端值（outliers）之標準差閾值的替代模型，對母牛繁殖與壽命性狀遺傳評估的影響。評過的四個性狀包含：首次分娩日齡（AFC，以天計）、早期受孕率（EP，二元性狀）、18月齡陰囊圍（SC18，以公分計）以及53月齡時的總分娩次數（NC53，計數性狀）。資料庫包含 954,216 頭動物，其中包含 401,885 頭雌性與 552,331 頭雄性，AFC、EP、NC53 和 SC18 分別有 227,447、401,885、356,519 和 531,579 筆有效紀錄，系譜檔案則包含 1,348,164 頭動物。連續性狀（AFC 與 SC18）的變方成分與遺傳參數係使用基於系譜之動物模式（透過 BLUPF90 軟體家族 1.57 版本執行）進行估計，而類別性狀（EP 與 NC53）則使用貝氏動物模式（透過 THRGIBBS1F90 2.108 版本執行）。線性迴歸（Linear Regression, LR）方法用於根據估計育種值（EBVs）的準確度、偏差和離散度來評估模型效能。主要的當代群標準包含：3、7 和 15 頭動物的最小當代群規模、針對連續性狀的四種表現型極端值移除閾值（±2.0、±2.5、±3.0 及 ±3.5 倍標準差），以及針對類別性狀在當代群內是否存在表現型變異。我們亦比較了包含在當代群內或外的固定效應之替代組合，並評估當代群之間的遺傳連結度。當代群的定義與資料編輯程序在不同情境與性狀間產生了不同的遺傳率估計值與育種值準確度。在各個當代群情境中，受評性狀的遺傳率估計值介於 0.06 至 0.45 之間，而育種值準確度則介於 0.45 至 0.92 之間。連續記錄的性狀（尤其是 AFC）對模型規格與當代群結構更為敏感，而類別性狀與 SC18 對品質控制標準的差異則展現較佳的穩健性。動物排名在不同情境間顯示出高度的一致性，前 1% 雄性與前 20% 雌性的平均一致率為 94.8%，全體動物則為 95.4%。我們的研究結果顯示，由於遺傳率估計值、育種值準確度、偏差和離散度等參數可能會受影響，因此在進行遺傳評估分析之前，仔細執行針對各性狀與族群之當代群定義與資料編輯程序是關鍵步驟。

papers.title: Machine-Learning-Based Genomic Prioritization and Genome-Wide Association Analysis of Growth Traits in Central Anatolian Merino Sheep
papers.abstract: Growth traits are major economic drivers in sheep production, yet their genetic architecture is highly polygenic and influenced by multiple genetic and environmental factors. Here, we integrated machine-learning-based genomic prioritization and prediction with conventional mixed-model genome-wide association analysis to investigate growth traits in Central Anatolian Merino sheep. Phenotypic records for birth weight (BW), weaning weight (WW), six-month weight (W6), and average daily gains before (ADWG1) and after weaning (ADWG2) were obtained from 278 lambs genotyped using the Illumina OvineSNP50 BeadChip. Following genotype quality control, 275 animals and 46,902 SNPs were retained for genome-wide analyses. Machine-learning models were evaluated using five-fold outer cross-validation repeated five times. Within each outer training set, SNP preprocessing, feature prioritization, consensus ranking, marker-panel construction, hyperparameter optimization, and model fitting were performed independently. LASSO, Elastic Net, Random Forest, and XGBoost were used for SNP prioritization, and 50-, 100-, and 200-SNP panels were evaluated using Ridge regression, Random Forest, XGBoost, and Support Vector Regression. Conventional mixed-model GWAS identified no SNP reaching genome-wide significance after Bonferroni or FDR correction, although several suggestive and chromosome-wide signals were detected. Exploratory comparison of ML prioritization and GWAS results revealed concordant genomic signals for related traits, particularly ADWG1–WW and ADWG2–W6; these were interpreted as shared genomic signals rather than evidence of pleiotropy. Candidate gene annotation identified biologically relevant positional candidate genes involved in muscle development, skeletal growth, metabolism, and cellular regulation, including PRMT1, TNC, POU1F1, RASD2, ERCC6L2, SSH2, and DYM. Overall, the complementary use of machine-learning-based genomic prioritization and conventional GWAS provided a conservative framework for investigating the genomic architecture of growth traits. The identified genomic signals and positional candidate genes should be considered exploratory and require validation in larger and independent sheep populations before their potential application in genomic selection.
papers.abstract_zh: 生長性狀是綿羊生產中主要的經濟驅動因素，然而其遺傳結構具有高度多基因性，並受到多種遺傳與環境因素的影響。在本研究中，我們結合了基於機器學習的基因體優先排序與預測技術，以及傳統的混合模式全基因體關聯分析，來探討中安那托利亞美利諾綿羊（Central Anatolian Merino sheep）的生長性狀。本研究從 278 隻使用 Illumina OvineSNP50 BeadChip 進行基因分型的羔羊中，獲取了出生體重（BW）、離乳體重（WW）、六月齡體重（W6），以及離乳前（ADWG1）與離乳後（ADWG2）平均日增重的表現型記錄。經過基因型品質控制後，最終保留 275 個個體與 46,902 個單核苷酸多型性（SNP）用於全基因體分析。機器學習模型採用重複五次的五折外部交叉驗證進行評估。在每個外部訓練集中，獨立進行了 SNP 前處理、特徵優先排序、共識排序、標記面板建構、超參數最佳化以及模型擬合。本研究使用 LASSO、Elastic Net、Random Forest 與 XGBoost 進行 SNP 優先排序，並利用 Ridge regression、Random Forest、XGBoost 和 Support Vector Regression 評估 50、100 與 200 個 SNP 的面板。傳統混合模式 GWAS 在經過 Bonferroni 或 FDR 校正後，未發現達到全基因體顯著水準的 SNP，但檢測到數個提示性（suggestive）與染色體範圍的信號。機器學習優先排序與 GWAS 結果的探索性比較顯示，相關性狀（特別是 ADWG1–WW 與 ADWG2–W6）具有一致的基因體信號；這些信號被解釋為共享的基因體信號，而非基因多效性的證據。候選基因註釋識別出參與肌肉發育、骨骼生長、代謝及細胞調節的具生物學相關性之位置候選基因，包含 *PRMT1*、*TNC*、*POU1F1*、*RASD2*、*ERCC6L2*、*SSH2* 和 *DYM*。總體而言，互補使用基於機器學習的基因體優先排序與傳統 GWAS，為探討生長性狀的基因體結構提供了一個保守的分析框架。所識別的基因體信號與位置候選基因應被視為探索性質，在應用於基因體選擇之前，尚需在更大規模且獨立的綿羊族群中進行驗證。

papers.title: Effects of Dietary Zeolite Inclusion on the Performance and Egg Quality of Laying Hens: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
papers.abstract: Zeolite has been increasingly investigated as a functional mineral feed additive in poultry diets because of its adsorptive and ion-exchange properties; evidence regarding its effects in laying hens remains inconsistent. A meta-analysis search was conducted in PubMed, Semantic Scholar, and Scopus following PRISMA guidelines and resulted in 30 eligible publications (1985 and 2026). Effect sizes were expressed as the natural logarithm of the response ratio (LnRR) and synthesized using robust variance estimation (RVE) as the primary analysis, while multilevel analysis was performed as a sensitivity analysis (to account for dependent effect sizes). Heterogeneity was assessed using I2 and τ2, and publication bias was evaluated using Egger’s regression test. Subgroup analyses were conducted according to zeolite type, laying hen strain, inclusion level based on the EFSA reference threshold (≤1.25% vs. >1.25%), and experimental period. Zeolite supplementation significantly reduced feed intake by 1.65% (LnRR = −0.017; p = 0.024) and feed conversion ratio by 9.21% (LnRR = −0.097; p = 0.003), while increasing final body weight by 3.91% (LnRR = 0.038; p = 0.003). Egg weight, eggshell thickness, albumen weight, and egg shape index increased by 1.57%, 4.24%, 5.05%, and 2.09%, respectively. Sensitivity analysis generally supported the direction of the responses, although statistical significance was inconsistently retained for some outcomes, including FBW, globulin, AST, tibial ash, Ca and P plasma, indicating model-dependent evidence. Several hematological and plasma biochemical parameters were not significantly altered. Subgroup analyses indicated variation according to hen strain, zeolite type, inclusion level, and experimental period, although within-subgroup significance did not consistently indicate between-subgroup differences. Overall, zeolite supplementation was associated with improved feed efficiency and selected production and egg-quality traits, but substantial heterogeneity, dependency among effect sizes, and model-dependent findings for some outcomes warrant cautious interpretation. Further well-controlled and longer-term studies are needed to clarify the factors underlying variation in response and their biological relevance.
papers.abstract_zh: 沸石因具備吸附與離子交換特性，作為家禽飼料中的功能性礦物質添加物已受到日益增加的研究關注；然而，關於其對產蛋母雞影響的證據仍存在不一致性。本研究遵循 PRISMA 指南，於 PubMed、Semantic Scholar 和 Scopus 進行統合分析文獻檢索，最終納入 30 篇符合條件的出版品（1985 年至 2026 年）。效果量以反應比的自然對數（LnRR）表示，並以強健變異數估計（RVE）作為主要分析進行綜合，同時執行多層次分析作為敏感性分析（以處理相依的效果量）。異質性以 $I^2$ 與 $\tau^2$ 評估，出版偏差則透過艾格氏迴歸檢定（Egger’s regression test）進行評估。子群分析根據沸石種類、產蛋母雞品系、基於 EFSA 參考閾值的添加量（$\le 1.25\%$ 對比 $>1.25\%$）以及實驗期間進行。沸石補充顯著降低了 $1.65\%$ 的採食量（$\text{LnRR} = -0.017$；$p = 0.024$）以及 $9.21\%$ 的料肉比（$\text{LnRR} = -0.097$；$p = 0.003$），同時使最終體重增加了 $3.91\%$（$\text{LnRR} = 0.038$；$p = 0.003$）。蛋重、蛋殼厚度、蛋白重及蛋形指數分別增加了 $1.57\%$、$4.24\%$、$5.05\%$ 及 $2.09\%$。敏感性分析大致支持反應的方向性，儘管部分指標（包含最終體重、球蛋白、天門冬胺酸轉胺酶、脛骨灰分、血漿鈣與磷）的統計顯著性未能持續保持，顯示出對模型的依賴性證據。數項血液學與血漿生化參數則未顯著改變。子群分析顯示，反應會因母雞品系、沸石種類、添加量及實驗期間而有所差異，儘管子群內的顯著性並不一致地代表子群間的差異。總體而言，補充沸石與改善飼料效率、部分生產及蛋品質性狀相關，但顯著的異質性、效果量間的相依性，以及部分指標對模型的依賴性結果，在解讀時需保持謹慎。未來仍需進行設計良好且為期更長的研究，以釐清反應變異背後的影響因素及其生物學相關性。

papers.title: Duck HERC3 Positively Regulates RIG-I/MAVS-Mediated IFN-β Production Through Interaction with MAVS
papers.abstract: The RIG-I-like receptor (RLR) pathway is essential for detecting cytosolic viral RNA and initiating type I interferon responses via the key adaptor MAVS. Although MAVS regulation has been extensively studied in mammals, little is known about its regulatory mechanisms in avian species. HERC3 participates in the regulation of RLR-mediated immunity in mammals, but its role in ducks remains unexplored. Here, we investigated the function of duck HERC3 (duHERC3) in the RLR pathway. We found that duHERC3 was ubiquitously expressed in all examined tissues and significantly upregulated upon Newcastle disease virus (NDV) infection and 3p-hpRNA stimulation. Overexpression of duHERC3 elevated the mRNA levels of MAVS and OASL and enhanced IFN-β production, whereas knockdown of duHERC3 exerted opposite effects. Co-immunoprecipitation (Co-IP) revealed that duHERC3 interacts with the N-terminal domain of MAVS (aa5-175). Moreover, duHERC3 enhanced MAVS-mediated IFN-β induction in a RIG-I-dependent manner, indicating that duHERC3 functions through the canonical RIG-I-MAVS axis. Collectively, our findings demonstrate that duck HERC3 positively regulates MAVS-dependent IFN-β production via interaction with MAVS, providing new insights into the regulatory network of avian innate immunity.
papers.abstract_zh: RIG-I樣受體（RLR）路徑對於偵測細胞質中的病毒RNA並透過關鍵接頭蛋白MAVS啟動第一型干擾素反應至關重要。儘管MAVS的調控機制在哺乳動物中已被廣泛研究，但其在鳥類中的調控機制所知甚少。HERC3參與哺乳動物中RLR介導的免疫調控，但其在鴨子中的作用仍未被探討。在本研究中，我們探討了鴨HERC3（duHERC3）在RLR路徑中的功能。我們發現duHERC3在所有檢測的組織中均普遍表現，並在感染新城雞瘟病毒（NDV）及受到3p-hpRNA刺激後顯著上調。過表現duHERC3會提高MAVS和OASL的mRNA水平並增強IFN-β的產生，而抑制duHERC3則產生相反的效果。共同免疫沉澱（Co-IP）顯示duHERC3與MAVS的N端結構域（aa5-175）相互作用。此外，duHERC3以依賴RIG-I的方式增強MAVS介導的IFN-β誘導，這表明duHERC3透過經典的RIG-I-MAVS軸發揮作用。總體而言，我們的研究結果證明了鴨HERC3透過與MAVS相互作用來正向調控MAVS依賴的IFN-β產生，為鳥類先天免疫的調控網路提供了新的見解。

papers.title: Feed physical form (mash vs . pellets) in layer and breeder chickens: implications for performance, gut function, and practical feeding strategies
papers.abstract: SUMMARYThis review synthesizes experimental and field data on pelleted versus mash diets in layers, breeders, and grandparent flocks. Pellets may improve early growth and FCR (by 5–10% in pullets), but they may also result in underdeveloped gizzards and reduced fertility. Mash diets could promote gizzard development, hatchability (by up to 8% in breeders), and flock uniformity across production phases. A novel synthesis suggests that stage-specific feeding strategies (such as chick pellets followed by grower mash) may optimize performance, gut health, and economics. Field cases indicate that mash may be superior for reproduction under heat stress. Chicks may thrive on crumbles or pellets for accelerated early growth, whereas growers and pre-layers may respond better to coarse mash, which promotes skeletal development and flock uniformity. Feeding mash to laying hens has been shown to improve egg quality and maintain high productivity over time. In breeder and grandparent stocks, mash diets are associated with improved fertility and hatchability. This review combines experimental data with detailed field case studies to reconcile differing opinions and provide useful, age-appropriate recommendations. Feed form should be viewed not as a fixed decision but as a dynamic strategy tailored to bird age, production goals, and prevailing farm conditions.
papers.abstract_zh:
摘要

本篇綜論整合了關於產蛋雞、種雞與曾祖代雞群食用粒料與粉料之實驗及田間數據。粒料可改善早期生長與飼料轉換率（在生長中母雞中提升 5–10%），但也可能導致肌胃發育不全及受精率下降。粉料則能促進肌胃發育、孵化率（在種雞中最高可提升 8%）以及各生產階段的雞群整齊度。一項新穎的綜合分析顯示，階段性飼餵策略（例如雛雞餵食粒料，隨後於生長期餵食粉料）可優化生產效能、腸道健康與經濟效益。田間案例指出，在熱應激下，粉料對於繁殖表現可能更具優勢。雛雞可透過碎粒料或粒料來促進早期生長，而生長期與預產期雞群對粗磨粉料反應較佳，因其能促進骨骼發育與雞群整齊度。研究顯示，對產蛋雞餵食粉料能改善雞蛋品質並長期維持高生產效能。在種雞與曾祖代雞群中，粉料飼糧與較佳的受精率和孵化率息息相關。本綜論結合了實驗數據與詳細的田間案例研究，以調和不同的見解，並提供實用且符合各生長階段的建議。飼料型態不應被視為一項固定決策，而應視為一項針對家禽日齡、生產目標與現有場區條件所量身打造的動態策略。

papers.title: Analysis of Factors Affecting Pregnancy Rate After Artificial Insemination in Lusitano Broodmares
papers.abstract: Artificial insemination (AI) is widely used in the horse breeding industry, but its success is often limited by different factors. Our objective was to assess the importance of various factors affecting fertility after AI, using field data collected in 125 mares over a period of 20 years, corresponding to a total of 860 mare-year combinations. The criteria defined for measuring fertility were: (1) pregnancy rate per breeding season; (2) pregnancy diagnosed at the 14th day on the first cycle and (3) number of cycles needed for a mare to become pregnant. Statistical analyses were performed using the GLIMMIX procedure of SAS, with a binary logit model with repeated records. The overall pregnancy rate per breeding season (PRBS) was 0.813 and at 14 days on the first cycle (PR1C) it was 0.546. The PRBS was higher when insemination was practiced early in the breeding season (p < 0.001) and declined with increasing mare age (p < 0.001) as well as with stallion age (p = 0.013). Mares presenting uterine pre-AI oedema had higher fertility at PR1C (p = 0.037). The mean number of oestrous cycles for a confirmed pregnancy was 1.82 ± 1.01 and, among others, age impacted this result adversely. In conclusion, our results suggest that some identified key factors can be used by owners, farm managers and veterinarians to improve mare reproductive performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 人工授精（AI）在馬匹繁殖產業中被廣泛應用，但其成功率往往受到多種因素的限制。本研究的目的是評估影響人工授精後受孕率之各種因素的重要性，我們使用了在20年間對125匹母馬所收集的現場數據，相當於總共860個「母馬-年」的組合。設定用以衡量受孕力的標準為：(1) 每個繁殖季的受孕率；(2) 第一個發情週期第14天診斷出的受孕率；以及 (3) 母馬受孕所需的發情週期數。統計分析使用SAS的GLIMMIX程序，採用具有重複記錄的二元logit模型。每個繁殖季的整體受孕率（PRBS）為0.813，第一個發情週期第14天的受孕率（PR1C）為0.546。當在繁殖季早期進行授精時，PRBS較高（p < 0.001），並且隨著母馬年齡（p < 0.001）以及公馬年齡（p = 0.013）的增長而下降。人工授精前呈現子宮水腫的母馬在PR1C時具有較高的受孕力（p = 0.037）。確診受孕所需的平均發情週期數為 1.82 ± 1.01，且年齡等因素對此結果有負面影響。總結來說，我們的結果顯示，某些被識別出的關鍵因素可供馬主、農場管理者和獸醫使用，以改善母馬的繁殖性能。

papers.title: Weighted Single‐Step GWAS Reveals Genetic Mechanisms Underlying Pregnancy Loss in Early Nellore Heifers
papers.abstract: Pregnancy loss (PL) affects reproductive efficiency in beef cattle, yet its genetic architecture remains poorly understood in Bos indicus populations. Here, PL was defined as failure from pregnancy diagnosis to calving, capturing a window approximately 60 days after the breeding season. This study aimed to identify genomic regions and biological pathways associated with PL in early Nellore heifers using weighted single‐step genome‐wide association study (WssGWAS). Phenotypic records from 23 507 Nellore heifers were analyzed, including 17 052 genotyped animals (GGP Indicus panel, Neogen) and 44 233 SNPs. Genomic regions explaining more than 0.5% of additive genetic variance were used to identify putative candidate genes and perform functional enrichment analysis. The estimated heritability for PL was low (0.033), indicating strong environmental influence. WssGWAS identified 25 genomic regions across 16 chromosomes, explaining 31.16% of additive genetic variance for PL. The most relevant region was located on BTA16, explaining 6.51% of the variance, although no annotated protein‐coding genes were found. Additional regions occurred on BTA6, BTA14, BTA22, BTA25, and BTA29. Putative candidate genes included IL4R, IL21R, LRRC4C, RBMS3, ZFPM2, PRSS23 , and NDST4 , involved in immune regulation, cell adhesion, extracellular matrix remodeling, and transcriptional regulation. Functional enrichment identified Gene Ontology terms and REACTOME pathways related to nucleosome assembly, epigenetic regulation, transmembrane transport, focal adhesion, calcium signaling, immune response, and WNT signaling. These findings inform the genetic architecture of PL in Nellore cattle and suggest roles for embryo–maternal communication, immune regulation, chromatin organization, and placental development in pregnancy maintenance, supporting future functional validation and genomic selection strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 姙娠損失（pregnancy loss, PL）會影響肉牛的繁殖效率，然而其在印度牛（Bos indicus）族群中的遺傳結構仍所知有限。在本研究中，PL被定義為從姙娠診斷到分娩失敗，涵蓋了配種季結束後大約60天的窗口期。本研究旨在透過加權單步全基因體關聯分析（weighted single-step genome-wide association study, WssGWAS），識別與早期奈盧爾（Nellore）女牛PL相關的基因體區域與生物學途徑。本研究分析了來自23,507頭奈盧爾女牛的表型記錄，其中包含17,052頭經過基因分型之動物（使用GGP Indicus晶片，Neogen）以及44,233個單核苷酸多型性（SNP）。利用解釋超過0.5%加成性遺傳變異的基因體區域來識別潛在候選基因，並進行功能富集分析。PL的估計遺傳力偏低（0.033），顯示其受到強烈的環境影響。WssGWAS在16條染色體上識別出25個基因體區域，解釋了PL達31.16%的加成性遺傳變異。最具相關性的區域位於第16號常染色體（BTA16）上，解釋了6.51%的變異，但未發現已註解的蛋白質編碼基因。其他區域則分佈於BTA6、BTA14、BTA22、BTA25和BTA29。潛在候選基因包含IL4R、IL21R、LRRC4C、RBMS3、ZFPM2、PRSS23和NDST4，這些基因參與免疫調節、細胞黏附、細胞外基質重塑及轉錄調控。功能富集分析識別出與核小體組合、表觀遺傳調控、跨膜運輸、局部黏附、鈣離子訊息傳遞、免疫反應及WNT訊息傳遞相關的基因本體（Gene Ontology）詞彙與REACTOME途徑。這些發現闡明了奈盧爾牛PL的遺傳結構，並指出胚胎與母體間通訊、免疫調節、染色質組織及胎盤發育在維持姙娠中扮演的角色，為未來的功能驗證與基因體選擇策略提供支持。

papers.title: Effect of dietary post-biotic supplementation on growth performance, antioxidant status, immunity and gut health in broiler chickens
papers.abstract: 1. This study evaluated the effects of dietary supplementation of a Saccharomyces cerevisiae post-biotic on growth performance, immune response, antioxidant status, gut microbial population and intestinal morphology in broiler chickens.2. A total of 144, one-day-old Vencobb-400F broiler chicks were randomly distributed into three dietary treatments, each with eight replicates containing six chicks, and reared in battery cages for 35 d.3. The control diet was without post-biotic supplementation, while the treatment diets contained 0.5 or 1 g/kg post-biotic. Growth performance, Newcastle disease antibody titre, caecal microbial counts, serum antioxidant indices and gut histomorphometry were recorded.4. Birds fed diets supplemented with post-biotics showed significantly (p < 0.05) higher body weight gain and improved feed conversion ratio compared to the control group, while feed intake remained unaffected.5. Newcastle disease antibody titres were significantly higher (p < 0.05) in birds fed 1 g/kg post-biotic. Supplementation increased (p < 0.05) Lactobacillus spp. counts and reduced (p < 0.05) E. coli populations in the caecum.6. Serum antioxidant enzymes were significantly elevated (p < 0.05), whereas lipid peroxidation and cortisol levels were significantly reduced in supplemented birds compared to control. Improvements in villi measurements were observed, although differences were mostly not significant.
papers.abstract_zh:
1. 本研究評估了日糧中補充釀酒酵母後生元（post-biotic）對肉雞生長性能、免疫反應、抗氧化狀態、腸道微生物菌群及腸道形態的影響。
2. 總共 144 隻一日齡 Vencobb-400F 肉雞被隨機分配至三個日糧處理組，每組有八個重複，每個重複包含六隻雛雞，並於層疊式籠養系統中飼養 35 天。
3. 對照組日糧未添加後生元，而處理組日糧則分別添加 0.5 或 1 g/kg 的後生元。記錄生長性能、新城病抗體力價、盲腸微生物數量、血清抗氧化指標及腸道組織形態學。
4. 與對照組相比，餵食添加後生元日糧的家禽其增重顯著增加（p < 0.05）且飼料轉換率獲得改善，而採食量則不受影響。
5. 餵食 1 g/kg 後生元的家禽，其新城病抗體力價顯著升高（p < 0.05）。添加後生元顯著增加了盲腸中乳酸桿菌屬（*Lactobacillus* spp.）的數量（p < 0.05），並減少了大腸桿菌（*E. coli*）的數量（p < 0.05）。
6. 與對照組相比，補充後生元組的血清抗氧化酵素顯著升高（p < 0.05），而脂質過氧化物與皮質醇濃度則顯著降低。腸絨毛測量值雖有所改善，但多數差異未達顯著水準。

papers.title: Multi-omics reveals that dietary Piper sarmentosum Roxb. extract improves goat meat quality via the microbiota–muscle amino acid metabolic axis
papers.abstract: Background Improving meat quality through nutritional regulation is an important approach in ruminant production. Growing evidence suggests that rumen microbiota influences host metabolism via microbial metabolites, thereby affecting meat quality. However, whether Piper sarmentosum Roxb. extract (PSE), a medicinal and edible plant-derived extract, improves meat quality through rumen microbiota–host metabolic interactions remains unclear. Thirty-six weaned male Hainan black goats (approximately 3 months old) were randomly assigned to four dietary treatments supplemented with 0, 200, 400, or 600 mg/kg PSE (dry matter basis), respectively. After a 90-day feeding trial, goats were fasted for 12 h before slaughter, and rumen and longissimus lumborum muscle samples were collected for subsequent analyses. Results Supplementation with 600 mg/kg PSE significantly enhanced meat quality traits, including higher ultimate pH, improved color stability, and increased water-holding capacity, without affecting growth performance or carcass traits. Transcriptomic and metabolomic analyses revealed that PSE supplementation was associated with remodeling of amino acid and energy metabolism in muscle, particularly glutamate-related pathways. These metabolic changes were accompanied by increased expression of key metabolic genes, including BCAT2 , IDH1 , and IDH3A , alongside alterations in energy-related metabolites, such as the downregulation of carnitine and upregulation of creatinine. Concomitant shifts in rumen microbial composition were observed, with PSE supplementation increasing the abundance of genera like Weissella and Ruminococcus , while reducing potentially opportunistic genera, such as Acinetobacter and Klebsiella . Weissella showed strong positive correlations with elevated rumen metabolites like serine, threonine, choline, and hypoxanthine. Metagenome-assembled genome analysis of Weissella cibaria revealed an enrichment of genes related to amino acid metabolism and glycosyltransferase families. Correlation and mediation analyses further revealed associations among Weissella abundance, rumen metabolites, and muscle metabolic traits, supporting a potential microbiota–metabolite–host metabolic relationship. Conclusions Collectively, this study provides new insights into the association network linking PSE-induced alterations in rumen microbiota, microbial metabolites, and host muscle metabolism in relation to goat meat quality. These findings suggest that PSE supplementation may improve meat quality through coordinated changes in rumen microbial ecology and muscle metabolic profiles.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Science and Biotechnology
papers.abstract_zh: 背景 透過營養調控來改善肉品品質是反芻動物生產中的重要方法。越來越多的證據表明，瘤胃微生物群透過微生物代謝物影響宿主代謝，進而影響肉品品質。然而，賈苔（Piper sarmentosum Roxb.）萃取物（PSE）這種兼具藥用與食用的植物源萃取物，是否能透過「瘤胃微生物群—宿主代謝」的交互作用來改善肉品品質，目前仍不清楚。本研究將 36 隻離乳海南黑山羊公羊（約 3 月齡）隨機分為四個日糧處理組，分別補充 0、200、400 或 600 mg/kg 的 PSE（以乾物質基礎計）。經過 90 天的飼養試驗後，山羊在屠宰前禁食 12 小時，並採集瘤胃及背最長肌樣本以進行後續分析。結果 補充 600 mg/kg 的 PSE 顯著提升了肉品品質特徵，包括較高的最終 pH 值、改善的色澤穩定性以及增加的保水力，且不影響生長性能或屠體性狀。轉錄體學與代謝體學分析顯示，PSE 補充與肌肉中胺基酸及能量代謝（特別是麩胺酸相關途徑）的重塑有關。這些代謝變化伴隨著關鍵代謝基因（包括 BCAT2、IDH1 及 IDH3A）表現量的增加，以及能量相關代謝物（如肉鹼的下調和肌酸酐的上調）的改變。同時觀察到瘤胃微生物組成的轉變，PSE 補充增加了魏斯氏菌屬（Weissella）和瘤胃球菌屬（Ruminococcus）等屬的豐度，同時減少了諸如不動桿菌屬（Acinetobacter）和克雷伯氏菌屬（Klebsiella）等潛在伺機性致病菌屬。魏斯氏菌屬與升高的瘤胃代謝物（如絲胺酸、蘇胺酸、膽鹼和次黃嘌呤）呈現強烈的正相關。對西氏魏斯氏菌（Weissella cibaria）進行的巨基因體組裝基因組（MAG）分析顯示，其胺基酸代謝及醣基轉移酶家族相關基因富集。相關性與中介分析進一步揭示了魏斯氏菌屬豐度、瘤胃代謝物與肌肉代謝特徵之間的關聯，支持了潛在的「微生物群—代謝物—宿主代謝」關係。結論 總體而言，本研究為連結 PSE 引起的瘤胃微生物群、微生物代謝物變化，以及與山羊肉品品質相關的宿主肌肉代謝之間的關聯網絡提供了新的見解。這些發現表明，補充 PSE 可能透過協調瘤胃微生物生態與肌肉代謝特徵的改變來改善肉品品質。

papers.title: Effects of Concentrated Pineapple Extract on Nutrient Digestibility, Growth Performance, and Digestive Health in Broiler Chickens
papers.abstract: Rising concerns about antimicrobial resistance and the safety of livestock-derived products have increased interest in natural feed additives for poultry production. Pineapple (Ananas comosus), which is rich in bromelain and phenolic compounds, has emerged as a promising candidate for supporting digestive function. This study evaluated the effects of concentrated pineapple extract (CPE) on nutrient digestibility, growth performance, and gastrointestinal health in broiler chickens. Using a completely randomized 6 × 2 factorial arrangement, 288 one-day-old Arbor Acres chicks were distributed to six dietary treatments (CPE at 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20 mL/kg, and a 110 ppm chlortetracycline), with six replications. Chicks were fed ad libitum for 42 days, and growth performance, apparent total tract nutrient disappearance, gut pH, microbial populations, and intestinal histomorphology were assessed. No significant diet–sex interaction was observed. CPE supplementation reduced gastric and duodenal pH and feed intake but did not affect body weight or intestinal morphology. Notably, CPE improved apparent total tract N retention and reduced intestinal Escherichia coli counts, while supplementation at 5 mL/kg enhanced fat digestibility. Sex-related differences were observed in jejunum and ileum pH. Overall, dietary inclusion of 5–10 mL/kg (44,770–89,540 GDU/kg diet) CPE may support digestive efficiency without compromising growth performance in broiler chickens.
papers.abstract_zh: 日益增加的抗生素抗藥性疑慮以及畜產品的安全性，提高了產業界對家禽生產中使用天然飼料添加物的興趣。鳳梨（Ananas comosus）富含鳳梨酵素與酚類化合物，已成為支援消化功能的潛力候選物。本研究評估了濃縮鳳梨萃取物（CPE）對肉雞營養分消化率、生長性能及胃腸道健康的影響。試驗採用完全隨機 6 × 2 因子排列設計，將 288 隻一日齡 Arbor Acres 肉雞分配至六種飼糧處理（CPE 添加量為 0、5、10、15 與 20 mL/kg，以及 110 ppm 金黴素），每處理六個重複。肉雞自由採食 42 天，並評估生長性能、全消化道營養分表觀消失率、腸道 pH 值、微生物菌相及腸道組織形態學。結果顯示，飼糧與性別之間無顯著的交戶作用。補充 CPE 降低了胃與十二指腸的 pH 值及採食量，但對體重或腸道形態無顯著影響。值得注意的是，CPE 改善了全消化道氮滯留率並減少了腸道大腸桿菌數量，而添加 5 mL/kg 則能提升脂肪消化率。空腸與迴腸的 pH 值則觀察到性別相關的差異。總體而言，在肉雞飼糧中添加 5–10 mL/kg（44,770–89,540 GDU/kg 飼糧）的 CPE，可在不影響生長性能的情況下，提升肉雞的消化效率。

papers.title: Genetic architecture of bone strength and composition in White Leghorn laying hens
papers.abstract: Background Skeletal issues such as fractures and poor bone quality are increasingly recognized for their negative impacts on animal welfare and the economic challenges they bring to the poultry industry. Previous pedigree-based analyses in White Leghorn laying hens have reported moderate heritabilities for cortical and medullary bone composition traits (ranging from 0.18 to 0.41) and strong genetic correlations (0.69 to 0.90) with tibia breaking strength and density. This study uses genome-wide association studies (GWAS) to identify genetic markers associated with bone strength and composition traits, aiming to advance our understanding of the genetic architecture of bone quality in White Leghorn laying hens. Results We identified a set of markers on chromosome 20 (11.55–12.29 Mb) in strong LD with each other ( r 2 > 0.8), significantly associated with humeral stiffness, and overlapping with humeral strength and tibial cortical thickness. These markers were located within the previously identified QTL on chromosome 20 for bone biomechanical strength and body weight. This region harbors a bone morphogenetic protein 7 gene ( BMP7 ) with a known role in skeletogenesis and growth in chicken. Genetic markers with the strongest suggestive association with organic and mineral contents, and total amount of carbonate in bone mineral MinCO3 1415 in tibia medullary bone were detected on chromosome 1 (173.5–173.6 Mb). This region contains the long non-coding RNA LOC107052041 (LncFAM) , which has previously been mapped within growth-related QTL and its polymorphisms have been associated with body weight and skeletal dimensions in chickens. Finally, more accurate heritabilities were estimated for thermogravimetry measurements of bone compositional traits as compared to infrared spectroscopy, with medullary organic and mineral contents being the most heritable (~0.19) and highly correlated with tibia density (0.7). Conclusions This study identified genomic loci associated with variation in bone quality traits, providing candidates for functional validation and for future evaluation of their potential to improve the prediction of bone strength in laying hens.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：骨骼問題（如骨折和骨質不良）對動物福利的負面影響，以及為家禽產業帶來的經濟挑戰，日益受到重視。先前針對白來亨產蛋雞的系譜分析指出，皮質骨與髓質骨組成性狀具有中等的遺傳率（介於 0.18 至 0.41 之間），且與脛骨斷裂強度和密度具有強烈的遺傳相關（0.69 至 0.90）。本研究利用全基因體關聯分析（GWAS）來識別與骨骼強度和組成性狀相關的基因標記，旨在深入了解白來亨產蛋雞骨質遺傳架構。結果：我們在第 20 染色體（11.55–12.29 Mb）上識別出一組彼此具有高度連鎖不平衡（$r^2 > 0.8$）的標記，這些標記與肱骨剛性顯著相關，且與肱骨強度和脛骨皮質厚度重疊。這些標記位於先前已識別出與骨骼生物力學強度和體重相關的第 20 染色體 QTL 內。該區域包含骨形貌發生蛋白 7 基因（*BMP7*），已知其在雞隻的骨骼發生和生長中具有重要作用。在第 1 染色體（173.5–173.6 Mb）上檢測到與脛骨髓質骨中有機物與礦物質含量，以及骨礦物質 MinCO3 1415 中碳酸鹽總量具有最強暗示性關聯的基因標記。此區域包含長非編碼 RNA *LOC107052041*（*LncFAM*），先前已被對應至生長相關的 QTL 內，且其多態性已與雞隻的體重和骨骼尺寸相關聯。最後，與紅外光譜相比，熱重分析測量的骨骼組成性狀估計出了更準確的遺傳率，其中髓質骨的有機物與礦物質含量具有最高的遺傳率（約 0.19），且與脛骨密度高度相關（0.7）。結論：本研究識別出與骨質性狀變異相關的基因體位點，為功能性驗證提供了候選標記，並為未來評估其提升產蛋雞骨骼強度預測潛力奠定基礎。

papers.title: Multi-omics analysis reveals microbial and metabolic signatures associated with neutral detergent fiber digestibility in dairy cattle
papers.abstract: Background The rumen microbiome is central to fiber degradation in dairy cows, yet the precise functional and metabolic networks driving variations in neutral detergent fiber (NDF) digestibility remain poorly understood. Elucidating these microbiome-host interactions is critical for improving forage utilization and advancing sustainable dairy production. Results Employing an integrative metagenomics-metabolomics approach, we characterized the rumen microecology of lactating dairy cows exhibiting high and low NDF digestibility phenotypes ( n = 10/group). Metagenomic profiling revealed a significant enrichment of fibrolytic taxa ( Prevotella sp., Lachnospiraceae bacterium) and carbohydrate-active enzymes in the high-NDF group (HI). In addition, species-level differential abundance testing showed that Methanobrevibacter spp. was more abundant in the low-NDF group (LO) than in the HI group, whereas no archaeal differences were detected at the phylum or genus levels. Functional and metabolomic analyses indicated broader enrichment of amino acid degradation functions and higher concentrations of major volatile fatty acids (VFAs) in HI cows, consistent with stronger overall ruminal fermentation activity. Furthermore, VFAs and microbial composition explained 54.3% and 43.0% of the variation in NDF digestibility, respectively. An exploratory machine learning model based on selected annotated metabolite features showed moderate discriminatory performance, with an out-of-bag accuracy of 77.19%. Conclusions Our findings suggest that coordinated shifts in rumen microbial composition, amino acid metabolism, and VFA production are associated with variation in NDF digestibility in dairy cattle. These results provide a basis for future studies aimed at improving fiber utilization through microbiome-informed nutritional or breeding strategies.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Science and Biotechnology
papers.abstract_zh: 背景 乳牛的瘤胃微生物相是纖維降解的核心，然而驅動中性洗劑纖維（NDF）消化率變異的精確功能與代謝網路仍所知有限。闡明這些微生物相與宿主的交互作用，對於提高粗飼料利用率及推進永續乳產業至關重要。 結果 採用整合性宏基因體學與代謝體學方法，我們對表現出高、低 NDF 消化率表型的泌乳牛之瘤胃微生態進行了特性分析（每組 n = 10）。宏基因體分析顯示，高 NDF 組（HI）中纖維分解分類群（普雷沃氏菌屬 *Prevotella* sp.、毛螺菌科細菌 *Lachnospiraceae* bacterium）與碳水化合物活性酶顯著富集。此外，物種層級的差異豐度檢定顯示，低 NDF 組（LO）的甲烷短桿菌屬 (*Methanobrevibacter* spp.) 豐度高於 HI 組，但在門或屬層級未檢測到古菌的差異。功能與代謝體學分析表明，HI 牛隻具有更廣泛的胺基酸降解功能富集以及更高濃度的主要揮發性脂肪酸（VFA），這與較強的整體瘤胃發酵活性一致。再者，VFA 與微生物組成分別解釋了 NDF 消化率 54.3% 和 43.0% 的變異。基於選定註釋代謝物特徵的探索性機器學習模型顯示出中等的區辨效能，袋外（out-of-bag）準確率為 77.19%。 結論 我們的研究結果表明，瘤胃微生物組成的協調轉變、胺基酸代謝與 VFA 生成，與乳牛 NDF 消化率的變異有關。這些結果為未來旨在透過基於微生物相的營養或育種策略來改善纖維利用的研究提供了基礎。

papers.title: Including ratio traits in multiple trait selection
papers.abstract: Background Animal breeding programs aim to improve productivity while reducing input costs and resource use. As sustainability has become a central concern, feed intake and enteric methane emissions now feature more prominently in breeding objectives, supported by increasing availability of individual-animal measurements for those traits. An important question is how to incorporate these traits most effectively in selection indices that aim at improving both resource efficiency and environmental outcomes. A seemingly appealing strategy is to augment existing selection indices with a ratio trait such as production per unit of feed intake or methane emitted per unit of product, as direct indicators of efficiency. This paper will investigate selection indices that include a ratio trait. Selection index theory was used to compare single trait selection for a ratio trait with selection based on a linear index comprising the component traits, as well as with selection including both the ratio trait and one of its components. Genetic parameters for ratio traits were approximated from those of the component traits. When incorporating a ratio trait into the breeding objective, the economic weights of the component traits were correspondingly adjusted. Results When ratio traits are used as a single trait selection criterion, the response to selection is driven largely by the coefficient of genetic variation of each component trait. However, an index including a ratio trait as well as one of the component traits is equivalent to a linear index with the two component traits. A breeding objective including both a ratio trait and a component trait requires an adjustment of economic values of the component traits. Conclusion Ratio traits such as feed efficiency and methane intensity can be used in selection indices as they give equivalent selection responses as indices that include the component traits (e.g. feed intake and methane production) alongside production traits, provided that at least one of the component traits—either the numerator or denominator—is also included in the index and economic weights are adjusted accordingly.
authors: Julius H. J. van der Werf
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：動物育種計畫旨在提高生產力，同時降低投入成本與資源使用。隨著永續性成為核心關注點，在可取得越來越多個別動物測量值的支持下，採食量與腸道甲烷排放量現在在育種目標中更顯重要。一個重要問題是如何在旨在改善資源效率與環境成果的選拔指數中，最有效地納入這些特徵。一個看似具吸引力的策略是，將比率特徵（例如每單位採食量的產量或每單位產品排放的甲烷量）加入現有的選拔指數中，作為效率的直接指標。本文將探討包含比率特徵的選拔指數。利用選拔指數理論，將針對比率特徵的單一特徵選拔，與基於包含組成特徵的線性指數選拔進行比較，同時也與同時包含比率特徵及其其中一個組成特徵的選拔進行比較。比率特徵的遺傳參數是由組成特徵的遺傳參數近似推導而得。當將比率特徵納入育種目標時，組成特徵的經濟權重也隨之進行相應調整。結果：當比率特徵被用作單一特徵選拔標準時，選拔反應主要由各組成特徵的遺傳變異係數驅動。然而，同時包含比率特徵與其中一個組成特徵的指數，等同於包含兩個組成特徵的線性指數。包含比率特徵與組成特徵的育種目標，需要對組成特徵的經濟價值進行調整。結論：諸如飼料效率與甲烷強度等比率特徵可用於選拔指數中，因為它們能產生與包含組成特徵（例如採食量與甲烷產量）及生產特徵之指數相同的選拔反應，前提是至少有一個組成特徵（分子或分母）也包含在指數中，且經濟權重已相應調整。

papers.title: Quantifying genetic load through joint modelling of inbreeding depression and inbreeding load for litter size in rabbits
papers.abstract: Background Genetic load, defined as the burden of deleterious variants carried by a population, has two components: a realized one that is expressed as reduced fitness, and a hidden one that is masked in heterozygotes. The hidden component, arising from recessive (or partially recessive) deleterious alleles and from overdominant loci, constitutes the inbreeding load (IL), which is unmasked under inbreeding and observed as inbreeding depression. Conventional analyses focus on average inbreeding depression and assume homogeneous effects across ancestors. In contrast, the IL framework allows heterogeneous ancestral contributions to be modelled through Mendelian decomposition. For composite reproductive traits, such as number born alive (NBA) in rabbits, inbreeding may act through distinct biological pathways associated with both the dam and the litter. We developed and validated an integrated model that jointly partitions maternal and litter IL underlying NBA in rabbits. Results Data consisted of 33,521 kindling records from a Pannon White rabbit population and a pedigree of 43,858 individuals. Total inbreeding was decomposed into partial ancestral contributions using a tabular Mendelian decomposition, allowing IL effects to be modelled as additive genetic random effects. Bayesian linear mixed models varying in maternal and litter IL effects, inbreeding depression covariates, and genetic correlations genetic correlations between the additive effect and each of the two IL measures, as well as between the two IL measures, were compared by the Deviance Information Criterion; the model with both IL effects but no genetic correlations fitted best. Average inbreeding depression was consistently negative, with litter inbreeding showing a stronger and more precisely estimated effects on NBA than maternal inbreeding. Both maternal and litter IL variances were substantial, indicating marked heterogeneity among ancestors in their contributions to inbreeding depression. Analysis of genetic trends revealed sustained genetic progress for NBA and litter IL, accompanied by opposite temporal trends for maternal IL. Conclusions Joint modelling of maternal and litter IL provides a deeper and biologically coherent understanding of the genetic architecture of litter size in rabbits. This approach reveals hidden tensions between selection for production and biological fitness, highlighting the need for breeding strategies that balance additive genetic progress with the management of hidden genetic load.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：遺傳負荷（genetic load）被定義為族群所攜帶之有害變異的負擔，包含兩個部分：一是以降低適應度表現出來的已顯現負荷，以及在合子異型合子中被遮蔽的隱藏負荷。隱藏負荷源自隱性（或部分隱性）有害對偶基因以及超顯性基因座，構成了近親交配負荷（inbreeding load, IL），該負荷在近親交配下會被解除遮蔽並表現為近親衰退。傳統分析聚焦於平均近親衰退，並假設各祖先的效應具有同質性。相比之下，IL 框架允許透過孟德爾分解來對異質的祖先貢獻進行建模。對於複合繁殖性狀（例如兔子的總產仔數 [NBA]），近親交配可能會透過與母兔及同胎仔兔皆相關的獨特生物學途徑發揮作用。我們開發並驗證了一個整合模型，能夠聯合分割兔子 NBA 背後的母體與同胎仔數 IL。結果：資料包含來自帕農白兔（Pannon White rabbit）族群的 33,521 筆分娩紀錄以及包含 43,858 個體的血統資料。總近親交配係數透過列表式孟德爾分解法被分解為部分祖先貢獻，使 IL 效應能被建模為加性遺傳隨機效應。本研究透過偏差資訊準則（Deviance Information Criterion）比較了多個貝氏線性混合模型，這些模型在母體與同胎仔數 IL 效應、近親衰退共變量、加性效應與兩種 IL 測量值各自之間以及兩種 IL 測量值之間的遺傳相關性有所不同；同時包含兩種 IL 效應但無遺傳相關性的模型擬合效果最佳。平均近親衰退始終呈現負值，其中同胎仔數近親交配對 NBA 的影響比母體近親交配更強且估計更精確。母體與同胎仔數 IL 的變異數皆相當可觀，顯示祖先對近親衰退的貢獻存在顯著的異質性。遺傳趨勢分析顯示，NBA 與同胎仔數 IL 獲得了持續的遺傳進展，但母體 IL 則伴隨著相反的時間趨勢。結論：聯合建模母體與同胎仔數 IL，能對兔子產仔數的遺傳結構提供更深入且符合生物學邏輯的理解。此方法揭示了生產選育與生物適應度之間的潛在張力，突顯出平衡加性遺傳進展與隱藏遺傳負荷管理之育種策略的必要性。

papers.title: A Comparison of Conventional Lighting Versus Poultry-Specific Lighting During the Day in Combination With or Without a Blue Light “Moonphase” at Night
papers.abstract: Lighting is a key environmental factor influencing the welfare and productivity of laying hens; however, the combined effects of poultry-specific daytime spectra and dim blue “moonlight” during the scotoperiod remain poorly characterized. This study aimed to evaluate the effects of spectral modification of daytime lighting and the use of dim monochromatic blue light at night on stress, fear, leg health, egg production, egg quality, and feeding activity in aged laying hens. One hundred and twenty 70-wk-old laying hens were assigned to one of four lighting treatments, arranged as a 2 × 2 factorial of daytime spectrum × night-time condition, for 28 d following a 14-d acclimation under common lighting: conventional 3000 K white LEDs (CON); poultry-specific lighting (PSL) combining 3000 K white LEDs with 630 nm red light; CON with dim monochromatic blue light at night (CON-moon); and PSL with dim monochromatic blue light at night (PSL-moon). Plasma corticosterone, heterophil-to-lymphocyte (H/L) ratio, composite asymmetry, tonic immobility, inversion response, tibial breaking strength and bone ash, egg production, egg quality, and AI-quantified feeding activity were measured. By the end of the treatment period, hens under PSL had lower corticosterone concentrations, lower H/L ratios, and less physical asymmetry than hens under conventional light, together with taller albumen and higher Haugh unit values, and they spent less time at the feeder without eating less. Moonlight at night produced a further reduction in the stress indicators and, by the final sampling, heavier eggs with stronger shells. Hen-day egg production and tibial breaking strength were unaffected by lighting. These findings indicate that poultry-specific lighting paired with dim blue moonlight is a practical, noninvasive enrichment strategy that can simultaneously improve welfare and egg quality without compromising production.
papers.abstract_zh: 光照是影響產蛋雞福祉與生產效能的關鍵環境因素；然而，家禽專屬的日間光譜與暗期中微弱藍光「月光」的綜合效應，目前仍少有明確的研究。本研究旨在評估日間光譜調整與夜間使用微弱單色藍光對高齡產蛋雞之壓力、恐懼、腳部健康、產蛋率、雞蛋品質及攝食行為的影響。將一百二十隻 70 週齡產蛋雞隨機分配至四種光照處理中，採日間光譜 × 夜間條件之 2 × 2 因子設計，在共同光照下適應 14 天後進行為期 28 天的試驗：傳統 3000 K 白光 LED（CON）；結合 3000 K 白光 LED 與 630 nm 紅光的家禽專屬光照（PSL）；CON 搭配夜間微弱單色藍光（CON-moon）；以及 PSL 搭配夜間微弱單色藍光（PSL-moon）。本研究測定了血漿皮質酮、嗜異性球與淋巴球比值（H/L 比）、綜合不對稱性、強直性靜止、倒立反應、脛骨斷裂強度與骨灰分、產蛋率、雞蛋品質，以及透過人工智慧（AI）量化的攝食活動。試驗期結束時，與傳統光照相比，處於 PSL 下的產蛋雞具有較低的皮質酮濃度、較低的 H/L 比及較少的身體不對稱性，同時伴隨較高的蛋白高度與豪氏單位數，且牠們在飼槽停留的時間較短但攝食量並未減少。夜間的月光使壓力指標進一步降低，且在最後一次採樣時，產出了較重且蛋殼較強韌的雞蛋。產蛋率與脛骨斷裂強度則不受光照影響。這些研究結果顯示，家禽專屬光照搭配微弱藍光月光是一種實用且無創的環境豐富化策略，能在不影響生產效能的情況下，同時改善福祉與雞蛋品質。

papers.title: Genetic Correlations Between Fleece Shedding and Production Traits Indicate Minimal Trade‐Offs When Breeding for Maternal Shedding Sheep
papers.abstract: Fleece shedding is becoming an increasingly important trait in sheep production systems focused on meat and dairy, where wool has limited economic value and reducing shearing costs is desirable. For inclusion in breeding programmes, a trait must exhibit genetic variation, sufficient heritability, and have well‐defined relationships with other economically important traits, as well as economic or desired value. The aim of this study was to estimate the genetic and phenotypic correlations between fleece shedding, recorded in both lambs and adult ewes, and key production traits currently included in the Australian national genetic evaluation for maternal sheep. Using these relationships, the implications of incorporating fleece shedding into a within‐flock maternal sheep breeding objective were also examined through desired gains indexes. Genetic correlations between shedding and body weight, carcase, and most visual traits were generally low, indicating limited biological constraints to simultaneous improvement. In contrast, favourable genetic relationships were observed between shedding and parasite resistance, fleece traits such as greasy fleece weight, fibre diameter, and staple strength. Reproductive traits were associated with weak but significant antagonistic genetic correlations with shedding, with phenotypic correlations also indicating that highly productive ewes tended to shed less. Under the base index (regular index with no emphasis on shedding), genetic progress in shedding was minimal, indicating that explicit inclusion of direct emphasis on shedding is required to achieve meaningful improvement. Within‐flock selection index simulations demonstrated that low to moderate (desired improvement of 0.33 to 0.66 of a shedding score in 10 years) inclusion of shedding could be achieved with minimal impact on gains in production traits over a 10‐year horizon. However, higher levels of emphasis (> 1 shedding score improvement) on shedding resulted in reduced responses in reproductive traits and increased mature weight, alongside diminishing economic returns. These results demonstrate that fleece shedding can be incorporated into multi‐trait breeding programmes with limited trade‐offs at moderate levels of selection pressure. However, higher levels of emphasis introduced important biological and economic trade‐offs. The findings highlight the importance of balanced breeding objectives to ensure that improvements in fleece shedding do not compromise overall productivity.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Breeding and Genetics
papers.abstract_zh:
在專注於肉品與乳品生產的綿羊飼養系統中，羊毛的經濟價值有限且降低剪毛成本的需求日益迫切，因此羊毛脫落（fleece shedding）正成為一項日益重要的性狀。一項性狀若要納入育種計畫中，必須展現出遺傳變異、足夠的遺傳力，並與其他具經濟重要性的性狀具有明確定義的相關性，同時需具備經濟價值或期望價值。本研究旨在估算在羔羊及成年母羊身上記錄的羊毛脫落性狀，與目前納入澳洲母羊全國遺傳評估中的關鍵生產性狀之間的遺傳相關與表型相關。利用這些相關性，本研究亦透過期望遺傳改進指數（desired gains indexes），檢視將羊毛脫落納入場內母羊育種目標中的意涵。

羊毛脫落與體重、胴體及多數外觀性狀之間的遺傳相關性通常較低，顯示同時改良這些性狀的生物學限制有限。相對地，羊毛脫落與寄生蟲抵抗力、油毛重、纖維直徑和毛束強度等羊毛性狀之間，則觀察到有利的遺傳相關。繁殖性狀與羊毛脫落呈現微弱但顯著的拮抗遺傳相關，表型相關也顯示高生產力的母羊傾向於較少脫落。在基礎指數（未特別強調羊毛脫落的常規指數）下，羊毛脫落的遺傳進展微乎其微，這表明必須明確納入對羊毛脫落的直接強調，才能取得顯著的改良。

場內選擇指數模擬顯示，在10年的時間跨度內，低度至中度（期望在10年內脫落評分改善0.33至0.66分）將羊毛脫落納入育種目標，可以在對生產性狀進展影響極小的情況下達成。然而，對羊毛脫落給予較高的強調程度（脫落評分改善 > 1分）會導致繁殖性狀的反應降低、成年體重增加，同時經濟效益遞減。這些結果表明，在適度的選擇壓力下，羊毛脫落可以納入多性狀育種計畫中，且僅需付出有限的取捨代價。然而，較高的強調程度會引入重要的生物學和經濟學取捨。這些發現凸顯了平衡育種目標的重要性，以確保羊毛脫落的改良不會損及整體生產力。

papers.title: Ovulation Timing After Recombinant Human Chorionic Gonadotropin, Gonadorelin, or Buserelin Under Estrus-Triggered and Fixed-Time Treatment Protocols for Artificial Insemination in Sows
papers.abstract: Precise coordination between ovulation and insemination is essential for optimizing fixed-time artificial insemination (FTAI) in sows. This study compared ovulation timing and reproductive outcomes after treatment with recombinant human chorionic gonadotropin (rhCG), gonadorelin, or buserelin under estrus-triggered and fixed-time treatment protocols. A total of 285 sows received equine chorionic gonadotropin 24 h after weaning. In Trial 1, the ovulation-inducing treatments were administered at estrus onset, whereas in Trial 2 they were administered 72 h after equine chorionic gonadotropin. Ovulation was monitored by transabdominal ultrasonography. In Trial 1, no significant differences in ovulation timing or reproductive performance were detected among treatments.
