In Trial 2, no significant differences were detected among treatments in the proportion of sows with ovulation detected within 72 h (p = 0.847), the overall time-to-event distributions (log-rank p = 0.790), or the variability in detected ovulation timing (Brown–Forsythe p = 0.884). Among rhCG-treated sows in which ovulation was detected, all observed ovulations occurred between 37 and 54 h after treatment. No statistically significant differences in reproductive outcomes were detected among treatments. These findings provide new information on the temporal ovulatory response to rhCG under fixed-time treatment and may inform further refinement of insemination timing in sow FTAI protocols.
papers.abstract_zh: 排卵與人工授精時間的精確協調，對於優化母豬定時人工授精（FTAI）至關重要。本研究比較了在發情觸發與定時處理方案下，使用重組人絨毛膜促性腺激素（rhCG）、促性腺激素釋放激素（gonadorelin）或布舍瑞林（buserelin）治療後的排卵時間與繁殖表現。總計 285 頭母豬於斷乳後 24 小時注射馬絨毛膜促性腺激素。試驗一中，於發情開始時投予誘導排卵處理；試驗二中，則於注射馬絨毛膜促性腺激素後 72 小時投予處理。利用經腹部超音波掃描監測排卵。試驗一中，各處理間的排卵時間或繁殖性能均未檢測到顯著差異。試驗二中，在 72 小時內檢測到排卵的母豬比例（$p = 0.847$）、整體事件發生時間分佈（log-rank $p = 0.790$）或檢測到排卵時間的變異性（Brown–Forsythe $p = 0.884$），各處理間均無顯著差異。在接受 rhCG 治療且檢測到排卵的母豬中，所有觀察到的排卵均發生在處理後 37 至 54 小時之間。各處理間的繁殖表現亦未檢測到具統計學顯著性的差異。這些發現為定時處理下母豬對 rhCG 的時間性排卵反應提供了新資訊，並有助於進一步完善母豬定時人工授精方案中的授精時間。

papers.title: Targeted Lipidomics Insights into Lipid Discrepancies in Chicken Embryonic Brains Under Hypoxia Based on UHPLC-QTRAP-MS
papers.abstract: Domestic chicken is an ideal model to study the relationship between lipid metabolism and environmental stress. However, the lipid composition of chicken embryonic brain under hypoxic conditions has not been systematically elucidated. We employed targeted lipidomics to comprehensively describe the alterations in the brain lipid profiles of embryonic day 18 TBCs and DLCs under hypoxia (13% O2, HTBC18, and HDLC18) and normoxia (21% O2, NTBC18, and NDLC18). Totally 1288 lipid species from 18 lipid classes were identified and screened for 47 (three up-regulated and 44 down-regulated) and 55 (10 up-regulated and 45 down-regulated) SDLs in HTBC18 compared to NTBC18 and HDLC18 compared to NDLC18, respectively. The five SDLs were shared between HTBC18 vs. NTBC18 and HDLC18 vs. NDLC18, including PI (16:0_20:3), PE (18:1_20:4), PC (20:0_22:5), PS (16:1_18:0) and PS (16:0_20:3), which were identified as candidate hypoxia-responsive lipids. Furthermore, the analysis of SDLs’ metabolic pathways revealed that glycerophospholipid metabolism was the most crucial. The present results provide insights into the dynamic composition of lipid in chicken embryo brains under hypoxic conditions.
papers.abstract_zh: 家雞是研究脂質代謝與環境壓力之間關係的理想模型。然而，缺氧條件下雞胚胎大腦的脂質組成尚未獲得系統性的闡明。我們採用標靶脂質體學，全面描述了孵化第 18 天的臺灣土雞（TBC）和大圍山微型雞（DLC）胚胎大腦在缺氧（13% O2，分別記為 HTBC18 和 HDLC18）與常氧（21% O2，分別記為 NTBC18 和 NDLC18）條件下的脂質圖譜變化。本研究總共鑑定出 18 個脂質類別中的 1288 種脂質分子，並分別篩選出在 HTBC18 相對於 NTBC18、以及 HDLC18 相對於 NDLC18 中具有顯著差異的脂質（SDL）47 種（3 種上調、44 種下調）與 55 種（10 種上調、45 種下調）。有 5 種顯著差異脂質同時存在於 HTBC18 對 NTBC18 及 HDLC18 對 NDLC18 的比較中，包含 PI (16:0_20:3)、PE (18:1_20:4)、PC (20:0_22:5)、PS (16:1_18:0) 和 PS (16:0_20:3)，這些脂質被認定為潛在的缺氧反應脂質。此外，顯著差異脂質的代謝途徑分析顯示，甘油磷脂代謝是最關鍵的途徑。本研究結果為缺氧條件下雞胚胎大腦脂質的動態組成提供了深入的見解。

papers.title: Genomic characterisation and lytic potential of phage SF01 against multidrug-resistant Salmonella enterica subsp. enterica , a key agent of infection in poultry
papers.abstract: 1. Salmonella enterica remains the key cause of salmonellosis in poultry, causing high morbidity and mortality. Due to the unprecedented resistance of S. enterica to antibiotics, bacteriophages have emerged as a powerful alternative to conventional antibiotics treatment for salmonellosis.2. In this study, a strain was isolated from infected broiler chickens and whole-genome sequencing (WGS) identified the strain SFD-01 as S. enterica subsp. enterica. Bioinformatics analyses revealed that the genome was 4.6 Mb in size with 4559 coding sequences (CDS), 77 tRNAs and 4 rRNAs. Additionally, 119 virulence genes, 125 antimicrobial resistance genes, 5 mobile genetic elements, 2 prophages and multiple copies of pathogenicity islands (SPI) were identified in the genome.3. To address this, bacteriophage SF01 was isolated from wastewater near a chicken slaughterhouse against host strain SFD-01. Transmission electron microscopy revealed that the phage had an 85-nm icosahedral head and a 130-nm long contractile tail. The Felixounavirus SF01 exhibited high stability across pH 3–9. Phage lytic activity at a multiplicity of infection of 0.01 restricted the bacterial growth.4. Whole genome analysis (WGS) identified phage SF01 as a Felixounavirus with 88-kb genome composed of 174 CDS, 20 tRNA genes and with no lysogenic markers, resistance genes or virulence factors. The strict lytic potential of phage SF01 makes it a highly viable option for use in the potential biocontrol of the novel strain S. enterica subsp. enterica serotype 42:z4,z23.
papers.abstract_zh:
1. 腸道沙門氏菌（Salmonella enterica）仍然之家禽沙門氏菌症的主要病因，會造成高罹病率與高死亡率。由於腸道沙門氏菌對抗生素產生前所未有的抗藥性，噬菌體已成為替代傳統抗生素治療沙門氏菌症的有力選擇。

2. 在本研究中，從受感染的肉雞中分離出一株菌株，經全基因串接定序（WGS）鑑定該SFD-01菌株為腸道沙門氏菌腸道亞種（S. enterica subsp. enterica）。生物資訊學分析顯示，其基因體大小為 4.6 Mb，具有 4559 個編碼序列（CDS）、77 個 tRNA 及 4 個 rRNA。此外，在該基因體中鑑定出 119 個毒力基因、125 個抗生素抗藥性基因、5 個移動性遺傳元件、2 個前噬菌體以及多個致病島（SPI）複本。

3. 為了解決此問題，從雞隻屠宰場附近的廢水中分離出針對宿主菌株 SFD-01 的噬菌體 SF01。穿透式電子顯微鏡顯示，該噬菌體具有一個 85 奈米的二十面體頭部以及一個 130 奈米長的收縮性尾部。菲利克斯奧微病毒屬（Felixounavirus）的 SF01 在 pH 3–9 之間展現出高度穩定性。在感染多重性（MOI）為 0.01 時，噬菌體的裂解活性可抑制細菌生長。

4. 全基因體分析（WGS）鑑定噬菌體 SF01 為菲利克斯奧微病毒屬（Felixounavirus），其 88-kb 的基因體由 174 個 CDS、20 個 tRNA 基因所組成，且不具溶原性標記、抗藥性基因或毒力因子。噬菌體 SF01 嚴格的裂解潛力，使其成為具備潛力應用於生物防治新型腸道沙門氏菌腸道亞種血清型 42:z4,z23 的高度可行選項。

papers.title: Genetic Diversity and Selection Signatures of Three Indonesian Indigenous Pig Populations From Eastern Indonesia Using Whole Genome Sequencing Data
papers.abstract: Indonesia is widely recognized as a megadiversity country, harboring a rich diversity of indigenous pig species that play significant roles in the cultural and religious practices of local communities. However, the limited availability of genomic and demographic data of these indigenous pigs has greatly impeded our understanding of their evolutionary history and population structure. To date, the genetic characteristics of indigenous pigs from Maluku, Southeast Sulawesi (Sultra), and East Nusa Tenggara (NTT) remain unknown. Here, we aimed to investigate the genetic diversity, population structure, and signatures of positive selection in indigenous pig populations from Maluku, Sultra, and NTT regions using whole‐genome sequencing. This study performed whole‐genome sequencing on 42 Indonesian indigenous pigs via Illumina HiSeq 4000, integrating datasets of Chinese domestic pigs, European domestic pigs, and wild boars for comparative genomic analysis. The results indicate that these pigs cluster phylogenetically with Southern Chinese breeds but are distinct from Northern Chinese and European pigs. Maluku pigs display genetic homogeneity, which indicates their purebred status. In contrast, Sultra and NTT pigs carry European alleles, suggesting historical introgression. The genetic diversity is higher in Sultra and NTT pigs than in Maluku pigs. Selective sweep analysis revealed predominantly population‐specific selection signals, highlighting the divergent evolution shaped by geographic isolation. Novel candidate genes for economic traits were identified, including FBXO36 in Maluku pigs, DIAPH3 in NTT pigs, and GTPBP4 in Sultra pigs. This study provides crucial insights for conservation strategies and breeding programs, emphasizing the need to preserve these unique genetic resources.
papers.abstract_zh: 印尼被廣泛認為是一個超級生物多樣性國家，擁有豐富多樣的本土豬種，這些豬種在當地社群的文化和宗教實踐中扮演著重要角色。然而，這些本土豬的基因體與人口統計學數據極度匱乏，極大地阻礙了我們對其演化歷史和族群結構的理解。迄今為止，來自馬露古（Maluku）、東南蘇拉威西（Sultra）和東努沙登加拉（NTT）等地區的本土豬之遺傳特徵仍然未知。在本研究中，我們旨在利用全基因體定序技術，探討馬露古、東南蘇拉威西和東努沙登加拉地區本土豬族群的遺傳多樣性、族群結構以及正向選擇訊號。本研究透過 Illumina HiSeq 4000 對 42 頭印尼本土豬進行了全基因體定序，並整合了中國家豬、歐洲家豬及野豬的資料集進行比較基因體學分析。結果表明，這些豬在系統發生學上與華南品種聚類在一起，但與華北及歐洲豬種明顯不同。馬露古豬展現出遺傳同質性，顯示其具有純種地位。相比之下，東南蘇拉威西和東努沙登加拉的豬隻帶有歐洲等位基因，暗示了歷史上的基因滲入。東南蘇拉威西和東努沙登加拉豬的遺傳多樣性高於馬露古豬。選擇清除分析揭示了主要為族群特異性的選擇訊號，突顯了地理隔離所塑造的分歧演化。本研究識別出與經濟性狀相關的新穎候選基因，包括馬露古豬中的 FBXO36、東努沙登加拉豬中的 DIAPH3，以及東南蘇拉威西豬中的 GTPBP4。本研究為保育策略和育種計畫提供了關鍵見解，強調了保護這些獨特遺傳資源的必要性。

papers.title: Rethinking poultry production: innovations, challenges, and pathways to a sustainable future
papers.abstract: SUMMARYAs global demand for poultry continues to rise, sustainable practices in poultry production have become an urgent priority to reduce the sector’s environmental footprint. While poultry is among the most efficient animal protein sources, significant environmental challenges remain, particularly regarding resource efficiency, energy use, waste management, and emissions. This review provides an integrated analysis of sustainable poultry production by combining environmental, technological, and regional perspectives. Feed production contributes approximately 60 to 70% of the environmental footprint of poultry systems, while improvements in feed conversion ratio (FCR) and precision nutrition offer substantial opportunities for resource optimisation. The review evaluates key innovations, including alternative protein sources, energy-efficient systems, carbon reduction strategies, and improved waste management practices. It also examines global and regional sustainability challenges, particularly climate change impacts and adaptive strategies across diverse production systems. While emerging solutions such as renewable energy integration, precision farming, and genetic advancements show strong potential, their large-scale implementation remains constrained by economic and regulatory factors. This review identifies priority pathways, including feed system transformation, circular resource management, and climate-resilient production strategies, as essential for achieving sustainable and resilient poultry production systems.
papers.abstract_zh:
摘要

隨著全球對家禽的需求持續上升，家禽生產的可持續實踐已成為減少該產業環境足跡的當務之急。儘管家禽是最具效率的動物蛋白質來源之一，但仍面臨顯著的環境挑戰，特別是在資源效率、能源使用、廢棄物管理和排放方面。本綜述結合環境、技術與區域觀點，對可持續家禽生產進行了綜合分析。飼料生產約佔家禽系統環境足跡的 60% 至 70%，而飼料轉換率（FCR）的改善與精準營養則為資源最佳化提供了巨大的機會。本綜述評估了關鍵創新，包括替代蛋白質來源、節能系統、減碳策略以及改進的廢棄物管理實踐。同時，亦探討了全球與區域性的可持續性挑戰，特別是氣候變遷的影響以及不同生產系統中的調適策略。儘管諸如再生能源整合、精準農業和基因改良等新興解決方案展現出強大的潛力，但其大規模實施仍受限於經濟與法規因素。本綜述指出了優先發展的路徑，包括飼料系統轉型、循環資源管理以及具氣候韌性的生產策略，這些皆為實現可持續且具韌性的家禽生產系統不可或缺的要素。

papers.title: Cryopreservation of Ram Semen: A Review on the Roles of Emerging Synthetic and Natural Additives
papers.abstract: Cryopreservation techniques and protocols for ram semen, particularly those with a focus on semen extender additives, have gained popularity recently, as many scientists are looking for ways to mitigate cryodamage and improve post-thaw sperm quality. The purpose of this structured narrative review was to examine studies published in 2019–2024 on both synthetic and natural additives, to separate evidence obtained in rams from comparative evidence in other species, and to analyze current trends and potential gaps for future research. Cryopreservation is an indispensable aspect in livestock production and conservation of genes using artificial insemination. Nevertheless, the freezing and thawing processes result in DNA fragmentation, oxidative stress and low sperm motility, which are detrimental to reproductive success. Conventional extenders that contain glycerol or egg yolk have been used extensively to support cell membranes and prevent the formation of ice crystals. Nevertheless, the fertility rates obtained from frozen–thawed ram semen have been poor, which has led to the investigation of other substances. Natural additives like plant polyphenols, vitamins, fatty acids and sugars have shown great potential to decrease free radicals and enhance sperm integrity. Synthetic additives, including Trolox, MitoQ, and Mito-TEMPO, were also found to enhance the antioxidant capacity. Over the past few years, some trends have emerged, including an increased interest in plant-based antioxidants and nanoparticle-based additives. Nevertheless, several research gaps were observed, including the need for further optimization of the additive dose ratios, availability of studies on the stability of these additives when used long-term, and the compatibility of extender formulations across breeds and species. This review synthesizes recent developments in ram semen cryopreservation additives; for most additives, the evidence is presented in a single study with sperm-quality endpoints. Few studies measured in vivo fertility. It emphasizes the necessity of shifting from descriptive additive studies to mechanism-focused protocols validated across breeds to enhance the scalability and reliability of reproductive biotechnologies.
papers.abstract_zh: 公羊精液的冷凍保存技術與方案，特別是聚焦於精液稀釋液添加物的研究，近年來受到的關注日益增加，因為許多科學家正尋求減輕冷凍損傷並改善解凍後精子品質的方法。本篇結構化敘述性文獻回顧的目的，旨在檢視 2019 至 2024 年間發表關於人工合成與天然添加物的研究，區分公羊所得之實驗證據與其他物種的比較證據，並分析當前趨勢及未來研究的潛在缺口。冷凍保存是畜牧生產及利用人工授精進行基因保育不可或缺的一環。然而，冷凍與解凍過程會導致 DNA 片段化、氧化壓力以及精子活力低下，這些對繁殖成功率皆有害。含有甘油或蛋黃的傳統稀釋液已被廣泛使用，以保護細胞膜並防止冰晶形成。儘管如此，冷凍解凍後的公羊精液所獲得的受孕率仍然偏低，這促使人們對其他物質進行探討。諸如植物多酚、維生素、脂肪酸和醣類等天然添加物，在減少自由基和增強精子完整性方面展現出巨大潛力。人工合成添加物，包括 Trolox、MitoQ 及 Mito-TEMPO，也被發現能增強抗氧化能力。在過去幾年中，出現了一些趨勢，包括對植物性抗氧化劑和奈米粒子基添加物的興趣增加。然而，也觀察到幾個研究缺口，包括需要進一步最佳化添加物劑量比例、缺乏這些添加物在長期使用時穩定性的研究，以及稀釋液配方在不同品種和物種間的相容性。本篇回顧綜合了公羊精液冷凍保存添加物的最新進展；對於多數添加物而言，相關證據僅呈現於單一研究中，且多以精子品質為評估指標。僅有極少數研究測量了活體（in vivo）受孕率。本文強調有必要從描述性的添加物研究轉向以機制為核心、並經不同品種驗證的方案，以提升生殖生物技術的可擴展性與可靠性。

papers.title: Standardized Ileal Amino Acid Digestibilities in Different Corn Sources for Medium-Growing Yellow-Feathered Broilers and Their Prediction Models
papers.abstract: The present study first aimed to analyze the chemical compositions and amino acid (AA) profiles in 10 different sources of corn samples, then determine the SIAADs of these corn samples in medium-growing yellow-feathered broilers and establish rapid prediction equations for SIAADs based on their chemical compositions and AA profiles, and finally preliminarily assess their predictive performance. Broilers (n = 276; medium-growing yellow-feathered broilers; 63 days of age) were randomly allocated to 11 dietary treatments based on initial body weight. The experimental groups consisted of one nitrogen-free diet (NFD) control and 10 corn diet groups, and each experimental group consisted of 6 replicates, with 6 chickens per replicate in the control group and 4 chickens per replicate in each corn diet group. The experimental period was 5 days. At 67 days of age, ileal digesta samples were collected. Both apparent ileal amino acid digestibilities (AIAADs) and SIAADs in corn were evaluated. Predictive equations for corn SIAAD values were constructed via stepwise regression based on 9 corn samples. One independent corn sample was randomly selected to provide a preliminary assessment of predictive performance of the SIAAD models. The results showed that corn sources affected (p < 0.05) the AIAADs and SIAADs in yellow-feathered broilers. Among all assayed AAs, leucine (Leu) showed the highest apparent ileal digestibility (AID) (84.9%) and tryptophan (Trp) the lowest (52.8%), whereas glutamic acid (Glu) demonstrated the highest standardized ileal digestibility (SID) (94.6%) and Trp the lowest (64.5%). Equations predicting SID values for 6 AAs, including methionine (Met), phenylalanine (Phe), histidine (His), Trp, Glu, and proline (Pro), in corn samples for yellow-feathered broilers were constructed (R2 = 0.559 to 0.883, p ≤ 0.021). Among the established prediction models, the model for the SID of Trp showed the best fit (R2 = 0.883, p < 0.002), whereas the model for His SID showed the weakest goodness of fit (R2 = 0.559, p = 0.021). Except for the SID prediction model for Trp, which showed poor predictive accuracy, the other 5 SIAAD prediction models provided preliminary evidence supporting the potential applicability of these models. Therefore, these established prediction equations can provide an important reference for the rapid prediction of the SIDs of these AAs in corn samples for medium-growing yellow-feathered broilers in the future. Owing to the small sample size in this study, further independent external validation is necessary to verify the accuracy of the derived SIAAD prediction equations.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在首先分析10種不同來源玉米樣品的化學成分與胺基酸（AA）組成，接著測定這些玉米樣品在中期生長黃羽肉雞中的標準化迴腸胺基酸消化率（SIAADs），並根據其化學成分與胺基酸組成建立SIAADs的快速預測方程式，最後初步評估其預測性能。試驗選用肉雞（n = 276；中生長黃羽肉雞；63日齡），依初始體重隨機分配至11個日糧處理組。試驗組包含一個無氮日糧（NFD）對照組及10個玉米日糧組，每組設6個重複，對照組每重複6隻雞，各玉米日糧組每重複4隻雞。試驗期為5天。於67日齡時收集迴腸食糜樣品。評估玉米中的表觀迴腸胺基酸消化率（AIAADs）與SIAADs。基於9個玉米樣品，透過逐步迴歸構建玉米SIAAD值的預測方程式。隨機選取一個獨立的玉米樣品，對SIAAD模型的預測性能進行初步評估。結果顯示，玉米來源會影響（p < 0.05）黃羽肉雞的AIAADs與SIAADs。在所有檢測的胺基酸中，白胺酸（Leu）表現出最高的表觀迴腸消化率（AID）（84.9%），色胺酸（Trp）最低（52.8%）；而麩胺酸（Glu）表現出最高的標準化迴腸消化率（SID）（94.6%），色胺酸最低（64.5%）。本研究建構了黃羽肉雞玉米樣品中6種胺基酸（包含甲硫胺酸〔Met〕、苯丙胺酸〔Phe〕、組織胺酸〔His〕、色胺酸〔Trp〕、麩胺酸〔Glu〕及脯胺酸〔Pro〕）SID值的預測方程式（R2 = 0.559至0.883，p ≤ 0.021）。在已建立的預測模型中，色胺酸SID的模型擬合度最好（R2 = 0.883，p < 0.002），而組織胺酸SID的模型擬合度最弱（R2 = 0.559，p = 0.021）。除了色胺酸的SID預測模型表現出較差的預測準確度外，其餘5個SIAAD預測模型提供了初步證據，支持這些模型的潛在適用性。因此，這些建立的預測方程式可為未來快速預測中生長黃羽肉雞玉米樣品中這些胺基酸的SID提供重要參考。由於本研究樣本數較小，未來仍需進一步的獨立外部驗證，以確認所推導SIAAD預測方程式的準確性。

papers.title: Insight into the Meat Quality Characteristics of Tibetan Sheep at Different Age Groups Using Metabolomics
papers.abstract: Age-associated variation in Tibetan sheep meat quality and muscle metabolism remains incompletely understood. Eighteen clinically healthy intact male Tibetan sheep were divided into group by age: 6 (M6), 18 (M18) and 42 (M42) months, and their Longissimus dorsi muscles were evaluated for pH, colour, Warner–Bratzler shear force, cooking loss, proximate composition, amino acids, and fatty acids. Volatile compounds were profiled using headspace solid-phase microextraction coupled with gas chromatography–mass spectrometry, while muscle metabolites were assessed by untargeted liquid chromatography–mass spectrometry. The results showed that M42 sheep had the highest protein and fat content, as well as the greatest shear force. Notably, levels of monounsaturated and polyunsaturated fatty acids were the highest at M18, yielding distinct flavour profiles and indicating age-associated differences in fatty-acid composition rather than a defined metabolic transition point. Metabolomic analysis identified differential metabolites, primarily enriched in amino acid and lipid metabolism pathways. Correlation analysis revealed that key metabolites, including fumaric acid and linoleic acid, were significantly associated with meat quality parameters. This study elucidates the meat quality characteristics and metabolic basis of Tibetan sheep at different age groups, providing a theoretical foundation for improving meat quality.
papers.abstract_zh: 年齡相關的藏羊肉品品質與肌肉代謝變異仍未被完全理解。本研究將十八隻臨床健康的公藏羊依年齡分為三組：6個月（M6）、18個月（M18）及42個月（M42），並評估其背最長肌的pH值、色澤、華納－布拉茨勒剪切力（Warner–Bratzler shear force）、蒸煮損失、一般成分、胺基酸及脂肪酸。利用頂空固相微萃取結合氣相層析－質譜儀分析揮發性化合物，並透過非標靶液相層析－質譜儀評估肌肉代謝物。結果顯示，M42組藏羊的蛋白質與脂肪含量最高，剪切力也最大。值得注意的是，單元不飽和脂肪酸與多元不飽和脂肪酸含量在M18時最高，呈現出獨特的風味特徵，並指出脂肪酸組成隨年齡而異，而非存在明確的代謝轉變點。代謝體學分析識別出差異代謝物，主要富集於胺基酸和脂質代謝途徑中。相關性分析顯示，包含延胡索酸和亞麻油酸在內的關鍵代謝物與肉品品質參數顯著相關。本研究闡明了不同年齡組藏羊的肉品品質特徵與代謝基礎，為改善肉品品質提供了理論基礎。

papers.title: Generative Adversarial Networks for Omics Data: An Overview and Future Directions for Livestock Applications
papers.abstract: Generative adversarial networks (GANs) are artificial intelligence models designed to generate novel data that is indistinguishable from real data. Originally developed to generate images to complement existing datasets and create more diverse samples, GAN‐based data can enhance downstream analysis for machine learning and deep learning applications. GAN‐based approaches are also versatile and suitable for augmenting omics data, improving downstream analyses such as genotype prediction, biomarker detection, and protein de novo design. In addition, GANs can preserve and reconstruct genomic regions under selective pressure, increase sample sizes from underrepresented groups, and mitigate class imbalance effects in genomic analyses, transcriptomics, and single‐cell omics. Recent work also demonstrates that GAN‐generated data can support privacy‐preserving data sharing and the design of novel biological sequences and proteins. This literature review presents the foundational concepts of GANs, explores diverse applications across omics fields, and highlights novel opportunities for applying GAN approaches in livestock genomics.
papers.abstract_zh: 生成對抗網路（GANs）是一種人工智慧模型，旨在生成與真實資料無法區分的全新資料。最初開發 GAN 是為了生成影像以互補現有資料集並建立更多樣化的樣本，基於 GAN 的資料可以增強機器學習與深度學習應用的下游分析。基於 GAN 的方法亦具有高度通用性，適合用於擴增體學資料，進而改善下游分析，例如基因型預測、生物標記偵測以及蛋白質從頭設計（de novo design）。此外，GAN 還能保留並重建承受選擇壓力的基因體區域、增加代表性不足群體的樣本數，並減輕基因體學、轉錄體學與單細胞體學中類別不平衡的影響。近期研究也表明，GAN 生成的資料可以支援保護隱私的資料分享，以及新穎生物序列和蛋白質的設計。本篇文獻綜述介紹了 GAN 的基礎概念，探討其在各個體學領域的多樣化應用，並突顯將 GAN 方法應用於家畜基因體學的新穎契機。

papers.title: Whole-Genome Resequencing Reveals Genetic Diversity and Selection Signatures in Honghe Cattle
papers.abstract: Honghe cattle were formally recognized as the eighth indigenous cattle breed in Yunnan Province, a region in southwestern China characterized by complex geography and variable climates that have shaped distinctive local cattle germplasm. In this study, we generated whole-genome resequencing data from 62 Honghe cattle and compared them with additional reference samples from other breeds. The results revealed that Honghe cattle are predominantly of indicine origin (54.7% East Asian indicine, 26.5% South Asian indicine and 18.8% taurine), with relatively high genetic diversity. Runs of homozygosity analysis revealed low inbreeding (FROH = 0.032) and identified 52 ROH islands, the strongest of which (chr7) harbored a protein homeostasis gene cluster (HSPA9, SIL1, DNAJC18). For selection signatures, we applied multiple methods, including composite likelihood ratio test (CLR), integrated haplotype score (iHS), fixation index (FST) and cross-population extended haplotype homozygosity (XP-EHH) to identify selective sweeps in the Honghe cattle genome. We detected several candidate genes associated with important traits, such as HMGA2 (body size) and MCM6 (milk production). Functional enrichment analyses revealed pathways related to immune response, protein absorption, energy metabolism, and lipid metabolism. In addition, Y-chromosomal haplotype analysis revealed that Honghe cattle predominantly belong to the Y3 lineage (Y1 4.5%, Y2 9.1%, Y3 86.4%). These findings inform strategies for improving production efficiency and guiding breeding programs in Honghe cattle.
papers.abstract_zh: 紅河牛正式獲認定為雲南省的第八個地方牛品種。該地區位於中國西南部，具有複雜的地理環境與多變的氣候，塑造了獨特的地方牛種質資源。在本研究中，我們對62頭紅河牛進行了全基因組重測序，並將其與來自其他品種的額外參考樣本進行比較。結果顯示紅河牛主要源自瘤牛血統（54.7%東亞瘤牛、26.5%南亞瘤牛及18.8%歐洲牛），並具有相對較高的遺傳多樣性。純合片段（Runs of homozygosity, ROH）分析顯示其近交程度低（$F_{ROH} = 0.032$），並鑑定出52個ROH島，其中信號最強的區域（第7號染色體）包含一個蛋白質恆定基因簇（$HSPA9$、$SIL1$、$DNAJC18$）。在選擇訊號方面，我們應用了多種方法，包含複合似然比檢定（CLR）、整合單倍型分數（iHS）、固定指數（$F_{ST}$）以及跨群體擴展單倍型純合性（XP-EHH），以鑑定紅河牛基因組中的選擇性清剿（selective sweeps）區域。我們檢測到數個與重要性狀相關的候選基因，例如 $HMGA2$（體型）與 $MCM6$（產奶量）。功能富集分析顯示，相關途徑與免疫反應、蛋白質吸收、能量代謝及脂質代謝有關。此外，Y染色體單倍型分析顯示紅河牛主要屬於Y3譜系（Y1佔4.5%、Y2佔9.1%、Y3佔86.4%）。這些發現為提升紅河牛的生產效率及指導育種計畫提供了重要參考依據。

papers.title: Implementation of Metafounders in the Genomic Prediction for the Polled Trait in Brahman Cattle Using a Multi‐Breed Population
papers.abstract: The absence of horns (polled trait) in cattle is associated with better animal welfare by reducing the need for dehorning. In Brahman cattle, population size and the scarcity of phenotypic records challenge the accuracy of genomic predictions for this trait. This study aimed to evaluate the genetic architecture of this trait in Brahman cattle using single‐breed and multi‐breed genomic prediction models, including metafounders, and to assess the influence of phenotypic classifications on heritability, prediction accuracy, bias, and dispersion. Phenotypic and genotypic data from 14 333 Nelore and Brahman animals were analyzed using threshold and linear models implemented in the BLUPF90+ software suite. Single‐breed models ( n = 12) were considered phenotypes (polled, scab, scur, horned), while multi‐breed models ( n = 10) incorporated metafounders and breed effects. Variance components were estimated via threshold models with Gibbs sampling, and predictive ability was assessed using the LR method with datasets. Single‐breed models showed heritability estimates ( h 2 ) ranging from 0.56 to 0.72, but with predictive ability reflecting the Brahman population size. Multi‐breed models improved predictive performance. Results were obtained with Model 20, which included alternative phenotypes, metafounders, and breed effects, yielding accuracy (0.79), reduced bias (0.36), and dispersion close to 1. These findings demonstrate that the polled trait in Brahman cattle exhibits additive genetic variability amenable to selection. The use of multi‐breed analyses and metafounders enhances predictive accuracy, providing a strategy for populations and traits, and enables the inclusion of traits as genomic selection criterion to increase allele frequency in Brahman cattle and improve animal welfare.
papers.abstract_zh: 牛隻無角性狀（無角基因型）可減少去角的需求，因此有助於提升動物福利。在布拉曼牛（Brahman cattle）中，群體規模與表型紀錄的匱乏對此性狀基因體預測的準確性構成了挑戰。本研究旨在利用單品種與多品種基因體預測模型（包含元創始者 [metafounders]），評估布拉曼牛此性狀的遺傳架構，並探討表型分類對遺傳率、預測準確性、偏差及離散度的影響。本研究分析了 14,333 頭內洛爾牛（Nelore）與布拉曼牛的表型與基因型資料，並使用 BLUPF90+ 軟體套件中實作的閾值模型與線性模型進行分析。單品種模型（n = 12）考慮了各種表型（無角、結痂、角瘤、有角），而多品種模型（n = 10）則納入了元創始者與品種效應。變方成分透過結合吉布斯抽樣（Gibbs sampling）的閾值模型進行估算，預測能力則使用資料集的 LR 方法進行評估。單品種模型的遺傳率（$h^2$）估計值介於 0.56 至 0.72 之間，但其預測能力反映出布拉曼牛的群體規模限制。多品種模型改善了預測效能。結果顯示，包含替代表型、元創始者與品種效應的模型 20 表現最佳，其準確性達 0.79、偏差降低（0.36），且離散度接近 1。這些發現表明，布拉曼牛的無角性狀具有可進行選育的加性遺傳變異。多品種分析與元創始者的應用提升了預測準確性，為特定群體與性狀提供了一種策略，並使得該性狀能被納入基因體選育標準中，以增加布拉曼牛的等位基因頻率並改善動物福利。

papers.title: Integrating longitudinal metabolite profiles improves phenotype prediction in pigs in a trait- and timepoint-dependent manner
papers.abstract: Background Accurate prediction of phenotypes is essential for assessing the actual productive performance of individual pigs, particularly for traits that are costly or difficult to measure directly. This study investigated the potential of integrating individual-level blood serum metabolite profiles sampled at two developmental stages (10-week and 20-week) into phenotype prediction models for five economically important traits: average daily feed intake (DFI), feed conversion ratio (FCR), backfat thickness (BF), test daily gain (TDG), and loin depth (LD). Using a BayesC modeling framework, we analyzed 1,637 pigs from a single purebred population with complete phenotype, genotype, and metabolite-profile data. We evaluated seven models, including a genotype-only model (G), metabolite-only models using metabolite-profile data from 10-week (M1), 20-week (M2), or both timepoints (M1+M2), and combined models integrating genotypes with metabolite-profile data (G+M1, G+M2, G+M1+M2). Results Heritability estimates were generally low to moderate, ranging from 0.08 to 0.23 for the 10-week metabolite profiles and from 0.07 to 0.26 for the 20-week metabolite profiles. Prediction accuracy of phenotypes consistently improved when metabolite-profile data were integrated into prediction models, although the magnitude of improvement varied depending on the trait and the timepoint of metabolite sampling. Prediction accuracy increased from 0.33 (G) to 0.42 (G+M2; G+M1+M2) for DFI, and from 0.27 (G) to 0.32 (G+M2; G+M1+M2) for FCR. The latter two models also delivered the largest gains over G for BF (from 0.39 to 0.46) and TDG (from 0.30 to 0.32). However, LD benefited the most when both 10-week and 20-week metabolite profiles were combined (G+M1+M2: 0.44 compared to G: 0.42). Conclusions Across all traits, models combining genotype data with metabolite profiles from one or multiple timepoints achieved the highest or equally high phenotype prediction accuracies compared to the genotype-only model, reflecting complementary biological insights captured by metabolite profiles. These findings highlight the potential value of metabolite-profile data as an intermediate omics layer to enhance phenotypic prediction, particularly when integration strategies are tailored to trait-specific biology and sampling timepoints.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：準確預測表型對於評估個別豬隻的實際生產性能至關重要，特別是用於那些成本高昂或難以直接測量的性狀。本研究探討了將兩個發育階段（10週齡與20週齡）採樣之個體血清代謝物譜整合至表型預測模型的潛力，研究對象涵蓋五個具經濟重要性的性狀：平均日採食量（DFI）、飼料換肉率（FCR）、背脂厚度（BF）、檢定日增重（TDG）以及背肌深度（LD）。本研究採用 BayesC 模型框架，分析了來自單一純種族群、具備完整表型、基因型及代謝物譜數據的 1,637 頭豬隻。我們評估了七種模型，包含僅使用基因型的模型（G）、僅使用 10 週齡（M1）、20 週齡（M2）或兩個時間點（M1+M2）代謝物譜數據的模型，以及整合基因型與代謝物譜數據的綜合模型（G+M1、G+M2、G+M1+M2）。結果：遺傳力估計值普遍偏低至中等，10 週齡代謝物譜的遺傳力介於 0.08 至 0.23 之間，20 週齡代謝物譜則介於 0.07 至 0.26 之間。當代謝物譜數據被整合至預測模型中時，表型預測準確度皆呈現一致的提升，儘管提升的幅度會因性狀及代謝物採樣的時間點而異。對於 DFI，預測準確度從 0.33（G）提升至 0.42（G+M2；G+M1+M2）；對於 FCR，則從 0.27（G）提升至 0.32（G+M2；G+M1+M2）。後兩者模型在 BF（從 0.39 提升至 0.46）和 TDG（從 0.30 提升至 0.32）上，也取得了相較於 G 模型最大的增幅。然而，LD 在結合 10 週齡與 20 週齡代謝物譜時獲益最大（G+M1+M2：0.44，相較於 G：0.42）。結論：在所有性狀中，結合基因型數據與一個或多個時間點代謝物譜的模型，相較於僅使用基因型的模型，皆達到了最高或同等高的表型預測準確度，這反映出代謝物譜所捕捉到的互補性生物學見解。這些發現突顯了代謝物譜數據作為中間體學（omics）層次以增強表型預測的潛在價值，特別是在整合策略針對性狀特異性生物學特性與採樣時間點進行調整時。

papers.title: Effects of Selected Plant-Derived By-Products as Partial Soybean Meal Replacements on Nutrient Utilization, Cecal Microbiota, and Performance of Aged Laying Hens
papers.abstract: Soybean meal (SBM) is a major protein source in commercial layer diets; however, fluctuations in SBM prices and supply have increased the need for alternative protein sources in poultry production. Plant processing by-products are considered promising feed resources because of their abundant availability and nutritional value. However, the effects of partially replacing SBM with different plant-derived by-products on digestive function, gut microbiota, nutrient utilization, productive performance, and egg quality in aged laying hens remain insufficiently characterized. Therefore, this study aimed to evaluate the effects of partially replacing SBM with different plant-derived by-products on gastrointestinal digestive enzyme activities, cecal microbial community composition, apparent nutrient utilization, productive performance, and egg quality in aged laying hens. A total of 270 Hy-Line Brown laying hens at 80 weeks of age were randomly assigned to five dietary treatments, with six replicates per treatment and nine hens per replicate. Digestive enzyme activities and cecal microbiota were assessed using three birds per treatment. The control group was fed a corn-SBM basal diet, whereas the experimental groups were fed diets in which SBM was partially replaced with 10% palm kernel meak (PKM, T1), 12% rice bran meal (RBM, T2), 15% sunflower meal (SFM, T3), or 8% Zanthoxylum bungeanum seeds (ZBS, T4), respectively. The results showed that digestive enzyme activities varied among dietary treatments, with responses depending on the type of enzyme and gastrointestinal segment examined. Cecal microbiota analysis revealed no significant differences in alpha diversity among dietary treatments (p > 0.05), whereas overall microbial community composition differed significantly (PERMANOVA, p = 0.015). Differences in the relative abundances of individual bacterial taxa were also observed, but none remained significant after multiple-testing correction. Furthermore, the T3 group exhibited significantly higher apparent utilization of all six measured nutrients than the control group, whereas the other treatments showed mixed, nutrient-specific responses. Dietary treatments affected laying rate and eggshell thickness (p < 0.05), whereas average egg weight, average daily feed intake, feed-to-egg ratio, and other measured egg quality parameters were not significantly affected (p > 0.05). Overall, the four plant-derived by-products produced variable responses across the measured outcomes, suggesting ingredient-specific potential as partial substitutes for SBM under the dietary formulations and inclusion levels evaluated. However, their equivalent nutritional suitability cannot be established from the present findings, and further studies with larger sample sizes and multiple inclusion levels are warranted.
papers.abstract_zh: 豆 粕（soybean meal, SBM）是商業蛋雞飼料中的主要蛋白質來源；然而，豆粕價格與供應的波動增加了家禽生產中尋找替代蛋白質來源的需求。植物加工副產物因其資源豐富且具營養價值，被認為是極具潛力的飼料資源。然而，以不同植物源副產物部分取代豆粕對老齡蛋雞消化功能、腸道微生物相、營養物質利用率、生產性能與雞蛋品質的影響，目前仍未得到充分的探討。因此，本研究旨在評估以不同植物源副產物部分取代豆粕，對老齡蛋雞胃腸道消化酶活性、盲腸微生物群落組成、表觀營養物質利用率、生產性能與雞蛋品質的影響。試驗選用 270 隻 80 週齡的海蘭褐（Hy-Line Brown）產蛋雞，隨機分為 5 個飼糧處理組，每處理 6 個重複，每重複 9 隻雞。每處理取 3 隻雞評估消化酶活性與盲腸微生物相。對照組飼餵玉米-豆粕基礎飼糧，試驗組則分別以 10% 棕櫚仁粕（palm kernel meal, PKM, T1）、12% 米糠粕（rice bran meal, RBM, T2）、15% 葵花粕（sunflower meal, SFM, T3）或 8% 花椒籽（Zanthoxylum bungeanum seeds, ZBS, T4）部分取代飼糧中的豆粕。結果顯示，各飼糧處理間的消化酶活性有所差異，其反應取決於所檢測的酶種類與胃腸道區段。盲腸微生物相分析顯示，各飼糧處理間的阿發多樣性（alpha diversity）無顯著差異（p > 0.05），但整體微生物群落組成存在顯著差異（PERMANOVA, p = 0.015）。各別細菌分類群的相對豐度亦觀察到差異，但在多重檢定校正後均未達顯著水準。此外，T3 組的所有 6 種受測營養物質表觀利用率均顯著高於對照組，而其他處理組則表現出混合且因營養物質而異的反應。飼糧處理影響了產蛋率與蛋殼厚度（p < 0.05），而平均蛋重、平均日糧攝入量、料蛋比及其他受測蛋品質指標則無顯著受影響（p > 0.05）。綜言之，這四種植物源副產物在各項受測指標中產生了變異性的反應，顯示在所評估的飼糧配方與添加水準下，它們作為豆粕部分替代物具有因原料而異的潛力。然而，從本研究結果尚無法確立其等效的營養適宜性，未來有必要進行更大樣本量及多種添加水準的進一步研究。

papers.title: RE-FB: An Efficient Vision Model for Feeding Behavior Detection and Group-Level Feeding Activity Assessment in Broilers Housed in Multi-Tier Cages
papers.abstract: Automated monitoring of broiler feeding can improve management, but occlusion and scale variation hinder reliable detection in commercial multi-tier cages. This study developed a lightweight vision model for feeding behavior detection (RE-FB) and a feeding activity level (FAL) indicator for group-level assessment. The 2300 annotated images of yellow-feathered broilers were divided 8:1:1 for training, validation, and testing. RE-FB combines reparameterized multi-branch feature extraction, attention, and bidirectional multi-scale fusion to detect feeding birds and segment cages and feed troughs. On the test set, RE-FB-m achieved 89.7% precision, 87.3% recall, 92.1% box mAP@0.5, and 99.6% mask mAP@0.5, with 8.1 million parameters and a reported model inference speed of 158 FPS on the test platform. RE-FB-m achieved the highest box mAP@0.5 for feeding behavior detection among the evaluated Faster R-CNN, RT-DETR, and YOLO models. RE-FB was then applied to videos of four fixed groups monitored from 11 to 17 days of age. FAL was defined as the time-averaged proportion of the total birds in each monitored group detected as feeding, expressed as a percentage. Age-specific mean FAL values across the four groups ranged from 7.95% to 8.74%, with no significant age effect detected (p = 0.175). After controlling for group effects, the association between FAL and same-day weight gain was not statistically significant (partial r = −0.106, p = 0.614). RE-FB accurately and efficiently detects feeding behavior in caged broilers and generates group-level FAL records by aggregating detections over time. This approach provides a technical basis for non-contact monitoring of feeding activity in broiler production and can provide quantitative behavioral information for feeding management.
papers.abstract_zh: 自動化監測肉雞採食有助於改善管理，但遮擋與尺度變化阻礙了在商業化多層籠飼環境中的可靠檢測。本研究開發了一款用於採食行為檢測的輕量化視覺模型（RE-FB），以及用於群體層面評估的採食活動水準（FAL）指標。將 2,300 張帶有標註的黃羽肉雞影像按 8:1:1 的比例劃分為訓練集、驗證集和測試集。RE-FB 結合了重新參數化多分支特徵提取、注意力機制與雙向多尺度融合，以檢測採食中的肉雞並分割籠舍與料槽。在測試集上，RE-FB-m 取得了 89.7% 的準確率、87.3% 的召回率、92.1% 的邊界框平均精度均值（box mAP@0.5）以及 99.6% 的遮罩平均精度均值（mask mAP@0.5），擁有 810 萬個參數，在測試平臺上的模型推論速度達 158 FPS。在所評估的 Faster R-CNN、RT-DETR 與 YOLO 模型中，RE-FB-m 在採食行為檢測的 box mAP@0.5 表現最高。隨後，將 RE-FB 應用於 11 至 17 日齡監測的四個固定群體之影片中。FAL 定義為每個監測群體中被檢測為採食的雞隻數量佔總雞隻數的時間平均比例，以百分比表示。四個群體在不同日齡的平均 FAL 值介於 7.95% 至 8.74% 之間，未檢測到顯著的日齡效應（p = 0.175）。在控制群體效應後，FAL 與當日增重之間的關聯性無統計學顯著性（偏相關係數 partial r = −0.106，p = 0.614）。RE-FB 能夠準確且高效地檢測籠飼肉雞的採食行為，並透過隨時間累積檢測結果來生成群體層面的 FAL 記錄。此方法為肉雞生產中採食活動的非接觸式監測提供了技術基礎，並可為飼養管理提供量化的行為資訊。

papers.title: Pharmacokinetics and plasma protein binding of oxytetracycline in ducks ( Anas platyrhynchos ) following intravenous, intramuscular, subcutaneous and oral administration
papers.abstract: 1. Tetracyclines are among the most widely used antibiotics in poultry, with oxytetracycline (OTC) playing a key role due to its routine administration via feed and water to treat susceptible bacterial infections. Despite its widespread clinical use, understanding of the pharmacokinetics of OTC in the genus Anas remains remarkably limited. The following study characterised the pharmacokinetic profile of OTC after intravenous (IV), intramuscular (IM), subcutaneous (SC) and oral administration in ducks (Anas platyrhynchos).2. A total of 24 ducks (six per group in a parallel study) were given OTC at a dose of 40 mg/kg via IV, IM, SC and oral routes. Blood samples were collected at various time points ranging from 0 min (control) to 96 h post-administration. The samples were examined by high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) and the pharmacokinetic parameters were assessed through non-compartmental analysis.3. Following IV administration, the volume of distribution (2.73 l/kg) suggested extensive tissue penetration. Elimination half-lives were 12.69 h (IM), 13.54 h (SC) and 12.62 h (oral), all slightly longer than after IV dosing (9.72 h) with no significant differences between extravascular routes. Bioavailability was high after parenteral administration (≈90–98%), suggesting near-complete absorption, whereas oral bioavailability was low (≈17%), indicating gastrointestinal absorption as the main limiting factor. Plasma protein binding was high (87–93%).4. Parenteral administration of OTC (40 mg/kg) in ducks can achieve effective exposure against pathogens with minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) ≤0.5 µg/ml.
papers.abstract_zh:
1. 四環黴素類（Tetracyclines）是家禽中最廣泛使用的抗生素之一，其中土黴素（oxytetracycline, OTC）因透過飼料和飲水例行投予來治療易感性細菌感染而扮演關鍵角色。儘管其在臨床上廣泛使用，但對於鴨屬（Anas）動物體內土黴素藥物動力學的了解仍極為有限。本研究旨在探討鴨（Anas platyrhynchos）靜脈注射（IV）、肌肉注射（IM）、皮下注射（SC）及口服投予土黴素後的藥物動力學特性。

2. 本研究採用平行試驗設計，總共將 24 隻鴨隨機分組（每組 6 隻），分別透過靜脈、肌肉、皮下及口服途徑給予 40 mg/kg 劑量的土黴素。於給藥後從 0 分鐘（對照組）至 96 小時不等的多個時間點採集血液樣本。利用高效能液相層析儀（HPLC）檢測樣本，並透過非房室模式分析（non-compartmental analysis）評估藥物動力學參數。

3. 靜脈注射給藥後的分佈體積（2.73 l/kg）顯示其具有廣泛的組織穿透性。肌肉注射（12.69 h）、皮下注射（13.54 h）及口服（12.62 h）的排除半衰期皆略長於靜脈注射（9.72 h），且血管外給藥途徑之間無顯著差異。非經腸道給藥（parenteral administration）後的生體可用率極高（約 90–98%），顯示其吸收幾近完全；相較之下，口服生體可用率則偏低（約 17%），表明胃腸道吸收是主要的限制因素。血漿蛋白結合率偏高（87–93%）。

4. 在鴨隻體內非經腸道投予土黴素（40 mg/kg），可針對最低抑菌濃度（MIC）≤0.5 µg/ml 的病原體達到有效的藥物暴露量。

papers.title: Gene editing technologies in poultry: advances, applications, and future prospects
papers.abstract: SUMMARYThe chicken is an important model organism for research and a major global source of animal protein (eggs and meat). Recently developed genome-editing technologies have allowed the production of genetically engineered animals for agriculture and food production. Genome editing in chicken is a promising approach to enhance growth, disease resistance, productivity, and welfare traits. In this review, we explore the recent progress of gene-editing technologies in poultry production, such as CRISPR/Cas9 and base editing. Genome editing in poultry has been applied to improve traits, analyse gene function and boost resistance to disease. While significant progress has been made, there are still bottlenecks in the scaling up and regulatory approval of gene-edited poultry. This review highlights the latest developments in genome editing technologies and discusses ethical, regulatory and biosafety issues, such as animal welfare, food safety and environmental risks.
papers.abstract_zh:
摘要
雞是重要的研究模式生物，也是全球動物蛋白質（蛋與肉類）的主要來源。近期發展的基因編輯技術使得生產用於農業與食品生產的基因改造動物成為可能。在家禽中進行基因編輯是提升生長、抗病力、生產力與福利性狀的前瞻性方法。在本篇綜論中，我們探討了基因編輯技術在家禽生產中的最新進展，例如 CRISPR/Cas9 與鹼基編輯。家禽的基因編輯已被應用於改良性狀、分析基因功能以及增強對疾病的抵抗力。儘管已取得顯著進展，但在基因編輯家禽的規模化生產與法規批准方面仍存在瓶頸。本篇綜論重點介紹了基因編輯技術的最新發展，並探討了倫理、法規與生物安全等議題，例如動物福利、食品安全與環境風險。

papers.title: Inbreeding Depression in Wild Mammals: Genomic Mechanisms and Conservation Consequences
papers.abstract: Inbreeding depression is a widespread but highly variable threat to wild mammal populations, especially small, isolated, or fragmented ones. Genomic tools can now estimate individual inbreeding and mutation load more precisely than pedigrees or a few genetic markers. They show that similar levels of autozygosity can have very different fitness consequences. In this structured narrative review, we examine how runs of homozygosity, genomic inbreeding coefficients, and mutation load relate to inbreeding depression in wild mammals. We distinguish inbreeding (a process), autozygosity (its genomic consequence), low genetic diversity, and inbreeding depression (a fitness outcome), and we stress that high autozygosity alone does not demonstrate fitness costs. We compare land and marine case studies in which high autozygosity is associated with reduced reproduction, survival, and disease resistance, with cases in which purging or demographic history may have limited the decline in fitness. We consider how environmental stress, methodological differences, and confounding factors affect the observed inbreeding–fitness relationships. We then discuss how genomic estimates can inform conservation decisions, including the limits of genetic rescue, and we identify research priorities such as long-term studies that combine genomic, demographic, and ecological data. The review offers a framework for interpreting genomic inbreeding measures cautiously in conservation planning.
papers.abstract_zh: 近親衰退（inbreeding depression）對野生哺乳動物族群是普遍存在且變異極大的威脅，特別是對小型、隔離或破碎化的族群而言。基因體工具現在能夠比譜系或少數基因標記更精確地估計個體的近親交配與突變負擔（mutation load）。這些工具顯示，相似程度的同源合子化（autozygosity）可能會產生截然不同的適應度（fitness）後果。在本篇結構化敘事綜論中，我們檢視了連續同源區段（runs of homozygosity）、基因體近親交配係數與突變負擔如何與野生哺乳動物的近親衰退相關聯。我們區分了近親交配（一種過程）、同源合子化（其基因體後果）、低基因多樣性以及近親衰退（一種適應度結果），並強調單憑高同源合子化並不能證明存在適應度成本。我們比較了陸域與海洋的案例研究，在這些案例中，高同源合子化與繁殖力、存活率及抗病力的降低有關，但也有些案例顯示基因淨化（purging）或人口學歷史可能限制了適應度的下降。我們探討了環境壓力、方法學差異與混擾因子如何影響所觀察到的近親交配與適應度之間的關係。接著，我們討論基因體估計值如何為保育決策提供資訊（包括基因救援的極限），並指出了研究優先事項，例如結合基因體、人口學與生態學數據的長期研究。本綜論為在保育規劃中審慎解讀基因體近親交配指標提供了框架。

papers.title: Genome-Wide Association Study of Body Weight and Body Size Traits in Wenshang Barred Chickens at the Late Rearing Stage
papers.abstract: The late rearing stage is a critical period for the development of body weight and body size traits in chickens. In this study, we investigated the genetic architecture underlying these traits in 925 healthy 16-week-old Wenshang Barred chickens, with the aim of identifying candidate genes and genetic markers for trait improvement. We performed a genome-wide association study, linkage disequilibrium analysis, genotype–phenotype effect analysis, and enrichment analysis for body weight and seven body size traits. Heritability estimates for these traits ranged from 0.18 to 0.48. The study identified 89 candidate genes, including SETDB2, CAB39L, RB1, TRIM13, LDB2, and LCORL. In addition to the classic growth-associated region at GGA4:72.48–76.42 Mb, we identified an important region at GGA4:68.24–70.22 Mb, located approximately 2.3 Mb upstream, as well as an important region at GGA1:168.03–170.24 Mb. Functional enrichment analysis revealed that candidate genes were nominally enriched (p < 0.05) in amino sugar and nucleotide sugar metabolism, biosynthesis of nucleotide sugars, calcium signaling, and neuroactive ligand–receptor interaction pathways. Collectively, our findings clarify the genetic basis of body weight and body size traits during the late rearing stage and may provide a basis for further evaluation of genetic markers in indigenous chicken breeding programs.
papers.abstract_zh: 育雛後期是雞隻體重與體型性狀發育的關鍵時期。在本研究中，我們探討了 925 隻 16 週齡健康汶上蘆花雞這些性狀背後的遺傳結構，旨在找出用於性狀改良的候選基因與遺傳標記。我們針對體重及七項體型性狀進行了全基因組關聯分析、連鎖不平衡分析、基因型－表現型效應分析以及富集分析。這些性狀的遺傳力估值介於 0.18 至 0.48 之間。本研究辨識出 89 個候選基因，包含 SETDB2、CAB39L、RB1、TRIM13、LDB2 與 LCORL。除了位於 GGA4:72.48–76.42 Mb 的經典生長相關區域外，我們還識別出一個位於約 2.3 Mb 上游、重要且位於 GGA4:68.24–70.22 Mb 的區域，以及一個位於 GGA1:168.03–170.24 Mb 的重要區域。功能富集分析顯示，候選基因在胺基糖與核苷酸糖代謝、核苷酸糖生物合成、鈣離子訊息傳遞及神經活性配體－受體交互作用等路徑中具有名義上的顯著富集（p < 0.05）。總體而言，我們的研究結果闡明了育雛後期體重與體型性狀的遺傳基礎，並可能為本土雞隻育種計畫中遺傳標記的進一步評估提供基礎。

papers.title: Ruminant Species Composition and Reported Methane Intensity in Global Milk Production: A 186-Country Decomposition Under Alternative Allocation Boundaries
papers.abstract: Methane intensity of milk is often compared across ruminant species, but the Food and Agriculture Organization Corporate Statistical Database (FAOSTAT) identifies a dairy herd only for cattle; for buffalo, goats, sheep and camels it reports whole-herd methane. For 186 countries in 2020–2023 we allocated non-bovine herd methane to milk using country-specific shares of animals in milk. This reduced pooled intensity ratios to cattle from 2.9–17.9 to 1.1–5.2, and cattle had the lowest reported milk-allocated intensity in 53 of 107 multispecies countries (89 under whole-herd allocation). In the screened primary analysis (one implausible Mongolian sheep-milk series excluded), the world ratio decreased by 0.64 g CH4 kg−1; the three-factor decomposition attributed +0.48 g CH4 kg−1 to country shares, −0.10 to species mix and −1.02 to within-species intensity. With the series retained, the corresponding components were +0.57, −1.43 and +0.21. Cross-species comparisons are accounting constructs until boundaries and influential records are explicit.
papers.abstract_zh: 反芻動物間的乳品甲烷強度經常被進行比較，但聯合國糧食及農業組織企業統計資料庫（FAOSTAT）僅針對牛隻識別出乳牛群；對於水牛、山羊、綿羊和駱駝，則僅報告全群甲烷排放量。針對 2020–2023 年間的 186 個國家，我們利用各國泌乳動物的比例，將非牛類畜群的甲烷分配至乳品。這使合併強度比值從牛隻的 2.9–17.9 降至 1.1–5.2；在 107 個多物種國家中，牛隻在 53 個國家中擁有最低的報告乳品分配強度（若採用全則為 89 個）。在篩選後的主要分析中（排除一筆不合理的蒙古綿羊乳系列資料），全球比值減少了 0.64 g CH4 kg−1；三因子分解顯示，國家佔比貢獻了 +0.48 g CH4 kg−1，物種組成貢獻了 −0.10，物種內部強度則貢獻了 −1.02。若保留該系列資料，相應的組成份則分別為 +0.57、−1.43 與 +0.21。在明確界線與具影響力的記錄之前，跨物種比較僅屬會計建構。

papers.title: Dose–Response Evaluation of Dietary Curcumin Supplementation on Ileal Morphology and Antioxidant Status in Broiler Chickens
papers.abstract: This study aimed to evaluate suitable dietary curcumin supplementation levels for improving intestinal morphology and antioxidant status in medium-growing broiler chickens fed a practical corn–soybean meal diet from 57 to 84 d of age. A total of 252 male broilers (57 d of age; 1092.86 ± 8.91 g) were randomly assigned to six dietary treatments with seven replicate cages of six birds each. Broilers were fed diets supplemented with 0, 80, 160, 240, 320, or 400 mg/kg curcumin for 28 d. Asymptotic, broken-line, and quadratic models were fitted to dose–response data to estimate suitable dietary curcumin supplementation levels. Curcumin supplementation improved ileal morphology and antioxidant status, as evidenced by increased villus height (VH), VH/crypt depth (CD), villus surface area, total antioxidant capacity, and superoxide dismutase (SOD) activity, together with decreased CD and malondialdehyde (MDA) content. Curcumin also upregulated the mRNA expression of catalase (CAT), SOD, glutathione peroxidase (GPX)1, GPX3, GPX4, and nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) and increased Nrf2 protein abundance. Among the candidate models, broken-line regression provided the best fit for key ileal antioxidant indices, indicating that approximately 188 mg/kg of dietary curcumin may be sufficient to maximize ileal total antioxidant capacity under the present experimental conditions. Furthermore, Nrf2 expression exhibited trends similar to those of antioxidant-related gene expression and antioxidant enzyme activities, but showed an opposite trend to MDA content. These findings suggest a potential association between Nrf2 expression and intestinal antioxidant status.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在評估在 57 至 84 日齡中生長肉雞飼餵實用型玉米－大豆粕日糧時，添加適宜劑量之日糧薑黃素對改善其腸道形態與抗氧化狀態的效果。試驗選用總計 252 隻公肉雞（57 日齡；1092.86 ± 8.91 克），隨機分配至 6 個日糧處理組，每組 7 個重複籠，每籠 6 隻雞。肉雞分別飼餵添加 0、80、160、240、320 或 400 mg/kg 薑黃素的日糧，為期 28 天。利用漸近線模型、折線模型及二次曲線模型對劑量反應數據進行擬合，以估算適宜的日糧薑黃素添加量。薑黃素添加改善了迴腸形態與抗氧化狀態，表現為絨毛高度（VH）、VH/隱窩深度（CD）比值、絨毛表面積、總抗氧化能力及超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）活性增加，同時隱窩深度與丙二醛（MDA）含量降低。薑黃素亦上調了過氧化氫酶（CAT）、SOD、麩胱甘肽過氧化物酶（GPX）1、GPX3、GPX4 及核因子紅血球 2 相關因子 2（Nrf2）的 mRNA 表達，並增加了 Nrf2 蛋白質豐度。在候選模型中，折線迴歸對關鍵迴腸抗氧化指標的擬合效果最佳，顯示在本試驗條件下，約 188 mg/kg 的日糧薑黃素添加量即足以最大化迴腸總抗氧化能力。此外，Nrf2 表達趨勢與抗氧化相關基因表達及抗氧化酶活性相似，但與 MDA 含量呈相反趨勢。這些結果表明 Nrf2 表達與腸道抗氧化狀態之間存在潛在的關聯性。

papers.title: Combined Dietary Supplementation with Bacillus subtilis DSM 29784 and a Phytogenic Blend Modulates the Microbiome–Gut–Bone Axis in Broiler Chickens
papers.abstract: The microbiome–gut–bone axis may influence skeletal physiology in fast-growing broilers. This study evaluated dietary Bacillus subtilis DSM 29784 combined with a phytogenic blend (BsP) in 560 male Ross 308 broilers assigned to control or BsP diets (eight pens/treatment; 35 birds/pen) for 42 days. One clinically normal bird per pen was sampled on days 21, 35, and 42. BsP increased final body weight and cumulative gain and reduced the overall feed conversion ratio (p < 0.05). Intestinal barrier-associated gene expression increased, several ileal inflammatory marker transcripts decreased, and mineral-handling-related gene expression and serum/femoral mineral concentrations were higher at selected ages. Cecal 16S rRNA gene profiles showed differences in diversity and taxonomic composition. PICRUSt2 identified differences in predicted microbial functional potential, not measured pathway activity or metabolite production. Femoral inflammatory and osteogenic gene expression responses varied with age. Exploratory networks summarized microbiome–gut–bone associations at days 21, 35, and 42 without establishing causality or within-bird temporal change. BsP was associated with improved growth and altered intestinal and bone-related indicators, but clinical BCO prevention was not established. Future factorial studies should include direct bone quality measurements, standardized clinical and lesion assessments, and targeted microbial metabolite measurements.
papers.abstract_zh: 微生物群－腸道－骨骼軸可能會影響生長快速的肉雞之骨骼生理。本研究評估在 560 隻羅斯 308（Ross 308）公肉雞日糧中添加枯草芽孢桿菌 DSM 29784 結合植物萃取物複合物（BsP），試驗雞隻隨機分配至對照組或 BsP 組（每處理 8 個欄位；每欄 35 隻雞），為期 42 天。於第 21、35 和 42 天每欄採樣 1 隻臨床健康的雞隻。BsP 提高了最終體重與累積增重，並降低了整體飼料增重比（$p < 0.05$）。在特定週齡下，腸道屏障相關基因表現增加、數個迴腸發育發炎標記轉錄本減少、礦物質處理相關基因表現以及血清／股盲腸礦物質濃度較高。盲腸 16S rRNA 基因圖譜顯示多樣性與分類組成有所差異。PICRUSt2 鑑定出預測微生物功能潛力的差異，但未測量代謝途徑活性或代謝物產量。股骨發炎與成骨基因表現反應隨週齡而異。探索性網路總結了第 21、35 和 42 天的微生物群－腸道－骨骼關聯，但未確立因果關係或個別雞隻的的時間序列變化。BsP 與生長改善及腸道和骨骼相關指標的改變有關，但尚未確立預防臨床細菌性軟骨壞死性骨髓炎（BCO）的效果。未來的析因研究應包含直接的骨骼品質測量、標準化的臨床與病灶評估，以及標的性微生物代謝物測量。

papers.title: Effects of Mixed-Strain Solid-State Fermentation on Mycotoxin Levels and Feeding Value of a Mixture Containing Spent Flammulina velutipes Substrate for Yellow-Feathered Broilers
papers.abstract: Spent Flammulina velutipes substrate (SFVS) is nutritious, but its high crude fiber content and contamination with zearalenone (ZEN) and deoxynivalenol (DON) may limit feed use. This study optimized mixed-strain solid-state fermentation (SSF) of an SFVS-containing mixture and evaluated feeding value using 420 one-day-old male yellow-feathered broilers. Optimal conditions were a 2:1:2:3 inoculum ratio of Saccharomyces cerevisiae, Bacillus coagulans, Clostridium butyricum, and Bacillus subtilis, with 5-day fermentation, 47% moisture, and 7% inoculum. In the mixture, ZEN and DON concentrations decreased from 8622.43 and 1612.74 to 1349.82 and 750.21 μg/kg (84.35% and 53.48% reductions). Fermentation increased crude protein and total measured amino acids, decreased crude fiber (p < 0.01), and increased in vitro digestibilities of dry matter, crude protein, and crude fiber (p < 0.05). Over 42 d, 3% and 5% inclusion of the fermented mixture increased body weight (BW) on days 21 and 42 and average daily gain (ADG), while reducing feed conversion ratio (FCR) versus unfermented-mixture treatments (p < 0.05). At 3% and 5% inclusion, serum antioxidant status and jejunal morphology improved, while breast meat cooking loss and overall texture were not adversely affected; cecal communities were generally closer to the control (CON). The 7% inclusion provided no further benefit.
papers.abstract_zh: 金針菇廢菌包（SFVS）富含營養，但其高粗纖維含量以及玉米赤黴烯酮（ZEN）和脫氧雪腐鐮刀菌烯醇（DON）的汙染可能會限制其作為飼料的使用。本研究最佳化了含SFVS混合物的多菌株固態發酵（SSF）條件，並使用420隻一日齡雄性黃羽肉雞評估其飼養價值。最佳條件為：釀酒酵母、凝結芽孢桿菌、酪酸梭菌和枯草芽孢桿菌的接種比例為2:1:2:3，發酵天數5天，水分含量47%，接種量7%。在混合物中，ZEN和DON的濃度分別從8622.43和1612.74 μg/kg降至1349.82和750.21 μg/kg（分別降低了84.35%和53.48%）。發酵提高了粗蛋白和總測得胺基酸含量，降低了粗纖維含量（p < 0.01），並提高了乾物質、粗蛋白和粗纖維的體外消化率（p < 0.05）。在為期42天的試驗中，與未發酵混合物處理組相比，添加3%和5%的發酵混合物提高了21日齡和42日齡的體重（BW）以及平均日增重（ADG），同時降低了飼料轉換率（FCR）（p < 0.05）。在3%和5%的添加量下，血清抗氧化狀態和空腸形態有所改善，而胸肉的蒸煮損失和整體質地未受負面影響；盲腸菌群結構總體上更接近對照組（CON）。7%的添加量則沒有帶來額外的好處。

papers.title: The Impact of Omnivorous Feeding on Antioxidant Capacity, Gut Microbiota, and the Relationship Between Gut Microbiota and Meat Quality in Xinghua and White Recessive Rock Chickens
papers.abstract: The impacts of omnivorous feeding on intestinal morphology and microbial community structure remain a critical area of research in poultry science, uncovering potential biological mechanisms regulating growth and development. This study investigated how feeding regimes modulate antioxidant enzyme activities, intestinal morphological structure, gut microbiota, and the relationship between gut microbiota and meat quality. We conducted a comprehensive analysis integrating antioxidant enzyme activities, intestinal histomorphology, and 16S rRNA gene sequencing. Correlation analyses were performed to identify key microbial taxa influencing meat quality. Omnivorous feeding significantly altered the activities of certain antioxidant enzymes in the serum and selected intestinal tissues of both White Recessive Rock and Xinghua chickens. Omnivorous feeding significantly reduced the VH/CD ratio in specific intestinal segments. Microbial analysis revealed that omnivorous feeding modulated the relative abundances of Bacillus, Enterococcus, Escherichia-Shigella, and Romboutsia. These shifts promoted metabolic functions, including carbohydrate, amino acid, and energy metabolism. Crucially, correlation analysis identified Faecalibacterium, Bacillus, Romboutsia, Streptococcus, and unclassified UCG_010 as key genera significantly associated with meat quality traits. The findings suggest that omnivorous feeding shows the potential to improve poultry health and meat quality.
papers.abstract_zh: 雜食性飼餵對腸道形態與微生物群落結構的影響，仍是家禽科學中一個關鍵的研究領域，有助於揭示調節生長與發育的潛在生物學機制。本研究探討了飼餵制度如何調節抗氧化酶活性、腸道形態結構、腸道微生物相，以及腸道微生物相與肉質之間的關係。我們進行了一項綜合分析，整合了抗氧化酶活性、腸道組織形態學及 16S rRNA 基因定序。透過相關性分析，識別出影響肉質的關鍵微生物分類群。雜食性飼餵顯著改變了白洛克雞與興華雞血清及特定腸道組織中的部分抗氧化酶活性。雜食性飼餵顯著降低了特定腸道區段的絨毛高度與隱窩深度比值（VH/CD ratio）。微生物分析顯示，雜食性飼餵調節了芽孢桿菌屬（Bacillus）、腸球菌屬（Enterococcus）、埃希氏菌-志賀氏菌屬（Escherichia-Shigella）及羅姆布茨菌屬（Romboutsia）的相對豐度。這些轉變促進了代謝功能，包含碳水化合物、胺基酸及能量代謝。至關重要的是，相關性分析識別出糞桿菌屬（Faecalibacterium）、芽孢桿菌屬（Bacillus）、羅姆布茨菌屬（Romboutsia）、鏈球菌屬（Streptococcus）以及未分類的 UCG_010 屬（unclassified UCG_010）為顯著與肉質性狀相關的關鍵屬。研究結果表明，雜食性飼餵展現出改善家禽健康與肉質的潛力。

papers.title: Locomotor Aptitude Is Associated with Differences in Protein-Bound and Free Amino Acid Pools in Breast and Thigh Muscles of Organic Chickens
papers.abstract: Organic poultry production requires genotypes suited to outdoor rearing, yet associations between previously characterised locomotor aptitude and meat amino acid composition remain poorly understood. This study examined breast and thigh muscles from 60 organically reared chickens representing six genetic lines (three classified as active and three as sedentary; ten carcasses per line), slaughtered at 81 days. Proximate composition and total and free amino acids were determined. Breast muscle contained more crude protein and total essential amino acids (EAAs) than thigh muscle. Genotypes classified as active had higher total EAA concentrations in breast (7.80 vs. 7.20 g/100 g meat), but not in thigh. After false discovery rate correction, the overall locomotor-group difference in crude protein was not significant. Free amino acid differences were concentrated in thigh: Bonferroni-adjusted comparisons showed lower total free amino acids, free EAAs, and individual free valine, isoleucine, and leucine in active-classified lines, whereas breast concentrations were comparable. The group × muscle interaction was significant for free EAAs (Q = 0.013), but not for total free amino acids. These muscle-specific patterns demonstrate the complementary value of total and free amino acid measurements for characterising poultry meat composition, without establishing an independent effect of locomotion or in vivo metabolic mechanisms.
papers.abstract_zh: 有機家禽生產需要適合戶外飼養的基因型，然而先前已表徵的運動能力與肉品胺基酸組成之間的關聯性仍所知有限。本研究探討了來自六個遺傳品系（三個被歸類為活躍型、三個為久坐型；每個品系十個屠體）、於81日齡屠宰之60隻有機飼養雞隻的胸肌與腿肌。測定了一般營養成分以及總胺基酸和游離胺基酸。胸肌的粗蛋白和總必需胺基酸（EAAs）含量高於腿肌。被歸類為活躍型的基因型在胸肌中具有較高的總必需胺基酸濃度（7.80對7.20克/100克肉），但在腿肌中則無此差異。在進行錯誤發現率校正後，粗蛋白的整體運動組別差異並無統計顯著性。游離胺基酸的差異集中於腿肌：經邦費羅尼校正後的比較顯示，活躍型品系的總游離胺基酸、游離必需胺基酸，以及個別的游離纈胺酸、異白胺酸和白胺酸濃度較低，而胸肌的濃度則相近。游離必需胺基酸的組別×肌肉交戶作用具顯著性（Q = 0.013），但總游離胺基酸則否。這些具肌肉特異性的模式證明瞭總胺基酸與游離胺基酸測定對於表徵家禽肉品組成的互補價值，但尚未能確立運動或活體代謝機制的獨立效應。

papers.title: Integrating pangenome and imputation framework reveals structural variants affecting stature and milk composition traits in French dairy cattle
papers.abstract: Background Structural variants (SVs) are most effectively identified using long-read (LR) sequencing. However, such data remain scarce, and sequenced samples often lack associated phenotypic information. To overcome this limitation, we integrated pangenome-based (variation graph-based) and imputation approaches to enable large-scale SV association studies in the three main French dairy cattle breeds. Results A variation graph was constructed using 69,892 deletions, 89,900 insertions, and 17,402 duplications detected in 176 LR samples. We subsequently genotyped 939 samples for each SV in the panel by realigning their short-read (SR) sequences to the graph. Validation analyses showed high genotype concordance rates for deletions (0.79) and insertions (0.79); however, concordance for duplications was low (0.14), leading to their exclusion from further analyses. The retained SVs were combined with single nucleotide variants (SNVs) to build a sequence-level imputation reference panel. Using SNP genotyping array data, we imputed SVs and SNVs for 11,902 Holstein, 3,753 Montbéliarde, and 3,053 Normande bulls. After quality control, more than 14 million SNVs and 40 thousand SVs were retained for within-breed genome-wide association studies (GWAS) using daughter yield deviations for stature and four milk production and composition traits. The GWAS results revealed genetic architectures consistent with previous findings and identified 40 genome-wide significant associations between structural variant and key phenotypes. Conditional analyses identified that ten of these SVs as potential candidate variants underlying QTLs related to milk fat and protein contents, as well as stature. Conclusions By integrating LR, SR, and SNP genotyping data within a unified pangenome and imputation framework, we demonstrate a scalable strategy to systematically interrogate the contribution of SVs to complex traits. The resulting genetic architectures were highly consistent with previous findings, validating both the robustness and transferability of our approach. Our findings highlight the added value of integrating SVs into routine genomic analyses and provide a scalable framework for incorporating SVs into genomic selection in dairy cattle.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Science and Biotechnology
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：結構變異（Structural variants, SVs）透過長讀長（long-read, LR）定序能獲得最有效的識別。然而，這類數據仍然稀缺，且定序樣本往往缺乏相關的表現型資訊。為了克服這項限制，我們整合了基於泛基因組（變異圖譜）與基因型 imputations（推填）的方法，在法國三個主要乳牛品種中實現大規模的 SV 關聯分析。
結果：利用 176 個長讀長樣本中檢測到的 69,892 個缺失、89,900 個插入以及 17,402 個重複，建構了一個變異圖譜。隨後，我們透過將這面板中各 SV 的短讀長（short-read, SR）序列重新比對至該圖譜，對 939 個樣本進行基因型分型。驗證分析顯示，缺失（0.79）與插入（0.79）具有高度的基因型一致率；然而，重複的一致率偏低（0.14），導致其被排除於後續分析之外。保留下來的 SV 與單核苷酸變異（SNVs）相結合，建立了序列層級的 imputation 參考面板。利用 SNP 晶片分型數據，我們對 11,902 頭荷斯坦牛（Holstein）、3,753 頭蒙貝利亞德牛（Montbéliarde）以及 3,053 頭諾曼第牛（Normande）公牛進行了 SV 與 SNV 的 imputation。經過品管後，保留了超過 14 百萬個 SNV 與 4 万個 SV，用於對體型以及四種乳量與乳成分性狀的女牛產乳離差（daughter yield deviations）進行品種內的全基因體關聯分析（GWAS）。GWAS 結果顯示出與先前發現一致的遺傳架構，並在結構變異與關鍵表現型之間識別出 40 個達全基因體顯著水準的關聯。條件分析識別出其中 10 個 SV 作為與乳脂、乳蛋白含量及體型相關之 QTL 的潛在候選變異。
結論：透過在統一的泛基因組與 imputation 架構中整合 LR、SR 和 SNP 分型數據，我們展示了一項可擴展的策略，以系統性地探討 SV 對複雜性狀的貢獻。所得的遺傳架構與先前的發現高度一致，驗證了我們方法的穩健性與可轉移性。我們的發現突顯了將 SV 納入常規基因體分析的附加價值，並為將 SV 納入乳牛基因體選拔提供了一個可擴展的架構。

papers.title: Integrative lipidomic and genomic analysis identifies key lipids for wooden breast in chickens
papers.abstract: Background Wooden breast (WB) is a prevalent myopathy in broilers that substantially reduces meat quality and causes considerable economic losses. However, the genetic architecture and lipidomic alterations associated with WB remain poorly understood. This study aimed to integrate untargeted lipidomics and genomic analyses to characterize lipid alterations and their associated genetic factors in WB. Results To characterize WB-related phenotypes, pectoralis major muscles from 312 broilers were evaluated for WB severity, compression force (CF), endomysium thickness, and total lipid abundance. By integrating differential abundance analysis, trend analysis, and weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA), we identified a core set of 25 lipid species. Further refinement using Mendelian randomization (MR) and mediation analyses prioritized nine lipids as candidate molecular traits associated with genetic variation and WB, seven of which showed consistent associations in an independent cohort ( n = 119). Metabolome genome‐wide association study (mGWAS) of these lipids identified a consensus genetic locus on chromosome 6 (19.55–20.15 Mb) shared by three candidate lipids. Integration of transcriptomic profiles from genes within this locus prioritized five candidate genes, with MAPK8 and NPY4R showing consistent expression patterns in the independent cohort. Based on its potential biological relevance, MAPK8 was selected for functional characterization in chicken primary myoblasts. MAPK8 overexpression and knockdown produced opposite effects on lipid accumulation, oxidative stress, and fibrosis-related gene expression, suggesting that MAPK8 may participate in cellular processes involved in lipid accumulation, oxidative stress, and fibrotic remodeling associated with WB. Conclusions This study provides an integrated overview of lipid metabolic alterations and their genetic architecture in WB-affected chickens. Collectively, these findings identify candidate lipid biomarkers and genetic loci and implicate MAPK8 as a candidate gene associated with lipid deposition and fibrotic remodeling in WB.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Science and Biotechnology
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：木胸症（Wooden breast, WB）是肉雞中常見的肌肉病變，會顯著降低肉品品質並造成相當大的經濟損失。然而，與WB相關的遺傳結構與脂質體學改變仍所知有限。本研究旨在整合非標靶脂質體學與基因體學分析，以表徵WB中的脂質改變及其相關遺傳因素。

結果：為了表徵WB相關表型，評估了312隻肉雞的胸大肌之WB嚴重程度、壓縮力（CF）、肌內膜厚度與總脂質豐度。透過整合差異豐度分析、趨勢分析與加權基因共表現網路分析（WGCNA），我們識別出核心的25種脂質。進一步利用孟德爾隨機化（MR）與中介分析進行篩選，確立了9種與遺傳變異和WB相關的候選分子性狀，其中7種在獨立世代（n = 119）中顯示出一致的關聯性。對這些脂質進行的代謝物全基因體關聯研究（mGWAS）識別出位於第6染色體（19.55–20.15 Mb）、由三種候選脂質所共享的一致性遺傳位點。整合該位點內基因的轉錄體學圖譜，篩選出5個候選基因，其中MAPK8和NPY4R在獨立世代中顯示出一致的表現模式。基於其潛在的生物學相關性，選定MAPK8進行雞隻原代肌細胞的功能表徵。MAPK8的過度表現與抑制對脂質累積、氧化壓力及纖維化相關基因表現產生相反的影響，這表明MAPK8可能參與了與WB相關的脂質累積、氧化壓力及纖維化重塑等細胞過程。

結論：本研究提供了罹患WB雞隻中脂質代謝改變及其遺傳結構的整合性概覽。綜上所述，這些發現識別了候選脂質生物標記與遺傳位點，並指出MAPK8是與WB中脂質沉積和纖維化重塑相關的候選基因。

papers.title: Multi‐Omics Reveals Divergent Gut Microbiome–Metabolome Associations Between High‐Altitude Snowcock and Low‐Altitude Pheasant
papers.abstract: The gut microecological differences associated with high‐altitude habitats remain poorly understood. The Snowcock ( Tetraogallus tibetanus ), a high‐altitude bird endemic to the Qinghai‐Xizang Plateau, and the low‐altitude Pheasant ( Phasianus colchicus ) differ strikingly in habitat elevation and diet, providing an ideal comparative model. Fecal samples from six Snowcocks and six Pheasants were analyzed using 16S rRNA gene sequencing and UPLC‐MS/MS untargeted metabolomics. Multi‐omics integration was performed via Procrustes analysis, correlation networks, and random forest classification. Snowcocks displayed significantly lower alpha diversity and distinct beta diversity clustering compared with Pheasants. The Snowcock microbiota was dominated by Actinobacteriota and enriched in cold‐tolerant genera such as Psychrobacillus . In contrast, the Pheasant microbiota showed higher diversity and was dominated by Firmicutes and Bacteroidota. Metabolomics revealed that differential metabolites enriched in Pheasants were predominantly mapped to amino acid metabolism and terpenoid biosynthesis pathways, while those enriched in Snowcocks were linked to glycerophospholipid and sphingolipid metabolism. Multi‐omics integration demonstrated a significantly correlated microbiome–metabolome association, and the random forest model discriminated the two species in this dataset. The Snowcock microbiota was simplified and enriched with psychrophilic genera, and its fecal metabolome showed specific glycerophospholipid signatures. These features may reflect microecological divergence associated with the harsh plateau environment. Our findings provide multi‐omics insights into high‐altitude divergence in wild birds.
papers.abstract_zh: 高海拔棲息地相關的腸道微生態差異目前仍所知甚少。藏雪雞（Tetraogallus tibetanus）為青藏高原特有的高海拔鳥類，與低海拔的環頸雉（Phasianus colchicus）在棲息海拔和飲食上存在顯著差異，提供了理想的比較模型。本研究利用 16S rRNA 基因定序與 UPLC-MS/MS 非標靶代謝體學，分析了六隻藏雪雞與六隻環頸雉的糞便樣本。透過普氏分析（Procrustes analysis）、相關性網路及隨機森林分類進行多體學整合。與環頸雉相比，藏雪雞表現出顯著較低的阿爾法多樣性（alpha diversity）以及截然不同的貝塔多樣性（beta diversity）分群。藏雪雞的菌相以放線菌門（Actinobacteriota）為主，並富含耐寒屬，如嗜冷桿菌屬（Psychrobacillus）。相比之下，環頸雉的菌相顯示出較高的多樣性，並以厚壁菌門（Firmicutes）和擬桿菌門（Bacteroidota）為主。代謝體學顯示，環頸雉中富集的差異代謝物主要對應至胺基酸代謝與類萜生物合成途徑，而藏雪雞中富集的代謝物則與甘油磷脂及鞘脂代謝有關。多體學整合證明了顯著相關的微生物組－代謝組關聯，且隨機森林模型在此資料集中區分了這兩個物種。藏雪雞的 microbiota 趨於簡化且富含嗜冷屬，其糞便代謝體則顯示出特定的甘油磷脂特徵。這些特徵可能反映了與嚴苛高原環境相關的微生態分化。我們的研究結果為野生鳥類的高海拔分化提供了多體學見解。

papers.title: Harnessing single-cell omics for farmed animal improvement and human health
papers.abstract: Cellular heterogeneity underlies the regulation of complex traits and diseases, making cell-resolved molecular characterization fundamental for advancing precision agriculture and human biomedicine. Rapid advances in single-cell omics technologies, together with the ever-evolving computational methods, have led to the establishment of large-scale single cell atlases across multiple species, providing unprecedented opportunities to systematically dissect cellular diversity and regulatory mechanisms underlying complex phenotypes. In this review, we summarize recent progresses in single-cell sequencing technologies, reference cell atlas projects, and the integration of single-cell omics with population/quantitative genetics, as well as discuss how artificial intelligence and predictive perturbation modelling are reshaping single-cell research. Finally, we highlight future directions toward population-scale single-cell omics, AI-driven virtual cells/tissues, and genotype–cell/tissue–trait frameworks, which are expected to transform biological discovery, enable better design of veterinary medicines and human therapeutics, as well as accelerate sustainable farmed animal improvement and precision medicine.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Science and Biotechnology
papers.abstract_zh: 細胞異質性是複雜性狀與疾病調控的基礎，使得具備細胞解析度的分子特性剖析成為推進精準農業與人類生物醫學的關鍵。單細胞體學技術的快速進展，加上不斷演進的計算方法，促成了多物種大規模單細胞圖譜的建立，為系統性解析複雜表現型背後的細胞多樣性與調控機制提供了前所未有的契機。在本篇綜述中，我們總結了單細胞定序技術、參考細胞圖譜計畫，以及單細胞體學與群體／數量遺傳學整合的最新進展，並討論人工智慧與預測性擾動建模如何重塑單細胞研究。最後，我們強調了朝向群體規模單細胞體學、AI 驅動的虛擬細胞／組織，以及基因型－細胞／組織－性狀框架的未來發展方向，這些方向預期將轉化生物學發現、實現更佳的獸醫藥物與人類治療藥物設計，並加速永續經濟動物改良與精準醫療。

papers.title: Effect of tannic acid and chitosan supplementation on growth performance, antioxidant status, immune function, and caecal microbial diversity of Pekin duck aged 0 to 21 days
papers.abstract: 1. Tannic acid (TA) and chitosan (CH) are natural compounds with antioxidant, antimicrobial and immunomodulatory bioactivities. This study evaluated the effects of dietary TA, CH and their combination on White Pekin ducks aged 0 to 21 d.2. A total of 336 one-day-old Pekin ducks were randomly assigned to one of four dietary treatments with six replicate cages per treatment and 14 birds per cage. The treatments included a basal diet (CON), CON +0.2% TA, CON +0.2% CH and CON +0.2% TA + 0.2% CH. The trial lasted 21 d.3. Dietary supplementation with 0.2% TA alone increased average daily gain (p < 0.05), while 0.2% CH decreased thymus weight and thymus index (p < 0.05). Both TA and CH alone improved serum antioxidant status and immunoglobulin levels, but their combination did not give any synergistic effects.4. All supplemented diets modified caecal microbial community structure, which significantly reduced the relative abundance of Proteobacteria at the phylum level and Desulphovibrio at the genus level (p < 0.05).5. In conclusion, 0.2% TA alone improved growth performance, while 0.2% CH alone enhanced antioxidant and immune function in 0–21 d Pekin ducks. The combination of TA and CH showed no synergistic benefits. Both compounds beneficially modulated caecal microbiota by inhibiting potentially harmful taxa. These results indicated that single supplementation of TA or CH is more suitable for Pekin duck production.
papers.abstract_zh:
1. 單寧酸（tannic acid, TA）與殼聚醣（chitosan, CH）是具有抗氧化、抗菌及免疫調節生物活性的天然化合物。本研究旨在評估飼糧中添加 TA、CH 及其複合添加對 0 至 21 日齡白北京鴨之影響。
2. 試驗選用共 336 隻一日齡北京鴨，隨機分配至四種飼糧處理組，每組 6 個重複籠，每籠 14 隻鴨。處理組包括基礎飼糧（CON）、CON + 0.2% TA、CON + 0.2% CH，以及 CON + 0.2% TA + 0.2% CH。試驗為期 21 天。
3. 飼糧單獨添加 0.2% TA 可提高平均日增重（p < 0.05），而單獨添加 0.2% CH 則會降低胸腺重與胸腺指數（p < 0.05）。單獨添加 TA 與 CH 均能改善血清抗氧化狀態及免疫球蛋白濃度，但兩者併用並未產生協同效應。
4. 所有添加試驗飼糧皆改變了盲腸微生物相結構，顯著降低了門級變形菌門（Proteobacteria）及屬級脫硫弧菌屬（Desulphovibrio）之相對豐度（p < 0.05）。
5. 綜上所述，於 0–21 日齡北京鴨飼糧中，單獨添加 0.2% TA 可改善生長性能，單獨添加 0.2% CH 則可增強抗氧化與免疫功能。TA 與 CH 併用並未顯示出協同效益。此兩種化合物皆能透過抑制潛在有害菌群，對盲腸微生物相發揮有益的調節作用。結果顯示，單獨添加 TA 或 CH 更適合應用於北京鴨生產。

papers.title: Population Genomic Survey of Dongliao Black and Jilin Spotted Pigs and Their Genetic Relationships With Northeastern Asian Breeds
papers.abstract: In this study, we conducted a population genomic survey of two local pig breeds in Jilin Province, Dongliao Black (DLB) and Jilin Spotted (JLS) pigs, and evaluated their genetic relationships with 23 Northeastern Asian pig breeds, comprising 46 wild boars, 211 Chinese local pigs, 69 Russian pigs, 13 Korean pigs, and 107 commercial pigs. The results will be helpful for the conservation and utilization of these rare germplasm resources. The minor allele frequency of DLB and JLS pigs was 0.24 and 0.22, respectively. Both DLB and JLS pigs exhibited higher observed heterozygosity than expected values. Moreover, JLS pigs displayed the lowest excess of homozygosity inbreeding coefficient (−0.12 ± 0.07) among all studied populations. Additionally, population structure analyses indicated that DLB and JLS pigs possess admixed ancestries intermediate between Chinese and Western pigs, with DLB being closely related to Min pigs and both breeds showing admixture signals with neighboring Northeastern Chinese breeds, reflecting their distinct hybrid histories. Furthermore, 16 and 19 genes were identified as putative candidate genes in DLB and JLS pigs using Fst analyses, respectively. All these findings are consistent with a history of crossbreeding and with low levels of inbreeding in DLB and JLS pig populations. Additionally, it is hypothesized that DLB and JLS pig breeds may carry putative candidate genes during their breeding programs, which are associated with meat quality, reproduction, production, immunity, and environmental adaptation. Therefore, strengthening conservation and promotion efforts for DLB and JLS pigs is of great significance.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究針對吉林省的兩個地方豬品種——東遼黑豬（DLB）與吉林斑豬（JLS）進行了群體基因體調查，並評估了牠們與23個東北亞豬品種（包含46頭野豬、211頭中國地方豬、69頭俄羅斯豬、13頭韓國豬及107頭商業豬）的遺傳關係。研究結果將有助於這些珍稀種質資源的保育與利用。DLB與JLS豬的次要等位基因頻率分別為0.24與0.22。DLB與JLS豬皆展現出高於期望值的觀測雜合度。此外，在所有受測群體中，JLS豬顯示出最低的純合度過剩近交係數（−0.12 ± 0.07）。再者，群體結構分析顯示，DLB與JLS豬具有介於中國地方豬與西方豬之間的混血祖先成分，其中DLB與民豬的親緣關係較近，且兩品種皆與鄰近的中國東北品種呈現混血信號，反映出其獨特的雜交歷史。此外，透過 $F_{st}$ 分析，分別在DLB與JLS豬中鑑定出16個與19個假定候選基因。所有這些發現皆與DLB和JLS豬群體的雜交歷史及低近交水準一致。此外，推測DLB與JLS豬品種在其育種過程中可能攜帶了與肉質、繁殖、生產、免疫及環境適應相關的假定候選基因。因此，加強DLB與JLS豬的保育與推廣工作具有重大意義。

papers.title: Effects of Grain Source and Emulsifier Supplementation of Reduced-Energy Diets on Performance, Slaughter Traits, Tibia Characteristics, Jejunal Histomorphology and Pancreatic Enzymes in Broilers
papers.abstract: The purpose of this study was to evaluate the effect of emulsifier addition to reduced-energy maize-, barley- or wheat-based diets on selected indicators in broilers. In this experiment, a total of 540 unsexed (mixed-sex) one-day-old Ross 308 chicks were allocated to six treatment groups using a 3 × 2 factorial design (five replicate pens of 18 birds). Each diet was fed either as a standard-energy diet without emulsifier or as a reduced-energy diet (−50 kcal/kg ME, achieved by lowering soybean oil inclusion) supplemented with 500 g/ton emulsifier. The wheat-based diet reduced body weight and feed consumption but improved feed conversion ratio compared with the barley-based diet. Feeding a maize-based diet increased carcass yield and the breast (meat, skin and bone) ratio but decreased the leg (two thighs and two drumsticks, with meat, skin and bone) ratio compared to feeding a wheat-based diet. The addition of emulsifiers to barley- and wheat-based diets increased carcass yield. The negative effects of barley- and wheat-based diets on the carcass compared to the maize diet were compensated for by the addition of emulsifiers to the diet. The highest values for tibia breaking strength and tibia ash content were obtained with wheat-, maize-, and barley-based diets, respectively. Tibia ash increased with the addition of emulsifiers to barley- and wheat-based diets. Barley- and wheat-based diets resulted in higher pancreatic amylase activity compared to maize-based diets. Pancreatic lipase activity increased with the addition of emulsifiers. The wheat-based diet increased villus surface area compared to other cereals. The addition of emulsifier to the diet increased villus height/crypt depth but decreased other villus measurements. In conclusion, it can be said that adding emulsifiers to reduced-energy broiler diets feed is more effective in increasing carcass yield in barley- and wheat-based feeds, and that emulsifier addition compensates for the energy deficit in the diet.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在評估在減低能量的玉米、大麥或小麥基礎飼糧中添加乳化劑對肉雞特定指標之影響。在本實驗中，共 540 隻一日齡、公母混養的 Ross 308 肉雞被分配至六個處理組，採用 3 × 2 因子設計（設有 5 個重複欄位，每欄 18 隻雞）。每種飼糧分別為不含乳化劑之標準能量飼糧，或添加 500 克/噸乳化劑之減低能量飼糧（代謝能減少 50 千卡/公斤，透過降低大豆油添加量達成）。與大麥基礎飼糧相比，小麥基礎飼糧降低了體重和飼料消耗量，但改善了飼料換肉率。與餵食小麥基礎飼糧相比，餵食玉米基礎飼糧提高了屠宰率與胸肉（肉、皮和骨）比例，但降低了腿部（兩個大腿和兩個小腿，含肉、皮和骨）比例。在大麥和小麥基礎飼糧中添加乳化劑提高了屠宰率。大麥和小麥基礎飼糧對屠宰性狀相較於玉米飼糧所產生的負面影響，可透過在飼糧中添加乳化劑來彌補。脛骨斷裂強度和脛骨灰分含量的最高值分別出現在小麥、玉米和大麥基礎飼糧中。在大麥和小麥基礎飼糧中添加乳化劑會使脛骨灰分增加。與玉米基礎飼糧相比，大麥和小麥基礎飼糧導致較高的胰澱粉酶活性。胰脂肪酶活性隨乳化劑的添加而增加。與其他穀物相比，小麥基礎飼糧增加了絨毛表面積。飼糧中添加乳化劑增加了絨毛高度／隱窩深度比，但減少了其他絨毛測量值。總體而言，在減低能量的肉雞飼糧中添加乳化劑，對於提高大麥和小麥基礎飼料的屠宰率更為有效，且乳化劑的添加能補償飼糧中的能量赤字。

papers.title: Integrating Heat Stress into Circular Livestock Production and Life Cycle Assessment: Toward a Heat-Stress Circularity Index
papers.abstract: Heat stress (HS) constrains livestock production under climate change, impairing health, welfare, productivity and survival. Because fixed resource use is then spread over less output, HS is also a systems-level sustainability problem. This narrative review, based on a targeted search of PubMed, Web of Science and Scopus (2013–2026), proposes a framework linking climate exposure, animal responses, resource flows, circular interventions and Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) across dairy cattle, pigs, poultry and small ruminants, and grades the evidence behind each link. A decomposition of meta-analytic data indicates that HS raises the impact per kg of milk by approximately 3–12% during heat-stress periods, mainly through non-feed burdens. Monte Carlo analysis shows that the direction of this effect is robust, whereas its magnitude depends mainly on the feed share of the total burden. A Heat-Stress Circularity Index (HSCI) is operationalized with explicit metrics, normalization bounds, a geometric aggregation rule and a minimum-welfare gate. A worked example shows that system rankings depend on the aggregation rule, and a pilot application to a commercial Mediterranean pig farm shows that heat-season piglet and weaner mortality triggers the welfare gate despite moderate productivity retention. Evidence is strong for physiological responses but absent for LCA under measured heat stress; five falsifiable hypotheses, with the corresponding validation designs and sample sizes, are therefore proposed.
papers.abstract_zh: 氣候變遷下的熱緊迫（HS）限制了畜牧生產，並損害了動物健康、福祉、生產力與存活率。由於固定資源的使用分散在較少的產出上，熱緊迫同時也是一個系統層面的永續性問題。本篇敘事性文獻回顧基於對 PubMed、Web of Science 與 Scopus（2013–2026年）的標的性檢索，提出了一個串聯乳牛、豬隻、家禽與小型反芻動物之氣候暴露、動物反應、資源流向、循環介入措施與生命週期評估（LCA）的架構，並評定各個連結背後的證據等級。對統合分析數據的分解顯示，在熱緊迫期間，熱緊迫使每公斤乳品的環境衝擊提高了約 3–12%，主要係透過非飼料負擔所致。蒙地卡羅分析顯示，此效應的方向相當穩健，而其幅度則主要取決於飼料佔總負擔的比例。熱緊迫循環性指數（HSCI）透過明確的指標、常態化界限、幾何聚合規則與最低福利閥值來具體實施。一個實例示範表明，系統排名取決於聚合規則；而對地中海地區某商業養豬場的試點應用則顯示，熱季時仔豬與保育豬的死亡率觸發了福利閥值，儘管其生產力保持在moderate（中等）水準。生理反應的證據相當扎實，但在實測熱緊迫下的 LCA 證據則有所欠缺；因此，本文提出了五個可否證的假設，並附帶相應的驗證設計與樣本大小。

papers.title: Content of Manganese and Molybdenum in Selected Tissues and Organs of Mallards (Anas platyrhynchos L.) in Relation to Their Sex and Harvest Location
papers.abstract: The aim of this study was to analyze the manganese and molybdenum content in selected tissues of mallard ducks (Anas platyrhynchos L.) depending on their location of collection and gender. The study was conducted on material obtained from mallard ducks from two study areas: the Siedlce hunting district and the Leszno hunting district. The research material consisted of breast muscles, leg muscles, and liver obtained from 28 mallards. The samples were frozen and stored at −20 °C. The material was analysed for manganese and molybdenum using inductively coupled argon plasma atomic emission spectroscopy (ICP OES), with a Perkin Elmer Optima 2000 DV spectrometer (Shelton, WA, USA). Manganese levels were significantly higher in mallards harvested in the Siedlce hunting district than in those from the Leszno hunting district. The pattern was reversed for molybdenum, which was present in higher concentrations in the tissues of mallards from the Leszno hunting district, although these were not statistically significant differences. Among the muscles and organs tested, the highest levels of manganese and molybdenum were shown in the liver. The level of molybdenum in the liver was significantly higher in male mallards than in females. An effect of the birds’ origin on manganese content and of sex on molybdenum content in mallard tissues was observed.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在分析綠頭鴨（*Anas platyrhynchos* L.）特定組織中的錳和鉬含量，並探討其與採集地點和性別的關係。本研究之實驗材料取自兩個研究區域的綠頭鴨：謝德爾采（Siedlce）狩獵區與萊什諾（Leszno）狩獵區。研究材料包含取自 28 隻綠頭鴨的胸肌、腿肌和肝臟。樣品經冷凍並保存於 −20 °C。使用感應耦合電漿原子發射光譜法（ICP OES），搭配 Perkin Elmer Optima 2000 DV 光譜儀（美國華盛頓州謝爾頓），分析材料中的錳和鉬含量。謝德爾采狩獵區捕獲的綠頭鴨，其錳濃度顯著高於萊什諾狩獵區的綠頭鴨。鉬則呈現相反的模式，萊什諾狩獵區綠頭鴨組織中的鉬濃度較高，儘管這些差異未達統計顯著性。在所測試的肌肉與器官中，錳和鉬的最高含量皆出現在肝臟中。雄性綠頭鴨肝臟中的鉬含量顯著高於雌性。研究觀察到鳥類的來源對綠頭鴨組織中的錳含量有影響，而性別則對鉬含量有影響。

papers.title: A Lightweight Deep Learning Approach for Real-Time Detection of Egg-Laying Behavior and Hatching Eggs in Breeding Ducks
papers.abstract: Egg production rate and laying behavior are important indicators of reproductive performance in breeding ducks. Manual monitoring is time-consuming and labor-intensive, and litter, small eggs, variable postures, and occlusion complicate detection. This study proposed DPG-YOLO to detect egg-laying behavior and hatching eggs. Based on YOLO26, the DE-C3K2 module was reconstructed to enhance fine-grained feature extraction. PPA was incorporated to strengthen multi-scale semantic modeling, and C3Ghost was adopted to optimize neck feature fusion and reduce redundant computation. DPG-YOLO achieved precision, recall, and mAP50 values of 96.8%, 96.3%, and 97.4%, respectively, exceeding YOLO26 by 4.6, 4.8, and 5.0 percentage points.
