The model required 7.6 GFLOPs, occupied 7.1 MB, and processed 124.1 frames/s. Automatically estimated egg production rate and laying behavior frequency were significantly and positively correlated with manually calculated values (rs = 0.987 and 0.964, p < 0.05). Neither indicator differed significantly between the two methods (p > 0.05). Thus, DPG-YOLO combines detection accuracy, real-time performance, and statistical reliability to support automated monitoring of reproductive performance, precision feeding management, and digitalization of breeding duck production.
papers.abstract_zh: 產蛋率與產蛋行為是種鴨繁殖性能的重要指標。人工監測耗時費力，且墊料、小蛋、多變的姿態及遮擋等因素使檢測更加複雜。本研究提出 DPG-YOLO 以檢測產蛋行為與種蛋。基於 YOLO26，重建了 DE-C3K2 模組以增強細粒度特徵萃取；納入 PPA 以強化多尺度語意建模；並採用 C3Ghost 來優化頸部特徵融合並減少冗餘計算。DPG-YOLO 的準確率、召回率和 mAP50 分別達到 96.8%、96.3% 和 97.4%，較 YOLO26 分別提升了 4.6、4.8 和 5.0 個百分點。該模型需要 7.6 GFLOPs 的運算量，佔用 7.1 MB 的記憶體，處理速度為 124.1 格/秒 (frames/s)。自動估算的產蛋率與產蛋行為頻率與人工計算值呈顯著正相關（rs 分別為 0.987 與 0.964，p < 0.05）。兩種方法的這兩項指標均無顯著差異（p > 0.05）。因此，DPG-YOLO 兼具檢測準確度、即時性能與統計可靠性，可支援繁殖性能的自動化監測、精準飼養管理以及種鴨生產的數位化。

papers.title: Bacteriophage applications in the poultry industry: from current practices to next-generation technologies
papers.abstract: SUMMARYThe poultry industry faces mounting pressure to maintain flock health and food safety while reducing reliance on antimicrobial agents. Bacteriophages, naturally occurring viruses that selectively lyse bacteria, offer a targeted intervention that can be deployed across every stage of the poultry production chain, from hatchery biosecurity to retail product preservation. This review adopts a translational, production-chain framework to evaluate the current status and industrial readiness of phage-based technologies at each stage, synthesising efficacy data against the four principal poultry pathogens (Salmonella enterica, Campylobacter jejuni, Clostridium perfringens, and avian pathogenic Escherichia coli). We map the specific regulatory approvals and commercial products already deployed in poultry processing, and analyse the practical barriers to broader on-farm adoption, including formulation stability, dose optimisation, and quality standardisation, and present emerging solutions grounded in encapsulation science and phage biobank infrastructure. Looking beyond current practices, we introduce two convergent technologies with transformative potential for poultry-specific applications: avian intestinal organoid platforms as physiologically relevant systems for phage screening and host–pathogen–phage interaction studies, and the translation of engineered bacteriophage concepts to the avian gut environment for precision pathogen management. A research roadmap organised by short-, medium-, and long-term milestones charts the transition from empirical phage therapy towards integrated precision phage management in poultry production.
papers.abstract_zh:
摘要
家禽產業正面臨日益增加的壓力，需在減少對抗菌劑依賴的同時維持禽群健康與食品安全。噬菌體是一類會選擇性裂解細菌的天然病毒，能提供具標靶性的介入措施，並可部署於家禽生產鏈的每一個階段，從孵化場生物安全到零售產品保存皆然。本篇綜論採用轉譯與生產鏈的架構，評估噬菌體相關技術在各階段的現狀與工業化就緒度，並綜合針對四大家禽主要病原菌（沙門氏桿菌 [Salmonella enterica]、空腸彎曲桿菌 [Campylobacter jejuni]、產氣莢膜梭菌 [Clostridium perfringens] 及禽病原性大腸桿菌 [avian pathogenic Escherichia coli]）的效力數據。我們勾勒出已在家禽加工中部署的特定法規核準與商業產品，分析更廣泛應用於農場時面臨的實際障礙（包括製劑穩定性、劑量最佳化及品質標準化），並提出奠基於微膠囊包覆科學與噬菌體生物庫基礎設施的新興解決方案。放眼當前實務之外，我們介紹了兩項對家禽專屬應用具有轉化潛力的收斂技術：作為噬菌體篩選及宿主-病原體-噬菌體交互作用研究之生理相關系統的禽類腸道類器官平台，以及將基因工程噬菌體概念轉化應用於禽類腸道環境以進行精準病原體管理的技術。一份由短期、中期與長期里程碑所組織的研究路線圖，勾勒出從經驗式噬菌體療法轉向家禽生產中整合性精準噬菌體管理的過渡進程。

papers.title: Comprehensive Genetic Characterization of Salmonella enterica Serovar Gallinarum Biovar Gallinarum from the Poultry Industry in South Korea
papers.abstract: Salmonella enterica subsp. enterica serovar Gallinarum biovar Gallinarum (SG) causes fowl typhoid, an important poultry disease, but the genetic diversity and phylogenetic relationships among Korean SG isolates remain insufficiently investigated. We analyzed 26 Korean SG isolates collected between 2002 and 2026 and compared them with 57 publicly available SG genomes from other countries using whole-genome sequencing. Using a cutoff of 100 core-genome single-nucleotide polymorphisms, 83 isolates were classified into eight clusters and ten singletons, with all Korean isolates assigned to the same cluster. Five sequence types (ST78, ST331, ST13540, ST14504, ST14529) were identified. ST78 was predominant, whereas ST14504 and ST14529 were identified exclusively among Korean isolates. Bayesian phylogenetic analysis estimated the time to the most recent common ancestor of the Korean isolates to be approximately 1990. Genomic analyses revealed differences in Salmonella pathogenicity islands, virulence genes, plasmid replicons, antimicrobial resistance genes, and quinolone resistance-determining region mutations. A resistance profile comprising aac(3)-VIa, aadA1, sul1, and qacEΔ1 was observed exclusively in 12 Korean isolates; of these, eleven harbored only the IncFII(S) plasmid replicon, and IncX1 was also detected in one isolate, together with blaTEM-1B and tet(A). These findings provide valuable genomic and epidemiological insights into SG and may contribute to improved control of fowl typhoid.
papers.abstract_zh: 沙門氏腸道菌腸道亞種雞傷寒血清型雞傷寒生物型（Salmonella enterica subsp. enterica serovar Gallinarum biovar Gallinarum, SG）會引起家禽傷寒，這是一種重要的家禽疾病，然而韓國 SG 分離株之間的基因多樣性與親緣關係仍未獲得充分研究。我們分析了 2002 年至 2026 年間收集的 26 株韓國 SG 分離株，並透過全基因體定序，將其與來自其他國家的 57 個公開 SG 基因體進行比較。以 100 個核心基因體單核苷酸多型性作為分群閾值，83 株分離株被歸類為 8 個群集和 10 個單獨株，所有韓國分離株皆被分配至同一群集。共識別出 5 種序列型（ST78、ST331、ST13540、ST14504、ST14529）。ST78 為優勢型別，而 ST14504 和 ST14529 則僅在韓國分離株中發現。貝氏親緣關係分析估計韓國分離株之最近共同祖先時間約為 1990 年。基因體分析揭示了沙門氏菌致病島、毒力基因、質體複製子、抗生素抗藥性基因以及喹諾酮抗藥性決定區突變的差異。僅在 12 株韓國分離株中觀察到包含 *aac(3)-VIa*、*aadA1*、*sul1* 和 *qacEΔ1* 的抗藥性譜；其中，11 株僅帶有 IncFII(S) 質體複製子，另有一株除上述外還檢測到 IncX1，以及 *blaTEM-1B* 和 *tet(A)*。這些發現為 SG 提供了寶貴的基因體與流行病學見解，並可能助益於改善家禽傷寒的控制。

papers.title: Assessing the predictive potential of the Holstein bovine sperm methylome for bull fertility using machine learning
papers.abstract: Background Bull fertility is a key parameter in the dairy cattle industry, with significant economic implications. DNA methylation is an epigenetic mark essential for fertility, and recent works have highlighted sperm DNA methylation as a promising source of biomarkers for male fertility, but no operational tool has been developed for predicting bull fertility based on DNA methylation. Here, we leveraged existing methylation data to evaluate the potential of DNA methylation for predicting bull fertility with machine learning models. Results Our study was conducted on a cohort of 351 Holstein commercial bulls, classified as subfertile, neutral and fertile based on a field fertility index (non-return rate of the inseminated cows after 56 days post-insemination). This dataset includes the largest cohort assembled for bull fertility prediction from epigenetic markers. We developed classification models to discriminate subfertile and fertile individuals using a subset of predictors derived from reduced representation bisulfite sequencing data obtained on frozen semen. Four machine learning algorithms were compared: Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator (LASSO), Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, and Neural Networks. To optimize performances of each algorithm and conduct an unbiased assessment of classification accuracy, we used a three-fold cross-validation before final testing on an independent test set. To increase the robustness of the results, model performances were averaged over 20 partitions of the data into training and test sets, to account for variability in bull distribution across sets. All models performed better than random classification. The best model was LASSO according to classification accuracy (0.62) and Random Forest according to Area Under Curve (0.69) computed with the independent test set. Conclusions Even with this moderate performance, our models would lead to a 12.4% point increase of the probability of identifying subfertile individuals. These results suggest that sperm DNA methylation holds potential as a relevant source of predictive markers for bull fertility.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：公牛生育力是乳牛產業中的關鍵參數，具有顯著的經濟影響。DNA甲基化是攸關生育力的一種表觀遺傳標記，近期研究指出，精子DNA甲基化是作為雄性生育力生物標記的極具潛力來源，但目前尚未開發出基於DNA甲基化來預測公牛生育力的實用工具。在此，我們利用現有的甲基化數據，透過機器學習模型評估了DNA甲基化在預測公牛生育力方面的潛力。結果：本研究針對由351頭荷仕坦（Holstein）商用公牛組成的世代進行，這些公牛根據田間生育力指數（人工授精後56天的母牛未回歸受孕率）被分類為亞生育力（subfertile）、中等（neutral）及具生育力（fertile）。此資料集包含了為基於表觀遺傳標記預測公牛生育力而組合出的最大世代。我們利用從冷凍精液獲得的減表徵亞硫酸氫鹽定序（RRBS）數據中衍生出的預測變數子集，開發了用以區分亞生育力與具生育力個體的分類模型。比較了四種機器學習演算法：最小絕對收縮和選擇算子（LASSO）、隨機森林（Random Forest）、梯度提升（Gradient Boosting）和類神經網路（Neural Networks）。為了優化各演算法的效能並對分類準確度進行無偏見的評估，我們在獨立測試集進行最終測試前，使用了三折交叉驗證。為了增加結果的穩健性，模型效能透過資料劃分為訓練集和測試集的20次分割進行平均，以考量公牛在各組分佈中的變異性。所有模型的表現皆優於隨機分類。根據獨立測試集計算的結果，以分類準確度（0.62）來看表現最好的是LASSO模型，而以曲線下面積（AUC，0.69）來看表現最好的是隨機森林模型。結論：即便有此中等的效能，我們的模型仍能將識別出亞生育力個體的機率提高12.4個百分點。這些結果表明，精子DNA甲基化具有作為公牛生育力預測標記之相關來源的潛力。

papers.title: Dietary Medium-Chain Fatty Acids and Chicken Breast Meat Quality: Comparing Crude Palm Kernel Oil and Its Fatty Acid Distillation By-Product
papers.abstract: This study aimed to evaluate the effect of replacing conventional dietary fat sources with crude palm kernel oil (PKO) or its by-product, palm kernel fatty acid distillate (PKFAD), on breast meat quality in female broiler chickens. Birds were fed diets containing 4% added fat during the starter phase and 6% during the finisher phase, using soybean oil (SO) during the starter phase and palm oil (PO) during the finisher phase as the control diet, whereas the experimental diets contained PKO or PKFAD. Fresh and refrigerated (commercial conditions; 7 days) chicken breast samples were assessed for pH, drip loss, cooking loss, and texture profile analysis (TPA). After refrigeration, using PKFAD led to meat with lower chewiness than when using SO-PO. Refrigeration decreased cohesiveness, with no differences among dietary treatments. Other quality parameters were not altered. For these reasons, the PKFAD and PKO used in this study are interesting fat sources for broiler feeds when seeking fat and by-product alternatives to conventional ones to contribute to the sustainability of the food chain.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在評估以粗棕櫚仁油（PKO）或其副產物棕櫚仁脂肪酸餾出物（PKFAD）取代傳統日糧脂肪來源，對雌性肉雞胸肉品質的影響。試驗雞隻在前期階段餵食添加 4% 脂肪的日糧，後期階段則餵食添加 6% 脂肪的日糧；對照組在前期使用大豆油（SO），後期使用棕櫚油（PO），而實驗組則含有 PKO 或 PKFAD。針對新鮮及冷藏（商業條件下；7 天）的雞胸肉樣本進行 pH 值、滴水損失、蒸煮損失及質地剖面分析（TPA）。冷藏後，使用 PKFAD 的肉品其咀嚼性低於使用 SO-PO 者。冷藏會降低內聚性，但各日糧處理組之間無顯著差異。其他品質參數則不受影響。綜上所述，本研究中使用的 PKFAD 和 PKO 是肉雞飼料中有潛力的脂肪來源，當尋求替代傳統脂肪及副產物以促進食物鏈永續性時，可作為一項選擇。

papers.title: Different Formulations and Concentrations of Sweet Chestnut Tannins Differentially Modulate Gut Microbiota in Broiler Chickens
papers.abstract: Sweet chestnut tannins (SCT) are used as phytogenic feed additives in poultry, but the effects of different formulations and concentrations on intestinal microbiota remain poorly understood. This study investigated powdered, soy protein-bound, microencapsulated and orthophosphoric acid-bound SCT at different dietary concentrations in sixty Ross 308 broilers, with six birds per group, including an unsupplemented control. Ileal and caecal microbiota were characterized using 16S rRNA gene sequencing. In the ileum, richness, phylogenetic diversity and beta diversity differed among treatments, whereas Shannon diversity and evenness remained unchanged. Lactobacillaceae remained dominant, and no significant family- or genus-level differences relative to the control remained after multiple-testing correction. In the caecum, all assessed alpha- and beta-diversity metrics differed among treatments, with numerous treatment-specific taxonomic changes. Several treatments increased the Firmicutes/Bacteroidota ratio, while Muribaculaceae decreased across most supplemented groups. Soy protein-bound SCT at 1000 mg/kg increased Parabacteroides and Odoribacter, whereas microencapsulated SCT at 1000 mg/kg increased Romboutsia and Peptostreptococcaceae. The genus Fournierella increased with soy protein-bound SCT at 2000 mg/kg. Responses were not consistently dose-dependent. These findings indicate that SCT-associated microbial changes vary with intestinal compartment, formulation and concentration, with broader responses detected in the caecum. Their implications for bird health and performance require further investigation.
papers.abstract_zh: 甜栗單寧（sweet chestnut tannins, SCT）常作為家禽的植物性飼料添加劑，然而不同劑型與濃度對腸道微生物相的影響仍所知有限。本研究探討將粉末狀、大豆蛋白結合型、微膠囊化及正磷酸結合型之SCT以不同日糧濃度添加於六十隻羅斯308（Ross 308）肉雞中（每組六隻，含未添加之對照組）。利用16S rRNA基因定序分析迴腸與盲腸的微生物相。在迴腸中，豐富度、親緣多樣性及貝塔多樣性（beta diversity）在各處理間有所差異，而香農多樣性（Shannon diversity）與均勻度則維持不變。乳桿菌科（Lactobacillaceae）仍佔優勢，且經多重檢定校正後，科或屬層級相較於對照組並無顯著差異。在盲腸中，所有評估的阿爾發（alpha）及貝塔多樣性指標在各處理間皆有差異，並伴隨許多處理特異性的分類群變動。數個處理提高了厚壁菌門與擬桿菌門的比值（Firmicutes/Bacteroidota ratio），而多數添加組的鼠桿菌科（Muribaculaceae）則下降。添加 1000 mg/kg 的大豆蛋白結合型 SCT 增加了副擬桿菌屬（Parabacteroides）與臭氣桿菌屬（Odoribacter），而添加 1000 mg/kg 的微膠囊化 SCT 則增加了隆布氏菌屬（Romboutsia）與消化鏈球菌科（Peptostreptococcaceae）。添加 2000 mg/kg 的大豆蛋白結合型 SCT 會使福尼爾氏菌屬（Fournierella）增加。反應並非一致呈現劑量依賴性。這些發現表明，SCT 相關的微生物變動隨腸道區室、劑型與濃度而異，且在盲腸中偵測到較廣泛的反應。其對家禽健康與生產性能的影響尚需進一步探討。

papers.title: Incomplete Protection by Maternally Derived Antibody Against H9N2 Low-Pathogenic Avian Influenza in Commercial Broiler Chickens
papers.abstract: H9N2 low-pathogenic avian influenza remains endemic in Korean poultry production, where commercial broilers rely largely on maternally derived antibodies (MDA) transferred from vaccinated breeder hens. This study quantified MDA transfer and decay and evaluated protection against homologous Y280-lineage H9N2 challenge. Paired sera were collected from breeder hens and day-old progeny on six commercial farms. MDA decay was monitored in 90 broilers from 1 to 22 days of age, and 32 birds with individual HI titers of 0, 2, 4, or 6 log2 were challenged intranasally at 7 days of age. Transfer efficiency averaged 18.2 ± 11.5%, and MDA had an estimated half-life of 3.2 days. Clinical signs occurred in 8/8, 8/8, 7/8, and 0/8 birds in the MDA 0, 2, 4, and 6 groups, respectively. Cecal tonsil virus detection decreased from 87.5% in the MDA 0 group to 37.5% in the MDA 6 group, although the pairwise difference was not statistically significant (p = 0.119). Oropharyngeal shedding occurred in all challenged birds at comparable titers. These findings suggest that higher MDA levels are associated with reduced clinical disease and lower cecal tonsil virus detection but do not prevent oropharyngeal shedding under the conditions tested.
papers.abstract_zh: H9N2低病原性禽流感在韓國家禽業中仍然呈地方性流行，當地的商業肉雞主要依賴從接種疫苗的種母雞所轉移的母源抗體（MDA）。本研究量化了母源抗體的轉移與衰退，並評估了對同源Y280譜系H9N2攻擊的保護效力。從6個商業場採集種母雞及其一日齡後代的配對血清。監測了90隻1至22日齡肉雞的母源抗體衰退情況，並對32隻個別血球凝集抑制（HI）效價為0、2、4或6 log2的肉雞於7日齡時進行鼻腔攻擊。抗體轉移效率平均為18.2 ± 11.5%，母源抗體的估計半衰期為3.2天。MDA 0、2、4和6組中分別有8/8、8/8、7/8和0/8隻鳥出現臨床症狀。盲腸扁桃體的病毒檢出率從MDA 0組的87.5%下降至MDA 6組的37.5%，儘管兩兩比較無統計學顯著差異（p = 0.119）。所有受攻擊的肉雞皆發生口咽排毒，且效價相當。這些發現表明，在所測試的條件下，較高的母源抗體水平與減輕臨床疾病及降低盲腸扁桃體病毒檢出率有關，但無法預防口咽排毒。

papers.title: Effect of Necrotic Enteritis on Breast Meat Quality, Muscle Development and Gene Expression in Broilers
papers.abstract: While the detrimental impacts of necrotic enteritis (NE) on poultry health and growth are well documented, its consequences on final meat quality are poorly understood. This research evaluated how a clinical NE infection alters the physicochemical and molecular properties of broiler breast meat. Two hundred and forty one-day-old Ross 708 male chicks were divided into an unchallenged control (CON) and an NE-infected group (6 replicate pens per treatment; 20 birds/pen). To induce disease, the NE cohort received a 10× coccidiosis vaccine at 14 days of age and was subsequently inoculated with Clostridium perfringens (~2.8 × 108 CFU/mL) on day 19, while CON birds received sterile fluid thioglycolate medium. At day 40, Pectoralis major samples were collected (n = 6 per group) to analyze physical characteristics, chemical composition, muscle histomorphology, and target gene expression. The disease challenge noticeably deteriorated key sensory traits, resulting in higher cooking loss and greater puncture force (p < 0.01), which points to diminished water-holding capacity and tougher meat. Furthermore, breast fillets from infected birds showed lower L* values (p < 0.05), indicating a darker color, while a* and b* values remained unchanged. Interestingly, macroscopic variables such as proximate composition, ultimate pH, and muscle fiber morphology did not differ significantly between treatments (p > 0.05). At the molecular level, NE upregulated the mRNA abundance of several targets related to myogenesis, fiber characteristics, proteolysis, and energy metabolism (MyoD, MYH1, MYH7, CAST, CAPN1, PHKG1, and PRKAA1; p < 0.05). Correlation matrices highlighted strong links between diminished physical meat quality and the expression of MYH1, CAPN1, and PRKAA1, with MYH1 specifically associated with both moisture loss and firmness. Ultimately, a clinical C. perfringens infection compromises more than live-bird performance; it fundamentally degrades the technological attributes of harvested meat, suggesting the financial toll of this enteric disease includes depreciation of end-product market value.
papers.abstract_zh: 雖然壞死性腸炎（necrotic enteritis, NE）對家禽健康與生長的負面影響已有許多文獻記錄，但其對最終肉品品質的影響卻所知有限。本研究評估了臨床型壞死性腸炎感染如何改變肉雞胸肉的物理化學及分子特性。將 240 隻一日齡 Ross 708 雄性雛雞隨機分為未受攻擊對照組（CON）及 NE 感染組（每處理 6 個重複欄位；每欄 20 隻雞）。為誘導疾病，NE 組於 14 日齡時接受 10 倍劑量的球蟲疫苗，隨後於 19 日齡接種產氣莢膜梭菌（*Clostridium perfringens*，約 $2.8 \times 10^8\text{ CFU/mL}$），而 CON 組則給予無菌硫乙醇酸鹽流體培養基。於 40 日齡收集胸大肌（*Pectoralis major*）樣本（每組 $n = 6$），以分析物理特性、化學組成、肌肉組織形態及標的基因表現。疾病攻擊顯著惡化了關鍵的感官特徵，導致較高的蒸煮損失與較大的穿刺力（$p < 0.01$），這指出保水能力降低且肉質變硬。此外，感染組的雞胸肉顯示出較低的 $L^*$ 值（$p < 0.05$），表示顏色較深，而 $a^*$ 和 $b^*$ 值則保持不變。有趣的是，諸如一般成分、最終 pH 值以及肌肉纖維形態等巨觀變數在各處理間沒有顯著差異（$p > 0.05$）。在分子層面上，NE 上調了數個與肌生長、纖維特性、蛋白質水解和能量代謝相關標的的 mRNA 豐度（MyoD、MYH1、MYH7、CAST、CAPN1、PHKG1 和 PRKAA1；$p < 0.05$）。相關性矩陣凸顯了降低的物理肉品品質與 MYH1、CAPN1 和 PRKAA1 表現之間的強烈關聯，其中 MYH1 特別與水分流失和緊實度相關。最終，臨床型產氣莢膜梭菌感染損害的不僅是活雞性能；它從根本上退化了所獲取肉品的加工工藝屬性，這表明此種腸道疾病的財務損失包括了最終產品市場價值的貶值。

papers.title: Correction: Genetic parameters via predictivity in large populations under strong genomic selection
Greenhouse Gas Emissions from Large-Scale Dairy Farms: Interannual Dynamics, Farm-Level Heterogeneity, and Key Determinants
papers.abstract: The transition to low-emission (LE) dairy production is essential for mitigating agricultural greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. However, the interannual variability and principal drivers of farm-level GHG footprints across intensive dairy farms remain insufficiently characterized, constraining targeted mitigation strategies. This study aimed to (i) quantify interannual variation in on-farm GHG emission intensity, (ii) characterize management contrasts between high- and low-emission farms, (iii) clarify the underlying mechanisms, and (iv) identify optimization pathways. A supplementary sensitivity analysis encompassing upstream emissions associated with feed production was performed using an expanded system boundary to assess the effects of system boundary selection on the estimated GHG emissions. Using 3-year (2021–2023) field data from 22 intensive dairy farms, a standardized farm-level GHG inventory was used to quantify operational GHG emission intensity per unit of fat- and protein-corrected milk (FPCM). The production-weighted mean on-farm operational GHG intensity was 0.86 kg CO2-eq kg−1 FPCM, with enteric methane constituting the dominant emission source. Incorporating upstream emissions associated with feed production contributed an additional 0.427 kg CO2-eq kg−1 FPCM, yielding a total emission intensity of 1.287 kg CO2-eq kg−1 FPCM under the expanded system boundary, representing a 49.7% increase relative to the operational inventory. Feed upstream emissions accounted for 33.2% of the total emissions estimated within the expanded system boundary. Both herd size and energy consumption exhibited increasing trends throughout the study period, whereas the proportion of lactating cows relating to the total herd declined from 46.01% in 2021 to 44.32% in 2023, suggesting that the expansion of the overall herd exceeded the corresponding growth in the lactating cow population. Under the operational system boundary, high-emission (HE) farms exhibited relatively greater contributions to their GHG emission profiles from enteric methane production, electricity consumption, and manure management activities. Conversely, LE farms attained improved performance through higher proportions of lactating cows, greater feed efficiency, and manure anaerobic digestion. Correlation analysis linked herd size, energy consumption, and dry matter intake positively to on-farm GHG emissions. Dietary starch was associated with manure N2O emissions, while feed efficiency was associated with higher energy-related GHG emissions. Overall, herd composition, feeding management practices, energy utilization, and manure management strategies were identified as principal determinants of on-farm GHG emission performance. Furthermore, the sensitivity analysis employing an expanded system boundary demonstrated that incorporating upstream emissions associated with feed production substantially elevates the overall GHG emission intensity expressed per kg FPCM. This study helps address the lack of multi-year farm-level evidence for China’s dairy sector and proposes integrated strategies—herd structure adjustment, precision feeding, clean energy exploitation, and manure management—alongside sustained long-term monitoring, given the pronounced interannual variability. These findings highlight the roles of farm-level GHG inventories in identifying targeted on-farm emission mitigation opportunities and expanded system boundary assessments in quantifying the overall GHG burden associated with the entire dairy production supply chain.
papers.abstract_zh: 轉型至低碳排放（LE）乳牛生產對於減緩農業溫室氣體（GHG）排放至關重要。然而，集約化乳牛場在場級溫室氣體足跡上的年際變異與主要驅動因素仍未得到充分闡明，從而限制了針對性減緩策略的制定。本研究旨在 (i) 量化場內溫室氣體排放強度的年際變異，(ii) 探討高排放與低排放牧場之間的管理差異，(iii) 釐清其潛在機制，以及 (iv) 識別優化途徑。本研究透過擴展系統邊界，進行了一項包含飼料生產相關上游排放的補充敏感度分析，以評估系統邊界選擇對估算溫室氣體排放的影響。基於 22 個集約化乳牛場為期 3 年（2021–2023 年）的實地數據，利用標準化的場級溫室氣體盤查方法，量化了每單位乳脂與乳蛋白校正乳（FPCM）的營運性溫室氣體排放強度。產量加權的場內營運溫室氣體平均強度為 0.86 kg CO2-eq kg−1 FPCM，其中腸道發酵產生的甲烷為主要的排放源。納入飼料生產相關的上游排放後，額外增加了 0.427 kg CO2-eq kg−1 FPCM，在擴展系統邊界下總排放強度達到 1.287 kg CO2-eq kg−1 FPCM，相較於營運盤查增加了 49.7%。飼料上游排放佔擴展系統邊界下總估算排放量的 33.2%。在研究期間，牛群規模與能源消耗均呈上升趨勢，而泌乳牛佔總牛群的比例則從 2021 年的 46.01% 下降至 2023 年的 44.32%，這表明整體牛群的擴張速度超過了泌乳牛群的相應增長。在營運系統邊界下，高排放（HE）牧場在其溫室氣體排放結構中，來自腸道甲烷產生、電力消耗和糞尿管理的貢獻相對較高。相反地，低排放牧場透過提高泌乳牛比例、提高飼料效率以及採用糞尿厭氧消化技術，實現了更佳的環境表現。相關性分析表明，牛群規模、能源消耗和乾物質攝取量與場內溫室氣體排放呈正相關。日糧澱粉與糞尿 N2O 排放有關，而飼料效率則與較高的能源相關溫室氣體排放有關。總體而言，牛群組成、飼養管理實務、能源利用和糞尿管理策略被確定為影響場內溫室氣體排放表現的主要決定因素。此外，採用擴展系統邊界的敏感度分析表明，納入飼料生產相關的上游排放會顯著提高以每公斤 FPCM 計算的整體溫室氣體排放強度。本研究有助於填補中國乳業缺乏多年期場級實證數據的空白，並考慮到明顯的年際變異，提出了整合性策略——包括牛群結構調整、精準飼養、清潔能源開發以及糞尿管理，同時強調需進行持續的長期監測。這些研究結果突顯了場級溫室氣體盤查在識別場內針對性減排機會方面的作用，以及擴展系統邊界評估在量化與整個乳品生產供應鏈相關的整體溫室氣體負擔方面的重要性。

papers.title: Beyond the Transcriptome: The m 6 A Epitranscriptome in Bovine Mastitis
papers.abstract: Bovine mastitis is a heterogeneous inflammatory disease that compromises milk production, animal welfare and dairy sustainability. Despite extensive transcriptomic and epigenomic research, a PubMed search completed in September 2026 identified only 12 primary studies addressing epitranscriptomic regulation in bovine mastitis, representing approximately 0.1% of indexed publications. This review critically evaluates N 6 ‐methyladenosine (m 6 A), the most extensively studied RNA modification in bovine mastitis, its regulatory machinery and effects on mammary immunity, while identifying m 5 C and A‐to‐I editing as priorities for mechanistic investigation. Current evidence identifies transcript‐specific RNA stability as the best‐supported mechanism and provides a foundation for investigating m 6 A‐dependent translation. Functional studies of ALKBH5– LOC4191 , YTHDF2– IER3 , YTHDF2‐associated CCL20 and CCL5 regulation, m 6 A‐regulated LncRNA7825 and FTO– FN1 demonstrate that m 6 A reshapes inflammatory signalling, mitochondrial stress, epithelial‐barrier integrity, cell survival and bacterial control. Synthesizing these findings, we propose a context‐dependent RNA‐fate checkpoint model in which biological effects depend on the modified transcript, effector protein, pathogen, cellular context and infection phase. The FTO– FN1 axis shows that bacterial control and tissue protection can diverge, establishing them as complementary outcomes. Future studies should test whether m 6 A provides an early post‐transcriptional response layer and whether pathogens manipulate it, using time‐resolved multi‐omics, nucleotide‐specific perturbation, primary cells, mammary organoids and longitudinal cattle samples. Parallel profiling of non‐m 6 A modifications should define interacting regulatory layers. These approaches should establish causal modification sites, resolve pathogen‐specific regulation, connect molecular mechanisms with disease trajectories, and support validated milk‐based biomarkers, mammary‐targeted interventions and prioritization of stable genetic variants for breeding mastitis‐resistant cattle.
papers.abstract_zh: 牛乳房炎是一種異質性發炎疾病，會危害產乳量、動物福祉及乳業永續性。儘管已有廣泛的轉錄體學與表觀基因體學研究，截至 2026 年 9 月完成的 PubMed 檢索顯示，僅有 12 項探討牛乳房炎表觀轉錄體調控的原創研究，約佔索引文獻的 0.1%。本篇綜論批判性地評估了 $N^6$-甲基腺苷（$m^6A$）——牛乳房炎中研究最廣泛的 RNA 修飾、其調控機制及對乳房免疫的影響，同時將 $m^5C$ 及 A-to-I 編輯界定為機制研究的優先方向。現有證據顯示，轉錄本特異性 RNA 穩定性是獲得最多支持的機制，並為探討 $m^6A$ 依賴性轉譯奠定了基礎。ALKBH5–LOC4191、YTHDF2–IER3、YTHDF2 相關的 CCL20 與 CCL5 調控、$m^6A$ 調控的 LncRNA7825 以及 FTO–FN1 的功能研究表明，$m^6A$ 會重塑發炎訊息傳遞、粒線體壓力、上皮屏障完整性、細胞存活與細菌控制。綜合這些發現，我們提出了「情境依賴的 RNA 命運檢查點模型」，在此模型中，生物學效應取決於受修飾的轉錄本、效應蛋白、病原體、細胞情境及感染階段。FTO–FN1 軸顯示細菌控制與組織保護可能會分歧，確立了它們作為互補結果的地位。未來研究應利用時間解析多體學、核苷酸特異性擾動、原代細胞、乳房類器官及縱向牛隻樣本，來檢驗 $m^6A$ 是否提供早期的轉錄後反應層級，以及病原體是否对其进行操控。非 $m^6A$ 修飾的平行分析應能界定相互作用的調控層級。這些方法應當確立具因果關係的修飾位點、解析病原體特異性調控、將分子機制與疾病病程相連結，並支援經過驗證的乳汁生物標記、標靶乳房的介入措施，以及優先選育具抗乳房炎特性牛隻的穩定遺傳變異。

papers.title: Study on the Effects of Dandelion Ultrafine Powder on the Production Performance and Intestinal Microbiota of Broiler Chickens
papers.abstract: This study aimed to investigate the effects of dietary supplementation with dandelion superfine powder (DSFP) on the growth performance, organ indices, intestinal length, antioxidant parameters, cecal microbiota and economic benefits of broilers, so as to determine its optimal dosage. A total of 240 one-day-old ROSS broilers were randomly allocated into four groups fed basal diets supplemented with 0%, 0.5%, 1% and 3% DSFP, respectively. The results showed that medium-dose (1%) DSFP significantly increased the overall ADG and average daily feed intake, elevated duodenal length, and improved serum GSH-Px activity of broilers. Microbiological analysis revealed that 1% DSFP was associated with changes in the cecal microbiota structure and tended to increase the relative abundance of Firmicutes and potential short-chain fatty acid-producing bacteria. Economically, the medium-dose group achieved the highest gross profit per broiler. In conclusion, dietary supplementation with 1% DSFP can effectively improve growth performance and was associated with favorable changes in certain intestinal microbial indicators, leading to superior economic benefits, and it represents the appropriate dosage for broiler production.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討飼糧中添加蒲公英超微粉（DSFP）對肉雞生長性能、臟器指數、腸道長度、抗氧化指標、盲腸微生物菌群及經濟效益的影響，以確定其最適添加劑量。試驗選取240隻一日齡ROSS肉雞，隨機分為4組，分別飼喂添加0%、0.5%、1%和3% DSFP的基礎飼糧。結果顯示，中劑量（1%）DSFP顯著提高了肉雞的全期平均日增重和平均日採食量，增加了十二指腸長度，並改善了血清GSH-Px活性。微生物分析顯示，1% DSFP組的盲腸微生物菌群結構發生改變，並有增加厚壁菌門及潛在短鏈脂肪酸產生菌相對豐度的趨勢。在經濟效益方面，中劑量組獲得了每隻肉雞最高的毛利。綜上所述，飼糧中添加1% DSFP能有效改善生長性能，並與某些腸道微生物指標的良好改變相關，從而帶來更佳的經濟效益，是肉雞生產中的適宜添加劑量。

papers.title: An Enhanced Genomic Transformer for Multi-Dataset Forward-Validation Benchmarking in Pig Genomic Prediction
papers.abstract: Genomic prediction models in pig breeding should forecast the performance of future selection candidates, yet random cross-validation does not accurately reflect this sequential setting. Here, we introduce an enhanced genomic transformer (EGT) that compresses genome-wide SNP profiles into compact tokens and incorporates a differentiable scoring term alongside mean squared error (MSE) during training. We constructed 70%/10%/20% forward-validation datasets for three pig datasets and evaluated single-trait and multi-task EGT variants against GBLUP, support-vector regression, random forest, XGBoost, CNN, and RNN across 12 prediction tasks. The better-performing EGT variant achieved a higher test-set Pearson correlation coefficient (PCC) than the baseline for 10 of the 12 prediction tasks, with the largest improvement on LDL-C (+0.057). In BloodLipid ablations, autoencoder-only representation yielded the highest mean PCC (0.285), while Pearson–MSE objective reached 0.293 versus 0.291 for MSE-only training. Integrated-gradient analysis revealed a recurrent candidate region on Sus scrofa chromosome 13 across three lipid traits, and masking the top-attributed features reduced predictive performance more than a marker-count-matched random control for HDL-C, LDL-C and TG, whereas masking increased test-set PCC for TCHOL. This work establishes forward-validation benchmarks across three pig datasets and reports results to inform model selection and region prioritization in pig breeding.
papers.abstract_zh: 豬隻育種中的基因體預測模型應預測未來選拔候選者的性能，然而隨機交叉驗證並無法準確反映這種序列設定。在此，我們引入了一種增強型基因體變壓器（enhanced genomic transformer, EGT），它將全基因體 SNP 特徵壓縮成緊湊的符號（tokens），並在訓練過程中結合了可微分的評分項與均方誤差（MSE）。我們針對三個豬隻資料集構建了 70%/10%/20% 的前向驗證資料集，並在 12 項預測任務中評估了單特質與多任務 EGT 變體與 GBLUP、支援向量迴歸、隨機森林、XGBoost、CNN 和 RNN 的表現。表現較佳的 EGT 變體在 12 項預測任務中的 10 項上，其測試集皮爾森相關係數（PCC）高於基準模型，其中以 LDL-C 的改善幅度最大（+0.057）。在 BloodLipid 消融實驗中，僅使用自動編碼器的表示法產生了最高的平均 PCC（0.285），而皮爾森-MSE 目標函數達到了 0.293，相較之下僅使用 MSE 訓練則為 0.291。整合梯度（integrated-gradient）分析揭示了在三個血脂特質中，位於豬隻第 13 號染色體（Sus scrofa chromosome 13）上的一個重複出現的候選區域；對於 HDL-C、LDL-C 和 TG 而言，遮蔽歸因評分最高的特徵比隨機控制（標記數量匹配）更能降低預測效能，而遮蔽則提高了 TCHOL 的測試集 PCC。這項工作建立了跨三個豬隻資料集的前向驗證基準，並報告相關結果以提供豬隻育種中的模型選擇與區域優先排序之參考。

papers.title: Estimation of Genomic Breeding Values for Economic Traits in Alxa-Type Cashmere Goats Using Bayesian Methods
papers.abstract: Conventional breeding has a long generation interval; genomic selection can enable early selection and shorten the breeding process in cashmere goats. This study aimed to estimate genomic breeding values for economic traits in Inner Mongolia (Alxa-type) cashmere goats using Bayesian methods. Whole-genome resequencing at 1× depth was performed on 491 Alxa-type cashmere goats (40 males and 451 females), and genotypes were imputed to 10× using a reference panel with an average imputation accuracy of 97.90%. Fixed effects were determined by analysis of variance, and breeding values for body weight, cashmere fiber diameter, and cashmere yield were estimated using Bayes A, Bayes B, and Bayes C; prediction accuracy and unbiasedness were evaluated by five-fold cross-validation. Measurement year and group affected all three traits highly significantly (p < 0.01); sex affected body weight and cashmere yield highly significantly (p < 0.01) but no significant effect on cashmere fiber diameter (p > 0.05); and maternal age had a significant effect on body weight (p < 0.05), but no significant effect on cashmere fiber diameter or cashmere yield (p > 0.05); group had a highly significant effect on all three traits (p < 0.01). Breeding values were estimated using Bayes A, Bayes B, and Bayes C, with five-fold cross-validation, and the three methods performed comparably overall in this population.
papers.abstract_zh: 傳統育種的世代間隔較長，而基因體選擇能實現早期選擇，並縮短喀什米爾羊的育種進程。本研究旨在利用貝氏方法評估內蒙古（阿拉善型）喀什米爾羊經濟性狀的基因體育種值。本研究對491隻阿拉善型喀什米爾羊（40隻公羊和451隻母羊）進行1倍深度的高通量全基因組定序，並利用參考群體將基因型填充至10倍深度，平均填充準確度達97.90%。透過變異數分析確定固定效應，並使用Bayes A、Bayes B和Bayes C方法評估體重、喀什米爾絨纖維直徑和產絨量的育種值；透過五折交叉驗證評估預測準確度與無偏性。測定期與群體對這三個性狀均有極顯著影響（p < 0.01）；性別對體重與產絨量有極顯著影響（p < 0.01），但對喀什米爾絨纖維直徑無顯著影響（p > 0.05）；母齡對體重有顯著影響（p < 0.05），但對喀什米爾絨纖維直徑與產絨量無顯著影響（p > 0.05）；群體對這三個性狀皆有極顯著影響（p < 0.01）。使用Bayes A、Bayes B和Bayes C方法進行育種值估計並結合五折交叉驗證，結果顯示這三種方法在此群體中的整體表現相當。

papers.title: Influence of dehydrated orange pomace inclusion and β-glucanase and xylanase supplementation on performance, egg quality and physiological responses of Japanese quails
papers.abstract: 1. This study evaluated the effects of replacing 10% of the maize in the diet with dehydrated orange pomace (DOP) in Japanese quail. Treatments included supplementation with β-glucanase and xylanase. Data included productive performance, nutrient digestibility, egg quality, serum biochemical profile, pancreatic characteristics and gastrointestinal tract biometry.2. A total of 144 female Japanese quails (Coturnix coturnix japonica) were used, arranged in a completely randomised design with a 2 × 2 factorial layout, consisting of two levels of DOP inclusion (0% and 10%) and two levels of enzyme supplementation (without and with β-glucanase and xylanase), with six replicates and six birds per experimental unit. The experiment lasted 84 d, divided into three experimental cycles of 28 d each. Data were subjected to analysis of variance and means were compared using Tukey’s test at a 5% significance level.3. Supplementation with β-glucanase and xylanase improved feed conversion for egg mass (FCRegg) and increased the nitrogen retention and ether extract digestibility coefficients. The inclusion of 10% DOP increased egg mass, laying percentage and commercial viability, in addition to reducing serum cholesterol concentrations. No negative effects were observed for feed intake, egg quality, pancreatic parameters or development of major gastrointestinal tract organs.4. Under the conditions evaluated in this study, inclusion of 10% DOP showed potential as an alternative feed ingredient for Japanese quail. Supplementation with β-glucanase and xylanase improved aspects of FCRegg and nutrient utilisation.
authors: L. F. Diniz Aniceto e Silva
papers.abstract_zh:
1. 本研究評估了在日本鶉飼糧中以脫水柑橘渣（dehydrated orange pomace, DOP）取代 10% 玉米的效果。處理組包含添加 β-葡聚糖酶與木聚糖酶。數據包括生產性能、營養分消化率、雞蛋品質、血清生化學特性、胰臟特徵與胃腸道生物測定。

2. 本試驗使用共 144 隻雌性日本鶉（Coturnix coturnix japonica），採完全隨機設計之 2 × 2 因子排列，包含兩個 DOP 添加水準（0% 與 10%）及兩個酵素添加水準（無與添加 β-葡聚糖酶和木聚糖酶），設有六個重複，每個試驗單位六隻鳥。試驗持續 84 天，分為三個每期 28 天的試驗週期。數據經變異數分析，並以顯著水準 5% 的 Tukey 檢定比較平均數。

3. 添加 β-葡聚糖酶與木聚糖酶改善了產蛋重飼料轉換率（FCRegg），並增加了氮滯留率與乙醚抽出物消化率係數。添加 10% DOP 提高了產蛋重、產蛋率與商業可行性，同時降低了血清膽固醇濃度。飼料攝取量、雞蛋品質、胰臟參數或主要胃腸道器官發育皆未觀察到負面影響。

4. 在本研究評估的條件下，添加 10% DOP 顯示出作為日本鶉替代飼料原料的潛力。添加 β-葡聚糖酶與木聚糖酶改善了 FCRegg 的部分表現與營養分利用率。

papers.title: Scenario of Housing and Environmental Conditions of Poultry Production: A Scientometric Analysis of Trends, Challenges, and Innovations
papers.abstract: Poultry production faces increasing challenges that directly affect animal welfare, productivity, and the sustainability of production systems. This review aimed to map the international scientific literature on housing systems for broilers and laying hens from 2014 to 2024, identifying research trends, knowledge gaps, and the main topics investigated in recent years. A total of 141 articles indexed in the Scopus and Web of Science databases were analyzed using the bibliometrix package in RStudio version 2026.08.2+200. The results revealed a significant increase in the number of publications from 2020 onward, with the United States, Brazil, and Germany emerging as the leading contributing countries. Research focused on topics such as heat stress, animal welfare, environmental control, building materials, and biosecurity. The analysis of scientific collaboration networks revealed a predominance of international publications and limited international collaboration, particularly in Brazil. Overall, the findings highlight the growing need for interdisciplinary and technology-oriented research aimed at increasing poultry productivity, thereby promoting sustainability, animal welfare, and production efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 家禽生產正面臨日益嚴峻的挑戰，這些挑戰直接影響動物福利、生產力及生產系統的永續性。本篇文獻綜述旨在對 2014 年至 2024 年間關於肉雞與蛋雞飼養系統的國際科學文獻進行圖譜分析，以識別近年來的研究趨勢、知識缺口及主要探討主題。本研究透過 RStudio 2026.08.2+200 版本中的 bibliometrix 套件，分析了收錄於 Scopus 和 Web of Science 資料庫中的總計 141 篇文獻。結果顯示，2020 年以後的出版品數量顯著增加，其中美國、巴西和德國成為主要的貢獻國家。研究焦點集中於熱緊迫、動物福利、環境控制、建築材料及生物安全等主題。科學合作網絡的分析顯示，國際發表佔多數，但跨國合作相對有限，特別是在巴西。總體而言，這些發現突顯了對跨學科和技術導向研究日益增長的需求，旨在提升家禽生產力，進而促進永續性、動物福利與生產效率。

papers.title: Genetic and regulatory architecture of meat yield traits in commercial pig populations
papers.abstract: Background Lean meat percentage (LMP), longissimus muscle area (LMA), and longissimus muscle depth (LMD) are critical carcass traits that directly impact meat yield and the economic efficiency of swine production. Although genome-wide association studies (GWAS) have identified numerous loci associated with these traits, the functional characterization of candidate quantitative trait loci (QTLs) and their regulatory mechanisms is still limited and poses significant challenges. Here, we conducted GWAS in 4593 pigs from three commercial populations (Yorkshire, Landrace and Duroc) to identify loci associated with LMP, LMA and LMD. We further integrated integrative chromatin accessibility, histone modifications, chromatin interaction information, and dual-luciferase reporter assays to identify candidate QTLs with potential regulatory functions. Candidate genes were subsequently prioritized using single-nucleus RNA sequencing, Phenome-wide association analysis, and Mendelian randomization. Results This multi-layered approach prioritized candidate regulatory QTLs associated with LMP, LMA and LMD, and identified high-confidence candidate genes potentially involved in the regulation of meat yield traits. For LMP, WWOX and ABL1 showed the strongest evidence in Yorkshire and Landrace population, respectively. For LMA, PHB1 and BAZ2A showed the strongest evidence in the Yorkshire and combined-population, respectively. SLC16A7 was specifically associated with both LMP and LMA in Landrace. For LMD, ENSSSCG00000045482 and RSPO4 showed the strongest evidence in Yorkshire pigs, while XPO4 was identified in the combined-population analysis. These genes may influence muscle metabolic homeostasis, muscle proliferation, hypertrophy, and atrophy through interactions with myogenic transcription factors and key signaling pathways such as PPAR-RXR and Wnt/β-catenin. Conclusions These findings provide new insights into the genetic and regulatory basis of meat yield traits in pigs and highlight candidate regulatory QTLs and genes for future functional validation and precision breeding applications aimed at improving pork yield.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：瘦肉率（Lean meat percentage, LMP）、背最長肌面積（longissimus muscle area, LMA）與背最長肌深度（longissimus muscle depth, LMD）是直接影響豬肉產量與養豬經濟效益的關鍵屠體性徵。儘管全基因體關聯分析（GWAS）已識別出許多與這些性徵相關的基因座，但候選數量性狀基因座（QTL）的功能表徵及其調控機制仍相當有限，且面臨重大挑戰。在本研究中，我們對來自三個商業品種（約克夏豬、藍瑞斯豬與杜洛克豬）共 4,593 頭豬隻進行了 GWAS，以識別與 LMP、LMA 和 LMD 相關的基因座。我們進一步整合染色質開放性、組織蛋白修飾、染色質交互作用資訊以及雙螢光素酶報導基因檢測，以識別具有潛在調控功能的候選 QTL。隨後，利用單核細胞核 RNA 定序、全表型關聯分析與孟德爾隨機化分析對候選基因進行優先順序排序。結果：這種多層次的方法對與 LMP、LMA 和 LMD 相關的候選調控 QTL 進行了優先排序，並識別出可能參與肉品產量性徵調控的高信心候選基因。在 LMP 方面，WWOX 與 ABL1 分別在約克夏與藍瑞斯族群中展現最強的證據力。在 LMA 方面，PHB1 與 BAZ2A 分別在約克夏與合併族群中展現最強的證據力。SLC16A7 則專一性地與藍瑞斯豬的 LMP 和 LMA 皆相關。在 LMD 方面，ENSSSCG00000045482 與 RSPO4 在約克夏豬中展現最強的證據力，而 XPO4 則是在合併族群分析中被識別。這些基因可能透過與生肌轉錄因子及關鍵訊號傳遞路徑（如 PPAR-RXR 與 Wnt/β-catenin）的交互作用，影響肌肉代謝恆定、肌肉增生、肥大與萎縮。結論：這些發現為豬隻肉品產量性徵的基因與調控基礎提供了新的見解，並突顯出可用於未來功能驗證及旨在提升豬肉產量的精準育種應用的候選調控 QTL 與基因。

papers.title: Pluchea dioscoridis (Barnûf) as a potential phytogenic feed additive in poultry nutrition: current evidence, mechanisms, and research gaps
papers.abstract: SUMMARYPluchea dioscoridis (L.) DC. commonly known as Barnûf, is a phytochemically diverse medicinal plant distributed mainly in North Africa and the Middle East. This review evaluates its potential relevance to poultry nutrition while distinguishing direct evidence for P. dioscoridis from evidence obtained with other Pluchea species, particularly P. indica. Available studies indicate that P. dioscoridis contains phenolic acids, flavonoids, terpenoids, and other bioactive constituents and exhibits antioxidant, antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and hepatoprotective activities in experimental systems. Direct evidence in poultry remains limited, and several reported poultry responses, including effects on growth performance and blood variables, derive from studies of P. indica rather than P. dioscoridis. Evidence for poultry gut-microbiota modulation and intestinal barrier effects is currently insufficient to establish efficacy. Non-poultry studies provide mechanistic hypotheses concerning antioxidant, inflammatory, metabolic, and tissue-protective pathways but should not be interpreted as evidence of poultry efficacy. Overall, Barnûf represents a promising but insufficiently validated phytogenic candidate for poultry nutrition. Future research should prioritize authenticated plant material, standardized extraction procedures, dose-response studies, controlled poultry trials, gut microbiota characterisation, molecular mechanistic analyses, and comprehensive safety assessment.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要：Pluchea dioscoridis (L.) DC. 通稱為 Barnûf，是一種具備豐富植物化學多樣性的藥用植物，主要分佈於北非和中東地區。本篇文獻回顧評估其在家禽營養中的潛在應用價值，同時區分針對 P. dioscoridis 的直接證據與其他香妃草屬（Pluchea）物種（特別是印度香妃草 P. indica）所獲得的證據。現有研究顯示，P. dioscoridis 含有酚酸、類黃酮、萜類及其他生物活性成分，並在實驗系統中展現抗氧化、抗菌、抗發炎及保肝活性。家禽的直接證據仍然有限，且數項關於家禽反應的報導（包含對生長性能與血液變數的影響）是源自對 P. indica 而非 P. dioscoridis 的研究。目前關於調節家禽腸道菌相與腸道屏障效應的證據尚不足以確立其效用。非家禽研究提供了關於抗氧化、發炎、代謝及組織保護途徑的機制假說，但不應被解釋為家禽效用的證據。總體而言，Barnûf 作為家禽營養中的植物源飼料添加物潛力備受期待，但尚未獲得充分驗證。未來研究應優先聚焦於經身分鑑定的植物原料、標準化萃取程序、劑量反應研究、對照家禽試驗、腸道菌相特性分析、分子機制分析以及全面的安全性評估。

papers.title: First Isolation, Genomic Characterization and Experimental Infection of Bovine Coronavirus from Sheep
papers.abstract: Bovine coronavirus (BCoV) is an important pathogen of cattle and has also been detected in several non-bovine ruminants. Although BCoV infection has been reported in sheep, virus isolation and genomic characterization from this host have not been described. In this study, two BCoV isolates were successfully recovered from fecal samples of sheep during an outbreak involving enteric and respiratory signs in Qinghai Province, China. Nearly complete genomes of the two isolates were obtained and were 100% identical to each other across the complete coding regions. Comparative genomic analysis showed that the complete coding regions of the sheep-derived isolates shared 100% nucleotide identity with a previously reported yak-derived BCoV strain, Yak/SWUN/NF2/2022 (OR603986). Phylogenetic analyses based on complete coding regions, S gene, and HE gene sequences showed that the sheep-derived isolates clustered with yak-derived BCoV strains previously identified in Qinghai Province, suggesting that closely related BCoV lineages may circulate among different ruminant hosts in the Qinghai–Tibet Plateau. Experimental infection provided evidence that the representative sheep-derived isolate was capable of establishing infection in sheep, as evidenced by viral RNA detection, seroconversion, and virus re-isolation from lung tissue. To our knowledge, this study represents the first successful isolation and genomic characterization of BCoV from sheep and provides new insights into the host range, genetic diversity, and potential distribution of closely related BCoV lineages among high-altitude ruminants.
papers.abstract_zh: 牛冠狀病毒（BCoV）是牛隻的重要病原體，亦曾在數種非牛類反芻動物中被檢測出。儘管綿羊感染 BCoV 的案例曾被報導，但尚未有來自該宿主的病毒分離與基因體特徵描述之相關記錄。在本研究中，中國青海省發生一起涉及腸道與呼吸道症狀的疫情期間，自綿羊糞便樣本中成功分離出兩株 BCoV。研究獲得了這兩株分離株的近完整基因體，其完整編碼區彼此具有 100% 的相同性。比較基因體學分析顯示，綿羊源分離株的完整編碼區與先前報導的一株氂牛源 BCoV 毒株 Yak/SWUN/NF2/2022（OR603986）具有 100% 的核苷酸相同性。基於完整編碼區、S 基因與 HE 基因序列的親緣關係分析顯示，綿羊源分離株與先前在青海省鑑定出的氂牛源 BCoV 毒株聚類在一起，這暗示了高度相關的 BCoV 譜系可能在青海高原的不同反芻動物宿主間循環傳播。動物實驗感染提供了證據，表明具代表性的綿羊源分離株能夠在綿羊體內建立感染，這可由病毒 RNA 檢測、血清轉換以及從肺組織中重新分離出病毒獲得證明。據我們所知，本研究代表了首次成功自綿羊中分離出 BCoV 並進行基因體特徵分析，為高海拔反芻動物中高度相關 BCoV 譜系的宿主範圍、基因多樣性及潛在分布提供了新的見解。

papers.title: Evaluation of Bacteriophage vB_SalS_KY05 Lysate on Physiological Status, Egg Production, and Intestinal Microbiota in Laying Hens
papers.abstract: Bacteriophage vB_SalS_KY05 (KY05) was propagated using a non-pathogenic E. coli K-12 strain. The lysate was administered via water for 56 days. Thirty Lohmann Brown-Classic laying hens (53 weeks old) were randomly assigned to three groups: the Control group (without phage lysate), the Low-Phage group (105 PFU/mL) and the High-Phage group (108 PFU/mL). This study aimed to evaluate the safety profile of the administered KY05 lysate by assessing its endotoxin content and its effects on immune responses and gut microbiota in laying hens. Phage lysate did not adversely affect physiological status, laying performance, plasma biochemical parameters, intestinal morphology, or inflammatory cytokine concentrations when compared with the results for the Control group, supporting the physiological safety of KY05 lysate in laying hens. Fecal Lactobacillus counts were not affected, while fecal E. coli counts showed a slight, although not statistically significant, decrease in the phage-treated groups. In cecal 16S rRNA analysis, microbial composition did not differ significantly among treatments. These findings support the safety of prolonged KY05 lysate administration under the experimental conditions used in this study and warrant further evaluation under field conditions.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究使用非致病性大腸桿菌 K-12 株來增殖沙門氏菌噬菌體 vB_SalS_KY05 (KY05)。將此裂解液透過飲水投予，為期 56 天。將 30 隻 53 週齡的羅曼棕經典產蛋雞隨機分為三組：對照組（無噬菌體裂解液）、低劑量噬菌體組（10⁵ PFU/mL）與高劑量噬菌體組（10⁸ PFU/mL）。本研究旨在透過評估 KY05 裂解液的內毒素含量及其對產蛋雞免疫反應與腸道微生物相的影響，來評估所投予 KY05 裂解液的安全性。與對照組的結果相比，噬菌體裂解液並未對生理狀態、產蛋性能、血漿生化參數、腸道形態或發炎性細胞激素濃度產生不良影響，支持了 KY05 裂解液在產蛋雞體內的生理安全性。糞便中的乳酸菌數量未受影響，而噬菌體處理組的糞便大腸桿菌數量則呈現微幅下降，但未達統計顯著差異。在盲腸 16S rRNA 分析中，各處理間的微生物組成無顯著差異。這些發現支持了在本研究使用的實驗條件下長期投予 KY05 裂解液的安全性，並有待在田間條件下進行進一步評估。

papers.title: Agonistic Behavior and Energy Metabolic Responses of Eriocheir sinensis Under Thermal Stress with Insights from Untargeted Metabolomics
papers.abstract: The Chinese mitten crab (Eriocheir sinensis) is an important freshwater aquaculture species in China, but high summer temperatures may disrupt its behavioral patterns and energy metabolism. In this study, male E. sinensis were maintained at 25 °C or 35 °C, and behavioral tracking, histological observation, biochemical assays, RT-qPCR, and untargeted metabolomics were combined to investigate the effects of thermal stress on swimming and aggressive behaviors and their associated metabolic responses. For swimming behavior, compared with 25 °C, crabs at 35 °C showed decreases in total moving distance, average speed, and the proportions of slow, medium, and fast-speed movement, together with a significant increase in inactive time (p < 0.05). For agonistic behavior, compared with 25 °C, both the overall proportion of agonistic intensity and the proportion of strong fighting decreased significantly at 35 °C (p < 0.05). According to agonistic behavior data, the crabs were classified as winners or losers, generating four groups: T25W, T25L, T35W, and T35L. Non-contact behaviors decreased significantly in both winners and losers, whereas contact behaviors also decreased significantly in winners (p < 0.05). Histopathological analysis revealed that, at 35 °C, E. sinensis exhibited disorganized muscle fibers and structural damage to the gills, including swelling of the distal lamellar tips and morphological abnormalities in epithelial and pillar cells. With respect to energy metabolism, muscle glycogen in winners was significantly higher than that in losers at both temperatures, whereas haemolymph lactate concentrations were significantly higher in winners only at 25 °C. Haemolymph glucose concentrations were significantly higher in winners at 25 °C but in losers at 35 °C (p < 0.05). Compared with 25 °C, exposure to 35 °C significantly decreased muscle succinate dehydrogenase (SDH) activity in both winners and losers and increased gill citrate synthase (CS) activity in winners. In losers, muscle pyruvate kinase (PK) activity decreased nonsignificantly; lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) activity increased (p < 0.05). Under 35 °C conditions, significant upregulation of AMPK, Sestrin, and SIRT1 expression and significant downregulation of mTOR expression (except in losers’ muscle) were exhibited in both muscle and gill tissues (p < 0.05). Untargeted metabolomics identified 297, 301, 484, and 393 differential metabolites in comparisons in T25W vs. T25L, T35W vs. T35L, T35W vs. T25W, and T35L vs. T25L, respectively. These differential metabolites were mainly associated with amino acid, nucleotide, and lipid metabolism, aminoacyl-tRNA biosynthesis, ABC transporters, and neuroactive ligand–receptor interaction. Collectively, acute exposure to 35 °C suppressed swimming and agonistic behavior, with this behavioral inhibition being associated with tissue damage and regulation of energy metabolism. This study provides candidate indicators and a scientific basis for the early assessment and monitoring of thermal stress in E. sinensis aquaculture.
papers.abstract_zh: 中華絨螯蟹（*Eriocheir sinensis*）是中國重要的淡水水產養殖物種，然而夏季的高溫可能會干擾其行為模式與能量代謝。在本研究中，雄性中華絨螯蟹分別飼養於 25 °C 或 35 °C 下，結合行為追蹤、組織學觀察、生化分析、RT-qPCR 及非標靶代謝體學，以探討熱緊迫對其游泳與攻擊行為及相關代謝反應的影響。在游泳行為方面，與 25 °C 相比，35 °C 下的螃蟹之總移動距離、平均速度以及慢速、中速和高速移動的比例均下降，且靜止時間顯著增加（p < 0.05）。在爭鬥行為方面，與 25 °C 相比，35 °C 下的爭鬥強度總體比例與激烈打鬥的比例均顯著下降（p < 0.05）。根據爭鬥行為數據，將螃蟹分為勝者與敗者，產生四個組別：T25W、T25L、T35W 和 T35L。無論是勝者或敗者，其非接觸性行為均顯著減少，而勝者的接觸性行為也顯著減少（p < 0.05）。組織病理學分析顯示，在 35 °C 下，中華絨螯蟹呈現肌肉纖維排列紊亂以及鰓部結構受損，包括遠端薄片尖端腫脹、上皮細胞與柱狀細胞形態異常。在能量代謝方面，在兩種溫度下，勝者的肌肉肝醣均顯著高於敗者，而血淋巴乳酸濃度僅在 25 °C 時勝者顯著較高。血淋巴葡萄糖濃度在 25 °C 時以勝者顯著較高，但在 35 °C 時則以敗者顯著較高（p < 0.05）。與 25 °C 相比，暴露於 35 °C 顯著降低了勝者與敗者的肌肉琥珀酸脫氫酶（SDH）活性，並增加了勝者的鰓檸檬酸合成酶（CS）活性。在敗者中，肌肉丙酮酸激酶（PK）活性無顯著下降；乳酸脫氫酶（LDH）活性增加（p < 0.05）。在 35 °C 條件下，肌肉和鰓組織中 AMPK、Sestrin 和 SIRT1 的表達均顯著上調，而 mTOR 的表達則顯著下調（敗者肌肉除外）（p < 0.05）。非標靶代謝體學在 T25W 對比 T25L、T35W 對比 T35L、T35W 對比 T25W 以及 T35L 對比 T25L 的比較中，分別鑑定出 297、301、484 和 393 個差異代謝物。這些差異代謝物主要與胺基酸、核苷酸及脂質代謝、胺基酰-tRNA 生合成、ABC 轉運蛋白以及神經活性配體-受體交互作用有關。綜上所述，急性暴露於 35 °C 會抑制游泳與爭鬥行為，此種行為抑制與組織損傷及能量代謝調節有關。本研究為中華絨螯蟹水產養殖中熱緊迫的早期評估與監測提供了候選指標與科學依據。

papers.title: RAPPORT: An Open-Source R Shiny Application for Breeding Program Management with Integrated Pedigree-Based Genetic Monitoring
papers.abstract: Managers of closed or semi-closed animal breeding programs must balance production targets with the preservation of genetic diversity, yet they often lack training in population genetics and access to integrated, user-friendly tools. RAPPORT (Relatedness Analysis and Population Planning, Organisation, Reporting and Tracking) is a freely available, open-source R Shiny application that combines pedigree-based genetic monitoring with operational breeding management in a single no-code interface. The application computes inbreeding coefficients and pairwise kinship, estimates rate of inbreeding (ΔF) and effective population size (Ne), and visualises inbreeding trends with forward projections. Production planning tools include dam scheduling, litter projections, and phenotype-integrated breeder selection with mean kinship ranking. Mating recommendations are filtered by a per-mating inbreeding increase threshold and user-defined health criteria. Pedigree and phenotypic data are uploaded in Excel format, and any user-defined traits are automatically incorporated into downstream analyses. Using a test case with anonymised data from a Belgian assistance dog breeding program (852 pedigree entries, 65 litters), the numerical correctness of RAPPORT’s pedigree-based genetic metrics was compared and confirmed against established R packages, and RAPPORT’s capacity to identify a production shortfall and support breeding decisions integrating genetic and phenotypic criteria was illustrated. RAPPORT makes population-level genetic management accessible to non-specialist breeding program managers.
papers.abstract_zh: 封閉或半封閉動物繁育計畫的管理人員必須在生產目標與遺傳多樣性的保存之間取得平衡，然而他們往往缺乏族群遺傳學的訓練，也缺乏整合且使用者友善的工具。RAPPORT（親緣關係分析與族群規劃、組織、報告與追蹤，Relatedness Analysis and Population Planning, Organisation, Reporting and Tracking）是一款免費的開源 R Shiny 應用程式，它在單一無程式碼介面中結合了基於譜系的遺傳監測與營運繁育管理。該應用程式可計算近親交配係數與成對親緣關係、估算近親交配速率（ΔF）與有效族群大小（Ne），並透過前瞻性預測視覺化近親交配趨勢。生產規劃工具包含母畜排程、產仔數預測，以及結合平均親緣關係排名的表型整合式種畜選擇。配對建議透過單次配對近親交配增加閾值與使用者定義的健康標準進行過濾。譜系與表型數據以 Excel 格式上傳，任何使用者定義的性狀都會自動納入後續分析中。透過使用來自比利時導盲犬繁育計畫之匿名數據的測試案例（852 筆譜系紀錄、65 窩），RAPPORT 基於譜系的遺傳指標之數值正確性已與既有的 R 套件進行對比並獲得確認，同時展示了 RAPPORT 識別生產不足以及支援整合遺傳與表型標準之繁育決策的能力。RAPPORT 使非專家的繁育計畫管理者也能進行族群層級的遺傳管理。

papers.title: Potential of autosomal crossover count to enhance additive genetic variance in pig breeding programs
papers.abstract: Background Crossovers can break the linkage between loci, thereby creating novel allele combinations and releasing genetic variation. However, empirical studies evaluating their potential use in livestock breeding programs remain scarce. In this study, we investigated the link between autosomal crossover count (ACC) and additive genetic variance for reproduction and production traits in pigs. Using univariate and bivariate sire models, individuals were grouped into five bins according to the number of paternal autosomal crossovers they inherited, as estimated in a previous study. Within each bin, sire additive genetic variance was estimated. The analysis included more than 50,000 records for total number born, number born alive, and number of stillborn piglets; over 14,000 records for number of teats; and more than 35,000 records for standardized average daily gain. Results For all traits, the 95% confidence interval of the overall estimated sire additive genetic variance overlapped with the estimates obtained for each ACC bin. Likewise, the 95% confidence interval for differences in $$\:{\widehat{\sigma\:}}_{a,sire}^{2}$$ between consecutive bins also overlapped in almost all cases. These results indicate that the observed number of crossovers did not significantly affect the $$\:{\widehat{\sigma\:}}_{a,sire}^{2}$$ . Nevertheless, trait-specific patterns were apparent. For three traits, the $$\:{\widehat{\sigma\:}}_{a,sire}^{2}$$ was highest at intermediate ACC ranges, whereas for the remaining traits it reached its maximum at either low or high ACC ranges. Despite the lack of statistically significant differences, the bins with the lowest and highest $$\:{\widehat{\sigma\:}}_{a,sire}^{2}$$ differed by an average of 57% across traits. Conclusions In conclusion, ACC may be of potential interest in breeding programs as a trait worth further investigation, although the present results do not provide significant evidence to support its direct use for the analyzed ACC ranges.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：交織（crossover）能打破基因座之間的連鎖，進而產生新穎的等位基因組合並釋放遺傳變異。然而，評估其在家畜育種計畫中潛在應用價值的實證研究仍然稀少。在本研究中，我們探討了豬隻體染色體交織次數（autosomal crossover count, ACC）與繁殖及生產性狀的加性遺傳變異之間的關聯。利用單變量與雙變量公畜模式，根據先前研究估算個體所繼承的父源體染色體交織數量，將個體分為五個區間（bins）。在每個區間內，估算公畜加性遺傳變異。本分析包含超過 50,000 筆總產仔數、活產仔數與死產仔數記錄；超過 14,000 筆乳頭數記錄；以及超過 35,000 筆標準化平均日增重記錄。結果：就所有性狀而言，整體估算公畜加性遺傳變異的 95% 信賴區間，與各 ACC 區間所獲得的估計值重疊。同樣地，連續區間之間 $$\:{\widehat{\sigma\:}}_{a,sire}^{2}$$ 差異的 95% 信賴區間在幾乎所有情況下也都有所重疊。這些結果顯示，觀察到的交織次數並未顯著影響 $$\:{\widehat{\sigma\:}}_{a,sire}^{2}$$。然而，具性狀特異性的模式仍然明顯。對於其中三個性狀，$$\:{\widehat{\sigma\:}}_{a,sire}^{2}$$ 在中等 ACC 範圍時最高，而對於其餘性狀，則在低或高 ACC 範圍時達到最大值。儘管缺乏統計上的顯著差異，但具有最低與最高 $$\:{\widehat{\sigma\:}}_{a,sire}^{2}$$ 的區間在各性狀間平均相差 57%。結論：總體而言，ACC 作為一個值得進一步研究的性狀，在育種計畫中可能具有潛在價值，儘管目前的結果並未提供顯著證據來支持其可直接應用於所分析的 ACC 範圍。

papers.title: Opportunities for creating a circular economy in the Australian poultry industry
papers.abstract: SUMMARYApproximately one third of the world’s food production is ultimately wasted. Current estimates suggest that the amount of land used to grow food that is wasted is greater than twice the landmass of Australia, and Australia itself wastes a landmass larger than the state of Victoria. With over 2 billion people suffering from food insecurity, an estimated world population of 9.7 billion by 2050, and ongoing detrimental environmental damage caused by industrialisation, there is ever increasing motivation to develop new and effective strategies to maximise efficiency in utilising the world’s available natural resources. In order to begin planning, an understanding of the present is required. Over the last 25 years, the idea of recycling food waste as animal feed on an industrial scale has become a focus for many researchers and agricultural industries. In particular, the poultry industry is well situated to take advantage, as it is an industry that already uses by-products and is intensive in nature and often integrated. A literature review was conducted to compare existing studies on the amount and value of wasted food and resources, the nutritional composition of various streams of food waste, and its potential application as poultry feed. This review explored global studies, ultimately focusing on an Australian context; a country in which poultry is the highest consumed protein source per capita. Many causes of food waste were identified, as well as several emerging strategies to combat this. While nutritional variability is a commonly noted issue, the consensus among researchers is that, depending on the source, food waste could feasibly be used to substitute conventional ingredients such as corn and soybean meal in poultry diets without production loss, with likely economic advantages.
papers.abstract_zh: 總結大約全球三分之一的糧食生產最終遭到浪費。目前的估計顯示，用於生產被浪費食物的土地面積大於澳洲本土面積的兩倍，而澳洲本身浪費的土地面積則比維多利亞州還要大。在超過 20 億人口面臨糧食不安全、預計到 2050 年世界人口將達到 97 億，以及工業化持續造成環境破壞的情況下，開發新且有效的策略以最大化利用全球可用自然資源的動機日益強烈。為了開始進行規劃，必須先對現狀有所理解。在過去 25 年中，以工業規模將廚餘回收作為動物飼料的理念已成為許多研究人員和農業產業的焦點。特別是，家禽產業非常適合從中受益，因為這是一個已經在使用副產品、具有集約化特點且通常呈垂直整合的產業。本研究進行了一項文獻回顧，旨在比較現有關於被浪費食物和資源的數量與價值、各類廚餘的營養成分，以及其作為家禽飼料之潛在應用的研究。本研究探討了全球性研究，並最終聚焦於澳洲本土的情境；在該國，家禽是每人平均消費量最高的蛋白質來源。本研究指出了浪費食物的許多原因，以及多種應對此問題的新興策略。儘管營養成分的變異性是一個經常被提及的問題，但研究人員的共識是，視來源而定，廚餘切實可用於替代家禽飼料中的傳統原料（如玉米和大豆粕），且不會造成生產損失，同時可能帶來經濟效益。

papers.title: Serum Corticosterone Concentrations and Granulocyte-to-Lymphocyte Ratios in Slaughter Geese Across Transport-Distance Categories: An Exploratory Descriptive Field Study
papers.abstract: Transport exposes poultry to multiple stressors. The declining number of slaughterhouses in the European Union can increase transport distances to slaughter facilities. Transport-related stress responses are documented in chickens and ducks but remain poorly characterized in geese. This exploratory descriptive field study characterized serum corticosterone (CORT) concentrations and the granulocyte-to-lymphocyte (G/L) ratio in pooled blood samples representing 292 slaughter geese from six flocks: one non-transported flock slaughtered on a farm and five commercial flocks transported 1–100, 101–200, 201–300, 301–400, or >400 km. Exploratory pool-level comparisons indicated overall differences in G/L ratios among the five evaluable flocks (p = 0.035), but no pairwise difference remained significant after Bonferroni adjustment. Corticosterone was lower in pooled serum samples from the non-transported flock than in those from the 1–100, 201–300, and >400 km flocks (p < 0.001). However, one flock and one journey per distance category prevented separation of distance effects from flock-, farm-, age- or journey-specific influences. These observations provide important descriptive field data but do not permit conclusions about an independent effect of transport distance. Studies with multiple independent flocks and journeys per distance category are required.
papers.abstract_zh: 運輸會使家禽面臨多種壓力源。歐盟屠宰場數量的減少可能會增加前往屠宰設施的運輸距離。與運輸相關的壓力反應在雞和鴨身上已有記錄，但在鵝身上則尚未得到充分的描述。這項探索性描述性現場研究描述了代表來自六個鵝群共 292 隻屠宰鵝之混合血液樣本中的血清皮質酮（CORT）濃度與嗜顆粒球與淋巴細胞比值（G/L 比值）：一個在農場屠宰的未運輸鵝群，以及五個分別運輸 1–100、101–200、201–300、301–400 或 >400 公里的商業鵝群。探索性的混合樣本層級比較顯示，五個可評估鵝群之間的 G/L 比值存在整體差異（p = 0.035），但在進行邦ferroni（Bonferroni）校正後，沒有任何成對差異達到顯著水準。未運輸鵝群混合血清樣本中的皮質酮低於 1–100、201–300 和 >400 公里鵝群的樣本（p < 0.001）。然而，每個距離類別僅有一個鵝群和一次運輸，使我們無法將距離效應與鵝群、農場、年齡或運輸特異性影響區分開來。這些觀察結果提供了重要的描述性現場數據，但無法得出關於運輸距離之獨立效應的結論。未來需要針對每個距離類別納入多個獨立鵝群和運輸次數的研究。

papers.title: Characterising the Yellow Muscle Phenotype of Common Carp by Muscle Carotenoids, Fatty Acid Composition and Multi-Omics Analysis
papers.abstract: Muscle color affects the market value of common carp (Cyprinus carpio), but the pigmentary and metabolic basis of the yellow muscle phenotype remains unclear. In this study, we compared muscle carotenoids, fatty acid profiles, and multi-omics data between wild yellow muscle (YC) and normal muscle (NC) common carp. YC showed significantly higher yellowness (b*) value, but there were no significant differences in the lightness (L*) and redness (a*) values. Total carotenoid was higher in YC and positively correlated with b*value. YC had higher saturated fatty acids (SFA) and n-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids (n-3 PUFA) proportions, including eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA) and docosahexaenoic acid (DHA), but lower n-6 and total PUFA, despite unchanged crude fat content. Total carotenoid content correlated with multiple fatty acids but not crude fat. Multi-omics analyses converged on glycerophospholipid metabolism, unsaturated fatty acid biosynthesis, and arachidonic acid metabolism, and cd36, scarb1, and bco2 were upregulated in YC muscle. In summary, these findings indicate that carotenoid accumulation underlies enhanced yellowness, while lipid remodeling and related transport processes may facilitate carotenoid retention in YC.
papers.abstract_zh: 肌肉顏色會影響鯉魚（Cyprinus carpio）的市場價值，然而黃色肌肉表型的色素與代謝基礎仍不清楚。在本研究中，我們比較了野生黃色肌肉（YC）與正常肌肉（NC）鯉魚的肌肉類胡蘿蔔素、脂肪酸組分以及多體學數據。YC顯示出顯著較高的黃色度（$b^*$）值，但在明度（$L^*$）和紅色度（$a^*$）值上則無顯著差異。總類胡蘿蔔素在YC中較高，且與$b^*$值呈正相關。儘管粗脂肪含量沒有改變，但YC具有較高的飽和脂肪酸（SFA）與n-3多元不飽和脂肪酸（n-3 PUFA）比例（包含二十碳五烯酸〔EPA〕與二十二碳六烯酸〔DHA〕），而n-6及總多元不飽和脂肪酸則較低。總類胡蘿蔔素含量與多種脂肪酸相關，但與粗脂肪無關。多體學分析聚焦於甘油磷脂代謝、不飽和脂肪酸生物合成及花生四烯酸代謝，且 $cd36$、$scarb1$ 和 $bco2$ 在 YC 肌肉中顯著上調。總括而言，這些發現表明類胡蘿蔔素的累積是增強黃色度的基礎，而脂質重塑及相關轉運過程則可能促進類胡蘿蔔素在 YC 中的滯留。

papers.title: The Effects of an Antimycotoxin Additive Based on Aluminosilicate and Marine Macroalgae in a Fumonisin-Contaminated Diet on the Performance and Health of Growing Lambs
papers.abstract: Fumonisins are important feed contaminants that can impair animal health and productive performance. This study evaluated whether the inclusion of an antimycotoxin additive based on aluminosilicate and marine macroalgae could mitigate the adverse effects of dietary fumonisin in growing lambs. Thirty-two male Lacaune lambs were assigned to four groups (n = 8): control, control + additive, fumonisin, and fumonisin + additive. The additive was included at 3 kg/t of feed, and fumonisin was provided at 33 ppm. The experimental period lasted 42 days. Productive performance, serum biochemical parameters, oxidative status, and hematological variables were evaluated throughout the experiment. Fumonisin exposure impaired performance from days 15 to 42, reducing body weight gain, average daily gain, and feed efficiency and increasing feed conversion ratio, without affecting dry matter intake. Fumonisin also increased serum creatine kinase activity and altered cholesterol, gamma-glutamyl transferase, and aspartate aminotransferase, along with increasing thiobarbituric acid reactive substances and oxidant-related fluorescence. Time-dependent alterations were also observed in urea, ferritin, and hematological variables. Inclusion of the additive partially attenuated several fumonisin-associated responses, with Fumonisin + additive lambs showing performance and health-related variables closer to those of Control animals for several outcomes. Dietary fumonisin at 33.9 ppm adversely affected productive performance and was associated with biochemical, oxidative, and hematological alterations in growing lambs. Inclusion of the aluminosilicate- and marine macroalgae-based additive partially attenuated these responses, indicating potential for mitigating the biological consequences of fumonisin exposure, although complete protection was not achieved.
papers.abstract_zh: 伏馬毒素是重要的飼料汙染物，會損害動物健康與生產性能。本研究評估添加以鋁矽酸鹽及海洋大型藻類為基底的抗黴菌毒素添加劑，是否能減緩飼料中伏馬毒素對生長期綿羊的不良影響。將三十二隻公拉科訥綿羊隨機分派至四組（n = 8）：對照組、對照組 + 添加劑、伏馬毒素組，以及伏馬毒素 + 添加劑組。添加劑的添加量為每噸飼料 3 公斤，伏馬毒素的提供量為 33 ppm。試驗期持續 42 天。試驗期間評估了生產性能、血清生化參數、氧化狀態及血液學變數。伏馬毒素暴露在第 15 至 42 天損害了生產性能，降低了體重增量、平均日增重及飼料效率，並增加了飼料轉換率，但未影響乾物質攝取量。伏馬毒素亦增加了血清肌酸激酶活性，並改變了膽固醇、伽瑪-麩胺醯基轉移酶及天門冬胺酸轉胺酶，同時增加硫代巴比妥酸反應物質與氧化物相關螢光。尿素、鐵蛋白及血液學變數也觀察到時間依賴性的改變。添加該添加劑部分減緩了數項與伏馬毒素相關的反應，在多項指標上，伏馬毒素 + 添加劑組綿羊的生產性能及健康相關變數更接近對照組動物。飲食中含有 33.9 ppm 的伏馬毒素會對生長期綿羊的生產性能造成不良影響，並伴隨生化、氧化及血液學的改變。添加基於鋁矽酸鹽與海洋大型藻類的添加劑可部分減緩這些反應，顯示其具有減輕伏馬毒素暴露生物學後果的潛力，儘管未能達到完全保護。

papers.title: Effects of light, sound, vibration, and odour stimuli on incubation performance and chick quality in broilers and layers: a systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.abstract: SUMMARYArtificial incubation is a critical stage in poultry production, and recent studies have explored the effects of non-conventional environmental stimuli such as light, sound, vibration, and odour on embryonic development and chick quality. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to evaluate the effects of these stimuli on incubation performance and chick quality in broiler and layers. Using the PICO framework, literature searches were conducted in Scopus, Web of Science, and PubMed, following PRISMA guidelines. A total of 48 studies were included: 42 on light, five on sound, one on vibration, and none on odour. All statistical analyses were performed using JAMOVI 2.5.6. In broilers, intermittent light exposure (12 h light:12 h dark) and warm-coloured light improved hatchability and chick quality (p 0.05). The single study on vibration was insufficient for statistical evaluation, and no studies addressing odour were identified. Overall, the findings indicate that appropriately applied light and sound stimuli may improve incubation outcomes, although the available evidence remains limited and heterogeneous. Further research is needed to standardise environmental stimuli protocols, evaluate their application on a larger scale, and determine their economic feasibility for the poultry industry.
papers.abstract_zh:
摘要
人工孵化是家禽生產中的關鍵階段，近期研究探討了光照、聲音、震動和氣味等非傳統環境刺激對胚胎發育與雛鳥品質的影響。本系統性文獻回顧與統合分析旨在評估這些刺激對肉雞與蛋雞之孵化表現及雛鳥品質的影響。本研究遵循PRISMA指引，並運用PICO框架，於Scopus、Web of Science及PubMed資料庫進行文獻搜尋。共納入48篇研究：42篇關於光照、5篇關於聲音、1篇關於震動，無關於氣味的研究。所有統計分析均使用JAMOVI 2.5.6軟體執行。在肉雞方面，間歇性光照（12小時光照：12小時黑暗）與暖色光改善了孵化率與雛鳥品質（p < 0.05）。在蛋雞方面，綠光或白光等特定光照方案以及聲音刺激促進了孵化表現與雛鳥品質（p < 0.05）。關於震動的單一研究不足以進行統計評估，且未識別出探討氣味的研究。整體而言，研究結果顯示，適當施加的光照與聲音刺激可改善孵化成果，儘管現有證據仍屬有限且具異質性。未來需要更多研究來標準化環境刺激方案、評估其大規模應用的成效，並確定其對家禽產業的經濟可行性。

papers.title: Mitochondrial Genome Variation in Breast Muscle of Tibetan Fragrant Chickens Across an Altitudinal Gradient and Its Association with Meat Quality
papers.abstract: This study aimed to characterize the mitochondrial (MT) genome of Tibetan fragrant chickens along an altitudinal gradient and to relate it to meat quality. Eighteen 150-day-old male chickens were selected from three groups (LX, 1500 m; MX, 2800 m; HX, 3500 m; n = 6 each; six birds were randomly chosen from 30 reared per group) and subjected to whole-genome resequencing (reference: Gallus gallus GCA_000002315.5). Ninety MT variants (85 polymorphic; transition/transversion 83:7) were identified, comprising 58 coding (42 synonymous, 16 non-synonymous), 20 D-loop/non-coding, 10 rRNA and 2 tRNA sites; no MT insertions/deletions or structural variants were found. The 18 birds clustered into three maternal lineages (A, B, C) that were only partially structured by altitude (A more frequent at low altitude; B at mid and high altitude). A neighbour-joining tree with 12 Gallus mitogenomes placed the population close to Gallus gallus gallus and Chinese local breeds. Fifteen heteroplasmic sites were detected, with 16S rRNA nt3946 (G/C/A) heteroplasmic in all birds. Relative mtDNA copy number did not differ among groups (p = 0.52). Meat quality varied with altitude (highest protein and lowest fat at 2800 m; highest inosine monophosphate at 3500 m) but not with maternal lineage, suggesting that the observed phenotypic differences are associated mainly with altitude of rearing rather than with maternal mitochondrial lineage, and that the MT genome contributes standing genetic variation rather than a direct functional basis for these differences.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討西藏藏香雞沿海拔梯度之粒線體（MT）基因組特徵，並探討其與肉質的關係。自三個海拔組別（LX，1500公尺；MX，2800公尺；HX，3500公尺；每組n = 6，每組30隻飼養雞隻中隨機選取6隻）選取18隻150日齡公雞，進行全基因組重定序（參考基因組：Gallus gallus GCA_000002315.5）。共鑑定出90個粒線體變異位點（85個具多態性；轉換／顛換比為83:7），包含58個編碼區位點（42個同義突變、16個非同義突變）、20個D-loop／非編碼區位點、10個rRNA位點及2個tRNA位點；未發現粒線體插入／缺失或結構變異。這18隻雞聚類為三個母系譜系（A、B、C），僅部分呈現海拔結構化（A譜系在低海拔較常見；B譜系在中高海拔較常見）。包含12個原雞粒線體基因組之鄰近接合樹（neighbor-joining tree）顯示，該群體與原雞原亞種（Gallus gallus gallus）及中國地方品種相近。檢測出15個異質型位點，其中16S rRNA nt3946（G/C/A）在所有雞隻中皆呈異質型。相對粒線體DNA拷貝數在各組間無顯著差異（p = 0.52）。肉質隨海拔而異（2800公尺時蛋白質最高、脂肪最低；3500公尺時肌苷酸最高），但與母系譜系無關，這表明所觀察到的表型差異主要與飼養海拔有關，而非母系粒線體譜系，且粒線體基因組主要提供基礎遺傳變異，而非這些差異的直接功能基礎。

papers.title: Genetic Diversity and Population Structure of the Kustanay Horse Breed Based on 16 STR Markers
papers.abstract: The Kustanay horse is a riding breed developed in Kazakhstan whose genetic diversity and differentiation remain insufficiently studied. We assessed genetic diversity and population structure using 16 autosomal STR loci from a 17-locus panel comprising 12 ISAG core markers. Of 765 genotyped horses, 703 remained after excluding duplicate records and close relatives; the X-linked LEX3 locus was excluded from population analyses. Five groups were studied: registered Kustanay (KST, n = 32), Kustanay from Qazaq Tulpary (KT, n = 36), Thoroughbred (TB, n = 31), Kustanay crossbred (CROSS, n = 9), and undocumented origin (UB, n = 595). Expected heterozygosity was high across groups (HE = 0.661–0.725). Overall FST was 0.0088, and AMOVA attributed 99.13% of molecular variance to variation within individuals. The Puechmaille estimators favored K = 2, whereas Evanno ΔK peaked at K = 4; neither solution revealed clear separation among groups. Nei’s genetic distances and PCoA were consistent with weak differentiation and similarity between registered Kustanay and undocumented horses. Unequal group sizes limit interpretation, and these findings do not establish breed identity for individual undocumented horses. The results inform pedigree recording and conservation planning.
papers.abstract_zh: 庫斯塔奈馬（Kustanay horse）是在哈薩克斯坦培育的騎乘品種，其遺傳多樣性與分化程度仍缺乏足夠研究。本研究利用包含12個國際動物遺傳學會（ISAG）核心標記的17個基因座小組中的16個體染色體STR基因座，評估了遺傳多樣性與族群結構。在765匹基因分型的馬匹中，排除重複記錄與近親後剩餘703匹；X染色體連鎖的LEX3基因座則被排除於族群分析之外。研究了五個群體：登記的庫斯塔奈馬（KST，n = 32）、來自Qazaq Tulpary的庫斯塔奈馬（KT，n = 36）、純種馬（TB，n = 31）、庫斯塔奈混血馬（CROSS，n = 9）以及來源不明馬（UB，n = 595）。各群體的期望雜合度均很高（$H_E = 0.661–0.725$）。整體 $F_{ST}$ 為 0.0088，分子變異數分析（AMOVA）顯示 99.13% 的分子變異歸因於個體內部變異。Puechmaille 估計值支持 $K = 2$，而 Evanno 的 $\Delta K$ 在 $K = 4$ 時達到峰值；這兩種方案均未顯示各群體間有明顯的分離。內氏遺傳距離（Nei's genetic distances）和主座標分析（PCoA）與登記的庫斯塔奈馬和來源不明馬之間的分化微弱且具相似性的一致。不均等的群體大小限制了解讀，且這些發現無法確立個別來源不明馬的品種身分。研究結果為系譜記錄和保育規劃提供了參考資訊。

papers.title: Effects of a Moderate Increase in Dietary Starch Content and Partial Replacement of Dietary Protein Source with Canola Meal on Methane Emissions and Lactation Performance in Dairy Cows
papers.abstract: This study aimed to evaluate the impact of moderately elevated dietary starch levels and the partial replacement of dietary protein source with canola meal (CM) on lactation performance, methane (CH4) emissions, ruminal fermentation parameters, and serum biochemical parameters in dairy cows. Initially, two in vitro gas production trials were conducted: Trial 1 involved diets formulated with starch levels of 24.0% (Low starch), 27.4% (Medium starch), and 30.8% (High starch) on a dry matter (DM) basis. In Trial 2, compared with a control diet without CM (CONin_vitro; 25.7% starch, the mean of 24.0% and 27.4%), a diet with moderately increased starch content and the inclusion of CM at 10.73% of DM (HSCMin_vitro; 29.1% starch, the mean of 27.4% and 30.8%) on a DM basis was formulated. In the subsequent in vivo experiment, thirty mid-lactation Holstein cows were randomly allocated to two groups: a control diet (CON, comprising 26.1% starch without CM, on a DM basis) or an experimental diet (HSCM, containing 28.9% starch with 7.68% CM, on a DM basis). In vitro results in Trial 1 showed that increasing dietary starch linearly decreased CO2 production (p < 0.01) and CH4 production (p = 0.03), but no significant differences between groups were detected. In Trial 2, a 3.4% increase in dietary starch combined with partial inclusion of CM showed a tendency to reduce CH4 (p = 0.06) and CO2 production (p = 0.08) compared to the CON diet. For the in vivo experiment, cows on the HSCM diet exhibited a tendency for greater dry matter intake (DMI; p = 0.06) and feed efficiency (milk yield/DMI; p = 0.09), and significantly improved milk yield (p < 0.01), energy-corrected milk (ECM; p < 0.01), and fat- and protein-corrected milk (FPCM; p < 0.01). The yields of milk fat (p < 0.01), protein (p < 0.01), lactose (p = 0.03), and total solids (p < 0.01) were also significantly improved, while the milk urea nitrogen (MUN) concentration was decreased (p < 0.01). The HSCM diet significantly decreased CH4 production by 14.1% (p = 0.02), as well as CH4 yield (p < 0.01) and CH4 emission intensity (p < 0.01) in terms of g/kg milk yield, ECM, and FPCM. Rumen fermentation parameters indicated lower molar proportions of isobutyrate and isovalerate in the HSCM group (p < 0.01), with no differences in other rumen parameters between groups. Additionally, the HSCM group exhibited a higher serum total protein (TP) concentration (p = 0.02) and a decreasing trend in blood urea nitrogen (BUN; p = 0.09). These findings demonstrate that a moderate increase in dietary starch content and partial replacement of dietary protein source with CM is an effective nutritional strategy for simultaneously improving lactation performance and mitigating CH4 emissions. However, as starch and CM were altered simultaneously in the in vivo experiment, the independent contribution of each factor cannot be determined and warrants further investigation.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在評估適度提高日糧澱粉水準以及用油菜籽粕（canola meal, CM）部分取代日糧蛋白質來源，對泌乳牛之泌乳性能、甲烷（CH4）排放量、瘤胃發酵參數及血清生化參數的影響。首先進行了兩項體外氣體產量試驗：試驗一包含以乾物質（DM）基礎計算，澱粉水準分別為 24.0%（低澱粉）、27.4%（中澱粉）和 30.8%（高澱粉）的日糧。在試驗二中，以不含 CM 的對照日糧（CONin_vitro；澱粉含量 25.7%，為 24.0% 與 27.4% 之平均值）為基準，調配出以乾物質基礎計算、澱粉含量適度增加且包含 10.73% 乾物質之 CM 的日糧（HSCMin_vitro；澱粉含量 29.1%，為 27.4% 與 30.8% 之平均值）。在隨後的體內試驗中，三十頭泌乳中期的荷斯登乳牛被隨機分配至兩組：對照日糧組（CON，以乾物質基礎計算，含 26.1% 澱粉且無 CM）或實驗日糧組（HSCM，以乾物質基礎計算，含 28.9% 澱粉及 7.68% CM）。試驗一的體外結果顯示，增加日糧澱粉會線性降低 CO2 產量（p < 0.01）與 CH4 產量（p = 0.03），但各組間未檢測到顯著差異。在試驗二中，與 CON 日糧相比，日糧澱粉增加 3.4% 並結合部分添加 CM，顯示出降低 CH4（p = 0.06）和 CO2 產量（p = 0.08）的趨勢。在體內試驗方面，攝取 HSCM 日糧的乳牛展現出較高的乾物質採食量（DMI；p = 0.06）與飼料效率（乳產量/DMI；p = 0.09）的趨勢，且乳產量（p < 0.01）、能量校正乳（ECM；p < 0.01）以及乳脂暨乳蛋白校正乳（FPCM；p < 0.01）顯著改善。乳脂（p < 0.01）、乳蛋白（p < 0.01）、乳糖（p = 0.03）和總固形物（p < 0.01）的產量也顯著提高，同時乳中尿素氮（MUN）濃度降低（p < 0.01）。HSCM 日糧使 CH4 產量顯著降低 14.1%（p = 0.02），且以每公斤乳產量、ECM 及 FPCM 計算之 CH4 排放量（p < 0.01）與 CH4 排放強度（p < 0.01）亦顯著降低。瘤胃發酵參數顯示，HSCM 組的異丁酸和異戊酸莫耳比例較低（p < 0.01），其他瘤胃參數在各組間則無差異。此外，HSCM 組呈現較高的血清總蛋白（TP）濃度（p = 0.02）以及血液尿素氮（BUN）下降的趨勢（p = 0.09）。這些研究結果表明，適度提高日糧澱粉含量並用 CM 部分取代日糧蛋白質來源，是同時改善泌乳性能與減少 CH4 排放的有效營養策略。然而，由於體內試驗中澱粉與 CM 同時進行了調整，因此無法確定各自因素的獨立貢獻，有待進一步研究探討。

papers.title: Molecular insights into ROS-induced aggregation in chicken primordial germ cells and its alleviation by ascorbic acid
papers.abstract: Background Primordial germ cells (PGCs) are highly valuable for chicken genetic engineering; however, their cultivation is frequently hindered by spontaneous cell aggregation and slow proliferation in certain breeds. Methods We systematically evaluated the culture dynamics of PGCs derived from four distinct chicken breeds. To investigate the molecular mechanisms driving these phenotypes, we performed integrated transcriptomic and proteomic profiling, alongside targeted exogenous supplementation assays. Results We found that White Leghorn PGCs exhibited superior line establishment efficiency, whereas broiler breeds, particularly White Cornish, displayed severe cell aggregation and delayed growth. Transcriptomic and proteomic analyses revealed that WC PGCs exhibit an inherent deficiency in glutathione metabolism and an activation of the p53 signaling pathway. This finding was experimentally corroborated by the accumulation of reactive oxygen species (ROS) in these cells. Based on these mechanistic insights, we experimentally demonstrated that targeted exogenous supplementation with L-sulforaphane and ascorbic acid effectively mitigated excessive ROS and ameliorated the aggregation phenotype in White Cornish PGCs, with ascorbic acid notably accelerating cell proliferation. Subsequently, ascorbic acid also promoted proliferation in both Rhode Island Red and White Plymouth Rock lines, while alleviating aggregation in the White Plymouth Rock line. Conclusions These findings demonstrate the cross-breed applicability of ascorbic acid, suggesting it could serve as a general supplement for PGC culture in other chicken breeds. Collectively, our study proposes a mechanistic model in which oxidative stress promotes PGC aggregation and offers practical antioxidant interventions to enhance the derivation efficiency of chicken PGCs, providing a valuable reference for the future optimization of in vitro culture media.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Science and Biotechnology
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：原始生殖細胞（Primordial germ cells, PGCs）對於雞隻基因工程具有極高的價值；然而其培養經常受到某些品種中自發性細胞聚集與增殖緩慢的阻礙。方法：我們系統性地評估了源自四個不同雞品種之 PGCs 的培養動態。為了探討驅動這些表型的分子機制，我們進行了整合性轉錄體學與蛋白質體學分析，並輔以標靶外源補充試驗。結果：我們發現白來亨雞（White Leghorn）PGCs 表現出優異的品系建立效率，而肉雞品種，特別是白康尼許雞（White Cornish），則顯示出嚴重的細胞聚集與生長遲緩。轉錄體學與蛋白質體學分析顯示，WC PGCs 在麩胱甘肽代謝方面具有固有的缺陷，且 p53 信息傳遞路徑被活化。此一發現在實驗上得到了這些細胞中活性氧種（ROS）累積的證實。基於這些機制上的見解，我們以實驗證明，標靶外源補充 L-蘿蔔硫素與抗壞血酸能有效減輕白康尼許雞 PGCs 過量的 ROS 並改善聚集表型，其中抗壞血酸顯著地加速了細胞增殖。隨後，抗壞血酸亦促進了洛島紅（Rhode Island Red）與白皮殼洛克（White Plymouth Rock）品系的增殖，同時緩解了白皮殼洛克品系的聚集現象。結論：這些發現證明了抗壞血酸的跨品種適用性，暗示其可作為其他雞品種 PGC 培養的一般性補充劑。總體而言，本研究提出了一個機械式模型，即氧化壓力會促進 PGC 聚集，並提供了實用的抗氧化劑介入措施以提高雞 PGCs 的分離效率，為未來體外培養基的優化提供了寶貴的參考。

papers.title: Genome-Wide Analysis of Genetic Diversity and Selection Signatures in the Jiami Donkey
papers.abstract: The Jiami donkey is an indigenous breed distributed on the Loess Plateau of northern Shaanxi Province, China. Owing to the rapid mechanization of agriculture, its population has declined substantially in recent decades, highlighting the need for effective conservation strategies. In this study, we performed whole-genome resequencing of 30 Jiami donkeys and integrated these data with 210 publicly available genomes from diverse domestic donkey breeds. After quality control, 23,752,978 high-quality biallelic SNPs were retained for downstream analyses. Population genetic analyses revealed that Jiami donkeys represent a genetically distinguishable indigenous population with relatively high genetic diversity, showing the lowest pairwise genetic differentiation from Dezhou donkeys (FST = 0.032), followed by Qingyang donkeys (FST = 0.034). Genome-wide selection scans using θπ, iHS, CLR, FST, θπ-ratio, and XP-EHH identified candidate genes associated with growth, reproduction, immunity, nervous system development, and environmental adaptation. Among these, NCAPG, SMG6, SCARF1, BTG4, ASTN2, and NLGN1 were highlighted as promising candidate genes. Functional enrichment analyses indicated that these genes were mainly involved in amino acid metabolism, epigenetic regulation, neuronal development, and cell adhesion. Collectively, these findings provide valuable genomic resources for understanding the evolutionary history of the Jiami donkey and support future conservation and genetic improvement of this indigenous breed.
