papers.abstract_zh: 佳米驢是分佈於中國陝西省北部黃土高原的本土驢品種。由於農業機械化快速發展，其族群數量在近幾十年來顯著下降，突顯出制定有效保育策略的必要性。在本研究中，我們對30隻佳米驢進行了全基因庫重測序，並將這些數據與來自不同家驢品種的210個公開基因庫數據進行整合。經過品質控制後，保留了23,752,978個高品質的雙等位基因單核苷酸多型性（SNPs）用於後續分析。族群遺傳學分析顯示，佳米驢是一個具有較高遺傳多樣性且可資區別的本土族群，其中與德州驢的成對遺傳分化最低（$F_{ST} = 0.032$），其次為慶陽驢（$F_{ST} = 0.034$）。利用 $\theta_\pi$、iHS、CLR、FST、$\theta_\pi$-ratio 和 XP-EHH 等全基因體選擇清除掃描，識別出與生長、繁殖、免疫、神經系統發育及環境適應相關的候選基因。其中，*NCAPG*、*SMG6*、*SCARF1*、*BTG4*、*ASTN2* 和 *NLGN1* 被認為是極具潛力的候選基因。功能富集分析表明，這些基因主要參與胺基酸代謝、表觀遺傳調控、神經元發育和細胞黏附。總體而言，這些發現為理解佳米驢的演化歷史提供了寶貴的基因體資源，並支持該本土品種未來的保育與遺傳改良。

papers.title: Mitogenome Insights Into the Domestication and Phylogeography of Zebu Cattle: A Focus on Pakistani Breeds and Asian Lineages
papers.abstract: Zebu cattle ( Bos indicus ) represent a critical livestock resource in the arid and semi‐arid regions, known for their disease resistance, heat tolerance and physiological hardiness. Despite their agricultural importance, the precise matrilineal evolutionary history, genetic diversity and demographic trajectory remain incompletely resolved within the broader context of South Asian cattle domestication. This study explores the phylogeographic patterns and maternal lineage diversity of zebu cattle through complete mitochondrial genomes (mtDNA), the D‐loop, and hypervariable regions from 50 individuals of 10 indigenous Pakistani breeds. These breeds were classified into three regions: North Pakistan, Central Pakistan/Punjab (Indus Valley region) and South Pakistan (the site of Mohenjo‐Daro). Our data include 183 newly generated sequences and are supplemented with comparative datasets from 19 countries. Analysis reveals South Pakistan, especially the Mehrgarh area, as a key potential domestication epicentre, exhibiting highest nucleotide diversity ( π = 0.01480) across Asian zebu populations, accompanied by ancient maternal lineages estimated to date back approximately 2.17 million years. Highest haplotype diversity was observed in Punjab (0.901 ± 0.014) followed by Southern Pakistan (0.893 ± 0.026). Phylogenetic and demographic analyses (mismatch distribution, Fu's Fs) further support an early dispersal scenario (I1 haplogroup) originating in Mehrgarh and radiating through the Indus Valley into broader Asian lineages. These findings enhance our understanding of the domestication origins of Bos indicus , its implications for breed conservation and sustainable livestock management.
papers.abstract_zh: 瘤牛（*Bos indicus*）是乾旱與半乾旱地區至關重要的家畜資源，以抗病能力、耐熱性及生理韌性聞名。儘管其具備重要的農業價值，但在南亞牛隻馴化的更廣泛背景下，其確切的母系演化歷史、遺傳多樣性與人口統計學軌跡仍未完全釐清。本研究透過來自巴基斯坦 10 個本土品種共 50 個體的完整粒線體基因組（mtDNA）、D 迴圈及高變異區，探討瘤牛的親緣地理模式與母系譜系多樣性。這些品種被歸類為三個區域：巴基斯坦北部、巴基斯坦中部／旁遮普（印度河流域地區）以及巴基斯坦南部（莫亨焦達羅遺址所在地）。我們的數據包含 183 個新產生的序列，並輔以來自 19 個國家的比較數據集。分析顯示，巴基斯坦南部（特別是梅爾加爾地區）是關鍵的潛在馴化中心，其展現出亞洲瘤牛族群中最高的核苷酸多樣性（$\pi = 0.01480$），並伴隨估計可追溯至約 217 萬年前的古老母系譜系。旁遮普觀察到最高的高倍型多樣性（$0.901 \pm 0.014$），其次為巴基斯坦南部（$0.893 \pm 0.026$）。系統發生與人口統計學分析（不匹配分佈、Fu's Fs 檢定）進一步支持一項早期擴散情景（I1 單倍群），即源自梅爾加爾，並透過印度河流域輻射至更廣泛的亞洲譜系。這些發現增進了我們對*Bos indicus*馴化起源的理解，及其對品種保育和永續畜牧管理的意涵。

papers.title: Spatiotemporal Dynamics and Trend Analysis of African Swine Fever Virus in Romanian Wild Boar Populations (2018–2024)
papers.abstract: Background: African Swine Fever (ASF) remains a critical threat to the swine industry globally, with wild boars (Sus scrofa) acting as a major wildlife reservoir. Romania has been one of the most severely affected European countries since the virus’s introduction. Objectives: This study aims to estimate the long-term spatiotemporal trends, environmental persistence, and transmission dynamics of ASF virus (ASFV) in the Romanian wild boar population based on a finalized dataset of 1443 confirmed cases distributed across an 80-month timeline (May 2018–December 2024). Methods: Advanced epidemiological workflows integrating spatial and temporal modeling frameworks were developed. Spatiotemporal cluster detection was performed using SatScan to identify significant disease hotspots. Generalized Additive Models (GAMs) were utilized to model non-linear seasonal trends and spatial patterns of carcass persistence. Furthermore, the time-varying reproduction number (Rt) was calculated using a Bayesian renewal framework via the EpiEstim package, parameterized with a wild boar serial distribution (mean = 10.3 days; SD = 4.2 days). Results: SatScan identified one most primary cluster in Dobrogea and five other major recurrent hot spots in Muntenia, Transylvania, and Moldova. The GAM analysis revealed a strong, statistically significant seasonal pattern, with case detection from carcasses peaking markedly during the winter months when low temperatures favor environmental virus stability. The Bayesian Rt reconstruction disclosed three distinct epidemiological phases: a sharp initial invasion peak at a mean Rt of 2.38 (95% Crl: 1.82–3.02), followed by regional wave-like oscillations, and a distinct long-term stabilization in the late endemic phase, hovering dynamically around a stationary mean of 1.01 (95% Crl: 0.87–1.16). Conclusions: Our findings statistically validate the shift from an acute epidemic wave to a self-sustaining, chronic endemic equilibrium within the natural habitat, driven by constant carcass-mediated environmental re-seeding. These insights underscore that successful disease mitigation must prioritize the rapid, targeted removal of infected carcasses in high-risk forest matrices rather than generic population reduction strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：非洲豬瘟（African Swine Fever, ASF）對全球養豬產業構成重大威脅，其中野豬（Sus scrofa）扮演主要的野生動物保毒宿主。自病毒引入以來，羅馬尼亞一直是受歐洲影響最嚴重的國家之一。目的：本研究旨在基於涵蓋 80 個月時間軸（2018 年 5 月至 2024 年 12 月）共 1,443 例確診病例的完整資料集，評估羅馬尼亞野豬族群中非洲豬瘟病毒（ASFV）的長期時空趨勢、環境持久性及傳播動態。方法：本研究開發了整合空間與時間建模框架的先進流行病學工作流程。使用 SatScan 進行時空群聚偵測，以識別顯著的疾病熱點。利用廣義加法模型（Generalized Additive Models, GAMs）對屍體持久性的非線性季節性趨勢與空間模式進行建模。此外，透過 EpiEstim 套件並使用貝氏更新框架計算時變再生數（Rt），其參數設定根據野豬的序列間隔分佈（平均值 = 10.3 天；標準差 = 4.2 天）。結果：SatScan 在多布羅加（Dobrogea）識別出一個主要核心群聚，並在蒙特尼亞（Muntenia）、特蘭 silvestris（Transylvania，註：維持原專有名詞 Transylvania 譯為特蘭西瓦尼亞）及摩爾達維亞（Moldova）識別出另外五個主要的覆發性熱點。GAM 分析顯示出強烈且具統計顯著性的季節性模式，在低溫有利於病毒在環境中穩定存活的冬季月份，從屍體中檢測到的病例數顯著達到高峰。貝氏 Rt 重建揭示了三個不同的流行病學階段：平均 Rt 為 2.38（95% 信賴區間：1.82–3.02）的急劇初始入侵高峰、隨後的區域性波浪狀振盪，以及在地方性流行後期明顯的長期穩定狀態，動態徘徊在 1.01 的平穩平均值附近（95% 信賴區間：0.87–1.16）。結論：我們的研究結果從統計學上證實了在由屍體介導的持續環境重複散播驅動下，自然棲息地內的疫情已從急性流行波轉變為自我維持的慢性地方性平衡。這些見解強調，成功的疾病緩解策略必須優先針對高風險森林基質中的受感染屍體進行快速、標靶式的移除，而非採取通用的族群減少策略。

papers.title: Genome-Wide Detection of Genetic Diversity and Genomic Structure in Hanwoo Cows
papers.abstract: This study aimed to utilize genomic information to elucidate the genetic diversity and structure of Hanwoo cows and develop a more efficient improvement system. Genomic DNA was extracted from hair root samples of 7273 Hanwoo cows, and genotypes were determined using a customized Illumina Hanwoo SNP50k BeadChip. A total of 41,884 single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) covering approximately 2500 Mb of the genome were selected for analysis, along with 7166 Hanwoo cows that passed quality control. The mean observed and expected heterozygosity were 0.358 ± 0.125 and 0.357 ± 0.124, respectively. A total of 94,560 runs of homozygosity (ROHs) were observed, with an average of 13.2 per animal. Linkage disequilibrium (LD) was estimated using two parameters, D’ and r2, which were found to be 0.381 ± 0.309 and 0.054 ± 0.126, respectively, on autosomes. LD declined sharply from< 50 kb to 50–100 kb. In addition, 1818 haplotype blocks were identified on autosomes, totaling 88.27 Mb (3.53% of the autosomal length). The most common haplotype block size was two SNPs, with 1101 blocks. Finally, the effective population size (Ne) was 2853 at 1691 generations but decreased to 277 at 13 generations. These results provide genomic information for further studies and will be helpful for Hanwoo breeding programs.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在利用基因體資訊來闡明韓牛的遺傳多樣性與結構，並開發更有效率的品種改良系統。本研究從 7,273 頭韓牛的毛根樣本中萃取基因體 DNA，並使用客製化的 Illumina 韓牛 SNP50k BeadChip 進行基因型鑑定。經過品質控制後，最終選出涵蓋約 2500 Mb 基因體、共 41,884 個單核苷酸多型性（SNP）以及 7,166 頭韓牛進行分析。平均觀察到的與預期的雜合度分別為 0.358 ± 0.125 和 0.357 ± 0.124。共觀察到 94,560 個純合區段（ROH），每隻動物平均有 13.2 個。本研究使用 D’ 與 r2 兩項參數來評估連鎖不平衡（LD），在體染色體上其值分別為 0.381 ± 0.309 與 0.054 ± 0.126。連鎖不平衡從 < 50 kb 到 50–100 kb 呈現急遽下降。此外，在體染色體上共鑑定出 1,818 個單套型區塊（haplotype blocks），總計 88.27 Mb（佔體染色體長度的 3.53%）。最常見的單套型區塊大小為兩個 SNP，共有 1,101 個區塊。最後，有效族群大小（Ne）在 1,691 個世代前為 2,853，但在 13 個世代前降至 277。這些結果為進一步的研究提供了基因體資訊，並將有助於韓牛的育種計畫。

papers.title: Effects of Curcumin Supplementation on Production Performance, Intestinal Health and Cecal Microbiota in Late-Phase Jingfen No. 1 Laying Hens
papers.abstract: This study investigated the effects of graded dietary curcumin supplementation on production performance, antioxidant capacity, immune status, intestinal barrier function, and cecal microbiota in late-laying hens. A total of 480 61-week-old Jingfen No. 1 laying hens were randomly allocated to four groups with six replicates of 20 birds each: a basal diet control (CG) and diets supplemented with 100, 200, or 400 mg/kg curcumin (CN1, CN2 and CN3) for 35 days. Curcumin supplementation significantly increased average egg weight (p < 0.05). Serum catalase concentration and immunoglobulin levels (IgM, IgA, and IgY) were elevated, whereas malondialdehyde, interleukin-6, interleukin-10, and tumor necrosis factor-α levels were reduced in a dose-dependent manner (p < 0.05). Similar improvements were observed in the jejunum, including increased glutathione peroxidase and catalase concentrations and reduced inflammatory cytokines. Birds in the CN3 group exhibited greater villus height and villus-to-crypt ratio, lower crypt depth, and upregulated mRNA expression of tight junction proteins (ZO-1, Occludin, and Claudin-1) (p < 0.05). Curcumin also modulated the cecal microbiota by enriching beneficial butyrate-producing bacteria (Lactobacillales, Faecalibacterium, Odoribacter, Roseburia, and Phascolarctobacterium) and reducing pathogenic Staphylococcus and Bilophila. Overall, dietary curcumin improved egg quality, antioxidant and immune functions, intestinal health, and microbial composition in late-laying hens.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究探討在飼糧中添加不同劑量的薑黃素對產後期蛋雞生產性能、抗氧化能力、免疫狀態、腸道屏障功能及盲腸微生物相的影響。試驗選取480隻61週齡的京粉1號蛋雞，隨機分為4組，每組6個重複，每個重複20隻雞：基礎飼糧對照組（CG），以及在基礎飼糧中分別添加100、200或400 mg/kg薑黃素的試驗組（CN1、CN2和CN3），試驗期為35天。結果顯示，添加薑黃素顯著提高了平均蛋重（p < 0.05）。血清過氧化氫酶濃度和免疫球蛋白濃度（IgM、IgA和IgY）呈劑量依效性升高，而丙二醛、介白素-6、介白素-10和腫瘤壞死因子-α濃度則呈劑量依效性降低（p < 0.05）。空腸中也觀察到類似的改善效果，包括麩胱甘肽過氧化酶和過氧化氫酶濃度的提高，以及發炎性細胞因子的減少。CN3組的雞隻表現出較高的絨毛高度、絨毛高度與隱窩深度比值、較低的隱窩深度，以及緊密連接蛋白（ZO-1、Occludin和Claudin-1）mRNA表現量的上調（p < 0.05）。薑黃素亦透過豐富有益的產丁酸菌（乳酸菌目、糞桿菌屬、臭氣桿菌屬、羅斯氏菌屬和副吉氏菌屬）以及減少致病性的葡萄球菌屬和雙歧桿菌屬，來調節盲腸微生物相。總體而言，飼糧中添加薑黃素可改善產後期蛋雞的蛋品質、抗氧化與免疫功能、腸道健康及微生物組成。

papers.title: Genotype by environment interaction under two production systems utilizing a random regression model for milk production traits in multiparous South African Holstein dairy cattle
papers.abstract: Background Dairy cattle in South Africa (SA) have to produce in varying environments which can roughly be separated as total mixed ration (TMR) and pasture (PAST) production systems according to the level of rainfall in the herd area. Previous studies aimed to determine a possible genotype × environment interaction (GxE) using 305-day lactation records, finding no interaction, but different heritabilities. An alternative random regression (aRR) model was developed using SA Holstein test-day records of herds with known production system used (TMR or PAST, analysed independently). The aRR model separates the animal genetic (additive) effect into a general production level and a linear persistency effect and shows clear differences in the genetic variances and heritability estimates over the lactation between TMR and PAST. The aim of this study was to further investigate the existence of a possible GxE interaction, using comparable data, methods and RR model to differentiate each trait (milk, fat and protein production for the first 3 lactations) separately for the two production systems (TMR or PAST). The possible reranking of sires on resulting estimated breeding values from the analysis between TMR and PAST were also investigated. Results Genetic correlations (0.83 to 0.93) of the genetic general production level effect between TMR and PAST were strong, while corresponding correlations of the genetic linear persistency effect were moderate (0.40 to 0.60) for all traits. Significant reranking of sires between TMR and PAST are predicted for genetic linear persistency, as well as genetic total production. Conclusions Genetic correlations show a significant genotype by environment interaction for the genetic linear persistency effect between the two production systems in SA Holsteins. Genetic evaluations should analyse production traits in the different systems as genetically different traits, utilizing an applicable random regression model that can effectively dissociate genetic general production level from genetic linear persistency. Estimating separate breeding values for persistency for each production system is justified.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：南非（SA）的乳牛必須在不同的環境下生產，根據牛群所在地區的降雨量，大致可區分為全混合日糧（TMR）和放牧（PAST）兩種生產系統。先前的研究旨在利用305天泌乳紀錄來判定可能存在的基因型與環境交戶作用（GxE），結果雖未發現交戶作用，但得出了不同的遺傳力。本研究開發了一種替代性隨機迴歸（aRR）模型，利用已知生產系統（TMR或PAST，分別進行分析）的SA荷仕登（Holstein）乳牛檢定日紀錄。aRR模型將動物的遺傳（加成）效應區分為總體產量水準與線性持續力效應，並顯示在整個泌乳期間，TMR與PAST的遺傳變異數及遺傳力估計值有明顯差異。本研究旨在利用可比較的資料、方法和RR模型，進一步探討是否存在可能的GxE交戶作用，針對這兩個生產系統（TMR或PAST）分別區分各性狀（前三胎次的乳量、乳脂量和乳蛋白質產量）。同時也探討了根據TMR與PAST分析所得的預估育種值，其種公牛排序可能發生的變動。結果：TMR與PAST之間，遺傳總體產量水準效應的遺傳相關性表現強烈（0.83至0.93），而遺傳線性持續力效應的對應相關性在所有性狀中則呈中等程度（0.40至0.60）。預測在遺傳線性持續力以及遺傳總產量方面，TMR與PAST之間的種公牛排序會出現顯著變動。結論：遺傳相關性顯示，南非荷仕登乳牛在這兩個生產系統之間的遺傳線性持續力效應，存在顯著的基因型與環境交互作用。遺傳評估應將不同系統中的生產性狀視為基因上相異的性狀，並利用能有效將遺傳總體產量水準與遺傳線性持續力分離的適用隨機迴歸模型。為每個生產系統分別估算持續力的育種值是合理且必要的。

papers.title: Full-fat soybean origin and thermal processing affect protein secondary structure, in vitro digestion kinetics, and predicted standardized ileal amino acid digestibility in broiler chickens
papers.abstract: Background This study evaluated the chemical composition, protein secondary structure, crude protein (CP) solubilization, and in-vitro amino acid (AA) digestibility of three Kenyan full-fat soybean (FFSB) samples (S1, S2, S3) with unknown processing histories and compared with Canadian samples: raw FFSB, extruded FFSB at 160.0 °C, and FFSB roasted at 136.7 °C, 151.7 °C, or 154.4 °C. Protein structure was characterized using attenuated total reflectance-Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy. A two-phase in-vitro digestion model was used to determine CP solubilization and AA digestibility. Observed in-vivo standardized ileal digestibility (SID) values from a study using FFSB roasted at 136.7 °C were regressed on corresponding in-vitro AA digestibility values to generate predicted SID values. Results Thermal processing reduced trypsin inhibitor activity (TIA) in Canadian FFSB from 17.42 TIU/mg in raw FFSB to 3.85 TIU/mg in extruded FFSB and to 4.77, 4.59, and 2.30 TIU/mg in samples roasted at 136.7, 151.7, and 154.4 °C, respectively. In contrast, Kenyan Samples 1, 2, and 3 had residual TIA values of 8.00, 6.00, and 12.00 TIU/mg, respectively. Protein secondary structure differed among samples ( P < 0.001), with the 136.7 °C-roasted sample having greater aggregated β-sheet and β-turn contents and lower random coil content than most samples. CP solubilization differed among samples at each digestion time point ( P < 0.001). At the end of the intestinal phase, processed Canadian samples had greater CP solubilization than raw FFSB but did not differ from one another, whereas Kenyan Samples 2 and 3 were comparable to Canadian raw FFSB. In-vitro AA digestibility differed among samples for all AA ( P ≤ 0.001). For mean total AA digestibility, the 154.4 °C and 151.7 °C-roasted sample had the highest digestibility; Kenyan Sample 1 was greater than Samples 2 and 3, and Sample 3 did not differ from raw FFSB. The regression model showed agreement at the mean level but larger prediction errors for lysine, aspartic acid, and proline, indicating AA-specific limitations. Conclusions Overall, processing conditions and ingredient origin influenced FFSB quality, with roasting at 151.7–154.4 °C producing favorable structural and digestibility responses. The variability observed among Kenyan samples highlights the need for routine quality assessment of commercial FFSB before feed formulation.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Science and Biotechnology
papers.abstract_zh: 背景 本研究評估了三個加工歷史未知的肯亞全脂大豆（FFSB）樣品（S1、S2、S3）的化學組成、蛋白質二級結構、粗蛋白質（CP）溶解度及體外胺基酸（AA）消化率，並與加拿大樣品進行比較：包括生全脂大豆、經 160.0 °C 擠壓膨發的全脂大豆，以及分別在 136.7 °C、151.7 °C 或 154.4 °C 下烘炒的全脂大豆。利用衰減全反射-傅立葉轉換紅外光譜儀（ATR-FTIR）對蛋白質結構進行表徵。採用兩階段體外消化模型來測定粗蛋白質溶解度與胺基酸消化率。將使用 136.7 °C 烘炒全脂大豆研究所得的體內標準化迴腸末端消化率（SID）觀測值，對應至體外胺基酸消化率值進行迴歸分析，以產生預測的標準化迴腸末端消化率值。結果 熱加工降低了加拿大全脂大豆的胰蛋白酶抑制劑活性（TIA），生全脂大豆中的 17.42 TIU/mg 降至擠壓膨發樣品的 3.85 TIU/mg，以及 136.7、151.7 和 154.4 °C 烘炒樣品的 4.77、4.59 和 2.30 TIU/mg。相比之下，肯亞樣品 1、2 和 3 的殘留胰蛋白酶抑制劑活性分別為 8.00、6.00 和 12.00 TIU/mg。蛋白質二級結構在各樣品間存在差異（P < 0.001），其中 136.7 °C 烘炒樣品具有較高的聚集型 β-折疊與 β-轉折含量，以及比多數樣品更低的無規捲曲含量。在每個消化時間點，各樣品的粗蛋白質溶解度均有差異（P < 0.001）。在腸道消化階段結束時，經過加工的加拿大樣品具有比生全脂大豆更高的粗蛋白質溶解度，但彼此間無顯著差異，而肯亞樣品 2 和 3 則與加拿大生全脂大豆相當。所有胺基酸的體外消化率在各樣品間均存在差異（P ≤ 0.001）。就平均總胺基酸消化率而言，154.4 °C 和 151.7 °C 烘炒樣品的消化率最高；肯亞樣品 1 大於樣品 2 和 3，而樣品 3 與生全脂大豆無顯著差異。迴歸模型顯示在平均水準上具有一致性，但離胺酸、天門冬胺酸和脯胺酸的預測誤差較大，顯示存在胺基酸特異性的限制。結論 總體而言，加工條件與原料來源會影響全脂大豆的品質，在 151.7–154.4 °C 下烘炒可產生良好的結構與消化率反應。肯亞樣品所表現出的變異性凸顯了在進行飼料配方設計之前，對市售全脂大豆進行常規品質評估的必要性。

papers.title: Comparison of Modified Lake’s Extender for Cryopreservation of Hungarian Giant and Chrabrany Rabbit Sperm
papers.abstract: Sperm cryopreservation is the most effective method for the long-term preservation of genetic resources. However, rabbit sperm cryopreservation remains challenging. One of the key factors influencing freezing success is the choice of semen diluent; however, no specific diluent has been established for rabbit semen. In this study, we compared the effectiveness of modified Lake’s diluent and evaluated the cryosurvival of semen from the native Hungarian breed and a native Slovak rabbit breed. Both breeds were subjected to the same static freezing procedure. The following parameters were evaluated: motility, viability, plasma membrane integrity, mitochondrial activity, acrosomal status, and intracellular reactive oxygen species. In fresh samples, viability (93.5% vs. 77.4%), total motility (84.6% vs. 67.0%), and progressive motility (76.1% vs. 47.0%) were significantly higher for the Hungarian Giant than in the Chrabrany rabbit samples. Following cryopreservation, viability (56.4% vs. 43.4%), total (39.2% vs. 20.5%) and progressive (20.6% vs. 8.5%) motility, acrosomal status (72.2% vs. 44.9%) and ROS activity (33.8% vs. 24.6%) were higher in samples from the Chrabrany breed. The results suggest that the modified Lake’s diluent may also be suitable for other rabbit breeds and highlight the importance of developing breed-specific cryopreservation protocols.
papers.abstract_zh: 精子冷凍保存是長期保存基因資源最有效的方法。然而，家兔精子冷凍保存仍具挑戰性。影響冷凍成功與否的關鍵因素之一是精液稀釋液的選擇；然而，目前尚未建立針對家兔精液的專屬稀釋液。在本研究中，我們比較了改良式萊克氏稀釋液（modified Lake’s diluent）的有效性，並評估了匈牙利本地品種與斯洛伐克本地家兔品種精液的冷凍存活率。兩個品種均採用相同的靜態冷凍程序。評估了以下參數：活力、存活率、質膜完整性、粒線體活性、頂體狀態及細胞內活性氧類。在新鮮樣本中，匈牙利巨兔的存活率（93.5% 對 77.4%）、總活力（84.6% 對 67.0%）和漸進性活力（76.1% 對 47.0%）顯著高於赫拉布拉尼（Chrabrany）家兔樣本。冷凍保存後，赫拉布拉尼品種樣本的存活率（56.4% 對 43.4%）、總活力（39.2% 對 20.5%）與漸進性活力（20.6% 對 8.5%）、頂體狀態（72.2% 對 44.9%）及活性氧類活性（33.8% 對 24.6%）則較高。結果表明，改良式萊克氏稀釋液亦可能適用於其他家兔品種，並凸顯了開發品種專屬冷凍保存方案的重要性。

papers.title: Integrated multi-omics analysis deciphers the molecular mechanisms underlying the characteristic volatile flavor of Meishan pork
papers.abstract: Background The Meishan pig is a celebrated indigenous Chinese swine breed renowned for its distinctive flavor profile. However, the specific signature flavor compounds and the molecular mechanisms underlying their formation remain largely uncharacterized. This study aimed to comprehensively profile the volatile flavor compounds across five pig breeds and decipher the molecular basis of the characteristic flavor of Meishan pork. Results Comparative analysis combining electronic nose, headspace solid-phase microextraction coupled with gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (HS-SPME-GC-MS), and relative odor activity value calculations revealed that Meishan pork contained significantly higher levels of four key aroma compounds: hexanal, nonanal, 2-pentylfuran, and (E,E)-2,4-nonadienal. Integrated metabolomic and transcriptomic analyses identified oleic acid and α-linolenic acid as critical precursors and highlighted the high expression of the arachidonate 5-lipoxygenase gene ( ALOX5 ) in Meishan pigs. Heating experiments confirmed that these fatty acids yield characteristic flavor compounds upon thermal oxidation. Furthermore, functional studies demonstrated that ALOX5 catalyzes the conversion of these precursors into flavor aldehydes. Conclusions The distinctive flavor of Meishan pork is associated with a dual mechanism: thermal oxidation of abundant precursors during cooking, and enhanced enzymatic oxidation prior to cooking resulting from constitutively high ALOX5 expression. By deciphering the flavor formation mechanism from metabolic precursors to enzyme-catalyzed conversion, this investigation provides a framework for elucidating meat flavor chemistry and offers potential targets for breeding strategies aimed at improving pork flavor.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Science and Biotechnology
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：梅山豬是著名的中國本土豬品種，以其獨特的風味特色而聞名。然而其特定的標誌性風味化合物及其形成的分子機制目前大多仍未明確。本研究旨在全面剖析五個豬品種中的揮發性風味化合物，並解析梅山豬肉獨特風味的分子基礎。結果：結合電子鼻、頂空固相微萃取結合氣相層析-質譜聯用技術（HS-SPME-GC-MS）以及相對氣味活性值計算的比較分析顯示，梅山豬肉含有顯著較高濃度的四種關鍵香氣化合物：己醛、壬醛、2-戊基呋喃以及(E,E)-2,4-壬二烯醛。整合性代謝體學與轉錄體學分析識別出油酸和α-次亞麻油酸為關鍵前驅物，並突顯了梅山豬體內花生四烯酸5-脂氧合酶基因（ALOX5）的高表達。加熱實驗證實，這些脂肪酸在熱氧化過程中會產生特徵性風味化合物。此外，功能研究證明ALOX5可催化這些前驅物轉化為風味醛類。結論：梅山豬肉的獨特風味與雙重機制有關：烹調過程中豐富前驅物的熱氧化，以及因ALOX5持續高表現而導致烹調前的增強型酵素氧化。本研究透過從代謝前驅物到酵素催化轉化的過程來解碼風味形成機制，為闡明肉品風味化學提供了框架，並為旨在改善豬肉風味的育種策略提供了潛在標靶。

papers.title: Effects of Dietary Hemp Harvest Residue Mixture on Carcass Characteristics, Meat Quality, and Muscle Amino Acid and Fatty Acid Profiles of Hu Ram Lambs
papers.abstract: To develop unconventional feed resources, this study investigated the effects of adding HHRM to the diet on carcass traits, meat quality, amino acids, and fatty acids in male Hu sheep lambs. Forty-eight healthy, 3-month-old lambs (24.33 ± 1.56 kg) were randomly divided into four groups (n = 12): CON (0%), LC (3%), MC (6%), and HC (9%). The trial included a 5-day adaptation period followed by an 80-day main trial period. Compared with the CON group, the HC group showed higher levels of GR, crude protein, EAAs, and several individual amino acids, while simultaneously reducing drip loss and improving cooking yield (p < 0.05). However, compared with the CON group, the HC group had a higher pH24 h value but lower b*24 h values, hardness, elasticity, cohesiveness, and chewiness; it also had the highest SFA content and the lowest PUFA, UFA, and n-6 contents. The LC and MC groups increased intramuscular fat content and reduced shear force (p < 0.05); among them, the MC group had the highest n-3 content (p < 0.05) and the lowest shear force. There were no significant differences in MUFA content. In summary, it is recommended that 6% HHRM be used as the appropriate addition level.
papers.abstract_zh: 為開發非常規飼料資源，本研究探討日糧中添加黑水虻幼蟲殘餘物（HHRM）對公湖羊羔羊屠體性狀、肉質、胺基酸及脂肪酸的影響。試驗選取48隻健康、3月齡的羔羊（24.33 ± 1.56公斤），隨機分為四組（每組12隻）：CON組（0%）、LC組（3%）、MC組（6%）及HC組（9%）。試驗包含5天適應期，隨後為80天的主試驗期。與CON組相比，HC組的GR值、粗蛋白質、必需胺基酸（EAAs）以及多種個別胺基酸含量較高，同時降低了滴水損失並改善了蒸煮失水率（p < 0.05）。然而，與CON組相比，HC組的24小時pH值（pH24 h）較高，但24小時黃度值（b*24 h）、硬度、彈性、黏聚性及咀嚼性較低；該組亦具有最高飽和脂肪酸（SFA）含量，以及最低的多元不飽和脂肪酸（PUFA）、不飽和脂肪酸（UFA）及n-6系列脂肪酸含量。LC組和MC組提高了肌間脂肪含量並降低了剪切力（p < 0.05）；其中，MC組的n-3系列脂肪酸含量最高（p < 0.05）且剪切力最低。單元不飽和脂肪酸（MUFA）含量則無顯著差異。綜上所述，建議HHRM的適宜添加比例為6%。

papers.title: The impact of Bacillus subtilis on gut health of poultry
papers.abstract: SUMMARYIt is essential to understand how natural feed additives, as alternatives to antibiotic use, can modulate the immune system and intestinal microbiota to regulate intestinal disorders and improve gut health. Probiotics are among the biological products that may serve as alternatives to synthetic additives in the modern era, as they meet food safety and eco-friendly standards. Bacillus subtilis has been shown to improve gut health in poultry. Dietary supplementation with B. subtilis can modulate the gut microbiome, reduce intestinal inflammation, and boost intestinal barrier function. The inclusion of B. subtilis in poultry feed has been shown to increase the abundance of lactobacilli and Bifidobacterium (by 6.83% and 3.80%, respectively) and reduced the abundance of harmful bacteria, including E. coli, Salmonella, and Clostridium, by 8.9%, 19.8%, and 31.77%, respectively, according to the reviewed studies. Supplementation with B. subtilis positively affected intestinal villus morphology. The improvement rates observed in previous studies following treatment with certain B. subtilis strains were 11.06% in the duodenum, 26.25% in the jejunum, and 19.92% in the ileum compared to the control group. B. subtilis spores can increase cytokine levels in the gut, such as interferon-γ and interleukin-1β, and release antimicrobial peptides that exhibit cytotoxicity towards bacterial pathogens. Feeding B. subtilis also upregulated gene expression of tight junction proteins, including claudin, occludin, and junctional adhesion molecule 2. Diets containing specific B. subtilis strains positively influenced the antioxidant system and digestive enzymes in poultry. This review article presents the most recent research investigating the beneficial effects of B. subtilis on the gastrointestinal tract integrity of poultry.
papers.abstract_zh:
摘要
理解天然飼料添加劑（作為抗生素使用的替代方案）如何調節免疫系統與腸道菌相，以調控腸道疾病並改善腸道健康，至關重要。益生菌是現代符合食品安全與環保標準、可作為合成添加劑替代品的生物製品之一。枯草芽孢桿菌（Bacillus subtilis）已被證實能改善家禽的腸道健康。在飼料中添加枯草芽孢桿菌可以調節腸道微生物相、減輕腸道發炎，並增強腸道屏障功能。根據文獻回顧，在家禽飼料中添加枯草芽孢桿菌，可使乳酸桿菌屬與雙歧桿菌屬的豐度分別增加 6.83% 與 3.80%，並使大腸桿菌、沙門氏菌及梭菌等有害細菌的豐度分別減少 8.9%、19.8% 與 31.77%。補充枯草芽孢桿菌對腸道絨毛形態有正向影響。與對照組相比，先前研究中觀察到特定枯草芽孢桿菌菌株處理後的改善率，在十二指腸為 11.06%、空腸為 26.25%、迴腸為 19.92%。枯草芽孢桿菌孢子可提高腸道中的細胞激素濃度（如干擾素-γ 與介白素-1β），並釋放對病原菌具有細胞毒性的抗菌肽。餵食枯草芽孢桿菌亦可上調緊密接合蛋白（包含閉鎖蛋白 claudin、occludin 及接合黏附分子 2）的基因表現。含有特定枯草芽孢桿菌菌株的飼料對家禽的抗氧化系統與消化酶有正向影響。本篇綜論文章旨在介紹探討枯草芽孢桿菌對家禽胃腸道完整性之有益影響的最新研究。

papers.title: Effects of Fermented and Unfermented Chinese Herbal Formulations on Laying Performance, Intestinal Health and Cecal Microbiota in Late-Phase Laying Hens
papers.abstract: The intestinal structure and function of laying hens undergo age-related degeneration, which can impair nutrient absorption and reduce production performance. Chinese herbal additives have been investigated for their potential benefits in supporting intestinal health and physiological function. In this study, a compound seven-herb formula was evaluated for its potential to support intestinal health in late-phase laying hens. The study aimed to compare the effects of unfermented and fermented herbal formulations on laying performance, egg quality, and intestinal health in late-phase laying hens. A total of 540 hens were randomly assigned to three groups (six replicates per group, 30 hens per replicate) and fed either a basal diet (Control), a diet supplemented with Chinese herbal medicine (CHM), or a diet supplemented with fermented Chinese herbal medicine (FHM) for 12 consecutive weeks. During weeks 9–12, egg production rate was significantly higher in the CHM and FHM groups than in the control group (p < 0.05). Over the entire experimental period, average egg weight was significantly higher in the FHM group than in the control and CHM groups (p < 0.05). Both treatments also improved selected indices of intestinal morphology, including villus height and the villus height-to-crypt depth ratio (p < 0.05). Additionally, serum concentrations of immunoglobulin A (IgA), the immunoglobulin reported as IgG, and immunoglobulin M (IgM) were significantly increased, whereas intestinal concentrations of interleukin-1β (IL-1β), interleukin-8 (IL-8), and transforming growth factor-β (TGF-β) were reduced in both treatment groups (p < 0.05). Both CHM and FHM supplementation reduced serum malondialdehyde (MDA) concentrations and increased superoxide dismutase (SOD) activity, although serum glutathione peroxidase (GSH-Px) activity was decreased (p < 0.05). Furthermore, FHM altered the cecal microbial composition and increased the concentrations of acetate, butyrate, and isovalerate. In conclusion, dietary herbal supplementation, particularly in fermented form, may improve selected production-performance traits and intestinal health in aged laying hens.
papers.abstract_zh: 產蛋雞的腸道結構與功能會隨著年齡增長而退化，進而妨礙營養物質吸收並降低生產性能。中草藥添加物因其在支持腸道健康與生理功能方面的潛在益處而受到研究探討。本研究旨在評估一項七味中藥複方對支持後期產蛋雞腸道健康的潛在作用，並比較未發酵與發酵中草藥配方對後期產蛋雞產蛋性能、雞蛋品質及腸道健康的影響。試驗共選用 540 隻產蛋雞，隨機分為三組（每組 6 個重複，每個重複 30 隻），分別餵食基礎日糧（對照組）、添加中草藥（CHM）的日糧，以及添加發酵中草藥（FHM）的日糧，持續餵食 12 週。在試驗第 9 至 12 週期間，CHM 組和 FHM 組的產蛋率顯著高於對照組（p < 0.05）。在整個試驗期間，FHM 組的平均蛋重顯著高於對照組和 CHM 組（p < 0.05）。這兩種處理均改善了部分腸道形態學指標，包括絨毛高度及絨毛高度與隱窩深度比值（p < 0.05）。此外，兩處理組的血清免疫球蛋白 A（IgA）、類 IgG 免疫球蛋白及免疫球蛋白 M（IgM）濃度顯著增加，而腸道中的介白素-1β（IL-1β）、介白素-8（IL-8）及轉化生長因子-β（TGF-β）濃度則降低（p < 0.05）。補充 CHM 與 FHM 均能降低血清丙二醛（MDA）濃度並提高超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）活性，儘管血清麩胱甘肽過氧化酶（GSH-Px）活性降低（p < 0.05）。再者，FHM 改變了盲腸微生物組成，並提高了乙酸、丁酸及異戊酸的濃度。總結而言，日糧中添加中草藥，特別是發酵形式，可改善高齡產蛋雞的部分生產性能特徵與腸道健康。

papers.title: Dietary vitamin C improves reproductive performance by increasing antioxidant capacity, steroid hormone concentration and expression of genes involved in steroid hormone synthesis in Yangzhou geese
papers.abstract: 1. This study aimed to evaluate the effects of dietary ascorbic acid (vitamin C) supplementation on the reproductive performance, follicular development, antioxidant capacity, serum steroid hormone concentration and expression of genes involved in steroid hormone synthesis in Yangzhou geese.2. A total of 540, 221-day-old geese (450 females and 90 males) were randomly divided into five groups that received different diets. Treatments included vitamin C levels of 0, 100, 200, 300 or 400 mg/kg, respectively.3. Dietary vitamin C supplementation led to a highly significant linear increase in laying rate (p < 0.01), with significant improvements detected at 300 mg/kg and 400 mg/kg (p < 0.01). Thus, within the supplement range of 0–400 mg/kg, graded additions of vitamin C linearly improved reproductive performance with economic benefits. In consideration of commercial breeding practices together with the observed physiological and productive indices, dietary vitamin C supplementation at 300 mg/kg was effective.4. Feeding 300 mg/kg prompted oestradiol and progesterone concentrations in both serum and hierarchical follicular yolks (p < 0.05) and the number of primordial follicles increased significantly (p < 0.01). This level of vitamin C in the feed resulted in elevated activity levels of total antioxidant capacity, superoxide dismutase and catalase in both serum and follicles, along with a reduction in malondialdehyde levels.5. Dietary supplementation with 300 mg/kg vitamin C increased the expressions of StAR, HSD3B1 and CYP11A1 in granulosa layer. Similar expression patterns of CYP17A1, CYP19A1, HSD3B1 and HSD17B1 were detected in the theca layer.
papers.abstract_zh:
1. 本研究旨在評估日糧中補充抗壞血酸（維生素C）對揚州鵝繁殖性能、卵泡發育、抗氧化能力、血清類固醇激素濃度及類固醇激素合成相關基因表現之影響。
2. 試驗選取 540 隻 221 日齡之揚州鵝（公鵝 90 隻、母鵝 450 隻），隨機分為五組並飼喂不同日糧。處理組之維生素C添加量分別為 0、100、200、300 及 400 mg/kg。
3. 日糧補充維生素C使產蛋率呈極顯著的線性增加（p < 0.01），且在添加 300 mg/kg 和 400 mg/kg 時檢測到顯著改善（p < 0.01）。因此，在 0–400 mg/kg 的補充範圍內，分級添加維生素C能以具經濟效益的方式線性改善繁殖性能。綜合商業育種實務以及觀察到的生理與生產指標，日糧補充 300 mg/kg 的維生素C效果最佳。
4. 飼喂 300 mg/kg 可促進血清及級別卵泡卵黃中的雌二醇與黃體素濃度（p < 0.05），且原始卵泡數量顯著增加（p < 0.01）。此飼料維生素C水平使血清及卵泡中的總抗氧化能力、超氧化物歧化酶和過氧化氫酶活性水平升高，同時降低丙二醛水平。
5. 日糧補充 300 mg/kg 維生素C提高了顆粒層中 StAR、HSD3B1 和 CYP11A1 的表現量。在膜層中也檢測到 CYP17A1、CYP19A1、HSD3B1 和 HSD17B1 具有相似的表現模式。

papers.title: Characterizing Runs of Homozygosity and Inbreeding in American Mink Using SNP Data and Pedigree Information
papers.abstract: Inbreeding increases the likelihood of deleterious recessive alleles becoming homozygous and consequently affecting economically important traits. Runs of homozygosity (ROH), the continuous homozygous segments of the genome and the higher than expected homozygosity (HOM) are genomic indicators of inbreeding, quantified as F ROH and F HOM , respectively. Previous ROH analyses in American mink ( Neogale vison ) were restricted to scaffold‐level references and could not resolve long autozygous segments. In this study, we characterized ROH in 1413 mink genotyped with the Affymetrix Mink 70K panel (50,902 autosomal SNPs after quality control) on the chromosome‐level genome assembly and compared F ROH with F HOM and with pedigree‐based inbreeding (F PED ) derived from 24,633 pedigree records. ROH were detected in all individuals, with a mean of 149.61 ± 13.82 segments per individual. Segments longer than 8 Mb, not detectable in earlier studies of this population, represented 12.86% of all ROH and accounted for 0.10 of the mean F ROH of 0.28. Mean F HOM and F PED were −0.03 and 0.02, respectively. ROH were unevenly distributed across chromosomes and chromosomes 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 and 11 harboured 78.59% of all segments. The Pearson correlation coefficient was highest (0.72) between F ROH and F HOM and moderate (0.34) between genomic inbreeding and F PED , increasing with ROH length to 0.35 for segments longer than 16 Mb. Because the density of the marker panel limits the resolution of short segments, quantitative inference was restricted to ROH longer than 4 Mb. Our results indicate that recent autozygosity in this closed population is concentrated in a small number of long genomic segments, providing an opportunity to inform mating decisions.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Breeding and Genetics
papers.abstract_zh: 近親交配會增加有害隱性等立基因成為純合子的機率，進而影響具經濟重要性的性狀。純合連續片段（runs of homozygosity, ROH）是基因體中連續的純合片段，而高於預期的純合度（homozygosity, HOM）則是近親交配的基因體指標，分別以 $F_{ROH}$ 與 $F_{HOM}$ 來量化。先前對美洲水貂（*Neogale vison*）的 ROH 分析受限於鷹架層級（scaffold-level）的參考基因體，無法解析長型的同源接合（autozygous）片段。在本研究中，我們使用基於染色體層級基因體組裝的 Affymetrix 水貂 70K 晶片（經品質控制後包含 50,902 個體染色體 SNP），對 1,413 隻水貂的 ROH 進行了特性分析，並將 $F_{ROH}$ 與 $F_{HOM}$ 以及源自 24,633 筆譜系紀錄的譜系近親交配係數（$F_{PED}$）進行比較。所有個體均偵測到 ROH，平均每個個體有 $149.61 \pm 13.82$ 個片段。長於 8 Mb 的片段（在該族群先前的研究中無法被偵測）佔所有 ROH 的 $12.86\%$，並佔平均 $F_{ROH}$（0.28）中的 0.10。平均 $F_{HOM}$ 與 $F_{PED}$ 分別為 -0.03 與 0.02。ROH 在染色體上的分布不均，其中第 1、2、3、4、6 和 11 號染色體包含了所有片段的 $78.59\%$。$F_{ROH}$ 與 $F_{HOM}$ 之間的皮爾森相關係數最高（0.72），基因體近親交配與 $F_{PED}$ 之間則呈中等相關（0.34），且隨著 ROH 長度增加而上升，對於長於 16 Mb 的片段其相關係數可達 0.35。由於標記晶片的密度限制了短片段的解析度，因此數量推論僅限於長於 4 Mb 的 ROH。我們的結果顯示，這個封閉族群近期的同源接合現象集中於少數幾個長基因體片段中，這為指導交配決策提供了契機。

papers.title: Early-life microbial contact with adult hens modulates cecal microbiota and mitigates host responses to lipopolysaccharide-induced stress in broilers
papers.abstract: Background In commercial production, the absence of adult hens disrupts natural gut colonization, forcing chicks to rely on environmental microbes and potentially compromising the ecological succession essential for health. This study investigated whether early-life adult hen microbial contact could optimize the intestinal community and metabolite profiles, thereby mitigating lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced immunological stress in broilers. Accordingly, 128 one-day-old broilers were assigned to control or adult hen microbial contact groups. Hens were removed on D 10, and LPS was administered on D 18 and D 20, resulting in a 2 × 2 factorial design. Results Adult hen microbial contact did not affect body weight or ileal histomorphology on D 10 or D 21. However, it reshaped the alpha diversity ( P < 0.05) and beta diversity ( P < 0.05) of the cecal microbiota, enriching beneficial genera such as Bacteroides , Prevotellaceae , Rikenellaceae , Muribaculaceae , and Megasphaera , although these were not primarily established through direct adult hen transfer. These microbial alterations were accompanied by increased production of cecal volatile fatty acids ( P < 0.05) and altered tryptophan metabolism ( P < 0.05), characterized by the conversion of serum tryptophan to indoleacetic acid. In the ileum, the adult hen microbial contact upregulated ( P < 0.05) genes associated with mucosal barrier integrity ( MUC13 , CLDN2 ) and antioxidant defense ( SOD2 , FOXO1 ), while independently downregulating ( P < 0.05) hepatic genes involved in redox regulation and autophagy ( GRX5 , LC3-1 ). LPS challenge induced a pronounced ( P < 0.05) antioxidant imbalance in the ileum, characterized by the downregulation of CAT and NRF2 , together with elevated expression of pro-inflammatory cytokines ( IL8 , IFNA , TNFA ), compromising barrier function ( MUC13 , CLDN2 ). Concurrently, the LPS challenge increased ( P < 0.05) the expression of hepatic genes involved in redox regulation and autophagy ( GRX5 , LC3-1 ), consistent with a systemic stress response. Notably, microbial contact attenuated the LPS-induced reduction in valeric acid ( P < 0.05), suggesting a protective effect on microbial metabolite production under immunological stress. Conclusion Adult hen microbial contact did not improve growth performance or ileal histomorphology, but shaped the early-life gut microbiota and associated metabolite profiles, contributing to improved resilience to subsequent immune challenges in broilers.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Science and Biotechnology
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：在商業化生產中，成年母雞的缺失會打亂自然的腸道定殖，迫使雛雞依賴環境微生物，進而可能危害對健康至關重要的生態演替。本研究旨在探討早期接觸成年母雞微生物是否能優化腸道菌相與代謝物譜，從而減輕脂多醣（LPS）誘導的肉雞免疫壓力。因此，將 128 隻一日齡肉雞分派至對照組或成年母雞微生物接觸組。母雞於第 10 天移出，並於第 18 天和第 20 天注射 LPS，形成 2 × 2 因子設計。結果：成年母雞微生物接觸對第 10 天或第 21 天的體重或迴腸組織形態無顯著影響。然而，它重塑了盲腸微生物相的阿伐多樣性（$\text{P} < 0.05$）與貝塔多樣性（$\text{P} < 0.05$），豐富了諸如擬桿菌屬（*Bacteroides*）、普雷沃菌科（*Prevotellaceae*）、理研菌科（*Rikenellaceae*）、毛螺菌科相關屬（*Muribaculaceae*）和巨球型菌屬（*Megasphaera*）等有益屬，儘管這些菌群主要並非透過成年母雞的直接轉移而建立。這些微生物的改變伴隨著盲腸揮發性脂肪酸產量的增加（$\text{P} < 0.05$）以及色胺酸代謝的改變（$\text{P} < 0.05$），其特徵為血清色胺酸轉化為吲哚乙酸。在迴腸中，成年母雞微生物接觸上調了（$\text{P} < 0.05$）與黏膜屏障完整性（*MUC13*、*CLDN2*）和抗氧化防禦（*SOD2*、*FOXO1*）相關的基因，同時獨立地下調了（$\text{P} < 0.05$）參與氧化還原調節與自噬的肝臟基因（*GRX5*、*LC3-1*）。LPS 攻擊導致迴腸產生顯著的（$\text{P} < 0.05$）抗氧化失衡，其特徵為 *CAT* 和 *Nrf2* 的下調，以及促發炎細胞激素（*IL8*、*IFNA*、*TNFA*）表達的升高，進而損害屏障功能（*MUC13*、*CLDN2*）。同時，LPS 攻擊增加了（$\text{P} < 0.05$）參與氧化還原調節與自噬的肝臟基因（*GRX5*、*LC3-1*）之表達，這與全身性壓力反應一致。值得注意的是，微生物接觸減輕了 LPS 引起的戊酸降低（$\text{P} < 0.05$），這表明其對免疫壓力下微生物代謝物的產生物理保護作用。結論：成年母雞微生物接觸雖未改善生長性能或迴腸組織形態，但塑造了早期腸道微生物相及相關的代謝物譜，有助於提高肉雞對後續免疫挑戰的抵禦能力。

papers.title: Detection and Persistence of Human Semen and DNA on Animal Fur: Implications for Forensic Investigation of Animal Sexual Abuse
papers.abstract: Animal sexual abuse (ASA) involves the sexual molestation of animals by humans. Forensic DNA analysis of human biological fluids on animal fur may provide investigative leads to a potential suspect. This study was the first to longitudinally assess the recovery of human semen and DNA from three fur models: freshly dissected baboon fur, preserved antelope hides and faux fur. Daily swabbing consistently demonstrated that DNA profiles could be generated from semen over the 14-day study period. Samples in baboon fur typically had greater degradation and yielded lower DNA concentrations compared to other fur models investigated. Although the baboon model best represented a deceased animal, experiments beyond 14 days were limited by decomposition. This study highlights the challenge of selecting a suitable fur model and demonstrates that model choice may influence DNA retention over time. Future research should consider models representing living animals and investigate dynamic variables (e.g., movement, body heat) on semen and DNA retention on animal fur. Overall, this study provides proof of concept and constitutes the first baseline data pertaining to evidence retention in the context of ASA. These findings support the application of forensic molecular techniques in ASA investigations.
papers.abstract_zh: 動物性虐待（Animal sexual abuse, ASA）涉及人類對動物的性侵犯。對動物毛皮上的人類生物體液進行法醫DNA分析，可為潛在嫌疑人提供偵查線索。本研究首次採縱向評估，自三種毛皮模型中回收人類精液與DNA：新鮮解剖的狒狒毛皮、保存的羚羊皮以及人造毛皮。每日的拭子採樣持續顯示，在為期14天的研究期間內，皆可自精液取得DNA圖譜。與其他研究的毛皮模型相比，狒狒毛皮中的樣本通常降解較嚴重且產出較低的DNA濃度。儘管狒狒模型最能代表死亡動物，但超過14天的實驗受到腐敗過程的限制。本研究凸顯了選擇合適毛皮模型的挑戰，並證明模型的選擇可能會影響DNA隨時間的保存。未來研究應考慮代表活體動物的模型，並探討動態變數（例如運動、體溫）對動物毛皮上精液與DNA保存的影響。總體而言，本研究提供了概念驗證，並構成了首批與ASA情境下證據保存相關的基準數據。這些發現支持法醫分子技術在ASA調查中的應用。

papers.title: Effect of Rearing System and Season on Herbage Intake, Performance and Meat Nutritional Quality of Growing Rabbits
papers.abstract: Consumer demand for sustainable and animal-friendly systems has driven interest in alternative livestock management; however, its impact on productive performance and meat quality requires further validation. This study monitored outdoor-reared rabbits during the spring and autumn seasons over a 48 d experimental period, comparing this alternative system to cage-reared rabbits slaughtered at a fixed age (80 d). Forage and energy intakes were evaluated alongside a post-slaughter analysis of muscle lipid content, fatty acid profiles, and tocopherol deposition. Meat oxidative stability was assessed by measuring thiobarbituric acid reactive substances (TBARS). Data were analyzed using mixed linear models and Principal Component Analysis (PCA). The results demonstrate that pasture-based rabbit systems offer a suitable alternative to conventional cages. Although pasture access significantly reduced growth performance, with average daily gain dropping by up to 7.24 g/day and digestible energy intake decreasing by approximately 6.20 MJ in autumn-reared rabbits, it enhanced meat quality by yielding leaner muscle profiles and higher levels of n-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFAs). Furthermore, although pasture-based systems are widely reported to increase physical activity—potentially elevating metabolic rate and oxidative load—the concurrent intake of natural antioxidants from fresh forage effectively maintained high oxidative stability in meat. Ultimately, these findings validate pasture-based systems as a viable approach to delivering high-quality meat within sustainable, welfare-friendly production frameworks.
papers.abstract_zh: 消費者對永續且動物友善飼養系統的需求，帶動了對替代性家畜管理模式的興趣；然而其對生產性能與肉質的影響仍需進一步驗證。本研究在春季與秋季對戶外飼養的兔子進行了為期48天的實驗監測，將此替代系統與固定屠宰年齡（80日齡）的籠飼兔子進行比較。評估了牧草與能量攝取量，並進行了屠宰後肌肉脂質含量、脂肪酸組成及生育酚沉積的分析。透過測定硫代巴比妥酸反應物（TBARS）來評估肉品的抗氧化穩定性。數據採用混合線性模型與主成分分析（PCA）進行分析。結果顯示，放牧兔隻系統可作為傳統籠飼的合適替代方案。儘管放牧顯著降低了生長性能，秋季飼養兔隻的平均每日增重下降高達7.24公克/天，且可消化能量攝取量減少約6.20百萬焦耳（MJ），但它透過產生較瘦的肌肉組織及較高水準的n-3多元不飽和脂肪酸（PUFAs），提升了肉品品質。此外，雖然廣泛報導指出放牧系統會增加體能活動——可能提高代謝率與氧化負擔，但同時攝取新鮮牧草中的天然抗氧化劑，有效地維持了肉品的高抗氧化穩定性。總體而言，這些發現證實了放牧系統作為在永續且兼顧動物福利的生產框架下提供高品質肉類的可行方法。

papers.title: Effects of Bacillus licheniformis Supplementation on Laying Performance, Antioxidant Capacity, and Cecal Microbiota in Post-Peak Laying Hens
papers.abstract: Bacillus licheniformis, a multifunctional probiotic, improves performance in peak laying hens, but its effects during post-peak laying—characterized by declining ovarian function, impaired intestinal barrier, and oxidative stress—remain unclear. This study evaluated the effects of dietary B. licheniformis on laying performance, antioxidant and immune parameters, intestinal morphology, cecal microbiota, and fermentation metabolites in post-peak-phase laying hens. A total of 720 forty-three-week-old laying hens were randomly assigned to four treatments: a basal diet or the basal diet supplemented with B. licheniformis at 2.5 × 109, 5 × 109, or 1 × 1010 CFU/kg for 31 days. Supplementation at 5 × 109 CFU/kg consistently improved the laying rate from 78.96 ± 0.47% to 80.40 ± 0.64% (+1.44 percentage points, p = 0.0091) and decreased the feed-to-egg ratio from 2.53 ± 0.02 to 2.47 ± 0.02 (−2.4 percentage points, p = 0.005). It enhanced systemic antioxidant capacity, as indicated by a decrease in serum MDA (35.8% p = 0.002) and increases in GSH-Px (33.2%, p = 0.002) and SOD (56.0%, p = 0.011). Jejunal and ileal villus height and villus-to-crypt ratio were also increased (p < 0.05). Cecal microbiota shifted toward a higher relative abundance of Clostridia_UCG-014 (p = 0.006) and norank_o_RF39 (p = 0.017) and a lower abundance of Megasphaera (p = 0.009), whereas individual and total VFA concentrations did not differ among groups (p > 0.05). In conclusion, 5 × 109 CFU/kg B. licheniformis exerted the most consistent benefits in post-peak-phase laying hens, likely through the modulation of gut microbiota, intestinal barrier integrity, and antioxidant status. These findings support B. licheniformis as a promising probiotic for sustainable laying-hen production.
papers.abstract_zh: 地衣芽孢桿菌（Bacillus licheniformis）是一種多功能益生菌，能改善產蛋高峰期產蛋雞的生產性能，但其對產蛋高峰期後（以卵巢功能下降、腸道屏障受損及氧化壓力為特徵）產蛋雞的效果仍不清楚。本研究旨在評估飼糧中添加地衣芽孢桿菌對產蛋高峰期後產蛋雞之產蛋性能、抗氧化與免疫參數、腸道形態、盲腸微生物相及發酵代謝產物的影響。試驗選用 720 隻 43 週齡產蛋雞，隨機分為四個處理組：基礎飼糧組，以及基礎飼糧分別添加 2.5 × 10⁹、5 × 10⁹ 或 1 × 10¹⁰ CFU/kg 地衣芽孢桿菌，試驗期為 31 天。結果顯示，添加 5 × 10⁹ CFU/kg 的地衣芽孢桿菌可持續提升產蛋率，從 78.96 ± 0.47% 增加至 80.40 ± 0.64%（+1.44 個百分點，p = 0.0091），並降低料蛋比，從 2.53 ± 0.02 降至 2.47 ± 0.02（−2.4 個百分點，p = 0.005）。此添加量亦增強了全身抗氧化能力，表現為血清丙二醛（MDA）降低（35.8%，p = 0.002），以及麩胱甘肽過氧化酶（GSH-Px，33.2%，p = 0.002）與超氧化物歧化酶（SOD，56.0%，p = 0.011）活性增加。空腸與迴腸的絨毛高度及絨毛高度與隱窩深度比值亦顯著增加（p < 0.05）。在盲腸微生物相方面，Clostridia_UCG-014（p = 0.006）和 norank_o_RF39（p = 0.017）的相對豐度增加，而巨球形菌屬（Megasphaera）的豐度降低（p = 0.009），各組間的個別及總揮發性脂肪酸（VFA）濃度則無顯著差異（p > 0.05）。綜上所述，添加 5 × 10⁹ CFU/kg 的地衣芽孢桿菌對產蛋高峰期後產蛋雞產生最顯著且一致的益處，這可能透過調節腸道微生物相、腸道屏障完整性及抗氧化狀態來實現。這些結果支持地作為促進蛋雞永續生產之潛力益生菌。

papers.title: Genomic architecture of non-nominal offspring risk in a simulated composite cattle breed
papers.abstract: Background Composite cattle breeds are designed to combine complementary attributes from different founder breeds while retaining part of the heterosis generated by crossbreeding. Brangus cattle are nominally defined as 5/8 Angus and 3/8 Brahman, but the same global breed composition can be produced by different genomic architectures. This distinction may be important because animals with the same Brahman ancestry proportion may differ in ancestry heterozygosity, homozygous ancestry composition and segregation behaviour when used as parents. The objective of this study was to use controlled simulations to evaluate whether genomic architecture affects the risk of producing offspring outside the nominal Brangus ancestry range. Results We simulated two alternative pathways to the same expected Brahman ancestry proportion of 0.375. Although both pathways produced similar mean Brahman ancestry, the direct pathway generated a broader ancestry distribution than the indirect pathway, with a higher proportion of individuals outside the nominal interval. After filtering candidate sires to the nominal interval, formation-pathway-dependent genomic architectures remained evident. In a mixed inter se mating analysis extended to 100 generations and three population-size scenarios, pathway-specific ancestry-state differences were progressively eroded and the standard deviation of Brahman ancestry proportion declined after an early maximum, but non-nominal frequencies remained non-negligible over the simulated time horizon. Family-level simulations showed that matings between nominal parents differed substantially in their probability of producing non-nominal daughters. This risk depended on both the distance between the expected family mean and the target ancestry and the block-weighted segregation potential of the parental genomes. An exploratory quasibinomial model supported positive associations between non-nominal risk and displacement from the target and high-variance parental block structures. Finally, a heuristic-assisted simulation-informed sire allocation strategy increased the proportion of nominal daughters relative to random sire allocation, with the greatest gains obtained from broader sire catalogues. Conclusions Nominal breed composition does not define a unique genomic state. In simulated Brangus cattle, animals that were equivalent in global ancestry could differ in genomic architecture and in the offspring ancestry distributions generated by specific matings. These results suggest that composite-breed management should consider not only the ancestry proportion of individual animals, but also the expected outcome of sire–dam pairs.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：複合肉牛品種旨在結合不同創始品種的互補特徵，同時保留雜交產生的部分雜種優勢。布蘭格斯牛（Brangus）的名義品種組成定義為 5/8 安格斯牛與 3/8 婆羅門牛，然而相同的整體品種組成可能由不同的基因體架構所產生。這項區別可能很重要，因為具有相同婆羅門牛血統比例的動物，在作為親本使用時，其血統雜合度、純合血統組成與分離行為可能會有所不同。本研究的目的在於利用控制模擬來評估基因體架構是否會影響產生超出名義布蘭格斯牛血統範圍後代之風險。結果：我們模擬了達到相同預期婆羅門牛血統比例 0.375 的兩種不同途徑。儘管這兩種途徑產生了相似的平均婆羅門牛血統，但直接途徑產生的血統分佈比間接途徑更廣，且落在名義區間之外的個體比例更高。在將候選種公牛篩選至名義區間後，取決於培育途徑的基因體架構仍然十分顯著。在延伸至 100 個世代及三種族群大小情境的混合自交分析中，特定途徑的血統狀態差異逐漸被抹平，且婆羅門牛血統比例標準差在達到早期最大值後下降，但在模擬的時間範圍內，非名義頻率仍然不可忽視。家族層級的模擬顯示，名義親本之間的交配在產生非名義後代母牛的機率上有顯著差異。此風險取決於預期家族平均值與目標血統之間的距離，以及親本基因體的區塊加權分離潛能。探索性擬二項式模型支持非名義風險與偏離目標及高變異親本區塊結構之間的正相關性。最後，與隨機分配種公牛相比，啟發式輔助的模擬資訊種公牛分配策略提高了名義後代母牛的比例，其中以較廣泛的種公牛目錄獲得的增幅最大。結論：名義品種組成並不能定義唯一的基因體狀態。在模擬的布蘭格斯牛中，整體血統相同的動物在基因體架構以及特定交配所產生的後代血統分佈上可能有所不同。這些結果表明，複合品種的管理不僅應考慮個體動物的血統比例，還應考慮公母牛配對的預期結果。

papers.title: Determination and Prediction of Standardized Mineral Availabilities in Different Sources of Soybean Meals for Broilers
papers.abstract: This study was conducted to estimate the standardized mineral availabilities (SMAs) of 10 soybean meals (SBMs) fed to broilers, and prediction models were developed and validated based on chemical properties. A total of 308 broilers (22 d of age), having similar initial body weights, were assigned at random to 11 dietary groups, with 7 replicate cages per group and 4 broilers per cage. On d 26, the broilers were given 4 h access to either a mineral-free diet or 10 test SBM-formulated diets. Fecal collection then proceeded for 52 h for SMA measurement. SMA-prediction models were established via stepwise regression using data from 9 SBMs, with the remaining SBM randomly used to validate the models’ accuracy. Soybean meal source influenced (p < 0.02) SMAs in broilers. Manganese (Mn) exhibited the lowest standardized availability (SA) at 30.4%, whereas calcium (Ca) showed the highest SA at 66.2%. Six prediction models for SAs of potassium (K), Ca, phosphorus (P), zinc (Zn), Mn, and copper (Cu) in SBMs for broilers were developed from the chemical properties, exhibiting R2 values spanning 0.487 to 0.964 (p < 0.04). The prediction model for standardized Ca availability provided the best goodness-of-fit (R2 = 0.964, p < 0.001). By contrast, this model for standardized Cu availability performed the worst (R2 = 0.487, p = 0.037). Except for Zn and Mn, the predicted SAs for Ca, P, K, and Cu were generally consistent with the measured values. Taken together, the constructed prediction models in our work can serve as a reliable tool for quickly predicting the SAs of Ca, P, K, and Cu in SBMs for broilers.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在評估肉雞餵食 10 種大豆粕（SBM）之標準化礦物質可用率（SMAs），並基於化學特性建立與驗證預測模式。總共 308 隻初始體重相近的肉雞（22 日齡）被隨機分配至 11 個飲食組，每組 7 個重複籠，每籠 4 隻肉雞。在 26 日齡時，肉雞限時 4 小時攝食無礦物質飼糧或 10 種試驗大豆粕配製飼糧。隨後進行 52 小時的糞便收集以測定 SMA。利用其中 9 種大豆粕的數據透過逐步迴歸建立 SMA 預測模式，剩餘的 10 分之 1 大豆粕則隨機用於驗證模式的準確性。大豆粕來源會影響肉雞的 SMA（p < 0.02）。錳（Mn）的標準化可用率（SA）最低，為 30.4%，而鈣（Ca）的 SA 最高，為 66.2%。本研究根據化學特性建立了肉雞大豆粕中鉀（K）、鈣、磷（P）、鋅（Zn）、錳和銅（Cu）等 6 種 SA 的預測模式，其 $R^2$ 值介於 0.487 至 0.964 之間（p < 0.04）。標準化鈣可用率的預測模式具有最佳的配適度（$R^2 = 0.964$，p < 0.001）。相對地，標準化銅可用率的預測模式表現最差（$R^2 = 0.487$，p = 0.037）。除鋅和錳外，鈣、磷、鉀和銅的預測 SA 與實測值大致一致。綜上所述，本研究中所建構的預測模式可作為快速預測肉雞大豆粕中鈣、磷、鉀和銅之 SA 的可靠工具。

papers.title: From Microbiome Associations to Deployable Precision Probiotics in Animals: A Critical Narrative Review and Proposed Causal Evidence Framework for Next-Generation Probiotic Development
papers.abstract: Next-generation probiotics (NGPs) are promoted as precision tools for animal health, yet the term is often applied to uncommon taxa before causality, safety and target-species efficacy are established. This critical narrative review reframes animal NGPs as a development pathway rather than a taxonomic category. A structured PubMed search was last run on 14 September 2026 with a publication date cutoff of 1 September 2026 and was supplemented by citation tracing and targeted searches of authoritative sources. From the screened literature, 45 representative and conceptually informative sources were purposively selected for the final narrative synthesis; the review was not intended to provide systematic or exhaustive coverage. The detailed synthesis focused on terrestrial farm and companion animals, whereas equine, rabbit and aquaculture studies were treated as boundary evidence. We evaluate how strain-resolved metagenomics, culturomics, metatranscriptomics, metaproteomics, metabolomics, host transcriptomics, machine learning, metabolic modeling and perturbation systems can move discovery beyond association. Studies across animal sectors show many biomarkers but limited causal validation, strain tracking, formulation data, multisite trials and ecological safety assessment. We propose an author-developed conceptual framework comprising a cumulative evidence ladder, from reproducible associations to field-ready deployment, and the ANIMAL-NGP reporting checklist (Animal endotype, Native ecological fit, Identity and genomic safety, Mechanism, Administration and manufacturing, and Longitudinal validation). These tools are intended to align claims with evidence and require prospective application and external validation. Multi-omics should therefore function as an evidence-navigation system, not as a substitute for causality.
papers.abstract_zh: 新一代益生菌（NGPs）被推廣為促進動物健康的精準工具，然而在確立其因果關係、安全性與標的物種效用之前，此術語往往就被應用於罕見的分類群。本篇批判性敘述性文獻回顧將動物新一代益生菌重新界定為一條發展途徑，而非一個分類學範疇。結構化 PubMed 檢索最後於 2026 年 9 月 14 日執行，出版日期截止至 2026 年 9 月 1 日，並輔以引文追蹤及對權威來源的針對性檢索。從篩選出的文獻中，有目的性地選出 45 篇具代表性且具概念性資訊的來源進行最終的敘述性綜合；本回顧並非旨在提供系統性或全面性的涵蓋。詳細的綜合分析聚焦於陸生家畜與伴侶動物，而馬、兔及水產養殖的研究則被視為邊界證據。我們評估了菌株解析巨基因體學、培養體學、巨轉錄體學、巨蛋白質體學、代謝體學、宿主轉錄體學、機器學習、代謝建模與擾動系統如何能推動發現超越單純的相關性。跨動物領域的研究顯示，許多生物標記但有限的因果驗證、菌株追蹤、配方數據、多中心試驗與生態安全性評估。我們提出了一個由作者發展的概念框架，包含一個從可重複的相關性到可現場部署的累積證據階梯，以及 ANIMAL-NGP 報告檢核表（動物內表現型 [Endotype]、原生生態適應性 [Native ecological fit]、身分與基因體安全性 [Identity and genomic safety]、機制 [Mechanism]、給藥與製造 [Administration and manufacturing]、以及縱向驗證 [Longitudinal validation]）。這些工具旨在使宣稱與證據一致，並需要前瞻性應用與外部驗證。因此，多體學應作為一個證據導航系統，而非因果關係的替代品。

papers.title: A Nelore Cattle Structural Variant Catalog
papers.abstract: Structural variants (SVs) contribute more nucleotide divergence between mammalian genomes than single nucleotide polymorphisms, yet no population‐scale, long‐read‐validated SV catalog has been available for Bos indicus cattle. Nelore, the most numerically important indicine breed worldwide, diverges substantially from the taurine‐derived reference genome used for most bovine SV discovery, leaving its structural variation largely uncharacterized. Long‐read sequencing of 20 Nelore bulls with two complementary callers (Sniffles2, SVIM) yielded 82 581 dual‐caller concordant SVs, of which 74 222 insertions and deletions passed independent read‐based validation. Ensembl VEP annotation identified 561 HIGH‐impact variants (0.75% of the catalog) across 7040 protein‐coding genes. Only 22 894 SVs (30.7%), including 147 of 561 HIGH‐impact variants (26.2%), could be tagged by an existing BovineHD SNP ( r 2 ≥ 0.8), showing that routine array genotyping captures a minority of this variation. Intersection with an indicine‐ancestry SNP map identified 6114 SVs (8.2%) enriched in Bos indicus , including 61 HIGH‐impact variants overlapping genes with plausible roles in immune/inflammatory defense and oxidative‐stress response, providing a resource and candidate variant set for genomic selection and tropical‐adaptation studies in indicine cattle.
papers.abstract_zh: 相較於單核苷酸多型性，結構變異（SVs）對哺乳動物基因組間的核苷酸差異貢獻更大，然而過去一直缺乏針對印度牛（Bos indicus）的群體規模、長讀長驗證之結構變異目錄。內羅爾牛（Nelore）是全球數量最重要的印度牛品種，與多數牛隻結構變異發現所使用的牛屬參考基因組（源自歐亞牛）存在顯著分化，導致其結構變異在很大程度上仍未被充分解析。本研究對20頭內羅爾公牛進行長讀長定序，並結合兩種互補的呼叫軟體（Sniffles2、SVIM），共得出82,581個雙軟體一致的結構變異，其中74,222個插入與刪除通過了獨立的基於讀長的驗證。Ensembl VEP註釋在7,040個蛋白質編碼基因中識別出561個高影響（HIGH-impact）變異（佔目錄的0.75%）。僅有22,894個結構變異（30.7%）——包含561個高影響變異中的147個（26.2%）——可被現有的BovineHD SNP晶片標記（$r^2 \ge 0.8$），顯示常規晶片基因型分型僅能捕捉此類變異的一小部分。透過與印度牛祖先成分SNP圖譜交集，識別出6114個在印度牛中顯著富集的結構變異（8.2%），其中包括61個高影響變異，這些變異與在免疫/發炎防禦及氧化壓力反應中具有合理功能的基因重疊，為印度牛的基因體選育與熱帶適應研究提供了資源與候選變異集。

papers.title: Mitochondrial Dysfunction Across Multiple Organs in Broilers Exhibiting Wooden Breast Myopathy
papers.abstract: Wooden breast (WB) in broilers has been linked to impaired mitochondrial function in the breast muscle. When mitochondrial function declines, organs receive less ATP and experience oxidative stress. Muscle development is linked to the optimal function of the gut, liver, and pancreas, which depends on adequate ATP to support nutrient absorption and metabolism. The effects of the WB myopathy on other organs and tissues within broilers are relatively unknown. The aim of this study was to investigate factors linked to mitochondrial function in multiple organs from broilers exhibiting WB. From sixty 8-week-old broilers, ten severe WB and ten normal breast muscles were selected for tissue collection (liver, pancreas, three sections of intestine, and breast muscle). Reduced citrate synthase activity and mitochondrial complex-II activity were observed in the muscle, pancreas, liver and duodenum tissues of WB broilers compared to normal broilers. Broilers with WB had reduced glutathione content in the pancreas and all three sections of the intestine when compared to normal broilers. Whole tissue ATP content was decreased in the muscle and liver of WB broilers. Overall, these data suggest that mitochondrial function may be impaired in tissues beyond just the breast muscle in broilers that exhibit the WB myopathy.
papers.abstract_zh: 肉雞的木胸症（Wooden breast, WB）已被認為與胸肌粒線體功能受損有關。當粒線體功能下降時，器官獲得的 ATP 減少並會經歷氧化壓力。肌肉發育與腸道、肝臟和胰臟的最佳功能息息相關，而這有賴於充足的 ATP 來支援營養物質的吸收與代謝。木胸病變對肉雞體內其他器官和組織的影響目前所知相對有限。本研究旨在探討表現出木胸症肉雞多個器官中與粒線體功能相關的因素。從六十隻 8 週齡肉雞中，選出十個嚴重木胸症與十個正常胸肌進行組織採樣（肝臟、胰臟、三段腸道及胸肌）。與正常肉雞相比，木胸症肉雞的肌肉、胰臟、肝臟和十二指腸組織中的檸檬酸合成酶活性和粒線體複合物 II 活性均降低。與正常肉雞相比，木胸症肉雞在胰臟和三段腸道中的穀胱甘肽含量皆減少。木胸症肉雞的肌肉和肝臟中全組織 ATP 含量降低。總體而言，這些數據表明，在表現出木胸病變的肉雞中，粒線體功能受損可能不僅限於胸肌，還擴及其他組織。

papers.title: Isolation and characterization of rabbit intramuscular preadipocytes: Establishing a foundation for studies of intramuscular fat metabolism
papers.abstract: Intramuscular fat (IMF) significantly influences meat quality, affecting flavor, tenderness, and juiciness. Despite extensive research on livestock such as cattle and pigs, the regulation of IMF in rabbits remains poorly understood. This study establishes a standardized in vitro method for isolating and characterizing intramuscular preadipocytes from the longissimus dorsi muscle of 3-day-old Hycole rabbits using enzymatic digestion and differential centrifugation. Three-day-old neonates were selected for initial protocol development due to their higher progenitor cell abundance and tissue accessibility, which facilitates method optimization and ensures consistent cell yields. Isolated cells displayed typical preadipocyte morphology and expressed key markers, including PREF-1, PPARγ, and Leptin, confirmed by RT-qPCR and immunofluorescence. Upon adipogenic induction, cells exhibited progressive lipid accumulation, as indicated by Oil Red O staining, and showed upregulated expression of PPARG, C/EBPa, and FABP4, confirming their differentiation potential. This study establishes a comprehensive protocol for isolating rabbit intramuscular preadipocytes, providing a foundational tool for investigating the molecular mechanisms of adipogenesis in lagomorphs. The model supports future studies on genetic and nutritional strategies to enhance rabbit meat quality while preserving its lean characteristics.
papers.abstract_zh: 肌內脂肪（IMF）顯著影響肉品品質，進而牽動風味、嫩度與多汁性。儘管針對牛、豬等家畜的相關研究已相當廣泛，兔類肌內脂肪的調控機制卻仍所知有限。本研究建立了一套標準化的體外方法，利用酵素消化法與差速離心法，自3日齡海科萊兔的背最長肌中分離並鑑定肌內前脂肪細胞。選擇3日齡新生兔進行最初的實驗方案開發，是由於其具有較高的前驅細胞豐度與組織可及性，這有助於方法的最佳化並確保穩定的細胞得率。分離出的細胞展現出典型的前脂肪細胞形態，並表現出包括PREF-1、PPARγ與Leptin在內的關鍵標記，此點已透過即時螢光定量PCR（RT-qPCR）與免疫螢光染色獲得證實。在進行成脂誘導後，細胞展現出漸進式的脂質累積（如油紅O染色所示），並顯示出PPARG、C/EBPa及FABP4表現量上調，從而證實其分化潛能。本研究建立了一個分離兔肌內前脂肪細胞的完整實驗方案，為探討兔形目動物脂肪生成之分子機制提供了基礎工具。此模型為未來的基因與營養策略研究提供了支持，有助於在維持兔肉瘦肉特性的同時提升其肉品品質。

papers.title: Modulation of Cecal Microbiota and Inflammatory-Immune Pathways Underlies the Reduced Eliminations but Unchanged Growth in Broilers Fed a Compound Probiotic
papers.abstract: With the global restriction on antibiotic growth promoters in poultry production, probiotics have emerged as promising alternatives. This study evaluated the effects of a compound probiotic formulation consisting of Lactobacillus salivarius, Lactobacillus acidophilus, and Lactobacillus reuteri at a ratio of 38:9:1 on growth performance and gut microbiota in Lingnan yellow-feathered broilers. A total of 700 one-day-old broilers were randomly assigned to a control group (basal diet) or a probiotic group (basal diet plus 1.45 × 109 CFU/L of the compound probiotic in drinking water, administered intermittently from 22 to 63 days of age). Growth performance, serum biochemical parameters, and intestinal morphology were measured, and 16S rRNA sequencing was performed on fecal, ileal, and cecal samples. Results showed that probiotic supplementation did not significantly affect growth performance, serum biochemical indices, or intestinal villus morphology. However, elimination rate during 43–63 days and over the entire experimental period was significantly reduced in the probiotic group. 16S rRNA sequencing revealed that the probiotic group exhibited significantly increased cecal microbial richness without alterations in community evenness, along with decreased Lactobacillus abundance in the ileum and increased Akkermansia abundance in the cecum. Functional prediction of cecal microbiota showed that 84 pathways, including inflammation- and immunity-related pathways such as the NOD-like receptor signaling pathway and multiple core functional categories, were significantly down-regulated, while only three pathways were significantly up-regulated. Collectively, although the compound probiotic failed to improve growth performance, it effectively reduced elimination rate, potentially through enrichment of beneficial Akkermansia and modulation of intestinal inflammation-related pathways.
papers.abstract_zh: 隨著全球對家禽生產中抗生素生長促進劑的限制，益生菌已成為具有潛力的替代品。本研究評估了由唾液乳桿菌、嗜酸乳桿菌和羅伊氏乳桿菌以 38:9:1 比例組成的複合益生菌配方，對嶺南黃羽肉雞生長性能和腸道菌相的影響。試驗共選用 700 隻一日齡肉雞，隨機分為對照組（基礎日糧）或益生菌組（基礎日糧加飲水中添加 $1.45 \times 10^9\text{ CFU/L}$ 之複合益生菌，於 22 至 63 日齡期間間歇性投餵）。測定生長性能、血清生化參數及腸道形態，並對糞便、迴腸和盲腸樣本進行 16S rRNA 定序。結果顯示，補充益生菌對生長性能、血清生化指標或腸道絨毛形態無顯著影響。然而，益生菌組在 43–63 日齡及整個試驗期間的淘汰率顯著降低。16S rRNA 定序顯示，益生菌組的盲腸微生物豐富度顯著增加，但群落均勻度未改變，同時伴隨迴腸中乳桿菌豐度下降以及盲腸中阿克曼氏菌（*Akkermansia*）豐度增加。盲腸微生物群的功能預測顯示，包括 NOD 樣受體信號通路等炎症和免疫相關通路在內的 84 個通路以及多個核心功能類別顯著下調，僅有 3 個通路顯著上調。綜上所述，儘管該複合益生菌未能改善生長性能，但它能有效降低淘汰率，這可能透過富集有益的阿克曼氏菌及調節腸道炎症相關通路來實現。

papers.title: Genome-Wide Analysis Reveals Copy Number Variation-Mediated Adaptive Evolution in Chickens Under Diverse Environmental and Domestication Pressures
papers.abstract: To elucidate the genetic basis underlying chicken adaptation to diverse environmental selection pressures, this study performed a genome-wide analysis of copy number variations (CNVs) using publicly available whole-genome resequencing data from global chicken populations. Population differentiation (FST) and nucleotide diversity (π ratio) were integrated to identify signatures of selection associated with thermal adaptation, domestication, and high-altitude adaptation, followed by the identification of candidate genes and enriched biological pathways. In total, 6862, 9348, and 9384 high-confidence copy number variations (CNVs) were identified in the heat adaptation group, domestication group, and high-altitude adaptation group, respectively. Candidate genes associated with heat adaptation include AQP9, SLC4A8, CAT, SMPD2, and CLOCK, which are mainly enriched in biological processes related to water and ion homeostasis, antioxidant defense, and circadian rhythm regulation. Candidate genes related to domestication, such as IL18R1, HTR2C, GRIN2A, PRKAG2, and FABP1, are mainly involved in neuroactive ligand-receptor interaction, energy metabolism, immune regulation, and melanogenesis. In contrast, candidate genes identified in high-altitude populations include EDNRB, ITPR1, OGDH, PPARA, and ADCY6, which are significantly enriched in vascular smooth muscle contraction, the tricarboxylic acid (TCA) cycle, the PPAR signaling pathway, and pathways related to hypoxic metabolic adaptation. The above findings indicate that distinct environmental selection pressures and artificial selection pressures have shaped population-specific CNV patterns in the chicken genome and promoted the formation of phenotypic adaptation through regulating water–salt balance, neural function, energy metabolism, vascular homeostasis, and hypoxic response pathways.
papers.abstract_zh: 為闡明雞適應多樣化環境選擇壓力背後的遺傳基礎，本研究利用全球雞群公開可用的全基因組重定序資料，對等位基因劑量與複製數變異（CNV）進行了全基因組分析。本研究整合了族群分化指數（$F_{ST}$）與核苷酸多樣性比值（$\pi$ ratio），以識別與熱適應、馴化和高原適應相關的選擇訊號，進而鑑別出候選基因及顯著富集的生物學途徑。在熱適應組、馴化組和高原適應組中，分別鑑定出 6862、9348 和 9384 個高信賴度的複製數變異（CNV）。與熱適應相關的候選基因包含 *AQP9*、*SLC4A8*、*CAT*、*SMPD2* 和 *CLOCK*，主要富集於水分與離子恆定、抗氧化防禦及晝夜節律調節相關的生物學過程。與馴化相關的候選基因（如 *IL18R1*、*HTR2C*、*GRIN2A*、*PRKAG2* 和 *FABP1*）主要參與神經活性配體-受體交互作用、能量代謝、免疫調節及黑色素生成。相較之下，在高原族群中鑑別出的候選基因包含 *EDNRB*、*ITPR1*、*OGDH*、*PPARA* 和 *ADCY6*，它們在血管平滑肌收縮、三羧酸（TCA）循環、PPAR 信號傳導途徑及缺氧代謝適應相關途徑中顯著富集。上述發現表明，不同的環境選擇壓力與人工選擇壓力塑造了雞基因組中具族群特異性的 CNV 模式，並透過調節水鹽平衡、神經功能、能量代謝、血管恆定及缺氧反應途徑，促進了表型適應的形成。

papers.title: Extruded Cassava-Based Corn Analogs Improve Nutrient Digestibility, Gut Health, Intestinal Histology, and Egg Performance in Late-Phase Laying Hens
papers.abstract: This study evaluated extruded cassava-based corn analogs as a dietary replacement for yellow corn in laying hens. A total of 180 Hy-Line Brown hens (60 weeks old) were allocated to four dietary treatments for 10 weeks. Treatments included a standard corn diet (T1), 100% non-extruded analog (T2), 50% extruded analog (T3), and 100% extruded analog replacement (T4). Thermomechanical extrusion significantly increased starch gelatinization to 88.50% and decreased water activity to 0.42. Hens fed the T4 diet achieved the highest apparent ileal starch digestibility (92.1%) and digestible energy (3063 kcal/kg). The T4 group also exhibited increased jejunal villus height compared to the T2 group. Metabolically, this coincided with elevated circulating serum triglycerides and total cholesterol, without disrupting glucose homeostasis. Consequently, the T4 group achieved the highest average egg weight, while maintaining egg mass, yolk weight, and feed conversion ratio at levels statistically comparable to the T1 control. In contrast, the T2 diet resulted in lower starch digestibility, reduced jejunal villus height, and increased cecal volatile fatty. Complete replacement with extruded cassava-based analogs maintains nutrient assimilation and productive performance relative to standard corn. This strategy provides a viable alternative to diversify global feed ingredient sourcing.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究評估了擠壓木薯基玉米替代品作為產蛋雞日糧中黃玉米替代品的效應。試驗選用 180 隻 60 週齡的海蘭褐蛋雞（Hy-Line Brown hens），隨機分配至四種日糧處理中，為期 10 週。處理組包括標準玉米日糧（T1）、100%未擠壓替代品（T2）、50%擠壓替代品（T3）及 100%擠壓替代品替代組（T4）。熱機械擠壓顯著將澱粉糊化度提高至 88.50%，並將水分活性降至 0.42。飼餵 T4 日糧的蛋雞獲得最高的表觀迴腸澱粉消化率（92.1%）與可消化能（3063 kcal/kg）。與 T2 組相比，T4 組的空腸絨毛高度亦有所增加。在代謝方面，這與循環血清三酸甘油酯和總膽固醇的升高相吻合，且未干擾葡萄糖恆定。因此，T4 組獲得最高的平均蛋重，同時維持蛋重總量、蛋黃重以及飼料轉換率與 T1 對照組達到統計學上相當的水平。相比之下，T2 日糧導致澱粉消化率降低、空腸絨毛高度減少以及盲腸揮發性脂肪酸增加。與標準玉米相比，完全以擠壓木薯基替代品進行替代可維持養分同化與生產性能。此策略為全球飼料原料來源的多樣化提供了可行的替代方案。

papers.title: Nutrient and Amino Acid Digestibility of Fermented Cottonseed Meal and Fermented Cottonseed Protein Produced with Different Microbial Combinations in Growing Pigs
papers.abstract: High-fiber unbalanced amino acid (AA) profiles and toxic free gossypol restrict cottonseed by-products for swine diets, while solid-state microbial fermentation can upgrade their nutrition. We prepared 103 fermented batches with diverse microbes under aerobic or anaerobic conditions, selected 10 representative groups via multivariate statistics for scaled-up fermentation and chemical analysis, and conducted two Youden square pig trials to determine available energy and standardized ileal digestible (SID) AAs before establishing relevant prediction equations. The metabolism experiment used 24.10 kg pigs to detect total tract digestibility and energy values, and an ileal cannula trial on 60.88 kg barrows adopted a nitrogen-free diet to correct endogenous amino acid losses. Fermentation largely lowered free gossypol, and short-term aerobic Aspergillus niger fermentation yielded the highest digestibility of most nutrients and essential amino acids. Digestible and metabolizable energy was positively related to crude protein (CP) and ash but was negatively linked to fiber fractions. SID lysine was negatively correlated with CP and ash yet was positively associated with fiber, while SID methionine and tryptophan displayed identical positive correlations with CP and negative correlations with fiber and free gossypol. Stepwise regression models (R2 = 0.57–0.93) allow rapid nutritional assessment via routine chemical analysis to guide precise pig feed production.
papers.abstract_zh: 高纖維、不平衡的胺基酸（AA）組成以及具毒性的游離棉酚限制了棉籽副產物在豬隻飼料中的應用，而固態微生物發酵則能提升其營養價值。本研究製備了103批在好氧或厭氧條件下使用不同微生物發酵的批次，透過多變量統計選出10個代表性組別進行放大發酵與化學分析，並進行兩項約登方格（Youden square）豬隻試驗以測定可用能與標準迴腸可消化（SID）胺基酸，隨後建立相關預測方程式。代謝試驗使用體重24.10公斤的豬隻來測定全消化道消化率與能量值，而對體重60.88公斤去勢公豬進行的迴腸導管試驗則採用無氮飼料以校正內源胺基酸損失。發酵大幅降低了游離棉酚含量，且短期好氧黑麴黴（Aspergillus niger）發酵產生了最高的大部分營養物質與必需胺基酸消化率。可消化能與代謝能與粗蛋白（CP）及灰分呈正相關，但與纖維分畫呈負相關。SID離胺酸與粗蛋白及灰分呈負相關，但與纖維呈正相關；而SID甲硫胺酸和色胺酸則表現出與粗蛋白呈相同的正相關，以及與纖維和游離棉酚呈負相關。逐步迴歸模型（R2 = 0.57–0.93）允許透過常規化學分析進行快速營養評估，以指導精準豬飼料的生產。

papers.title: In ovo green light cycles (6 versus 12 hours) modulate embryonic development via hepatic gene expression and amino acid metabolism in ducks
papers.abstract: 1. While in ovo green lighting (IOL) promotes embryo growth and shortens the incubation period in meat-type ducks, photoperiod effects remain unclear. This study investigated the impact of different IOL photoperiods on embryo development, the hepatic transcriptome and amino acid metabolism.2. A total of 300 fertilised Pekin duck eggs were divided into three groups (n = 100/group) with eight replicates per group and 12–13 eggs per replicate. For the light-treated groups, green LED lamps (520–526 nm, 150 lux) were inserted into the air cells on embryonic day (ED) 9. From ED10 to ED24, eggs were subjected three treatments. 1. Control group conventional total darkness without LED implantation (CON), 6 h/day short-term lighting (STL), or 12 h/day long-term lighting (LTL), both with lights turned on at 07:00 daily. Embryo, heart and liver weights were measured on ED17 and 24, with ED24 livers collected for free amino acid, transcriptomic and PCR analyses.3. Heart and liver weights were unaffected by IOL. However, while embryo weight on ED24 was significantly higher in the LTL group, relative embryonic weight did not differ significantly. Apart from proline, IOL significantly reduced free amino acid levels in the liver, which increased in decline with longer photoperiods. Transcriptomic comparisons between the LTL and CON embryos revealed that light exposure upregulated genes related to energy, lipid and amino acid metabolism, but suppressed extracellular matrix (ECM) genes.4. The 12 h/day green IOL photoperiod altered transcriptomic signatures associated with amino acid utilisation and energy metabolism during the late stages of embryogenesis. This contributed to absolute embryonic biomass accumulation in meat-type ducks.
papers.abstract_zh:
1. 雖然胚胎內綠光照射（IOL）能促進肉鴨的胚胎生長並縮短孵化期，但光週期效應仍不清楚。本研究探討不同 IOL 光週期對胚胎發育、肝臟轉錄體及胺基酸代謝的影響。
2. 總共 300 枚受精北京鴨蛋被分為三組（每組 100 枚），每組有八個重複，每個重複 12–13 枚蛋。對於光照處理組，綠色 LED 燈（520–526 nm，150 lux）於胚胎第 9 天（ED9）植入氣室中。從 ED10 至 ED24，雞蛋接受三種處理：1. 控制組為傳統完全黑暗且無植入 LED（CON）、6 小時/天短期光照（STL），或 12 小時/天長期光照（LTL），兩者的燈光均於每日 07:00 開啟。於 ED17 和 ED24 測定胚胎、心臟和肝臟重量，並收集 ED24 的肝臟用於游離胺基酸、轉錄體及 PCR 分析。
3. 心臟和肝臟重量不受 IOL 影響。然而，儘管 ED24 時 LTL 組的胚胎重量顯著較高，相對胚胎重量則無顯著差異。除脯胺酸外，IOL 顯著降低了肝臟中的游離胺基酸濃度，且隨著光照週期的延長，其下降幅度增加。LTL 與 CON 胚胎之間的轉錄體比較顯示，光照上調了與能量、脂質和胺基酸代謝相關的基因，但抑制了細胞外基質（ECM）基因。
4. 每天 12 小時的綠光 IOL 光週期改變了胚胎發生後期與胺基酸利用和能量代謝相關的轉錄體特徵。這有助於肉鴨絕對胚胎生物量的累積。

papers.title: Effect of Replacing Lucerne Meal with Seriphium plumosum Meal in the Diet on Growth Performance, Methane Emission, In Vitro Rumen Fermentation Characteristics, and Rumen Microbial Community Composition of Nguni Steers
papers.abstract: This study assessed the effects of replacing lucerne meal with Seriphium (S.) plumosum meal on growth performance, methane emissions, rumen fermentation characteristics, and rumen bacterial community composition of Nguni steers. Twenty-eight 22-month-old Nguni steers (average body weight 300 ± 10 kg) were randomly assigned to diets containing 0%, 10%, 20%, or 30% of S. plumosum meal in a completely randomized design. The diets were formulated to be isocaloric to meet the nutrient requirements of growing Nguni steers. Feed intake, nutrient digestibility, and live weight gain were measured over a 90-day feeding period. Methane emissions were recorded using a laser methane detector, while rumen fermentation characteristics were evaluated in vitro. Rumen microbial communities were characterized using 16S rRNA gene sequencing. Increasing S. plumosum inclusion had no effect (p > 0.05) on dry matter intake, nutrient digestibility, live weight gain, or methane emissions, indicating that replacement of lucerne meal did not compromise production performance. However, dietary treatments influenced (p < 0.05) gas production throughout the incubation period (3–48 h). The 10% diet (T2) produced the highest gas volumes, with values declining at 20% (T3) and 30% (T4). Cumulative gas production after 48 h followed a similar pattern. Significant linear, quadratic, and cubic responses (p < 0.01) indicated a non-linear response of gas production to increasing dietary inclusion of S. plumosum. In vitro organic matter digestibility, ammonia–nitrogen concentration, volatile fatty acid profiles, and the acetate-to-propionate ratio, demonstrated changes (p < 0.05) in rumen fermentation dynamics. Heatmap analysis of the rumen microbiota revealed clear shifts in bacterial community composition with increasing S. plumosum inclusion in the diet. Therefore, S. plumosum meal has potential as a locally available alternative forage resource for partial replacement of lucerne meal in Nguni steer diets.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究評估以多刺灌木（Seriphium (S.) plumosum）粉取代苜蓿粉（lucerne meal）對恩古尼（Nguni）肉牛生長性能、甲烷排放、瘤胃發酵特性及瘤胃細菌群落組成之影響。試驗選用28頭22月齡之恩古尼肉牛（平均體重 300 ± 10公斤），採完全逢機設計，隨機分配至含 0%、10%、20% 或 30% S. plumosum 粉之試驗日糧中。試驗日糧之能量設計為等能，以符合生長中恩古尼肉牛之營養需求。在為期90天的飼養期間內，測定採食量、營養分消化率及活重增量。利用雷射甲烷偵測器記錄甲烷排放量，同時以體外法評估瘤胃發酵特性。利用 16S rRNA 基因定序鑑定瘤胃微生物群落。增加 S. plumosum 的添加比例對乾物質採食量、營養分消化率、活重增量或甲烷排放量均無顯著影響（p > 0.05），顯示取代苜蓿粉並未損害生產性能。然而，日糧處理顯著影響（p < 0.05）整個培養期間（3–48 小時）之產氣量。10% 添加組（T2）產生最高之氣體體積，隨 20%（T3）與 30%（T4）組之添加而下降。48 小時後之累積產氣量亦呈現相似趨勢。顯著的線性、二次及三次反應（p < 0.01）顯示產氣量對日糧中 S. plumosum 添加量增加呈非線性反應。體外有機物質消化率、氨態氮濃度、揮發性脂肪酸組成及乙酸與丙酸之比值，均顯示瘤胃發酵動態發生變化（p < 0.05）。瘤胃微生物相之熱圖分析顯示，隨著日糧中 S. plumosum 添加量之增加，細菌群落組成發生明顯轉變。因此，S. plumosum 粉具有作為當地可取得之替代粗飼料資源的潛力，可用於部分取代恩古尼肉牛日糧中的苜蓿粉。

papers.title: Non-Invasive Monitoring of Dense Landes Goose Flocks: An Automated Counting Method Driven by Simulation Data and Robust Trajectory Anchoring
papers.abstract: To address low efficiency in manual counting and high costs of data collection and labeling in Landes goose farming, this study developed a simulation-driven video detection and counting method. A three-dimensional simulation environment generated goose scenes under varied densities, perspectives, and lighting conditions, with automatic bounding-box labeling. A YOLO26 detector was pre-trained on the 6000-image training subset of a 10,000-image simulated dataset, which was divided into training, validation, and test subsets at a ratio of 6:2:2 (6000, 2000, and 2000 images, respectively), and was then fine-tuned using 500 real images. A bottom-center trajectory anchor and line-crossing rules were combined with BoT-SORT tracking to construct a detection-tracking-counting pipeline. Evaluation on three real video sequences comprising 1780 reference crossing events yielded an event-level counting accuracy of 99.16% and an aggregate net-count accuracy of 99.38%, with a mean absolute error of 3.7 and a root mean square error of 5.3 across the sequences. In the dense sequence, the predicted count was 1021 against 1030 reference crossings, corresponding to a net-count accuracy of 99.13%. These findings support simulation-assisted training and non-contact line-crossing counting for the evaluated Landes goose passage. Further validation is needed before extending the method to other farm layouts or production environments.
papers.abstract_zh: 為了解決朗德鵝養殖中人工清點效率低落以及數據收集與標註成本高昂的問題，本研究開發了一種模擬驅動的視訊檢測與計數方法。三維模擬環境生成了不同密度、視角與光照條件下的鵝群場景，並具備自動邊界框標註功能。YOLO26檢測器先在10,000張模擬資料集（按6:2:2比例劃分為訓練、驗證與測試子集，分別為6000、2000與2000張圖片）中的6000張圖片訓練子集上進行預訓練，隨後使用500張真實圖片進行微調。結合底部中心軌跡錨點與越線規則，搭配BoT-SORT追蹤器，建構出檢測-追蹤-計數流程。在包含1780個參考越線事件的三個真實視訊序列上進行評估，事件級計數準確度達99.16%，總體淨計數準確度達99.38%，各序列的平均絕對誤差為3.7，均方根誤差為5.3。在密集序列中，預測計數為1021，對應的參考越線次數為1030，淨計數準確度達99.13%。這些研究結果支持了所評估之朗德鵝通道的模擬輔助訓練與非接觸式越線計數。在將此方法推廣至其他農場佈局或生產環境之前，仍需進行進一步的驗證。

papers.title: Effects of Dietary Selenium Nanoparticle Supplementation of a Low-Selenium Basal Diet on Nutrient Digestibility, Hemato-Biochemical Indices, Reproductive and Lactational Performance of Ossimi Sheep
papers.abstract: Thirty Ossimi ewes and twelve Ossimi rams were used to evaluate the effects of supplementing a low-selenium (Se) basal diet with Se nanoparticles (Se-NP) on nutrient digestibility, hemato-biochemical indices, and reproductive-lactational performance. Ewes and rams were randomly allocated to two groups: a control group fed the basal diet (estimated Se content 0.005–0.014 mg/kg dry matter, DM) and a Se-NP group fed the same basal diet supplemented with 0.3 mg Se-NP/kg DM. Repeated measurements were analyzed with linear mixed models. In rams, dietary Se-NP increased (p < 0.001) ejaculate volume, sperm concentration, progressive motility, and serum testosterone levels compared with the control. In the Se-NP breeding group, the conception rate was numerically higher (93.3%) compared with 60.0% in the control group. Dietary Se-NP increased (p < 0.001) total antioxidant capacity, blood Se concentration, serum triiodothyronine (T3), the T3/thyroxine (T4) ratio, nutrient digestibility coefficients and nutritive values in both rams and ewes. Maternal Se-NP supplementation also increased (p < 0.001) milk yield, fat corrected milk, milk composition and daily yields of milk fat, protein, and lactose, as well as the birth weight, weaning weight and average daily gain of suckling lambs. Under the conditions of this study, Se-NP supplementation of a low-Se diet during the breeding period was associated with improved semen characteristics, lactational, and digestive performance; because ram and ewe supplementation were applied jointly within breeding groups and the sample size was limited, these findings should be confirmed in larger studies.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究使用三十隻奧西米（Ossimi）母羊與十二隻奧西米公羊，以評估在低硒（Se）基礎日糧中添加奈米硒（Se-NP）對營養物質消化率、血液生化指標以及繁殖與泌乳性能的影響。公羊與母羊被隨機分至兩組：對照組餵食基礎日糧（估計硒含量為乾物質 [DM] 0.005–0.014 毫克/公斤），以及 Se-NP 組餵食添加 0.3 毫克 Se-NP/公斤 DM 的相同基礎日糧。重複測量數據以線性混合模型進行分析。在公羊方面，與對照組相比，日糧添加 Se-NP 顯著增加了（$p < 0.001$）精液量、精子濃度、直線運動能力及血清睪固酮濃度。在 Se-NP 繁殖組中，受孕率在數值上較高（93.3%），而對照組則為 60.0%。日糧添加 Se-NP 顯著提高了（$p < 0.001$）公羊和母羊的總抗氧化能力、血液硒濃度、血清三碘甲狀腺原氨酸（T3）、T3/甲狀腺素（T4）比值、營養物質消化率係數及營養價值。母體補充 Se-NP 也顯著增加了（$p < 0.001$）產乳量、乳脂校正乳量、乳成分以及乳脂、乳蛋白和乳糖的每日產量，同時提升了哺乳羔羊的初生重、斷奶重與平均日增重。在本試驗條件下，於繁殖期間在低硒日糧中添加 Se-NP 與改善精液特性、泌乳及消化性能有關；由於公羊和母羊的補充是在繁殖組內共同進行且樣本數有限，這些發現尚需透過更大規模的研究來進一步確認。

papers.title: Genome‐Wide Analysis of Resistance to Gastrointestinal Parasites in Portuguese Merino and Merino‐Related Sheep
