papers.title: The Impact of Vaccination Practices in Cow–Calf Operations on Bovine Respiratory Disease Morbidity and Mortality in Beef Calves: A Rapid Scoping Review
papers.abstract: Background: Bovine respiratory disease (BRD) drives antimicrobial use in cow–calf herds and feedlots. This rapid scoping review evaluated vaccination of North American beef dams or pre-weaning calves against respiratory pathogens and subsequent calf health. Methods: Five databases and gray literature sources were searched for English-language North American trials and observational studies published since 2000. Data were charted in Excel and independently reviewed. Results: Twenty-eight studies reported clinical outcomes. One of seven field trials of pre-weaning calf vaccination reported pre-weaning clinical benefit; two of six reported post-weaning benefit. Four of ten calf vaccination challenge trials reported clinical differences. Two of six observational studies of dam vaccination reported beneficial pre-weaning associations. Post weaning, one dam vaccination challenge trial reduced pathogen shedding without improving clinical outcomes, while one cohort reported favorable feedlot associations. Two of the three field trials with beneficial clinical findings evaluated vaccines targeting pathogens previously associated with disease in the study herd. Observational evidence from multicomponent programs could not isolate vaccination effects. Conclusions: Evidence did not identify a consistently effective vaccination protocol. Benefits may depend on herd disease history, pathogen targets, disease pressure, and management context. Trials should evaluate clearly defined protocols in relevant settings and report absolute and relative effects with confidence intervals.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：牛呼吸道疾病（Bovine respiratory disease, BRD）是促使母牛群與肥育場使用抗菌劑的主要原因。本快速範圍性文獻回顧旨在評估對北美肉牛母牛或離乳前牛隻進行呼吸道病原體疫苗接種，對隨後牛隻健康的影響。方法：檢索五個資料庫與灰色文獻來源，尋找2000年以後發表之英文北美試驗與觀察性研究。資料記錄於Excel並經獨立審閱。結果：共有二十八篇研究報告了臨床結果。在七項離乳前牛隻疫苗接種的現場試驗中，有一項報告了離乳前的臨床效益；六項中有兩項報告了離乳後的效益。十項牛隻疫苗接種攻毒試驗中有四項報告了臨床差異。六項母牛疫苗接種的觀察性研究中有兩項報告了對離乳前有益的相關性。離乳後，一項母牛疫苗接種攻毒試驗減少了病原體排出，但未改善臨床結果，而一項世代研究則報告了與肥育場有利的相關性。三項具有正面臨床發現的現場試驗中，有兩項評估了針對研究牛群先前已相關之病原體的疫苗。多組分計畫的觀察性證據無法分離出疫苗的效果。結論：證據未能指出一套持續有效的疫苗接種方案。其效益可能取決於牛群疾病史、目標病原體、疾病壓力以及管理背景。試驗應在相關環境中評估明確定義的方案，並報告包含信賴區間的絕對與相對效應。

papers.title: The Regulatory Mechanism of MiR-122 in the Antiviral Immunity of Larimichthys crocea Kidney Cells
papers.abstract: Larimichthys crocea is an important marine aquaculture fish in China, but its farming industry has long been threatened by viral diseases. MicroRNAs (miRNAs) are short non-coding RNAs that regulate gene expression post-transcriptionally, typically by inducing mRNA degradation or translational repression. And they have emerged as essential players in orchestrating antiviral-related cellular responses in fish. In the present study, the large yellow croaker kidney cell line (PCK) was used as an in vitro model. Through transfection of miR-122 mimics and inhibitors, combined with poly(I:C) immune stimulation, transcriptome, dual-luciferase reporter assays and qPCR validation were employed to systematically investigate the immune regulatory mechanism of miR-122. Transcriptome analysis revealed that 1995 and 1577 genes were differentially expressed after miR-122 overexpression and inhibition, respectively, and they were significantly enriched in pathways such as ECM–receptor interaction, focal adhesion, PPAR signaling, and TGF-β signaling. In these DEGs, prkci and slc40a1 were confirmed as direct target genes of miR-122 in large yellow croaker via target gene prediction and dual-luciferase reporter assays. Furthermore, miR-122 overexpression significantly inhibited poly(I:C)-induced superoxide dismutase (SOD) activity, suggesting its involvement in the regulation of oxidative stress. These results support miR-122-responsive transcriptional and redox changes in poly(I:C)-stimulated PCK cells, mediated by targeting prkci and slc40a1 and by affecting SOD-mediated redox balance. This study provides new insights into the miRNA-mediated immune regulatory network in teleosts and offers potential molecular targets for disease-resistant breeding and the development of disease prevention and control strategies in large yellow croaker.
papers.abstract_zh: 大黃魚（Larimichthys crocea）是中國重要的海水養殖魚類，然而其養殖產業長期受到病毒性疾病的威脅。微小核糖核酸（miRNAs）是一類短片段的非編碼RNA，主要透過誘導mRNA降解或轉譯抑制來調控基因的轉譯後表達，且已被證實是協調魚類抗病毒相關細胞反應的重要角色。在本研究中，以大黃魚腎臟細胞系（PCK）作為體外模型，透過轉染miR-122模擬物（mimics）與抑制劑（inhibitors），結合poly(I:C)免疫刺激，並綜合運用轉錄體學、雙螢光素酶報告基因檢測及qPCR驗證，系統性地探討miR-122的免疫調控機制。轉錄體分析顯示，miR-122過表達和抑制後分別有1995個和1577個差異表達基因（DEGs），且這些基因顯著富集於細胞外基質－受體交互作用（ECM-receptor interaction）、黏著斑（focal adhesion）、PPAR信號傳導及TGF-β信號傳導等路徑。在這些DEGs中，結合標靶基因預測與雙螢光素酶報告基因檢測，證實prkci和大黃魚的slc40a1為miR-122的直接標靶基因。此外，miR-122的過表達顯著抑制了poly(I:C)誘導 超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）的活性，暗示其參與了氧化壓力的調控。這些結果支持了在poly(I:C)刺激的PCK細胞中，miR-122會透過靶向prkci和slc40a1以及影響SOD介導的氧化還原平衡，來調控轉錄與氧化還原的變化。本研究為硬骨魚類中miRNA介導的免疫調控網路提供了新的見解，並為大黃魚的抗病育種及疾病預防控制策略的開發提供了潛在的分子標靶。

papers.title: Protective Effects of Cinnamaldehyde Against Heat Stress in Mice and Its Regulatory Influence on Estrogen Secretion
papers.abstract: Heat stress (HS) causes reproductive damage in female mammals, including pigs, cattle, and sheep. As the primary site of estrogen (E2) biosynthesis, follicular granulosa cells (GCs) act as the critical target of HS injury. Previous studies have shown that cinnamaldehyde (CA) effectively participates in reproductive regulation in mice. Therefore, female mice and their follicular GCs were taken as the research subjects in this study. First, we adopted ELISA and H&E staining to investigate the effects of CA on ovarian follicular histology and E2 secretion in mice. Second, CCK-8 assay, flow cytometry, and ELISA were applied to clarify how CA regulates proliferation, apoptosis, and E2 secretion of mouse follicular GCs under HS. Finally, RT-qPCR and Western blotting (WB) were used to elucidate the protective effects of CA together with its underlying molecular mechanisms. Animal experiment results revealed that HS elevated the proportion of primordial and primary follicles and suppressed E2 secretion. Oral gavage of mice with CA at 25 mg/kg exhibited no obvious hepatotoxicity. This dosage effectively increased the percentage of secondary and antral follicles, alleviated HS-induced histological damage in ovaries, and raised serum E2 levels both under normal conditions and HS. Further in vitro cell experiments confirmed that HS reduced cell viability and accelerated apoptosis in mouse follicular GCs. HS decreased estrogen secretion by downregulating the relative protein expression of StAR and CYP19A1. Treatment with CA at a concentration of 2.5 × 10−5 M significantly increased cell viability and inhibited excessive apoptosis in mouse follicular GCs under HS. Under HS conditions, CA treatment elevated E2 secretion in mouse follicular GCs by upregulating the relative protein expression of StAR and CYP19A1. In conclusion, the findings of this study indicate that CA holds promise as a natural anti-HS additive.
papers.abstract_zh: 熱緊迫（Heat stress, HS）會對雌性哺乳動物（包括豬、牛和羊）造成生殖損傷。卵巢濾泡顆粒細胞（Granulosa cells, GCs）作為雌激素（E2）生物合成的主要場所，是熱緊迫損傷的關鍵標靶。先前的研究表明，肉桂醛（Cinnamaldehyde, CA）能有效參與小鼠的生殖調控。因此，本研究以雌性小鼠及其卵巢濾泡顆粒細胞作為研究對象。首先，我們採用酵素聯結免疫吸附分析（ELISA）和蘇木素－伊紅染色（H&E staining）來探討CA對小鼠卵巢濾泡組織學及E2分泌的影響。其次，應用CCK-8檢測、流式細胞儀和ELISA，闡明CA如何調控熱緊迫下小鼠濾泡顆粒細胞的增生、細胞凋亡與E2分泌。最後，利用即時定量聚合酶鏈鎖反應（RT-qPCR）與西方墨點法（Western blotting, WB）來闡明CA的保護作用及其潛在的分子機制。動物實驗結果顯示，熱緊迫會提高原始濾泡和初級濾泡的比例，並抑制E2的分泌。以25 mg/kg劑量對小鼠進行肉桂醛灌胃未顯示出明顯的肝毒性。此劑量能有效增加次級濾泡與成熟濾泡的百分比，減輕熱緊迫引起的卵巢組織學損傷，並在正常條件及熱緊迫下皆能提高血清E2濃度。進一步的體外細胞實驗證實，熱緊迫會降低小鼠濾泡顆粒細胞的細胞活力並加速細胞凋亡。熱緊迫透過下調StAR和CYP19A1的相對蛋白表現量來減少雌激素的分泌。以濃度為 $2.5 \times 10^{-5}\text{ M}$ 的CA處理，能顯著提高熱緊迫下小鼠濾泡顆粒細胞的細胞活力，並抑制過度的細胞凋亡。在熱緊迫條件下，CA處理透過上調StAR和CYP19A1的相對蛋白表現量，增加了小鼠濾泡顆粒細胞的E2分泌。綜上所述，本研究結果表明CA具有作為天然抗熱緊迫添加劑的潛力。

papers.title: Influence of broiler breeder age on egg characteristics, embryonic development, and early post-hatch physiology
papers.abstract: SUMMARYIn modern broiler production systems, maternal factors play crucial roles in shaping progeny performance. Among these factors, breeder age has emerged as a key determinant of progeny development by influencing egg characteristics, embryonic metabolism, and chick physiological quality at hatch. As breeders age, reproductive and physiological changes lead to increases in egg weight, yolk deposition, and follicle size, which are generally associated with heavier chicks at hatch. These changes, however, are accompanied by alterations in eggshell characteristics, including thickness and conductance, which modify gas exchange and water loss during incubation and consequently influence embryonic metabolic dynamics and developmental conditions. Because embryonic development depends on the coordinated interaction between nutrient availability and gas exchange, breeder age also influences the transfer of nutrients, immune components, and antioxidant compounds to the egg, shaping gastrointestinal development, immune competence, and early physiological adaptation. Collectively, these maternal influences determine hatchling quality and the efficiency with which chicks transition from endogenous yolk-derived metabolism to exogenous feed intake, both of which are critical for subsequent broiler performance. Although numerous studies have described individual effects of breeder age on egg characteristics, embryonic development, and progeny performance, the molecular and physiological mechanisms linking these processes remain insufficiently integrated. Therefore, this review aims to consolidate current knowledge on the physiological mechanisms through which breeder age influences egg formation, embryonic development, and subsequent progeny performance, highlighting the mechanistic links between maternal physiology, embryonic development, and early post-hatch adaptation.
papers.abstract_zh:
摘要
在現代肉雞生產系統中，母源因素在塑造後代性能方面扮演著關鍵角色。在這些因素中，種雞日齡已成為透過影響蛋的特性、胚胎代謝及初生雛雞生理品質來決定後代發育的關鍵因素。隨著種雞日齡增長，其繁殖與生理上的變化會導致蛋重、卵黃沉積與卵泡大小增加，這通常與較重的初生雛雞有關。然而，這些變化伴隨著蛋殼特性（包括厚度和氣孔導度）的改變，從而調節孵化過程中的氣體交換與水分流失，進而影響胚胎代謝動態與發育條件。由於胚胎發育取決於養分可用性與氣體交換之間的協調交互作用，種雞日齡亦會影響養分、免疫成分及抗氧化物質向蛋中的轉移，進而塑造胃腸道發育、免疫能力及早期生理適應。總體而言，這些母源影響決定了雛雞品質以及雛雞從內源性卵黃代謝過渡到外源性飼料攝取的效率，兩者對於後續的肉雞性能至關重要。儘管許多研究已描述了種雞日齡對蛋的特性、胚胎發育和後代性能的個別影響，但連結這些過程的分子與生理機制仍缺乏足夠的整合。因此，本篇綜論旨在整合當前關於種雞日齡影響蛋形成、胚胎發育及後續後代性能之生理機制的知識，並探討母源生理、胚胎發育與早期出殼後適應之間的機制連結。

papers.title: Porcine Circovirus Types 2 and 3: Detection and Association with the Productive Performance of Pigs on Commercial Farms in Southern Brazil
papers.abstract: Porcine circoviruses 2 (PCV2) and 3 (PCV3) are endemic pathogens in swine populations worldwide. This study aimed to detect PCV2, PCV3, and genotype PCV2, and associate these PCV infections with pig productive performance on commercial Brazilian farms. Palatine tonsils were collected from 250 slaughtered pigs, originating from 25 batches/herds from 25 different farms (10 samples per batch/herd), and were used to identify PCV2 and PCV3. Overall, 23 (92%) herds tested positive for PCV2 and 19 (76%) for PCV3, with 18 (72%) herds positive for both these PCVs. Within-herd prevalence in the positive batches ranged from 10% to 100% for PCV2 and 10% to 50% for PCV3. The PCV2d genotype was identified in all positive herds, whereas PCV2b was only co-detected with PCV2d in five herds. Amino acid sequence analysis additionally revealed three main substitutions (A133H, T134D and L136M) in the Cap protein of most PCV2d samples evaluated here. PCV2 positivity in the herds correlated with mortality rate (ρ = 0.70; p = 0.001) and carcass condemnation (ρ = 0.57; p = 0.003), but not with average slaughter weight (ρ = −0.33; p = 0.102). PCV3 showed no significant correlation with pig productive performance (p > 0.05). In conclusion, PCV2 and PCV3 are widely and concurrently circulating on commercial pig farms in Southern Brazil, with PCV2d being the predominant genotype. The high frequency of PCV2 was associated with field mortality and carcass condemnation, highlighting the need for continuous molecular surveillance, prevention, and control of this circovirus in commercial swine production.
papers.abstract_zh: 第二型與第三型豬圓環病毒（PCV2及PCV3）是全球豬群中的地方性流行病原。本研究旨在檢測PCV2與PCV3、進行PCV2基因型分型，並探討這些PCV感染與巴西商業化豬場之豬隻生產性能的關聯。本研究自25個不同豬場的25批/群（每批/群10個樣本）、共250頭送宰豬隻採集口蓋扁桃腺，用於識別PCV2與PCV3。總體而言，有23個（92%）豬群檢出PCV2陽性，19個（76%）檢出PCV3陽性，其中18個（72%）豬群同時對這兩種豬圓環病毒呈陽性反應。在陽性批次中，場內感染率在PCV2為10%至100%，在PCV3則為10%至50%。PCV2d基因型在所有陽性豬場中皆被鑑定出，而PCV2b僅在五個豬場中與PCV2d共同檢出。胺基酸序列分析進一步顯示，此處評估的多數PCV2d樣本之Cap蛋白中存在三個主要的胺基酸置換（A133H、T134D與L136M）。豬群中的PCV2陽性率與場內死亡率（ρ = 0.70; p = 0.001）及屠體廢棄率（ρ = 0.57; p = 0.003）呈顯著相關，但與平均屠宰體重無顯著相關（ρ = −0.33; p = 0.102）。PCV3則與豬隻生產性能無顯著相關性（p > 0.05）。總結而言，PCV2與PCV3在巴西南部的商業養豬場中廣泛且同時流行，其中以PCV2d為優勢基因型。高頻率的PCV2感染與現場死亡率及屠體廢棄率相關，凸顯了在商業養豬生產中對此類圓環病毒進行持續性分子流行病學監測、預防與控制的必要性。

papers.title: Movement Patterns of Laying Hens Across Production Stages in a Commercial Aviary System
papers.abstract: We characterised radio-frequency identification (RFID) transitions among monitored areas of a commercial multi-tier aviary using a four-stage cohort of 2162 Lohmann Brown hens. The analysis used 204 retained dates from 21 November 2016 to 15 November 2017, approximately 18–70 weeks of age according to the supplied production records. Source bouts shorter than 10 s were excluded, and successive same-area bouts separated by at most 10 s were merged. Self-loops comprised 73.9% of 23,756,706 recorded transitions and were concentrated at the feeders. Pooled non-looping rates were 9.65, 13.54, 17.77 and 15.10 transitions per detected hen-day during pre-, peak-, late- and end-laying. Lower feeders formed the strongest cross-area connections, with pop-hole links more prominent later. Restricting existing links to the six indoor feeder/nest-box locations reduced the peak-to-late increase from 31.2% to 2.7%. A higher-coverage cohort and timing sensitivities retained the same ordering of stage rates. Adding eligible cross-midnight non-looping links increased counts by less than 0.9% per stage. These descriptive results separate repeated detection from cross-area adjacency, while showing that contrast magnitudes depend on the locations represented. Age, season, management and monitoring coverage changed together; the records do not identify their separate effects or verify continuous occupancy or outdoor journeys.
papers.abstract_zh: 我們利用涵蓋四個階段、共 2,162 隻羅曼棕母雞（Lohmann Brown hens）的世代，對商業化多層平飼雞舍監控區域間的無線射頻辨識（RFID）轉移進行了特性分析。本分析採用 2016 年 11 月 21 日至 2017 年 11 月 15 日期間共 204 個保留的日期，根據提供的生產記錄，雞隻日齡約為 18 至 70 週。小於 10 秒的原始行為發作（bouts）予以排除，間隔不大於 10 秒且位於同一區域的連續行為發作則予以合併。在記錄到的 23,756,706 次轉移中，自我循環（self-loops）佔了 73.9%，且集中於餵料器。在產蛋前期、高峰期、後期和末期，合併的非循環轉移率分別為每隻檢測母雞日 9.65、13.54、17.77 和 15.10 次。下層餵料器形成了最強的跨區域連結，而出入孔（pop-hole）連結則在後期更為顯著。將現有連結限制於六個室內餵料器／產蛋箱位置，可將從高峰期到後期的增幅從 31.2% 降低至 2.7%。具有更高涵蓋率的世代與時間敏感度分析維持了各階段速率相同的排序。加入符合條件的跨午夜非循環連結，使各階段的計數增加了不到 0.9%。這些描述性結果將重複偵測與跨區域鄰接性區分開來，同時表明對比幅度取決於所代表的位置。日齡、季節、管理和監控涵蓋率共同發生變化；這些記錄無法識別其各自的獨立影響，亦無法驗證持續在舍內或戶外活動的情況。

papers.title: Effect of Oats Grain Inclusion as a Main Source of Crude Fibre in Wheat–Barley and Rye-Based Diets for Growing–Finishing Pigs
papers.abstract: Dietary fibre is important for gastrointestinal health and feed efficiency in pigs, but alternative fibre sources, particularly in high-rye diets, require further evaluation. This study examined the effects of rye and oat inclusion on growth performance, carcass characteristics, and economic efficiency in growing–finishing pigs. A total of 920 DanBred fattening pigs were allocated to four dietary treatments: wheat− and barley-based control (CON), control + 10% oats (CON + O), rye-based diet with 30% rye in the grower diet and 60% in the finisher diet (RYE), and RYE + 10% oats (RYE + O). During the grower phase, rye significantly increased daily weight gain, whereas oat supplementation to the rye-based diet significantly reduced feed intake and weight gain. During the finisher phase, oat supplementation significantly increased daily weight gain in both dietary groups and improved feed conversion in pigs receiving the rye-based diet. Over the entire fattening period, oat-supplemented groups had significantly higher weight gain, while RYE + O had lower feed intake and feed conversion than RYE. Rye-containing diets produced significantly leaner carcasses, and oat supplementation in the rye-based diet reduced backfat thickness. RYE + O resulted in the lowest cost of weight gain and higher average simplified profit per pig. These findings indicate that the combination of rye inclusion and oat supplementation had phase-dependent effects and may have improved production efficiency and economic outcomes.
papers.abstract_zh: 膳食纖維對豬隻的胃腸道健康與飼料效率至關重要，但替代纖維來源（特別是高黑麥飼料）需要進一步評估。本研究探討了添加黑麥與燕麥對生長肥育豬生長性能、屠體特性及經濟效益的影響。總計 920 頭 DanBred 肥育豬被分配至四種日糧處理：以小麥和大麥為基礎的對照組（CON）、對照組 + 10% 燕麥（CON + O）、生長期含 30% 黑麥且肥育期含 60% 黑麥的黑麥日糧組（RYE），以及 RYE + 10% 燕麥（RYE + O）。在生長期，黑麥顯著增加了日增重，而在黑麥日糧中補充燕麥則顯著降低了採食量和增重。在肥育期，補充燕麥顯著增加了兩個日糧組的日增重，並改善了接受黑麥日糧豬隻的飼料換肉率。在整個肥育期中，補充燕麥的組別具有顯著較高的增重，而 RYE + O 組的採食量和飼料換肉率則低於 RYE 組。含黑麥的日糧產出顯著較瘦的屠體，且在黑麥日糧中補充燕麥降低了背脂厚度。RYE + O 組產生了最低的增重成本，並提高了每頭豬的平均簡化利潤。這些發現表明，納入黑麥與補充燕麥的組合具有階段依賴性效應，並可能改善生產效率與經濟效益。

papers.title: Evidence for the Presence of a Viable Bovine Embryo During Days 18 to 28 After Insemination
papers.abstract: This narrative review asks how accurately available tests identify the presence of a viable bovine embryo during days 18–28 after insemination and what evidence is required to improve their interpretation. We compare each method’s biological target, sampling window, diagnostic performance, reference examination, and validation. Luteal progesterone and color Doppler ultrasonography provide information on corpus luteum function and can support identification of probable non-pregnancy, but persistent luteal activity does not confirm an embryo. Pregnancy-associated glycoproteins provide trophoblast-associated evidence near the later part of this interval. Cervical interferon-tau and maternal interferon-stimulated genes offer earlier conceptus-associated signals, although sampling, specificity, threshold transfer, and independent validation remain limitations. Circulating nucleic acids and multi-omics signatures remain exploratory. None of these indirect signals independently demonstrates embryonic cardiac activity. B-mode ultrasonography provides direct evidence of a living embryo when cardiac activity is reliably visualized, although early performance depends on examination timing and technical conditions. A correct diagnosis at sampling is not invalidated by subsequent pregnancy loss; studies using a later reference examination must distinguish later pregnancy classification from contemporaneous diagnosis. The clearest scientific role of earlier assessment is to investigate embryo establishment and loss using appropriately validated endpoints. Routine commercial benefit cannot be inferred from earlier detection alone, particularly when breeding dates are uncertain or additional handling is required. Priorities are to establish the relationship between early signals and embryo viability, validate prespecified thresholds in independent populations, and evaluate decision value only where a specific unmet need has been demonstrated.
papers.abstract_zh: 本篇敘述性文獻回顧探討現有檢測方法在人工授精後第 18 至 28 天識別具活力牛胚胎之準確度，以及改善其判讀所需之證據。我們比較了各方法的生物學標靶、採樣時間窗、診斷性能、參照檢查與驗證。黃體素與彩色都卜勒超音波可提供黃體功能之資訊，並有助於識別可能的未受孕狀態，但持續的黃體活性並不能確診胚胎的存在。妊娠相關醣蛋白在此時間區段的後半段提供滋養層相關的證據。子宮頸干擾素-tau 與母體干擾素刺激基因則提供較早期的胚胎相關訊號，儘管採樣、專一性、閾值轉移與獨立驗證仍受限制。循環核酸與多體學特徵仍處於探索階段。這些間接訊號均無法獨立證明胚胎心臟活動。B 型超音波在能可靠觀察到心臟活動時計會提供活胚胎的直接證據，雖然早期性能取決於檢查時機與技術條件。採樣時的正確診斷不會因隨後的姙娠損失而失效；使用較晚期參照檢查的研究必須區分後期的妊娠分類與同期的診斷。早期評估最明確的科學角色是利用適當驗證的終點來探討胚胎的建立與損失。常規的商業效益無法僅從早期檢測推論而得，特別是在配種日期不確定或需要額外保定操作的情況下。當務之急是建立早期訊號與胚胎活力之間的關係、在獨立族群中驗證預先指定的閾值，並僅在已證實具特定未滿足需求的情況下評估決策價值。

papers.title: In silico evaluation of selected plant-based compounds as potent dual target inhibitors against highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1 virus
papers.abstract: 1. Influenza viruses remain a serious global health issue due to their high morbidity and mortality rates. Among them, avian influenza H5N1 virus is highly pathogenic, causing up to 100% mortality in poultry. As the avian influenza H5N1 virus continues to mutate across different regions, understanding multiple viral proteins, particularly the mutated haemagglutinin (HA) and neuraminidase (NA), is crucial for effective control.2. In this study, dual-target inhibitors capable of neutralising both HA and NA were developed, and a comprehensive in silico analysis was performed on different variants collected over the past decade. Structural modelling revealed conserved domains in NA (A0A1I9QM14, China) and HA (A0A0A0V4U2, Bali), which were selected for ligand docking.3. Twenty active compounds, traditionally used as natural feed additives in broiler chicken diets, were screened using protein-ligand docking, ADME profiling, and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. Quercetin and luteolin emerged as promising dual-target inhibitors, showing high binding affinity, drug-likeness, and favourable toxicity profiles. The binding free energy (ΔG = −8 ± 0.2 kcal/mol) from docking studies confirmed their inhibitory potential against avian influenza H5N1 virus HA and NA.4. The results demonstrated that virtual screening of natural compounds can effectively identify those effective against influenza virus surface proteins. This integrative computational-experimental strategy supported the development of novel plant-derived antiviral agents with potential applications for disease control.
papers.abstract_zh:
1. 由於流感病毒具有高罹病率與死亡率，至今仍是嚴重的全球健康問題。其中，A型流感H5N1病毒具有高度致病性，對家禽的致病死亡率可高達100%。隨著H5N1禽流感病毒在不同地區持續突變，深入了解多種病毒蛋白（特別是突變的血球凝集素〔HA〕與神經胺酸酶〔NA〕）對於有效防控至關重要。

2. 本研究開發了能同時中和HA與NA的雙標靶抑制劑，並對過去十年收集的不同變異株進行了全面的電腦模擬（in silico）分析。結構建模揭示了NA（A0A1I9QM14，中國）與HA（A0A0A0V4U2，峇里島）中的保守結構域，這些結構域被選用於配體對接。

3. 透過蛋白質-配體對接、ADME（吸收、分佈、代謝、排泄）分析與分子動力學（MD）模擬，篩選了二十種傳統上用作肉雞飼料天然添加物的活性化合物。槲皮素與木犀草素脫穎而出，成為具潛力的雙標靶抑制劑，展現出高度結合親和力、類藥性及良好的毒性學特性。對接研究所得的結合自由能（$\Delta G = -8 \pm 0.2\text{ kcal/mol}$）證實了它們對H5N1禽流感病毒HA與NA的抑制潛力。

4. 結果表明，天然化合物的虛擬篩選能有效辨識出針對流感病毒表面蛋白具療效的成分。此項整合計算與實驗的策略，支持了新型植物源抗病毒劑的開發，並在疾病防控方面具有潛在應用價值。

papers.title: Gene-Length Bias and Compartment Non-Identifiability in Cell-Type Deconvolution of Sheep Skin: A Prospectively Specified and Timestamped Diagnostic Re-Analysis of Wool-Density Transcriptomes in Hetian Sheep
papers.abstract: Bulk skin transcriptomes cannot distinguish cell-intrinsic gene regulation from shifts in tissue-type composition, and computational deconvolution is widely applied to resolve this limitation. In this study, we performed deconvolution on published Hetian sheep skin RNA-seq data from three high-wool-density and three low-wool-density animals, using the available ovine skin single-cell reference. All hypotheses and analytical workflows were prospectively specified and timestamped prior to estimating cell-type fractions. Our work identifies two major methodological pitfalls for livestock tissue deconvolution. First, gene-length bias distorts deconvolution outputs derived from mixed bulk and 3′ single-cell references. After bias correction, the estimated hair-follicle epithelial fraction changed substantially. This bias cannot be uncovered by standard benchmark workflows, highlighting a hidden failure mode for deconvolution. Second, limited signature separability within the reference prevents reliable discrimination between related epidermal compartments. This non-identifiability strongly disturbs apparent compartment-level effects. When analysed at the granularity the reference reliably supports, we found no compositional difference between high- and low-wool-density groups for the epithelial hypothesis. The dermal hypothesis could not be meaningfully evaluated due to incompatible reference compartment merging requirements. Group-level differential expression remained robust despite this null compositional outcome. We recovered a large set of differentially expressed genes consistent with the original study, including most qPCR-validated candidates. Adjusting for cell-type composition altered part of this gene list, as expected given negligible group-level compositional divergence. Co-expression modules correlated more strongly with inter-individual compositional variation than with wool-density phenotype. This indicates compositional heterogeneity shapes transcriptome co-expression even without measurable mean differences across experimental groups. To avoid misleading biological inference, we propose a set of practical diagnostic checks for deconvolution when developmental or limited single-cell atlases are used for livestock tissues. Collectively, these transcriptomic patterns support cell-state-driven regulation rather than detectable mean shifts in tissue compartment composition.
papers.abstract_zh: 群體皮膚轉錄體無法區分細胞固有的基因調控與組織類型組成的轉變，而計算解convolution（去交織／反褶積）已被廣泛應用以解決此限制。在本研究中，我們對已發表、來自三個高羊毛密度與三個低羊毛密度個體的和田羊皮膚 RNA-seq 數據進行了解convolution，並使用了現有的綿羊皮膚單細胞參考群體。所有假設與分析工作流程皆在估算細胞類型比例之前預先指定並加蓋時間戳記。我們的工作指出了家畜組織解convolution的兩個主要方法學陷阱。首先，基因長度偏差會扭曲衍生自混合群體與 3′ 單細胞參考數據的解convolution輸出。在進行偏差校正後，估算的毛囊上皮細胞比例發生了顯著變化。此種偏差無法透過標準的基準測試工作流程被發現，這凸顯了解convolution中一個隱藏的失效模式。其次，參考數據內有限的特徵可區分性，阻礙了對相關表皮區室的可靠鑑別。這種不可辨識性強烈擾亂了表顯的區室層級效應。當以參考數據能夠可靠支援的精細度進行分析時，我們發現上皮細胞假設的高羊毛密度與低羊毛密度組之間並無組成上的差異。由於不相容的參考區室合併需求，真皮假設無法進行有意義的評估。儘管有此零組成的結果，組別層級的差異表現仍保持穩健。我們恢復了與原研究一致的大量差異表現基因，包括大多數經 qPCR 驗證的候選基因。正如在組別層級組成差異微乎其微的情況下所預期的，調整細胞類型組成改變了部分此基因列表。共表現模組與個體間組成變異的相關性，大於其與羊毛密度表現型的相關性。這表明即使在實驗組之間沒有可測量的平均差異的情況下，組成異質性仍會形塑轉錄體共表現。為了避免誤導性的生物學推論，當針對家畜組織使用發育中或有限的單細胞圖譜進行解convolution時，我們提出了一套實用的診斷檢查方法。總體而言，這些轉錄體模式支持的是細胞狀態驅動的調控，而非組織區室組成中可偵測到的平均轉移。

papers.title: Baicalein and Neohesperidin Dihydrochalcone Improve Post-Thaw Sperm Quality and Modulate the Semen Supernatant Metabolome in Qinchuan Bulls
papers.abstract: Oxidative stress during cryopreservation compromises post-thaw sperm quality in bulls. This study evaluated the effects of baicalein (BAI), neohesperidin dihydrochalcone (NHDC) and their combined supplementation on Qinchuan bull sperm cryopreservation and the associated metabolic responses. Concentration screening identified 40 μg/mL BAI and 30 μg/mL NHDC for subsequent experiments. Compared with the control, BAI, NHDC and BAI + NHDC increased post-thaw sperm motility, plasma membrane integrity, acrosome integrity, adenosine triphosphate (ATP) content and mitochondrial membrane potential (MMP). The supplemented groups also showed lower reactive oxygen species (ROS) and malondialdehyde (MDA) levels; higher activities of superoxide dismutase (SOD), catalase (CAT), and glutathione peroxidase (GSH-Px); and higher total antioxidant capacity (T-AOC). The combined treatment showed higher total motility, plasma membrane integrity, and acrosome integrity than either single treatment. Untargeted metabolomics identified 96, 123 and 197 differential metabolites in the BAI, NHDC and BAI + NHDC groups, respectively. Differential metabolites from all three treatments were enriched in lipid-related pathways, including glycerophospholipid metabolism and linoleic acid metabolism. Metabolites identified in the BAI + NHDC group were additionally enriched in nucleotide metabolism, purine metabolism, and ubiquinone-related pathways. BAI × NHDC interaction analysis identified 200 metabolites showing non-additive responses, with enrichment in lipid-related pathways, including glycerophospholipid metabolism and linoleic acid metabolism. Together, BAI and NHDC improved post-thaw sperm quality in Qinchuan bulls, accompanied by changes in oxidative status, mitochondrial function, and lipid- and energy-related metabolites.
papers.abstract_zh: 公牛冷凍保存過程中的氧化壓力會損害解凍後的精子品質。本研究評估了黃芩素（BAI）、新橙皮苷二氫查耳酮（NHDC）及其聯合添加對秦川牛精子冷凍保存及相關代謝反應的影響。濃度篩選確定了 40 μg/mL 的 BAI 和 30 μg/mL 的 NHDC 用於後續實驗。與對照組相比，BAI、NHDC 及 BAI + NHDC 組提高了解凍後精子活力、質膜完整性、頂體完整性、三磷酸腺苷（ATP）含量和線粒體膜電位（MMP）。添加組亦表現出較低的活性氧（ROS）和丙二醛（MDA）水平；較高的超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）、過氧化氫酶（CAT）和穀胱甘肽過氧化物酶（GSH-Px）活性；以及較高的總抗氧化能力（T-AOC）。與單一處理相比，聯合處理顯示出更高的總活力、質膜完整性和頂體完整性。非標靶代謝體學在 BAI、NHDC 和 BAI + NHDC 組中分別鑑定出 96、123 和 197 個差異代謝物。所有三個處理組的差異代謝物均富集於脂質相關途徑，包括甘油磷脂代謝和亞麻油酸代謝。在 BAI + NHDC 組中鑑定的代謝物還額外富集於核苷酸代謝、嘌呤代謝及泛醌相關途徑。BAI × NHDC 交互作用分析鑑定出 200 個表現出非加成性反應的代謝物，其富集於脂質相關途徑，包含甘油磷脂代謝和亞麻油酸代謝。綜上所述，BAI 和 NHDC 改善了秦川牛解凍後的精子品質，並伴隨氧化狀態、線粒體功能以及脂質和能量相關代謝物的改變。

papers.title: Genome‐Wide Characterization of Heterozygosity‐Rich Regions in Kazakh Native Sheep Breeds
papers.abstract: Heterozygosity‐rich regions (HRR) are genomic segments characterized by high heterozygosity that may arise from admixture, introgression, or balancing selection and may harbor loci associated with adaptation and fitness‐related traits. This study aimed to characterize HRR patterns in five Kazakh sheep breeds using a publicly available OvineSNP50 genotyping dataset. After quality control, ~25 000 SNPs were retained for 1634 Akzhaiyk, 1089 Edilbay, 532 Kazakh Fine‐Wool, 932 Kazakh Semi‐Coarse, and 282 Saryarka sheep. HRR were detected separately in each breed using the sliding‐window approach in detectRUNS R package, with a minimum segment length of 250 kb, at least 10 SNPs per window and segment, and a maximum of two opposing homozygous and one missing SNP per window. The average number of HRR per individual ranged from 40.75 ± 6.38 in Saryarka to 54.75 ± 7.34 in Kazakh Fine‐Wool sheep. HRR lengths ranged from 259.07 kb to 3.26 Mb, with an average of 0.7 Mb across breeds. Seventeen HRR islands, defined as regions shared by HRR in at least 25% of individuals within a breed, were identified, including regions on chromosomes 8 and 17 shared across all breeds. Genes overlapping these islands were associated with cellular homeostasis, immunity, metabolism, growth, and stress response, while the HRR islands overlapped with QTL associated with health, wool characteristics, and reproduction. These findings highlight the potential of HRR analysis to identify candidate genomic regions relevant to adaptation and economically important traits, providing insights for the conservation and genetic improvement of Kazakh sheep populations.
papers.abstract_zh: 富含雜合性區域（Heterozygosity‐rich regions, HRR）是以高雜合性為特徵的基因組片段，可能源自基因滲入、滲透或平衡選擇，並可能包含與適應及適應度相關性狀關聯的位點。本研究旨在利用公開可得的 OvineSNP50 基因型資料集，表徵五個哈薩克綿羊品種中的 HRR 模式。經過品質控制後，分別保留了 1634 隻阿克扎伊克綿羊（Akzhaiyk）、1089 隻埃迪爾拜綿羊（Edilbay）、532 隻哈薩克細毛羊（Kazakh Fine‐Wool）、932 隻哈薩克半粗毛羊（Kazakh Semi‐Coarse）以及 282 隻薩雷阿拉克綿羊（Saryarka）的大約 25,000 個 SNP。使用 detectRUNS R 套件中的滑動視窗方法，在各品種中分別偵測 HRR，最小片段長度設定為 250 kb，每個視窗和片段至少包含 10 個 SNP，每個視窗最多允許兩個相反的純合子 SNP 和一個缺失的 SNP。每個個體的平均 HRR 數量從薩雷阿拉克綿羊的 40.75 ± 6.38 到哈薩克細毛羊的 54.75 ± 7.34 不等。HRR 長度介於 259.07 kb 至 3.26 Mb 之間，各品種的平均長度為 0.7 Mb。共鑑定出 17 個 HRR 熱點區（定義為在品種內至少 25% 的個體中共享的 HRR 區域），其中包括跨所有品種共享的第 8 號和第 17 號染色體上的區域。與這些熱點區重疊的基因與細胞恆定、免疫、代謝、生長和壓力反應相關，同時這些 HRR 熱點區與和健康、羊毛特性及繁殖相關的 QTL 重疊。這些發現凸顯了 HRR 分析在識別與適應及經濟重要性狀相關的候選基因組區域方面的潛力，為哈薩克綿羊族群的保育和遺傳改良提供了見解。

papers.title: Effects of Dietary Wolfberry Sprout Stems and Leaves on the Rumen Bacterial Community of Fattening Tan Sheep and Its Association with Fermentation and Growth Traits
papers.abstract: Wolfberry (Lycium barbarum) sprouts are harvested on a large scale in Ningxia, and the residual tender stems and leaves constitute an abundant but largely unused by-product. This experiment was conducted to investigate the effects of dietary supplementation with different proportions of wolfberry (Lycium barbarum) sprout stems and leaves (WSSLs) on rumen fermentation and the rumen bacterial community of fattening Tan sheep, and to reveal the relationships between rumen bacteria and fermentation and growth traits. Forty-eight healthy 3-month-old weaned Tan rams with similar body weight ((22.75 ± 0.52) kg) were randomly divided into four groups of 12 sheep; the control group (G0) was fed a basal diet, while the G4, G8 and G12 groups were fed basal diets in which 4%, 8% and 12% of the corn straw was replaced by WSSLs. The adaptation period lasted 10 days and the experimental period 60 days. At the end of the experiment, six sheep per group (24 in total) were slaughtered and rumen contents were collected for fermentation measurements, and the V3–V4 region of the bacterial 16S rRNA gene was sequenced on the Illumina NovaSeq platform. Ruminal pH, ammonia nitrogen (NH3-N) and microbial crude protein (MCP) did not differ among groups (p > 0.05), whereas total volatile fatty acid (VFA) concentration differed (30.15–56.27 mmol/L; p = 0.025), together with acetate (p = 0.032) and butyrate (p = 0.010); these VFA differences were driven mainly by the high and variable values in the control group and showed no dose–response. Average daily gain was higher in G8 than in G0 and G4 (p = 0.010), and live weight before slaughter and carcass weight increased with the dietary WSSL level (p = 0.011 and 0.013). Seventeen phyla and 210 genera were identified, with Bacteroidota and Bacillota dominant; the relative abundance of Bacteroidota decreased while that of Bacillota tended to increase with the WSSL level, and Xylanibacter was the most abundant genus (15.85–18.18%). Alpha diversity indices did not differ among groups (p > 0.05), and principal coordinate analysis (PCoA) based on Bray–Curtis distance showed limited separation (Adonis R2 = 0.157, p = 0.002). Nine genera showed nominal between-group variation (uncorrected p < 0.05); however, after Benjamini–Hochberg FDR correction across all 210 genera tested, none remained significant (all q = 1.00). Howardella was negatively correlated with acetate, propionate, butyrate and total VFA (p < 0.05), U29-B03 was positively correlated with live weight before slaughter and carcass weight (p < 0.05), and bacteria of Christensenellaceae were positively correlated with propionate, butyrate and total VFA (p < 0.05); none of these associations survived FDR correction. Dietary supplementation with 4–12% WSSLs did not depress growth performance and did not significantly alter the abundance of any individual taxon after correction for multiple testing; it moderately alters rumen bacterial community composition, and WSSLs can be used safely at inclusion levels of 4–12% as an unconventional feed resource for fattening Tan sheep.
papers.abstract_zh: 枸杞（Lycium barbarum）幼苗在寧夏進行大規模採收，其殘留的嫩莖葉構成了豐富但大多未被利用的副產物。本實驗旨在探討日糧中添加不同比例的枸杞嫩莖葉（WSSLs）對育肥灘羊瘤胃發酵及瘤胃細菌群落的影響，並揭示瘤胃細菌與發酵及生長性狀之間的關係。選取 48 隻健康、體重相近（(22.75 ± 0.52) kg）的 3 月齡斷奶灘羊公羊，隨機分為 4 組，每組 12 隻；對照組（G0）飼餵基礎日糧，G4、G8 和 G12 組則飼餵分別用 4%、8% 和 12% 的 WSSLs 取代部分玉米秸稈的基礎日糧。預試期為 10 天，正試期為 60 天。試驗結束時，每組屠宰 6 隻羊（共 24 隻）並採集瘤胃內容物進行發酵測定，並利用 Illumina NovaSeq 平台對細菌 16S rRNA 基因的 V3–V4 區進行定序。各組間的瘤胃 pH 值、氨態氮（NH3-N）和微生物粗蛋白（MCP）無顯著差異（p > 0.05），而總揮發性脂肪酸（VFA）濃度則存在差異（30.15–56.27 mmol/L；p = 0.025），乙酸（p = 0.032）和丁酸（p = 0.010）亦同；這些 VFA 的差異主要由對照組較高且變異的值所驅動，且未呈現劑量效應反應。G8 組的平均日增重高於 G0 和 G4 組（p = 0.010），且屠宰前活重和胴體重隨著日糧 WSSL 添加水平的增加而增加（p = 0.011 和 0.013）。共鑑定出 17 個門和 210 個屬，其中擬桿菌門（Bacteroidota）和厚壁菌門（Bacillota）佔優勢；隨著 WSSL 添加水平的增加，擬桿菌門的相對豐度下降，而厚壁菌門則呈增加趨勢，其中木聚醣桿菌屬（Xylanibacter）為最豐富的屬（15.85–18.18%）。各組間的阿爾法多樣性指數（Alpha diversity indices）無顯著差異（p > 0.05），基於 Bray–Curtis 距離的主座標分析（PCoA）顯示有限的分離（Adonis R2 = 0.157，p = 0.002）。有 9 個屬顯示出名義上的組間變異（未校正的 p < 0.05）；然而，在對所有 210 個測試屬進行 Benjamini–Hochberg FDR 校正後，沒有任何屬保持顯著（皆 q = 1.00）。Howardella 與乙酸、丙酸、丁酸和總 VFA 呈負相關（p < 0.05），U29-B03 與屠宰前活重和胴體重呈正相關（p < 0.05），克里斯滕森菌科（Christensenellaceae）的細菌與丙酸、丁酸和總 VFA 呈正相關（p < 0.05）；這些關聯在經過 FDR 校正後皆不顯著。日糧中添加 4–12% 的 WSSLs 不會降低生長性能，且在進行多重檢定校正後，不會顯著改變任何單一分類群的豐度；它能適度改變瘤胃細菌群落組成，WSSLs 可作為育肥灘羊的一種非常規飼料資源，以 4–12% 的添加水平安全使用。

papers.title: Neuro-behavioural modulatory and bio-disinfectant effects of standardised Peganum harmala L. extract on incubation performance and neonatal welfare in quail
papers.abstract: 1. The following study investigated the effects of a standardised Peganum harmala L. (PH) extract on post-hatch behaviour, environmental adaptation, incubation performance and eggshell disinfection in Japanese quail (Coturnix japonica).2. A total of 520 fertile eggs were utilised in the experiment, with 130 eggs randomly assigned to each of the four treatment groups: distilled water (P1), ethanol (P2), 1% PH extract (P3) or 5% PH extract (P4) appliedviaactive humidification on d 1, 3, 7 and 14 of incubation. Analysis by GC-MS was used to identify peganine and quinazoline alkaloids as the primary bioactive components of the PH extract.3. Behavioural assessments (Open Field and Runway tests) showed shorter behavioural latency and enhanced exploratory behaviour in chicks exposed to PH extract compared with controls.4. Microbial analysis showed that the 5% extract (P4) achieved the lowest bacterial load on day 10 compared with P1 (p < 0.05). The eggs in the P4 group had the highest fertile hatchability and chick quality scores among the treatment groups.5. Standardised PH extract represents a promising botanical disinfectant associated with favourable behavioural outcomes in newly hatched chicks, with potential applications for hatchery management.
papers.abstract_zh:
1. 本研究探討了標準化駱駝蓬（Peganum harmala L., PH）萃取物對日本鵪鶉（Coturnix japonica）孵化後行為、環境適應、孵化表現及蛋殼消毒的影響。

2. 本實驗總共使用 520 枚受精蛋，隨機分配至四個處理組，每組 130 枚：於孵化第 1、3、7 和 14 天透過主動加濕分別施用蒸餾水（P1）、乙醇（P2）、1% PH 萃取物（P3）或 5% PH 萃取物（P4）。透過氣相層析質譜儀（GC-MS）分析，確認培加寧（peganine）與喹唑啉生物鹼（quinazoline alkaloids）為 PH 萃取物的主要生物活性成分。

3. 行為評估（開闊場測試與跑道測試）顯示，與對照組相比，暴露於 PH 萃取物的雛鳥表現出較短的行為潛伏期及增強的探索行為。

4. 微生物分析顯示，與 P1 組相比，5% 萃取物組（P4）在第 10 天達到了最低的細菌負荷（p < 0.05）。在各處理組中，P4 組的蛋具有最高的受精卵孵化率及雛鳥品質評分。

5. 標準化 PH 萃取物是一種具潛力的植物性消毒劑，且與初孵雛鳥的良好行為表現相關，在孵化場管理中具有潛在的應用價值。

papers.title: Effect of Dietary Rumen-Protected Methionine and Lysine on Performance and Plasma Amino Acid of Dairy Cows: A Meta-Analysis
papers.abstract: Low-protein diets supplemented with rumen-protected methionine and lysine (RPML) can optimize amino acid supply while maintaining milk performance and reducing environmental impacts. But responses of cows to RPML are inconsistent and modulating factors remain poorly understood. This meta-analysis tested whether RPML supplementation improves lactational performance and alters plasma amino acid profiles of dairy cows. Forty-two eligible studies published up to 1 June 2026 were retrieved from PubMed, Web of Science and ScienceDirect. Meta-analysis, subgroup analysis, correlation analysis and dose–response regression were adopted. Results showed that RPML supplementation significantly increased milk yield by 0.500 kg/d, energy-corrected milk by 1.378 kg/d, protein yield by 0.038 kg/d, protein concentration by 0.052%, fat yield by 0.030 kg/d, fat concentration by 0.043%, 3.5% fat-corrected milk by 0.778 kg/d, milk total nitrogen by 0.010%, and casein nitrogen by 0.007%. Plasma arginine, asparagine, isoleucine, leucine, lysine and methionine increased, while glycine declined. Subgroup analysis showed that cow breed, parity, lactation stage, basal diet and dietary crude protein were key moderators. Digestible methionine dosage correlated with milk fat concentration and plasma leucine, and digestible lysine dosage correlated with milk protein yield. Significant regression models confirmed the combined effects of methionine and lysine on multiple milk traits. These results indicate that supplementation with RPML represents an effective nutritional strategy for enhancing milk yield and milk quality in dairy cows. Such findings may assist producers and nutritionists in refining amino acid feeding programs to optimize dairy cow productive performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 補充瘤胃保護性甲硫胺酸與離胺酸（RPML）的低蛋白飼糧，能在維持泌乳表現並減少環境衝擊的同時，最佳化胺基酸供應。然而，乳牛對 RPML 的反應並不一致，且其調節因子仍所知有限。本統合分析旨在檢驗補充 RPML 是否能改善乳牛的泌乳表現並改變其血漿胺基酸圖譜。從 PubMed、Web of Science 和 ScienceDirect 檢索截至 2026 年 6 月 1 日發布的 42 篇符合條件的研究。採用統合分析、次群組分析、相關性分析及劑量效應迴歸。結果顯示，補充 RPML 顯著增加了產乳量 0.500 kg/d、能量校正乳產量 1.378 kg/d、乳蛋白產量 0.038 kg/d、乳蛋白濃度 0.052%、乳脂產量 0.030 kg/d、乳脂濃度 0.043%、3.5% 脂校正乳產量 0.778 kg/d、乳總氮 0.010% 以及酪蛋白氮 0.007%。血漿精胺酸、天冬胺酸、異白胺酸、白胺酸、離胺酸和甲硫胺酸增加，而甘胺酸下降。次群組分析顯示，乳牛品種、胎次、泌乳階段、基礎飼糧及飼糧粗蛋白質為關鍵調節因子。可消化甲硫胺酸劑量與乳脂濃度及血漿白胺酸相關，可消化離胺酸劑量則與乳蛋白產量相關。顯著的迴歸模型證實了甲硫胺酸和離胺酸對多項乳品性狀的綜合效應。這些結果表明，補充 RPML 是提升乳牛產乳量與乳品質的有效營養策略。這些發現有助於畜牧生產者與營養學家精進胺基酸飼養計畫，以最佳化乳牛的生產表現。

papers.title: Neutering Practices, Reproductive Management, and Clinical Findings in European Endurance Sled Dogs: A Field Study from the Lekkarod® Event
papers.abstract: Decisions regarding neutering in athletic sled dogs involve a complex balance between health, behaviour, performance, breeding objectives, and management considerations. However, evidence regarding neutering practices and their relationship with health outcomes in actively competing sled dogs remains limited. To identify factors associated with neutering status and musher-reported motivations for neutering or maintaining dogs intact, and to evaluate the occurrence and distribution of clinical findings according to reproductive status in sled dogs participating in the 2023 Lekkarod® event. A total of 599 sled dogs registered for the 2023 Lekkarod® event, including participants in the main endurance race and the associated Kraft tournament, were included. Information regarding age, sex, breed, neutering status, and owner-reported motivations was collected using a structured questionnaire. Multivariable logistic regression was used to identify factors associated with neutering status. Clinical findings recorded during veterinary examinations conducted throughout the main Lekkarod race were classified and analysed according to reproductive status. Overall, 28.0% (168/599) of dogs were neutered. Neutering was significantly associated with female sex, older age, and breed category, whereas team position was not associated with reproductive status. The most frequently reported reasons for neutering were reproductive management, behavioural management, and disease prevention, whereas breeding purposes, preservation of genetic lines, performance-related considerations, and ethical concerns were the principal motivations for maintaining dogs intact. A total of 82 clinical findings were recorded, corresponding to 13.7% of the study population. Reproductive status was not associated with the overall occurrence of clinical abnormalities. However, the distribution of clinical finding categories differed significantly according to reproductive status (χ2 = 7.564, p = 0.023). Intact dogs presented proportionally more metabolic/systemic abnormalities, whereas neutered dogs presented proportionally more musculoskeletal findings. The observed distribution of musculoskeletal findings was not explained by age alone. In this population of actively competing European sled dogs, neutering was relatively uncommon and reflected a combination of reproductive management, health, breeding, and performance-related considerations. Although reproductive status was not associated with the overall occurrence of clinical abnormalities during competition, it was associated with differing patterns of clinical findings. Intact dogs presented proportionally more metabolic abnormalities, whereas neutered dogs presented proportionally more musculoskeletal findings. These findings support an individualised approach to reproductive management in canine athletes and warrant further prospective investigation of the relationships among reproductive status, metabolic adaptation, musculoskeletal health, and athletic performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 關於運動雪橇犬是否進行絕育的決策，涉及健康、行為、表現、繁殖目標與管理考量之間的複雜平衡。然而，關於絕育實務及其與活躍競賽雪橇犬健康結果之間關聯的證據仍然有限。本研究旨在識別與絕育狀態相關的因素、御犬員（musher）回報絕育或維持犬隻未絕育的動機，並評估參與 2023 年 Lekkarod® 賽事之雪橇犬根據繁殖狀態的臨床發現之發生率與分佈。總計 599 隻報名 2023 年 Lekkarod® 賽事的雪橇犬被納入研究，包含主耐力賽及相關之 Kraft 賽事的參賽犬。透過結構化問卷收集有關年齡、性別、品種、絕育狀態以及飼主回報之動機的資訊。使用多變量邏輯斯迴歸來識別與絕育狀態相關的因素。對在主要 Lekkarod 賽事期間進行的獸醫檢查中所記錄的臨床發現進行分類，並根據繁殖狀態進行分析。總體而言，28.0%（168/599）的犬隻已絕育。絕育與雌性、高齡及品種類別顯著相關，而團隊位置則與繁殖狀態無關。回報絕育最常見的原因為繁殖管理、行為管理與疾病預防，而繁殖目的、保存遺傳品系、表現相關考量以及倫理考量則是維持犬隻未絕育的主要動機。共記錄了 82 項臨床發現，佔研究群體的 13.7%。繁殖狀態與臨床異常的整體發生率無關。然而，臨床發現類別的分佈根據繁殖狀態有顯著差異（χ2 = 7.564, p = 0.023）。未絕育犬隻呈現較高比例的代謝／全身性異常，而絕育犬隻則呈現較高比例的肌肉骨骼發現。觀察到的肌肉骨骼發現分佈無法單獨以年齡來解釋。在這群活躍競賽的歐洲雪橇犬中，絕育相對少見，且反映了繁殖管理、健康、育種及表現相關考量的結合。儘管繁殖狀態與競賽期間臨床異常的整體發生率無關，但它與不同的臨床發現模式相關。未絕育犬隻呈現較高比例的代謝異常，而絕育犬隻則呈現較高比例的肌肉骨骼發現。這些發現支持對犬隻運動員採取個體化的繁殖管理方法，並有必要進一步前瞻性探討繁殖狀態、代謝適應、肌肉骨骼健康與運動表現之間的關聯。

papers.title: Dietary Supplementation with Mitragyna speciosa Leaf Powder and Saccharomyces cerevisiae Improves Nutrient Digestibility, Rumen Fermentation Efficiency, and Microbial Nitrogen Supply in Thai Native Beef Cattle
papers.abstract: This study evaluated the effects of Mitragyna speciosa leaf powder (MSP) and Saccharomyces cerevisiae (SC) supplementation on nutrient intake and digestibility, rumen fermentation, microbial populations, and microbial protein synthesis in Thai native beef cattle. Four female Thai native cattle (130.0 ± 7.4 kg body weight at the start of the experiment) were randomly assigned in a 4 × 4 Latin square design to four dietary treatments: (T1) total mixed ration (TMR) alone (control); (T2) TMR + MSP at 10 g/head/day; (T3) TMR + SC at 10 g/head/day; and (T4) TMR + MSP at 5 g/head/day + SC at 5 g/head/day. A TMR containing 14% crude protein was offered ad libitum throughout four 21-day periods. Total dry matter intake and nutrient intakes did not differ among treatments (p > 0.05), although the planned contrast between the control and the supplemented treatments indicated a small shortfall in the control for dry matter intake (p = 0.041). Apparent total-tract digestibility of dry matter, organic matter, crude protein, and acid detergent fiber was higher in supplemented animals than in the control (p < 0.05), and neutral detergent fiber digestibility tended to increase (p = 0.052). Ruminal pH increased, significantly so in the two treatments containing SC (p = 0.001), whereas ruminal ammonia nitrogen and blood urea nitrogen decreased with supplementation (p < 0.05). Total volatile fatty acid concentration was unchanged, but the propionate proportion increased and estimated methane production decreased (p < 0.05). Total bacterial counts increased and protozoal counts decreased with supplementation (p < 0.05), while fungal counts were unaffected. Urinary purine derivative excretion and absorption increased with supplementation, and microbial nitrogen supply rose from 24.66 to 34.21–35.93 g N/d (p = 0.002). The efficiency of microbial nitrogen supply rose from 15.44 to 19.30–20.07 g N/kg of organic matter digested in the rumen (p = 0.007). Supplementation with MSP and SC, alone or in combination at 5 g of each, therefore enhances nutrient digestibility and rumen fermentation efficiency in Thai native beef cattle without depressing intake.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究評估了補充哥白 kratom（Mitragyna speciosa）葉粉（MSP）與釀酒酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae, SC）對泰國本地肉牛之營養分攝取量與消化率、瘤胃發酵、微生物菌相及微生物蛋白質合成的影響。試驗選用四頭雌性泰國本地肉牛（試驗開始時體重為 130.0 ± 7.4 kg），以 4 × 4 拉丁方格設計隨機分配至四種日糧處理：(1) 僅餵食全混合日糧（TMR，對照組）；(2) TMR + MSP 10 g/頭/天；(3) TMR + SC 10 g/頭/天；以及 (4) TMR + MSP 5 g/頭/天 + SC 5 g/頭/天。所有處理在四個為期 21 天的試驗期中皆自由採食含 14% 粗蛋白質之 TMR。各處理間的總乾物質攝取量與營養分攝取量無顯著差異（p > 0.05），惟對照組與補充組之間的預定對比顯示，對照組的乾物質攝取量略低（p = 0.041）。補充組動物的乾物質、有機物、粗蛋白質和酸性洗滌纖維之全消化道表觀消化率均高於對照組（p < 0.05），中性洗滌纖維消化率亦有增加的趨勢（p = 0.052）。瘤胃 pH 值上升，其中含有 SC 的兩個處理組呈顯著上升（p = 0.001），而瘤胃氨態氮和血液尿素氮則隨補充劑的使用而下降（p < 0.05）。總揮發性脂肪酸濃度維持不變，但丙酸比例增加，估計甲烷產量降低（p < 0.05）。補充劑的使用使總細菌數增加、原蟲數減少（p < 0.05），而真菌數則不受影響。尿液中普林衍生物的排泄量與吸收量隨補充劑的使用而增加，微生物氮供應量從 24.66 g N/d 升至 34.21–35.93 g N/d（p = 0.002）。在瘤胃內消化的有機物中，微生物氮供應效率從 15.44 升至 19.30–20.07 g N/kg（p = 0.007）。因此，單獨補充或以各 5 g 組合補充 MSP 和 SC，可在不抑制採食量的情況下，提高泰國本地肉牛的營養分消化率與瘤胃發酵效率。

papers.title: GnIH Modulates Proliferation, Apoptosis, and Steroid Hormone Secretion in Tibetan Sheep Granulosa Cells
papers.abstract: Gonadotropin-inhibitory hormone (GnIH) is a key neuropeptide that negatively regulates animal reproduction. This study aims to elucidate its functional mechanism in Tibetan sheep, a characteristic plateau-adapted breed. A total of 12 Tibetan sheep were used in this study. For granulosa cell experiments, granulosa cells were isolated from the ovaries of three independent Tibetan sheep to generate three biological replicates, and three technical replicates were set for qPCR and Western blot detection within each biological replicate. The mRNA levels of GnIH in gonadal axis tissues, including the hypothalamus, pituitary, ovary, uterus and oviduct, were detected using RT-qPCR, and fluorescence in situ hybridization was performed to identify the subcellular localization of GnIH in ovarian granulosa cells. The overexpression plasmid pcDNA3.1 GnIH and GnIH-targeted siRNA fragments were constructed and transfected into Tibetan sheep ovarian granulosa cells. Cell proliferation, apoptosis, cell cycle distribution, and hormone secretion were examined with the aid of CCK 8 assay, flow cytometry, RT-qPCR and ELISA. The results showed that GnIH was widely expressed in gonadal axis tissues of Tibetan ewes. The highest mRNA abundance of GnIH was found in the hypothalamus, followed by the ovary. GnIH signals were mainly localized in the cytoplasm of ovarian granulosa cells. GnIH overexpression reduced granulosa cell viability, arrested cell cycle progression, upregulated proapoptotic genes BAX, Caspase 3 and Caspase 9, and downregulated the proliferation-related gene PCNA. Simultaneously, the secretion of estradiol (E2) and progesterone (P4) was simultaneously reduced. Endogenous GnIH knockdown enhanced the proliferative capacity of granulosa cells, inhibited cell apoptosis, uplifted the proportions of S phase and G2/M phase cells, and elevated estradiol secretion. These results confirm that GnIH acts as a negative regulator of granulosa cell function. It inhibits follicular development by suppressing cell proliferation, promoting cell apoptosis and reducing steroid hormone synthesis. These in vitro observations offer preliminary clues regarding the regulatory role of GnIH in granulosa cell proliferation and apoptosis.
papers.abstract_zh: 促性腺激素抑制激素（GnIH）是用於負向調節動物生殖的關鍵神經肽。本研究旨在闡明其在具高原適應特徵的品種——藏綿羊體內的功能機制。本研究總共使用了 12 隻藏綿羊。在顆粒細胞實驗中，從 3 隻獨立的藏綿羊卵巢中分離出顆粒細胞以產生 3 個生物學重複，並且在每個生物學重複內設置 3 個技術重複以進行 qPCR 和西方墨點法檢測。利用 RT-qPCR 檢測 GnIH 在性腺軸組織（包括下視丘、腦下垂體、卵巢、子宮和輸卵管）中的 mRNA 表現量，並進行螢光原位雜交以鑑定 GnIH 在卵巢顆粒細胞中的亞細胞定位。建構過度表現質體 pcDNA3.1-GnIH 及標靶 GnIH 之 siRNA 片段，並轉染至藏綿羊卵巢顆粒細胞中。借助 CCK-8 檢測、流式細胞儀、RT-qPCR 和 ELISA 檢查細胞增生、細胞凋亡、細胞週期分佈以及荷爾蒙分泌。結果顯示，GnIH 在母藏綿羊的性腺軸組織中廣泛表現。GnIH 的 mRNA 豐度以下視丘最高，卵巢次之。GnIH 訊號主要定位於卵巢顆粒細胞的細胞質中。GnIH 過度表現降低了顆粒細胞活力、阻滯細胞週期進展、上調促凋亡基因 BAX、Caspase 3 和 Caspase 9，並下調增生相關基因 PCNA。同時，雌二醇（E2）和黃體素（P4）的分泌量均減少。內源性 GnIH 基因敲低增強了顆粒細胞的增生能力、抑制細胞凋亡、提高 S 期和 G2/M 期細胞的比例，並提升雌二醇的分泌。這些結果證實，GnIH 作為顆粒細胞功能的負向調節因子。它透過抑制細胞增生、促進細胞凋亡及減少類固醇荷爾蒙合成來抑制卵泡發育。這些體外觀察結果為 GnIH 在顆粒細胞增生與凋亡中的調節作用提供了初步線索。

papers.title: Effect of Magnesium Oxide on In Vitro Fermentation Parameters and Methane Emission from Low and High-Grain Diets in Ruminants
papers.abstract: CH4 emissions from cattle are a major contributor of greenhouse gases in the world. Finding additives to mitigate CH4 production is essential to achieve sustainable livestock operations. MgO may reduce carbon dioxide (CO2) production under anaerobic conditions and, theoretically, can decrease CH4 synthesis. To evaluate the effects of MgO on CH4 production and dry matter digestibility (DMD) using an in vitro ruminant model, two experiments were conducted. The first experiment evaluated the combined effect of replacing sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO3) with MgO and of CO2 flushing (as a C source) on CH4 production and fermentation parameters. The second experiment evaluated the addition of three MgO sources (A, B, and C at 50 mg/g of DM) to one of three substrates (100% corn, 50:50 corn/forage, or 100% forage) in three independent incubations. In both experiments, CH4 concentration and production, gas production, pH, and DMD were individually determined in each bottle per incubation. Data for Experiment 1 were analyzed under a completely randomized design with a 2 × 2 factorial arrangement; for Experiment 2, data were analyzed using the MIXED procedure from SAS following a randomized complete block design with a 3 × 4 factorial arrangement. In Experiment 1, replacing NaHCO3 with MgO reduced gas production and CH4 concentration while increasing pH. In contrast, CO2 flushing increased CH4 concentration and decreased pH. In Experiment 2, increasing forage inclusion reduced CH4 production and gas production, which is potentially associated with the reduced DMD in forage. Supplementation of MgO at 50 mg/g of DM reduced gas production and CH4 yield without significantly affecting DMD. Source A reduced CH4 production per gram of incubated dry matter by 44.6% relative to the non-supplemented control and reduced CH4 yield per gram of DMD. Overall, MgO modified fermentation responses and reduced in vitro CH4 production without significantly affecting DMD. Source A seemed to mediate an aggressive CH4 yield reduction in forage-based substrate. Despite these promising results, further studies measuring fermentation products and evaluating animal responses are needed to clarify the mechanisms and practical applications of MgO addition in cattle diets.
papers.abstract_zh: 牛隻的 $\text{CH}_4$ 排放是全球溫室氣體的主要貢獻源之一。尋找能減少 $\text{CH}_4$ 生成的添加劑，對於實現永續畜牧業至關重要。$\text{MgO}$ 可能在厭氧條件下減少二氧化碳（$\text{CO}_2$）生成，從理論上講，能夠降低 $\text{CH}_4$ 的合成。為了評估 $\text{MgO}$ 對 $\text{CH}_4$ 生成及乾物質消化率（DMD）的影響，本研究利用體外反芻動物模型進行了兩項實驗。第一實驗評估以 $\text{MgO}$ 取代碳酸氫鈉（$\text{NaHCO}_3$）以及 $\text{CO}_2$ 沖洗（作為碳源）對 $\text{CH}_4$ 生成及醱酵參數的綜合影響。第二實驗則在三個獨立的培養中，評估三種 $\text{MgO}$ 來源（A、B 和 C，添加量為 50 mg/g 乾物質）對三種基質（100% 玉米、50:50 玉米/粗飼料，或 100% 粗飼料）中其中一者的添加效果。在兩個實驗中，分別測定每瓶每次培養中的 $\text{CH}_4$ 濃度與生成量、總氣體生成量、pH 值以及 DMD。實驗一的數據以完全隨機設計進行分析，採 2 × 2 因子排列；實驗二的數據則利用 SAS 的 MIXED 程序，根據隨機完全區集設計進行分析，採 3 × 4 因子排列。在實驗一中，以 $\text{MgO}$ 取代 $\text{NaHCO}_3$ 降低了總氣體生成量和 $\text{CH}_4$ 濃度，同時提高了 pH 值。相比之下，$\text{CO}_2$ 沖洗則增加了 $\text{CH}_4$ 濃度並降低了 pH 值。在實驗二中，增加粗飼料比例降低了 $\text{CH}_4$ 生成量和總氣體生成量，這可能與粗飼料中較低的 DMD 有關。以 50 mg/g 乾物質補充 $\text{MgO}$ 降低了總氣體生成量和 $\text{CH}_4$ 產率，且未顯著影響 DMD。來源 A 使每克受孵育乾物質的 $\text{CH}_4$ 生成量較未補充的對照組減少了 44.6%，並降低了每克 DMD 的 $\text{CH}_4$ 產率。總體而言，$\text{MgO}$ 改變了醱酵反應並降低了體外 $\text{CH}_4$ 生成量，同時未顯著影響 DMD。來源 A 似乎能在以粗飼料為基礎的基質中發揮積極的 $\text{CH}_4$ 產率削減作用。儘管這些結果令人振奮，仍需進一步研究來測定醱酵產物並評估動物反應，以釐清在牛隻日糧中添加 $\text{MgO}$ 的機制與實際應用。

papers.title: Decoding the lncRNA landscape in bovine mastitis: insights into immune regulation and gene networks underlying host response
papers.abstract: Background Long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) are critical regulatory elements of gene expression and play a crucial role in immune regulation of disease, such as bovine mastitis. With this study we evaluated expression profile of lncRNAs in subclinical intramammary infection (sIMI) from two pathogens: Streptococcus agalactiae ( S. agalactiae ; Sa+) and Prototheca spp. (P+) and predicted their interaction with protein coding genes in 31 Holstein cows. Quantitative trait loci (QTL) annotation and enrichment analysis was carried out on the lncRNAs partner genes for a comprehensive overview of their potential association with phenotypic traits. Finally, Partial Correlation and Information Theory (PCIT) and Regulatory Impact Factor (RIF) algorithms were adopted to assess co-expression network of differentially expressed lncRNAs (DELs) and genes (DEGs). Results A total of 211, 146, 353 and 184 DELs were identified when comparing Sa+ vs. Neg, P+ vs. Neg, Sa+ vs. P+, and uninfected vs. infected animals (Mast vs. Neg), respectively. Most of these DELs were mainly located within genic regions, and 78% had not been previously annotated in the bovine reference genome. Overall S. agalactiae infection modulated both immune and metabolic pathways (lipid metabolism, extracellular matrix synthesis), whereas Prototheca spp. infection activated immune signaling networks (B-cell and innate immunity). Unique lncRNAs induced by Sa+ were predicted to target genes controlling fatty acid synthesis and milk fat QTLs, while P+-induced lncRNAs were found associated mostly with immune genes and somatic cell count QTLs. The co-expression network also revealed shared lncRNAs between the two types of infection suggesting a core response: both infections converge on common hub genes (e.g., EBF1 , BTLA ), indicating potential conserved host-defense mechanisms. Conclusions These results suggest that, despite distinct lncRNA expression patterns, the downstream regulatory pathways—particularly those linked to immune function—may converge toward a shared host response during subclinical intramammary infections. Together, these findings underscore the complexity of lncRNA-mediated regulation in the bovine mammary gland and highlight the need for functional studies to clarify the biological roles of these novel transcripts.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Science and Biotechnology
papers.abstract_zh: 背景 長鏈非coding RNA（lncRNAs）是基因表現的關鍵調節元件，並在疾病的免疫調節中扮演至關重要的角色，例如牛乳房炎。本研究評估了來自兩種病原體：無乳鏈球菌（Streptococcus agalactiae，Sa+）與藻樣原體屬（Prototheca spp.，P+）引起的亞臨床乳房內感染（sIMI）中 lncRNAs 的表現圖譜，並預測其與 31 頭荷 Holstein 乳牛中蛋白質編碼基因的交互作用。對 lncRNA 伴侶基因進行了數量性狀基因座（QTL）註釋與富集分析，以全面了解其與表型性狀的潛在關聯。最後，採用偏相關與資訊理論（PCIT）以及調節影響因子（RIF）演算法來評估差異表現 lncRNAs（DELs）與基因（DEGs）的共表現網路。結果 在比較 Sa+ 對 Neg、P+ 對 Neg、Sa+ 對 P+ 以及未感染對感染動物（Mast 對 Neg）時，分別鑑定出總共 211、146、353 和 184 個 DELs。這些 DELs 大多位於基因區域內，且有 78% 尚未在牛隻參考基因組中被註釋。整體而言，無乳鏈球菌感染同時調節了免疫與代謝途徑（脂質代謝、細胞外基質合成），而藻樣原體屬感染則活化了免疫訊號傳遞網路（B 細胞與先天免疫）。預測由 Sa+ 誘導的獨特 lncRNAs 其標的為控制脂肪酸合成與乳脂 QTL 的基因，而 P+ 誘導的 lncRNAs 則被發現主要與免疫基因及體細胞數 QTL 有關。共表現網路也揭示了兩種感染之間共有的 lncRNAs，暗示了一種核心反應：這兩種感染皆匯聚於共同的樞紐基因（例如 EBF1、BTLA），顯示出潛在且保守的宿主防禦機制。結論 這些結果表明，儘管具有不同的 lncRNA 表現模式，但在亞臨床乳房內感染期間，下游調節途徑（特別是那些與免疫功能相關的途徑）可能會匯聚成共同的宿主反應。綜上所述，這些發現強調了牛乳房中 lncRNA 介導調節的複雜性，並突顯了進行功能性研究以闡明這些新穎轉錄本生物學角色的必要性。

papers.title: Postbiotics enhance immune competence in black rockfish (Sebastes schlegelii): linking innate immunity, apoptosis, and resistance to bacterial infection
papers.abstract: Background This study investigated the functional potential and safety of postbiotics derived from Latilactobacillus curvatus NBL2305 as a dietary feed additive for juvenile black rockfish ( Sebastes schlegelii ). Fish were fed diets supplemented with NBL2305-derived postbiotics, and their effects on growth performance, immune responses, antioxidant capacity, apoptosis-related gene expression, intestinal microbiota, and disease resistance were evaluated. Results Supplementation with postbiotics significantly improved growth performance and feed utilization, as indicated by increased weight gain and specific growth rate, along with a reduced feed conversion ratio. Innate immune responses were enhanced, as demonstrated by elevated activities of myeloperoxidase, superoxide dismutase, and lysozyme together with the upregulated expression of immune-related genes, including il8 , il1b , tnfa , tnfsf13b , and nfkb1 . In addition, postbiotic treatment modulated apoptosis-related gene expression in the liver, characterized by the downregulation of pro-apoptotic genes ( bax , tp53 , and casp3 ) and the upregulation of anti-apoptotic genes ( bcl2 and xiap ), indicating an anti-apoptotic gene expression profile. The postbiotics also exhibited strong antimicrobial activity against major fish pathogens and considerable antioxidant capacity. These functional effects were further supported by an in vivo challenge test, in which the postbiotic-fed group showed significantly higher survival following Edwardsiella tarda infection. No adverse effects were observed in serum biochemical parameters, somatic indices, or histopathological analyses, supporting the short-term safety of supplementation under the experimental conditions evaluated. Moreover, the intestinal microbiota composition remained stable, with selective enrichment of beneficial taxa. Conclusions Collectively, these findings demonstrate that NBL2305-derived postbiotics are safe and effective functional feed additives that enhance growth, modulated innate immune responses, and disease resistance in aquaculture species.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Science and Biotechnology
papers.abstract_zh: 背景 本研究旨在探討源自彎曲乳桿菌（Latilactobacillus curvatus）NBL2305 的後生元（postbiotics）作為幼黑鯛（Sebastes schlegelii）飼料添加劑的功能潛力與安全性。試驗魚餵食添加了 NBL2305 衍生後生元的飼料，並評估其對生長表現、免疫反應、抗氧化能力、細胞凋亡相關基因表現、腸道菌相及抗病能力的影響。結果 添加後生元顯著改善了生長表現和飼料利用率，表現為增重與特定生長率增加，同時飼料轉換率降低。先天性免疫反應顯現出提升，髓過氧化酶、超氧化物歧化酶及溶菌酶的活性升高，且免疫相關基因（包含 *il8*、*il1b*、*tnfa*、*tnfsf13b* 與 *nfkb1*）的表現量亦上調。此外，後生元處理調節了肝臟中細胞凋亡相關基因的表現，其特徵為促凋亡基因（*bax*、*tp53* 與 *casp3*）表現下調，而抗凋亡基因（*bcl2* 與 *xiap*）表現上調，顯示出抗凋亡的基因表現譜。該後生元對主要魚類病原菌亦展現出強效的抗菌活性與顯著的抗氧化能力。這些功能性效果進一步獲得活體攻毒試驗的證實，在感染遲緩愛德華氏菌（*Edwardsiella tarda*）後，餵食後生元的組別顯示出顯著較高的存活率。在血清生化參數、形質指數或組織病理學分析中皆未觀察到不良影響，支持了在所評估之試驗條件下短期添加的安全性。此外，腸道菌相組成保持穩定，並有益菌群獲得選擇性富集。結論 總體而言，這些發現表明 NBL2305 衍生的後生元是安全且有效的功能性飼料添加劑，能促進水產養殖物種的生長、調節先天性免疫反應並提高抗病能力。

papers.title: Investigating the Relationship Between Hoof, Liver, and Cardiac Abnormalities in Bos taurus Grain-Fed Beef Cattle < 30 Months in a Natural Program with No Antibiotics or Growth Promotants
papers.abstract: Our primary objective was to determine the relationship between hoof, liver, and cardiac abnormalities in a group of natural-fed cattle at slaughter. Bos taurus beef cattle (N = 1312), without dairy phenotype, were evaluated for abnormalities at a slaughter establishment in the Great Plains region of the United States (elevation: 563 m). Cattle were enrolled in a vegetarian-fed program that prohibited implants, diet-included hormones, and beta-adrenergic agonists. Generalized linear mixed models were used to determine the prevalence of each abnormality within other abnormalities. There was no detectable difference (p ≥ 0.1630) to support an association between the proportion of cattle with each hoof score within each heart or liver score. Cattle with no liver abscesses were more prevalent (p = 0.0355) among cattle with normal cardiac morphology (Heart Score (HS)1) (94.37 ± 1.19% (mean ± SE)) than cattle with HS2 (very mild remodeling) (88.6 ± 1.42%). Further research is needed to understand this observed difference between two similar heart scores and to further explore contributing factors to these production diseases.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究的主要目的是探討自然飼養肉牛在屠宰時蹄部、肝臟和心臟異常之間的關聯性。本研究評估了美國大平原地區（海拔：563公尺）一處屠宰場的肉用牛（Bos taurus）（N = 1312，不具乳牛表現型）之異常情況。這些牛隻納入一項禁止使用生長植入劑、飼料添加荷爾蒙及乙型受體促效劑的素食飼養計畫中。本研究採用廣義線性混合模型，以判定各項異常與其他異常之間的盛行率。結果顯示，並無可偵測的差異（p ≥ 0.1630）足以支持心臟或肝臟各評分中牛隻蹄部評分比例之間的關聯性。在心臟形態正常（心臟評分 [HS] 1）的牛隻中，無肝膿瘍的牛隻比例（94.37 ± 1.19% [平均值 ± 標準誤]）顯著高於具備 HS2（極輕微重塑）的牛隻（88.6 ± 1.42%）（p = 0.0355）。未來需要更多研究來釐清這兩個相近心臟評分之間所觀察到的差異，並進一步探討這些生產疾病的成因。

papers.title: Single-Nucleus Transcriptomics Identifies Stage-Associated Differences in the Olfactory Epithelium During Natural Sex Reversal in Monopterus albus
papers.abstract: The rice field eel (Monopterus albus) undergoes natural protogynous sex reversal, but whether peripheral sensory tissues differ across sexual stages remains poorly understood. We used single-nucleus RNA sequencing to characterize the olfactory epithelium (OE) of female, intersex, and male rice field eels. After quality control, 22,959 nuclei were retained and classified into 19 cell populations, including olfactory sensory neurons (OSNs), basal/progenitor, epithelial, mesenchymal, endothelial, and immune populations. OE tissues from five individuals within each sexual stage were pooled prior to nuclei isolation, resulting in one pooled snRNA-Seq library per stage; therefore, between-stage comparisons are interpreted as exploratory and descriptive rather than as independently replicated population-level differences. The relative representation of captured nuclei differed among stages, particularly within the sensory neuronal and basal-cell compartments. Pseudotime analysis placed immature OSNs at relatively early transcriptional states associated with ciliated and microvillous OSN populations, whereas CrOSNs were not continuously connected to the principal iOSN–cOSN/mOSN trajectory. Cell-type-specific analyses identified stage-associated transcriptional differences in basal cells and multiple OSN populations. Predicted cell–cell communication profiles also differed among stages, with male OE showing a larger nominal number of inferred interactions but lower overall predicted interaction strength. Expression patterns of ompa, gng8, and ora4 supported the marker-based annotation of major OSN populations within the dataset. These findings provide an exploratory single-nucleus framework for investigating stage-associated variation in the peripheral olfactory system of M. albus.
papers.abstract_zh: 黃鱔（Monopterus albus）會經歷自然的雌性先熟性轉變，然而周邊感覺組織是否在不同性別階段有所差異，目前仍所知甚少。我們利用單核RNA定序（single-nucleus RNA sequencing）來解析雌性、間性與雄性黃鱔的嗅覺上皮（olfactory epithelium, OE）。經過品管後，保留了 22,959 個細胞核，並被分類為 19 個細胞群，包括嗅覺感覺神經元（OSNs）、基底／祖細胞、上皮細胞、間葉細胞、內皮細胞及免疫細胞群。每個性別階段的五個個體之 OE 組織在分離細胞核前進行混合，使得每個階段僅產生一個混合的 snRNA-Seq 文庫；因此，階段間的比較被解讀為探索性與描述性，而非獨立重複的族群層級差異。所捕獲細胞核的相對比例在各階段之間有所不同，特別是在感覺神經元和基底細胞區室內。偽時間（pseudotime）分析將未成熟的 OSN 置於與纖毛型和微絨毛型 OSN 群體相關的相對早期轉錄狀態，而 CrOSNs 則與主要的 iOSN–cOSN/mOSN 軌跡沒有連續連接。細胞類型專一性分析識別出基底細胞及多個 OSN 群體中與階段相關的轉錄差異。預測的細胞間通訊概況在各階段之間亦有所不同，其中雄性 OE 顯示出較多名義上的推斷交互作用數量，但整體預測的交互作用強度較低。ompa、gng8 與 ora4 的表現模式支持了資料集中主要 OSN 群體的標記基因註解。這些發現為探討 M. albus 周邊嗅覺系統中與性別階段相關的變異，提供了一個探索性的單核框架。

papers.title: Porcine Adenovirus-Based Viral Vectors for Swine Vaccines: A Scoping Review and Future Perspectives
papers.abstract: Porcine adenoviruses (PAdVs) are promising but still underdeveloped viral-vector platforms for swine vaccine development. Compared with human adenovirus-based vectors, PAdV vectors may offer potential advantages in host association, veterinary relevance, and mucosal delivery while avoiding direct reliance on common human adenovirus backbones. This review summarizes current knowledge on PAdV biology, vector engineering, vaccine applications, immune responses, translational challenges, and future priorities. Early studies showed that recombinant PAdV vectors can express heterologous antigens from important swine pathogens, including classical swine fever virus, pseudorabies virus, and transmissible gastroenteritis virus. The strongest direct proof-of-concept evidence comes from recombinant PAdV expressing classical swine fever virus E2/gp55, which induced neutralizing antibodies and protection in pigs. Comparative adenovirus-vectored swine vaccine studies support the broader feasibility of adenoviral antigen delivery for porcine reproductive and respiratory syndrome, porcine epidemic diarrhea, swine influenza, and African swine fever, but these data should not be interpreted as direct validation of PAdV for these diseases. Major gaps remain in anti-PAdV immunity, genetic stability, biosafety, shedding, target-animal safety, DIVA compatibility, manufacturing, and regulatory readiness. Recent advances in PAdV-5 reverse genetics provide new opportunities for modern vector design.
papers.abstract_zh: 豬腺病毒（Porcine adenoviruses, PAdVs）是具潛力但發展尚不成熟的病毒載體平台，可用於開發豬用疫苗。與基於人類腺病毒的載體相比，PAdV載體在宿主相關性、獸醫學相關性及黏膜遞送方面可能具有潛在優勢，同時避免直接依賴常見的人類腺病毒骨架。本綜述總結了目前關於PAdV生物學、載體工程、疫苗應用、免疫反應、轉化挑戰及未來優先事項的知識。早期研究表明，重組PAdV載體能夠表現重要豬隻病原體的異源抗原，包括傳統豬瘟病毒、偽狂犬病病毒和傳染性胃腸炎病毒。最強而有力的直接概念驗證證據來自於表現傳統豬瘟病毒E2/gp55的重組PAdV，該載體能在豬隻體內誘導中和抗體與保護力。比較腺病毒載體豬用疫苗的研究支持了將腺病毒抗原遞送應用於豬繁殖與呼吸綜合症、豬流行性下痢、豬流行性感冒及非洲豬瘟的更廣泛可行性，但這些數據不應被解讀為PAdV針對這些疾病的直接驗證。在抗PAdV免疫力、基因穩定性、生物安全性、排毒、標靶動物安全性、DIVA相容性、製造工藝及法規準備度方面，仍存在重大缺口。PAdV-5反向 genética（反向遺傳學）的最新進展為現代載體設計提供了新契機。

papers.title: Longitudinal Genotype Replacement, Recombination and Neutralizing Epitope Variations in Porcine Epidemic Diarrhea Virus at a Commercial Pig Farm in Guangxi, China
papers.abstract: Porcine epidemic diarrhea virus (PEDV) causes severe enteric disease in piglets. The spike (S) gene is the major target of neutralizing antibodies and a hotspot for genetic variation. In this study, eight PEDV S-gene sequences were obtained from a commercial pig farm in Guangxi, China, between 2021 and 2025. Phylogenetic analysis assigned all sequences to the G2 genotype, with G2c, G2d, and G2b subclusters detected at different time points. Recombination analysis identified sequence-level recombination signatures in the G2c sequences, with G2b-like and G2d-like sequences as parental relatives. Several amino acid substitutions were located within or adjacent to the COE and SS2 neutralizing epitopes, and N-glycosylation site variations were observed among subclusters. Structural predictions suggest that these combined changes may alter surface antigenic properties and confer immune evasion potential, though functional validation using neutralization assays is still required. These findings provide field-derived evidence for PEDV genetic evolution and recombination within a single swine herd, and support rational vaccine-strain evaluation and on-farm biosecurity strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 豬流行性下痢病毒（PEDV）會在仔豬身上引起嚴重的腸道疾病。棘蛋白（S）基因是中和抗體的主要標靶，也是基因變異的熱點。在本研究中，自2021年至2025年期間，從中國廣西的一個商業養豬場獲得了八個PEDV S基因序列。親緣 phylogenetic 分析將所有序列歸類於G2基因型，並在不同時間點檢測到G2c、G2d和G2b次群集。重組分析在G2c序列中識別出序列層級的重組特徵，其中以G2b樣和G2d樣序列作為親緣來源。多個胺基酸置換位於COE和SS2中和抗原表位內或其鄰近區域，且在各次群集中觀察到N-糖基化位點的變異。結構預測表明，這些綜合變化可能會改變表面抗原特性並賦予免疫逃脫的潛力，儘管仍需利用中和試驗進行功能驗證。這些發現為單一豬群內PEDV的基因演化與重組提供了來自現場的證據，並有助於合理的疫苗株評估與場內生物安全策略。

papers.title: New Insights into Avian Aerodynamic Valving: CT-Based CFD Analysis of Bronchial Airflow in the Domestic Chicken
papers.abstract: The avian respiratory system, characterized by its caudocranial unidirectional pulmonary airflow, has long fascinated scientists. To date, the mechanisms underlying the unidirectional airflow and the formation of aerodynamic valving, especially the expiratory valve, remain poorly understood. To provide new insights into pulmonary airflow characteristics and to deepen our understanding of the role of aerodynamic valving in generating unidirectional pulmonary airflow, the respiratory tract of a domestic chicken was reconstructed based on CT-scanned data. CFD simulations were performed under various conditions after validation of the numerical model. Flow parameters were analyzed qualitatively and quantitatively during inspiration and expiration phases, respectively. The results showed that the coupled interaction of the distinctive bronchial topology and air-sac pressure conditions preferentially routed inspired air toward the caudal-sac pathways during inspiration. During expiration, aerodynamic valving was primarily associated with a momentum barrier generated by the cranial-sac airstream, which suppressed retrograde caudal-sac airflow through the primary bronchus and redirected it toward the dorsobronchial outlets leading to the physiological paleopulmonic pathway. Moreover, the ‘segmentum accelerans’ structure facilitated the formation of aerodynamic valving, whereas its removal did not abolish major-bronchial flow rectification, although higher air-sac boundary pressures were required during expiration. Finally, fluid density substantially affected inspiratory aerodynamic valving, whereas its effect on the critical pressures associated with expiratory valving remained below 5%.
papers.abstract_zh: 鳥類呼吸系統具備尾向頭的單向肺部氣流特徵，長期以來一直令科學家著迷。迄今為止，單向氣流背後的機制以及空氣動力學瓣膜（尤其是呼氣瓣膜）的形成，仍所知有限。為了深入了解肺部氣流特性，並加深我們對空氣動力學瓣膜在產生單向肺部氣流中作用的理解，本研究基於斷層掃描（CT）數據重建了家雞的呼吸道。在驗證數值模型後，於各種條件下進行了計算流體力學（CFD）模擬。分別對吸氣和呼氣階段的流動參數進行了定性和定量分析。結果表明，獨特的支氣管拓樸結構與氣囊壓力條件的耦合交互作用，在吸氣過程中優選將吸入的空氣引導至尾囊路徑。在呼氣過程中，空氣動力學瓣膜主要與由頭囊氣流產生的動量障礙有關，該障礙抑制了通過主支氣管的逆行尾囊氣流，並將其重新導向通往生理古肺（paleopulmonic）路徑的背支氣管出口。此外，「加速段」（segmentum accelerans）結構促進了空氣動力學瓣膜的形成，而移除該結構並未消除主支氣管的氣流整流作用，儘管在呼氣過程中需要更高的氣囊邊界壓力。最後，流體密度顯著影響吸氣空氣動力學瓣膜，而其對與呼氣瓣膜相關的臨界壓力的影響則保持在 5% 以下。

papers.title: Estimation of Greenhouse Gas Emission Factor During Hanwoo Manure Composting
papers.abstract: Accurate estimation of climate-altering gases, such as methane and nitrous oxide, from livestock waste treatment is critical for establishing national inventories. This study aims to monitor and analyze the emission characteristics of these gases during the treatment process at an operational Hanwoo (Korean cattle for beef) farm in Republic of Korea to develop country-specific metrics. A full-scale compost shed was modified into a 2400 m3 flux chamber equipped with fans to control airflow at 183 m3·min−1. Real-time gas concentrations were measured using enhanced-performance laser-based analyzers across summer, autumn, and winter. The results indicated that mean emissions for both methane and nitrous oxide were highest in summer, followed by winter, and lowest in autumn. Daily patterns revealed higher hourly mean emissions during the morning and afternoon. The final estimated emission factors were 1.28 kgCH4·head−1·yr−1 and 0.039 kgN2O· head−1·yr−1. These values are relatively lower than those reported in previous studies. These values were lower than those reported in several previous studies. Differences in facility scale and operating conditions may partly explain this result; however, potential underestimation due to non-uniform airflow should also be considered.
papers.abstract_zh: 準確估計畜牧廢棄物處理過程中產生的氣候變遷相關氣體（如甲烷和氧化亞氮）對於建立國家清冊至關重要。本研究旨在監測與分析大韓民國一座營運中的韓牛（肉牛）農場在處理過程中這些氣體的排放特徵，以建立符合國情的係數。研究將一座全尺寸堆肥舍改造為 2400 立方公尺的通量室，並配備風扇以將氣流控制在每分鐘 183 立方公尺。利用高效能雷射分析儀，在夏季、秋季和冬季對即時氣體濃度進行了測量。結果顯示，甲烷和氧化亞氮的平均排放量均以夏季最高、冬季次之、秋季最低。每日變化模式顯示，早晨和下午的每小時平均排放量較高。最終估算的排放係數分別為每頭每年 1.28 公斤甲烷（1.28 kgCH4·head−1·yr−1）以及每頭每年 0.039 公斤氧化亞氮（0.039 kgN2O·head−1·yr−1）。這些數值相對低於先前研究所報告的結果。設施規模和營運條件的差異或許能部分解釋此結果；然而，非均勻氣流可能導致的低估亦應納入考量。

papers.title: Effects of Thymol Supplementation in Health Care Sand on Growth Performance, Serum Biochemical Parameters, Fecal Microbial Diversity, and Fecal Metabolites in Squabs
papers.abstract: This study aimed to investigate the effects of thymol supplementation in health care sand on growth performance, serum biochemical parameters, fecal microbial diversity, and fecal metabolites in Grey King squabs. A total of 160 healthy 28-day-old Grey King squabs were selected and randomly assigned to four treatment groups: the CON, 2%Thy, 3%Thy, and 4%Thy groups. Each group consisted of 10 replicates with four squabs per replicate, resulting in a total of 40 squabs per group. Under identical feeding management conditions and dietary nutrient levels, squabs in the CON group received the basal diet plus 5 g of health care sand; those in the 2%Thy group received the basal diet plus 5 g of health care sand containing 2% thymol; those in the 3%Thy group received the basal diet plus 5 g of health care sand containing 3% thymol; and those in the 4%Thy group received the basal diet plus 5 g of health care sand containing 4% thymol. The experiment lasted for 30 days. During the experimental period, the pigeons were housed in cages measuring 45 cm × 50 cm × 60 cm. Each pigeon was provided with 40 g of diet and 5 g of health care sand daily and had free access to water. After Benjamini–Hochberg false discovery rate correction, no significant differences were observed in growth performance, body measurements, apparent nutrient retention, or energy metabolizability among treatments (q > 0.05). However, thymol-supplemented groups exhibited significantly increased serum total antioxidant capacity and superoxide dismutase, glutathione peroxidase, and catalase activities, together with decreased malondialdehyde levels (q < 0.05). Fecal microbiome and metabolomic analyses were restricted to the CON and 3%Thy groups, with the 3%Thy group selected after evaluation of the phenotypic and physiological responses rather than being prespecified before the experiment. These omics comparisons were therefore considered exploratory. No statistically significant difference in overall fecal microbial community composition was detected between the two groups, whereas 17 candidate differential fecal metabolite features were observed. These features were mainly putatively annotated as lipids and lipid-like molecules, organic acids and derivatives, organoheterocyclic compounds, and benzenoids. Among the supplementation levels evaluated, the 3%Thy group showed comparatively favorable numerical responses in several measured parameters and may be considered a candidate level for further investigation. However, the present findings do not establish an optimal thymol supplementation level, and the biological significance of the exploratory fecal omics results requires further validation.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討在保健砂中添加百里香酚（thymol）對灰王鴿幼鴿生長性能、血清生化指標、糞便微生物多樣性及糞便代謝物的影響。試驗選取 160 隻 28 日齡健康灰王鴿幼鴿，隨機分為 4 個處理組：CON 組、2%Thy 組、3%Thy 組和 4%Thy 組。每組設 10 個重複，每個重複 4 隻幼鴿，每組共 40 隻幼鴿。在相同的飼養管理條件與日糧營養水平下，CON 組飼喂基礎日糧加 5 克保健砂；2%Thy 組飼喂基礎日糧加含 2% 百里香酚的 5 克保健砂；3%Thy 組飼喂基礎日糧加含 3% 百里香酚的 5 克保健砂；4%Thy 組飼喂基礎日糧加含 4% 百里香酚的 5 克保健砂。試驗期為 30 天。試驗期間，鴿子飼養於 45 cm × 50 cm × 60 cm 的籠舍中。每隻鴿子每日提供 40 克日糧及 5 克保健砂，自由飲水。經 Benjamini–Hochberg 偽發現率校正後，各處理組間的生長性能、體型指標、表觀養分留存率或能量代謝率均無顯著差異（$q > 0.05$）。然而，添加百里香酚組別的血清總抗氧化能力、超氧化物歧化酶、穀胱甘肽過氧化物酶及過氧化氫酶活性均顯著增加，同時丙二醛含量顯著降低（$q < 0.05$）。糞便微生物組與代謝體學分析僅限於 CON 組與 3%Thy 組，其中 3%Thy 組是在評估表型與生理反應後選出，而非在試驗前預先指定。因此，這些體學比較被視為探索性分析。兩組間的整體糞便微生物群落組成未檢測到統計學上的顯著差異，但觀察到 17 個潛在的差異糞便代謝物特徵。這些特徵主要被推測註解為脂質與類脂分子、有機酸及其衍生物、有機雜環化合物以及苯類化合物。在所評估的添加水平中，3%Thy 組在數項測量指標上表現出相對較佳的數值反應，可被視為進一步研究的候選添加水平。然而，本研究結果並未確立最佳百里香酚添加水平，探索性糞便體學結果的生物學意義仍需進一步驗證。

papers.title: Effects of different laying management strategies on subsequent fear responses in aviary laying hens
papers.abstract: 1. This study investigated subsequent effects of different floor laying management strategies on the fear response of laying hens housed in two different aviary styles (Big Dutchman® NaturaStep and Natura60).2. Tonic immobility (TI) responses in hens were measured as reactions to a ground robot moving or a human walking on the litter area, compared with control/standard practices. Management strategies were started at 16 weeks of age (WOA) and ended at 32 WOA.3. Twenty birds from six groups (three treatments × two aviary styles) were chosen at random for TI testing at 36, 44, and 55 WOA. For this purpose, randomly collected hens were gently taken out of their pens and transported to the testing room using a mobile multi-tier cage. Each individual hen was placed gently on its back on a flat surface, and TI was induced by gently pressing on its breast. If TI was induced, the length of time to the first head movement, the latency to return to an upright position, and the number of attempts to induce TI were recorded.4. Aviary style significantly affected the length of time to first head movement (p < 0.05). Hens at 55 WOA remained in TI significantly longer than those of earlier ages (p = 0.004). There were no significant effects of stressors/management strategies or aviary style on time to upright position. The average number of attempts required to induce TI was similar for all birds.5. The results indicated that neither stressors or aviary styles had any significant effects on the traits investigated. Older hens tended to exhibit higher levels of fearfulness compared to younger hens.
papers.abstract_zh:
1. 本研究探討不同地面鋪面管理策略對飼養於兩種不同平飼系統（Big Dutchman® NaturaStep 及 Natura60）中產蛋雞恐懼反應之後續影響。
2. 測量母雞的強直不動（tonic immobility, TI）反應，作為其對地墊區移動地面機器人或步行人類之反應，並與對照／標準做法進行比較。管理策略從 16 週齡（WOA）開始，至 32 週齡結束。
3. 隨機選取六個組別（三個處理 × 兩個平飼系統）中各二十隻雞，分別在 36、44 及 55 週齡進行 TI 測試。為此目的，隨機捕獲母雞並溫和地将其移出欄舍，使用移動式多層籠具運送至測試室。將每隻母雞輕輕仰躺於平坦表面上，並透過輕壓其胸部來引發強直不動。若成功引發 TI，則記錄至首次頭部移動的時間長度、恢復直立姿勢的潛伏期，以及引發 TI 所需的嘗試次數。
4. 平飼系統顯著影響首次頭部移動的時間長度（p < 0.05）。55 週齡母雞處於 TI 的時間顯著長於較年輕的母雞（p = 0.004）。壓力源／管理策略或平飼系統對恢復直立姿勢的時間無顯著影響。所有雞隻引發 TI 所需的平均嘗試次數相近。
5. 結果顯示，壓力源或平飼系統對所調查的性狀皆無顯著影響。與較年輕的母雞相比，較年長的母雞傾向表現出較高的恐懼程度。

papers.title: Association Analysis of ARHGEF37 Gene Polymorphisms with Growth Traits in Pigs
papers.abstract: Growth traits are key economic indicators in pig breeding, and identifying molecular markers associated with body weight, backfat thickness, loin eye depth, body length, chest girth, and chest width is of great importance for improving the efficiency of marker-assisted selection (MAS). In this study, 400 French Large White sows and 40 French Landrace sows were used as experimental populations. Single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) within the ARHGEF37 gene were genotyped using PCR amplification and sequencing. Genotype frequencies, allele frequencies, and genetic diversity parameters were systematically analyzed, and associations between different genotypes, haplotypes, and growth traits were evaluated using one-way analysis of variance (ANOVA).
