Several variants showed nominal associations with growth traits in the French Large White population, although none remained significant after FDR correction; ARHGEF37 is therefore proposed as a candidate gene requiring validation in larger populations. Additionally, haplotype analysis revealed that certain haplotype combinations exhibited synergistic improvements in economically important traits including body weight, backfat thickness, and chest circumference, providing potential genetic targets for marker-assisted selection.
papers.abstract_zh: 生長性狀是養豬育種中的關鍵經濟指標，而識別與體重、背脂厚度、眼肌深度、體長、胸圍和胸寬相關的分子標記，對於提升標記輔助選擇（MAS）的效率具有重要意義。在本研究中，以 400 頭法國大白母豬和 40 頭法國長白母豬作為實驗群體。利用 PCR 擴增與定序技術，對 $ARHGEF37$ 基因內的單核苷酸多型性（SNPs）進行基因分型。系統性地分析了基因型頻率、等位基因頻率及遺傳多樣性參數，並使用單因子變異數分析（ANOVA）評估不同基因型、單倍型與生長性狀之間的關聯性。在法國大白群體中，數個變異位點與生長性狀顯示出名義上的關聯，儘管經過 FDR 校正後皆未達顯著水準；因此，推測 $ARHGEF37$ 是一個需要在更大群體中進行驗證的候選基因。此外，單倍型分析顯示，特定的單倍型組合對體重、背脂厚度和胸圍等具經濟重要性的性狀展現出協同改善效果，為標記輔助選擇提供了潛在的遺傳標靶。

papers.title: Dietary astaxanthin enhances egg yolk redness and carotenoid deposition in laying hens fed β-apo-8′-carotenoic acid ethyl ester and canthaxanthin
papers.abstract: 1. This study evaluated the effects of dietary astaxanthin supplementation on yolk pigmentation, carotenoid deposition and yolk quality in laying hens fed diets containing β-apo-8′-carotenoic acid ethyl ester (apo-ester) and canthaxanthin.2. A total of 168 NovoColor hens (71 weeks of age) were assigned to one of 14 dietary treatments. Treatments included a low-pigment control (CON), canthaxanthin-only (CAN), an apo-ester (AE) plus canthaxanthin treatment, with graded levels of astaxanthin (AX) supplementation (from 5 to 100 mg/kg). Each treatment consisted of six replicates of two individually housed hens. The study lasted for 4 weeks. Egg production performance, yolk colour, carotenoid deposition and yolk index were determined.3. Dietary treatments did not affect laying performance (p > 0.05). Increasing dietary AX supplementation increased yolk concentrations of AE, CAN and AX and improved yolk pigmentation (p < 0.05). Both CAN and AX deposition efficiencies showed both linear and quadratic responses to increasing AX inclusion, whereas AE deposition responded quadratically (p < 0.05), with AE and CAN deposition peaking at 50 mg/kg astaxanthin.4. Yolk pigmentation increased rapidly after dietary introduction and reached a plateau by d 8. Eggs from carotenoid-supplemented hens had higher yolk index values than eggs from CON hens (p < 0.05), while yolk index decreased with storage duration.5. In conclusion, dietary AX enhanced yolk pigmentation and carotenoid deposition without compromising laying performance, supporting its use as a complementary red pigment in layer diets. The higher egg yolk index from hens fed carotenoid-containing diets may contribute to maintaining yolk quality during ambient storage.
papers.abstract_zh:
1. 本研究旨在評估在含有 $\beta$-阿朴-8'-胡蘿蔔素酸乙酯（阿朴酯）與斑蝥黃素的飼糧中，添加蝦紅素對產蛋雞蛋黃著色、類胡蘿蔔素沉積及蛋黃品質之影響。

2. 試驗選用 168 隻 71 週齡之 NovoColor 產蛋雞，隨機分配至 14 種飼糧處理組中。處理組包含低色素對照組（CON）、單獨添加斑蝥黃素組（CAN）、阿朴酯（AE）加斑蝥黃素組，以及不同梯度（5 至 100 mg/kg）之蝦紅素（AX）補充組。每個處理組設有 6 個重複，每個重複包含 2 隻單籠飼養之產蛋雞。試驗期為 4 週。試驗期間測定產蛋性能、蛋黃顏色、類胡蘿蔔素沉積及蛋黃指數。

3. 飼糧處理對產蛋性能無顯著影響（$p > 0.05$）。提高飼糧中蝦紅素的添加量會增加蛋黃中阿朴酯、斑蝥黃素及蝦紅素之濃度，並改善蛋黃著色（$p < 0.05$）。隨著蝦紅素添加量之增加，斑蝥黃素與蝦紅素之沉積效率皆呈線性及二次方反應，而阿朴酯之沉積則呈二次方反應（$p < 0.05$），其中阿朴酯與斑蝥黃素之沉積在蝦紅素添加量為 50 mg/kg 時達到高峰。

4. 飼糧引入色素後，蛋黃著色迅速增加，並於第 8 天達到高原期。攝取補充類胡蘿蔔素飼糧之產蛋雞所產下的蛋，其蛋黃指數高於對照組（$p < 0.05$），而蛋黃指數則隨著儲存時間之延長而下降。

5. 總結而言，飼糧添加蝦紅素可增進蛋黃著色及類胡蘿蔔素沉積，且不影響產蛋性能，支持其作為蛋雞飼糧中補充性紅色色素之應用。餵食含類胡蘿蔔素飼糧之蛋雞所產之較高蛋黃指數，有助於維持室溫儲存期間的蛋黃品質。

papers.title: Effects of Dietary Protease at Different Levels of Probiotics on the Growth Potential, Enzyme Activities, Physiological and Hematoimmune Responses of Striped Catfish (Pangasianodon hypophthalmus (Sauvage, 1878))
papers.abstract: Probiotics and exogenous enzymes play essential roles in the growth and health of aquatic animals. This study explored the interactive effects of probiotics (Prob) and exogenous protease (Prot) on the growth indices, digestive and antioxidant enzyme activities, body composition, hematoimmune parameters and serum biochemical indices of striped catfish (n = 600, ≈10.17 ± 0.03 g). In this context, ten diets were formulated with a crude protein level of 35.23% by incorporating Prob (0.0, 1.0, 2.0, 3.0, and 4.0 g/kg) at each Prot level (0.5 and 1.0 g/kg). After a 14-day acclimatization period, the fish were stocked in ten groups, each in triplicate (20 fish/aquaria (40 × 40 × 70 cm, i.e., width × depth × length)) in a 2 × 5 factorial design and fed for 90 days at 3% of their body weight. The results of the current study revealed significant improvements in growth performance with Prob supplementation at both Prot levels (0.5 and 1.0 g/kg). At 0.5 g/kg Prot, FBW and AWG increased with increasing Prob supplementation, reaching their highest mean values at 4.0 g/kg Prob. However, WG% was highest (498.49%), and FCR was lowest (1.33) at 2.0 g/kg Prob, with no substantial further improvement at higher Prob levels. In contrast, at 1.0 g/kg Prot, the optimal Prob level shifted to 1.0 g/kg, resulting in a WG% of 486.99% and an FCR of 1.37. Similarly, the main effect and interactive effect were significant for digestive and antioxidant enzymes in response to dietary Prot and Prob. However, the levels of malondialdehyde (MDA), white blood cells (WBCs), and liver enzymes significantly decreased, reversing the growth trend. Furthermore, hematoimmunological parameters, including red blood cell (RBC) count, hemoglobin (Hb) concentration, hematocrit (HCT), lysozyme activity, and immunoglobulin M (IgM), showed the highest mean values at 4.0 g/kg Prob with 0.5 g/kg Prot, although the differences among the 2.0, 3.0, and 4.0 g/kg Prob treatments were not statistically significant. At 1.0 g/kg Prot, these parameters generally showed the highest mean values at 1.0–2.0 g/kg Prob. Moreover, the proximate analysis (crude protein, crude fat, moisture and ash) was not significantly (p > 0.05) affected by either supplement. The polynomial broken-line regression analysis based on WG% indicated that the optimum Prob level with 0.5 g/kg protease was 1.46 g/kg, whereas at 1.0 g/kg protease supplementation, the optimal probiotic level was estimated at 1.39 g/kg. In conclusion, dietary supplementation with Prob and Prot enhances the growth and health status of P. hypophthalmus, suggesting a sustainable and economical approach for intensive catfish farming.
papers.abstract_zh: 益生菌與外源酶在水生動物的生長與健康中扮演著關鍵角色。本研究探討了益生菌（Prob）與外源蛋白酶（Prot）對虎頭鯊（striped catfish，n = 600，≈10.17 ± 0.03 g）生長指標、消化酶與抗氧化酶活性、魚體組成、血液免疫參數及血清生化指標的交互作用。在此背景下，設計了粗蛋白質含量為 35.23% 的十種飼料，每種蛋白酶添加水準（0.5 和 1.0 g/kg）分別結合不同水準的益生菌（0.0、1.0、2.0、3.0 和 4.0 g/kg）。經過 14 天的馴養期後，將試驗魚隨機分配至十個組別中，每組設三個重複（每缸 20 尾魚，規格 40 × 40 × 70 cm，即寬 × 深 × 長），採 2 × 5 因子設計進行飼養，投餵量為體重的 3%，試驗期為 90 天。本研究結果顯示，在兩種蛋白酶添加水準（0.5 和 1.0 g/kg）下，補充益生菌皆顯著改善了生長性能。在 0.5 g/kg 蛋白酶組中，隨著益生菌添加量的增加，最終體重（FBW）與平均增重（AWG）隨之增加，並在益生菌為 4.0 g/kg 時達到最高平均值。然而，當益生菌為 2.0 g/kg 時，增重率（WG%）最高（498.49%），而飼料轉換率（FCR）最低（1.33），且在更高的益生菌水準下無進一步的顯著改善。相比之下，在 1.0 g/kg 蛋白酶組中，最佳益生菌添加量偏移至 1.0 g/kg，其 WG% 為 486.99%，FCR 為 1.37。同樣地，針對飼料蛋白酶與益生菌的反應，消化酶和抗氧化酶的主效應與交互作用皆顯著。然而，丙二醛（MDA）、白血球（WBCs）及肝臟酶的含量顯著下降，呈現與生長趨勢相反的情況。此外，血液免疫學參數，包括紅血球（RBC）計數、血紅素（Hb）濃度、血容比（HCT）、溶菌酶活性及免疫球蛋白 M（IgM），在 0.5 g/kg 蛋白酶與 4.0 g/kg 益生菌組合時顯示出最高的平均值，儘管 2.0、3.0 和 4.0 g/kg 益生菌處理組之間的差異並無統計學顯著性。在 1.0 g/kg 蛋白酶下，這些參數通常在益生菌為 1.0–2.0 g/kg 時表現出最高平均值。再者，一般成分分析（粗蛋白質、粗脂肪、水分和灰分）不受這兩種補充劑的顯著影響（p > 0.05）。基於 WG% 的多項式折線迴歸分析表明，在蛋白酶為 0.5 g/kg 時，最佳益生菌添加量為 1.46 g/kg；而在蛋白酶補充量為 1.0 g/kg 時，最佳益生菌水準估計為 1.39 g/kg。總體而言，在飼料中補充益生菌與蛋白酶能促進斑鯊（P. hypophthalmus）的生長並提升健康狀態，這為集約化鮎魚養殖提供了一種具永續性且符合經濟效益的方法。

papers.title: Severe Chronic Tubulointerstitial Nephropathy in a Geriatric Pet Chinchilla (Chinchilla lanigera): A Case Report and Literature Review
papers.abstract: Chronic renal disease is recognized in geriatric companion mammals, but detailed clinicopathological descriptions in chinchillas remain limited. An 11-year-old neutered female pet chinchilla (Chinchilla lanigera) with a six-month history of progressive weight loss and hyporexia developed acute clinical deterioration following approximately 8 h of indoor heat exposure (estimated maximum 29 °C). Anorexia, lethargy, absence of fecal output, and progressive dyspnoea preceded death. Necropsy revealed severe bilateral chronic renal lesions, gastrointestinal gaseous distension, and severe pulmonary congestion. Histopathology documented chronic tubulointerstitial nephropathy with interstitial fibrosis supported by Masson–Goldner trichrome staining and mineral deposits demonstrated by von Kossa staining. Periodic acid–Schiff staining highlighted glomerular and tubular basement membranes. Marked pulmonary vascular congestion was confirmed histologically, whereas pulmonary oedema and established pneumonia were not demonstrated in the examined sections. Together with the progressive terminal dyspnoea, these findings indicated clinically important respiratory abnormalities, although their underlying mechanism and contribution to death remained uncertain. Pure cultures of Klebsiella pneumoniae were recovered from six anatomical sites, with all isolates exhibiting an identical antimicrobial susceptibility profile and a reported multidrug-resistant phenotype. No bacterial-associated inflammatory lesions were identified in the histologically examined tissues, providing no morphological evidence of established disseminated septic disease. Given the uncertain time of death and a possible post-mortem interval of up to approximately 6 h, ante-mortem infection could not be reliably distinguished from perimortem dissemination or post-mortem translocation. Environmental heat exposure may have contributed to acute deterioration in an animal with severe chronic disease, although heat stroke could not be established retrospectively. This case supports a multifactorial interpretation and highlights the potential One Health relevance of antimicrobial resistance in companion animals, without demonstrating transmission.
papers.abstract_zh: 慢性腎臟病已被確認存在於高齡伴侶哺乳動物中，但關於絨鼠（chinchillas）的詳細臨床病理學描述仍相當有限。一隻11歲已絕育的雌性寵物絨鼠（Chinchilla lanigera）有進行性體重減輕及食慾減退達六個月的病史，在大約8小時的室內受熱暴露（估計最高溫度29 °C）後，出現急性臨床惡化。厭食、精神沉鬱、無糞便排出以及進行性呼吸困難發生於死亡之前。解剖顯示嚴重的雙側慢性腎臟病灶、胃腸道氣體膨脹以及嚴重的肺部充血。組織病理學記錄了慢性腎小管間質性腎病合併間質纖維化，此診斷由馬松-戈德納三色染色（Masson–Goldner trichrome staining）所支持，而礦物質沉積則由馮科薩染色（von Kossa staining）證實。高碘酸-希夫氏染色（Periodic acid–Schiff staining）突顯了腎絲球與腎小管基底膜。組織學證實有顯著的肺血管充血，但在檢查的切片中未顯示肺水腫及確診的肺炎。結合進行性的末期呼吸困難，這些發現表明了臨床上重要的呼吸道異常，儘管其潛在機制與對死亡的貢獻仍不確定。從六個解剖部位分離出純培養的肺炎克雷伯氏菌（Klebsiella pneumoniae），所有分離株均表現出相同的抗生素感受性譜及已報告的多重抗藥性表型。在組織學檢查的組織中未發現細菌相關的發炎病灶，這並未提供確診瀰漫性敗血症疾病的形態學證據。鑑於死亡時間不確定且死後間隔可能長達約6小時，生前感染無法可靠地與瀕死期瀰漫或死後移位區分開來。環境受熱暴露可能促成了患有嚴重慢性疾病動物的急性惡化，儘管無法回溯性確診中暑。本病例支援多因素的解釋，並突顯了伴侶動物中抗藥性的潛在「同一健康」（One Health）相關性，但未展現出傳播性。

papers.title: Landscape of m6A Modification in Testicular Tissues of Normal and Cryptorchid Tianhua Mutton Sheep
papers.abstract: Cryptorchidism is a common male reproductive disorder generally characterized by spermatogenic failure. Nevertheless, the molecular mechanisms underlying infertility induced by cryptorchidism in sexually mature rams remain insufficiently characterized. N6-methyladenosine (m6A), the most prevalent internal RNA modification, plays a dynamic role in testicular development and spermatogenesis. In the present study, testicular tissues collected from normal and cryptorchid Tianhua mutton sheep were used to construct a transcriptome-wide m6A methylation atlas of the testis. Histological observation showed significantly reduced numbers of Sertoli and Leydig cells and diminished seminiferous tubule diameters in cryptorchid testes. RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) results demonstrated the dysregulated tissue-level mRNA expression of m6A regulators in cryptorchid testes. Methylated RNA immunoprecipitation sequencing (MeRIP-seq) revealed 2080 differentially methylated m6A peaks, with 1449 hypermethylated and 631 hypomethylated m6A peaks in cryptorchid testes. The majority of these peaks were concentrated in the CDS region, followed by the stop codons and 3′ UTR. The integrative analysis of MeRIP-seq and RNA-seq data revealed that differentially expressed and m6A methylated genes were enriched in the apoptosis, AMPK, FoxO, TNF, and MAPK signaling pathways. Seven candidate genes, including RRM2, GTSE1, ATM, GORAB, INSR, HSPA1L, and MAPK9 were screened. In conclusion, this study identified differences in the mRNA abundance of m6A regulators and regional m6A enrichment between normal and cryptorchid sheep testes. These tissue-level differences may partly reflect changes in cellular composition. The findings provide a basis for further investigation of the potential involvement of m6A regulation in cryptorchidism-associated spermatogenic impairment.
papers.abstract_zh: 隱睾症是一種常見的男性生殖系統疾病，通常以生精功能障礙為特徵。然而，性成熟公羊隱睾症引發不育的分子機制仍未得到充分闡明。N6-甲基腺苷（m6A）是最普遍的內部RNA修飾，在睪丸發育和精子發生中發揮動態作用。在本研究中，利用自正常和隱睾天華肉羊採集的睪丸組織，構建了睪丸的全轉錄組m6A甲基化圖譜。組織學觀察顯示，隱睾睪丸中的塞爾托利氏細胞（Sertoli cells）和萊迪希氏細胞（Leydig cells）數量顯著減少，曲細精管直徑縮小。RNA定序（RNA-seq)結果表明，隱睾睪丸中m6A調控因子的組織層級mRNA表達失調。甲基化RNA免疫沉澱定序（MeRIP-seq）顯示有2080個差異甲基化的m6A峰，其中隱睾睪丸中有1449個高甲基化和631個低甲基化m6A峰。這些峰主要集中在編碼序列（CDS）區域，其次是終止密碼子和3′非轉譯區（3′ UTR）。MeRIP-seq與RNA-seq數據的整合分析顯示，差異表達和m6A甲基化基因顯著富集於細胞凋亡、AMPK、FoxO、TNF和MAPK訊號傳導路徑中。篩選出RRM2、GTSE1、ATM、GORAB、INSR、HSPA1L和MAPK9等7個候選基因。總之，本研究鑑定出正常綿羊與隱睾綿羊睪丸之間m6A調控因子mRNA豐度及區域性m6A富集的差異。這些組織層級的差異可能部分反映了細胞組成份額的變化。這些研究結果為進一步探討m6A調控是否參與隱睾相關生精障礙提供了基礎。

papers.title: Effects of environmental enrichments applied to pasture areas on free-range laying hens: 2. Pasture use, behaviour and welfare
papers.abstract: 1. This study assessed the effects of environmental enrichment on outdoor ranges for birds aged either 25, 36, 48 and 56 weeks on pasture use, behaviour and welfare of free-range laying hens. In total, 900 hens (25 weeks old) were randomly divided into three groups (control, object enrichment and tree enrichment) with three pens each (100 hens/pen). Each group was provided with a closed shelter and pasture range nearby.2. A control (CON) group of birds was maintained without any extra enrichment. Various rectangular, square, cylindrical and triangle shaped boxes, pipes, buckets and structures in yellow, red and orange colour were used for the ‘object’ (OBJ) enrichment treatment, whereas tall and broad-leaved plants and Thuja trees were used for the ‘tree’ (TREE) enrichment treatment.3. The use of total pasture area in hens was not different amongst enrichment treatment groups or bird age. While the proportion of OBJ hens using the inner zone of the pasture was higher (p < 0.01), CON and TREE hen groups were found more in the outer zone of the pasture (p < 0.01).4. Enrichment treatment and age did not affect blood heterophil, lymphocyte and heterophil/lymphocyte (H/L) ratio. Feeding, drinking, walking, foraging, resting/laying, perching, scratching/preening and pecking behaviours were not different between enrichment treatment groups. Hens exhibited more feeding, drinking, walking, foraging and less perching, scratching/preening and pecking behaviours with age (p < 0.01).5. There were no differences in feather condition, comb wounds, foot pad dermatitis, keel bone damage, duration of tonic immobility or induction number amongst the enrichment groups. Older hens were showed significant deterioration in feather condition, increased occurrence of comb wounds, footpad dermatitis, hock burns and keel bone damage (p < 0.01). These findings indicated that environmental enrichment can increase the use of a specific area of the pasture where objects are used for enrichment.
papers.abstract_zh:
1. 本研究評估了環境豐富化對 25、36、48 和 56 週齡放牧蛋雞之戶外放牧場利用率、行為與福利的影響。總計 900 隻 25 週齡蛋雞被隨機分為三組（對照組、物件豐富化組與樹木豐富化組），每組設有 3 個欄舍（每欄 100 隻雞）。每組均配有封閉式遮蔽所及鄰近的放牧草地。

2. 對照組（CON）未提供任何額外的環境豐富化。「物件」豐富化處理（OBJ）使用黃、紅、橙三色且形狀包含長方形、正方形、圓柱形與三角形的箱子、管子、水桶及結構物；「樹木」豐富化處理（TREE）則使用高大闊葉植物與側柏。

3. 蛋雞對整體放牧草地面積的使用率在各豐富化處理組或不同週齡間並無差異。雖然 OBJ 組蛋雞使用草地內側區域的比例較高（p < 0.01），但 CON 組與 TREE 組的蛋雞則較常被發現在草地外側區域活動（p < 0.01）。

4. 環境豐富化處理與週齡對血液嗜異性球、淋巴球及嗜異性球／淋巴球（H/L）比值無顯著影響。進食、飲水、行走、覓食、休息／躺臥、棲息、抓地／理羽及啄食等行為在各豐富化處理組之間沒有差異。隨著週齡增長，蛋雞表現出更多的進食、飲水、行走、覓食行為，以及較少的棲息、抓地／理羽和啄食行為（p < 0.01）。

5. 各豐富化組在羽毛狀況、雞冠傷口、足墊皮膚炎、龍骨損傷、強直不動持續時間或誘導次數方面均無差異。較年長的蛋雞則顯示出顯著的羽毛狀況惡化、雞冠傷口增加、足墊皮膚炎、跗關節灼傷以及龍骨損傷增加（p < 0.01）。這些發現表明，當使用物件進行環境豐富化時，可以增加蛋雞對放牧場特定區域的利用。

papers.title: PedXylo: an integrated platform for autosomal and sex-linked pedigree analysis
papers.abstract: Background Pedigree-based inference remains central to animal breeding and to conservation, evolutionary, and human-isolate research. However, existing pedigree software offers no integrated support for X-linked analysis, limited partial-decomposition functionality, no standardised pedigree-quality framework, and limited scalability to industry-sized pedigrees. Results We developed PedXylo, which extends previously published gene-dropping software for ancestral and partial inbreeding analysis into a comprehensive pedigree-analysis platform with integrated pedigree management, quality assessment, and effective-population-size estimation. PedXylo computes classical (F), Kalinowski’s new (F N ), and ancestral (F aB , F aK , AHC) inbreeding coefficients on both autosomes and the X chromosome and provides ancestor-resolved (partial) decomposition of all five coefficient families in both inheritance modes, a combination not currently available in any other tool. Pedigree quality is summarised through complete (CGE) and discrete (DGE) generation equivalents alongside two new metrics: the asymmetrical pedigree equivalents (cAPE and mAPE) and the pedigree tree imbalance (PTI). cAPE and mAPE were only weakly correlated with CGE in the European bison reference population, indicating that they capture information not represented by depth-based metrics alone. Per-individual rates of inbreeding (ΔF and ΔF X ) and effective population sizes are estimated for both autosomes and the X chromosome. We illustrate these analyses using the Habsburg lineage and a long-term captive European bison pedigree and demonstrate scalability on a 23.2-million-individual Holstein pedigree analysed in approximately 18 h on a single 40-thread workstation. Conclusions PedXylo provides a unified, scalable framework for pedigree-based inference suitable for routine application in animal breeding and applicable to wide use in conservation, evolutionary, and human-isolate research. By integrating sex-linked analysis, partial decomposition of ancestral coefficients, and new pedigree-quality metrics, it enables hypotheses that could not previously be tested with available pedigree software. The software is freely available with documentation and worked examples.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景 基於系譜的推論在動物育種、保育研究、演化生物學及人類等立群體（isolate）研究中依然佔有核心地位。然而現有的系譜軟體無法提供對X染色體連鎖分析的整合支援、部分分解功能有限、缺乏標準化的系譜品質框架，且對產業規模系譜的可擴展性亦屬有限。結果 我們開發了 PedXylo，其將先前發表的基因拋撒（gene-dropping）軟體（用於祖先及部分近親交配分析）擴充為一個全方位的系譜分析平台，並整合了系譜管理、品質評估與有效母群體大小估計等功能。PedXylo 可計算體染色體及 X 染色體上的經典（$F$）、Kalinowski 新（$F_N$），以及祖先（$F_{aB}$、$F_{aK}$、AHC）近親交配係數，並提供這五類係數在兩種遺傳模式下的祖先解析（部分）分解，此種組合為目前其他任何工具所無。系譜品質則透過完整世代當量（CGE）與離散世代當量（DGE），以及兩項新指標（非對稱系譜當量 cAPE 與 mAPE，以及系譜樹不平衡度 PTI）來進行總結。在歐洲野牛參考族群中，cAPE 和 mAPE 與 CGE 僅呈現弱相關，顯示它們捕捉了僅靠深度指標所無法呈現的資訊。本軟體可針對體染色體與 X 染色體估計個別個體的近親交配速率（$\Delta F$ 與 $\Delta F_X$）及有效母群體大小。我們以哈布斯堡王朝世系與一筆長期圈養的歐洲野牛系譜說明這些分析，並展示其對一個包含 2,320 萬個體、在單一 40 執行緒工作站上耗時約 18 小時完成分析的荷斯坦牛系譜之可擴展性。結論 PedXylo 提供了一個統一且具可擴展性的系譜推論框架，適用於動物育種的常規應用，並可廣泛應用於保育、演化及人類等立群體研究。透過整合性聯鎖分析、祖先係數的部分分解以及全新的系譜品質指標，它能實現過去無法利用現有系譜軟體進行檢驗的假說。該軟體為免費提供，並附有說明文件與操作範例。

papers.title: Partial Replacement of Fish Meal with Tuna By-Product Meal, Black Soldier Fly Larvae Meal, Fermented Soybean Meal, and Their Two Combinations in Olive Flounder (Paralichthys olivaceus) Diets: Effects on Growth, Feed Utilization, Biochemical Composition, and Economic Analysis
papers.abstract: Fish meal (FM) remains a primary protein source in aquafeeds; however, its high cost and limited availability necessitate the exploration of alternative protein sources. This study, thus, investigates the effects of replacing 10% FM protein, equivalent to 22.2% of FM, with tuna by-product meal (TBM), black soldier fly (Hermetia illucens) larvae meal (BSF), fermented soybean meal (FSB), and their two combinations in diets on the growth, feed utilization, and biochemical composition of olive flounder (P. olivaceus), as well as on economic efficiency. A total of 450 juveniles averaging 10.3 g were randomly distributed into 18 300 L flow-through tanks (25 juveniles per tank). In the control (Con) diet (45% FM-basal), 10% FM protein was replaced with TBM, BSF, FSB, or a combination of TBM and BSF or TBM and FSB at a 1:1 ratio, referred to as the TBM, BSF, FSB, CTB, and CTF diets, respectively. Each experimental diet was randomly allocated to three replicate groups of fish. The fish were hand-fed to apparent satiation twice daily for 12 weeks. The weight gain, specific growth rate, feed consumption, and feed efficiency of fish fed the TBM diet were comparable to those fed the Con diet, but significantly higher than those fed the BSF, FSB, CTB, and CTF diets. The protein efficiency ratio of fish fed the TBM diet was significantly higher than that of fish fed the FSB diet. The protein retention of fish fed the TBM diet was significantly higher than that of fish fed the FSB and CTF diets. The condition factor of fish fed the Con and TBM diets was significantly higher than that of fish fed all other diets. In contrast, dietary treatment had no significant influence on the viscerosomatic index, hepatosomatic index, blood chemistry, proximate composition, and amino acid profiles of the fish. The economic conversion ratio was the lowest in the TBM diet, while the Con and TBM diets led to a significantly higher economic profit index than all other diets. Among the five tested formulations, thus, TBM was the best-performing substitute for FM when 10% FM protein was replaced in a 45% FM-basal diet of olive flounder.
papers.abstract_zh: 魚粉仍是水產飼料中的主要蛋白質來源；然而，其高昂的成本與有限的供應量促使人們必須探索替代蛋白質來源。因此，本研究探討在飼料中以鮪魚副產物粉（TBM）、黑水虻（Hermetia illucens）幼蟲粉（BSF）、發酵大豆粕（FSB）及其兩種組合替代 10% 的魚粉蛋白質（相當於 22.2% 的魚粉），對牙鮃（Paralichthys olivaceus）的生長、飼料利用、生化組成以及經濟效益的影響。總計 450 尾平均體重 10.3 克的幼魚被隨機分配至 18 個 300 公升的流水式水槽中（每槽 25 尾幼魚）。在對照組（Con）飼料（含 45% 魚粉之基礎飼料）中，10% 的魚粉蛋白質分別被 TBM、BSF、FSB，或以 1:1 比例混合的 TBM 與 BSF、TBM 與 FSB 取代，分別稱為 TBM、BSF、FSB、CTB 和 CTF 飼料。每種實驗飼料隨機分配給三個重複的魚群。魚隻每天以手工餵食至明顯飽食兩次，持續 12 週。餵食 TBM 飼料的魚隻，其增重、特定生長率、飼料消耗量和飼料效率與對照組相當，但顯著高於餵食 BSF、FSB、CTB 和 CTF 飼料的魚隻。餵食 TBM 飼料的魚隻，其蛋白質效率比顯著高於餵食 FSB 飼料的魚隻。餵食 TBM 飼料的魚隻，其蛋白質保留率顯著高於餵食 FSB 和 CTF 飼料的魚隻。對照組與 TBM 組魚隻的肥滿度顯著高於所有其他飼料組。相反地，飼料處理對魚隻的內臟體相指數、肝體相指數、血液生化值、一般成分及胺基酸組成沒有顯著影響。TBM 飼料的經濟轉換率最低，而對照組和 TBM 飼料則帶來顯著高於所有其他飼料的經濟利潤指數。因此，在 45% 魚粉基礎飼料的牙鮃飼料中，當替代 10% 的魚粉蛋白質時，TBM 是五種測試配方中表現最好的魚粉替代品。

papers.title: Naturally Occurring PB2 Paired Substitutions Confer Host-Dependent Polymerase Phenotypes in H7N9 Avian Influenza Viruses with Differential ANP32 Support
papers.abstract: H7N9 avian influenza viruses have caused repeated human infections since 2013, but the effects of naturally occurring PB2 substitution combinations on polymerase activity remain poorly understood. We analyzed 899 avian-derived and 1087 human-derived H7N9 PB2 sequences collected between 2013 and 2025. Six PB2 positions (109, 122, 191, 340, 559, and 640) showed distinct frequency changes across epidemic waves and host origins. Pairwise analysis identified five representative combinations with different temporal patterns. In minigenome assays, four paired substitutions reduced polymerase activity in human 293T cells at both 33 °C and 37 °C, whereas none of the five significantly altered activity in chicken DF1 cells at 37 °C or 41 °C. Several paired substitutions showed polymerase activity profiles different from those of the corresponding single substitutions in the tested cellular assays. ANP32 overexpression experiments showed different polymerase activity responses across the tested cellular conditions. Under chicken ANP32A expression, none of the paired-substitution polymerases differed significantly from the wild type, whereas human ANP32A and ANP32B overexpression did not enhance their activity in DF1 cells. Co-immunoprecipitation confirmed detectable interactions between PB2 variants and human or chicken ANP32 proteins. Structural modeling further revealed differences in predicted PB2–ANP32A interfaces among the tested variants. Together, these results show that the tested PB2 substitution combinations produced different polymerase activity profiles in human 293T and chicken DF1 cells and exhibited different responses to ANP32 overexpression under the examined conditions. The findings provide insight into the functional consequences of PB2 evolution during H7N9 circulation.
papers.abstract_zh: 自2013年起，H7N9禽流感病毒已造成反覆的人類感染，然而自然發生的PB2胺基酸置換組合對聚合酶活性的影響仍所知有限。本研究分析了2013至2025年間收集的899個禽源及1087個人源H7N9 PB2序列。結果顯示，六個PB2位點（109、122、191、340、559和640）在不同的流行波與宿主來源間展現出明顯的頻率變化。成對分析識別出五種具有不同時間模式的代表性組合。在微型基因體（minigenome）檢定中，四種成對置換在33 °C和37 °C下均降低了人類293T細胞中的聚合酶活性，而在37 °C或41 °C下，這五種置換均未顯著改變雞DF1細胞中的聚合酶活性。在受測的細胞檢定中，數種成對置換表現出與對應單一置換不同的聚合酶活性圖譜。ANP32過表現實驗顯示，在受測的細胞條件下，聚合酶活性對ANP32的反應有所不同。在雞ANP32A表現下，所有成對置換的聚合酶均與野生型無顯著差異，而人類ANP32A和ANP32B的過表現並未增強其在DF1細胞中的活性。免疫共沉澱（Co-IP）證實了PB2變異株與人類或雞ANP32蛋白質之間存在可檢測的交互作用。結構建模進一步揭示了受測變異株在預測的PB2–ANP32A介面上的差異。綜上所述，這些結果顯示受測的PB2置換組合在人類293T和雞DF1細胞中產生了不同的聚合酶活性圖譜，並在所檢驗的條件下對ANP32過表現展現出不同的反應。這些發現為深入理解H7N9流行期間PB2演化的功能性後果提供了重要見解。

papers.title: HOXA5 Targets ABCD1 and IRF7 to Regulate the Proliferation and Differentiation of Goat Intramuscular Preadipocytes
papers.abstract: Intramuscular fat (IMF) is crucial for goat meat quality, being influenced by preadipocyte proliferation and differentiation. Although the developmental transcription factor HOXA5 is associated with adipose tissue development and lipid deposition in mice, its role in goat adipogenesis remains unclear. This study investigated HOXA5’s role in regulating IMF lipid deposition in goats. Regarding differentiation, HOXA5 overexpression reduced mRNA and protein levels of differentiation genes, including CEBP/α and CEBP/β. Additionally, Oil Red O and Bodipy staining demonstrated a decrease in lipid accumulation in the HOXA5 overexpression group. Conversely, these phenotypes showed opposite trends in the HOXA5 knockdown group. Regarding proliferation, HOXA5 overexpression upregulated mRNA levels of proliferation genes, enhanced cell vitality, and increased the proportion of EdU-positive cells, while HOXA5 knockdown inhibited these phenotypes. Mechanistically, IRF7 and ABCD1 were identified as the target genes of HOXA5 by RNA-Seq and dual luciferase reporter gene assay. Functional analyses further showed that IRF7 promoted both proliferation and adipogenic differentiation, whereas ABCD1 inhibited both processes. Rescue experiments supported the involvement of IRF7 and ABCD1 in HOXA5-induced promotion of proliferation and inhibition of adipogenic differentiation. These results highlight HOXA5’s critical regulatory role in goat intramuscular adipocyte lipid deposition, offering novel insights into the underlying molecular mechanisms.
papers.abstract_zh: 肌內脂肪（IMF）對羊肉品質至關重要，受前脂肪細胞的增殖與分化所調控。儘管發育轉錄因子HOXA5與小鼠的脂肪組織發育及脂質沉積相關，但其在山羊脂肪生成中的作用仍不清楚。本研究探討了HOXA5在調節山羊IMF脂質沉積中的作用。在分化方面，HOXA5過度表現降低了分化基因（包括CEBP/α和CEBP/β）的mRNA和蛋白質表現量。此外，油紅O和Bodipy染色顯示HOXA5過度表現組的脂質累積減少。相反地，這些表型在HOXA5基因靜默組中呈現相反的趨勢。在增殖方面，HOXA5過度表現上調了增殖基因的mRNA表現量、增強了細胞活力，並增加了EdU陽性細胞的比例，而HOXA5基因靜默則抑制了這些表型。在機制上，透過RNA-Seq和雙螢光素酶報導基因實驗，鑑定出IRF7和ABCD1為HOXA5的標的基因。功能分析進一步顯示，IRF7促進增殖與成脂分化，而ABCD1則抑制這兩個過程。回補實驗證實了IRF7和ABCD1參與了HOXA5所誘導的增殖促進與成脂分化抑制作用。這些結果突顯了HOXA5在山羊肌內脂肪細胞脂質沉積中的關鍵調節作用，為其潛在的分子機制提供了新的見解。

papers.title: Whole-Genome Characterization and Pathogenicity of Two Novel Recombinant NADC30-like Porcine Reproductive and Respiratory Syndrome Virus Strains in Southern China
papers.abstract: Porcine Reproductive and Respiratory Syndrome Virus (PRRSV) continues to pose a substantial threat to the global swine industry, with recombination-driven evolution generating novel variants that complicate disease control. In this study, two novel recombinant PRRSV-2 strains, designated GXNN202004a and GXGG20210301, were isolated from PRRS-affected pig farms in southern China. Whole-genome sequencing and phylogenetic analysis revealed that both strains possess an NADC30-like backbone, with GXNN202004a arising from recombination between NADC30 and JXA1 and GXGG20210301 representing a multi-lineage recombinant derived from NADC30, JXA1, and QYYZ. Genomic characterization identified a characteristic discontinuous 131-amino-acid deletion (111+1+19 aa) in the NSP2 coding region, along with a previously unreported six-amino-acid deletion in GXGG20210301. Animal pathogenicity assays demonstrated that both strains induced moderate clinical signs, including persistent fever, respiratory symptoms, and growth impairment, without causing mortality in piglets. Viral loads were detectable in multiple tissues, serum, and nasal swabs, indicating broad organ tropism and shedding potential. These findings enrich the molecular epidemiological data on PRRSV in China, highlight the increasing genetic diversity and recombination complexity of circulating strains, and provide scientific evidence for improved PRRS surveillance and vaccine development strategies in southern China.
papers.abstract_zh: 豬繁殖與呼吸綜合症病毒（PRRSV）持續對全球養豬業構成重大威脅，由重組驅動的演化產生了新的變異株，使疾病防控更加複雜。在本研究中，從中國南方受 PRRS 影響的養豬場分離出兩個新型重組 PRRSV-2 株，分別命名為 GXNN202004a 和 GXGG20210301。全基因組定序與系統發生分析顯示，兩個毒株均具有 NADC30-like 基因骨架，其中 GXNN202004a 源自 NADC30 與 JXA1 的重組，而 GXGG20210301 則代表源自 NADC30、JXA1 與 QYYZ 的多譜系重組株。基因組特徵分析在 NSP2 編碼區鑑定出一個具代表性的不連續 131 個胺基酸缺失（111+1+19 aa），以及 GXGG20210301 中先前未曾報導的 6 個胺基酸缺失。動物致病性試驗表明，兩毒株皆會引起中等程度的臨床症狀，包括持續發燒、呼吸道症狀和生長受阻，但未導致仔豬死亡。多個組織、血清和鼻拭子中均可檢測到病毒量，顯示其具有廣泛的器官嗜性與排毒潛力。這些發現豐富了中國 PRRSV 的分子流行病學數據，凸顯了流行毒株日益增加的遺傳多樣性與重組複雜性，並為改善中國南方的 PRRS 監測與疫苗開發策略提供了科學依據。

papers.title: Magnolol enhances yak oocyte maturation and blastocyst quality by improving lipid metabolism and redox homeostasis through a PPARγ-dependent mechanism
papers.abstract: Background Reproductive efficiency in yaks is limited by the poor developmental competence of their oocytes during in vitro maturation (IVM). Magnolol (MAG), a natural polyphenolic compound with potent antioxidant activity, has been reported to regulate cellular metabolism and oxidative stress; however, its role in oocyte maturation and early embryonic development remains unclear. Therefore, this study investigated the effects and molecular mechanisms of MAG on yak oocyte maturation and developmental competence. Methods Yak cumulus–oocyte complexes were cultured in IVM medium supplemented with different concentrations of MAG (0, 0.5, 1, 5, and 10 μmol/L). Oocyte maturation, cumulus expansion, oxidative stress indicators, mitochondrial function, apoptosis, and lipid metabolism were evaluated using fluorescence staining, qPCR, and immunofluorescence analysis. Network pharmacology and molecular docking were used to predict potential targets of MAG, and the peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPARγ) antagonist GW9662 was applied to verify the regulatory mechanism occurring during IVM and subsequent embryo development. Results Based on the concentration-screening results, 1 μmol/L MAG was selected for subsequent mechanistic and embryo-development analyses. MAG supplementation significantly improved oocyte maturation and cumulus expansion, enhanced glutathione levels and mitochondrial membrane potential, and reduced reactive oxygen species accumulation and apoptosis. MAG also promoted lipid droplet accumulation and upregulated the expression of lipid metabolism–related genes, including PPARG , CD36 , FABP3 , and FABP4 . Network pharmacology identified PPARγ as a key target of MAG. Pharmacological inhibition of PPARγ with GW9662 markedly reversed MAG-induced improvements in lipid metabolism, antioxidant capacity, and oocyte developmental competence. Furthermore, MAG increased blastocyst formation rate, total cell number, and CDX2 expression while reducing the blastocyst apoptosis. Conclusion MAG improves yak oocyte quality and embryonic developmental competence by promoting lipid homeostasis, maintaining redox balance, and enhancing mitochondrial function. The beneficial effects of MAG are closely associated with the involvement of PPARγ signaling in the regulation of lipid homeostasis. These findings provide a potential strategy for improving the efficiency of yak assisted reproductive technologies.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Science and Biotechnology
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：氂牛的繁殖效率受限於其卵母細胞在體外成熟（IVM）期間較差的發育能力。厚朴酚（Magnolol, MAG）是一種具有強效抗氧化活性的天然多酚類化合物，據報導能調節細胞代謝與氧化壓力；然而，其在卵母細胞成熟與早期胚胎發育中的作用仍不清楚。因此，本研究探討了 MAG 對氂牛卵母細胞成熟與發育能力的作用及其分子機制。方法：將氂牛卵丘—卵母細胞複合體培養於添加不同濃度 MAG（0、0.5、1、5 及 10 μmol/L）的 IVM 培養基中。利用螢光染色、qPCR 及免疫螢光分析，評估卵母細胞成熟度、卵丘擴張、氧化壓力指標、粒線體功能、細胞凋亡與脂質代謝。運用網路藥理學與分子對接預測 MAG 的潛在標靶，並應用過氧化體增殖物活化受體γ（PPARγ）拮抗劑 GW9662，以驗證在 IVM 及後續胚胎發育期間發生的調節機制。結果：根據濃度篩選結果，選擇 1 μmol/L MAG 用於後續的機制與胚胎發育分析。添加 MAG 顯著改善了卵母細胞成熟與卵丘擴張、提高了穀胱甘肽含量與粒線體膜電位，並減少了活性氧自由基的累積與細胞凋亡。MAG 同時促進了脂滴的累積，並上調了脂質代謝相關基因（包括 PPARG、CD36、FABP3 及 FABP4）的表現。網路藥理學鑑定出 PPARγ 為 MAG 的關鍵標靶。以 GW9662 進行 PPARγ 的藥理學抑制，顯著逆轉了 MAG 所誘導的脂質代謝、抗氧化能力及卵母細胞發育能力的提升。此外，MAG 提高了囊胚率、總細胞數及 CDX2 表現量，同時降低了囊胚細胞凋亡。結論：MAG 透過促進脂質恆定、維持氧化還原平衡以及增強粒線體功能，改善了氂牛卵母細胞的品質與胚胎發育能力。MAG 的有益作用與 PPARγ 信號傳導參與脂質恆定的調節密切相關。這些發現為提高氂牛輔助生殖技術的效率提供了潛在策略。

papers.title: Cellular mechanism of gain-of-function mutation I173M in sheep MC4R gene identified in year-round and seasonal estrus breeds through whole-genome resequencing
papers.abstract: Background Investigating key genes regulating year-round estrus can improve sheep reproductive performance and industry efficiency. Although several candidate genes have been proposed, the key regulators underlying estrus seasonality remain unclear. Therefore, this study aimed to identify critical genetic variants associated with year-round estrus using whole-genome resequencing data from multiple sheep breeds. Results In this study, we analyzed whole-genome resequencing data from 392 sheep across six year-round and ten seasonal estrus breeds, and identified the Melanocortin 4 receptor ( MC4R ) gene as a key regulator of estrus seasonality. A missense mutation in the MC4R gene, I173M (g.59480440G > C; p.Ile173Met), was significantly enriched in year-round estrus breeds. Transcriptome analysis following MC4R I173M transfection revealed differential expression of genes enriched in reproductive pathways. Subsequent functional experiments demonstrated that the I173M mutation increased MC4R constitutive activity, activated cAMP and MAPK/ERK signaling, and promoted both granulosa cell proliferation and the expression of steroidogenic regulatory genes. Cells harboring the I173M mutation exhibited substantially amplified transcription levels of gonadotropin signaling components. Specifically, follicle-stimulating hormone receptor ( FSHR ) and luteinizing hormone receptor ( LHR ) were expressed at much higher levels relative to wild-type (WT) controls. Conclusions Our study provides evidence that MC4R functions as a molecular modulator of estrous cyclicity, with the I173M missense mutation identified as a critical functional variant driving constitutive estrous activity in ovine species.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：探討調節全年發情之關鍵基因有助於提升綿羊繁殖性能與產業效率。儘管先前已提出多個候選基因，但發情季節性背後的關鍵調控機制仍不清楚。因此，本研究旨在利用多個綿羊品種的全基因組重定序數據，鑑定與全年發情相關的關鍵基因變異。結果：本研究分析了來自 6 個全年發情品種與 10 個季節性發情品種共 392 隻綿羊的全基因組重定序數據，並鑑定出黑皮質素受體 4（MC4R）基因為發情季節性的關鍵調控因子。MC4R 基因中的一個錯義突變 I173M（g.59480440G > C；p.Ile173Met）在全年發情品種中顯著富集。MC4R I173M 轉染後的轉錄體分析顯示，參與生殖通路的基因表現出差異表現。隨後的功能實驗證明，I173M 突變提高了 MC4R 的組成型活性（constitutive activity）、活化了 cAMP 及 MAPK/ERK 信號傳遞路徑，並促進了顆粒細胞的增殖以及類固醇生成調節基因的表現。攜帶 I173M 突變的細胞表現出顯著增加的促性腺激素信號成分轉錄水平。具體而言，相較於野生型（WT）對照組，促濾泡素受體（FSHR）和促黃體素受體（LHR）的表現量顯著升高。結論：本研究提供了證據證明 MC4R 作為動情週期之分子調節因子發揮作用，其中 I173M 錯義突變被認定為驅動綿羊物種持續性發情活性的關鍵功能性變異。

papers.title: Use of Encapsulated and Raw Organic Acids for Inhibition of Salmonella in a Refrigerated Raw Meat-Based Diet (RMBD) Matrix for Dogs
papers.abstract: The rising demand for using raw meat diets (RMBDs) for feeding companion animals requires improvement in their food safety. Organic acids could be a promising anti-microbial ingredient for mitigating pathogen contamination. This study investigated the effects of encapsulated (E) and raw (R) acids (citric—CE and CR; lactic—LE and LR) on Salmonella survival in RMBDs during refrigerated storage. The acidulants (1.0% LE, 1.0% CE, 0.5% LE + 0.5% CE, 0.5% CE + 0.5% LR, 0.5% LE + 0.5% CR, and 0.5% LR + 0.5% CR) were incorporated in RMBD patties inoculated with Salmonella (ATCC 8326, ATCC 14802, and ATCC 13076) at 6 and 9 log CFU/patty levels. Inoculated (PC) and non-inoculated (NC) patties made without acidulants were used as controls. Patties were stored at 4 °C and Salmonella enumeration was done at days 0, 1, 4, 7, 10, 13, 16, 19, and 22. Salmonella reduction was higher (p < 0.05) in stored patties with both encapsulated and raw acids (3.10–4.10 logs) added relative to using individual encapsulated acids (2.40–3.70 logs) and control (0.70–0.90 logs). Higher inoculation levels resulted in greater (p < 0.05) Salmonella reductions in the patties after storage. The reductions were influenced (p < 0.05) by the treatment × time interaction with longer storage time resulting in higher reductions. The Salmonella inactivation under all acid treatments followed the Weibull model (R2—0.86 to 0.98; RMSE—0.19 to 0.34; β—1.23 to 2.08). The results show that encapsulated organic acids can inhibit Salmonella growth and survival in RMBDs under refrigerated conditions. The results from this study could be used as basis for improving the food safety of RMBDs.
papers.abstract_zh: 餵食伴侶動物生肉飲食（RMBDs）的需求不斷上升，這有必要提升其食品安全。有機酸可能是一種有潛力的抗菌成分，可用於降低病原菌污染。本研究探討了微膠囊化（E）與原生（R）有機酸（檸檬酸——CE 和 CR；乳酸——LE 和 LR）對冷藏期間 RMBDs 中沙門氏菌存活的影響。酸化劑（1.0% LE、1.0% CE、0.5% LE + 0.5% CE、0.5% CE + 0.5% LR、0.5% LE + 0.5% CR 以及 0.5% LR + 0.5% CR）被添加至接種了沙門氏菌（ATCC 8326、ATCC 14802 和 ATCC 13076，接種量為 6 和 9 log CFU/塊）的 RMBD 肉餅中。未添加酸化劑的接種肉餅（PC）與未接種肉餅（NC）作為對照組。肉餅儲存於 4 °C，並於第 0、1、4、7、10、13、16、19 和 22 天進行沙門氏菌計數。相較於單獨使用微膠囊化酸（2.40–3.70 logs）和對照組（0.70–0.90 logs），添加微膠囊化酸與原生酸結合的儲存肉餅其沙門氏菌削減量更高（p < 0.05，達 3.10–4.10 logs）。較高的接種量導致肉餅在儲存後有更大的沙門氏菌削減量（p < 0.05）。削減量受到處理方式與時間交互作用的影響（p < 0.05），較長的儲存時間會導致更高的削減量。所有酸處理下的沙門氏菌去活性皆符合韋伯模型（Weibull model，R² = 0.86 至 0.98；RMSE = 0.19 至 0.34；β = 1.23 至 2.08）。研究結果顯示，微膠囊化有機酸能有效抑制冷藏條件下 RMBDs 中沙門氏菌的生長與存活。本研究的結果可作為改善 RMBDs 食品安全的基礎。

papers.title: Association of VCS2000-Measured Carcass Traits with Anatomical Site-Specific Fat Deposition and Appearance Acceptability of Pork Belly
papers.abstract: The primary objective of this study was to evaluate the utility of automated carcass parameters (VCS2000) in reflecting site-specific fat distribution along the thoracic (TV) and lumbar vertebrae (LV) of pork bellies. Additionally, this study aimed to determine how VCS2000-derived carcass weight and fat proportion influence localized fat accumulation and the resulting visual acceptability of these distinct anatomical sites. Total fat content, evaluated via the VCS2000 system, showed a positive loading on principal component 1 along with carcass weight, backfat thickness at various sites, and fat percentages at anatomical belly sites, demonstrating a close association with specific belly traits. Considering the carcass weight, belly weight, and belly fat accumulation at anatomical belly sites, carcasses with a higher weight but a lower fat percentage exhibited more favorable belly traits among all evaluated carcasses (p < 0.05). Anatomical location significantly influenced visual acceptability, with panelists preferring leaner sections (the 13th and 14th TV) over those with heavy fat accumulation (the 10th and 11th TV; p < 0.05). These results suggest that visual acceptability may be primarily driven by the localized distribution and structural balance of fat and lean meat, rather than the absolute fat proportion of pork belly.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究的主要目的在於評估自動化屠體性狀測量系統（VCS2000）反映豬腹肉沿著胸椎（TV）與腰椎（LV）特定部位脂肪分布之效用。此外，本研究旨在探討源自VCS2000之屠體重量與脂肪比例如何影響局部脂肪蓄積，以及這些不同解剖部位隨之產生的外觀接受度。透過VCS2000系統評估之總脂肪含量，與主成分1呈現正向負荷，同時伴隨屠體重量、各部位背脂厚度以及腹肉解剖部位之脂肪百分比，顯示其與特定腹肉性狀具有密切關聯。綜合考量屠體重量、腹肉重量以及腹肉解剖部位之脂肪蓄積，在所有評估的屠體中，具有較高重量但較低脂肪百分比的屠體表現出較佳的腹肉性狀（p < 0.05）。解剖位置對外觀接受度有顯著影響，評審員偏好較瘦的切段（第13與14節胸椎），勝過脂肪蓄積較多的切段（第10與11節胸椎；p < 0.05）。這些結果顯示，外觀接受度可能主要取決於脂肪與瘦肉的局部分布及結構平衡，而非豬腹肉的絕對脂肪比例。

papers.title: Genome‐Wide Association Studies for Anogenital Distance and Linear Type Traits in Gir Cattle
papers.abstract: Although linear type traits have been under selection in the Dairy Gir cattle for the past three decades, there are few studies exploring genetic architecture for these traits. The aim of this study was to identify candidate genes for anogenital distance and linear type traits in the Gir breed. For this study, the body measures of rump length (cm, RL), ilium width (cm, ILW), hip height (cm, HH), body length (cm, BL), thoracic perimeter (cm, TP) and rump area (cm 2 , RA) along with anogenital distance (cm, AGD) were collected from 604 Gir dairy cows, around 5.69 years old. The pedigree file included 2206 animals, of which 742 were genotyped with different SNP panels and imputed to Illumina BovineHD BeadChip (777 K). Genome‐wide association studies were carried out using the blupf90+ program for all traits and for a phenotypic index created to assist selecting candidate genes. The top 5 windows for the traits and top 10 windows for the index explaining the highest percentage of additive genetic variance were selected for gene search. Biological processes and transcription factors were searched from the genes found. In total, 90 genes were identified for all seven traits, of which 17 were pleiotropic, that is, they were common results for pairs or trios of traits. From that, the candidate genes (chromosome) identified from the phenotypic index were CXCL13 (6), CNOT6L (6), MRPL1 (6), CCSER1 (6), CDH26 (13), DOCK8 (8), ZNG1 (8) and PGM5 (8). For those eight genes, 11 transcription factors and 59 biological processes were identified. In conclusion, BTA6 seems to have a deeper role in linear type traits in the Gir breed. Even though there are few studies confirming the action of those genes on body conformation, all eight candidate genes are recommended for future studies to validate their action on muscle and skeletal development or fat deposition due to their biological process functions, which could be pleiotropically affecting linear traits in cattle.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Breeding and Genetics
papers.abstract_zh: 儘管乳用吉爾牛（Dairy Gir）在過去三十年間一直進行線性外貌特徵的選育，但探索這些特徵遺傳架構的研究卻十分稀少。本研究旨在識別吉爾牛品種中肛門生殖器距離與線性外貌特徵的候選基因。在本研究中，共收集了 604 頭平均年齡約 5.69 歲的乳用吉爾牛之體型測量數據，包括臀長（公分，RL）、髂骨寬（公分，ILW）、髖高（公分，HH）、體長（公分，BL）、胸圍（公分，TP）及臀部面積（平方公分，RA），以及肛門生殖器距離（公分，AGD）。譜系檔案包含 2206 個體，其中 742 個體使用不同的 SNP 晶片進行基因分型，並聚集（impute）至 Illumina BovineHD BeadChip（777K）。使用 blupf90+ 程式對所有特徵以及為協助選擇候選基因而建立的表型指數進行全基因體關聯性研究（GWAS）。選取解釋最高百分比加性遺傳變異的前 5 個特徵基因體視窗及前 10 個指數基因體視窗進行基因搜尋。並自所發現的基因中搜尋其生物學過程與轉錄因子。總計為所有七個特徵識別出 90 個基因，其中 17 個具多效性（pleiotropic），亦即它們是成對或成三特徵組合的共同結果。其中，由表型指數識別出的候選基因（染色體）為 CXCL13 (6)、CNOT6L (6)、MRPL1 (6)、CCSER1 (6)、CDH26 (13)、DOCK8 (8)、ZNG1 (8) 及 PGM5 (8)。針對這八個基因，識別出 11 個轉錄因子與 59 個生物學過程。總結來說，BTA6 似乎在吉爾牛的線性外貌特徵中扮演更深層的角色。儘管目前少有研究證實這些基因對體型構造的作用，但基於其生物學過程功能，這八個候選基因皆被推薦用於未來研究，以驗證其對肌肉、骨骼發育或脂肪沉積的作用，這些作用可能會多效性地影響牛隻的線性特徵。

papers.title: Sleep and Drowsiness in Cattle: A Narrative Review of Physiology, Measurement, and Methodological Challenges
papers.abstract: Sleep in cattle is a complex physiological state comprising non-rapid eye movement (NREM) and rapid eye movement (REM) sleep, while drowsing represents an intermediate vigilance state between wakefulness and sleep. Research has progressed from invasive electrophysiological recordings to noninvasive polysomnography (PSG), behavioral assessment, accelerometry, and automated classification approaches. However, accurately identifying and quantifying vigilance states under production conditions remains challenging. This narrative review, based on 22 primary studies identified through searches of Web of Science, Scopus and Google Scholar, critically synthesizes current knowledge of sleep physiology in cattle, the approaches used to assess it, and the principal methodological limitations affecting interpretation of the available evidence. Cattle exhibit a polyphasic sleep pattern, with NREM generally accounting for the largest proportion of total sleep. However, reported sleep and drowsing durations vary considerably among studies, and these differences may reflect both biological variation and methodological factors. Drowsing is particularly difficult to characterize because its behavioral and physiological features overlap with quiet wakefulness and light sleep. Rumination represents an additional challenge because associated muscular activity can interfere with electrophysiological recordings and complicate vigilance-state classification. Behavioral observations and accelerometry provide scalable measures of resting and sleep-like behavior but cannot independently establish physiological sleep, whereas PSG provides greater physiological resolution while remaining susceptible to artifacts and practical constraints. Current evidence is insufficient to establish causal relationships between sleep variation and cattle health, welfare, or productive performance. Future research should improve physiological classification during overlapping behavioral states, better validate scalable monitoring approaches, and evaluate the functional consequences of sleep variation across diverse cattle populations and production conditions.
papers.abstract_zh: 牛隻的睡眠是一個複雜的生理狀態，包含非快速動眼期（NREM）與快速動眼期（REM）睡眠，而打瞌睡則代表清醒與睡眠之間的過渡警覺狀態。相關研究已從侵入式電生理記錄進展至非侵入式多項生理睡眠檢查（PSG）、行為評估、加速度計及自動化分類方法。然而，在生產環境下準確辨識與量化警覺狀態仍然深具挑戰。本篇敘述性文獻回顧透過檢索 Web of Science、Scopus 和 Google Scholar 識別出 22 篇主要研究，批判性地綜合了目前對牛隻睡眠生理學、評估方法，以及影響現有證據判讀之主要方法學限制的理解。牛隻表現出多相性睡眠模式，其中 NREM 通常占總睡眠的最大比例。然而，文獻中報告的睡眠與打瞌睡持續時間在各研究間存在顯著差異，這些差異可能反映了生物學變異與方法學因素。打瞌睡特別難以表徵，因為其行為與生理特徵與安靜清醒及淺眠有所重疊。反芻則是另一項挑戰，因為相關的肌肉活動會干擾電生理記錄並使警覺狀態的分類變得複雜。行為觀察與加速度計提供了休息與類睡眠行為的可擴展測量方法，但無法獨立確立生理上的睡眠；而 PSG 則提供了更高的生理解析度，卻仍易受假影與實務限制的影響。目前的證據尚不足以確立睡眠變異與牛隻健康、福祉或生產表現之間的因果關係。未來的研究應改進重疊行為狀態期間的生理分類，更好地驗證可擴展的監測方法，並評估多樣化牛群與生產條件下睡眠變異的功能性後果。

papers.title: Antimicrobial Resistance Profiles of Staphylococcus spp. Isolated from the Oral Cavity of Captive Wild Mammals at a Zoo in Southern Brazil
papers.abstract: Antimicrobial resistance in Staphylococcus spp. poses a challenge to One Health due to the potential for transmission among humans, animals, and the environment. This study investigated antimicrobial resistance patterns in Staphylococcus spp. isolates from the oral cavities of non-human primates and wild felids kept in captivity at a zoo in southern Brazil. Samples were collected from Sapajus apella and wild felids (Leopardus pardalis, Leopardus guttulus, Herpailurus yagouaroundi, Leopardus wiedii, Panthera tigris, Puma concolor, Panthera onca). Bacterial isolation and identification were performed using phenotypic methods, followed by antimicrobial susceptibility testing and molecular diagnosis for the detection of Staphylococcus aureus and the mecA gene. Of the Staphylococcus spp. isolates, 64.5% originated from non-human primates and 35.5% from wild felids. S. aureus was identified in 12.9% of the isolates, all from non-human primates. Azithromycin, erythromycin, and sulfamethoxazole-trimethoprim showed 90.3% resistance. Additionally, 80.6% of the isolates were multidrug-resistant (MDR), and 90.3% demonstrated a multiple antibiotic resistance (MAR) index, suggesting possible exposure to antimicrobial selective pressure. These findings demonstrate the circulation of multidrug-resistant Staphylococcus spp. in captive animals and reinforce the importance of antimicrobial resistance surveillance from a One Health perspective.
papers.abstract_zh: 葡萄球菌屬（Staphylococcus spp.）的抗生素抗藥性對「健康一體」（One Health）構成了挑戰，因為其具有在人類、動物和環境之間傳播的潛力。本研究旨在調查巴西南部某動物園內收容的非人靈長類動物與野生貓科動物口腔中分離出的葡萄球菌屬之抗生素抗藥性模式。樣本取自黑帽懸猴（Sapajus apella）以及野生貓科動物（豹貓 [Leopardus pardalis]、小斑貓 [Leopardus guttulus]、細腰貓 [Herpailurus yagouaroundi]、長尾貓 [Leopardus wiedii]、老虎 [Panthera tigris]、美洲獅 [Puma concolor]、美洲豹 [Panthera onca]）。細菌分離與鑑定採用表型方法，隨後進行抗生素敏感性試驗，並以分子診斷檢測金黃色葡萄球菌（Staphylococcus aureus）及 mecA 基因。在所有葡萄球菌屬分離株中，64.5% 源自非人靈長類動物，35.5% 源自野生貓科動物。金黃色葡萄球菌佔所有分離株的 12.9%，且全數來自非人靈長類動物。阿奇黴素（azithromycin）、紅黴素（erythromycin）以及磺胺amethoxazole-trimethoprim 表現出 90.3% 的抗藥性。此外，80.6% 的分離株具有多重抗藥性（MDR），90.3% 顯示出多重抗生素抗藥性（MAR）指數，這暗示了這些動物可能曾暴露於抗生素的選擇壓力之下。這些發現證明了多重抗藥性葡萄球菌屬在圈養動物中的流行，並從「健康一體」的視角強化了持續監測抗生素抗藥性的重要性。

papers.title: Management System, Resource Constraints, and Composite Disease Burden in Dromedary Camels in El Oued, Algeria: An Observational Study with Exploratory Dystocia Analyses
papers.abstract: Background: Dromedary camel husbandry in Algeria is shifting toward sedentary confinement, yet the consequences for herd health and reproductive outcomes remain poorly documented. This study examined the associations of housing system, environmental constraints, and disease burden with dystocia in El Oued, Algeria. Methods: A 12-month observational study of 55 farms (45 extensive, 10 semi-intensive) and 70 focal adult females integrated surveys, clinical assessments, and retrospective records. Herd Total Disease Burden (TDB; 0–24 scale) was modeled using negative-binomial regression (n = 55). Exponentiated coefficients were interpreted as ratios of expected TDB scores. Results: Feed, water, and health constraints were strongly correlated (Spearman’s ρ = 0.89–0.96). Semi-intensive management yielded higher expected TDB scores than extensive management (ratio = 1.71, 95% CI: 1.28–2.29, p < 0.001), as did feed (ratio = 1.15, p = 0.015) and water deficits (ratio = 1.10, p = 0.048). Confined herds reported greater forage-species richness and higher female body weights; however, current individual clinical morbidity positively correlated with historical dystocia rates. An exploratory Random Forest ranked herd size and TDB as top farm-level dystocia predictors, though its out-of-bag error (25.5%) exceeded the 16.4% error of the majority-class baseline. Conclusions: Semi-intensive management and resource constraints are associated with higher composite disease-burden scores. Forage-species richness and increased body weight alone should not be interpreted as indicators of better health. The exploratory classifier underscores the need for larger studies to validate predictive reproductive models.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：阿爾ジェ利亞的單峰駱駝飼養正轉向定居式舍飼，然而其對群體健康與繁殖成效的影響仍缺乏充分記錄。本研究探討阿爾及利亞阿爾瓦德（El Oued）地區之飼養系統、環境限制及疾病負擔與難產之間的關聯。方法：這是一項為期 12 個月的觀察性研究，涵蓋 55 個農場（45 個粗放式、10 個半精集約式）以及 70 頭焦點成年母駱駝，整合了問卷調查、臨床評估及回溯性記錄。群體總疾病負擔（Total Disease Burden, TDB；0–24 分量表）使用負二項迴歸進行建模（n = 55）。指數化係數被解釋為預期 TDB 分數的比值。結果：飼料、水資源與健康限制呈高度相關（斯皮爾曼相關係數 Spearman’s ρ = 0.89–0.96）。半精集約化管理的預期 TDB 分數高於粗放式管理（比值 = 1.71，95% 信賴區間：1.28–2.29，p < 0.001），飼料（比值 = 1.15，p = 0.015）與水資源短缺（比值 = 1.10，p = 0.048）亦然。舍飼群體回報了較高的牧草物種豐富度及較高的母駝體重；然而，當前的個別臨床發病率與歷史難產率呈正相關。一項探索性隨機森林模型將群體規模和 TDB 列為農場層級難產的主要預測因子，儘管其袋外誤差（25.5%）超過了多數類別基準的 16.4% 誤差。結論：半精集約化管理與資源限制和較高的綜合疾病負擔分數相關。僅憑牧草物種豐富度和體重增加，不應被解讀為健康狀況較佳的指標。該探索性分類器突顯了進行更大規模研究以驗證預測性繁殖模型的必要性。

papers.title: HDAC2-Specific Inhibitor Santacruzamate A Inhibits Mouse Preantral Folliculogenesis Through Granulosa Cell Apoptosis and Oocyte Meiosis Interference
papers.abstract: Histone deacetylase 2 (HDAC2)-mediated epigenetic modifications play a crucial role in oogenesis, yet the regulatory mechanisms of HDAC2 throughout the entire process of folliculogenesis remain elusive. In the present study, the localization and expression of HDAC2 were detected in mouse ovaries at distinct postnatal ages and after gonadotropin treatment. The effects and molecular mechanisms of Santacruzamate A (SCA), a selective HDAC2 inhibitor, on folliculogenesis were investigated via an in vitro 3D culture model of mouse preantral follicles. The results showed that HDAC2 was localized in the nuclei of both ovarian granulosa cells and oocytes. Its expression was gradually increased with ovarian development in mice aged from postnatal day 7 to 21, and significantly decreased after 12 h hCG treatment. In follicles cultured in vitro, HDAC2 expression peaked on day 4 of culture. SCA exerted stage-specific and dose-dependent regulatory effects on folliculogenesis. SCA significantly suppressed follicular growth, blocked antrum formation, and triggered follicular atresia. Mechanistically, SCA promoted ovarian granulosa cell apoptosis via increases in pro-apoptotic genes BAX and Caspase-3 levels, and a decrease in anti-apoptotic gene BCL-2 level. Furthermore, SCA disrupted the structural integrity of the follicular microfilament cytoskeleton, interfered with the levels of genes related to oocyte–granulosa cell communication including CX37 and GDF9, caused abnormalities in oocyte spindle structure, chromosome alignment, mitochondrial distribution, and decreased mitochondrial membrane potential (ΔΨm). In conclusion, HDAC2 participates in the transcriptional regulation of mouse folliculogenesis through dynamically changing expression at distinct developmental stages. HDAC2 exerts stage-specific regulatory effects on follicular growth and oocyte maturation, and its mechanisms are associated with maintaining granulosa cell survival, ensuring cytoskeletal integrity, and preserving oocyte mitochondrial function. This study advances our understanding of epigenetic regulation of folliculogenesis and provides novel targets and an experimental basis for optimizing in vitro follicular culture systems and regulating female reproductive performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 組織去乙醯酶2（HDAC2）介導的表觀遺傳修飾在卵子發生中扮演關鍵角色，然而HDAC2在整個卵泡發育過程中的調控機制仍未完全明瞭。在本研究中，我們檢測了不同出生後發育階段及性腺激素刺激後的小鼠卵巢中HDAC2的定位與表現。透過小鼠小卵泡體外三維培養模型，探討選擇性HDAC2抑制劑Santacruzamate A（SCA）對卵泡發育的影響及相關分子機制。結果顯示，HDAC2定位於卵巢顆粒細胞及卵母細胞的細胞核中。在出生後第7天至第21天的小鼠中，其表現量隨著卵巢發育而逐漸增加，並在注射hCG 12小時後顯著下降。在體外培養的卵泡中，HDAC2表現量於培養第4天達到峰值。SCA對卵泡發育產生具有階段特異性及劑量依賴性的調控作用。SCA顯著抑制卵泡生長、阻礙竇狀卵泡形成，並引發卵泡閉鎖。在機制上，SCA透過增加促凋亡基因BAX和Caspase-3的表現量、降低抗凋亡基因BCL-2的表現量，促進卵巢顆粒細胞凋亡。此外，SCA破壞了卵泡微絲細胞骨架的結構完整性，干擾了與卵母細胞－顆粒細胞通訊相關的基因（如CX37和GDF9）表現量，導致卵母細胞紡錘體結構、染色體排列及線粒體分佈異常，並降低了線粒體膜電位（ΔΨm）。綜上所述，HDAC2透過在不同發育階段動態變化的表現，參與小鼠卵泡發育的轉錄調控。HDAC2對卵泡生長和卵母細胞成熟發揮階段特異性的調控作用，其機制與維持顆粒細胞存活、確保細胞骨架完整性以及維持卵母細胞線粒體功能密切相關。本研究加深了我們對卵泡發育表觀遺傳調控的理解，並為優化體外卵泡培養系統及調控雌性生殖性能提供了新的標靶與實驗基礎。

papers.title: High Salinity Stress Affects Flavor Free Amino Acid Content and GLUL Gene Expression in Crassostrea hongkongensis
papers.abstract: Crassostrea hongkongensis (C. hongkongensis) is an important aquacultured bivalve species inhabiting estuarine environments, where salinity fluctuations can influence its amino acid composition and associated taste attributes. In this study, the effect of hyper-salinity stress on free amino acid metabolism and glutamate–ammonia ligase (ChGLUL) expression was investigated. Tissue expression analysis showed that ChGLUL was significantly upregulated in hepatopancreas, gill, mantle, gonad, and adductor muscle following hyper-salinity stress, with the most pronounced increase observed in the gonads (7.08-fold). Hyper-salinity markedly elevated the activities of glutamine synthetase (GS) and glutamate decarboxylase (GAD), whereas ChGLUL silencing suppressed stress-induced enzyme activities. Metabolically, hyper-salinity stress increased total free amino acids (TFAAs) and total flavor free amino acids (FFAAs) in the mixed tissues, characterized by markedly increased sweet (glycine and alanine) and bitter amino acids but decreased umami amino acids (glutamic and aspartic acids). Conversely, ChGLUL silencing led to decreased total FFAAs and sweet amino acids but increased umami amino acids. Furthermore, ChGLUL knockdown significantly reduced the expression of key genes in flavor amino acid metabolism, including GAD1, PHGDH, and PAH. Collectively, these findings demonstrate that hyper-salinity stress affects both the flavor free amino acid content and ChGLUL expression in C. hongkongensis.
papers.abstract_zh: 香港牡蠣（*Crassostrea hongkongensis*）是一種重要的養殖雙殼類物種，棲息於河口環境中，其間的鹽度波動會影響其胺基酸組成及相關的呈味特徵。本研究探討了高鹽度逆境對游離胺基酸代謝及麩胺酸－氨連接酶（*ChGLUL*）表現的影響。組織表現分析顯示，在高鹽度逆境後，*ChGLUL*在肝胰腺、鰓、外套膜、性腺和閉殼肌中均顯著上調，其中以性腺的增幅最為顯著（達 7.08 倍）。高鹽度顯著提高了麩胺酸合成酶（GS）和麩胺酸脫羧酶（GAD）的活性，而 *ChGLUL* 的靜默則抑制了逆境誘導的酶活性。在代謝方面，高鹽度逆境增加了混合組織中的總游離胺基酸（TFAAs）和總呈味游離胺基酸（FFAAs），其特徵為甜味胺基酸（甘胺酸和丙胺酸）及苦味胺基酸顯著增加，但鮮味胺基酸（麩胺酸和天門冬胺酸）減少。相反地，*ChGLUL* 的靜默導致總 FFAAs 和甜味胺基酸減少，但鮮味胺基酸增加。此外，*ChGLUL* 的基因敲低顯著降低了呈味胺基酸代謝中關鍵基因的表現，包括 *GAD1*、*PHGDH* 和 *PAH*。綜上所述，這些結果表明高鹽度逆境會影響香港牡蠣的呈味游離胺基酸含量及 *ChGLUL* 的表現。

papers.title: Can Leukocyte Morphology Contribute to Welfare Assessment in Beef Cattle Raised Under Intensive and Extensive Farming Systems?
papers.abstract: To investigate the potential contribution of leukocyte morphology to animal welfare assessment, this study evaluated leukocyte profiles in beef cattle raised under intensive and extensive production systems. A total of 664 blood samples were collected at the end of the production cycle from commercial farms in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil. Welfare assessments included qualitative behavioral assessment, health indicators, hematocrit, total and differential leukocyte counts, neutrophil-to-lymphocyte (N/L) ratio, and leukocyte morphology using an image-supported scoring system. In pooled descriptive data, severe neutrophil morphological alterations were observed in 27.1% of cattle from intensive systems and 11.4% from extensive systems, while atypical lymphocytes were observed in 21.8% and 9.6%, respectively. Exploratory season-specific generalized estimating equation (GEE) analyses indicated higher neutrophil counts and N/L ratios in cattle from intensive systems in both autumn and spring. In autumn, lymphocyte counts were lower in cattle from the intensive system, and severe neutrophil morphological alterations and atypical lymphocytes had higher estimated probabilities. In spring, no clear evidence of differences between systems was observed for lymphocyte counts or leukocyte morphology. Qualitative behavioral assessment revealed variation among farms, including farms within the same production system. Health alterations, including nasal discharge, coughing, and swelling, were recorded exclusively in the evaluated intensive systems. These findings indicate differences in leukocyte morphology among cattle from the evaluated farms and suggest that leukocyte morphological assessment may provide a useful complementary animal-based indicator within multidimensional welfare assessment frameworks.
papers.abstract_zh: 為探討白血球形態對動物福利評估潛在的貢獻，本研究評估了在密集式與粗放式生產系統下飼養之肉牛的白血球相。本研究自巴西南馬托格羅索州（Mato Grosso do Sul）的商業農場，在生產週期結束時共採集了 664 個血液樣本。福利評估包含質化行為評估、健康指標、紅血球容積比（hematocrit）、總白血球及白血球分類計數、嗜中性球與淋巴球比值（N/L ratio），以及利用影像支援評分系統進行的白血球形態評估。在合併的描述性數據中，密集式系統牛隻有 27.1%、粗放式系統有 11.4% 觀察到嚴重的嗜中性球形態改變；非典型淋巴球則分別佔 21.8% 與 9.6%。探索性季節特定廣義估計方程式（GEE）分析顯示，在秋季與春季，密集式系統牛隻的嗜中性球計數與 N/L 比值均較高。在秋季，密集式系統牛隻的淋巴球計數較低，且嚴重嗜中性球形態改變與非典型淋巴球具有較高的估計機率。在春季，淋巴球計數或白血球形態在不同系統間未觀察到明顯差異。質化行為評估顯示農場間存在差異，包含同一生產系統內的農場。健康狀況改變（包含鼻分泌物、咳嗽與腫脹）僅在所評估的密集式系統中記錄到。這些發現指出受評估農場之牛隻的白血球形態存在差異，並表明白血球形態評估可作為多維度動物福利評估框架中一項有用的互補性動物基礎指標。

papers.title: Skeletal Muscle Gene Expression in Nellore Cattle Fed Guanidinoacetic Acid During the Growing and Finishing Phases
papers.abstract: This study evaluated the effects of different levels of guanidinoacetic acid (GAA) supplementation on the transcript abundance of genes related to myogenesis, protein turnover, and energy metabolism in Nellore (Bos indicus) cattle during the growing and finishing phases. Fifty-one bulls were supplemented with 0, 3, 6, or 9 g GAA·kg−1 of supplement dry matter (DM) during the growing phase and 0, 0.3, 0.6, or 0.9 g GAA·kg−1 of dietary DM during the finishing phase. Longissimus thoracis samples were collected at the end of each phase for RT-qPCR analyses. During the growing phase, GAA supplementation increased the transcript abundance of genes associated with myogenic regulation (PAX7, MYF5, and MYOG) and anabolic signaling (MTOR and EIF4E), resulting in a transcriptional profile consistent with the modulation of genes involved in myogenic regulation and protein turnover, with responses differing among doses. During the finishing phase, continued GAA supplementation decreased the transcript abundance of MYF5, MYOG, EIF4E, FBXO32, and SLC2A4, whereas MTOR and GSK3B showed positive quadratic responses to increasing GAA doses. However, these molecular responses were not accompanied by improvements in growth performance, carcass characteristics, or most meat quality variables. Differences in gene expression observed at the end of the growing and finishing phases should be interpreted in the context of diet, management, feeding system, and duration of GAA exposure.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究評估了在生長期與肥育期中，補充不同劑量之胍基乙酸（GAA）對尼洛代牛（Bos indicus）肌肉生成、蛋白質代謝週轉及能量代謝相關基因轉錄豐度的影響。試驗選用51頭公牛，在生長期分別補充 0、3、6 或 9 g GAA·kg−1 補充料乾物質（DM），在肥育期則分別補充 0、0.3、0.6 或 0.9 g GAA·kg−1 日糧乾物質（DM）。於各階段結束時採集背最長肌（Longissimus thoracis）樣本進行即時定量反轉錄聚合酶連鎖反應（RT-qPCR）分析。在生長期，GAA 補充提高了與肌生成調節（PAX7、MYF5 及 MYOG）和合成代謝訊號傳遞（MTOR 及 EIF4E）相關基因的轉錄豐度，呈現出與肌生成調節及蛋白質代謝週轉相關基因調控一致的轉錄表現譜，且不同劑量之反應有所差異。在肥育期，持續補充 GAA 降低了 MYF5、MYOG、EIF4E、FBXO32 及 SLC2A4 的基因轉錄豐度，而 MTOR 與 GSK3B 則對遞增的 GAA 劑量表現出正向二次方反應。然而，這些分子層面的反應並未伴隨生長性能、屠體性狀或大多數肉質變數的改善。在生長期與肥育期結束時觀察到的基因表現差異，應在日糧、管理、飼養系統以及 GAA 暴露持續時間的脈絡下進行解讀。

papers.title: Possible Effects of Manual Stripping on Stress Response and Reproductive Status in Captive Female Salmo carpio
papers.abstract: Captive breeding programs are essential for conserving the endangered salmonid Salmo carpio. However, standard hatchery operations rely on manual stripping, whose effects on Carpione reproductive physiology and welfare remain poorly understood. This preliminary study investigated the physiological and reproductive responses of captive female S. carpio to manual stripping. Forty-five mature females were assigned to three groups: pre-stripping (PRE), 1 day post-stripping (POST1), and 21 days post-stripping (POST21). Plasma concentrations of 17β-estradiol, testosterone, progesterone, cortisol, glucose, and antioxidant enzyme activities (SOD, CAT, GPx) were assessed alongside ovarian histology. While no effects were detected on circulating steroid or glucose levels, POST21 females showed significantly higher cortisol and increased SOD and CAT activities than PRE and POST1 fish (p < 0.05), while both POST1 and POST21 showed higher GPx activity compared to PRE, indicating a delayed modulation of stress response and oxidative challenge after the stripping event. Ovarian histology revealed no evident histopathological alterations. PRE group ovaries were characterized by the presence of primary growth and tertiary vitellogenic oocytes. Primary growth oocytes were identified in all the experimental groups. Secondary vitellogenic oocytes, together with post-ovulatory follicles and atretic oocytes, were observed at POST1. At POST21, histological examination revealed primary growth and early vitellogenic oocytes, while mature oocytes were also identified macroscopically, supporting the persistence of ovarian reproductive activity during the reproductive season. Overall, females maintained ovarian activity throughout the examined period, while delayed systemic stress during post-spawning recovery was observed in the POST21 group. Broodstock management should therefore include adequate recovery periods and reduce handling to support welfare and reproductive performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 圈養繁殖計畫對於保育瀕危鮭科魚類 *Salmo carpio* 至關重要。然而，標準的人工孵化場作業依賴人工擠卵，其對該魚種之生殖生理與福利的影響尚所知有限。本先期研究探討了圈養雌性 *S. carpio* 對人工擠卵的生理與生殖反應。將四十五尾成熟雌魚分為三組：擠卵前（PRE）、擠卵後 1 天（POST1）以及擠卵後 21 天（POST21）。評估血漿中 17β-雌二醇、睪固酮、黃體素、皮質醇、葡萄糖的濃度，以及抗氧化酶活性（超氧化物歧化酶 SOD、過氧化氫酶 CAT、穀胱甘肽過氧化物酶 GPx），並同時進行卵巢組織學分析。儘管對循環類固醇或葡萄糖濃度未檢測到影響，但與 PRE 和 POST1 魚隻相比，POST21 雌魚顯現出顯著較高的皮質醇以及增加的 SOD 與 CAT 活性（p < 0.05）；而與 PRE 相比，POST1 與 POST21 均顯示出較高的 GPx 活性，這表明在擠卵事件後，壓力反應與氧化挑戰具有延遲調控的特性。卵巢組織學未顯示出明顯的組織病理學改變。PRE 組卵巢的特徵為存在初級生長卵母細胞和三級卵黃生成期卵母細胞。在所有實驗組中皆識別出初級生長卵母細胞。在 POST1 觀察到次級卵黃生成期卵母細胞，伴隨排卵後濾泡與閉鎖卵母細胞。在 POST21，組織學檢查顯示有初級生長和早期卵黃生成期卵母細胞，同時肉眼亦可辨識出成熟卵母細胞，支持了在生殖季節期間卵巢生殖活動的持續性。總體而言，雌魚在所檢測的期間內維持了卵巢活動，而在 POST21 組中觀察到產卵後恢復期間的延遲性全身性壓力。因此，種魚管理應包含足夠的恢復期並減少操作，以維護其動物福利與生殖表現。

papers.title: Functional Effects of IGF2BP2 Genetic Variants on Growth Traits in Sheep
papers.abstract: Growth traits are economically important in sheep, but the regulatory variants contributing to body‐weight variation remain incompletely characterized. A selective‐sweep analysis identified a candidate region on chromosome 1 containing IGF2BP2 . Sequence comparison indicated that IGF2BP2 is highly conserved across mammals. Genotyping of Hu sheep, Hulunbuir sheep, and Tan sheep identified Chr1 g.202274996G>A was significantly associated with sheep body weight at 6 months of age. Epigenomic data indicated that the region containing this variant has features of an active cis‐regulatory element, and dual‐luciferase assays showed that the A allele reduced enhancer activity relative to the G allele. In isogenic sheep fetal fibroblast clones generated by cytosine base editing, the AA genotype was associated with lower IGF2BP2 and CCAR1 expression than the GG genotype. MeRIP‐qPCR further indicated genotype‐dependent differences in m 6 A‐enriched CCAR1 RNA. Together, these findings support Chr1 g.202274996G>A as a candidate regulatory variant affecting IGF2BP2 expression and body weight in Hu sheep, and provide a potential molecular marker for the genetic improvement of growth traits in sheep.
papers.abstract_zh: 生長性狀對綿羊具有經濟重要性，但促成體重變異的調控變異仍尚未完全解析。選擇清除分析（selective-sweep analysis）識別出第一染色體上包含 $IGF2BP2$ 的候選區域。序列比對顯示，$IGF2BP2$ 在哺乳動物中高度保守。對湖羊、呼倫貝爾羊和灘羊的基因型鑑定發現，Chr1 g.202274996G>A 與綿羊 6 月齡體重顯著相關。表觀基因體數據顯示，包含此變異的區域具有活性順式調控元件（cis-regulatory element）的特徵，雙螢光素酶實驗表明，相較於 G 等位基因，A 等位基因降低了增強子活性。在使用胞嘧啶鹼基編輯（cytosine base editing）生成的同基因綿羊胎兒成纖維細胞株中，AA 基因型與較低的 $IGF2BP2$ 及 $CCAR1$ 表達量相關（相較於 GG 基因型）。甲基化 RNA 免疫沉澱定量 PCR（MeRIP-qPCR）進一步顯示，富含 $\text{m}^6\text{A}$ 的 $CCAR1$ RNA 表現出基因型依賴性的差異。綜上所述，這些發現支持 Chr1 g.202274996G>A 作為影響湖羊 $IGF2BP2$ 表達及體重的候選調控變異，並為綿羊生長性狀的遺傳改良提供了潛在的分子標誌。

papers.title: RNA Modification Profiles and m6A Regulatory Patterns in the Lungs of Sheep at Different Altitudes
papers.abstract: The lung is a key organ for oxygen uptake and gas exchange and plays an important role in adaptation to hypoxic environments at high altitudes. RNA modifications represent an important layer of epitranscriptomic regulation and participate in cellular processes by affecting RNA stability, splicing, translation, and degradation. In this study, the right lung parenchyma from low-altitude Hu sheep (LL), mid-altitude Tibetan sheep (ML), and high-altitude Tibetan sheep (HL) were used to investigate altitude-associated RNA modification profiles and m6A regulatory patterns. A UPLC-MS/MS platform was employed to quantitatively detect 55 RNA modifications, while RT-qPCR and Western blot analyses were performed to evaluate the expression of HIF1α, HIF2α, and m6A-related regulatory factors. The results showed distinct differences in lung RNA modification profiles among the three groups. Compared with the LL and ML groups, the HL group exhibited reduced m6A and m6Am levels, whereas several non- m6A modifications, including t6A, m1G, m2G, m7G, m3C, and m5C, showed increasing trends. The expression levels of HIF1α and HIF2α were higher in the ML and HL groups than in the LL group. In addition, METTL3, METTL14, WTAP, and several YTH family reader proteins were downregulated in the HL group at both the protein and mRNA levels. These findings indicate that sheep lung RNA modification profiles and the m6A regulatory machinery differ among groups with different altitude-related adaptation backgrounds. Collectively, these findings reveal epitranscriptomic differences associated with altitude and breed in sheep lungs and provide a basis for further investigation of the role of m6A regulation in high-altitude adaptation.
papers.abstract_zh: 肺臟是用於攝取氧氣與進行氣體交換的關鍵器官，並在適應高海拔低氧環境中扮演重要角色。RNA修飾代表了表觀轉錄體調控的重要層面，透過影響RNA的穩定性、剪接、轉譯與降解來參與細胞過程。本研究以低海拔湖羊（LL）、中海拔藏羊（ML）及高海拔藏羊（HL）的右肺實質為材料，探討與海拔高度相關的RNA修飾圖譜與m6A調控模式。採用UPLC-MS/MS平台定量檢測55種RNA修飾，並進行RT-qPCR與西方墨點法分析以評估HIF1α、HIF2α及m6A相關調控因子的表現量。結果顯示，三組間的肺部RNA修飾圖譜存在明顯差異。與LL組和ML組相比，HL組的m6A與m6Am水平均下降，而多種非m6A修飾（包含t6A、m1G、m2G、m7G、m3C及m5C）則呈現上升趨勢。ML組和HL組的HIF1α與HIF2α表現量高於LL組。此外，HL組的METTL3、METTL14、WTAP以及多種YTH家族讀取蛋白在蛋白質與mRNA水平均表現下調。這些結果表明，不同海拔適應背景的綿羊其肺部RNA修飾圖譜與m6A調控機制有所不同。綜上所述，這些發現揭示了綿羊肺部與海拔及品種相關的表觀轉錄體差異，並為進一步探討m6A調控在高海拔適應中的作用提供了基礎。

papers.title: Influence of Donor Cells on the Efficiency of Cloned Ỉ Pig Production
papers.abstract: In this study, we investigated the effects of donor cell on the efficiency of producing cloned Ỉ pigs, an endangered Vietnamese breed. Cloned Ỉ pig embryos were generated using somatic cell nuclear transfer technology (SCNT). The results demonstrated that pregnancy, farrowing, and piglet production rates of Ỉ pig fibroblasts (ID:6004) at the 5th and 6th passages were significantly higher compared with those observed at the 4th and 7th passages. Under the conditions of this study, no significant effect of donor cell sex or cell lines on the efficiency of cloned Ỉ pig embryo transfer was observed. The pregnancy, farrowing, and piglet production rates did not differ significantly between donor cell groups of male and female origin (p > 0.05). Similarly, no significant differences were observed in pregnancy rates, farrowing outcomes, or one-week survival of live cloned piglets among the three donor cell lines (IDs: 6004, 9154, and 9157) (p > 0.05). These findings contribute to improving the efficiency of the somatic cell nuclear transfer (SCNT) technique in efforts to conserve the critically endangered Vietnamese Ỉ pig.
papers.abstract_zh: 在這項研究中，我們探討了供體細胞對複製瀕危越南Ỉ豬效率的影響。複製Ỉ豬胚胎是利用體細胞核移植（SCNT）技術生產的。結果顯示，第5代與第6代Ỉ豬纖維母細胞（編號：6004）的妊娠率、分娩率和小豬產出率，顯著高於第4代與第7代。在本研究條件下，未觀察到供體細胞性別或細胞株對複製Ỉ豬胚胎移植效率有顯著影響。來自雄性與雌性來源的供體細胞組別在妊娠率、分娩率和小豬產出率上無顯著差異（p > 0.05）。同樣地，三個供體細胞株（編號：6004、9154和9157）在妊娠率、分娩結果或複製活小豬的一週存活率方面，亦未觀察到顯著差異（p > 0.05）。這些發現有助於提升體細胞核移植（SCNT）技術的效率，以用於保育極度瀕危的越南Ỉ豬。

papers.title: Abortion Storms in Dromedary Camels: Causes, Pathogenesis, Risks, Diagnosis, and Control
papers.abstract: Abortion storms are a significant reproductive and economic challenge for dromedary camels, especially in the Arabian Peninsula and North Africa. They are characterized by an abrupt increase in pregnancy losses within a short period of time. The camel’s seasonal breeding pattern, which restricts opportunities for rebreeding within the same reproductive season, amplifies their impact. Abortion storms are multifactorial phenomena that arise from intricate relationships between infectious agents, host susceptibility, environmental factors, and management techniques. Bacterial pathogens like Brucella spp., Chlamydia abortus, and Coxiella burnetii, as well as protozoal infections like Trypanosoma evansi and Toxoplasma gondii are thought to be the main infectious causes. However, viral, fungal, nutritional, environmental, and management-related factors may also play a role. This narrative review addresses the biological mechanisms underlying herd-level outbreaks and summarizes the current understanding of the etiology, pathogenesis, and risk factors related to abortion storms in dromedary camels. Relevant literature was identified through structured searches of PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science, supplemented by Google Scholar and reference-list screening, covering published evidence on abortion and abortion storms in dromedary camels. It offers helpful advice for field research, clinical assessment, sample collection, laboratory diagnosis, outbreak response, and long-term prevention in addition to addressing current diagnostic issues. In order to lessen the frequency and effects of abortion storms in camel populations, standardized diagnostic procedures, enhanced surveillance systems, and integrated herd health strategies are highlighted as key knowledge gaps and future research priorities.
papers.abstract_zh: 單峰駱駝的流產風暴（abortion storms）是其繁殖與經濟上面臨的一大挑戰，尤其在阿拉伯半島和北非地區。其特徵為在短時間內妊娠損失急劇增加。駱駝具有季節性繁殖特性，限制了在同一繁殖季內重新配種的機會，因而放大了流產風暴的影響。流產風暴是多重因素造成的現象，源於傳染原、宿主易感性、環境因素與飼養管理技術之間的複雜關係。布魯氏菌（Brucella spp.）、流產衣原體（Chlamydia abortus）和Ｑ熱柯克斯體（Coxiella burnetii）等細菌病原體，以及伊氏錐蟲（Trypanosoma evansi）和弓蟲（Toxoplasma gondii）等原蟲感染，被認為是主要的感染性病因。然而，病毒、真菌、營養、環境及管理相關因素亦可能扮演一定角色。本篇敘述性文獻回顧探討了群體層級爆發背後的生物學機制，並總結了目前對單峰駱駝流產風暴之病因學、致病機轉與風險因子的理解。透過對 PubMed、Scopus 和 Web of Science 進行結構化檢索，並輔以 Google Scholar 與文獻清單篩選，識別出涵蓋單峰駱駝流產及流產風暴已發表證據的相關文獻。除了探討當前的診斷問題外，本文亦為實地研究、臨床評估、樣品採集、實驗室診斷、疫情應對及長期預防提供了實用的建議。為了降低駱駝族群中流產風暴的發生率與影響，本文強調標準化診斷程序、強化監測系統以及整合性牛（駱駝）群健康策略為關鍵的知識缺口與未來研究重點。

papers.title: Computer Vision-Based Characterization of Temporal Feeding Dynamic in Group-Housed Dairy Goats
papers.abstract: Feeding behavior is closely related to nutrient intake, health, and production performance, yet its temporal dynamics are difficult to quantify in group-housed dairy goats. We developed a computer vision-based framework to characterize feeding dynamics under commercial farm conditions. Video data were collected from 550 Guanzhong dairy goats housed in five pens over three consecutive days. YOLO11, RF-DETR, and RT-DETR were compared for feeding-area goat detection, and temporal feeding features were analyzed to characterize high feeding activity (HFA) and low feeding activity (LFA). In a subsequent recording phase, head-down feeding behavior was assessed in 150 goats originating from the classified source pens. A total of 24 of these goats (12 HFA and 12 LFA) were selected for exploratory milk-production and serum comparisons. RF-DETR showed the best overall detection performance, with a precision (P) of 87.39%, recall (R) of 84.00%, F1-score of 85.66%, mean average precision (mAP)@0.5 of 90.38%, and mAP@0.5:0.95 of 53.30%. Goats exhibited a “rapid entry–peak aggregation–gradual departure” feeding pattern after feed delivery. Among the temporal features, rise time of feeding-area goat count (RTFGC), fall time of feeding-area goat count (FTFGC), and feeding-area goat count increase rate (FGCIR) were the most informative features for distinguishing HFA from LFA. HFA goats reached peak feeding-area occupancy earlier, entered the feeding area at a higher rate, and maintained feeding activity for longer than LFA goats. HFA goats also showed higher head-down feeding proportions, greater average daily dry matter intake (DMI), and higher milk yield, as well as distinct serum immune, antioxidant, and neuroendocrine-related profiles. These findings indicate that feeding dynamics derived from video observations can provide a quantitative digital behavioral phenotype for characterizing individual differences in dairy goat feeding activity and their associations with production and physiological status.
papers.abstract_zh: 採食行為與營養攝取、健康及生產性能密切相關，然而在群養乳山羊中，其時間動態難以量化。本研究開發了一個基於電腦視覺的框架，以表徵商業牧場條件下的採食動態。我們連續三天收集了 5 種欄舍中 550 隻關中乳山羊的影像數據。比較了 YOLO11、RF-DETR 與 RT-DETR 用於採食區山羊偵測的效能，並分析時間採食特徵以表徵高採食活動（HFA）與低採食活動（LFA）。在隨後的記錄階段，對來自已分類來源欄舍的 150 隻山羊進行低頭採食行為評估。從中選出共 24 隻山羊（12 隻 HFA 與 12 隻 LFA）進行探索性產奶量與血清學比較。RF-DETR 顯示出最佳的整體偵測效能，其準確率（precision, P）為 87.39%、召回率（recall, R）為 84.00%、F1 分數為 85.66%、平均精確度均值（mAP）@0.5 為 90.38%，且 mAP@0.5:0.95 為 53.30%。山羊在給料後表現出「快速進入－尖峰聚集－逐漸離開」的採食模式。在時間特徵中，採食區山羊數量上升時間（RTFGC）、採食區山羊數量下降時間（FTFGC）以及採食區山羊數量增加率（FGCIR）是用於區分 HFA 與 LFA 最具資訊量的特徵。與 LFA 山羊相比，HFA 山羊較早達到採食區佔有率峰值、以較高速率進入採食區，且維持採食活動的時間更長。HFA 山羊亦表現出較高的低頭採食比例、較高的平均每日乾物質採食量（DMI）與產奶量，以及截然不同的血清免疫、抗氧化與神經內分泌相關特徵譜。這些發現表明，源自影像觀測的採食動態可提供一個量化的數位行為表型，用於表徵乳山羊採食活動的個體差異及其與生產和生理狀態的關聯。

papers.title: Indole-3-Lactic Acid Modulates Feeding Behavior and Appetite-Related Signals in Weaned Piglets
papers.abstract: Gut microbiota-derived metabolites act as important mediators linking the gut microbiome with host physiological functions and participate in the regulation of metabolic homeostasis and behavior. However, whether the tryptophan metabolite indole-3-lactic acid (ILA) regulates feeding behavior in piglets and its potential central regulatory mechanisms remain unclear. In this study, 12 weaned piglets were used as a model to investigate the effects of ILA on feeding behavior regulation. The results showed that ILA supplementation did not significantly affect growth performance (p > 0.05), although final body weight, average daily gain, and average daily feed intake were numerically higher in the ILA group than in the control group. ILA also altered feeding behavior patterns, characterized by reduced daily feeding frequency (p < 0.05) and increased feeding rate (p = 0.053). Furthermore, ILA significantly increased serum concentrations of several appetite-related gastrointestinal hormones, including glucagon-like peptide-1, peptide YY, ghrelin, and cholecystokinin, and modified serum lipid metabolism-related parameters (p < 0.05). Hypothalamic transcriptomic analysis identified 240 differentially expressed genes in the ILA group compared with the CON group, with enrichment of genes involved in neural signaling and appetite regulation. These findings suggest that ILA may influence feeding behavior in weaned piglets, accompanied by numerical increases in feed intake and growth-related parameters, as well as changes in peripheral appetite-related gastrointestinal hormones and hypothalamic transcriptional responses.
papers.abstract_zh: 腸道菌群衍生的代謝物作為重要媒介，連結了腸道微生物組與宿主生理功能，並參與調節代謝恆定與行為。然而，色胺酸代謝物吲哚-3-乳酸（ILA）是否調節仔豬的攝食行為及其潛在的中樞調節機制仍不清楚。本研究以12頭離乳仔豬作為模型，探討ILA對攝食行為調節的影響。結果顯示，補充ILA對生長性能並無顯著影響（p > 0.05），儘管ILA組的最終體重、平均日增重和平均日採食量在數值上高於對照組。ILA也改變了攝食行為模式，其特徵為每日進食頻率降低（p < 0.05）以及進食速率增加（p = 0.053）。此外，ILA顯著增加了多種與食慾相關的血清胃腸道荷爾蒙濃度，包括升糖素類似肽-1、肽YY、飢餓素和膽囊收縮素，並改變了血清脂質代謝相關參數（p < 0.05）。下視丘轉錄體分析顯示，與CON組相比，ILA組有240個差異表現基因，並富集了參與神經信號傳遞與食慾調節的基因。這些發現表明，ILA可能會影響離乳仔豬的攝食行為，並伴隨採食量與生長相關參數的數值增加，以及周邊食慾相關胃腸道荷爾蒙和下視丘轉錄反應的改變。

papers.title: Life-Stage-Specific Prioritization of Feline Diseases for Health Screening in South Korea
papers.abstract: Feline health screening in South Korea lacks local disease priorities. We developed a model combining diagnostic proportions from 39,016 diagnosis entries with disease importance and treatment/management efficacy ratings from 39 veterinarians. Two scoring versions used different orders of multiplication and decile conversion across four life stages: kitten, young adult, mature adult, and senior. Eligibility required a stage-specific diagnostic proportion of at least half the overall proportion for that disease and at least 0.3% of diagnoses in that stage. The versions produced similar top-10 lists. Stomatitis was selected for all four life stages; stomatitis and six additional diseases—chronic kidney disease, urolithiasis, systemic hypertension, pancreatitis, diabetes mellitus, and periodontal disease—were selected for all three adult stages. Infectious diseases featured prominently in kittens, whereas chronic and metabolic diseases became prominent in older cats. Hyperthyroidism was selected only in seniors, and neoplasia remained below the top 10, reflecting its low efficacy score. Scoring prioritized severe chronic or life-threatening conditions more highly than diagnostic proportions alone. Diagnostic proportions describe recorded diagnoses rather than individual-cat population prevalence. These candidate lists require validation and evaluation of screening tests, clinical benefits, cost, accessibility, and patient stress before guidelines can be established.
papers.abstract_zh: 南韓的貓咪健康篩檢缺乏在地疾病優先順序。我們開發了一項模型，結合了 39,016 筆診斷記錄的診斷比例，以及 39 位獸醫師對疾病重要性與治療／管理成效的評分。兩個計分版本在幼貓、青年貓、成熟貓與高齡貓等四個生命階段中，採用了不同的相乘順序與十分位數轉換。納入資格要求特定生命階段的診斷比例，至少達到該疾病整體比例的一半，且至少佔該階段診斷的 0.3%。兩個版本產生了相似的前十大疾病名單。口炎在所有四個生命階段皆被選中；口炎及另外六種疾病——慢性腎臟病、尿石症、全身性高血壓、胰臟炎、糖尿病與牙周病——在所有三個成年階段皆被選中。傳染病在幼貓中佔顯著地位，而慢性病與代謝性疾病則在較年長的貓隻中變得顯著。甲狀腺功能亢進僅在高齡貓中被選中，而腫瘤則維持在十名之外，反映出其較低的成效評分。與單純的診斷比例相比，計分機制將嚴重慢性或危及生命的狀況排在更高優先順序。診斷比例描述的是記錄到的診斷，而非個別貓隻族群的盛行率。這些候選名單在建立指南之前，需要進行篩檢試驗的驗證與評估，以及臨床效益、成本、可近性與病患壓力的評估。

papers.title: Melatonin Ameliorates Stress-Induced Oocyte Developmental Impairment: Evidence from In Vivo and In Vitro Models
papers.abstract: Stress compromises oocyte quality and reproductive performance, yet the comparative efficacy of MT and other antioxidants under stress remains unclear.
