papers.title: Reproductive Indicators, Blood Biochemistry, Steroid Hormones, and Sperm Quality of Nile Tilapia Oreochromis niloticus Broodstock Subjected to Panax ginseng Extract as Dietary Supplements During the Spawning Season
papers.abstract: To achieve sustainable aquaculture and enhance the reproductive efficiency of tilapia fish safely, our work studied the beneficial impact of a dietary extract of Panax ginseng (PGE) on the reproductive efficiency of Nile tilapia broodstock and the performance of their fry. The broodstock were conditioned for 21 days by separately rearing the females and males into four groups of each and fed with four levels of dietary PGE (0, 0.5, 1, and 1.5 g/kg). Following this, a 100-day spawning experiment was conducted in 12 hapas (28 m3) with a sex ratio of 3:1 [90 females: 30 males/hapa]. A hapa was considered an experimental unit with 3 hapas per treatment. Males and females that received the same diets in the conditioning stage were mated and continued to be fed the same feed during this stage. Hapas were checked every 10 days to collect yolk sac larvae or eggs, which were transferred to incubators. A sample of 10 males and 30 females was taken after 30 days from each group to evaluate semen characters, blood indices, the gonadosomatic index GSI, and egg diameter. At the end, a blood sample was collected from the broodstocks of each group to evaluate their biochemicals and sexual hormones. Another trial was performed for 28 days to compare the performance of the offspring from each treatment at a density rate of 20,000 larvae/hapa (12 m3) with a basal diet containing 40% CP. Results showed a significant increase in semen quality, sexual hormones, the GSI, hatching rate, and fry production in the broodstock fed the dietary PGE compared to the control group. Specifically, the group that received 1.5 g/kg showed the best results and the highest values in all parameters as sperm motility (92.50%), egg diameter (1.66 mm), and fry number per hapa per collection (16,515 fry) followed by those that received 1.0 and 0.5 g/kg PGE, respectively.
papers.abstract_zh: 為實現永續水產養殖並安全地提升羅飛魚（吳郭魚）的繁殖效率，本研究探討了在飼料中添加人參萃取物（PGE）對尼羅羅飛魚親魚繁殖效率及魚苗性能的有益影響。將雌雄親魚分別飼養並分為四組進行為期 21 天的馴化，各組投餵四種不同添加量的飼料 PGE（0、0.5、1 及 1.5 g/kg）。隨後，在 12 個網箱（28 m³）中進行為期 100 天的產卵實驗，性別比例為 3:1（每網箱 90 尾雌魚：30 尾雄魚）。每個網箱被視為一個實驗單位，每個處理組設有 3 個網箱。在馴化階段攝食相同飼料的雄魚和雌魚進行配對，並在此階段繼續投餵相同的飼料。每 10 天檢查一次網箱以收集卵黃囊仔魚或魚卵，並將其移至孵化器中。各組在 30 天後分別隨機抽取 10 尾雄魚和 30 尾雌魚樣本，以評估精液特徵、血液指標、性腺體重指數（GSI）及卵徑。最後，收集各組親魚的血液樣本以評估其生化指標及性激素。進行另一項為期 28 天的試驗，以基礎飼料（含 40% 粗蛋白）在 20,000 尾/網箱（12 m³）的密度下，比較各處理組後代的生長性能。結果顯示，與對照組相比，投餵添加 PGE 飼料的親魚在精液品質、性激素、GSI、孵化率及魚苗產量方面均顯著增加。具體而言，攝食 1.5 g/kg 添加量的組別在所有參數中表現出最佳結果與最高數值，例如精子活力（92.50%）、卵徑（1.66 mm）以及每網箱每次收集的魚苗數（16,515 尾），其次依序為攝食 1.0 和 0.5 g/kg PGE 的組別。

papers.title: Exploratory Comparative Ovarian Transcriptomic Profiling in Dekalb White Hens Identified Candidate Signatures Associated with Egg-Laying Plateau Persistence
papers.abstract: The peak egg-laying plateau in poultry is regulated by complex genetic factors. To elucidate these, we performed a comparative ovarian transcriptome profiling (RNA-Seq) of Dekalb White hens with distinct egg production curves, using early-persistent (PP, n = 3) vs. late-degraded (DP, n = 3) birds selected by contrasting phenotypes from 60 birds per cohort at 49.5 weeks of age. PP hens showed earlier plateau onset (24 vs. 27 weeks), higher production (97.32% vs. 85.43%), lower body weight (1652.27 ± 26.19 vs. 1869.05 ± 32.18 g) and lower liver weight (34.85 ± 2.55 vs. 44.55 ± 1.10 g) than DP birds (p < 0.05). Suggestive shifts in hematological profiles (erythrocytes, hemoglobin, color index) were observed in the DP group (p < 0.05). Among 17,285 loci, 484 differentially expressed genes were identified (305 upregulated and 179 downregulated in PP). Functional enrichment analysis highlighted enzymatic activity and immune response pathways. Notably, PP hens exhibited upregulation of PNLIPRP1 (log2FC = 1.9, p = 0.001) and downregulation of PLTP (log2FC = −1.65, p = 0.015). Non-linear hierarchical approximation revealed a stochastic noise mode in DP (α = 45.05, p = 0.276). Network analysis identified a compact regulatory cluster (SFRP5, WNT5B, MMP13) linked to the Wnt pathway. RT-qPCR validated RNA-Seq trends for five candidate genes; SERPINB10B, MMP13 and LYG3 expression increased 3.86- to 16.00-fold in DP (p < 0.05). These signatures offer potential candidate molecular markers for future exploratory breeding programs targeting extended egg-laying plateaus.
papers.abstract_zh: 家禽產蛋高峰期之高原期係由複雜的遺傳因素所調控。為闡明這些機制，本研究對具有不同產蛋曲線的迪卡白（Dekalb White）母雞進行了比較性卵巢轉錄體定點分析（RNA-Seq）。樣本取自各世代 60 隻 49.5 週齡母雞中，藉由對比表現型所選出之早期持續產蛋組（PP, n = 3）與晚期衰退產蛋組（DP, n = 3）。與 DP 組相比，PP 組母雞展現出較早的產蛋高原期起始時間（24 週對 27 週）、較高的產蛋率（97.32% 對 85.43%）、較低的體重（1652.27 ± 26.19 對 1869.05 ± 32.18 克）以及較低的肝臟重量（34.85 ± 2.55 對 44.55 ± 1.10 克）（p < 0.05）。在 DP 組中觀察到血液學指標（紅血球、血紅素、色澤指數）有顯著的轉變趨勢（p < 0.05）。在 17,285 個基因座中，共鑑定出 484 個差異表現基因（PP 組中有 305 個顯著上調及 179 個顯著下調）。功能富集分析突顯了酵素活性與免疫反應路徑。值得注意的是，PP 組母雞表現出 PNLIPRP1 的上調（log2FC = 1.9, p = 0.001）以及 PLTP 的下調（log2FC = −1.65, p = 0.015）。非線性階層近似法揭示了 DP 組中的隨機雜訊模式（α = 45.05, p = 0.276）。網路分析鑑定出一個與 Wnt 路徑連結的緊密調控叢集（SFRP5、WNT5B、MMP13）。RT-qPCR 驗證了五個候選基因的 RNA-Seq 趨勢；DP 組中 SERPINB10B、MMP13 與 LYG3 的表現量增加了 3.86 至 16.00 倍（p < 0.05）。這些特徵為未來旨在延長產蛋高原期的探索性育種計畫，提供了具潛力的候選分子標記。

papers.title: Capsaicin Incorporated into Fermented Concentrate: In Vitro Screening and Effects on Digestibility and Rumen Fermentation in Finishing Yanbian Cattle
papers.abstract: This study evaluated the effects of capsaicin addition before feed fermentation on electronic-nose profiles, in vitro fermentation, and animal responses in finishing Yanbian cattle. Electronic-nose analysis compared unfermented and fermented feeds prepared with nominal capsaicin additions of 0, 250, 500, or 750 mg per 500 g substrate. Fermented feeds prepared with 250 and 500 mg (FC250 and FC500) visually resembled the fermented control (FC0) in their sensor response patterns, whereas FC750 showed a more distinct profile. These observations were descriptive; no pairwise comparison was significant after multiplicity adjustment. In vitro, FC500 increased cumulative gas production relative to FC0 at several incubation times, whereas FC250 exceeded FC0 only at 36 h, without significant differences in nutrient digestibility. Thirty female cattle housed in ten pens received FC0 or FC500 at 500 g per animal daily, with five pens per treatment. Using pen as the experimental unit and adjusting for initial body weight, FC500 increased final body weight and average daily gain (both p = 0.018), whereas dry matter intake did not differ significantly. FC500 also increased chewing frequency, and apparent dry matter digestibility (65.73% vs. 63.09%; p = 0.029). At a single sampling point after prolonged fasting, FC500 had higher ruminal pH and propionate concentration, and a lower acetate-to-propionate ratio (p < 0.05). No significant differences were detected in bacterial alpha diversity or overall community structure, and no genus differences survived false discovery rate correction. These findings provide preliminary evidence of improved digestibility and growth with FC500 under the experimental conditions. Because residual capsaicin was not quantified, the responses apply to the fermented preparation as a whole.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究評估在飼料發酵前添加辣椒素對延邊育肥牛之電子鼻氣味指紋、體外發酵及動物反應的影響。電子鼻分析比較了未發酵飼料以及名義上每 500 克基質添加 0、250、500 或 750 毫克辣椒素所製備之發酵飼料。添加 250 和 500 毫克辣椒素製備的發酵飼料（FC250 和 FC500）在感測器響應模式上與發酵對照組（FC0）相似，而 FC750 則呈現較明顯不同的特徵。這些觀察僅為描述性；經多重比較校正後，所有成對比較皆無顯著差異。在體外試驗中，與 FC0 相比，FC500 在多個培養時間點增加了累積產氣量，而 FC250 僅在 36 小時顯著高於 FC0，營養物質消化率則無顯著差異。三十頭雌性肉牛飼養於十個欄位中，每天每隻動物餵食 500 克的 FC0 或 FC500，每處理五個欄位。以欄位作為實驗單位並校正初始體重後，FC500 顯著提高了最終體重和平均日增重（兩者 $p = 0.018$），而乾物質採食量則無顯著差異。FC500 也提高了咀嚼頻率以及表觀乾物質消化率（65.73% 對 63.09%；$p = 0.029$）。在長時間禁食後的一個單一取樣點，FC500 組具有較高的瘤胃 pH 值和丙酸濃度，以及較低的乙酸與丙酸比值（$p < 0.05$）。細菌阿伐多樣性（alpha diversity）或整體群落結構未檢測到顯著差異，且沒有任何屬級差異在經過偽發現率（false discovery rate）校正後保持顯著。這些結果提供了在實驗條件下使用 FC500 可改善消化率和生長的初步證據。由於未對殘留辣椒素進行定量，因此相關反應適用於發酵製劑整體。

papers.title: Breed Composition and Heterozygosity in Brangus and Braford Composite Cattle Breeds
papers.abstract: Composite cattle breeds are developed to combine favorable traits from parental populations and to exploit heterosis across diverse production environments. However, their genomic structure becomes progressively more complex across generations, and it remains unclear to what extent patterns of local ancestry and heterozygosity are conserved across breeds. The objective of this study was to characterize genomic breed composition in Argentine Brangus and Braford at both global and local levels, and to identify shared genomic segments with extreme values of indicine ancestry and heterozygosity. A total of 783 animals from six breeds were analyzed using SNP data. Global ancestry proportions were estimated using STRUCTURE, whereas local ancestry was inferred through haplotype phasing (Shapeit5) and local ancestry inference using LOTER. Deviations between observed and expected breed composition and heterozygosity were evaluated at the SNP level using chi‐square tests with multiple testing correction. Shared genomic segments were defined as contiguous genomic intervals composed of SNPs showing significant deviations in both breeds. Brangus and Braford showed lower indicine proportions than the expected 37.5%, with reductions of 1.2% and 7.1%, respectively. Local ancestry analysis revealed heterogeneous genomic patterns, with shared segments enriched for indicine ancestry on chromosomes 3, 6, 20, and 28. In contrast, segments with reduced indicine ancestry were more broadly distributed. No SNP exceeded the expected heterozygosity; however, multiple regions showed significant reductions, particularly on chromosome 18. These results demonstrate that Brangus and Braford exhibit complex and heterogeneous genomic architectures, with shared genomic regions showing extreme patterns of ancestry and heterozygosity.
papers.abstract_zh: 複合肉牛品種的培育旨在結合親本群體的優良性狀，並在不同的生產環境中利用雜種優勢。然而，其基因體結構在跨世代間變得日益複雜，且局部祖先來源（local ancestry）與雜合度（heterozygosity）的模式在不同品種間保留的程度仍不清楚。本研究旨在於全基因體與局部層次上描述阿根廷布蘭格斯牛（Brangus）與布拉佛牛（Braford）的基因體品種組成，並識別具有極端瘤牛（indicine）祖先比例與雜合度數值的共享基因體片段。本研究使用單核苷酸多型性（SNP）資料，分析了來自六個品種共 783 頭動物。全基因體祖先比例利用 STRUCTURE 進行估計，而局部祖先則是透過單套型分型（Shapeit5）與利用 LOTER 的局部祖先推論來推斷。透過卡方檢定及多重檢定校正，在 SNP 層次上評估觀察到的與預期的品種組成及雜合度之間的偏差。共享基因體片段被定義為由在兩個品種中皆顯示顯著偏差的 SNP 所構成的連續基因體區間。布蘭格斯牛與布拉佛牛顯示出低於預期 37.5% 的瘤牛比例，分別減少了 1.2% 與 7.1%。局部祖先分析揭示了異質性的基因體模式，其中富含瘤牛祖先的共享片段位於第 3、6、20 和 28 染色體上。相比之下，瘤牛祖先減少的片段分佈更為廣泛。沒有任何 SNP 超過預期的雜合度；然而，多個區域顯示出顯著的減少，特別是在第 18 染色體上。這些結果證明了布蘭格斯牛與布拉佛牛展現出複雜且具異質性的基因體架構，其中共享的基因體區域顯示出祖先來源與雜合度的極端模式。

papers.title: Dietary phosphorus source reprograms the kidney-intestine axis to dictate calcium-phosphorus efficiency and egg production in aging hens
papers.abstract: Background The decline in egg production in aging hens poses a significant challenge to sustainable poultry production. Given that evidence suggests the phosphorus source affects late‑lay performance, we tested the hypothesis that the dietary phosphorus source is a decisive regulator sustaining performance by reprogramming systemic mineral homeostasis. Using a systems biology approach, we analyzed the coordinated expression of eleven key mineral transporter genes across the duodenum, jejunum, ileum, and kidney of hens fed dicalcium phosphate (DCP) or tricalcium phosphate (TCP). Results During weeks 5–8, hens fed DCP showed significant declines in egg production (β = −3.11/week, P < 0.001) and egg weight (β = −0.47 g/week, P = 0.049), unlike the stable TCP group. TCP induced an efficient "precision conservation" phenotype, characterized by the co-upregulation of key duodenal phosphorus and calcium transporters ( NaPi-IIb , PiT2; NCX1 , PMCA1b ), a gene set identified as the top predictor of performance. Conversely, DCP triggered a costly "compensatory salvage" state, scattering expression to duodenal calcium channels ( TRPV5 , TRPV6 ) and renal compensatory genes ( NCX1 , CALB1 ). Network analysis pinpointed these renal genes as a central, performance-limiting hub. Conclusion We conclude that TCP sustains production by programming a systemically efficient homeostatic strategy, thereby explaining the established performance benefit at a molecular level. This establishes a new principle for layer nutrition: phosphorus source selection must consider its role as a physiological signal that modulates homeostasis. This strategy mitigates age-related decline and enhances resource allocation to production.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Science and Biotechnology
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：高齡母雞產蛋量下降對永續家禽生產構成了重大挑戰。鑑於有證據表明磷源會影響後期產蛋表現，我們假設日糧磷源是透過重新編程全身礦物質恆定來維持生產表現的決定性調節因子。我們採用系統生物學方法，分析了餵食磷酸氫鈣（DCP）或磷酸三鈣（TCP）的母雞在十二指腸、空腸、迴腸和腎臟中十一個關鍵礦物質轉運蛋白基因的協調表達。結果：在第 5 至 8 週期間，與表現穩定的 TCP 組不同，餵食 DCP 的母雞之產蛋量（β = −3.11/週，P < 0.001）和蛋重（β = −0.47 克/週，P = 0.049）均顯現顯著下降。TCP 誘導出高效的「精準保存」表現型，其特徵在於十二指腸關鍵磷和鈣轉運蛋白（ NaPi-IIb 、 PiT2 ； NCX1 、 PMCA1b ）的共同上調，這組基因被確定為生產表現的最佳預測指標。相反地，DCP 則引發了消耗性的「代償性回收」狀態，將表達分散至十二指腸鈣通道（ TRPV5 、 TRPV6 ）和腎臟代償基因（ NCX1 、 CALB1 ）。網路分析將這些腎臟基因精確定位為一個核心的、限制表現的樞紐。結論：我們得出結論，TCP 透過編程全身高效的恆定策略來維持生產，從而在分子水平上解釋了既定的生產表現優勢。這為蛋雞營養確立了一項新原則：磷源選擇必須考慮其作為調節恆定之生理信號的角色。此策略可減緩與年齡相關的機能衰退，並增強資源分配以提升生產力。

papers.title: Effects of Dietary Bacillus spp. and Bacillus spp.-Fermented Soybean Hull on Growth Performance and Apparent Nutrient Digestibility in Growing–Finishing Pigs
papers.abstract: This study investigated the fermentation improvement of soybean hull by Bacillus subtilis and Bacillus licheniformis from Ningxiang pigs and evaluated different feeding methods in growing-finishing pigs. The cellulase-producing capacity of the two strains and their fermentation effects on soybean hull were determined. Compound Bacillus preparation (200 and 400 g/t) and fermented soybean hull (5% and 10%) were supplemented into finishing pig diets, and their effects on growth performance; apparent nutrient digestibility; and serum biochemical, immune, and antioxidant indices were evaluated. In vitro results showed that combined fermentation significantly decreased crude fiber content and increased crude protein and ether extract concentrations. Animal trial results showed that supplementation with 400 g/t compound Bacillus preparation or 5% fermented soybean hull significantly increased final body weight but did not significantly affect average daily gain (ADG), average daily feed intake (ADFI), or feed-to-gain ratio (F/G). In the compound Bacillus preparation trial, supplementation increased the apparent digestibility of crude protein and gross energy and was associated with changes in several serum antioxidant and inflammatory indicators. In the fermented soybean hull trial, supplementation improved crude protein utilization efficiency, with no significant effects on the measured serum immune parameters. Supplementation with 200 g/t compound Bacillus preparation or 10% fermented soybean hull showed no growth-promoting effects. Neither method adversely affected the measured growth performance, nutrient digestibility, or serum parameters. The present study demonstrates that appropriate doses of Ningxiang pig-derived compound Bacillus preparation or its fermented soybean hull can increase final body weight and nutrient digestibility in growing–finishing pigs. These findings provide experimental support for the application of Bacillus spp. in feed fermentation and finishing pig production.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究探討利用源自寧鄉豬的枯草芽孢桿菌（Bacillus subtilis）與地衣芽孢桿菌（Bacillus licheniformis）改善大豆皮醱酵之效果，並評估其在生長肥育豬中的不同飼餵方式。測定了兩株菌株的產纖維素酶能力及其對大豆皮的醱酵效果。在肥育豬日糧中添加複合芽孢桿菌製劑（200與400克/噸）以及醱酵大豆皮（5%與10%），並評估其對生長性能、養分表觀消化率、血清生化、免疫及抗氧化指標的影響。體外試驗結果顯示，混合醱酵顯著降低了粗纖維含量，並提高了粗蛋白質與乙醚萃取物的濃度。動物試驗結果顯示，添加400克/噸複合芽孢桿菌製劑或5%醱酵大豆皮顯著提高了最終體重，但對平均日增重（ADG）、平均日採食量（ADFI）或料重比（F/G）無顯著影響。在複合芽孢桿菌製劑試驗中，添加該製劑提高了粗蛋白質和總能的表觀消化率，並與多項血清抗氧化及發炎指標的變化有關。在醱酵大豆皮試驗中，添加該組分提高了粗蛋白質利用效率，且對所測定的血清免疫參數無顯著影響。添加200克/噸複合芽孢桿菌製劑或10%醱酵大豆皮則未顯示出生長促進效果。兩種方法均未對所測定的生長性能、養分消化率或血清參數產生不良影響。本研究證明，適當劑量的寧鄉豬源性複合芽孢桿菌製劑及其醱酵大豆皮可提高生長肥育豬的最終體重與養分消化率。這些發現為芽孢桿菌屬在飼料醱酵與肥育豬生產中的應用提供了實驗支持。

papers.title: The Application of Artificial Intelligence in Brucellosis: Diagnosis, Genomic Analysis, Epidemiological Prediction and Drug Discovery
papers.abstract: Brucellosis, a globally significant zoonosis caused by Brucella, poses a substantial impediment to the sustainable development of the livestock industry and threatens public health security. Traditional control and prevention strategies for brucellosis suffer from fundamental limitations. These include the time-consuming, biosafety risks associated with bacterial culture and the difficulty in differentiating between natural infection and vaccine-induced immunity with serological tests. There remains a challenge in accurately distinguishing vaccine strains from wild-type strains via genotyping methods. Furthermore, current practice relies on manual reporting and empirical judgment without real-time data support. Consequently, these challenges could hinder early detection and reduce the efficiency of large-scale screening, which leads to imprecise outbreak tracing and fails to meet the practical demands of modern livestock production for rapid diagnosis, intelligent prevention and control. In recent years, artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) technologies have been widely applied in the field of veterinary microbiology, which could offer novel technical pathways for the prevention and control of brucellosis. This paper reviews the latest research progress in the application of AI for the rapid diagnosis of brucellosis, genomic analysis and antimicrobial resistance prediction of Brucella, epidemiological risk early warning and the development of drugs and vaccines. We further analyze the current limitations of AI in brucellosis research including the scarcity of high-quality, annotated datasets, insufficient model interpretability and low efficiency in on-site translation and implementation. The paper provides an outlook on the future development of AI-based intelligent prevention and control systems for brucellosis, which offer a theoretical reference and innovative perspectives for the fundamental research and clinical application of AI technologies. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first review to integrate AI applications across the entire chain of brucellosis prevention and control and to propose a conceptual framework for AI-driven intelligent brucellosis management.
papers.abstract_zh: 布魯氏菌病是由布魯氏菌屬引起、具有全球重要性的人畜共通傳染病，對畜牧業的可持續發展構成重大阻礙，並威脅公共衛生安全。傳統的布魯氏菌病防控策略存在根本上的侷限性，包括細菌培養耗時且伴隨生物安全風險，以及血清學檢測難以區分自然感染與疫苗誘導免疫。透過基因分型方法準確區分疫苗株與野生型菌株仍是一大挑戰。此外，現行實務依賴人工通報與經驗判斷，缺乏即時數據支援。因此，這些挑戰可能妨礙早期檢測並降低大規模篩檢的效率，導致疫情追蹤不夠精準，無法滿足現代畜牧生產對快速診斷、智慧化防控的實際需求。近年來，人工智慧（AI）與機器學習（ML）技術已廣泛應用於獸醫微生物學領域，為布魯氏菌病的防控提供了新穎的技術途徑。本文綜述了人工智慧在布魯氏菌病快速診斷、布魯氏菌基因體分析與抗生素抗藥性預測、流行病學風險預警以及藥物和疫苗開發應用方面的最新研究進展。我們進一步分析了人工智慧在布魯氏菌病研究中的現有限制，包括高品質標註數據集的匱乏、模型可解釋性不足，以及現場轉化與實施效率低下。本文對基於人工智慧的布魯氏菌病智慧化防控系統的未來發展進行了展望，為人工智慧技術的基礎研究與臨床應用提供了理論參考與創新視角。據我們所知，這是第一篇整合布魯氏菌病全鏈條防控中人工智慧應用，並提出人工智慧驅動之布魯氏菌病智慧化管理概念框架的綜述文獻。

papers.title: Physiological Adaptations of Tibetan Antelopes to High-Altitude Hypoxia: Insights from Pulmonary and Vasoactive Peptide Studies
papers.abstract: The Qinghai–Tibetan Plateau is characterized by persistent hypobaric hypoxia, and Tibetan antelopes (Pantholops hodgsonii) exhibit exceptional athletic performance under extreme oxygen-deficient conditions. This study conducted a comparative analysis of pulmonary hemodynamics, ventilatory regulation, vasoactive peptides, and cardiopulmonary ultrastructure among 10 Tibetan antelopes, 10 high-altitude sheep, and 8 low-altitude sheep under normoxia, mild hypoxia, and severe hypoxia. The findings revealed that Tibetan antelopes possess a lower baseline mean pulmonary arterial pressure (mPAP) compared to high-altitude sheep, with values similar to those of low-altitude sheep. Under hypoxic conditions, antelopes experienced a mild increase in mPAP, whereas sheep exhibited significant vasoconstriction. Additionally, antelopes demonstrated a reduced hypoxic ventilatory response, in contrast to sheep, which increased total ventilation. Antelopes also had lower levels of plasma endothelin-1, nitric oxide synthase, arterial oxygen pressure, and blood oxygen saturation, with no significant differences observed in blood pH, carbon dioxide pressure, and lactate levels among the groups. Ultrastructural analyses indicated that Tibetan antelopes possess a higher density of alveolar lamellar bodies and myocardial mitochondria. These traits minimize energy use during breathing, prevent pulmonary hypertension, and maintain excellent movement ability in high-altitude, low-oxygen environments.
papers.abstract_zh: 青藏高原以持續性低壓缺氧為特徵，而藏羚羊（Pantholops hodgsonii）在極端缺氧環境下展現出卓越的運動能力。本研究對 10 隻藏羚羊、10 隻高海拔綿羊和 8 隻低海拔綿羊在常氧、輕度缺氧與重度缺氧條件下的肺部血行動力學、通氣調節、血管活性肽以及心肺超微結構進行了比較分析。研究結果顯示，與高海拔綿羊相比，藏羚羊具有較低的基礎平均肺動脈壓（mPAP），其數值與低海拔綿羊相似。在缺氧條件下，藏羚羊的 mPAP 僅輕微上升，而綿羊則表現出顯著的血管收縮。此外，藏羚羊表現出較低的缺氧通氣反應，這與總通氣量增加的綿羊形成對比。藏羚羊的血漿內皮素-1、一氧化氮合酶、動脈氧分壓和血氧飽和度水準也較低，而各組間的血液 pH 值、二氧化碳分壓和乳酸水準則無顯著差異。超微結構分析表明，藏羚羊具有較高密度的肺泡板層小體和心肌粒線體。這些特徵能最大限度地減少呼吸過程中的能量消耗、預防肺動脈高壓，並在高海拔低氧環境中維持優異的運動能力。

papers.title: From Trauma to Innovation: A Comparative History of Limb Amputation and Prosthetics in Humans and Ungulates from Historical and Zooarchaeological Perspectives
papers.abstract: Amputation and prosthetics represent vital themes in the history of medicine and zooarchaeology, reflecting the boundaries of therapeutic capabilities and evolving human–animal relationships. This study provides a comprehensive, comparative historical analysis of limb amputation procedures, surgical tools, haemostasis, and prosthetic rehabilitation in both humans and ungulates. A narrative literature review was conducted across electronic databases (PubMed, Web of Science, Scopus, Google Scholar, and the Cochrane Library) and digital repositories to evaluate archaeological evidence, ancient legal frameworks, and medieval/early modern medical and veterinary treatises. The historical evolution reveals striking cross-disciplinary technical analogies. Early modern surgical instruments (amputation knives and saws) and basic haemostatic approaches (fire cauterization transitioning to vascular ligation) developed along parallel trajectories in human and veterinary surgeries. However, the post-operative application of prosthetics reveals sharp biomechanical contrasts. While human prosthetics primarily addressed locomotion and cosmetics, veterinary prosthetics in heavy ungulates (horses and cattle) faced critical biological barriers, most notably contralateral limb overload leading to laminitis. Conversely, modern cases in lighter species (donkeys, alpacas, and sheep) demonstrate significantly higher adaptive success. Integrating human medical milestones with veterinary history provides a holistic framework for understanding paleopathologies and the cultural shift from culling injured livestock toward advanced, empathetic veterinary bioengineering.
papers.abstract_zh: 截肢與義肢是醫學史與動物考古學中的重要主題，反映了治療能力的界限以及不斷演變的人與動物關係。本研究針對人類與有蹄類動物的四肢截肢手術、手術器械、止血方法與義肢復健，提供了一項全面性的比較歷史分析。本研究透過電子資料庫（PubMed、Web of Science、Scopus、Google Scholar與Cochrane Library）及數位典藏進行敘事性文獻回顧，以評估考古證據、古代法律架構以及中世紀／近代早期的醫學與獸醫專著。歷史演變揭示了驚人的跨學科技術類比。近代早期的手術器械（截肢刀與鋸子）以及基本的止血方法（從火灼止血法過渡到血管結紮術）在人類與獸醫外科手術中沿著平行的軌跡發展。然而，義肢的術後應用則展現出鮮明的生物力學對比。人類義肢主要解決行動與美觀問題，而重型有蹄類動物（馬與牛）的獸醫義肢則面臨關鍵的生物學障礙，其中最顯著的是對側肢體負荷過重導致的蹄葉炎。相反地，較輕物種（驢、羊駝與綿羊）的現代案例則展現出顯著較高的適應成功率。將人類醫學里程碑與獸醫歷史相結合，為理解古病理學以及從淘汰受傷牲畜轉向先進、具同理心的獸醫生物工程之文化轉變，提供了一個全方位的架構。

papers.title: Allele and Genotype Frequencies of Production Trait SNPs in Crossbred Heifers of the Colombian Caribbean
papers.abstract: The Colombian Caribbean dual-purpose livestock system (Bos taurus × Bos indicus) is an important source of milk and beef, yet molecular characterization of trait-associated markers remains limited. This study characterized allele and genotype frequencies of 29 single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) associated with meat quality and milk production traits in 1585 crossbred heifers from five departments of the Colombian Caribbean. DNA was extracted from hair follicles and genotyped with the Axiom™ Bovine 100K Array. Markers spanned genes for muscle growth and proteolysis (CAPN1, CAST, MSTN), energy metabolism (LEP, DGAT1), and milk protein composition (CSN2, CSN3, PAEP, GH1, GHR, ABCG2). Hardy–Weinberg equilibrium (HWE) was assessed by chi-squared test. Of the 29 markers, 21 were polymorphic and testable: 19 conformed to HWE and 2 deviated (PAEP_239, PAEP_312). The remaining 8 were monomorphic. Approximately 48% of loci showed very high favorable allele frequencies (q > 0.99 or p > 0.99), whereas 52% maintained intermediate heterozygosity. CSN3_526 reached near-fixation of the favorable B allele (q = 0.996), consistent with selection for cheese yield, whereas CAST_282 and CAST_2870 showed high heterozygosity (f(AB) ≈ 0.47–0.48), indicating substantial remaining variation at these loci. These findings provide the first descriptive dual meat-and-milk SNP frequency profile for these crossbred heifers and a molecular baseline for the future development of bioeconomic selection indices in tropical dual-purpose systems. Frequencies are reported at the pooled and department-stratified levels; the results are descriptive and require phenotypic validation before any inference on marker effects or suitability for selection.
papers.abstract_zh: 哥倫比亞加勒比海地區的肉乳兼用型家畜系統（Bos taurus × Bos indicus）是牛奶和牛肉的重要來源，然而針對性狀關聯標記的分子特徵研究仍相當有限。本研究旨在探討來自哥倫比亞加勒比海五個省份的 1585 頭雜交女牛中，29 個與肉質及產乳性狀相關之單核苷酸多型性（SNP）的等位基因及基因型頻率。本研究從毛囊中萃取 DNA，並使用 Axiom™ Bovine 100K 晶片進行基因分型。這些標記涵蓋了與肌肉生長及蛋白質水解（CAPN1、CAST、MSTN）、能量代謝（LEP、DGAT1）以及乳蛋白組成（CSN2、CSN3、PAEP、GH1、GHR、ABC​​G2）相關的基因。哈代－溫堡平衡（HWE）透過卡方檢定進行評估。在這 29 個標記中，有 21 個具多型性且可進行檢定：19 個符合 HWE，2 個偏離（PAEP_239、PAEP_312）。其餘 8 個為單型性。大約 48% 的基因座顯示出極高的有利等位基因頻率（q > 0.99 或 p > 0.99），而 52% 的基因座則維持中等雜合度。CSN3_526 的有利 B 等位基因頻率接近固定（q = 0.996），這與針對起司產量的選育一致，而 CAST_282 和 CAST_2870 則顯示出高雜合度（f(AB) ≈ 0.47–0.48），表明這些基因座仍保有顯著的變異。這些發現提供了這些雜交女牛的首份兼具肉與乳性狀之描述性 SNP 頻率概況，並為未來在熱帶肉乳兼用系統中發展生物經濟選育指數奠定了分子基準。頻率數據分別以合併及分省層級進行報告；本結果具描述性，在對標記效應或選育適宜性進行任何推論之前，尚需進行表現型驗證。

papers.title: Human–Horse Neuromuscular Coordination Across Sequential Conditions During Physical Therapy Utilizing Equine Movement in Parkinson’s Disease
papers.abstract: This exploratory, single-session, repeated-measures study characterized human and equine trunk muscle activity and human–horse EMG covariation during physical therapy utilizing equine movement in individuals with Parkinson’s disease (PD). Nine individuals with PD and three horses completed pre-session quiet sitting (QS Pre), figure-eight riding (F8), stop-and-go riding (SNG), and post-session quiet sitting (QS Post). Bilateral surface EMG was recorded from three human and four equine trunk muscles. All analyses were exploratory and examined four outcomes: normalized EMG amplitude, zero-lag human–horse correlation, lagged human–horse correlation, and human–horse EMG-EMG coherence. Human normalized EMG amplitude did not differ across QS Pre, F8, and SNG. Equine amplitude was greater during F8 than QS Pre (difference 9.43 percentage points, 95% CI [4.27, 14.59]). SNG also showed greater amplitude than QS Pre (5.30 percentage points, 95% CI [0.32, 10.27]), although this difference was not statistically significant in the participant-level sensitivity analysis. F8 exceeded SNG in the direct comparison (4.43 percentage points, 95% CI [1.44, 7.41]) but not in the adjusted three-condition comparison. Zero-lag correlations were generally close to zero; SNG exceeded F8 by only 0.0056 Fisher’s z units (95% CI [0.0004, 0.0107]) in the direct comparison, but this difference was not statistically significant in the adjusted three-condition comparison. When temporal offsets of ±300 ms were permitted, lagged correlation strength was greater during F8 than QS Pre (difference 0.013, 95% CI [0.003, 0.024]) and during SNG than QS Pre (0.011, 95% CI [0.001, 0.021]), with no difference between riding conditions. Median wavelet coherence was greater during QS Pre than F8 (difference 0.016, 95% CI [0.013, 0.018]) or SNG (0.013, 95% CI [0.011, 0.015]), while SNG exceeded F8 overall (0.003, 95% CI [0.002, 0.004]). Simultaneous human and equine EMG was feasible during the sequential mounted conditions, but the observed signal properties differed across outcomes. Because the conditions were administered in a fixed sequence, their individual effects could not be distinguished from order-related influences. These exploratory findings require confirmation in larger studies with counterbalanced task orders, controlled gait characteristics, and relevant clinical outcomes.
papers.abstract_zh: 這項探索性、單次介入、重複測量的研究，旨在探討巴金森氏症（PD）患者在接受利用馬匹動作的物理治療（馬術治療）期間，人類與馬匹軀幹肌肉的活動情形以及人馬肌電圖（EMG）的共變異性。9名巴金森氏症患者與3匹馬完成了介入前的靜坐（QS Pre）、數字「8」字騎乘（F8）、起停騎乘（SNG）以及介入後的靜坐（QS Post）。本研究記錄了3條人類軀幹肌肉與4條馬匹軀幹肌肉的雙側表面肌電圖。所有分析皆屬探索性，並檢視了四項結果：標準化肌電圖振幅、零落後人馬相關性、具落後量之人和馬相關性，以及人馬肌電圖-肌電圖相干性。人類標準化肌電圖振幅在 QS Pre、F8 和 SNG 之間並無差異。F8 期間的馬匹振幅大於 QS Pre（差值為 9.43 個百分點，95% 信賴區間 [4.27, 14.59]）。SNG 的振幅也大於 QS Pre（5.30 個百分點，95% 信賴區間 [0.32, 10.27]），儘管此差異在受試者層級的敏感度分析中未達統計顯著。在直接比較中，F8 超過 SNG（4.43 個百分點，95% 信賴區間 [1.44, 7.41]），但在調整後的3種條件比較中則否。零落後相關性大致接近於零；在直接比較中，SNG 僅以 0.0056 個費雪 z 單位（Fisher’s z units）超過 F8（95% 信賴區間 [0.0004, 0.0107]），但此差異在調整後的3種條件比較中未達統計顯著。當允許 ±300 毫秒的時間偏移時，F8 期間的落後相關強度大於 QS Pre（差值 0.013，95% 信賴區間 [0.003, 0.024]），SNG 期間也大於 QS Pre（0.011，95% 信賴區間 [0.001, 0.021]），而兩種騎乘條件之間則無差異。中位小波相干性在 QS Pre 期間大於 F8（差值 0.016，95% 信賴區間 [0.013, 0.018]）或 SNG（0.013，95% 信賴區間 [0.011, 0.015]），而 SNG 整體大於 F8（0.003，95% 信賴區間 [0.002, 0.004]）。在連續的騎乘條件下，同時記錄人類與馬匹的肌電圖是可行的，但觀察到的訊號特性因評估結果而異。由於這些條件是以固定順序進行施測，因此無法將其個別效應與順序相關的影響區分開來。這些探索性發現尚需透過更大規模、採用平衡任務順序（counterbalanced task orders）、控制步態特徵以及評估相關臨床結果的研究來進一步確認。

papers.title: Impacts of Water Level on Multidimensional Waterbird Diversity in a Wetland of Yangtze River Floodplain: Insights for Conservation
papers.abstract: Anthropogenic hydrological modifications have profoundly altered natural hydrological regimes, which are widely acknowledged as a key driver of waterbird diversity in wetland systems. However, the pathways linking water level to multidimensional waterbird diversity and seasonal variation remain poorly understood, limiting targeted conservation and sustainable wetland management. To address these, based on an annual survey data from Shijiu lake in the Yangtze River Floodplain, we examined the direct and indirect effects of water level on the taxonomic, functional, phylogenetic diversity of waterbirds across annual, wintering, and non-wintering periods. Piecewise structural equation models showed that water level influenced multidimensional waterbird diversity primarily through indirect pathways mediated by local habitat conditions, including water area (WA) and vegetation condition (NDVI). The strength of these indirect pathways differed between the wintering and non-wintering periods. Moreover, generalized additive models revealed seasonally distinct response patterns of multidimensional waterbird diversity to these habitat variables, consistent with the seasonally mediated effects of water level. Overall, our results reveal seasonal differences in waterbird community responses to water level changes. These findings underscore the need for targeted, seasonally responsive hydrological management following future dam construction in lakes and provide practical guidance for waterbird conservation in Shijiu Lake and similar wetland ecosystems.
papers.abstract_zh: 人類活動造成的水文改變已深刻地改變了自然水文情勢，這被普遍認為是濕地生態系統中水鳥多樣性的關鍵驅動因素。然而，將水位與多維度水鳥多樣性及季節變化連結的路徑仍所知有限，從而限制了針對性的保育與永續的濕地管理。為了解決這些問題，本研究基於長江中下游平原石臼湖的年度調查數據，探討了水位對全年、越冬期和非越冬期等不同時期之水鳥分類、功能及演化多樣性的直接與間接影響。分段結構方程模型顯示，水位主要透過以當地棲地條件（包括水域面積與植被狀況）為中介的間接路徑來影響多維度水鳥多樣性。這些間接路徑的強度在越冬期與非越冬期之間有所不同。此外，廣義加法模型揭示了多維度水鳥多樣性對這些棲地變數具有季節差異的響應模式，這與水位受季節調節的影響一致。總體而言，我們的研究結果揭示了水鳥群落對水位變化的季節性差異響應。這些發現強調了在湖泊未來水庫建設後，需要進行具針對性且能因應季節變化的水文管理，並為石臼湖及類似濕地生態系統的水鳥保育提供實務指引。

papers.title: Association of Ruminal Volatile Fatty Acids with Average Daily Gain in Growing Sheep and Goats: A Systematic Review and Meta-Regression Analysis
papers.abstract: This study assessed how ruminal volatile fatty acid (VFA) biomarkers—acetic acid, propionic acid, the acetate-to-propionate ratio (A:P), and total VFA—relate to average daily gain (ADG) in growing sheep and goats, and their added predictive value over covariates. A systematic search identified 84 unique studies (290 treatment groups; complete data: 82 studies, 283 groups). Two analytic strategies were used: inverse-variance-weighted multilevel meta-regression and an unweighted mixed model, adjusting for dry matter intake, initial body weight, crude protein, neutral detergent fiber, and species. Under inverse-variance weighting with cluster-robust inference, acetic acid (β = 0.00088; robust p = 0.003), propionic acid (β = 0.00188; robust p < 0.001), and total VFA (β = 0.00088; robust p < 0.001) were positively related to ADG, whereas A:P was not significant (robust p = 0.074) and behaved inconsistently (p = 0.015). The mixed linear framework gave consistent results (marginal R2 = 0.610–0.642). Leave-one-out cross-validation showed propionic acid gave the largest predictive gain (overall ΔCV-R2 = 0.124, 95% CI 0.012–0.326; RMSE reduced 10.84%). In conclusion, acetic acid, propionic acid, and total VFA are robustly associated with ADG, but their incremental explanatory power is modest; propionic acid offers the largest cross-study predictive increment, whereas A:P is unreliable.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究評估了瘤胃揮發性脂肪酸（VFA）生物標記——乙酸、丙酸、乙酸與丙酸比值（A:P）及總 VFA——與生長期綿羊和山羊平均日增重（ADG）的關係，及其相較於共變數所增加的預測價值。透過系統性文獻檢索，共識別出 84 項獨立研究（290 個處理組；完整資料：82 項研究，283 個處理組）。本研究採用兩種分析策略：反變異數加權多層次統合迴歸以及未加權混合模型，並對乾物質攝取量、初始體重、粗蛋白質、中性洗劑纖維及物種進行調整。在具群聚穩健推論的反變異數加權下，乙酸（β = 0.00088；穩健 p = 0.003）、丙酸（β = 0.00188；穩健 p < 0.001）以及總 VFA（β = 0.00088；穩健 p < 0.001）與 ADG 呈顯著正相關，而 A:P 則無顯著相關（穩健 p = 0.074）且表現不一致（p = 0.015）。混合線性框架得出了一致的結果（邊際 R2 = 0.610–0.642）。留一法交叉驗證顯示，丙酸提供了最大的預測增益（整體 ΔCV-R2 = 0.124，95% CI 0.012–0.326；RMSE 降低 10.84%）。結論顯示，乙酸、丙酸和總 VFA 與 ADG 具有穩健的相關性，但其漸進解釋能力適中；丙酸可提供最大的跨研究預測增量，而 A:P 則不可靠。

papers.title: De Novo Genome Assemblies of Kazakh Horses: Adai, Zhabe, Mugalzhar and Naiman
papers.abstract: Kazakh horses represent an important cultural heritage of the Kazakh people, shaped over thousands of years across the territory of present-day Kazakhstan. Long-term adaptation to extreme natural conditions has led to the development of a unique set of characteristics that ensure the high survivability, ecological plasticity and economic value of these horses. Long- and short-read sequencing was performed for three breeds (Adai, Zhabe, Mugalzhar), while Naiman was sequenced exclusively with nanopore long-read data. The resulting reads were assembled, and the genomes were subsequently annotated. The assembled genomes showed high contiguity with an average contig N50 value of 9.68 Mb (9,681,711 bp) for Adai, Zhabe and Mugalzhar, while the resulting contig N50 was 17.09 Mb (17,090,216 bp) for Naiman, and average assembly length was 2.42 Gb (2,442,471,376 bp). These are individual reference assemblies that establish foundations for future comparative genomics and pangenome development. Gene annotation yielded 19,584, 19,941, 18,695 and 20,572 protein-coding genes for Adai, Zhabe, Mugalzhar and Naiman, respectively. These assemblies complement existing assemblies for future genetic analysis, research into the geographic and breed origins of domestic horses, and breed conservation efforts, and will contribute to ongoing equine pangenome efforts.
papers.abstract_zh: 哈薩克馬是哈薩克族重要的文化遺產，經過數千年來在現今哈薩克領土上的演化而形成。長期對極端自然條件的適應，促使這些馬匹發展出一套獨特的特徵，確保了其高度的生存能力、生態可塑性與經濟價值。本研究對三個品種（阿代馬、札貝馬、穆加爾扎爾馬）進行了長讀長與短讀長定序，而乃蠻馬則僅使用奈米孔長讀長數據進行定序。隨後將所得的讀長進行組裝與基因體註解。組裝後的基因體顯示出高度的連續性，阿代馬、札貝馬和穆加爾扎爾馬的平均重疊群（contig）N50 值為 9.68 Mb（9,681,711 bp），而乃蠻馬的重疊群 N50 值則為 17.09 Mb（17,090,216 bp），平均組裝長度為 2.42 Gb（2,442,471,376 bp）。這些是個體參考基因體組裝，為未來的比較基因體學與泛基因體（pangenome）發展奠定了基礎。經基因註解後，阿代馬、札貝馬、穆加爾扎爾馬和乃蠻馬分別產出 19,584、19,941、18,695 和 20,572 個蛋白質編碼基因。這些基因體組裝互補了現有的組裝成果，有助於未來的遺傳分析、家馬地理與品種起源研究以及品種保育工作，並將促進當前的馬屬泛基因體研究計畫。

papers.title: Retrospective Evaluation of Livestock Monitoring Replay Controllers Under Limited Evidence and Distribution Shift
papers.abstract: Livestock monitoring systems must determine which records to inspect, assess whether the evidence supports an answer, and decide when to abstain. We constructed a retrospective replay benchmark using public MmCows records, with separate animals for development and evaluation. The benchmark included 120 current-state episodes and 62 scripted temporal and history checks from four evaluation cows. Across all 182 episodes, conditional routing used 2.51 stored-record calls per episode, compared with 2.82 for a fixed sequence. Task success was lower (90.11% versus 93.96%), while errors among accepted answers were higher (14/85 versus 2/68, or 16.47% versus 2.94%). Conditional routing did not save calls within the current-state episodes. Requiring two supporting cameras reduced errors and coverage, while the learned policy did not outperform a revisable fixed order. Raw confidence, temperature scaling, and isotonic calibration each retained 24 errors among 940 cases. Exploratory image analyses showed poor transfer to the Cow Behavior Video Dataset 5 (CBVD-5), and personalized forecasts showed no clear advantage over seven-day means. Verification accepted all 31 synthetically constructed correlated errors with valid record structure. The framework identifies limitations in evidence acquisition and verification, while the small number of animals and constructed task mixture limit conclusions about farm-level performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 牲畜監控系統必須決定要檢查哪些紀錄、評估證據是否支援某個答案，以及決定何時應拒絕回答。我們利用公開的 MmCows 紀錄建構了一個回顧性重播基準測試，並將不同的動物分別用於開發與評估。此基準測試包含來自 4 頭評估用牛隻的 120 個現狀情境（episodes），以及 62 個有腳本的時間與歷史檢查。在總共 182 個情境中，條件式路由（conditional routing）每個情境平均使用 2.51 次儲存紀錄呼叫，而固定順序則為 2.82 次。任務成功率較低（90.11% 對比 93.96%），而接受答案中的錯誤率較高（14/85 對比 2/68，即 16.47% 對比 2.94%）。條件式路由並未在現狀情境中減少呼叫次數。要求兩個支援攝影機降低了錯誤率與覆蓋率，而學習得到的策略並未優於可修正的固定順序。原始信賴度、溫度縮放（temperature scaling）與等張校準（isotonic calibration）在 940 個案例中各自保留了 24 個錯誤。探索性影像分析顯示，其向牛隻行為視訊資料集 5（CBVD-5）的遷移效果不佳，且個人化預測相比於七天平均值並未展現出明顯優勢。驗證接受了所有 31 個具備有效紀錄結構、以合成方式建構的相關錯誤。此框架指出了證據獲取與驗證方面的侷限性，而少數的動物數量與建構的任務組合則限制了對農場層級效能的推論。

papers.title: Physiological and Nitrogen Balance Responses of Adult Dogs Fed Diets Containing Different Crude Protein Levels
papers.abstract: This nonrandomized sequential study evaluated nitrogen (N) balance, apparent nutrient digestibility, serum biochemistry, and indoxyl sulfate (IS)-related outcomes in ten healthy adult Beagles. Dogs received the crude protein (CP) 30% formulation for four weeks followed by the CP 18% formulation for four weeks; urine and feces were quantitatively collected during four consecutive days in each period. Analyzed dietary CP concentrations were 31.36% and 19.20% of dry matter. Daily urinary N excretion was lower in the second period (5.60 ± 0.35 vs. 3.34 ± 0.15 g/day; false discovery rate (FDR)-adjusted q < 0.001), as was calculated N balance (2.52 ± 0.39 vs. 1.04 ± 0.14 g N/day; paired p = 0.0022). The N retention percentages were 28.78 ± 4.45% and 20.66 ± 2.81%, respectively (p = 0.077; q = 0.132), and were not demonstrated to be equivalent. Apparent total tract digestibility of CP and most analyzed amino acids was lower in the second period. Exploratory daily urinary IS excretion was 3.08 ± 0.35 and 2.59 ± 0.36 mg/day, respectively (p = 0.394; q = 0.394). The analyzed indispensable amino acid concentrations of both diets met the dietary nutrient profile benchmarks evaluated in this study. However, the formulations differed in ingredients and predicted daily energy intake, and period was completely confounded with feeding order. These observations cannot establish an isolated effect of dietary protein, actual long-term body protein retention, or nutritional equivalence.
papers.abstract_zh: 這項非隨機序列研究評估了十隻健康的成犬之氮（N）平衡、表觀營養素消化率、血清生化學以及硫酸吲哚oxyl（IS）相關指標。犬隻先後接受粗蛋白（CP）30%配方四周，接著接受CP 18%配方四周；在每個時期的連續四天內定量收集尿液與糞便。分析所得的日糧CP濃度分別為乾物質的31.36%與19.20%。第二時期的每日尿氮排泄量較低（5.60 ± 0.35 對比 3.34 ± 0.15 g/天；經偽發現率（FDR）調整之 q < 0.001），計算所得的氮平衡亦然（2.52 ± 0.39 對比 1.04 ± 0.14 g N/天；配對 p = 0.0022）。氮滯留百分比分別為 28.78 ± 4.45% 與 20.66 ± 2.81%（p = 0.077；q = 0.132），且未能證明具等效性。CP及大多數分析胺基酸的表觀全消化道消化率在第二時期較低。探索性每日尿液IS排泄量分別為 3.08 ± 0.35 與 2.59 ± 0.36 mg/天（p = 0.394；q = 0.394）。兩種日糧中經分析的必需胺基酸濃度皆符合本研究評估之日糧營養素規範基準。然而，兩款配方的原料與預估每日能量攝取量有所不同，且時期與餵食順序完全混淆。這些觀察結果無法確立膳食蛋白質的獨立效應、實際的長期體蛋白滯留，或營養上的等效性。

papers.title: An Improved Pigs Weaned per Sow per Year (PSY) Accounting Method Based on Whole-Herd Resource Accounting with Mode-Specific Adaptation for Continuous and Batch Production
papers.abstract: Pigs weaned per sow per year (PSY) is the core indicator used to evaluate sow-herd reproductive efficiency and a key factor affecting production profitability in commercial pig farms. The traditional PSY calculation uses the average inventory of mated (or parous) sows as the denominator and ignores the resource consumption of non-productive inventory, such as unserved gilts and weaned sows awaiting culling, leading to overestimated reproductive efficiency, concealed costs, and misleading management decisions. The overestimation range of 8–15% has been indicative estimates on non-productive days of commercial sow herds, and the improved method achieved a robustness of ≤ 3% based on the validation of basic data from pig farming enterprises involved in this paper. In this study, an improved PSY accounting method was developed based on whole-herd resource accounting. Gilts ≥220 days of age and weaned sows not yet culled were incorporated into the basic sow inventory, a dynamic inventory-time-weighting approach was established, and the method was adaptively optimized for continuous and batch production, with mode-specific formulas, validation cases, and an implementation system. It should be noted that traditional PSY and improved whole-herd PSY measure different quantities: the former reflects reproductive efficiency per mated sow, while the latter reflects resource-weighted reproductive efficiency per unit of resource-weighted sow inventory. Case studies on two commercial pig farms showed that the improved method addressed the structural limitations of the traditional formula, produced PSY values of 20–30 piglets per sow per year, and remained robust to parameter variation, with PSY estimates fluctuating by no more than 3% across the feasible range of w (0.60–0.80) in these two cases, and supports refined on-farm cost accounting and standardized cross-farm comparison, although independent multi-farm validation is still required. This study provides a practical tool for reproductive efficiency assessment and refined management in pig farms.
papers.abstract_zh: 每母豬年離乳ن仔豬數（PSY）是用於評估母豬群繁殖效率的核心指標，也是影響商業豬場生產獲利能力的關鍵因素。傳統的PSY計算以已配種（或已產仔）母豬的平均存欄量作為分母，忽略了未配種後備母豬及待淘汰離乳母豬等非生產存欄的資源消耗，導致繁殖效率被高估、成本被掩蓋，並誤導管理決策。根據商業母豬群非生產天數的指示性估算，高估幅度約在8–15%之間，而本研究根據參與之養豬企業的基礎數據驗證，改進後的方法達到了≤ 3%的穩健性。本研究基於全群資源會計，開發了一種改進的PSY核算方法。該方法將日齡≥220天的後備母豬與尚未淘汰的離乳母豬納入基礎母豬存欄中，建立了動態存欄時間加權方法，並針對連續式與分批次生產進行了適應性優化，提供了模式專屬公式、驗證案例及實施系統。需要注意的是，傳統PSY與改進的全納入式全群PSY衡量的是不同的量：前者反映每頭已配種母豬的繁殖效率，而後者反映每單位資源加權母豬存欄的資源加權繁殖效率。對兩個商業豬場的案例研究表明，改進的方法解決了傳統公式的結構性限制，產出的PSY值為每母豬每年20–30頭仔豬，且對參數變異保持穩健，在這兩個案例中，PSY估算值在w的可行範圍（0.60–0.80）內的波動不超过3%，並支援場內精細化成本會計與跨場標準化比較，儘管仍需要進行獨立的多場驗證。本研究為豬場繁殖效率評估與精細化管理提供了一個實用工具。

papers.title: Development and Preliminary Evaluation of a Serum Blocking ELISA for the Detection of PEDV Antibodies and Assessment of Its Association with Neutralizing Antibody Titers
papers.abstract: Porcine epidemic diarrhea virus (PEDV), the etiological agent of porcine epidemic diarrhea (PED), remains a major threat to swine production worldwide. The genetic variation and the co-circulation of multiple genotypes of this virus may compromise vaccine-induced protection, creating an urgent need for practical serological tools for herd-level monitoring. A blocking enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (blocking ELISA) was developed using a recombinant truncated PEDV S1 protein as the coating antigen and a horseradish peroxidase (HRP)-labeled anti-PEDV S1 monoclonal antibody as the competing detector. No cross-reactivity was detected with the tested antisera against porcine reproductive and respiratory syndrome virus (PRRSV), pseudorabies virus (PRV), classical swine fever virus (CSFV), or porcine circovirus type 2 (PCV2). The intra-assay and inter-assay coefficients of variation were 3.02% and 3.76%, respectively. Receiver operating characteristic analysis yielded an optimal cutoff of 31.76%, with a sensitivity of 98% and a specificity of 99%. Among 33 clinical serum samples, blocking-ELISA classifications were fully concordant with infected-cell indirect immunofluorescence assay (IFA) results (33/33, 100%), which were interpreted as a measure of general PEDV seroreactivity. Comparison with virus neutralization testing of 98 sera showed category-specific concordance rates of 81.25%, 90.91%, and 100% for neutralizing antibody titers of 1:64, 1:128, and ≥1:256, respectively. All sera in the ≤1:16 category were negative by blocking ELISA. A continuous correlation analysis between the blocking percentage and neutralizing antibody titer was performed (ρ = 0.484, 95% CI 0.315–0.623, p = 5.1 × 10−7; n = 97). Compared to traditional neutralization tests, this method features simpler operation, faster detection, and higher efficiency, rendering it suitable for large-scale monitoring of vaccine efficacy in swine herds and offering robust technical support for precise evaluation of PEDV immunity.
papers.abstract_zh: 豬流行性下痢病毒（Porcine epidemic diarrhea virus, PEDV）為豬流行性下痢（PED）之病原，對全球養豬產業構成重大威脅。該病毒的基因變異及多種基因型的共同流行可能會降低疫苗誘導之保護力，因此迫切需要用於豬群監控之實用血清學工具。本研究利用重組截短型 PEDV S1 蛋白作為包被抗原，並以辣根過氧化酶（HRP）標記之抗 PEDV S1 單株抗體作為競爭性檢測抗體，開發了一種阻斷型酵素接合免疫吸附分析法（blocking ELISA）。經檢測，該方法與豬繁殖與呼吸綜合症病毒（PRRSV）、假性狂犬病病毒（PRV）、傳統豬瘟病毒（CSFV）或第二型豬圓環病毒（PCV2）之陽性抗血清均無交叉反應。批內與批間變異係數分別為 3.02% 與 3.76%。受試者工作特性曲線分析顯示，最佳截斷值為 31.76%，敏感性為 98%，特異性為 99%。在 33 件臨床血清樣本中，blocking-ELISA 的判定結果與感染細胞間接免疫螢光試驗（IFA）之結果完全一致（33/33, 100%），後者被用作評估整體 PEDV 血清反應性之指標。與 98 件血清之病毒中和試驗比較顯示，當中和抗體效價分別為 1:64、1:128 及 ≥1:256 時，其類別專一性的一致率分別為 81.25%、90.91% 及 100%。≤1:16 類別的所有血清以 blocking ELISA 檢測均呈陰性。對阻斷百分比與中和抗體效價進行連續相關性分析（ρ = 0.484, 95% CI 0.315–0.623, p = 5.1 × 10−7; n = 97）。相較於傳統中和試驗，此方法具有操作簡便、檢測快速及效率高等特點，適合用於大規模監測豬群之疫苗效力，並為精準評估 PEDV 免疫力提供強而有力的技術支援。

papers.title: Adjuvant Interstitial Yttrium-90 Hydrogel (IsoPet®) Following Limb-Sparing Marginal Excision of Multifocal Distal Pelvic-Limb Neoplasia in a Dog
papers.abstract: Background: Achieving complete surgical margins can be challenging for tumors involving the distal extremities due to limited surrounding soft tissue and the proximity of functionally important structures. Incompletely excised tumors may require adjuvant radiation therapy to treat suspected residual microscopic disease. Yttrium-90 phosphate hydrogel (IsoPet®) is an emerging injectable radiation modality that delivers localized beta radiation to a tumor bed or surgical margin. Case Description: An eight-year-old neutered male Bullmastiff was evaluated by the referring veterinarian for firm subcutaneous masses developed along the right pelvic limb. Fine-needle aspiration was initially suggestive of an inflammatory process; however, subsequent punch biopsies identified Grade II soft tissue sarcoma. The patient was referred for surgical oncology evaluation. Four right pelvic limb masses and the right popliteal lymph node were surgically excised. Histopathological examination of the excisional specimens identified poorly differentiated carcinoma involving the excised masses, with metastatic involvement of the right popliteal lymph node and incomplete surgical margins. Adjuvant Y-90 hydrogel was elected following complete surgical wound healing. On 20 November 2025, 8.46 mCi (313 MBq) of Y-90 phosphate hydrogel in a total volume of 4.7 mL was administered through 66 peri-incisional and incisional injections distributed across the previous right pelvic limb surgical beds using a grid-based technique. The procedure was completed without complications. Post-treatment follow-up demonstrated satisfactory wound healing, with only mild transient appetite reduction and minimal localized tissue irritation. After surgery plus adjuvant Y-90, no clinically detectable local recurrence was identified at the treatment sites during the 120-day documented follow-up period. Seventy-four days following Y-90 hydrogel treatment, computed tomography performed for persistent otic disease identified an aggressive osteolytic lesion involving the right C5 vertebra with extradural spinal cord compression. The relationship between this lesion and the previously treated pelvic limb neoplasia could not be definitively established. Despite the subsequent development of this cervical lesion, no clinically detectable recurrence was documented at the original treatment limb sites. This finding is an observation after combined surgery and Y-90, not evidence of Y-90-specific efficacy. The patient was subsequently managed supportively and was euthanized by the referring veterinarian approximately four months after identification of the cervical lesion. Conclusion: This single case demonstrates that peri-incisional Y-90 phosphate hydrogel could be administered to multiple distal pelvic-limb surgical beds after limb-sparing excision. The procedure was well tolerated. No clinically detectable local recurrence was identified at the treated sites during the 120-day documented follow-up period. Because gross disease had already been removed and there was no comparator, these observations cannot establish the independent efficacy of IsoPet®. Prospective studies are needed.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：由於周圍軟組織有限以及鄰近具功能重要性的結構，針對侵犯遠端肢體的腫瘤要達到完全的手術邊界可能具有挑戰性。切除不完全的腫瘤可能需要輔助放射治療來治療疑似殘存的顯微病灶。釔-90磷酸氫膠（IsoPet®）是一種新興的可注射放射治療方式，可將局部的貝塔射線遞送至腫瘤床或手術邊界。病例描述：一隻八歲絕育雄性牛頭獒犬因右後肢出現堅硬的皮下腫塊而由轉診獸醫師進行評估。細針抽吸最初顯示可能為發炎過程；然而，隨後的punch切片（punch biopsies）確認為II級軟組織肉瘤。病患被轉診進行外科腫瘤學評估。手術切除了四個右後肢腫塊及右膕動脈淋巴結。切除標本的組織病理學檢查顯示切除之腫塊為低分化癌，右膕動脈淋巴結有轉移侵犯且手術邊界不完全。在手術傷口完全癒合後，選擇接受輔助性Y-90氫膠治療。於2025年11月20日，透過網格狀技術（grid-based technique），在先前的右後肢手術床分佈進行66次切口周圍及切口內注射，投予總體積為4.7 mL、劑量達8.46 mCi (313 MBq)的Y-90磷酸氫膠。手術過程順利完成，無併發症。治療後追蹤顯示傷口癒合良好，僅有輕微暫時性食慾減退及極輕微的局部組織刺激。在手術加輔助性Y-90治療後的120天記錄追蹤期內，治療部位未發現臨床上可檢測到的局部復發。在Y-90氫膠治療後第74天，因持續的耳部疾病進行電腦斷層掃描，發現一個侵襲性骨溶解病灶侵犯右側第五頸椎（C5）並伴隨硬膜外脊髓壓迫。此病灶與先前治療的後肢腫瘤之間的關係無法明確建立。儘管隨後出現了此頸椎病灶，但在原治療的肢體部位並未記錄到臨床上可檢測到的復發。此發現為結合手術與Y-90治療後的觀察結果，並非Y-90特定療效之證據。病患隨後接受支持性療法，並在識別出頸椎病灶後約四個月由轉診獸醫師實施安樂死。結論：此單一病例顯示，在進行保留肢體切除術後，切口周圍Y-90磷酸氫膠可施用於多個遠端後肢手術床。此程序耐受性良好。在記錄的120天追蹤期內，於治療部位未發現臨床上可檢測到的局部復發。由於肉眼可見的病灶已被移除且缺乏對照組，這些觀察結果無法確立IsoPet®的獨立療效。仍需進行前瞻性研究。

papers.title: A Multi-Object Tracking Method for Pigs Based on Oriented Bounding Box Detection
papers.abstract: To address background redundancy in detection boxes and identity switches caused by variable body orientations, mutual occlusion, and high appearance similarity among group-housed pigs, a multi-object tracking method based on oriented bounding box detection was proposed to improve the accuracy of pig detection and trajectory association in farming environments. First, YOLO11m-OBB was adopted as the baseline detector. Its original backbone was replaced with EfficientViT-M0, and a dual-teacher knowledge distillation framework based on the DINOv3 vision foundation model was constructed, resulting in a lightweight pig detection model named PIG-YOLO. Second, an AdaptiveSORT tracking algorithm was developed within the tracking-by-detection framework. Camera motion compensation, adaptive state prediction, and multi-scale feature extraction modules were incorporated into the multi-object tracking process, together with a three-stage association strategy and a dedicated track management mechanism. Finally, detection, tracking, and cross-dataset generalization experiments were conducted using both public and self-collected pig video datasets. PIG-YOLO achieved a precision of 94.7%, a recall of 88.3%, an mAP50 of 93.1%, and an mAP50–95 of 85.6%, representing improvements of 3.7, 9.9, 8.0, and 8.9 percentage points over the baseline model, respectively. Meanwhile, the number of parameters, floating-point operations, and model size were reduced by 37.7%, 51.5%, and 36.2%, respectively. On the public test dataset, the combination of PIG-YOLO and AdaptiveSORT achieved HOTA, MOTA, and IDF1 scores of 96.32%, 98.82%, and 99.41%, respectively. On the private dataset, the corresponding scores were 94.98%, 97.31%, and 98.86%. In the cross-dataset generalization experiment, the proposed method achieved HOTA, MOTA, and IDF1 scores of 71.231%, 76.043%, and 83.008%, respectively, outperforming the other comparative tracking algorithms in overall performance. The proposed method reduces the computational complexity of the detection model while improving the accuracy of pig detection and the stability of trajectory association. It therefore provides technical support for pig behavior analysis and intelligent monitoring in large-scale pig farms.
papers.abstract_zh: 針對群養豬隻因身體朝向多變、互相遮擋以及外觀高度相似而導致檢測框背景冗餘與身分切換等問題，本研究提出了一種基於導向邊界框檢測的多物件追蹤方法，以提升養殖環境中豬隻檢測與軌跡關聯的準確性。首先，採用 YOLO11m-OBB 作為基礎檢測器，將其原始骨幹網路替換為 EfficientViT-M0，並建構基於 DINOv3 視覺基礎模型的雙教師知識蒸餾框架，從而得到一個名為 PIG-YOLO 的輕量化豬隻檢測模型。其次，在檢測驅動追蹤（tracking-by-detection）框架下開發了 AdaptiveSORT 追蹤演算法，將相機運動補償、自適應狀態預測和多尺度特徵萃取模組納入多物件追蹤流程中，並結合三階段關聯策略與專屬的軌跡管理機制。最後，利用公開與自行收集的豬隻影片資料集進行檢測、追蹤以及跨資料集泛化實驗。PIG-YOLO 的精確率達 94.7%、召回率達 88.3%、mAP50 達 93.1%、mAP50–95 達 85.6%，分別比基礎模型提升了 3.7、9.9、8.0 與 8.9 個百分點。同時，參數量、浮點運算數與模型大小分別減少了 37.7%、51.5% 與 36.2%。在公開測試資料集上，PIG-YOLO 與 AdaptiveSORT 的結合取得了 96.32% 的 HOTA、98.82% 的 MOTA 以及 99.41% 的 IDF1 分數；在私有資料集上，相應的分數則為 94.98%、97.31% 與 98.86%。在跨資料集泛化實驗中，所提方法的 HOTA、MOTA 與 IDF1 分數分別達到 71.231%、76.043% 與 83.008%，整體效能優於其他對比追蹤演算法。本方法在降低檢測模型計算複雜度的同時，提升了豬隻檢測的準確性與軌跡關聯的穩定性，從而為大規模豬場的豬隻行為分析與智慧化監控提供了技術支援。

papers.title: Testicular and Rumen Microbial Responses to Selenium-Enriched Malt in Heat-Exposed Simmental Bulls
papers.abstract: This study evaluated testicular and rumen microbial responses to selenium-enriched malt in heat-exposed Simmental bulls. Eighteen bulls received a basal diet alone or supplemented to provide target supplemental Se levels of 0.3 or 0.5 mg/kg dietary DM. Metagenomics included six bulls per group, host assays four per group, and RNA sequencing three per group. Compared with controls, the high-dose group had higher serum antioxidant indices and reproductive hormone concentrations, lower inflammatory markers, higher Johnsen scores, and lower TUNEL positivity. Gene-level FDR control identified 23, 1, and 4 differentially expressed genes in the low-dose versus control, high-dose versus control, and high-dose versus low-dose contrasts, respectively. Provider-reported GSEA showed negative normalized enrichment scores for steroid biosynthesis in the control-versus-low-dose and control-versus-high-dose contrasts, indicating enrichment toward the supplemented side under the provider’s contrast convention. qPCR showed lower CYP11A1, CYP17A1, SCARB1, and LDLR expression at the low dose, whereas Bax, Bcl-2, and CYP17A1 protein abundance did not differ. Rumen microbial diversity and community composition differed among groups, and two post hoc selected cofactor-related pathways had lower abundance at the low dose. None of the 160 microbiome–testis or 720 microbiome–serum associations survived FDR correction. Supplementation was associated with favorable systemic and testicular histological responses and dose-specific molecular and microbial changes under heat exposure.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究評估了熱應激西門塔爾公牛對富硒麥芽的睪丸及瘤胃微生物反應。十八頭公牛僅食用基礎飼料，或在基礎飼料中補充目標補充硒濃度為每公斤乾物質 0.3 或 0.5 毫克的飼糧。總體基因體學分析每組包含六頭公牛，宿主分析每組四頭，RNA 定序每組三頭。與對照組相比，高劑量組具有較高的血清抗氧化指標與生殖荷爾蒙濃度、較低的發炎標記、較高的約翰森評分（Johnsen scores）以及較低的 TUNEL 陽性率。基因層級的偽陽性率（FDR）控制在低劑量對照組、高劑量對照組，以及高劑量對低劑量對比中，分別識別出 23 個、1 個和 4 個差異表現基因。廠商報告的基因設集富集分析（GSEA）顯示，在對照組對低劑量組及對照組對高劑量組的對比中，類固醇生合成呈現負的標準化富集分數，依據廠商的對比慣例，表明其朝向補充組富集。qPCR 顯示低劑量組的 CYP11A1、CYP17A1、SCARB1 和 LDLR 表現量較低，而 Bax、Bcl-2 和 CYP17A1 蛋白質豐度則無差異。瘤胃微生物多樣性與群落組成在各組間有所不同，且兩個事後選定的輔因子相關路徑在低劑量組的豐度較低。在 160 個微生物群－睪丸或 720 個微生物群－血清關聯中，沒有任何一個能通過 FDR 校正。在熱應激下，補充硒與良好的全身及睪丸組織學反應，以及劑量特異性的分子與微生物變化有關。

papers.title: Superimposed Intramammary Infection with Staphylococcus hominis Under Different Pre-Existing Infection Conditions in Bovine Udder: Bacterial Dynamics, Inflammatory Response and Oxidative Stress
papers.abstract: Microbial interactions control mammary gland inflammation and disease severity. This study examined bacterial dynamics, inflammatory responses, and oxidative stress following Staphylococcus hominis (SH) superinfection in cows with chronic subclinical mastitis. Mammary quarters were assigned to varying SH doses: COW1 received 106 and 105 CFU/mL (two quarters each); COW2 received 106 CFU/mL (two quarters) and PBS control (one quarter); COW3 received 104 and 105 CFU/mL (two quarters each); and COW4 received 104 CFU/mL (two quarters). On Day 0, quarters received 5 mL of their assigned preparations. Milk and clinical parameters were evaluated during a pre-challenge baseline and monitored for 8 days post-inoculation. Results showed post-infection mastitis severity depended heavily on prior infections. SH alone functioned as a mild pathogen, inducing short-term inflammation with elevated somatic cell counts and IL-6 levels primarily on Days 1 to 3, but did not independently cause severe tissue damage. The intense immune response, elevated malondialdehyde (MDA) levels, and severe tissue damage were primarily driven by pre-existing major mastitis pathogens. Although S. hominis is inherently a mild pathogen, high bacterial loads synergistically exacerbate oxidative stress and clinical mastitis symptoms in co-infected quarters.
papers.abstract_zh: 微生物交互作用會調控乳房發炎與疾病嚴重程度。本研究探討罹患慢性亞臨床乳房炎之乳牛經人型葡萄球菌（Staphylococcus hominis, SH）重複感染後，其細菌動態、發炎反應與氧化壓力之變化。乳房分區分別接種不同劑量的 SH：COW1 接種 $10^6$ 與 $10^5$ CFU/mL（各兩個分區）；COW2 接種 $10^6$ CFU/mL（兩個分區）及 PBS 對照組（一個分區）；COW3 接種 $10^4$ 與 $10^5$ CFU/mL（各兩個分區）；COW4 接種 $10^4$ CFU/mL（兩個分區）。於第 0 天，各乳房分區注入 5 mL 指定之製劑。於攻毒前的基準期評估乳汁與臨床參數，並在接種後監測 8 天。結果顯示，感染後的乳房炎嚴重程度極大程度取決於先前的感染狀況。單獨的 SH 屬於輕度病原體，主要在第 1 至 3 天引發短暫發炎，伴隨體細胞數與介白素-6（IL-6）濃度升高，但不會單獨造成嚴重的組織損傷。強烈的免疫反應、丙二醛（MDA）濃度升高以及嚴重的組織損傷，主要由先前存在的重大乳房炎病原體所驅動。儘管人型葡萄球菌本質上屬於輕度病原體，但高菌量會在共同感染的分區中產生協同作用，加劇氧化壓力與臨床乳房炎症狀。

papers.title: Microbial Functional Carriers and Metabolic Background Associated with Natural Musk Quality in Forest Musk Deer
papers.abstract: Whether differences in natural musk quality are associated with identifiable microbial ecological and metabolic configurations remains unclear, as studies integrating phenotype, community composition, functional sources, and non-muscone metabolic background are lacking. In this study, integrated metagenomic and GC–MS/LC–MS analyses were conducted on six natural musk samples from forest musk deer on a single farm, categorized into low-quality-associated (S1, S2, and S6) and high-quality-associated (S3, S4, and S5) groups. The two groups exhibited phenotypic differentiation in muscone, moisture, and sensory characteristics. Genus-level composition revealed quality-associated consortia with individual heterogeneity. KEGG Level 3 pathway decomposition into taxonomic carriers showed that similar functional potential could be achieved across genera, particularly lipid, ketone-body, and terpenoid pathways. After excluding muscone, candidate features related to lipid/membrane components, sterols, macrocyclic ketones, and volatiles changed coordinately along the quality axis. These results outline a multi-omics evidence chain of “phenotypic differentiation–consortium reorganization–functional carrier redistribution–background metabolic remodeling”, in which the identity of the organisms carrying each function provides an additional explanatory layer beyond total pathway abundance. This exploratory cross-sectional study provides testable hypotheses on the quality-associated ecological–metabolic organization of natural musk and targets for subsequent mechanistic validation.
papers.abstract_zh: 天然麝香品質差異是否與可識別的微生物生態及代謝構型有關尚不清楚，因為目前缺乏整合表型、群落組成、功能來源以及非麝酮代謝背景的研究。本研究對來自單一養殖場的六個林麝天然麝香樣品進行了整合巨基因體學與 GC–MS/LC–MS 分析，這些樣品被分為低品質相關組（S1、S2 和 S6）與高品質相關組（S3、S4 和 S5）。這兩組在麝酮、水分和感官特徵上展現出表型分化。屬級組成顯示出與品質相關的共生群落，並具備個體異質性。將 KEGG 第三級路徑分解至分類學載體表明，跨屬之間可以實現相似的功能潛力，特別是在脂質、酮體和萜類路徑方面。在排除麝酮後，與脂質/膜成分、固醇、大環酮和揮發性物質相關的候選特徵沿著品質軸呈現協同變化。這些結果勾勒出「表型分化–群落重組–功能載體重新分佈–背景代謝重塑」的多體學證據鏈，其中承載各功能的生物體身分，提供了超出總路徑豐度的額外解釋層面。這項探索性橫斷面研究為天然麝香品質相關的生態-代謝組織提供了可檢驗的假說，並為後續的機制驗證提供了標的。

papers.title: Point-of-Care Testing for Aquatic Animal Disease Diagnosis: A Socio-Technical Review of Technologies Enabling Sustainable Aquaculture and Blue Food Security
papers.abstract: Disease outbreaks are among the principal constraints on the sustainability of global aquaculture, yet diagnostic capacity remains concentrated in centralized laboratories far from the point of production. Point-of-care testing (POCT)—immunochromatographic strips, isothermal amplification (LAMP, RPA/RAA), CRISPR-Cas assays, microfluidics and biosensors—can compress the diagnosis-to-intervention window from days to about an hour. This structured narrative review draws on a documented search of the Web of Science Core Collection, Scopus, PubMed and the China National Knowledge Infrastructure (2000–2026), with explicit inclusion criteria and a three-tier evidence-grading scheme (Section Review Methodology and Evidence Grading). We synthesize the evidence in the following three tiers: the technical landscape, comparing eight representative platform classes on sensitivity, turnaround, instrument dependence and deployment maturity; the application geography, tracing how POCT has entered pond-side screening, hatchery biosecurity, border inspection of live aquatic trade and IoT-based surveillance networks across East Asian freshwater, Indo-Pacific shrimp and North Atlantic salmonid systems, with markedly uneven evidence of routine adoption; and the bottlenecks that determine whether analytical performance becomes a sustainability outcome—sample-matrix interference, cold-chain dependence, the absence of unified field-performance standards (with WOAH diagnostic-kit registration suspended from May 2024 to May 2027), ambiguous legal status of POCT results, and smallholder affordability. Adopting a sustainability-transition perspective, we argue that the binding constraint is no longer assay chemistry but socio-technical governance, and that POCT should be positioned as enabling infrastructure for antimicrobial stewardship (SDG 3), loss avoidance and trade resilience (SDG 2/12), and aquatic ecosystem protection (SDG 14). We close with coordinated action imperatives for researchers, standard setters, policymakers and industry, including field-validation-first study designs and use of the 2024–2027 standards window to establish graded performance claims for on-site aquatic diagnostics.
papers.abstract_zh: 疾病爆發是全球水產養殖永續發展的主要制約因素之一，然而診斷能力仍然集中在遠離生產現場的中央實驗室。即時檢驗（POCT）——包含免疫層析試紙、恆溫擴增技術（LAMP、RPA/RAA）、CRISPR-Cas 分析、微流體與生物感測器——能將從診斷到介入的時間從數天縮短至約一小時。本結構化敘述性文獻回顧基於對 Web of Science 核心合集、Scopus、PubMed 以及中國知網（CNKI）的文獻檢索（2000–2026），設定了明確的納入標準與三級證據評分機制（見「回顧方法學與證據評分」章節）。我們將證據綜合成以下三個層次：技術格局，比較八類具代表性平台的靈敏度、週轉時間、儀器依賴性與部署成熟度；應用地域，追蹤 POCT 如何進入東亞淡水、印度洋-太平洋蝦類及北大西洋鮭魚養殖系統中的池邊篩檢、孵化場生物安全、活體水產貿易邊境檢驗以及基於物聯網（IoT）的監測網路，但常規採納的證據呈現明顯的不均衡；以及決定分析效能能否轉化為永續成果的瓶頸——樣品基質干擾、對冷鏈的依賴、缺乏統一的現場效能標準（世界動物衛生組織 [WOAH] 診斷試劑盒註冊自 2024 年 5 月起至 2027 年 5 月暫停）、POCT 結果的法律地位模糊，以及小農的負擔能力。從永續轉型的視角出發，我們認為關鍵限制已不再是分析化學，而是社會技術治理，且 POCT 應被定位為促進抗菌素管理（目標 3）、減少損失與增強貿易韌性（目標 2/12）以及保護水生生態系統（目標 14）的賦能基礎設施。最後，我們針對研究人員、標準制定者、政策制定者和產業界提出協同行動要點，包括優先進行現場驗證的研究設計，以及利用 2024–2027 年的標準空窗期，為現場水產診斷建立分級效能宣告。

papers.title: Adapting Old Tools for the Reality of the Southern Hemisphere: SNP Panels for Local Parentage Assignment in Small Ruminant Breeds from Brazil
papers.abstract: This study evaluated species-specific 96-SNP panels for parentage assignment in Brazilian sheep and goats using genotypes from 1481 animals, generated with the EMBRAPA Multispecies 65K Illumina Infinium 1 chip. Panels were selected under strict quality control (minor allele frequency ≥ 0.30) and compared with published panels and full species-specific datasets. Evaluation included confirmed trios (84 sheep, 95 goats) and independent simulation sets (357 sheep, 117 goats). Under the P2 parentage-exclusion scenario, in which the second parent’s genotype is unknown, the panels achieved a cumulative probability of exclusion (CPE) of 0.9999 using ≤70 SNPs in sheep and ≤72 in goats. They showed higher heterozygosity and polymorphic information content than random subsets and published reference panels (Holm-adjusted p < 0.0001), whereas differences from the full species-specific datasets varied. In empirical trio validation, observed parentage assignment success at the 95% confidence level was 96.43% in sheep and 95.80% in goats, comparable to larger panels. These findings support the potential utility of the panels for parentage assignment. As all markers are present on the multispecies BeadChip, they can be extracted from existing genotyping datasets, potentially reducing additional genotyping requirements and computational burden. Further validation across broader genetic backgrounds and complex pedigree scenarios is recommended before large-scale implementation.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究評估了針對巴西綿羊與山羊親子鑑定之物種專屬 96-SNP 基因型面板，使用透過 EMBRAPA 多物種 65K Illumina Infinium 1 晶片所產生的 1481 個動物基因型資料。面板是在嚴格的品質控制下（次要等位基因頻率 $\ge 0.30$）進行挑選，並與已發表之面板及完整的物種專屬資料集進行比較。評估內容包含已確認的三親組合（84 隻綿羊、95 隻山羊）以及獨立的模擬資料集（357 隻綿羊、117 隻山羊）。在第二親代基因型未知的 P2 親子排除情境下，綿羊使用 $\le 70$ 個 SNP、山羊使用 $\le 72$ 個 SNP 即達到 0.9999 的累積排除機率（CPE）。與隨機子集及已發表之參考面板相比，這些面板顯示出較高的雜合度與多型性資訊含量（Holm 調整後 $p < 0.0001$，而與完整物種專屬資料集的差異則有所不同。在經驗三親組合驗證中，在 95% 信賴水準下，觀察到的親子鑑定成功率在綿羊為 96.43%，在山羊為 95.80%，與較大面板相當。這些發現支持了這些面板應用於親子鑑定的潛在效用。由於所有標記皆存在於多物種 BeadChip 上，因此可從現有的基因型資料集中萃取出來，從而有可能降低額外的基因型檢測需求與計算負擔。在進行大規模實施之前，建議針對更廣泛的遺傳背景與複雜的譜系情境進行進一步的驗證。

papers.title: Transcriptome Profiling of lncRNA in Mammary Tissue of Dairy Cows With Escherichia coli ‐Induced Mastitis
papers.abstract: Mastitis in dairy cows is a complex disease regulated by a series of gene networks. However, the expression patterns and molecular roles of long non‐coding RNAs (lncRNAs) in the mammary glands of mastitic dairy cows remain unclear. In this study, an Escherichia coli ( E. coli )‐induced mastitis model was established, and RNA‐seq was employed to profile lncRNA expression and identify differentially expressed genes in the mammary glands of healthy and E. coli ‐induced mastitis dairy cows. A total of 44 up‐regulated and 111 down‐regulated differentially expressed lncRNAs (DE‐lncRNAs) were identified in the mammary tissues of E. coli ‐induced mastitis dairy cows compared to healthy controls. Functional annotation and interaction network analysis revealed that eight DE‐lncRNAs (TCONS_00077660, TCONS_00020252, TCONS_00042123, TCONS_00104816, TCONS_00111594, TCONS_00057669, TCONS_00084031, and TCONS_00076361) were predicted to be associated with 61 miRNAs and nine mRNAs ( BOLA , PPP3R1 , MAPKAPK2 , NECTIN2 , C3AR1 , JSP.1 , SERPINF2 , ITGAM , and PIM1 ), potentially providing insights into the molecular mechanisms associated with mastitis. These findings enhance our understanding of the molecular regulatory network underlying dairy cow mastitis and provide a theoretical foundation for future molecular breeding and biotherapeutic strategies for mastitis prevention and treatment.
papers.abstract_zh: 乳牛乳房炎是一種由一系列基因網路所調控的複雜疾病。然而，長鏈非編碼 RNA（lncRNAs）在罹患乳房炎乳牛乳腺中的表現模式與分子角色仍不清楚。本研究建立了大腸桿菌（*Escherichia coli*）誘發的乳房炎模型，並利用 RNA-seq 分析健康與大腸桿菌誘發乳房炎乳牛乳腺中的 lncRNA 表現圖譜，同時識別差異表現基因。與健康對照組相比，在大腸桿菌誘發乳房炎乳牛的乳腺組織中，共鑑定出 44 個顯著上調及 111 個顯著下調的差異表現 lncRNA（DE-lncRNAs）。功能註解與交互作用網路分析顯示，預測有 8 個 DE-lncRNA（TCONS_00077660、TCONS_00020252、TCONS_00042123、TCONS_00104816、TCONS_00111594、TCONS_00057669、TCONS_00084031 及 TCONS_00076361）與 61 個 miRNA 和 9 個 mRNA（BOLA、PPP3R1、MAPKAPK2、NECTIN2、C3AR1、JSP.1、SERPINF2、ITGAM 及 PIM1）相關，這可能為乳房炎相關的分子機制提供深入見解。這些發現加深了我們對乳牛乳房炎潛在分子調控網路的理解，並為未來乳房炎預防與治療的分子育種及生物治療策略提供了理論基礎。

papers.title: Dietary Methionine-Induced Changes in the Gut Microbiota Are Associated with Immunity and Reproductive Physiological Profiles in Plateau Pika (Ochotona curzoniae)
papers.abstract: Rapid population increases in degraded habitats have been reported for the plateau pika (Ochotona curzoniae)—a small burrowing lagomorph endemic to the Qinghai–Tibet Plateau—challenging the ecological balance of alpine meadow ecosystems. Although previous studies have indicated that high-protein and sulfur-containing amino acid (particularly methionine) intake in degraded habitats may drive this expansion, whether methionine modulates the physiology of plateau pikas through the gut microbiota remains unclear. This study investigates the effects of dietary methionine on the gut microbiota, immunity, and reproductive physiological profiles in plateau pikas through controlled feeding and fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) experiments. The results show that a high-methionine diet significantly enhanced cellular immunity in both sexes and humoral immunity in males, reduced the intensity of coccidian infection, and elevated GnRH, estradiol, progesterone, and testosterone levels. Microbiota analysis reveals that, while the dietary content of methionine does not alter the α-diversity of the gut microbiota, it does significantly affect the β-diversity, with enrichment of the genera Alistipes, Prevotella, and Prevotellaceae_UCG-001 observed in the high-methionine diet group. Fecal microbiota transplantation from high-methionine diet group pikas increased the relative abundances of Alistipes and Prevotella in female and male recipients, respectively. In parallel, these microbial shifts were accompanied by increased cellular immunity in both sexes and humoral immunity in males, reduced coccidian infection, and increased male reproductive traits. In contrast, female recipients showed no significant changes in reproductive traits. Metagenomic functional annotation showed that functional pathways involved in energy, amino acid metabolism, and carbohydrate metabolism exhibited lower abundance in female recipients, while those involved in amino acid and lipid metabolism exhibited higher abundance in male recipients following microbiota transplantation from high-methionine diet group donor pikas. Collectively, these findings suggest that improvements in immunity and reproductive physiological profiles induced by a high-methionine diet may partially contribute to the abundances of specific gut microbial taxa in plateau pikas.
papers.abstract_zh: 研究指出，棲息於退化棲地中的高原鼠兔（*Ochotona curzoniae*）數量急劇增加，這是一種青藏高原特有的小型穴居兔形目動物，對高山草甸生態系統的生態平衡造成了挑戰。儘管先前的研究表明，在退化棲地中攝取高蛋白與含硫胺素（特別是甲硫胺酸）可能是驅動這種族群擴張的原因，但甲硫胺酸是否透過腸道菌相來調節高原鼠兔的生理機能尚不清楚。本研究透過控制餵食與糞便微生物移植（FMT）實驗，探討飲食中的甲硫胺酸對高原鼠兔腸道菌相、免疫力及生殖生理特徵的影響。結果顯示，高甲硫胺酸飲食顯著增強了兩性動物的細胞免疫力以及雄性動物的體液免疫力，降低了球蟲感染強度，並提高了促性腺激素釋放激素（GnRH）、雌二醇、黃體素和睪固酮的濃度。菌相分析顯示，雖然飲食中的甲硫胺酸含量不會改變腸道菌相的α多樣性，但會顯著影響β多樣性，其中在高甲硫胺酸飲食組中觀察到*Alistipes*屬、普雷沃氏菌屬（*Prevotella*）和*Prevotellaceae_UCG-001*屬的富集。接受高甲硫胺酸飲食組鼠兔糞便微生物移植的雌性和雄性受體，其體內分別增加了 *Alistipes* 和普雷沃氏菌屬的相對豐度。同時，這些微生物的轉變伴隨著兩性細胞免疫力及雄性體液免疫力的提升、球蟲感染的減少，以及雄性生殖特徵的增強；相較之下，雌性受體的生殖特徵則無顯著變化。巨基因體功能註解顯示，接受高甲硫胺酸飲食供體鼠兔微生物移植後，雌性受體中參與能量、胺基酸代謝和碳水化合物代謝的功能路徑豐度較低，而雄性受體中參與胺基酸和脂質代謝的功能路徑豐度則較高。綜上所述，這些發現表明，高甲硫胺酸飲食所誘導的免疫力與生殖生理特徵之改善，可能部分歸因於高原鼠兔體內特定腸道菌群的豐度變化。

papers.title: Effects of Nest Box Lighting on Nest Box Use in Four Commercial Layer Strains Reared Cage-Free
papers.abstract: Laying hens exhibit strong motivations for environmental features including secluded nest sites and specific lighting conditions, yet research comparing preferences across commercial layer strains in cage-free systems remains limited. This study examined nest box use under four lighting conditions (monochromatic red LED, monochromatic blue LED, UVA LED, or dark) in four commercial layer strains—three White Leghorn strains (Hy-Line W36, Hy-Line W80, and Lohmann LSL) and one brown layer strain (Hy-Line Brown)—reared under identical cage-free conditions. Sixty birds per strain were housed in a single floor pen per strain (four pens in total), each with an eight-nest, two-tier nest box unit, and the location of eggs laid in nest boxes was recorded at 45 days during early lay. The percentage of eggs laid under each condition was used as an indirect measure of preference. Within each flock, lighting condition affected nest box use (p < 0.001). Overall, more eggs than expected by chance were laid in dark (33.12%) and red-lit (29.51%) nest boxes, and fewer in UV (21.46%) and blue-lit (15.91%) nest boxes. The three White Leghorn flocks used dark nest boxes most, whereas the Hy-Line Brown flock used red-lit boxes most (36.36%), and blue-lit boxes were the least used in all flocks. Use of top- versus bottom-row nest boxes also differed among flocks. Because each strain was represented by a single pen, strain and pen effects are confounded, and differences among strains should be considered preliminary and hypothesis-generating. Replicated studies are needed before strain-specific nest box lighting recommendations can be made.
papers.abstract_zh: 產蛋雞對環境特徵（包含隱蔽的產巢區及特定的光照條件）表現出強烈的動機，然而針對無籠飼系統中不同商業蛋雞品系偏好之比較研究仍相當有限.本研究探討了四種商業蛋雞品系（三個白來亨雞品系：Hy-Line W36、Hy-Line W80、Lohmann LSL，以及一個褐殼蛋雞品系：Hy-Line Brown）在四種光照條件（單色紅光 LED、單色藍光 LED、UVA LED 或黑暗）下的產巢箱使用情形，這些雞隻均在相同的無籠飼條件下飼養.每品系有六十隻雞，飼養於各品系專屬的單一地面平飼欄中（共四欄），每欄皆設有一個八巢、雙層的產巢箱單元，並記錄產於產巢箱內的雞蛋位置，時間為產蛋初期共 45 天.產在各條件下的雞蛋百分比作為偏好的間接測量指標.在每個雞群中，光照條件皆會影響產巢箱的使用（p < 0.001）.整體而言，產在黑暗（33.12%）及紅光（29.51%）產巢箱中的雞蛋多於隨機期望值，而產在紫外線（21.46%）及藍光（15.91%）產巢箱中的雞蛋則較少.三個白來亨雞群最常使用黑暗產巢箱，而 Hy-Line Brown 雞群則最常使用紅光產巢箱（36.36%），且藍光產巢箱在所有雞群中的使用率皆最低.上層與下層產巢箱的使用情形在各雞群之間亦有不同.由於每個品系僅代表單一雞欄，因此品系與雞欄效應存在混淆，品系間的差異應被視為初步且具假設生成性質.在提出針對特定品系的產巢箱光照建議之前，仍需進行重複性研究.

papers.title: Sanitisation of Enterococcus cecorum attached to the shells of fertilised eggs by carbon dioxide microbubbles and sodium hypochlorite
papers.abstract: 1. Enterococcus cecorum (EC) infection in chicks must be prevented because of its severe pathogenicity in poultry farming. In this study, the combined sanitising effects of sodium hypochlorite (NaClO) and carbon dioxide microbubbles (CO2MB) on artificially applied EC on eggshells were clarified and the effectiveness for sanitising fertilised eggs was investigated.2. The number of surviving EC cells on eggshells decreased with increasing chlorine concentration and treatment time, with the NaClO solution containing CO2MB. The spray treatment of the NaClO solution containing CO2MB was more effective for sanitising EC.3. In addition, sanitisation of EC on fertilised eggs using a NaClO solution containing CO2MB was effective in preventing contamination in the setter, without negative effects on hatching or early growth of chicks.4. Using NaClO solution containing CO2MB was an effective method for sanitising EC on fertilised eggs.
papers.abstract_zh:
1. 由於盲腸球菌（Enterococcus cecorum, EC）在家禽飼養中具有嚴重的致病性，因此必須預防雛雞感染。本研究旨在闡明次氯酸鈉（NaClO）與二氧化碳微氣泡（CO2MB）結合對人工接種於蛋殼上之EC的綜合殺菌效果，並探討其對種蛋殺菌的有效性。
2. 在含有CO2MB的NaClO溶液處理下，蛋殼上存活的EC菌數隨著氯濃度和處理時間的增加而減少。含有CO2MB之NaClO溶液的噴霧處理對EC的殺菌效果更為顯著。
3. 此外，使用含有CO2MB的NaClO溶液對種蛋進行殺菌，能有效防止孵化器內的污染，且對雛雞的孵化率或早期生長沒有負面影響。
4. 使用含有CO2MB的NaClO溶液是種蛋上EC殺菌的有效方法。

papers.title: Comprehensive Non-Specific Immune and Gene Expression Profiling of FACS-Sorted Hemocyte Subpopulations in Litopenaeus vannamei After Vibrio parahaemolyticus (AHPND Strain) Infection
papers.abstract: Vibrio parahaemolyticus is the causative agent of acute hepatopancreatic necrosis disease (AHPND) in white shrimp aquaculture, which often causes high mortality. Circulating hemocytes play a central role during vibriosis infection, however, the hemocyte subpopulation specific responses to VP-AHPND infection remain poorly understood. This study used flow cytometry and fluorescence-activated cell sorting (FACS) to characterize four hemocyte subpopulations (H1–H4), including prohemocyte (H1), hyalinocyte (H2), semi-granulocyte (H3), and granulocyte (H4) based on non-specific immune functions and gene-expression profiles after VP-AHPND infection. Differentially hemocyte counts changed dynamically over 48 h, revealing hemocyte subpopulation specific responses to infection, which are H1 peaked during 6 h post infection, H2 increased for most of the period, whereas H3 and H4 declined at 24 and 48 h, respectively. Gene set variation analysis revealed marked early activation (6 hpi) of coagulation and notch-1 in the H1 subpopulation. The H2 subpopulation showed enrichment of pattern-recognition and coagulation genes, which mostly enhanced in the 12 hpi. Meanwhile, genes associated with prophenoloxidase and antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) were strongly upregulated especially in the late sampling time point (24 and 48 h), coinciding with a decrease in the percentages of their corresponding hemocytes (H3 and H4 subpopulation). These findings reveal that VP infection triggers a coordinated, subpopulation-specific innate immune response instead of a uniform reaction across all hemocytes. By integrating the relative proportions of hemocyte subpopulations, non-specific immune, and gene-expression, this study offers new mechanistic insights into shrimp cellular immunity and highlights key hemocyte subpopulations and pathways as potential targets for enhancing disease resistance in white shrimp aquaculture.
papers.abstract_zh: 副溶血性弧菌（Vibrio parahaemolyticus）是造成白蝦養殖場急性肝胰腺壞死症（AHPND）的病原體，經常引發高死亡率。循環血球在弧動菌病感染期間扮演核心角色，然而，對於血球亞群對VP-AHPND感染的特異性反應所知仍相當有限。本研究利用流式細胞儀與螢光啟動細胞分選術（FACS），根據VP-AHPND感染後的非特異性免疫功能與基因表現圖譜，對四種血球亞群（H1–H4）進行特徵分析，包含原血球（H1）、透明血球（H2）、半顆粒血球（H3）及顆粒血球（H4）。不同血球計數在48小時內呈現動態變化，顯示血球亞群對感染具有特異性反應：H1在感染後6小時達到高峰，H2在大部分期間增加，而H3與H4則分別在第24及48小時下降。基因集變異分析顯示，H1亞群中的凝血與notch-1在早期（感染後6小時）即有顯著活化。H2亞群顯示模式識別與凝血基因的富集，這些基因多半在感染後12小時增強。同時，與原酚氧化酶和抗菌肽（AMPs）相關的基因則強烈顯著上調，特別是在較晚的採樣時間點（24與48小時），這與其對應血球（H3與H4亞群）百分比的下降吻合。這些發現揭示了VP感染會觸發協調的、具亞群特異性的先天免疫反應，而非所有血球產生一致的反應。透過整合血球亞群的相對比例、非特異性免疫與基因表現，本研究為蝦類細胞免疫提供了新的機制見解，並突顯關鍵的血球亞群與路徑，可作為提升白蝦養殖抗病能力的潛在標的。

papers.title: Silent Infection, Early Warning: Animals as Candidate Sentinels for Crimean–Congo Haemorrhagic Fever Surveillance—A Systematic Review
papers.abstract: Crimean–Congo haemorrhagic fever virus (CCHFV) is a widely distributed tick-borne arbovirus maintained in an enzootic cycle involving wild and domestic mammals and ixodid ticks, particularly Hyalomma. This systematic review synthesised 390 eligible publication-level reports published from 2015 through 31 August 2026, comprising 351 independent quantitative reports and 39 linked/nonadditive publications. The evidence tables contained 150 animal, 106 tick and 180 human records across 69 countries. Serology dominated animal investigations; among reports with species-specific raw counts, antibody positivity was highest in camels (72.9%; 3918/5377 across 23 reports), followed by red deer (41.4%) and cattle (25.1%). Among 106 tick reports, CCHFV-positive Hyalomma and Rhipicephalus were reported in 80 (75.5%) and 41 (38.7%), respectively. Human sensitivity analyses yielded median estimates of 3.8% for antibody positivity, 13.6% for direct/composite viral detection and 20.0% for case fatality. These summaries are descriptive rather than pooled prevalence estimates. Overall, the evidence supports livestock and tick surveillance as complementary components of One Health surveillance, while prospective temporal studies are needed to establish predictive early-warning performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 克里米亞－剛果出血熱病毒（Crimean–Congo haemorrhagic fever virus, CCHFV）是一種廣泛分布的蜱媒蟲媒病毒，維持於包含野生與家養哺乳動物及硬蜱（特別是璃眼蜱屬）之動物傳染病循環中。本系統性文獻回顧綜合分析了自2015年至2026年8月31日間發布的390篇符合條件之出版物級別報告，包含351份獨立定量報告以及39份相關／非累加出版物。證據表格包含來自69個國家的150筆動物、106筆蜱蟲及180筆人類紀錄。血清學調查在動物研究中佔主體；在具有物種特異性原始計數的報告中，抗體陽性率以駱駝最高（72.9%；涵蓋23份報告中的3918/5377），其次為赤鹿（41.4%）與牛（25.1%）。在106份蜱蟲報告中，分別有80份（75.5%）和41份（38.7%）報告檢出CCHFV陽性的璃眼蜱屬（Hyalomma）與扇頭蜱屬（Rhipicephalus）。人類敏感性分析得出之抗體陽性率、直接／綜合病毒檢出率及病例致死率的中位數估計值分別為3.8%、13.6%和20.0%。這些總結屬於描述性而非合併盛行率估計值。整體而言，此證據支持將家畜與蜱蟲監測作為「同一健康」（One Health）監測的互補組成部分，同時需要前瞻性時間序列研究來確立預測性早期預警效能。
