papers.title: Wildlife as a Potential Reservoir of Paratuberculosis: Molecular Evidence of Mycobacterium avium Subspecies paratuberculosis in a Biosphere Reserve, the Sudan
papers.abstract: Mycobacterium avium subspecies paratuberculosis (MAP) causes paratuberculosis (PTB), a chronic wasting enteritis of domestic and wild ruminants. Although the disease and/or its aetiology have been reported in livestock in the Sudan, they have not been investigated in wild animals. This study investigated MAP DNA prevalence in the Dinder National Park (DNP) to provide baseline data on PTB in wildlife. Fresh faecal samples (n = 274) of wild ruminants were collected from the ground around the six major water ponds of the DNP (44–48 samples/pond). Faecal DNA was extracted using a rapid extraction protocol and tested for MAP DNA using a real-time recombinase-aided amplification (RAA) assay. The vegetation structure around the ponds was observed and described. MAP DNA detection rates around the ponds ranged between 64.4% and 22.9%, with an overall apparent prevalence of 37.9% and a sensitivity/specificity-adjusted sample positivity of 42.4%. The faecal samples belonged to Reedbuck (Redunca redunca), Warthog (Phacochoerus aethiopicus), Waterbuck (Kobus defasa), African Buffalo (Syncerus caffer), Oribi (Ourebia ourebia), and among which MAP DNA detection rates were 39.4% (28/71), 39.1% (18/46), 38.0% (27/71), 37.5% (12/32) and 35.2% (19/54), respectively. The vegetation pattern around the ponds showed a notable difference that was consistent with MAP DNA detection. These results are consistent with the potential role of wildlife in paratuberculosis maintenance and transmission. Future investigations, including genotyping, would identify possible cross-transmission of the pathogen at the wildlife-domestic animal interface.
papers.abstract_zh: 副結核分枝桿菌禽結核亞種（*Mycobacterium avium* subspecies *paratuberculosis*, MAP）會引起副結核病（paratuberculosis, PTB），這是一種發生在家畜和野生反芻動物身上的慢性消耗性腸炎。儘管蘇丹的家畜已有人員通報該疾病及其病因，但對於野生動物的研究尚屬空白。本研究調查了丁德爾國家公園（Dinder National Park, DNP）中 MAP DNA 的盛行率，以為野生動物副結核病提供基準數據。從 DNP 六個主要水塘周圍的地面採集了野生反芻動物的新鮮糞便樣本（n = 274，每個水塘 44–48 個樣本）。使用快速萃取方案萃取糞便 DNA，並利用即時重組酶輔助擴增（real-time recombinase-aided amplification, RAA）檢測 MAP DNA。觀察並描述了水塘周圍的植被結構。水塘周圍的 MAP DNA 檢出率介於 64.4% 至 22.9% 之間，總體表面盛行率為 37.9%，經敏感度／特異度調整後的樣本陽性率為 42.4%。糞便樣本分別來自葦羚（*Redunca redunca*）、疣豬（*Phacochoerus aethiopicus*）、水羚（*Kobus defasa*）、非洲水牛（*Syncerus caffer*）以及鸝羚（*Ourebia ourebia*），其 MAP DNA 檢出率分別為 39.4% (28/71)、39.1% (18/46)、38.0% (27/71)、37.5% (12/32) 和 35.2% (19/54)。水塘周圍的植被模式呈顯著差異，這與 MAP DNA 的檢出情形相符。這些結果與野生動物在副結核病維持與傳播中扮演的潛在角色相符。未來的研究（包括基因型分型）將有助於識別該病原體在野生動物與家畜交界處的可能交叉傳播。

papers.title: Short-Term Associations Between a Government-Funded Sterilization Program for Owned Outdoor Dogs and Abandonment-Related Shelter Admissions in the Republic of Korea: A Nationwide Municipality-Level Panel Study
papers.abstract: Sterilization programs for owned outdoor dogs aim to reduce uncontrolled breeding and subsequent abandonment, but population-level evidence remains limited. This study examined short-term associations between the Korean government-funded sterilization program introduced in 2022 and shelter-recorded abandoned-dog admissions using annual data from 229 municipalities from 2019 to 2024 (1374 municipality-year observations). The outcome was shelter-recorded abandoned-dog admissions per 100,000 residents. Socioeconomic associations, program implementation, and implementation volume were evaluated using two-way fixed-effects (TWFE) and difference-in-differences (DID) models. Estimates were interpreted as ecological associations because parallel pre-intervention trends could not be fully established, program allocation was non-random, and eligible owned outdoor dog populations were unavailable. In the primary linear TWFE models, neither program implementation nor implementation volume was significantly associated with the shelter-recorded abandoned-dog admissions, and urban–rural-stratified analyses yielded similar null findings. Baseline-need-scaled sensitivity analyses produced positive associations in the pooled and urban samples, indicating sensitivity to denominator choice and model specification. Province-specific analyses were heterogeneous but inconsistent. Overall, the analyses provided no consistent evidence of a short-term reduction associated with the program. Future evaluations should measure coverage among eligible owned outdoor dogs, use longer follow-up, and evaluate sterilization within broader dog population management.
papers.abstract_zh: 有主戶外犬隻的絕育計畫旨在減少不受控制的繁殖與隨之而來的棄養，但族群層級的證據仍然有限。本研究檢視了2022年實施的韓國政府資助絕育計畫與收容所記錄的棄養犬隻收容數之間的短期關聯，使用了來自229個行政區從2019年至2024年的年度資料（共1,374筆行政區-年份觀察值）。結果變項為每10萬名居民收容所記錄的棄養犬隻收容數。本研究使用雙向固定效果（TWFE）與雙差分（DID）模型，評估了社會經濟相關因素、計畫實施情況以及實施數量。由於無法完全建立平行的介入前趨勢、計畫分配並非隨機，且缺乏符合資格的有主戶外犬隻族群數據，因此估計值被解釋為生態學上的相關性。在主要的線性TWFE模型中，計畫的實施與實施數量皆與收容所記錄的棄養犬隻收容數無顯著關聯，城鄉分層分析也得出相似的無顯著效果發現。以基準需求規模調整的敏感度分析在合併樣本與城鄉樣本中產生了正向關聯，顯示結果對分母選擇與模型設定具敏感性。各省的分析結果具異質性但不一致。整體而言，分析未提供該計畫與短期減少之間具一致性的證據。未來評估應測量符合資格的有主戶外犬隻涵蓋率、使用更長的追蹤期，並在更廣泛的犬隻族群管理架構下評估絕育效果。

papers.title: Transcriptome Analysis Reveals the Effects of Dietary DHA and EPA on the Hepatic Response to Unpredictable Chronic Stress in Atlantic Salmon (Salmo salar L.)
papers.abstract: Eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA) and docosahexaenoic acid (DHA) are key long-chain omega-3 fatty acids in fish nutrition, but their differential effects on Atlantic salmon under unpredictable chronic stress (UCS) remain unclear. This study compared hepatic responses to DHA- and EPA-rich diets under unstressed and UCS conditions. Atlantic salmon post-smolts were fed a low-EPA+DHA, DHA-rich, or EPA-rich diet for 10 weeks, followed by 3 weeks of UCS. Liver transcriptomes were analyzed by RNA sequencing, and selected genes were validated by quantitative reverse transcription PCR. Growth did not differ among dietary groups. Under unstressed conditions, the DHA-rich diet induced more differentially expressed genes than the EPA-rich diet (67 vs. 29) and affected pathways related to fatty acid metabolism, autophagy, cholesterol homeostasis, and antioxidant defense. After UCS, the EPA-rich diet induced a broader hepatic transcriptional response than the DHA-rich diet (205 vs. 57 differentially expressed genes), with only 12 genes shared between the two comparisons. Both diets affected fatty acid- and steroid-biosynthesis-related pathways, while gene-level responses were diet-specific. These findings reveal distinct, stress-dependent hepatic responses to dietary DHA and EPA and may inform future optimization of their nutritional provision in Atlantic salmon production.
papers.abstract_zh: 二十碳五烯酸（EPA）與二十二碳六烯酸（DHA）是大西洋鮭魚營養中的關鍵長鏈 omega-3 脂肪酸，但它們對處於不可預測之慢性壓力（UCS）下的大西洋鮭魚之差異性影響仍不清楚。本研究比較了在無壓力與 UCS 條件下，富含 DHA 與富含 EPA 飲食的肝臟反應。大西洋鮭魚後 smolt 分別投餵低 EPA+DHA、富含 DHA 或富含 EPA 的飼料 10 週，隨後進行 3 週的 UCS。利用 RNA 定序分析肝臟轉錄體，並透過即時定量反轉錄聚合酶連鎖反應（qRT-PCR）驗證部分基因。各飲食組間的生長情形無顯著差異。在無壓力條件下，富含 DHA 的飲食比富含 EPA 的飲食誘導出更多的差異表現基因（67 個對 29 個），並影響與脂肪酸代謝、自噬作用、膽固醇恆定及抗氧化防禦相關的通路。在 UCS 之後，富含 EPA 的飲食比富含 DHA 的飲食誘導出更廣泛的肝臟轉錄反應（205 個對 57 個差異表現基因），且兩者比較中僅有 12 個基因重疊。兩種飲食皆影響與脂肪酸及類固醇生物合成相關的通路，而基因層面的反應則具飲食特異性。這些發現揭示了飲食中 DHA 與具壓力依賴性的相異肝臟反應，並可為未來優化大西洋鮭魚生產中的營養供給提供參考。

papers.title: Berberine Protects Brain Endothelial Barrier via β-Catenin: A Network Pharmacology in Pigs and In Vitro Mechanistic Analysis
papers.abstract: Glaesserella parasuis (G. parasuis) is an important swine pathogen that causes Glässer’s disease, of which meningitis is among the most severe clinical symptoms. However, the molecular mechanisms underlying G. parasuis-induced meningitis remain poorly understood. In this study, we employed a network pharmacology-based strategy combined with in vitro experimental validation to investigate the protective effects and mechanisms of berberine against G. parasuis meningitis. Network pharmacology analysis identified CTNNB1 (encodes the β-catenin protein) as a core target among multiple candidate targets. Gene Ontology (GO) and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) enrichment analyses revealed that the predicted targets of berberine are significantly associated with inflammatory signaling (mitogen-activated protein kinase MAPK/nuclear factor kappa B NF-κB) and stress-response pathways (forkhead box O FoxO/p53), suggesting a multifaceted protective mechanism against G. parasuis-induced blood–brain barrier (BBB) disruption. Molecular docking results combined with drug affinity responsive target stability (DARTS) assays demonstrated that berberine binds directly to β-catenin with high affinity (docking score = −7.52 kcal/mol), as evidenced by enhanced proteolytic stability of β-catenin upon berberine (2.5, 10, and 20 μg/mL) treatment. To further validate the functional relevance, we introduced zonula occludens-1 (ZO-1), a representative tight junction protein, as a functional verification indicator. Our results demonstrated that G. parasuis infection significantly downregulated the expression of both ZO-1 and β-catenin in human brain microvascular endothelial cells (hBMECs), while berberine (2.5, 10, and 20 μg/mL) treatment effectively reversed this downregulation in a concentration-dependent manner. These findings reveal that berberine exerts its protective effects against G. parasuis meningitis by targeting CTNNB1 to restore intercellular junctional integrity—including tight junctions (ZO-1) and adherens junctions (β-catenin)—thereby preserving BBB function. This study provides a mechanistic basis for the development of berberine as a promising alternative therapeutic agent against G. parasuis meningitis.
papers.abstract_zh: 副豬嗜血桿菌（*Glaesserella parasuis*）是一種重要的豬隻病原菌，會引起格氏病（Glässer's disease），其中腦膜炎是最嚴重的臨床症狀之一。然而，副豬嗜血桿菌引發腦膜炎的分子機制仍所知有限。在本研究中，我們採用基於網絡藥理學的策略結合體外實驗驗證，探討小蘗鹼（berberine）對副豬嗜血桿菌性腦膜炎的保護作用及機制。網絡藥理學分析識別出 CTNNB1（編碼 $\beta$-catenin 蛋白質）為多個候選標靶中的核心標靶。基因本體論（Gene Ontology, GO）與京都基因與基因體百科全書（KEGG）富集分析顯示，小蘗鹼預測的標靶與發炎訊息傳遞（絲裂原活化蛋白質激酶 MAPK / 核因子卡巴 B NF-$\kappa$B）及壓力反應路徑（叉頭框 O FoxO / p53）顯著相關，這表明其具有針對副豬嗜血桿菌誘導之血腦屏障（BBB）破壞的多方面保護機制。分子模擬對接（molecular docking）結果結合藥物親和力反應標靶穩定性（DARTS）分析顯示，小蘗鹼以高親和力直接結合至 $\beta$-catenin（對接分數 = −7.52 kcal/mol），經小蘗鹼（2.5、10 和 20 μg/mL）處理後 $\beta$-catenin 的蛋白質水解穩定性增強即證明了這一點。為了進一步驗證其功能相關性，我們引入了具代表性的緊密連接蛋白質——胞質僵直蛋白-1（zonula occludens-1, ZO-1）作為功能驗證指標。我們的結果表明，副豬嗜血桿菌感染顯著下調了人類大腦微血管內皮細胞（hBMECs）中 ZO-1 與 $\beta$-catenin 的表達，而小蘗鹼（2.5、10 和 20 μg/mL）處理則以濃度依賴的方式有效逆轉了這種下調。這些發現揭示了小蘗鹼透過標靶 CTNNB1 以恢復細胞間連接完整性——包含緊密連接（ZO-1）與黏附連接（$\beta$-catenin）——從而發揮對副豬嗜血桿菌性腦膜炎的保護作用，並維持血腦屏障功能。本研究為將小蘗鹼開發為對抗副豬嗜血桿菌性腦膜炎之有潛力的替代治療藥物提供了機制基礎。

papers.title: The Most Effective Molnupiravir Dosage for Eliminating Feline Calicivirus from Cats with and Without Chronic Gingivostomatitis
papers.abstract: Feline chronic gingivostomatitis (FCGS) and gingival hyperplasia are extremely painful conditions for which there is no universally recognised cause or cure. Feline calicivirus (FCV) was detected by RT-qPCR in two pet Domestic Shorthair cats with FCGS and isolated from mouth swabs of 14 cats following a gingivitis and fading kitten outbreak in a British Shorthair and Maine Coon breeding cattery. Oral inflammation was graded 0 (healthy) to 4 (FCGS). Nine of 16 gingivitis cases presented with FCGS. Mean inflammation grade significantly improved (p < 0.001) from 3.1 ± 1.0 to 0.3 ± 0.5 when cats became FCV negative. Eleven of 16 (69%) cats gained weight. Cats became FCV negative following antiviral treatment with molnupiravir (n = 15) and nitazoxanide (n = 1). (Nitazoxanide (31–48 mg/kg q24h for 70 days) failed to stop FCV shedding in three other cats.) Across 38 treatment courses, FCV shedding ceased with once daily oral molnupiravir doses of 22–39 mg/kg in 5/10 (50%); 40–55 mg/kg in 14/16 (88%); and >55 mg/kg in 8/12 (67%). Subclinically infected cats became FCV negative after 14 days molnupiravir, but gingivitis cases required longer (p = 0.005). Three cattery cats were reinfected and relapsed. Conclusion: Molnupiravir at a dose of 40–55 mg/kg q24h stopped FCV shedding, enabling recovery of some gingivitis cases.
papers.abstract_zh: 貓慢性齒齦口炎（FCGS）與齒齦增生是極度疼痛的疾病，目前尚無全球公認的病因或療法。本研究在兩隻患有 FCGS 的家貓（米克斯）體內以 RT-qPCR 檢測出貓卡里西病毒（FCV），並從一個英國短毛貓與緬因貓繁殖貓舍中發生齒齦炎及幼貓衰弱疫情後的 14 貓隻口腔拭子中分離出該病毒。口腔發炎程度評分為 0 分（健康）至 4 分（FCGS）。16 例齒齦炎病例中有 9 例表現出 FCGS。當貓隻的 FCV 轉為陰性時，平均發炎評分顯著改善（p < 0.001），從 3.1 ± 1.1 降至 0.3 ± 0.5。11 隻貓（69%）體重增加。貓隻在接受抗病毒藥物莫納皮拉韋（molnupiravir，n = 15）與硝唑尼特（nitazoxanide，n = 1）治療後，FCV 轉為陰性。（硝唑尼特〔31–48 mg/kg，每 24 小時一次，療程 70 天〕未能阻止其他三隻貓排出 FCV）。在 39 個治療療程中，透過每日口服一次莫納皮拉韋，停止 FCV 排毒的比例分別為：劑量 22–39 mg/kg 者占 5/10（50%）；劑量 40–55 mg/kg 者占 15/16（94%）；劑量 >55 mg/kg 者占 10/13（77%）。無臨床症狀感染貓在接受莫納皮拉韋治療 14 天後 FCV 轉為陰性，但齒齦炎病例需要更長的療程（p = 0.005）。三隻貓舍貓隻再次感染並復發。結論：劑量為 40–55 mg/kg、每 24 小時一次的莫納皮拉韋能停止 FCV 排毒，使部分齒齦炎病例得以康復。

papers.title: Correction to “ MiR ‐376c‐3p Targets STRBP mRNA to Regulate Cashmere Goat Hair Follicle Stem Cell Proliferation and Multipotency by Inhibiting the Wnt/β‐catenin and BMP Signalling Pathways”
Automated Acoustic Monitoring of Oestrus in Dairy Cows and Sows: Behavioural Evidence, Signal Processing, and Detection Methods
papers.abstract: Oestrus detection determines insemination timing and reproductive efficiency in dairy cow and sow herds, yet manual observation and single-sensor systems remain vulnerable to weak behavioural expression and commercial barn conditions. This structured narrative review organises evidence across biological plausibility, acoustic acquisition, barn interference, feature representation, recognition models, multimodal fusion, decision support, and on-farm validation. Searches of PubMed and Crossref through 3 October 2026 produced 373 records and 339 unique records after deduplication. Of the core database records, 16 met the direct relevance criteria, and 78 supplementary biological, engineering, and methodological sources were incorporated through backward citation searching and targeted contextual retrieval, yielding 94 cited sources. Dairy cow evidence most consistently supports increased vocalisation rate around the oestrus climax and individual acoustic monitoring under defined conditions. Sow evidence depends more strongly on boar stimulation, the standing reflex, and multimodal labels, positioning acoustics mainly as an auxiliary behavioural cue. Reported direct recognition accuracies range from 91.25% to 98.92%, but heterogeneous labels and predominantly internal validation prevent statistical pooling or claims of commercial generalisability. Acoustic monitoring is best positioned as an early-warning and verification layer rather than a standalone predictor of ovulation or optimal insemination timing. Priority needs are standardised reference labels, leakage-resistant animal- and farm-level validation, device robustness, multimodal uncertainty handling, open benchmarks, and evaluation of reproductive and economic outcomes.
papers.abstract_zh: 發情偵測決定了乳牛與母豬群體的授精時機與繁殖效率，然而人工觀察與單一感測器系統仍易受到微弱行為表現及商業畜舍環境的限制。本結構化敘述性文獻回顧整合了生物學合理性、聲學擷取、畜舍干擾、特徵表示、辨識模型、多模態融合、決策支援以及場域驗證等面向的證據。透過 PubMed 與 Crossref 檢索截至 2026 年 10 月 3 日的文獻，共產生 373 筆記錄，經去除重複後剩餘 339 筆獨特記錄。在核心資料庫記錄中，有 16 筆符合直接相關性標準，並透過逆向引用檢索與針對性情境文獻擷取納入 78 筆補充性的生物學、工程學與方法學來源，總計引用 94 個來源。乳牛的證據最一致地支持在發情高峰期發聲率增加，以及在特定條件下進行個別聲學監測。母豬的證據則較強烈依賴公豬刺激、靜立反射與多模態標記，將聲學定位為主要的輔助行為線索。報告的直接辨識準確度介於 91.25% 至 98.92% 之間，但異質性標記與以內部驗證為主的情況，妨礙了統計合併或商業泛用性的聲稱。聲學監測最適合作為早期預警與驗證層，而非作為排卵或最佳授精時機的獨立預測指標。當務之急包括標準化參考標記、具抗洩漏能力的動物與牧場層級驗證、裝置強韌性、多模態不確定性處理、開放基準，以及對繁殖與經濟效益的評估。

papers.title: Inclusion of Palm Kernel Cake in Supplements for Grazing Lambs on Growth Performance, Digestibility, Nitrogen Balance, Blood Metabolites and Meat Quality
papers.abstract: Palm kernel cake (PKC), a byproduct produced in various countries, has been studied for its potential use as animal feed. This study aimed to assess the effects of PKC as a feed supplement on Santa Inês lambs raised on pasture (Panicum maximum cv. Massai). Forty uncastrated lambs were included in a completely randomized design and allocated to four treatments consisting of feed supplements with different levels of PKC included (0.0, 150, 300, and 450 g/kg). The intake of dry matter, neutral detergent fiber, and non-fibrous carbohydrates and the time spent ruminating decreased linearly as the level of PKC increased. Digestibility of the ether extract improved, fecal levels and intake of nitrogen decreased, and microbial protein remained consistent with PKC inclusion. The final body weight, total weight gain, and average daily weight gain decreased quadratically with PKC inclusion levels. Marbling and meat color improved with the inclusion of PKC in the diet. Lambs grazing and supplemented with control rations exhibited superior performance compared to those consuming supplements with PKC content. Including PKC at levels up to 450 g/kg in feed supplement for grazing lambs may reduce feed intake and animal performance without affecting blood metabolites. However, it enhances meat redness, which may appeal to consumers. Its use may be advantageous during critical dry periods for the maintenance feeding of grazing animals.
papers.abstract_zh: 棕櫚仁粕（PKC）是多個國家生產的副產物，其作為動物飼料的潛在用途已被廣泛研究。本研究旨在評估在放牧（Massai幾內亞草，*Panicum maximum* cv. Massai）飼養條件下，以棕櫚仁粕作為飼料補充劑對聖伊內斯（Santa Inês）綿羊的影響。試驗納入四十隻未去勢綿羊，採完全隨機設計，並分配至四種處理組，其飼料補充劑含有不同水準的棕櫚仁粕（0.0、150、300及450 g/kg）。隨著棕櫚仁粕添加水準的增加，乾物質、中性洗劑纖維和非纖維性碳水化合物的攝入量以及反芻時間均呈線性下降。粗脂肪的消化率有所改善，糞便中的氮含量與氮攝入量則皆下降，而微生物蛋白質在添加棕櫚仁粕後保持穩定。終端體重、總增重和平均日增重隨著棕櫚仁粕添加水準呈二次方下降。在日糧中添加棕櫚仁粕可改善大理石紋（油花）和肉色。與食用含棕櫚仁粕補充劑的綿羊相比，放牧並補充對照飼糧的綿羊表現出更優異的生產性能。在放牧綿羊的飼料補充劑中添加高達 450 g/kg 的棕櫚仁粕可能會降低採食量和動物表現，但不會影響血液代謝物。不過，它能增強肉品的紅度，這可能較受消費者青睞。在乾旱等關鍵時期，將其用於放牧動物的維持飼養可能具有優勢。

papers.title: Deep Learning Models for FAMACHA©-Based Anemia Screening in Goats
papers.abstract: Haemonchus contortus infection is a major cause of anemia in goats and can reduce productivity, reproductive performance, and animal welfare. The FAMACHA© system supports on-farm anemia screening by visually assessing ocular conjunctival color, but scoring can vary with evaluator experience, and lighting conditions. This study developed a smartphone-oriented deep learning framework for FAMACHA©-based anemia screening in goats using ocular conjunctival images. The dataset included 1995 FAMACHA©-labeled images from 141 meat and dairy goats collected across three acquisition campaigns. For the binary screening task, FAMACHA© scores of 4–5 were assigned to the anemic screening class, whereas scores of 1–3 were assigned to the non-anemic screening class. The pipeline combined U-Net-based conjunctiva segmentation with classification using six ImageNet-pretrained backbones: ResNet-50, ViT-B/16, Swin-T, EfficientNet-B0, MobileNetV4-Small, and MobileViT-v2-1.0. Models were evaluated using animal-level dataset splitting, nested cross-validation, validation-selected thresholds, goat-level cluster bootstrap confidence intervals and goat-block paired permutation tests. U-Net with a ResNet-34 encoder achieved a foreground IoU of 0.7342 and a Dice coefficient of 0.8372 for conjunctiva segmentation. On the held-out test set, ViT-B/16 achieved the highest anemia recall (0.924), accuracy (0.861), and anemia-class F1-score (0.879). However, MobileNetV4-Small performed closely, with 0.847 accuracy, a 0.861 F1-score, and the highest specificity (0.825). U-Net-ResNet34 combined with MobileNetV4-Small yielded the lowest estimated combined inference latency of 479.04 ms per image, calculated from separately measured segmentation and classification latencies on a Samsung SM-A556E smartphone using TensorFlow Lite. A Pearson’s correlation analysis showed a strong positive association between fecal egg count and FAMACHA© score (r = 0.7082, R2 = 0.5015, p < 0.0001). These results suggest that ocular-conjunctival imaging can support FAMACHA©-based anemia screening in goats, with ViT-B/16 serving as the strongest recall-oriented model and MobileNetV4-Small as a practical candidate for low-latency on-device inference under the tested smartphone configuration.
papers.abstract_zh: 捻轉血矛線蟲（*Haemonchus contortus*）感染是山羊貧血的主要原因，並會降低生產性能、繁殖表現和動物福利。FAMACHA©系統透過視覺評估眼結膜顏色來支援牧場端的貧血篩檢，但評分結果可能會隨評估人員的經驗和光照條件而有所不同。本研究開發了一種基於智慧型手機的深度學習框架，利用眼結膜影像進行山羊的FAMACHA©貧血篩檢。資料集包含來自三個採集梯次、共 141 隻肉山羊與乳山羊的 1995 張具 FAMACHA© 標籤的影像。在二元篩檢任務中，FAMACHA© 評分 4–5 分被歸類為貧血篩檢類別，而 1–3 分則歸類為非貧血篩檢類別。該處理流程結合了基於 U-Net 的結膜分割，以及使用六個在 ImageNet 上預訓練的主幹網路進行分類：ResNet-50、ViT-B/16、Swin-T、EfficientNet-B0、MobileNetV4-Small 和 MobileViT-v2-1.0. 模型評估採用動物層級的資料集分割、巢狀交叉驗證、驗證集選定的閾值、山羊層級群聚拔靴（cluster bootstrap）信賴區間以及山羊區塊配對置換檢定。使用 ResNet-34 編碼器的 U-Net 在結膜分割上取得了 0.7342 的前景交併比（IoU）和 0.8372 的戴斯係數（Dice coefficient）。在保留的測試集上，ViT-B/16 取得了最高的貧血召回率（0.924）、準確度（0.861）以及貧血類別 F1 分數（0.879）。然而，MobileNetV4-Small 的表現亦相當接近，具備 0.847 的準確度、0.861 的 F1 分數，以及最高 特異度（0.825）。結合 U-Net-ResNet34 與 MobileNetV4-Small 產生的估計綜合推論延遲最低，每張影像為 479.04 毫秒，此數據是使用 TensorFlow Lite 在 Samsung SM-A556E 智慧型手機上分別測量分割與分類延遲計算而得。皮爾森相關分析顯示糞便蟲卵數與 FAMACHA© 評分之間具有強烈的正相關（r = 0.7082, R2 = 0.5015, p < 0.0001）。這些結果表明，眼結膜成像可用於支援山羊基於 FAMACHA© 的貧血篩檢，其中 ViT-B/16 可作為最強的導向召回率模型，而 MobileNetV4-Small 則是所測試的智慧型手機配置下，適用於低延遲裝置端推論的實用候選模型。

papers.title: Courtship Behavior and Induced Spawning Dynamics of the Freshwater Shark, Wallago attu, in Captivity: Implications for Silurid Reproductive Strategies
papers.abstract: The vulnerable catfish Wallago attu, a commercially important freshwater species in Southeast Asia, faces population decline due to habitat degradation and overfishing. This study is the first to document the courtship behavior and induced spawning of W. attu under captive conditions in circular spawning tanks. The hormonal induction was achieved using a combination of salmon gonadotropin-releasing hormone analogue and domperidone (0.5 mL kg−1 for females; 0.2 mL kg−1 for males). Males exhibited dominant courtship behavior, characterized by aggressive chasing and U-shaped body wrapping around the female’s abdomen for 5.15 ± 0.17 s, leading to synchronized gamete release. The latency period prior to the onset of spawning occurred within a time frame of 9–10 h following hormonal administration. The findings indicate that the removal of brooders following egg release resulted in a significantly higher rate of fertilization and hatching, with a percentage of 88.12 ± 0.26%, as compared to 67.78 ± 1.78% in tanks that contained brooders This observation suggests the presence of egg predation. Plastic strings functioned as effective artificial substrates, enhancing fertilization (86.42 ± 1.18%) and hatching (89.28 ± 0.80%) in comparison to aquatic weeds. The findings presented herein provide a foundation of information upon which the establishment of efficient captive breeding and hatchery protocols for W. attu can be based. Such protocols will in turn support the conservation of the species and the sustainable development of aquaculture.
papers.abstract_zh: 具商業重要性的東南亞淡水物種──易危鯰魚黑翅琵琶魚（*Wallago attu*），因棲地退化與過漁而面臨族群數量下降。本研究首次記錄了黑翅琵琶魚在圓形產卵池之人工飼養條件下的求偶行為與催產。荷爾蒙催產係使用鮭魚促性腺激素釋放激素類似物與嗎酮之混合物（雌魚為 0.5 mL kg−1；雄魚為 0.2 mL kg−1）。雄魚展現出優勢的求偶行為，其特徵為具侵略性的追逐，並以 U 形身體纏繞雌魚腹部達 5.15 ± 0.17 秒，進而促成同步釋放配子。荷爾蒙給藥後的產卵潛伏期出現在 9 至 10 小時的時間範圍內。研究結果顯示，產卵後移除親魚可顯著提高受精率與孵化率，其百分比達 88.12 ± 0.26%，相較之下，含有親魚的水槽則為 67.78 ± 1.78%。此觀察結果暗示存在卵掠食現象。與水草相比，塑膠繩能作為有效的人工基質，提高受精率（86.42 ± 1.18%）與孵化率（89.28 ± 0.80%）。本文所呈現之發現為建立黑翅琵琶魚高效人工繁殖與孵化場操作規程奠定資訊基礎。此類操作規程將進一步支持該物種之保育及水產養殖的可持續發展。

papers.title: Performance of a Sensor-Based Health Monitoring System for the Detection of Clinical Mastitis in Dairy Cows
papers.abstract: Mastitis is one of the most important production diseases in dairy farming and affects animal welfare, milk quality, and farm profitability. The use of automated health-monitoring systems has increased, and temperature-sensing reticular boluses are used to detect mastitis and other diseases or physiological responses. This study aimed to evaluate whether mastitis alerts generated by the smaXtec system are associated with subsequently diagnosed clinical mastitis under field conditions. An alert-based prospective case series was conducted on nine dairy farms in northern and western Germany. All cows receiving a smaXtec mastitis alert were included if a corresponding milk sample was available. Clinical examination, quarter milk sampling and microbiological analysis were performed. Among the 102 alerted cows, 40 were diagnosed with clinical mastitis within a 4-day observation period, with most of the cases being non-severe. This corresponded to a positive predictive value of 39.2%. We conclude that accelerometer- and temperature-based monitoring may support the detection of clinical mastitis, but this study showed limited diagnostic value under practical field conditions, when used as a stand-alone tool.
papers.abstract_zh: 乳房炎是乳牛養殖中最重要的生產疾病之一，會影響動物福利、乳品品質以及牧場獲利能力。自動化健康監測系統的使用日益普及，其中感溫網胃膠囊已被用於偵測乳房炎及其他疾病或生理反應。本研究旨在評估在實場飼養條件下，由 smaXtec 系統產生的乳房炎警報是否與隨後診斷出的臨床型乳房炎有關。本研究於德國北部和西部的九個乳牛場進行以警報為基礎的前瞻性病例系列研究。所有收到 smaXtec 乳房炎警報且有對應乳樣可用的乳牛皆被納入研究。進行了臨床檢查、分房乳樣採集與微生物學分析。在 102 頭收到警報的乳牛中，有 40 頭在 4 天的觀察期內被診斷出罹患臨床型乳房炎，其中多數病例為非嚴重型。這相當於 39.2% 的陽性預測值。我們得出結論，基於加速度計與溫度感測的監測有助於臨床型乳房炎的偵測，但本研究顯示，當其作為單一獨立工具應用於實際牧場環境時，其診斷價值有限。

papers.title: Matrix Metalloproteinase-9 Concentration in Peritoneal Fluid of Horses with and Without Strongyle Infection
papers.abstract: Strongyle infections are common in horses and can cause clinically relevant disease, yet their associated inflammatory responses remain incompletely understood. Matrix metalloproteinase-9 (MMP-9), a key mediator of extracellular matrix degradation and inflammation, has been proposed as a biomarker in various equine diseases. This study investigated whether strongyle infection is associated with increased MMP-9 concentrations in equine peritoneal fluid (PF). A total of 83 horses presenting with colic, weight loss, or faecal water were included, and strongyle infection was determined semi-quantitatively by combined sedimentation–flotation. MMP-9 concentrations in non-anticoagulated and citrate-anticoagulated PF were measured using ELISA, and non-parametric statistical tests were applied. MMP-9 measurements in non-anticoagulated samples were strongly correlated with the values from citrate-anticoagulated samples. No significant differences in MMP-9 concentrations, total nucleated cell count (TNCC), total protein (TP) or lactate were observed between strongyle-positive and -negative horses, nor across faecal egg count categories. In contrast, MMP-9 concentrations showed significant positive correlations with inflammatory parameters, including TNCC and TP, irrespective of strongyle infection. These findings indicate that peritoneal MMP-9 reflects non-specific inflammatory processes rather than strongyle infection. The lack of association may also reflect limitations of faecal egg counts and sampling site, suggesting that PF is not optimal for detecting parasite-specific inflammation.
papers.abstract_zh: 圓柱線蟲感染在馬匹中很常見，且會引起臨床相關疾病，然而其相關的發炎反應仍尚未完全釐清。基質金屬蛋白酶-9（MMP-9）是細胞外基質降解和發炎反應的關鍵調節因子，已被提出可作為多種馬匹疾病的生物標記。本研究旨在探討圓柱線蟲感染是否與馬匹腹膜液（PF）中MMP-9濃度的升高有關。本研究共納入83匹呈現絞痛、體重減輕或糞便含水量異常的馬匹，並透過沉淀浮選法結合半定量方式判定圓柱線蟲感染。本研究使用ELISA測定未抗凝固與檸檬酸鹽抗凝固腹膜液中的MMP-9濃度，並應用無母數統計檢定。未抗凝固樣本中的MMP-9測定值與檸檬酸鹽抗凝固樣本的數值呈高度相關。圓柱線蟲陽性與陰性馬匹之間，以及不同糞便蟲卵數（FEC）分級之間，在MMP-9濃度、總有核細胞計數（TNCC）、總蛋白質（TP）或乳酸濃度方面均未觀察到顯著差異。相比之下，無論是否感染圓柱線蟲，MMP-9濃度皆與發炎參數（包括TNCC和TP）呈顯著正相關。這些發現表明，腹膜液中的MMP-9反映的是非特異性發炎過程，而非圓柱線蟲感染。缺乏相關性也可能反映了糞便蟲卵數與採樣部位的侷限性，這表明腹膜液並非檢測寄生虫特異性發炎的最佳檢體。

papers.title: Quantifying American Alligator (Alligator mississippiensis) Nest Depredation by Wild Pigs (Sus scrofa)
papers.abstract: Understanding interactions between native and invasive species is crucial for effective wildlife management, as predation by invasive species can significantly impact native populations. This study investigated the factors influencing wild pig (Sus scrofa) predation on 28 American alligator (Alligator mississippiensis) nests in Texas coastal marshes between 2022 and 2023. We examined variables including nest location, wetland type, soil type, landcover, distance to roads, distance to management headquarters (i.e., human infrastructure), distance to levees, distance to trees, and salinity levels to determine their relationship with nest predation. We analyzed data using generalized linear regression models and evaluated the models’ performance using AICc values and the Hosmer–Lemeshow goodness-of-fit test. Our results revealed that proximity to roads was negatively associated with nest predation risk (β = −0.01, p = 0.05), while increased distance from management headquarters was positively correlated with predation (β = 0.0004, p = 0.09). This study’s findings indicate that distance to roads influence predation dynamics, with potential implications for wildlife managers seeking to mitigate wild pig depredation of alligator nests and potentially other ground-nesting reptiles and birds. These insights can guide habitat management strategies and inform conservation efforts by identifying high-risk areas and enhancing protective measures for alligator nests.
papers.abstract_zh: 理解原生種與外來種之間的交互作用對於有效的野生動物管理至關重要，因為外來種的掠食可能會顯著影響原生種族群。本研究探討了 2022 年至 2023 年間，德州沿海沼澤中影響野豬（Sus scrofa）掠食 28 個美國短吻鱷（Alligator mississippiensis）巢穴的因素。我們檢視了包括巢穴位置、濕地類型、土壤類型、土地覆蓋、距道路距離、距管理總部（即人類基礎設施）距離、距堤防距離、距樹木距離以及鹽度水平等變數，以確定其與巢穴掠食之間的關係。我們使用廣義線性迴歸模型分析數據，並利用 AICc 值和荷斯默－勒梅肖擬合優度檢定（Hosmer–Lemeshow goodness-of-fit test）評估模型的效能。我們的結果顯示，接近道路與巢穴掠食風險呈負相關（β = −0.01, p = 0.05），而距離管理總部越遠則與掠食呈正相關（β = 0.0004, p = 0.09）。本研究的發現指出，距道路的距離會影響掠食動態，這對試圖減輕野豬對短吻鱷巢穴以及可能對其他地面築巢爬蟲類和鳥類掠食的野生動物管理者具有潛在的啟示。這些見解可透過識別高風險區域並加強對短吻鱷巢穴的保護措施，來指導棲地管理策略並為保育工作提供參考。

papers.title: Effects of Varying Levels of Fermented Camellia oleifera Seed Meal on Growth Performance, Biochemical Indices, and Intestinal Health in Nursery Pigs
papers.abstract: Camellia oleifera seed meal (CSM) is a protein-rich by-product from camellia oil production, but its utilization in animal diets is restricted by antinutritional compounds, especially tea saponins. This study evaluated the effects of solid-state fermented CSM, produced using Bacillus subtilis, Aspergillus niger, and Trichoderma longibrachiatum, on growth performance, antioxidant capacity, immune status, and intestinal health in weaned piglets, and identified the optimal dietary inclusion level. A total of 84 piglets (15.46 ± 0.10 kg) were randomly allocated to four treatments: a basal diet (control) or the basal diet supplemented with 2.5%, 5.0%, or 7.5% fermented CSM for 48 d. Compared with the control, 2.5% fermented CSM maintained normal growth performance while improving neutral detergent fiber digestibility, antioxidant activity, immune-related indices, jejunal morphology, and expression of tight junction proteins and MUC-2. The relative abundance of butyrate-producing Collinsella was altered, and colonic butyric acid showed a significant quadratic response to graded FCSM supplementation; meanwhile, isocaproic acid concentration was reduced. In contrast, supplementation at 5.0% or above negatively affected growth, nutrient utilization, and intestinal health. Overall, piglets exhibited an inverted U-shaped response to fermented CSM supplementation, with 2.5% identified as the most suitable inclusion level. This study provides a theoretical basis for the application of fermented CSM as a potential partial replacer of conventional feed ingredients in nursery pig diets.
papers.abstract_zh: 油茶籽粕（Camellia oleifera seed meal, CSM）是茶油生產過程中富含蛋白質的副產物，但其在動物飼料中的應用受限於抗營養因子，特別是茶皂素。本研究評估了利用枯草芽孢桿菌（Bacillus subtilis）、黑麴黴（Aspergillus niger）和長枝木黴（Trichoderma longibrachiatum）進行固態發酵的油茶籽粕對斷奶仔豬生長性能、抗氧化能力、免疫狀態及腸道健康的影響，並確定了最佳的飼糧添加水準。試驗選取總計 84 頭仔豬（15.46 ± 0.10 kg），隨機分配至四個處理組：基礎飼糧（對照組）以及在基礎飼糧中分別添加 2.5%、5.0% 或 7.5% 發酵油茶籽粕的飼糧，試驗期為 48 天。與對照組相比，添加 2.5% 發酵油茶籽粕可在維持正常生長性能的同時，改善中性洗滌纖維消化率、抗氧化活性、免疫相關指標、空腸形態以及緊密連接蛋白和 MUC-2 的表達。產丁酸的柯林斯氏菌（Collinsella）相對豐度發生改變，結腸丁酸濃度對梯度添加發酵油茶籽粕呈顯著的二次方響應；同時，異己酸濃度降低。相比之下，添加 5.0% 及以上則對生長、營養物質利用和腸道健康產生負面影響。總體而言，仔豬對發酵油茶籽粕的添加呈現倒 U 型響應，其中 2.5% 被確定為最適合的添加水準。本研究為發酵油茶籽粕作為保育豬飼糧中傳統飼料原料的潛在部分替代物提供了理論基礎。

papers.title: Neonatal Colostrum Intake in Dairy Heifers Can Affect Lactation Performance
papers.abstract: Passive transfer of immunity through colostrum is known to improve short-term health in neonatal dairy calves, but its long-term effects remain poorly understood. Lactational programming proposes that bioactive components in milk and colostrum induce epigenetic changes that influence future performance, although this concept has received limited attention in dairy cattle. The aim of this study was to investigate potential associations between neonatal colostrum intake, as estimated by serum total protein (STP), with subsequent growth, reproductive performance, and milk production in 2661 dairy heifers from five pasture-based dairy herds in South Australia. Blood samples collected within the first 1–7 days of life were used to measure STP as an indicator of passive immunity transfer, and consequently, colostrum intake. Heifers with adequate passive transfer (STP > 50 g/L) produced 0.5, 2.4, and 0.7 kg more milk per day during their first, second, and third lactations, respectively, than heifers with inadequate passive transfer (STP ≤ 50 g/L). In contrast, no meaningful associations were identified between neonatal STP and yearling weight, age at first or subsequent calvings or calving intervals. These findings suggest that adequate colostrum intake enhances lifetime milk production and provide evidence supporting lactocrine programming in dairy cattle.
papers.abstract_zh: 透過初乳進行的被動免疫轉移已知能改善初生乳牛犢的短期健康狀況，但其長期影響仍所知有限。泌乳程式化（lactational programming）假說認為，乳汁與初乳中的生物活性成分會誘導表觀遺傳變異，進而影響未來表現，儘管此概念在乳牛領域受到的關注相當有限。本研究旨在探討初生期初乳攝取量（以血清總蛋白［STP］估算）與南澳洲五個放牧型乳牛場中 2,661 頭女牛隨後之生長、繁殖性能及產乳量之間的潛在關聯。研究使用出生後首 1 至 7 天內採集的血液樣本來測定 STP，作為被動免疫轉移及初乳攝取量的指標。具有充足被動免疫轉移（STP > 50 g/L）的女牛，其第一、第二和第三胎泌乳期中，每日產乳量分別比被動免疫轉移不足（STP ≤ 50 g/L）的女牛多出 0.5、2.4 和 0.7 公斤。相對地，初生期 STP 與週齡體重、初產或隨後分娩年齡以及分娩間距之間並未發現具實質意義的關聯。這些研究結果顯示，充足的初乳攝取量能提升終生產乳量，並提供了支持乳腺分泌程式化（lactocrine programming）於乳牛中存在的證據。

papers.title: Hydrated Nucleus Pulposus Extrusion in Dogs: A Narrative Review of Pathophysiology, Diagnosis, and Clinical Management
papers.abstract: Hydrated nucleus pulposus extrusion (HNPE) is a non-Hansen type of acute canine intervertebral disc herniation: gelatinous, minimally degenerate nuclear material extrudes and forms a well-marginated extradural mass on MRI, the so-called ‘seagull sign’. It differs from classic Hansen type I or II disc disease, typically affecting the cervical spine of small-breed dogs, with spinal hyperaesthesia often mild or absent. This narrative review synthesises the literature on HNPE in dogs, focusing on four clinically relevant comparisons: cervical versus thoracolumbar disease, MRI versus computed tomography for diagnosis, conservative versus surgical management, and the proposed causes of extrusion from a non-degenerate disc. Across the studies reviewed, most dogs recover functionally whether managed surgically or conservatively, and recovery time relates more closely to intramedullary T2-weighted hyperintensity than to treatment choice. Gaps remain: comparative studies are retrospective and non-randomised, so treatment equivalence remains unproven, thoracolumbar cases remain fewer, and the terminology separating HNPE from acute non-compressive nucleus pulposus extrusion (ANNPE) is used inconsistently. We conclude that conservative management is a reasonable first option for ambulatory dogs with compressive HNPE and normal to mild hyperaesthesia, and that surgical decompression remains appropriate for severe or progressive deficits, and we set out priorities for future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 水合髓核擠出（HNPE）是一種非漢森氏型（non-Hansen type）的犬隻急性椎間盤突出：呈膠狀、退化程度極輕微的髓核物質擠出，並在磁振造影（MRI）上形成邊界清晰的硬膜外腫塊，即所謂的「海鷗徵」（seagull sign）。它不同於典型的漢森氏一型或二型椎間盤疾病，通常侵犯小型犬的頸椎，且脊椎神經痛（hyperaesthesia）通常輕微或不存在。本篇敘事性文獻回顧綜合了有關犬類 HNPE 的文獻，並聚焦於四個臨床相關的比較：頸椎與胸腰椎疾病、用於診斷的磁振造影與電腦斷層掃描、保守治療與手術治療，以及從無退化現象的椎間盤中擠出的潛在原因。在所回顧的研究中，無論採取手術或保守治療，大多數犬隻的功能皆能恢復，且恢復時間與髓質內 T2 加權高信號（hyperintensity）的關聯性大於與治療選擇的關聯性。研究缺口仍然存在：比較性研究多為回顧性且非隨機分組，因此治療等效性尚未獲得證實；胸腰椎病例仍然較少；且區分 HNPE 與急性非壓迫性髓核擠出（ANNPE）的術語使用並不一致。我們得出結論：對於具備壓迫性 HNPE 且神經痛程度正常至輕微的具行走能力犬隻，保守治療是合理的首選；而對於嚴重或持續惡化的神經缺損，手術減壓仍然是適當的做法，我們同時也提出了未來研究的優先方向。

papers.title: Whole-Genome Characterization of a G3P[59] Rotavirus A Strain from a Diarrheic Donkey Foal Reveals an Unusual Genomic Background
papers.abstract: Rotavirus A (RVA) is an important enteric pathogen of neonatal animals, whereas the genomic diversity of donkey-origin RVA remains incompletely defined. In 2025, an RVA strain was recovered from a diarrheic donkey foal in Shandong Province, China, and designated RVA/Donkey-wt/CHN/SD2503/2025/G3P[59] (SD2503). Viral RNA was subjected to Illumina NovaSeq paired-end sequencing, de novo assembly, genotype assignment, sequence comparison, and segment-specific maximum-likelihood phylogenetic analysis. Sequences corresponding to all 11 genome segments were recovered, yielding the constellation G3-P[59]-I3-R3-C3-M3-A9-N3-T3-E3-H6. The VP4 gene was highly divergent: the closest BLASTn match was the P[24] rhesus strain TUCH, with 79.58% nucleotide identity, below the 80% threshold used to assign VP4 sequences to the same P genotype. The VP4 sequence was subsequently confirmed by the Rotavirus Classification Working Group as P[59]. Other segments showed discordant relationships. VP7 clustered with rabbit strain rab1404 with strong bootstrap support, whereas several internal genes grouped within genotype backgrounds represented by simian, rabbit, pangolin, equine, and other mammalian RVAs. The topological incongruence across segments, together with the unusual genotype constellation, suggests possible historical reassortment involving cross-species-associated RVA lineages, although the specific reassortment events remain unresolved. SD2503 provides an 11-segment genomic framework for an independently identified donkey G3P[59] RVA and supports broader genomic surveillance of RVA in equids.
papers.abstract_zh: A群輪狀病毒（Rotavirus A, RVA）是新生動物重要的腸道病原體，然而源自驢子的RVA基因體多樣性仍未被完全闡明。2025年，自中國山東省一頭患有腹瀉的驢駒中分離出一株RVA，命名為 RVA/Donkey-wt/CHN/SD2503/2025/G3P[59]（簡稱 SD2503）。對病毒RNA進行Illumina NovaSeq雙端定序、從頭組裝（de novo assembly）、基因型判定、序列比較，以及針對各基因片段的最高似然法（maximum-likelihood）親緣關係分析。本研究獲取了對應全部11個基因片段的序列，其基因型組合（constellation）為 G3-P[59]-I3-R3-C3-M3-A9-N3-T3-E3-H6。其中，VP4基因具有高度分歧性：透過BLASTn比對，最相近的序列為P[24]恆河猴株TUCH，其核苷酸相似性僅為79.58%，低於將VP4序列歸類至同一P基因型的80%閾值。隨後，該VP4序列經輪狀病毒分類工作小組（Rotavirus Classification Working Group）確認為P[59]。其他基因片段則顯示出不一致的親緣關係。VP7在高度的拔靴法（bootstrap）支持下與兔源株rab1404聚類，而多數內部基因則歸類於由猿猴、兔子、穿山甲、馬及其他哺乳動物RVA所代表的基因型背景中。各片段間拓樸結構的不一致性，加上不尋常的基因型組合，暗示其可能經歷了涉及跨物種關聯之RVA譜系的歷史性基因重配（reassortment），儘管具體的重配事件仍待解析。SD2503為一株獨立鑑定的驢源G3P[59] RVA提供了11個基因片段的基因體框架，並支持對馬科動物RVA進行更廣泛的基因體監測。

papers.title: Validation of VHH-Binding Proteins as a Dietary Alternative to Pharmacological Zinc Oxide for the Control of Post-Weaning Diarrhoea in Piglets
papers.abstract: Post-weaning diarrhoea remains a major health and production challenge in pig farming, and effective alternatives to pharmacological zinc oxide are needed. This study evaluated bivalent VHH constructs as a potential dietary alternative to pharmacological zinc oxide under both controlled experimental and commercial production conditions. In Trial 1, 96 weaned piglets were orally challenged with enterotoxigenic Escherichia coli F4+ and received either a control diet, zinc-oxide-supplemented diet, or diet supplemented with bivalent VHH constructs. In Trial 2, 528 piglets were evaluated in a commercial nursery barn using the same dietary groups. In Trial 1, VHH supplementation improved post-challenge growth performance, reduced faecal EHEC counts and increased the lactobacilli-to-EHEC ratio, confirming previous evidence obtained under controlled conditions. Importantly, similar responses were observed under commercial conditions in Trial 2, where VHH-supplemented piglets showed improved faecal scores, higher average daily gain and greater final body weight. Quantile analysis further indicated that the positive response extended to the lower tail of the distribution of pen-level performance. These findings extend previous experimental evidence and demonstrate the efficacy of VHH supplementation under commercial production conditions, supporting its use as a nutritional alternative to pharmacological ZnO during the post-weaning period.
papers.abstract_zh: 斷乳後腹瀉仍是養豬業的一大健康與生產挑戰，亟需尋找具藥理劑量氧化鋅（ZnO）之有效替代方案。本研究評估雙價VHH結構體在控制實驗條件與商業生產條件下，作為飲食中替代藥理劑量氧化鋅之潛力。試驗一中，96頭斷乳仔豬遭受產腸毒素大腸桿菌F4+（ETEC F4+）口服攻毒，並分別餵食對照飼料、添加氧化鋅飼料，或添加雙價VHH結構體飼料。試驗二則在商業保育舍中評估528頭仔豬，採用相同的飲食組別。在試驗一中，補充VHH改善了攻毒後的生長性能、減少了糞便中腸出血性大腸桿菌（EHEC）計數，並提高了乳酸桿菌與EHEC的比率，證實了先前在控制條件下獲得的證據。重要的是，在試驗二的商業條件下也觀察到類似的反應，補充VHH的仔豬表現出較佳的糞便分數、較高的平均日增重以及較大的最終體重。分位數分析進一步表明，此正向反應延伸至欄位表現分佈的底端。這些發現擴展了先前的實驗證據，並證明了VHH補充劑在商業生產條件下的效用，支持其作為斷乳期間替代藥理劑量ZnO之營養替代方案。

papers.title: Effects of Dietary Manganese Levels on Tibia Development, Bone Mineralization, and Cartilage Growth-Related Gene Expression in Squabs
papers.abstract: Manganese (Mn) is indispensable for skeletal development in poultry, yet its dietary requirement for meat pigeons has never been established. This study fed 120 pairs of White King pigeon breeders diets containing 28.43, 63.43, 98.43, 133.43, or 168.43 mg/kg total Mn (0, 35, 70, 105, or 140 mg/kg supplemental Mn) for 53 days to assess effects on reproductive performance, squab tibia development, and epiphyseal cartilage gene expression. Egg hatchability responded quadratically (p = 0.006), peaking at 97.9% in the 98.43 mg/kg group and falling to 83.3% at 168.43 mg/kg. Mn concentration in squab crop contents increased linearly with increasing dietary Mn levels provided to breeders (p = 0.009), indicating greater Mn exposure in the sampled offspring. However, this measurement does not directly quantify Mn transfer through pure crop milk. In 28-day-old squabs, serum alkaline phosphatase (ALP) activity was affected by dietary Mn level (overall treatment effect, p = 0.010) and showed a quadratic response (p = 0.003), with the highest activity observed in the 98.43 mg/kg total dietary Mn group. Tibial strength and maximum deflection did not differ among dietary treatments (p > 0.05). Tibial ash percentage showed a significant treatment effect (p = 0.001) and a linear response to dietary Mn level (p = 0.021), although the difference between the basal and highest-Mn groups was relatively modest (49.9% vs. 46.9%). These findings do not provide sufficient evidence of severe impairment of tibial mineralization at the highest dietary Mn level. In tibial epiphyseal cartilage, fibroblast growth factor 23 (FGF23) mRNA expression at 63.43 mg/kg total dietary Mn was approximately 3.85 times that in the basal group, whereas expression at 98.43~168.43 mg/kg did not differ significantly from the basal group. ETS-related gene (ERG) mRNA expression was approximately 5.63~5.85 times that in the basal group at 63.43~133.43 mg/kg, but expression at 168.43 mg/kg was lower than in these intermediate-dose groups and did not differ significantly from the basal group. Quadratic regression analyses based on replicate-level observations revealed significant relationships between dietary total Mn levels and egg hatchability (R2 = 0.931, p = 0.0155) and relative ERG expression (R2 = 0.783, p = 0.0368). The estimated optimal dietary total Mn levels were 92.63 and 95.34 mg/kg based on egg hatchability and ERG expression, respectively. These findings suggest a preliminary optimal dietary total Mn range of 92.63~95.34 mg/kg for meat pigeons under the conditions of this study, which requires further validation.
papers.abstract_zh: 錳（Mn）對家禽的骨骼發育不可或缺，然而肉鴿對錳的飲食需求量過去從未被確立。本研究以 120 對白王鴿種鴿為試驗對象，餵食總錳含量分別為 28.43、63.43、98.43、133.43 或 168.43 mg/kg（補充錳分別為 0、35、70、105 或 140 mg/kg）的飼糧，為期 53 天，以評估其對繁殖性能、幼鴿脛骨發育及生長板軟骨基因表現的影響。種蛋孵化率呈二次方反應（p = 0.006），在 98.43 mg/kg 組達到 97.9% 的峰值，並在 168.43 mg/kg 時降至 83.3%。幼鴿嗉囊內容物中的錳濃度隨著種鴿飼糧錳水準的增加而呈線性增加（p = 0.009），顯示所採樣的後代暴露於較高的錳量中；然而，此項測定並未直接量化透過純嗉囊乳的錳轉移。在 28 日齡幼鴿中，血清鹼性磷酸酶（ALP）活性受飼糧錳水準影響（整體處理效果，p = 0.010）並呈現二次方反應（p = 0.003），其中以總飼糧錳 98.43 mg/kg 組的活性最高。脛骨強度和最大撓度在各飼糧處理間無顯著差異（p > 0.05）。脛骨灰分百分比顯示出顯著的處理效果（p = 0.001）以及對飼糧錳水準的線性反應（p = 0.021），儘管基礎組與最高錳組之間的差異相對較小（49.9% 對 46.9%）。這些發現並未提供足夠的證據表明最高飼糧錳水準會嚴重損害脛骨礦化。在脛骨生長板軟骨中，總飼糧錳在 63.43 mg/kg 時的纖維母細胞生長因子 23（FGF23）mRNA 表現量約為基礎組的 3.85 倍，而 98.43~168.43 mg/kg 組的表現量與基礎組無顯著差異。在 63.43~133.43 mg/kg 時，ETS 相關基因（ERG）mRNA 表現量約為基礎組的 5.63~5.85 倍，但在 168.43 mg/kg 時的表現量低於這些中劑量組，且與基礎組無顯著差異。基於重複組層級觀察值的二次方迴歸分析顯示，飼糧總錳水準與種蛋孵化率（R2 = 0.931, p = 0.0155）及相對 ERG 表現量（R2 = 0.783, p = 0.0368）之間具有顯著相關性。基於種蛋孵化率和 ERG 表現量估算的最佳飼糧總錳水準分別為 92.63 和 95.34 mg/kg。這些結果表明，在本研究條件下，肉鴿的初步最佳飼糧總錳範圍為 92.63~95.34 mg/kg，此結果尚需進一步驗證。

papers.title: Bacterial Isolates and Antimicrobial Susceptibility Profiles in Mares with Endometritis in Zhangye, China
papers.abstract: Equine endometritis impairs fertility, but regional data remain scarce in Zhangye, Gansu Province, China, a major production base for equine serum-derived biological products. This cross-sectional study investigated endometritis and associated bacterial isolates in 985 mares from five intensive horse farms. Mares with reproductive abnormalities underwent clinical, ultrasonographic, and cytological evaluation. Laboratory investigations included culture of low-volume uterine flush samples, biochemical testing, 16S rRNA gene sequencing, phylogenetic analysis, and antimicrobial susceptibility testing. Among the 156 mares selected for further evaluation, 35 were diagnosed with endometritis. This corresponded to an apparent prevalence of 3.6% in the full surveyed population (35/985; 95% confidence interval, 2.5–4.9%) and a detection rate of 22.4% in the selected subgroup (35/156; 95% confidence interval, 16.2–29.8%). Clinical manifestations were generally subtle. Thirty culture-positive samples yielded 38 isolates across six genera. Escherichia coli, Streptococcus equi subsp. zooepidemicus, and Staphylococcus aureus predominated. A single bacterial taxon was recovered from 22 (73.3%) culture-positive mares, whereas multiple bacterial taxa were recovered from eight (26.7%). Escherichia and Streptococcus isolates showed relatively high resistance, whereas Staphylococcus and Bacillus isolates exhibited lower overall resistance. Limited geographical coverage, small isolate numbers, incomplete antimicrobial-use records, and unexamined resistance genes constrained interpretation. These findings support early screening of mares with reproductive disorders and antimicrobial selection guided by culture and susceptibility testing.
papers.abstract_zh: 馬子宮內膜炎會損害生育能力，但在中國甘肅省張掖市——這個作為馬血清衍生生物製品的主要生產基地——相關的區域數據仍然匱乏。這項橫斷研究調查了來自五個集約化養馬場的 985 匹母馬的子宮內膜炎及相關分離菌株。對具有繁殖異常的母馬進行了臨床、超音波和細胞學評估。實驗室調查包括低量子宮沖洗樣品的培養、生化檢測、16S rRNA 基因定序、系統發生分析以及抗生素敏感性試驗。在選用於進一步評估的 156 匹母馬中，有 35 匹被診斷患有子宮內膜炎。這相當於在整個調查族群中的表面盛行率為 3.6%（35/985；95% 信賴區間，2.5–4.9%），而在選定亞群中的檢出率為 22.4%（35/156；95% 信賴區間，16.2–29.8%）。臨床表徵通常較為輕微。30 個培養陽性樣品產出了來自 6 個屬的 38 株分離株。大腸桿菌（*Escherichia coli*）、獸疫鏈球菌獸疫亞種（*Streptococcus equi* subsp. *zooepidemicus*）和金黃色葡萄球菌（*Staphylococcus aureus*）佔優勢。從 22 匹（73.3%）培養陽性的母馬中分離出單一細菌分類群，而從 8 匹（26.7%）中分離出多種細菌分類群。大腸桿菌和鏈球菌分離株顯示出較高的抗藥性，而葡萄球菌和芽孢桿菌分離株則表現出較低的整體抗藥性。有限的地理覆蓋範圍、少量的分離株數量、不完整的抗生素使用記錄以及未檢測的抗藥性基因限制了解讀性。這些發現支持對具有繁殖障礙的母馬進行早期篩檢，並根據培養和敏感性試驗來指導抗生素的選擇。

papers.title: Audit-Based Deviation Patterns in Trichinella Testing Establishments: Evidence from Southern Spain
papers.abstract: Deviation patterns identified through quality management system (QMS) audits in Trichinella spp. meat inspection may vary across species processed, activity idiosyncrasies and audit scenarios. This study retrospectively analysed 3023 category-level audit records (2012–2018) from 18 supervised Satellite Laboratories (SLs) in southern Spain. Graphical canonical discriminant analysis (GCDA) explored differences in audit-related characteristics across groups defined by species/breed, activity and audit scenario. Following multicollinearity screening, final models retained two variables: auditor combination and audit-derived risk description. Statistically significant differences were identified across groups, although relatively low canonical correlations and record-level cross-validation indicated limited discrimination. Species/breed classification was particularly challenging, with poor identification of Iberian pig records and confusion between wild boar and White pig records. Complementary cluster-aware analyses examined deviation counts, classifications, requirement scopes, deviation types and audit scores, accounting for laboratory–year clustering. These analyses provided additional insights into deviation-related characteristics beyond those retained in the final GCDA. Overall, findings demonstrate the value of routine audit data for characterising QMS implementation across operational contexts and identifying opportunities to strengthen audit practices and support continuous improvement. Although diagnostic effectiveness, detection reliability and meat safety were not directly assessed, these results highlight the complementary role of audit information in QMS monitoring.
papers.abstract_zh: 旋毛蟲屬（Trichinella spp.）肉品檢驗中透過品質管理系統（QMS）稽核所識別出的缺失模式，可能會因加工物種、作業特性及稽核情境而有所不同。本研究回顧性分析了西班牙南部 18 間受監督衛星實驗室（SLs）於 2012 年至 2018 年間共 3023 筆類別層級的稽核紀錄。圖形典型判別分析（GCDA）探討了由物種／品種、作業及稽核情境所定義之群組間，稽核相關特徵的差異。在進行多重共線性篩檢後，最終模型保留了兩個變數：稽核員組合與稽核衍生風險描述。儘管群組間存在統計學上顯著的差異，但相對較低的典型相關性及紀錄層級交叉驗證顯示其鑑別能力有限。物種／品種分類尤其具有挑戰性，伊比利豬紀錄的辨識度差，且野豬與白豬紀錄之間存在混淆。互補的群集感知分析檢視了缺失計數、分類、要求範疇、缺失類型及稽核評分，同時納入了實驗室－年份群集效應。這些分析除了最終 GCDA 所保留的變數外，針對與缺失相關的特徵提供了額外的見解。整體而言，研究結果證明了常規稽核數據對於描繪不同營運情境下 QMS 實施情況、尋找強化稽核實務之機會以及支持持續改善的價值。儘管本研究未直接評估診斷效能、檢測可靠性及肉品安全性，但這些結果突顯了稽核資訊在 QMS 監控中的互補角色。

papers.title: The Genetic Architecture of Behavior in the German Shepherd Dog
papers.abstract: Studying canine behavioral genetics could provide important insights for dog breeding and for understanding both canine and human behavior. To identify genetic determinants of behavior in German Shepherd Dogs, we used a cohort of 373 dogs to search for genome‐wide associations with behavioral variables and personality traits measured by the Dog Mentality Assessment (DMA), a standardized dog behavior evaluation widely used in Sweden. Multidimensional scaling using genetic data revealed two clusters identified by merits as working and show sub‐populations differing in most of their DMA scores. These behavioral differences were strongly correlated with BOLDNESS—a higher‐order trait considered a measure of the shyness‐boldness personality continuum in dogs. A region with highest allele frequency differences between sub‐populations was found on CFA24: 23.5–25.5 Mb containing genes for coat color specification and previously reported candidate regions of selection. The strongest association signals were found for traits/behavioral variables correlating with BOLDNESS as, for example, on CFA1 within a region encompassing the TCF4 gene for which, in humans, multiple associations with neuroticism (a reverse equivalent in humans of BOLDNESS in dogs) were reported. Signals of association were found in regions containing genes with important roles in the nervous system and associations with comparable personality traits, such as neuroticism, in humans. Our results indicate that within‐breed selection in GSDs has had an effect on the shyness‐boldness personality continuum, with working dogs scoring higher in all aspects of BOLDNESS—being more playful, prone to chase after toys, curious, fearless and socially interested in strangers compared with show dogs.
papers.abstract_zh: 研究犬類行為遺傳學能為犬隻育種以及理解犬類與人類的行為提供重要的見解。為了識別德國狼犬（German Shepherd Dogs）行為的遺傳決定因素，我們使用了一個由 373 隻犬組成的世代，來尋找與行為變數及人格特質的基因體全關聯性（genome‐wide associations），這些特質是透過瑞典廣泛使用的標準化犬隻行為評估工具「犬隻心智評估」（Dog Mentality Assessment, DMA）所測得。使用遺傳數據進行的多維尺度分析（multidimensional scaling）顯示出兩個由優勢所識別的群集，分別為工作犬與展覽犬亞群，牠們在大多數 DMA 得分上有所不同。這些行為差異與「勇敢」（BOLDNESS）高度相關——這是一項被認為可用來衡量犬隻害羞－勇敢人格連續體的高階特質。在亞群之間具有最高等位基因頻率差異的區域發現於 CFA24: 23.5–25.5 Mb，該區域包含指定皮毛顏色的基因以及先前報導過的人擇候選區域。最強的關聯訊號發現在與「勇敢」相關的特質／行為變數上，例如在 CFA1 上涵蓋 *TCF4* 基因的區域內；在人類中，該基因已被報導與神經質（neuroticism，在人類中相當於犬類「勇敢」的反向對應特質）有多重關聯。在包含對神經系統具有重要作用之基因的區域中，也發現了關聯訊號，這些基因與人類中可比擬的人格特質（如神經質）有所關聯。我們的結果表明，德國狼犬的品種內選育對害羞－勇敢人格連續體產生了影響，與展覽犬相比，工作犬在「勇敢」的所有面向得分更高——表現得更愛玩、傾向追逐玩具、好奇、無所畏懼，且對陌生人具有更高的社交興趣。

papers.title: Genome-Wide Analysis of Codon Usage Bias of Pseudorabies Virus (PRV)-Responsive Porcine Genes Based on Transcriptome Data
papers.abstract: Pseudorabies virus (PRV) causes Aujeszky’s disease and continues to pose a potential threat to the swine industry. Understanding the codon usage patterns of PRV-responsive porcine genes could shed light on host–virus interactions, evolutionary pressure, and gene expression optimization. In this study, we characterized the codon usage bias (CUB) of 77 PRV-responsive porcine genes identified from published RNA-seq data of PRV type II-infected cells. CUB analysis showed that the compositional bias influenced codon bias. Overall percent T composition is the lowest among all nucleotides. The analyzed genes were GC-rich, with mean GC and GC3s contents of 56.75% and 68.31%, respectively, and generally favored G/C-ending synonymous codons. Odds ratio reveals the overrepresentation of CpT, TpG, and the depletion of TpA. PCA, codon-shuffling, and matched-control analyses further indicated that nucleotide composition, particularly at the third codon position, contributed strongly to the major variation in synonymous codon usage, with 34 of 59 codons differing significantly from length-matched genomic backgrounds. Compared with average Sus scrofa codon usage and length-matched control sets, the codon usage profile of the PRV-responsive porcine genes was significantly shifted, and the neutrality-plot slope of 0.245 (95% CI: 0.157–0.334) was typical of porcine genes. The ENC-GC3s analysis showed substantial deviation from the expected curve, and matched-control analyses confirmed that the GC3 enrichment and codon-usage shift persisted after controlling for gene length and expression status. Overall, these results reveal a GC3-enriched codon usage pattern among porcine host genes strongly induced during PRV infection, significantly shifted relative to matched genomic backgrounds, and provide a basis for further investigation of host–virus interactions, translational regulation, and sequence optimization in PRV-related research.
papers.abstract_zh: 偽狂犬病病毒（PRV）會引起奧傑斯基氏病（Aujeszky’s disease），並持續對養豬產業構成潛在威脅。了解PRV反應性豬隻基因的密碼子使用模式，有助於闡明宿主與病毒的交互作用、演化壓力以及基因表現優化。在本研究中，我們分析了從已發表之PRV II型感染細胞RNA-seq數據中所識別出的77個PRV反應性豬隻基因之密碼子使用偏好性（CUB）。CUB分析顯示，組成偏好性會影響密碼子偏好性。總T鹼基組成百分比在所有核苷酸中最低。被分析的基因富含GC，平均GC和GC3s含量分別為56.75%和68.31%，且普遍偏好以G/C結尾的同義密碼子。勝算比（odds ratio）顯示CpT和TpG有過度代表性，而TpA則有匱乏現象。主成分分析（PCA）、密碼子洗牌（codon-shuffling）及匹配對照分析進一步表明，核苷酸組成（特別是在密碼子第三個位置）對同義密碼子使用的主要變異有顯著貢獻，在59個密碼子中有34個與長度匹配的基因組背景存在顯著差異。與平均家豬（Sus scrofa）密碼子使用及長度匹配對照組相比，PRV反應性豬隻基因的密碼子使用概況發生了顯著偏移，其中性圖（neutrality-plot）斜率為0.245（95% CI：0.157–0.334），符合豬隻基因的典型特徵。ENC-GC3s分析顯示其與預期曲線有顯著偏離，且匹配對照分析證實，在控制基因長度和表現狀態後，GC3富集和密碼子使用偏移現象仍然存在。總體而言，這些結果揭示了在PRV感染期間被強烈誘導的豬隻宿主基因具有富含GC3的密碼子使用模式，相較於匹配的基因組背景有顯著偏移，並為進一步研究PRV相關研究中的宿主與病毒交互作用、轉譯調控及序列優化提供了基礎。

papers.title: ZBED6 deletion activates FNDC1-mediated PI3K/AKT and MAPK/ERK1/2 signaling pathways to promote myogenesis in pigs
papers.abstract: Background Myogenesis is a tightly regulated biological process that is essential for skeletal muscle growth, regeneration, and livestock production. Although the transcription factor ZBED6 is a key regulator of skeletal muscle development, the downstream molecular mechanisms through which it controls myogenesis remain incompletely understood. Here, using ZBED6-deficient pigs and primary porcine skeletal muscle satellite cells, we sought to identify novel downstream targets of ZBED6 and elucidate the molecular mechanisms underlying ZBED6-mediated regulation of myogenesis. Results By integrating transcriptomic, quantitative proteomic, and ChIP-seq datasets, we identified fibronectin type III domain-containing protein 1 (FNDC1), a muscle-derived secreted factor, as a previously unrecognized direct transcriptional target of ZBED6. ChIP-qPCR and dual-luciferase reporter assays showed that ZBED6 directly binds to the FNDC1 promoter and represses its transcription. Functional analyses in primary porcine skeletal muscle satellite cells showed that ZBED6 knockdown markedly promoted myoblast proliferation, differentiation, and myotube formation, whereas FNDC1 knockdown partially attenuated these effects. Conversely, FNDC1 overexpression partially rescued the impaired myogenesis caused by ZBED6 overexpression. Mechanistically, ZBED6 deficiency promoted porcine myoblast proliferation and differentiation, at least in part, through FNDC1 -mediated activation of the PI3K/AKT and MAPK/ERK1/2 signaling pathways. Consistently, pharmacological inhibition of either pathway significantly attenuated the enhanced porcine myoblast proliferation and differentiation induced by ZBED6 deficiency, supporting that activation of these signaling pathways contributes in part to the pro-myogenic effects mediated by the ZBED6-FNDC1 regulatory axis in porcine myoblasts. Conclusions This study identifies FNDC1 as a novel direct transcriptional target of ZBED6, supporting the ZBED6-FNDC1 axis as a regulatory mechanism contributing to porcine myoblast proliferation and differentiation. These findings expand the current understanding of the ZBED6 regulatory network and provide a cellular framework for future studies investigating skeletal muscle growth in vivo.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Science and Biotechnology
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：肌肉生成是一個受到嚴密調控的生物學過程，對骨骼肌生長、再生以及家畜生產至關重要。儘管轉錄因子 ZBED6 是骨骼肌發育的關鍵調節因子，但其控制肌肉生成下游的分子機制仍未完全闡明。在此，我們利用 ZBED6 缺陷豬和原代豬骨骼肌衛星細胞，旨在識別 ZBED6 的新型下游標靶，並闡明 ZBED6 介導肌肉生成調節的底層分子機制。結果：透過整合轉錄體學、定量蛋白質體學和 ChIP-seq 數據集，我們將纖維結合蛋白 III 型域包含蛋白 1 (FNDC1，一種肌肉來源的分泌因子) 識別為先前未被發現的 ZBED6 直接轉錄標靶。ChIP-qPCR 和雙螢光素酶報告基因分析顯示，ZBED6 直接結合至 FNDC1 啟動子並抑制其轉錄。在原代豬骨骼肌衛星細胞中的功能分析表明，ZBED6 基因 knockdown（表現抑制）顯著促進了肌原細胞的增殖、分化和肌管形成，而 FNDC1 的 knockdown 則部分減弱了這些效應。相反地，FNDC1 的過度表現部分挽救了由 ZBED6 過度表現所引起的肌肉生成受損。在機制上，ZBED6 缺陷至少部分透過 FNDC1 介導的 PI3K/AKT 和 MAPK/ERK1/2 信號通路活化，促進了豬肌原細胞的增殖與分化。一致地，對任一信號通路的藥理學抑制均顯著減弱了由 ZBED6 缺陷所誘導的豬肌原細胞增殖與分化的增強效果，支持了這些信號通路的活化部分促成了豬肌原細胞中由 ZBED6-FNDC1 調節軸所介導的促肌肉生成效應。結論：本研究將 FNDC1 識別為 ZBED6 的一個新型直接轉錄標靶，支持 ZBED6-FNDC1 軸作為促進豬肌原細胞增殖與分化的調節機制。這些發現擴展了當前對 ZBED6 調節網絡的理解，並為未來研究活體骨骼肌生長的細胞學研究提供了框架。

papers.title: Association Between Body Condition Score and Early Radiographic Osteotomy Healing Following Tibial Plateau Leveling Osteotomy in Dogs: A Retrospective Study
papers.abstract: Body condition may be associated with postoperative orthopedic outcomes, but its relationship with early radiographic osteotomy healing following tibial plateau leveling osteotomy (TPLO) remains unclear. This retrospective study evaluated the association between preoperative body condition score (BCS) and early radiographic outcomes after TPLO for canine cranial cruciate ligament disease. Seventy-six stifles from 68 dogs with eligible radiographs obtained 42–70 days postoperatively were included. Radiographic osteotomy healing was assessed using a TPLO-specific modified Radiographic Union Scale for Tibial fractures (mRUST), and tibial plateau angle (TPA) was measured preoperatively, immediately postoperatively, and at follow-up. Seventy-one stifles were evaluable for mRUST and 72 for follow-up TPA. Higher BCS was associated with lower mRUST after adjustment for age, body weight, and follow-up interval (β = −0.433 per BCS point; 95% CI, −0.565 to −0.301; p < 0.001). Higher BCS was also associated with a modestly greater postoperative TPA change in the prespecified secondary analysis (β = +0.340° per BCS point; 95% CI, 0.021–0.659; p = 0.037). Higher preoperative BCS was associated with lower early radiographic osteotomy healing scores and a greater increase in TPA during follow-up after TPLO.
papers.abstract_zh: 體態可能與術後骨科預后相關，但其與脛骨高原平整術（TPLO）後早期放射學截骨癒合的關係仍不清楚。本回顧性研究評估術前體態評分（BCS）與犬隻前十字韌帶疾病接受TPLO後早期放射學預后之間的關聯。納入了68隻犬的76個膝關節，其具備術後42至70天獲得的合格X光片。使用TPLO專用的改良式脛骨骨折癒合評分量表（mRUST）評估放射學截骨癒合情況，並在術前、術後立即及追蹤時測量脛骨高原角（TPA）。76個膝關節中有71個可評估mRUST，72個可評估追蹤TPA。在調整年齡、體重和追蹤間隔後，較高的BCS與較低的mRUST相關（每個BCS分點之 $\beta = -0.433$；95% CI, $-0.565$ 至 $-0.301$；$p < 0.001$）。在預先指定的次要分析中，較高的BCS亦與較大的術後TPA變化幅度輕度相關（每個BCS分點之 $\beta = +0.340^\circ$；95% CI, $0.021$ 至 $0.659$；$p = 0.037$）。較高的術前BCS與TPLO後較低的早期放射學截骨癒合評分以及追蹤期間較大的TPA增加量相關。

papers.title: Temporal Dynamics of Reproductive Activity and Sexual Group Maturity of Octopus minor in the Deukryang Bay, Southern Coast of Korea
papers.abstract: This study was performed to obtain basic information for the resource management and conservation of Octopus minor, one of the important fishery resources in Korea. O. minor used in this study were collected monthly from May 2022 to August 2023 using a drum-shaped net in Deukryang Bay, southern coast of Korea. The overall sex ratio (female:male) of O. minor was 1:1.03 (n = 322; females = 159, males = 163), with a significantly higher proportion of males at a total weight of 150.1 g and above (p < 0.05). The gonadosomatic index (GSI) of females reached its highest value in July, whereas the reproductive complex index (RCI) showed its lowest value. In males, the RCI reached its highest values in June and July, showing a variation pattern opposite to that of the GSI. Although the timing of changes in GSI, RCI, and gonadal morphology and histology differed between females and males, both sexes exhibited clear seasonal patterns. The main mating and spawning season was estimated as summer (July–August). The oocyte development pattern was synchronous, while the spawning pattern was monocyclic with strict seasonality. The size at 50% sexual group maturity of O. minor was estimated at a total weight and mantle length of 49.5 g and 43.6 mm in females, and 49.7 g and 41.9 mm in males. The information on the main spawning season and size at 50% sexual group maturity obtained from the O. minor population in Deukryang Bay, Korea, can be used to establish a prohibited fishing season and size limit for resource management.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在獲取可用於韓國重要漁業資源之一的小章魚（Octopus minor）資源管理與保育之基礎資訊。本研究所使用的小章魚於2022年5月至2023年8月期間，自韓國南岸得良灣（Deukryang Bay）利用筒型網逐月採集。小章魚的整體性比（雌：雄）為 1:1.03（n = 322；雌性 = 159，雄性 = 163），其中在總重量達 150.1 克及以上的個體中，雄性比例顯著較高（p < 0.05）。雌性生殖腺重量指數（GSI）在 7 月達到最高值，而生殖複合體指數（RCI）則呈現最低值。在雄性方面，RCI 在 6 月和 7 月達到最高值，展現出與 GSI 相反的變動模式。儘管雌雄兩性在 GSI、RCI 以及生殖腺形態學和組織學的變化時間上有所不同，但兩性皆表現出明確的季節性模式。主要交配與產卵期估計為夏季（7月至8月）。卵母細胞發育模式為同步型，而產卵模式則為具嚴格季節性的單次產卵型。小章魚達 50% 性成熟群體的體型，在雌性為總重量 49.5 克、胴長 43.6 毫米；在雄性則為總重量 49.7 克、胴長 41.9 毫米。自韓國得良灣小章魚族群所獲得的主要產卵期及 50% 性成熟群體體型等資訊，可用於制定資源管理的禁漁期與體型限制。

papers.title: Integrating Camera-Trap Monitoring and Community Surveys to Assess Human–Asian Badger (Meles leucurus) Interactions in Agricultural Landscapes of the Meng Mountains, China
papers.abstract: Human–wildlife interactions can threaten rural livelihoods and complicate wildlife conservation in agricultural landscapes. We combined community surveys and camera-trap monitoring as complementary sources of information to assess human–Asian badger (Meles leucurus) interactions across four sites in the Meng Mountains, China. We surveyed 400 residents and monitored 82 camera-trap stations from April 2024 to August 2026, representing 72,406 trap-nights. Reported encounter frequency differed significantly among study sites (χ2 = 139.36, p < 0.001), with evening and autumn most frequently reported. Agricultural land ownership was associated with reported crop damage (χ2 = 16.64, p = 0.0002), while livestock ownership was associated with both reported crop damage (χ2 = 36.23, p < 0.001) and conflict awareness (χ2 = 60.47, p < 0.001). Camera traps recorded 103 independent detections at 52 of 82 targeted stations (detection proportion = 0.63). Because stations were selected where badger occurrence was suspected, this proportion should not be interpreted as landscape-wide occupancy. Detections differed among diurnal, crepuscular, and nocturnal periods (χ2 = 14.99, p < 0.001), with greater representation during diurnal and crepuscular periods. Together, the ecological and questionnaire data provide complementary evidence on badger occurrence, agricultural exposure, livelihood activities, and human perceptions relevant to reported human–badger conflict. Integrating ecological monitoring with community information may help inform targeted, non-lethal conflict mitigation and coexistence planning.
papers.abstract_zh: 人與野生動物的互動可能會威脅農村生計，並使農業景觀中的野生動物保育工作變得複雜。我們結合了社區調查與紅外線自動相機監測作為互補的資訊來源，以評估中國蒙山四個樣點的人與亞洲獾（Meles leucurus）之間的互動。我們於2024年4月至2026年8月間調查了400名居民，並監測了82個相機站位，相當於72,406個相機日。通報的相遇頻率在各研究樣點間存在顯著差異（$\chi^2 = 139.36, p < 0.001$），其中以傍晚和秋季通報頻率最高。農地所有權與通報的農作物受損有關（$\chi^2 = 16.64, p = 0.0002$），而牲畜所有權則同時與通報的農作物受損（$\chi^2 = 36.23, p < 0.001$）及衝突意識（$\chi^2 = 60.47, p < 0.001$）有關。紅外線相機在82個目標站位中的52個站位記錄到103次獨立偵測（偵測比例為0.63）。由於相機站位是選在懷疑有亞洲獾出沒的地點，因此該比例不應被解讀為全景觀的佔用率。日行性、曙暮性與夜間的偵測次數有所不同（$\chi^2 = 14.99, p < 0.001$），其中以日行性和曙暮性時段的記錄佔比較高。生態與問卷數據共同提供了關於亞洲獾出沒、農業暴露、生計活動以及與通報之人獾衝突相關的人類觀感的互補證據。將生態監測與社區資訊相結合，將有助於為具針對性、非致命的衝突減緩及共存規劃提供參考。

papers.title: Deep Learning for Snake Species Identification to Support Snakebite Treatment: A Comparative Study of Efficient CNN and Vision Transformer Architectures
papers.abstract: Snakebite envenoming is a neglected tropical disease that affects millions of people each year, and species identification is a critical component in choosing the correct antivenom. In this study, six convolutional neural network and vision transformer architectures are compared for the image-based snake species classification task on the SnakeCLEF 2024 dataset, which contains 1599 snake species observed in 209 countries. We use knowledge distillation to boost accuracy without increasing inference cost, and incorporate country-level geographic location through a closed-form Bayesian fusion of the classifier’s output with location-conditioned species-occurrence priors. Location fusion reduced the classification error rate by over 40% across all architectures, and knowledge distillation provided a further improvement. The best model, CAFormer-S18, obtained an accuracy of 81.71% using both image and country-level location. We also compare the single-image inference latency on a smartphone and a Raspberry Pi 5, revealing that the latency of real-world, on-device deployments is significantly influenced by the interplay of model architecture and inference toolchain. Our top-performing model can infer in about 1 s on both devices, demonstrating that fine-grained species identification of snakes is feasible for real-time use in snakebite treatment and, when combined with an additional object detection stage, in wildlife monitoring.
papers.abstract_zh: 蛇咬傷中毒是一種被忽視的熱帶疾病，每年影響數百萬人，而物種辨識是選擇正確抗蛇毒血清的關鍵環節。在本研究中，我們針對 SnakeCLEF 2024 資料集（包含在 209 個國家中觀察到的 1599 種蛇類）的基於影像之蛇類物種分類任務，比較了六種卷積神經網路與視覺轉換器架構。我們使用知識蒸餾來提升準確率而不增加推論成本，並透過將分類器輸出與國家層級的地點條件物種出現先驗機率進行封閉式貝氏融合，納入了國家層級的地理位置。地點融合使所有架構的分類錯誤率降低了 40% 以上，而知識蒸餾則帶來了進一步的改善。表現最好的模型 CAFormer-S18 同時使用影像與國家層級地點時，獲得了 81.71% 的準確率。我們亦比較了智慧型手機和 Raspberry Pi 5 上的單張影像推論延遲，結果顯示現實世界中裝置端部署的延遲顯著受到模型架構與推論工具鏈交互作用的影響。我們表現最佳的模型在兩款裝置上皆可以大約 1 秒的時間完成推論，這證明瞭細粒度的蛇類物種辨識適用於蛇咬傷治療的即時使用，且若結合額外的物件偵測階段，亦可應用於野生動物監測。

papers.title: A Newly Established Fin Cell Line from Tomato Hind (Cephalopholis sonnerati) and Transcriptome Profiling Characterizing Its Response to Vibrio harveyi Infection
papers.abstract: The tomato hind (Cephalopholis sonnerati) is an emerging mariculture species increasingly threatened by Vibrio harveyi infection, yet in vitro tools for studying its immune defense remain limited. Here, we established a novel fin-derived fibroblast-like cell line, designated Tomato hind Grouper Fin (TGF), from C. sonnerati using the tissue explant method. TGF cells have been stably subcultured for more than 83 passages in Leibovitz’s L-15 medium supplemented with 20% fetal bovine serum at 28 °C. Species authentication via mt-co1 barcoding confirmed 99.9% sequence identity, and karyotype analysis revealed a diploid chromosome number of 2n = 48, matching the donor species. TGF cells exhibited robust post-thaw viability (>80%) and were amenable to exogenous nucleic acid delivery, with higher efficiency for siRNA than plasmid DNA. To evaluate immune competence, TGF cells were challenged with V. harveyi, and transcriptomic profiling was performed at 60, 90, and 120 min post-infection. A total of 1876 differentially expressed genes were identified at 120 min. KEGG enrichment analysis revealed sustained activation of Toll-like receptor, NOD-like receptor, NF-κB, TNF, and IL-17 signaling pathways across all time points. The TGF cell line represents a valuable in vitro resource for studying host–pathogen interactions of C. sonnerati.
papers.abstract_zh: 紅斑格（Cephalopholis sonnerati）是一種新興的海水養殖魚種，正面臨哈維氏弧菌（Vibrio harveyi）感染日益嚴重的威脅，然而用於研究其免疫防禦的體外（in vitro）工具仍然有限。本研究利用組織塊培養法，從紅斑格建立了一個全新的鰭源成纖維細胞樣細胞株，命名為紅斑格石斑魚鰭細胞（Tomato hind Grouper Fin, TGF）。TGF 細胞在含有 20% 胎牛血清的 Leibovitz’s L-15 培養基中、28 °C 條件下已穩定繼代超過 83 代。透過 mt-co1 DNA條形碼進行物種鑑定，確認其序列相似度達 99.9%；核型分析顯示其二倍體染色體數為 2n = 48，與供體物種相符。TGF 細胞展現出良好的解凍後存活率（>80%），且適合外源性核酸遞送，其中 siRNA 的轉染效率高於質體 DNA。為評估其免疫能力，本研究以哈維氏弧菌攻擊 TGF 細胞，並在感染後 60、90 和 120 分鐘進行轉錄體分析。在 120 分鐘時共鑑定出 1876 個差異表現基因。KEGG 富集分析顯示，Toll 樣受體、NOD 樣受體、NF-κB、TNF 和 IL-17 等信號傳遞途徑在所有時間點皆持續被活化。TGF 細胞株為研究紅斑格宿主與病原體交互作用提供了一項寶貴的體外研究資源。

papers.title: Free-Ranging Cat Predation on Wildlife in East Asia: A Scoping Review of Ecological Evidence and Knowledge Gaps
papers.abstract: Free-ranging domestic cats (Felis catus) interact with wildlife through predation and other ecological pathways, yet evidence of their associated effects has not been comprehensively synthesized in East Asia. This scoping review mapped empirical evidence on free-ranging cat predation and associated ecological effects in East Asia, characterized its geographic distribution and inferential strength, and identified knowledge gaps. Five databases, including region-specific databases, were searched through June 2026, and reference lists of included full-text sources were hand-searched. Of 9326 records identified, 31 sources met the inclusion criteria: 28 from the pre-specified East Asian region and 3 global or multinational sources with independently extractable East Asia-specific data. Diet- and carcass-based studies documented consumption of diverse wildlife taxa, whereas fewer evaluated prey abundance or other population-level outcomes. Reported predation estimates varied substantially among studies, reflecting differences in cat category, ecological setting, and methodology. Evidence was concentrated in Japan, with the clearest conservation concerns reported from Japanese island ecosystems involving endemic or IUCN-listed threatened species. Human-mediated factors and management practices were recurrent contextual themes; however, direct evidence linking these factors to wildlife outcomes was limited. Overall, the evidence base was geographically and methodologically uneven, underscoring the need for standardization, broader regional coverage, and improved documentation.
papers.abstract_zh: 放山家貓（Felis catus）透過掠食及其他生態途徑與野生動物互動，然而其相關影響的證據尚未在東亞進行全面綜合。本範疇性文獻回顧（scoping review）旨在梳理東亞地區有關放山貓掠食及其相關生態影響的實證資料、描繪其地理分佈與推論強度，並識別知識缺口。本研究檢索了包括區域專屬資料庫在內的五個資料庫（截至2026年6月），並手動檢索了納入之全文文獻的參考文獻列表。在識別出的9,326筆記錄中，有31篇文獻符合納入標準：28篇來自預先指定的東亞地區，3篇為可獨立萃取東亞專屬資料的全球性或跨國文獻。基於食性與屍體的研究記錄了貓隻對多樣化野生動物分類群的消耗，但評估獵物豐度或其他族群層面結果的研究較少。研究所報告的掠食估計值差異甚大，反映出貓隻類別、生態環境與方法的差異。證據集中於日本，其中最明確的保育疑慮來自涉及特有種或IUCN列名受脅物種的日本島嶼生態系。人為因素與管理實務是反覆出現的背景主題；然而，將這些因素與野生動物結果直接連結的證據相當有限。整體而言，現有證據基礎在地理分佈與方法學上存在落差，凸顯了標準化、擴大區域涵蓋範圍以及改進記錄方式的迫切需求。

papers.title: Still Valid: Clearance of Pseudocapillaroides xenopi from a Xenopus laevis Colony Using the 1997 Levamisole Immersion Protocol
papers.abstract: Pseudocapillaroides xenopi is a capillariid nematode of the epidermis of Xenopus spp. and a cause of “flaky” or “gray skin disease” in laboratory colonies. The only published regimen for eradicating it from an entire colony, which is a levamisole immersion, dates from 1997. We report its unmodified application in a colony of approximately 480 adult female X. laevis. An index animal with pale, roughened skin and severe weight loss was diagnosed by PCR. Screening all 42 cohabitants of three tanks each holding one animal with macroscopic skin abnormalities gave a prevalence of 21.4% (9/42), with seven of them clinically inconspicuous. Two four-day levamisole baths (12 mg/L) ten days apart, with tank cleaning and dedicated equipment, were applied colony-wide. Post-treatment skin scrapings were negative in 42/42 animals, gross lesions resolved, body weight was maintained and no further cases have occurred. The 1997 protocol remains fully effective. As the untreated infection is ultimately fatal and the alternative to treatment is depopulation, a regimen that reliably clears a colony is also a refinement.
papers.abstract_zh: Pseudocapillaroides xenopi 是一種會寄生於爪蟾屬（Xenopus spp.）表皮的毛細線蟲，也是實驗動物群體中引起「鱗片狀」或「灰皮膚病」的病因。目前唯一發表可用於從整個群體中根除該寄生蟲的療程為左旋咪唑（levamisole）浸泡法，發表於 1997 年。我們報導了該方案在一個約有 480 隻成年雌性非洲爪蟾（X. laevis）群體中的未修改應用。透過 PCR 診斷出一隻具有皮膚蒼白、粗糙且體重嚴重下降的指標動物。篩檢了三個飼養槽中共 42 隻同居動物（每槽各有一隻具有肉眼可見皮膚異常的動物），盛行率為 21.4%（9/42），其中 7 隻在臨床上並無顯著症狀。全群實施了兩次為期四天、間隔十天的左旋咪唑藥浴（12 mg/L），並配合清洗飼槽及專用設備。治療後，42/42 隻動物的皮膚刮片檢查結果皆為陰性，巨觀病灶消失，體重維持正常，且未再發生其他病例。1997 年的方案依然完全有效。由於未治療的感染最終會致命，且治療的替代方案是撲殺，因此能夠可靠地清除群體感染的療程同時也是一種動物福利的精進（refinement）。
