papers.title: Cervical Neutrophil Infiltration in Relation to Macroscopic Cervix Appearance, Cytological Endometritis, and Reproductive Stage in Postpartum Grazing Dairy Cows
papers.abstract: The bovine cervix undergoes endocrine-dependent physiological changes that may influence local immune activity and complicate the interpretation of cervical inflammation. This study evaluated the relationships among macroscopic cervical appearance, cervical neutrophil infiltration, reproductive stage, and endometrial inflammation in postpartum grazing dairy cows. Non-pregnant lactating Holstein × Jersey crossbred cows (n = 80) ≥ 45 days in milk underwent reproductive examination, cervical video-endoscopy, ultrasonography, cervical and endometrial cytology, and serum progesterone determination. Macroscopic cervical appearance was classified as C0, C1, or C2, whereas cervical polymorphonuclear neutrophil (PMN) percentage was analyzed as the primary proportional outcome using adjusted fractional logistic regression. A ≥5% cervical PMN threshold was used operationally for secondary analyses. C0, C1, and C2 occurred in 30.0%, 50.0%, and 20.0% of cows, respectively, and 20.0% had cervical PMN ≥ 5%. Macroscopic cervical appearance was not associated with cervical PMN percentage (p = 0.931) or cervical PMN ≥ 5% (p = 1.000). Cervical PMN percentage was higher in follicular-stage than in luteal-stage cows (p < 0.001). This association persisted after adjustment for parity and cytological endometritis using fractional logistic regression (β = 2.42; 95% CI, 0.81–4.03; p = 0.003), with an adjusted marginal difference of 10.48 percentage points (95% CI, 1.42–19.54; p = 0.023). A complementary two-part analysis supported this association, showing higher odds of detectable cervical PMNs (OR = 4.71; 95% CI, 1.73–12.82; p = 0.002) and higher mean PMN proportions among positive observations (mean ratio = 4.11; 95% CI, 1.40–12.06; p = 0.010) during the follicular stage. In secondary Firth penalized logistic regression, follicular stage remained associated with cervical PMN ≥ 5% (aOR = 5.38; 95% CI, 1.39–20.83; p = 0.015). Cervical and endometrial PMN percentages were weakly positively correlated (ρ = 0.240; p = 0.033), while agreement between cervical PMN ≥ 5% and cytological endometritis was limited (κ = 0.258). Neither cervical neutrophil infiltration nor cytological endometritis was associated with subsequent pregnancy, whereas serum progesterone concentration showed a positive exploratory association with pregnancy. Cervical neutrophil infiltration is associated with reproductive stage independently of parity and cytological endometritis, without relying on an unvalidated diagnostic threshold. Cervical cytology should therefore be interpreted within the reproductive and physiological context of the cow.
papers.abstract_zh: 牛子宮頸會經歷內分泌依賴性的生理變化，這些變化可能會影響局部的免疫活性，並使子宮頸發炎的判讀變得複雜。本研究評估了分娩後放牧乳牛的巨觀子宮頸外觀、子宮頸嗜中性球浸潤、繁殖階段以及子宮內膜炎之間的關係。選取泌乳天數 $\ge$ 45 天、未懷孕的荷斯登 $\times$ 澤西混種泌乳牛（$n = 80$），進行繁殖檢查、子宮頸視訊內視鏡檢查、超音波檢查、子宮頸與子宮內膜細胞學檢查，以及血清黃體素測定。巨觀子宮頸外觀分為 C0、C1 或 C2 型，而子宮頸多形核嗜中性球（PMN）百分比則作為主要的比例結果，以校正的分數邏輯斯迴歸（fractional logistic regression）進行分析。次要分析則採用 $\ge$ 5% 的子宮頸 PMN 閾值作為操作性定義。C0、C1 和 C2 型的發生率分別為 30.0%、50.0% 和 20.0%，且有 20.0% 的牛隻子宮頸 PMN $\ge$ 5%。巨觀子宮頸外觀與子宮頸 PMN 百分比（$p = 0.931$）或子宮頸 PMN $\ge$ 5%（$p = 1.000$）無顯著關聯。濾泡期牛隻的子宮頸 PMN 百分比高於黃體期牛隻（$p < 0.001$）。在使用分數邏輯斯迴歸校正胎次與細胞學子宮內膜炎後，此關聯仍然存在（$\beta = 2.42$；95% 信賴區間，0.81–4.03；$p = 0.003$），校正後的邊際差為 10.48 個百分點（95% 信賴區間，1.42–19.54；$p = 0.023$）。補充性的兩部分分析支持此關聯，顯示在濾泡期期間，可偵測到子宮頸 PMN 的勝算較高（勝算比 $\text{OR} = 4.71$；95% 信賴區間，1.73–12.82；$p = 0.002$），且在陽性觀察值中的平均 PMN 比例也較高（平均比值 $= 4.11$；95% 信賴區間，1.40–12.06；$p = 0.010$）。在次要的佛斯懲罰邏輯斯迴歸（Firth penalized logistic regression）中，濾泡期仍與子宮頸 PMN $\ge$ 5% 相關（校正勝算比 $\text{aOR} = 5.38$；95% 信賴區間，1.39–20.83；$p = 0.015$）。子宮頸與子宮內膜的 PMN 百分比呈微弱的正相關（$\rho = 0.240$；$p = 0.033$），而子宮頸 PMN $\ge$ 5% 與細胞學子宮內膜炎之間的一致性有限（$\kappa = 0.258$）。子宮頸嗜中性球浸潤與細胞學子宮內膜炎皆與隨後的妊娠無顯著關聯，而血清黃體素濃度則與妊娠呈現探索性的正相關。子宮頸嗜中性球浸潤與繁殖階段相關，此關係獨立於胎次與細胞學子宮內膜炎之外，且不依賴未經驗證的診斷閾值。因此，子宮頸細胞學檢查結果應在乳牛的繁殖與生理脈絡下進行判讀。

papers.title: Predicting the Dietary Metabolizable Energy and Crude Protein Levels of 1- to 70-Day-Old Hy-Line Brown Male Chicks Using Response Surface Methodology and Artificial Neural Network Models
papers.abstract: To determine dietary metabolizable energy (ME) and crude protein (CP) levels of Hy-Line Brown male chicks and compare response surface methodology (RSM) with artificial neural network (ANN) modeling, a total of 2160 birds were assigned to a 4 × 3 factorial design with three growth stages. Both RSM and ANN were fitted to predict body weight gain (BWG) and feed-to-gain ratio (F/G), with performance evaluated via LOOCV, leave-2-treatments-out validation, and bootstrap resampling. The 22–56-day stage yielded the best model performance overall. For F/G, both models achieved strong and comparable fit (in-sample R2 ≈ 0.86–0.88; LOOCV retention ≈ 97%), and both remained predictive under leave-2-treatments-out validation (RSM R2 = 0.72, ANN R2 = 0.45). For BWG, model performance was weaker, and ANN’s apparent in-sample advantage over RSM (R2 = 0.585 vs. 0.388 at 22–56 d) did not hold under leave-2-treatments-out validation (ANN R2 = −12.7 vs. RSM R2 = −0.24). Lastly, multi-objective optimization combining both models predicted stage-specific nutrient combinations. The results of this study provide empirical support and a methodological reference for establishing stage-specific nutritional standards for Hy-Line Brown male chicks.
papers.abstract_zh: 為測定海蘭褐（Hy-Line Brown）公雏之日糧代謝能（ME）與粗蛋白（CP）需量，並比較反應面法（RSM）與人工神經網路（ANN）之建模效果，本研究將 2160 隻雛鳥依 4 × 3 因子設計分配至三個生長期。同時擬合 RSM 與 ANN 以預測體重增量（BWG）與料肉比（F/G），並透過留一法交叉驗證（LOOCV）、留二處理交叉驗證及拔靴重抽法（bootstrap resampling）評估其效能。22–56 日齡階段之整體模型表現最佳。在 F/G 方面，兩者皆達到強大且相當的擬合度（樣本內 $R^2 \approx 0.86\text{–}0.88$；LOOCV 保留率 $\approx 97\%$），且在留二處理交叉驗證下仍具預測力（RSM $R^2 = 0.72$、ANN $R^2 = 0.45$）。在 BWG 方面，模型表現較弱，且 ANN 在 22–56 日齡時相對於 RSM 的明顯樣本內優勢（$R^2 = 0.585$ 對 $0.388$）在留二處理交叉驗證中並不成立（ANN $R^2 = -12.7$ 對 RSM $R^2 = -0.24$）。最後，結合兩者之多目標最佳化預測出各生長階段之營養素組合。本研究結果為建立海蘭褐公雛分階段營養標準提供了實證支持與方法學參考。

papers.title: In Vitro Functional Characterization of the -143A>C Variant in the Porcine DLD Promoter and Its Modulation of KLF2-Dependent Repression and Myoblast Phenotypes
papers.abstract: Meat quality in pigs is fundamentally shaped by the relative abundance and metabolic properties of distinct skeletal muscle fiber types. Dihydrolipoyl dehydrogenase (DLDH), an indispensable catalytic subunit of mitochondrial dehydrogenase complexes, has been documented to link with myocyte development; nevertheless, the effects of the causal regulatory variants governing transcription of its encoding gene DLD on the myogenic fate remain largely uncharacterized. In this study, comparative polymorphism analysis between Large White and Min pigs uncovered a regulatory single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) at position -143A>C within the porcine DLD promoter. Mechanistic dissection using dual-luciferase reporter, electrophoretic mobility shift, and chromatin immunoprecipitation assays revealed that the C allele strengthens Krüppel-like factor 2 (KLF2) DNA-binding affinity and potentiates KLF2-mediated transcriptional repression, leading to significantly reduced DLD expression. Functional characterization in porcine primary myoblasts demonstrated that DLD promotes myoblast proliferation by accelerating G2/M transition and upregulating cell-cycle regulators while suppressing terminal differentiation. Furthermore, DLD overexpression inhibited slow-twitch (myosin heavy chain (MYH) 7-positive) myogenic differentiation and suppressed the expression of myogenic regulatory factors MYOD and MYOG, whereas DLD knockdown produced converse effects. Taken together, these multiple lines of evidence suggest that the −143 A>C variant may reinforce transcriptional repression of DLD by increasing KLF2-binding occupancy. Because reduced DLD expression favors MYH7-positive myotube formation in our myoblast assays, this variant is hypothesized to influence myotube subtype balance. These findings may provide a potential molecular mechanism contributing to pork-quality variation and suggest the −143 A>C variant on the DLD promoter as a candidate marker for future genomic-selection studies.
papers.abstract_zh: 豬隻的肉質主要取決於不同骨骼肌纖維類型的相對豐度與代謝特性。二氫硫辛酸脫氫酶（Dihydrolipoyl dehydrogenase, DLDH）作為粒線體脫氫酶複合體中不可或缺的催化次單位，已被記錄與肌細胞發育有關；然而，調控其編碼基因 *DLD* 轉錄之因果調節變異對肌源性命運的影響仍屬未知。在本研究中，對大白豬與版納微型豬進行比較多型性分析，在豬 *DLD* 啟動子上游 -143A>C 的位置發現了一個調節性單核苷酸多型性（SNP）。利用雙螢光素酶報導基因、電泳遷移率遲滯及染色質免疫沉澱分析等機轉解析顯示，C 等位基因增強了 Krüppel 樣因子 2（KLF2）的 DNA 結合親和力，並促進 KLF2 媒介的轉錄抑制，導致 *DLD* 表現量顯著降低。對豬原代成肌細胞的功能特性分析表明，DLD 透過加速 G2/M 期轉換和上調細胞週期調節因子來促進成肌細胞增殖，同時抑制終末分化。此外，DLD 過表現抑制了慢肌（肌球蛋白重鏈（MYH）7 陽性）肌源性分化，並抑制了肌源性調節因子 MYOD 和 MYOG 的表現，而 DLD 基因靜默則產生相反的效果。綜上所述，這些多重證據表明 -143 A>C 變異可能透過增加 KLF2 的結合佔有率，來強化 *DLD* 的轉錄抑制。由於在本研究的成肌細胞實驗中，*DLD* 表現量的降低有利於 MYH7 陽性肌管的形成，因此推測此變異會影響肌管亞型的平衡。這些發現可能為豬肉品質差異提供潛在的分子機制，並指出 *DLD* 啟動子上的 -143 A>C 變異可作為未來基因體選擇研究的候選標記。

papers.title: Climate-Driven Changes in the Habitat Suitability and Potential Co-Occurrence of Daurian Ground Squirrels and Pikas in Inner Mongolia: Implications for Brucellosis Surveillance
papers.abstract: Where a multi-host pathogen can circulate depends on where its hosts overlap, not on any single host’s range, yet climate-change projections for zoonoses rarely model two hosts jointly or test how a warming signal is channeled toward their overlap. We addressed this gap for brucellosis, which remains endemic across the pastoral landscapes of Inner Mongolia, China, by building ENMeval-optimized MaxEnt niche models for two candidate sylvatic hosts (infection of which with Brucella in this region has not been established), the Daurian ground squirrel (Spermophilus dauricus, n = 620) and the Daurian pika (Ochotona dauurica, n = 17, with a three-method variable-screening pipeline and small-sample controls), projecting both onto current climate and eight CMIP6 scenarios (SSP1-2.6/2-4.5/3-7.0/5-8.5 × 2050s/2070s; validation AUC = 0.808 for the squirrel and 0.940 for the pika), combining them into a joint host co-occurrence index (JCI) that describes potential habitat overlap rather than disease risk, and fitting a path model that describes how climate anomaly relates to each host’s suitability and to the JCI. The two hosts diverge sharply: by the 2070s, suitable habitat contracts by 9.6–84.3% for the generalist ground squirrel but by >99.9% for the pika under the fitted model, whose projected collapse follows from a threshold in mean wettest-quarter temperature (≈18–19 °C) that is exceeded almost everywhere in the future; this loss is robust to occurrence filtering, regularization, binary thresholds and a second climate model but depends on the temperature variable and on climates beyond those sampled by the 17 records. This asymmetry carries over to the overlap: the current 66,737 km2 zone where both hosts co-occur shrinks by >99.9% under six of eight future scenarios, a collapse that is robust to how the joint index is constructed (geometric mean, minimum, or arithmetic mean all show the same pattern). The path model shows that climate anomaly is the better linear predictor of the squirrel’s own habitat trajectory (standardized β = −0.195 vs. −0.059 for the pika), whereas the pika’s habitat change has nearly double the standardized association with JCI change (β = 0.635 vs. 0.324); the latter association is largely a mathematical consequence of how the JCI is constructed, and under spatially corrected estimation, the climate effect on pika suitability is statistically indistinguishable from zero (95% CI −0.305 to 0.184). An exploratory next-generation-matrix calculation with uncalibrated parameters shows the same direction of change under most parameter combinations (the area with R0 > 1 declines under all but one) but is sensitive to its assumptions and is not a validated epidemiological prediction. These results identify the pika as the more informative indicator of change in host overlap for ecological monitoring; whether it matters more for brucellosis maintenance or spillover is unknown and requires serological, abundance and contact-rate data. The approach offers a reproducible template (joint niche modeling coupled to path analysis and exploratory transmission-threshold modeling) for exploring multi-host co-occurrence under climate change beyond this system.
papers.abstract_zh: 多宿主病原體能夠傳播的區域取決於其宿主的重疊範圍，而非單一宿主的棲息範圍；然而，針對人畜共通傳染病的氣候變遷預測，極少同時對兩個宿主進行聯合建模，亦少測試暖化訊號如何引導至其重疊區域。本研究填補了此一知識缺口以探討布魯氏菌病（brucellosis），該病目前在中國內蒙古的牧區仍屬地方性流行。我們為兩個候選野生宿主（該區域內布魯氏菌對此二者的感染尚未確立）建立經 ENMeval 優化的 MaxEnt 生態棲位模型：達烏爾黃鼠（*Spermophilus dauricus*，n = 620）與達烏爾鼠兔（*Ochotona dauurica*，n = 17，採用三種方法的變數篩選流程及小樣本控制）；將兩者投影至當代氣候及八種 CMIP6 情境（SSP1-2.6/2-4.5/3-7.0/5-8.5 × 2050年代/2070年代；黃鼠驗證 AUC = 0.808，鼠兔驗證 AUC = 0.940）；將其結合成描述潛在棲息地重疊而非疾病風險的聯合宿主共存指數（JCI）；並配適一條徑路模型，用以描述氣候異常如何與各宿主的適宜性及 JCI 產生關聯。這兩個宿主出現顯著分歧：在配適模型下，至 2070 年代，廣布型的黃鼠其適宜棲息地縮減了 9.6–84.3%，而鼠兔的縮減幅度則超過 99.9%。鼠兔預期中的崩解源自於最濕季平均溫度的閾值（約 18–19 °C），該閾值在未來幾乎全面被超越；此種棲息地喪失對出現紀錄篩選、正則化、二元閾值以及第二個氣候模型具備穩健性，但取決於溫度變數以及超出 17 筆紀錄取樣範圍的氣候條件。這種不對稱性延伸至重疊區域：目前兩宿主共存達 66,737 平方公里的區域，在八個未來情境中的六個下縮減超過 99.9%，此崩解現象對聯合指數的建構方式（幾何平均數、最小值或算術平均數均顯示相同模式）具備穩健性。徑路模型顯示，氣候異常是黃鼠自身棲息地軌跡較佳的線性預測因子（標準化 β = −0.195，相較於鼠兔的 −0.059），而鼠兔的棲息地變化與 JCI 變化的標準化關聯性則接近兩倍（β = 0.635 相較於 0.324）；後者的關聯性在很大程度上是 JCI 建構方式的數學結果，且在空間校正估計下，氣候對鼠兔適宜性的影響在統計學上與零無顯著差異（95% 信賴區間為 −0.305 至 0.184）。使用未校準參數進行的探索性世代交替矩陣（next-generation matrix）計算，在多數參數組合下顯示出相同的變化方向（$R_0 > 1$ 的區域在除了一種情況外均呈現下降），但對其假設敏感，且並非經過驗證的流行病學預測。這些結果指出，鼠兔是生態監測中反映宿主重疊變化的更具資訊性之指標；其對於布魯氏菌病的維持或溢出是否更為重要則屬未知，尚需血清學、族群豐度及接觸率數據。本方法提供了一個可重複使用的模板（結合生態棲位聯合建模、徑路分析與探索性傳播閾值建模），用以探討此系統以外氣候變遷下的多宿主共存。

papers.title: Dietary Ursolic Acid Supplementation Induces Beneficial Changes in Skeletal Muscle mRNA Expression and Improves Functional Mobility in Older Cats with Sarcopenia: A Proof-of-Concept Study
papers.abstract: Cats frequently lose mobility when they become older, ill, or injured, leading to additional impairments in health and quality of life. To help address this problem, a dietary supplement for cats containing ursolic acid was tested. Ursolic acid is a natural dietary compound that promotes muscle health and mobility in several non-feline species. A 60-day proof-of-concept efficacy study of ursolic acid dietary supplementation was conducted in older domestic shorthair cats with sarcopenia (age-related skeletal muscle atrophy). In feline skeletal muscle, 12 mg of ursolic acid per day generated beneficial changes in skeletal muscle mRNA expression, including repression of mRNAs that promote muscle atrophy and weakness and induction of mRNAs that promote muscle health. Furthermore, ursolic acid generated significant improvements in several important measures of feline mobility, including jumping, playing with toys, rising from a resting position, and transitioning from a standing position to a sitting or lying position. These findings identify ursolic acid supplementation as a new nutritional approach for promoting beneficial molecular and functional mobility outcomes in cats.
papers.abstract_zh: 貓隻常因高齡、疾病或受傷而失去活動能力，進而導致健康與生活品質的額外受損。為協助解決此問題，本研究測試了一種含有熊果酸（ursolic acid）的貓用膳食補充劑。熊果酸是一種天然膳食化合物，能促進多種非貓科動物的肌肉健康與活動能力。本研究針對患有肌少症（與年齡相關的骨骼肌萎縮）的高齡家貓，進行為期 60 天的熊果酸膳食補充概念驗證（proof-of-concept）療效研究。在貓骨骼肌中，每日 12 毫克的熊果酸可對骨骼肌 mRNA 表現產生有益的變化，包括抑制促進肌肉萎縮與無力的 mRNA，以及誘導促進肌肉健康的 mRNA。此外，熊果酸在多項重要的貓隻活動能力指標上帶來顯著改善，包括跳躍、玩玩具、從休息姿勢起身，以及從站立姿勢轉換為坐姿或躺姿。這些發現確立了補充熊果酸作為一種新的營養方法，可促進貓隻在分子與功能上的活動能力達到有益的成果。

papers.title: Impact of Sugar Beet Pulp-Based Diets on the Chemical Composition, Mineral Profile, and Chitin Yield of Black Soldier Fly (Hermetia illucens L.) Larvae
papers.abstract: Utilizing agro-industrial by-products such as sugar beet pulp (SBP) in black soldier fly (Hermetia illucens L.) rearing is an attractive strategy for circular feed production; however, its consequences on larval chemical composition and cuticular mineralization require detailed characterization. This study evaluated the effects of SBP inclusion, with or without Trichoderma sp. inoculation or beet molasses addition, on the proximate composition, macro- and trace mineral profiles, and gravimetric chitin yield of whole H. illucens larvae. Five-day-old larvae were reared across three independent biological cycles (n = 3 rearing containers per treatment) on four diets: Control (100% wheat bran), Option 1 (60% wheat bran + 40% SBP), Option 2 (60% wheat bran + 40% SBP with Trichoderma sp. at 1 × 106 CFU/g), and Option 3 (60% wheat bran + 30% SBP + 10% molasses). Larvae were harvested without a pre-harvest fasting period to reflect commercial whole-larva processing. Dietary inclusion of SBP significantly decreased larval crude protein (44.66 ± 2.88% DM in Option 1, 44.36 ± 3.12% DM in Option 2, and 45.25 ± 0.97% DM in Option 3 vs. 50.85 ± 3.23% DM in Control; p = 0.038), reflecting the lower protein density of SBP. Crude fat (32.18–36.32% DM; p = 0.774) and water-soluble carbohydrates (1.80–2.20% DM; p = 0.388) did not differ significantly among treatments. SBP inclusion markedly increased the crude ash content (10.59–13.68% DM vs. 5.75 ± 0.52% DM in Control; p < 0.001) and whole-body calcium (7.46–8.84% DM vs. 2.43 ± 1.39% DM in Control; p = 0.003), driving the larval Ca:P ratio from 2.45:1 to 8.04:1. Manganese concentrations were elevated in all SBP diets (661.2–700.6 mg/kg vs. 589.9 ± 71.7 mg/kg in Control; p = 0.041), while iron was significantly higher in Option 1 (286.9 ± 71.5 mg/kg vs. 168.9 ± 34.4 mg/kg in Control; p = 0.024). The gravimetric chitin yield was significantly higher on 40% SBP diets (7.75 ± 0.22% DM in Option 1; 7.82 ± 0.18% DM in Option 2) than in the Control (7.34 ± 0.15% DM; p = 0.004), whereas Option 3 yielded the lowest chitin content (7.14 ± 0.12% DM). Fungal inoculation produced no significant differences over SBP alone. These results demonstrate that SBP-based diets substantially increase whole-body ash and calcium levels while altering chitin yields, providing critical compositional benchmarks for tailoring insect meal to non-ruminant livestock feeding.
papers.abstract_zh: 利用如甜菜粕（SBP）等農工業副產物來飼養黑水虻（Hermetia illucens L.）是實現循環飼料生產的一項具吸引力的策略；然而，其對幼蟲化學組成及表皮礦化作用的影響則需要詳細的特性分析。本研究評估了添加甜菜粕（伴隨或不伴隨木黴菌（Trichoderma sp.）接種或添加甜菜糖蜜）對黑水虻全蟲幼蟲的一般成分、巨量與微量礦物質譜及重量法幾 chitin（幾丁質）產量的影響。日齡五天的幼蟲在三個獨立的生物循環中（每個處理 n = 3 個飼養容器）以四種飼料進行飼養：對照組（100% 麥麩）、選項 1（60% 麥麩 + 40% 甜菜粕）、選項 2（60% 麥麩 + 40% 甜菜粕加 1 × 10^6 CFU/g 的木黴菌），以及選項 3（60% 麥麩 + 30% 甜菜粕 + 10% 糖蜜）。幼蟲在收穫前未進行絕食處理，以反映商業全蟲加工的情況。飼糧中添加甜菜粕顯著降低了幼蟲的粗蛋白質含量（選項 1 為 44.66 ± 2.88% 乾物質，選項 2 為 44.36 ± 3.12% 乾物質，選項 3 為 45.25 ± 0.97% 乾物質，相對照組之 50.85 ± 3.23% 乾物質；p = 0.038），這反映出甜菜粕較低的蛋白質濃度。粗脂肪（32.18–36.32% 乾物質；p = 0.774）和水溶性碳水化合物（1.80–2.20% 乾物質；p = 0.388）在各處理間無顯著差異。添加甜菜粕顯著增加了粗灰分含量（10.59–13.68% 乾物質，相對照組之 5.75 ± 0.52% 乾物質；p < 0.001）以及全蟲鈣含量（7.46–8.84% 乾物質，相對照組之 2.43 ± 1.39% 乾物質；p = 0.003），使幼蟲的鈣磷比（Ca:P ratio）從 2.45:1 提高至 8.04:1。所有甜菜粕飼糧中的錳濃度均升高（661.2–700.6 mg/kg，相對照組之 589.9 ± 71.7 mg/kg；p = 0.041），而選項 1 的鐵含量則顯著較高（286.9 ± 71.5 mg/kg，相對照組之 168.9 ± 34.4 mg/kg；p = 0.024）。40% 甜菜粕飼糧的重量法幾丁質產量顯著高於對照組（7.34 ± 0.15% 乾物質；p = 0.004），其中選項 1 為 7.75 ± 0.22% 乾物質、選項 2 為 7.82 ± 0.18% 乾物質；而選項 3 的幾丁質含量最低（7.14 ± 0.12% 乾物質）。真菌接種與單獨添加甜菜粕相比，並未產生顯著差異。這些結果表明，基於甜菜粕的飼糧會大幅增加全蟲的灰分和鈣含量，同時改變幾丁質產量，為調整昆蟲蛋白粉以供非反芻家畜餵養提供了關鍵的組成基準。

papers.title: Pharmacokinetics of Orally Administered Fluralaner in Alpacas (Vicugna pacos) Affected by Sarcoptic Mange
papers.abstract: Sarcoptic mange may cause severe clinical disease in alpacas (Vicugna pacos), and treatment outcomes with commonly used acaricides can be variable. Fluralaner, an isoxazoline drug licensed as an insecticide and acaricide in different species, has been reported as a promising off-label option in alpacas, but pharmacokinetic data and evidence from herd settings are lacking. This study aims to define the pharmacokinetic profile of orally administered fluralaner in alpacas naturally affected by sarcoptic mange. A herd of seven adult female alpacas with clinical mange received a single oral dose of fluralaner at 5.2 mg/kg. Serial blood sampling from pre-treatment to 60 days post-administration was performed; then, serum fluralaner concentrations were quantified by a validated UPLC–HRMS-MS/MS method and analyzed using a non-compartmental approach for pharmacokinetic profile determination. Fluralaner showed prolonged systemic exposure, although marked inter-individual variability was observed. Mean Cmax was 498.18 ± 302.02 ng/mL, reached at 1.6 ± 0.5 days, with an AUClast of 3323.19 ± 1866.60 ng × day/mL and an elimination half-life of 6.8 ± 2.8 days. Quantifiable concentrations persisted for 35.0 ± 11.2 days on average. No adverse effects were observed, and all animals showed progressive clinical improvement. The findings indicate that a single oral dose of fluralaner provides sustained systemic exposure in alpacas, while further studies are warranted to refine the dosing regimen and to assess its clinical efficacy under herd conditions.
papers.abstract_zh: 疥蟎病可能對羊駝（*Vicugna pacos*）造成嚴重的臨床疾病，且使用常用殺蟎劑的治療效果往往因人而異。氟雷拉納（Fluralaner）是一種異噁唑啉類藥物，已獲准用於多種動物的殺蟲劑與殺蟎劑，據報導其作為羊駝的標示外用藥具有潛力，但目前尚缺乏藥物動力學數據以及群體飼養環境下的相關證據。本研究旨在明確口服給藥氟雷拉納於自然感染疥蟎羊駝體內的藥物動力學特性。試驗選取一群患有臨床疥蟎病的七隻成年母羊駝，單次口服給藥 5.2 mg/kg 的氟雷拉納。自給藥前至給藥後 60 天進行連續血液採樣；隨後，利用經過驗證的 UPLC–HRMS-MS/MS 方法定量血清中的氟雷拉納濃度，並採用非房室模式分析法來測定藥物動力學特性。氟雷拉納顯示出長效的全身暴露量，儘管觀察到顯著的個體間差異。平均最高血中濃度（Cmax）為 498.18 ± 302.02 ng/mL，在 1.6 ± 0.5 天時達到，給藥後血漿濃度曲線下面積（AUClast）為 3323.19 ± 1866.60 ng × day/mL，消除半衰期為 6.8 ± 2.8 天。可定量濃度平均持續了 35.0 ± 11.2 天。未觀察到任何不良反應，且所有動物的臨床症狀均呈進行性改善。研究結果顯示，單次口服氟雷拉納可在羊駝體內提供持續的全身暴露量，惟尚需進一步研究以優化給藥方案，並評估其在群體飼養條件下的臨床療效。

papers.title: Acute Hyperkalaemia During General Anaesthesia in Two Cows
papers.abstract: An 8-year-old, 600 kg, female Simmental cow and a 6-year-old, 662 kg, pregnant Hérens cow were referred for surgical repair of mandibular symphyseal fractures following trauma in two unrelated events. Pre-anaesthetic blood tests revealed mild hypokalaemia in the Simmental cow and mild hypocalcaemia in the Hérens cow. Anaesthesia was induced with xylazine, ketamine, and lidocaine, and maintained with isoflurane combined with a ketamine constant rate infusion. Throughout most of the procedures, physiological parameters remained stable, although mild hypercapnia and progressive bradycardia were noted. During surgical closure, both cows developed sudden severe bradycardia, followed by ventricular escape beats and short periods of asystole. Arterial blood gas analysis revealed acute severe hyperkalaemia, with potassium concentrations of 6.8 mmol/L in the Simmental cow and 8.66 mmol/L in the Hérens cow. Immediate treatment with a calcium–magnesium–glucose solution was initiated, resulting in rapid improvement in heart rate, restoration of sinus rhythm, and reduction in potassium concentrations. Both cows recovered uneventfully, with normal electrolyte values over the following 72 h. This report describes acute intra-anaesthetic hyperkalaemia in two cattle, including a pregnant animal, occurring without an identifiable predisposing factor. Continuous monitoring and rapid recognition of changes in cardiovascular status and electrolyte concentrations allowed prompt treatment and restoration of normal cardiac rhythm.
papers.abstract_zh: 一隻8歲、體重600公斤雌性西門塔爾牛（Simmental cow）與一隻6歲、體重662公斤懷孕荷林斯牛（Hérens cow），因兩起無關的外傷導致下頷聯合骨折，被轉診進行外科手術修復。麻醉前血液檢查顯示，西門塔爾牛有輕度低血鉀，荷林斯牛則有輕度低血鈣。麻醉誘導使用木苯噻嗪（xylazine）、氯胺酮（ketamine）與利多卡因（lidocaine），並以異氟醚（isoflurane）結合氯胺酮持續恆速輸注（CRI）來維持麻醉。在大部分的手術過程中，生理參數保持穩定，但觀察到輕度高碳酸血症及進行性心搏過緩。在手術縫合期間，兩頭牛皆突然發生嚴重的心搏過緩，隨後出現心室逸搏及短暫的心搏停止。動脈血液氣體分析顯示急性嚴重高血鉀，西門塔爾牛的鉀離子濃度為 6.8 mmol/L，荷林斯牛則為 8.66 mmol/L。立即給予鈣-鎂-葡萄糖溶液治療，使心率迅速改善、恢復竇性心律並降低鉀離子濃度。兩頭牛皆順利恢復，在接下來的72小時內電解質數值正常。本病例報告描述了兩頭牛（包含一頭懷孕母牛）在無可辨識之易感因素下發生的急性麻醉中高血鉀症。持續監測並快速識別心血管狀態與電解質濃度的變化，有助於即時治療並恢復正常的心律。

papers.title: Suspected Focal Junctional Tachycardia with Type I Isorhythmic Atrioventricular Dissociation Associated with Diffuse Lymphocytic Myocarditis of Undetermined Etiology in a Cat
papers.abstract: Focal junctional tachycardia (FJT) is a regular, narrow QRS complex tachycardia with subtle cycle length irregularity, frequently associated with isorhythmic atrioventricular dissociation (IAVD). Its presentation may be paroxysmal or non-paroxysmal. This rhythm is well recognized in humans and dogs. However, to the best of the authors’ knowledge, FJT has not been previously published in cats. This case report describes a 9-year-old neutered male domestic shorthair cat presenting with signs of congestive heart failure, hyperthermia, and a non-paroxysmal FJT. Electrocardiography demonstrated a narrow QRS tachycardia with type I synchronization IAVD, consistent with suspected FJT. Transthoracic echocardiography revealed severe biatrial enlargement, concentric ventricular hypertrophy and echocardiographic measures suggestive of high probability of pulmonary hypertension. There was apparently preserved global systolic function and diastolic dysfunction. These findings were consistent with a non-specific cardiomyopathy phenotype stage C. Pleural fluid cytology initially suggested a lymphoproliferative disorder; however, postmortem histopathological examination confirmed diffuse lymphocytic myocarditis without evidence of neoplasia. Despite intensive supportive and antithrombotic therapy, the cat experienced sudden death. To the authors’ knowledge, this is the first description of suspected FJT with type I IAVD in a cat. This case highlights myocarditis as a critical differential diagnosis in cats presenting with a lymphocytic effusion, structural echocardiographic changes, and complex supraventricular arrhythmias. It also discusses the diagnostic challenges and prognostic implications associated with inflammatory myocardial disease in this species.
papers.abstract_zh: 焦點性交界性心搏過速（Focal junctional tachycardia, FJT）是一種規則且伴隨窄 QRS 波群的心搏過速，其心跳週期長度略有不規則，常伴隨等長房室分離（isorhythmic atrioventricular dissociation, IAVD）。其臨床表現可能為陣發性或非陣發性。此心律不整在人類與犬隻中已被廣泛識別，然而據作者所知，過去並無貓隻發生 FJT 的文獻發表。本病例報告描述一隻 9 歲絕育公米克斯貓，主訴呈現鬱血性心衰竭、體溫過高以及非陣發性 FJT。心電圖顯示窄 QRS 波群心搏過速，伴隨第一型同步化等長房室分離，符合疑似 FJT 之特徵。經胸壁心臟超音波檢查顯示嚴重的雙心房擴大、心室向心性肥厚，且超音波指標顯示具高度肺動脈高壓之可能性。其整體收縮功能大致保留，並伴隨舒張功能障礙。這些發現符合非特異性心肌病變表現型 C 期。胸水細胞學檢查初步懷疑為淋巴增生性疾病；然而，死後組織病理學檢查證實為瀰漫性淋巴球性心肌炎，且無腫瘤證據。儘管接受了積極的支持性與抗血栓治療，該貓仍不幸猝死。據作者所知，這是首次在貓隻中描述疑似 FJT 伴隨第一型 IAVD 的病例。本病例強調了心肌炎對於出現淋巴球性肋膜積水、結構性心臟超音波改變及複雜性室上性心律不整的貓隻而言，是一項關鍵的鑑別診斷；同時亦探討了與該物種發炎性心肌疾病相關的診斷挑戰與預後意涵。

papers.title: Effects of Conjugated Linoleic Acid on Antioxidant and Immune Functions of Perinatal Ewes and Lambs
papers.abstract: This study evaluated the effects of dietary conjugated linoleic acid (CLA) on serum metabolites, antioxidant capacity, and immune function of transition ewes, as well as on growth performance, serum biochemical indices, and hormone levels of their suckling lambs. Forty healthy Ujumqin ewes (body weight 56.62 ± 5.30 kg) were randomly assigned to four groups (n = 10/group) at 28 d before expected parturition: control (basal diet), CLA-1 (basal diet + 10 g/d CLA), CLA-2 (basal diet + 20 g/d CLA), and CLA-3 (basal diet + 30 g/d CLA). Blood samples were collected from ewes at 21 d prepartum, at delivery, and at 21 d postpartum, and from lambs at 7 and 42 d postpartum. Serum metabolites, antioxidant enzymes, and inflammatory cytokines were measured. In ewes, CLA supplementation did not significantly affect serum AST, β-HB, GLU, TG, NEFA, SOD, GPX, MDA, or T-AOC (p > 0.05), although β-HB, GLU, SOD, GPX, and MDA changed with time. However, CLA markedly decreased serum TNF-α, IL-8, IL-6, and IL-1β (p < 0.05). In lambs, maternal CLA did not affect birth or final body weight. Maternal CLA decreased serum GH and the GH/IGF-1 ratio and increased IGF-1 (p < 0.05), especially at 30 g/d. Serum SOD, GPX, and MDA did not differ among groups, whereas T-AOC showed a significant group × time interaction (p = 0.004). Maternal CLA also decreased serum TNF-α, IL-8, IL-6, and IL-1β in lambs (p < 0.05). In conclusion, perinatal CLA supplementation did not significantly improve most energy metabolic or antioxidant enzyme indices under these conditions, but it alleviated excessive inflammatory responses in ewes and suckling lambs and activated the GH-IGF-1 axis in lambs. The 30 g/d CLA dose showed the strongest immunomodulatory and endocrine effects. These findings suggest that CLA may serve mainly as an immunomodulatory strategy in perinatal sheep, and dose optimization warrants further study.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究評估了日糧添加共軛亞麻油酸（CLA）對圍產期母羊血清代謝物、抗氧化能力與免疫功能，以及對其哺乳羔羊生長性能、血清生化指標和激素水平的影響。試驗選取40隻健康烏珠穆沁母羊（體重 56.62 ± 5.30 kg），於預產期前 28 天隨機分為四組（每組 10 隻）：對照組（基礎日糧）、CLA-1 組（基礎日糧 + 10 g/d CLA）、CLA-2 組（基礎日糧 + 20 g/d CLA）及 CLA-3 組（基礎日糧 + 30 g/d CLA）。分別於母羊產前 21 天、分娩時及產後 21 天，以及羔羊產後 7 天和 42 天採集血液樣本，測定血清代謝物、抗氧化酶及發炎細胞因子。在母羊方面，添加 CLA 對血清 AST、β-HB、GLU、TG、NEFA、SOD、GPX、MDA 或 T-AOC 無顯著影響（p > 0.05），儘管 β-HB、GLU、SOD、GPX 和 MDA 隨時間發生變化。然而，CLA 顯著降低了血清 TNF-α、IL-8、IL-6 和 IL-1β 的濃度（p < 0.05）。在羔羊方面，母體補充 CLA 不影響初生重或最終體重。母體補充 CLA 降低了血清 GH 濃度及 GH/IGF-1 比值，並提高了 IGF-1 濃度（p < 0.05），特別是在 30 g/d 組中。血清 SOD、GPX 和 MDA 在各組間無差異，而 T-AOC 則顯示出顯著的組別與時間交互作用（p = 0.004）。母體補充 CLA 同時降低了羔羊血清中的 TNF-α、IL-8、IL-6 和 IL-1β（p < 0.05）。綜上所述，在這些試驗條件下，圍產期補充 CLA 並未顯著改善多數能量代謝或抗氧化酶指標，但它減輕了母羊及哺乳羔羊過度的發炎反應，並活化了羔羊的 GH-IGF-1 軸。其中 30 g/d 的 CLA 劑量表現出最強的免疫調節與內分泌效應。這些結果表明，CLA 在圍產期綿羊中主要作為一種免疫調節策略，其劑量最佳化仍有待進一步研究。

papers.title: Computer-Aided Diagnosis System for Sow Pregnancy Using Low-Frequency Portable Ultrasound Videos with Preprocessing and Augmentation Techniques
papers.abstract: Accurate pregnancy diagnosis is important for reproductive management in pig farming. This study evaluated a computer-aided diagnosis workflow using portable low-frequency ultrasound videos from 1895 sows at two sites. Xception frame predictions were aggregated into video-level decisions. Original, Preprocessing (wavelet denoising and contrast-limited adaptive histogram equalization), Mixup, and their combination (Combined) were compared across ten repeated sow-level splits. Combined achieved mean accuracies of 84.5% and 85.3% in Datasets A and B, respectively, with pregnant-sow videos restricted to days 18–25 post-insemination. Compared with Original, mean specificity increased by 1.3 and 2.4 percentage points and Youden’s index by 1.7 and 2.3 points, while mean sensitivity was numerically similar. Paired 95% confidence intervals for specificity and Youden’s index differences excluded zero only in Dataset B, without adjustment for multiple comparisons. Paired comparisons of the area under the curve (AUC) did not establish improved discrimination. Mixup yielded the highest mean specificity and AUC, whereas Combined yielded higher mean sensitivity than Mixup. This trade-off varied across partition subsets. Cross-site and leave-one-session-out evaluations showed performance variability across acquisition settings, with no consistently best condition. These comparisons identify configuration-dependent trade-offs requiring further evaluation for diagnostic support.
papers.abstract_zh: 準確的妊娠診斷對於養豬業的繁殖管理至關重要。本研究評估了一項電腦輔助診斷工作流程，該流程使用來自兩個場區共 1895 頭母豬的可攜式低頻超音波影片。Xception 的影格預測被聚合為影片級別的判定。在十次重複的母豬層級分割中，比較了原始資料（Original）、前處理（小波去噪與對比度受限的調適性直方圖等化）、Mixup 及其組合（Combined）。當懷孕母豬影片限定於人工授精後 18 至 25 天時，Combined 在 A、B 兩個資料集中分別達到 84.5% 與 85.3% 的平均準確率。與原始資料相比，平均特異度分別增加了 1.3 與 2.4 個百分點，約登指數（Youden’s index）分別增加了 1.7 與 2.3 個點，而平均敏感度則在數值上相近。針對特異度與約登指數差異的成對 95% 信賴區間，僅在資料集 B 中未包含零（未進行多重比較校正）。曲線下面積（AUC）的成對比較未能確立鑑別力的提升。Mixup 產生了最高平均特異度和 AUC，而 Combined 則產生了比 Mixup 更高的平均敏感度。這種權衡取捨在不同的分割子集間有所差異。跨場區與留一場次（leave-one-session-out）評估顯示，效能會隨著取像設定而產生變異，並不存在一致最佳的條件。這些比較識別出了取決於配置的權衡取捨，需要進一步評估以提供診斷支援。

papers.title: Evaluation of Coated Urea Products as Supplemental Nitrogen Alternatives to Soybean Meal in Dairy Cow Diets
papers.abstract: Coated slow-release urea (SRU) may provide an alternative source of supplemental nitrogen in dairy cattle diets, but its ruminal release behavior can vary among formulations. This study compared three palm-oil-coated SRU products with different nominal release specifications using nonlactating, nonpregnant, rumen-cannulated Chinese Holstein cows. Three cows were used in an in situ experiment to characterize dry matter (DM) and urea disappearance from 0.5 to 12 h, and four cows were assigned to a 4 × 4 Latin square feeding trial. The control treatment consisted of a basal diet plus 500 g/d supplemental soybean meal (SBM), whereas the SRU treatments received the same basal diet plus 100 g/d SRU I, SRU II, or SRU III as approximately isonitrogenous supplemental nitrogen alternatives. SRU I consistently showed slower early DM and urea disappearance than SRU II and SRU III, whereas differences between SRU II and SRU III were less consistent across incubation times. Dietary treatment did not significantly affect DM, crude protein, or neutral detergent fiber intake, apparent total-tract digestibility, ruminal pH, total or individual volatile fatty acid concentrations, or hematological variables. Ruminal ammonia nitrogen differed among treatments (p = 0.04), with SRU III having a higher concentration than the control and SRU I and SRU II showing intermediate values. These results demonstrate formulation-dependent in situ disappearance patterns among coated SRU products and suggest that they can serve as alternative supplemental nitrogen sources under the conditions tested.
papers.abstract_zh: 包膜緩釋尿素（SRU）可為乳牛日糧提供另一種補充氮源，但其瘤胃釋放特性因配方而異。本研究以乾乳、未孕、裝有瘤胃廔管的中國荷視乳牛，比較三種具有不同標稱釋放規格的棕櫚油包膜SRU產品。利用三頭乳牛進行原位（in situ）試驗，以探討0.5至12小時內乾物質（DM）及尿素的消失率；另將四頭乳牛分配至4 × 4拉丁方格飼養試驗中。對照組飼糧為基礎日糧加500克／天的補充豆粕（SBM），而SRU處理組則飼糧為相同基礎日糧加上100克／天的SRU I、SRU II或SRU III，作為約莫等氮量的補充氮替代源。與SRU II和SRU III相比，SRU I持續展現出較慢的早期乾物質及尿素消失率，而SRU II與SRU III之間的差異在各培養時間點則較不一致。日糧處理對乾物質、粗蛋白或中性洗滌纖維的採食量、全消化道表觀消化率、瘤胃pH值、總揮發性脂肪酸或個別揮發性脂肪酸濃度、以及血液學變數均無顯著影響。瘤胃氨態氮濃度在各處理間有顯著差異（p = 0.04），其中SRU III的濃度高於對照組，而SRU I和SRU II則呈中間值。這些結果顯示，包膜SRU產品的原位消失模式具有配方依賴性，並表明在所測試的條件下，它們可作為替代的補充氮源。

papers.title: Health Status of Adult Cynomolgus and Rhesus Monkeys Produced by Embryo Splitting
papers.abstract: Animals derived from embryo splitting have been successfully produced in livestock farming, and their milk and meat products have entered the human food market. However, although monkeys have been obtained through the same technique, their adult health status remains poorly studied. Here, we performed a comprehensive and systematic evaluation of five adult cynomolgus and two rhesus monkeys derived from embryo splitting, including hematological and biochemical analyses, glucose metabolism assessment, cardiovascular evaluation, bone mineral density examination, brain MRI, and reproductive performance assessment. No significant differences were found in measured parameters between sp-monkeys and controls in cynomolgus monkeys (5 vs. 4), with similar trends in rhesus monkeys. Because only two rhesus sp-monkeys and three rhesus controls were available, the rhesus data were not statistically compared. These results provide no evidence of obvious adverse effects on adult health and offer preliminary support for the safety of this technique in biomedical research.
papers.abstract_zh: 胚胎分割來源動物已成功應用於畜牧業，其乳製品與肉類產品亦已進入人類食物市場。然而，儘管已利用相同技術獲得猴子，其成年後的健康狀況卻鮮少被深入研究。在此，我們對五隻食蟹猴與兩隻恆河猴（皆源自胚胎分割的成年猴）進行了全面且系統性的評估，包括血液學與生化分析、葡萄糖代謝評估、心血管評估、骨質密度檢查、大腦核磁共振造影（MRI）及生殖效能評估。在食蟹猴中，分割猴（5隻）與對照組（4隻）在各項測量參數上未發現顯著差異，恆河猴亦呈現相似趨勢。由於恆河猴分割猴僅有兩隻且對照組僅有三隻，故未對恆河猴數據進行統計學比較。這些結果並未顯示該技術對成年健康有明顯的不良影響，並為該技術在生物醫學研究中的安全性提供了初步支持。

papers.title: Assessing the Incremental Value of Environment-Aware Bioelectrical Impedance Sensing for Machine Learning-Based Anemia Risk Monitoring in Goats
papers.abstract: Bioelectrical impedance analysis (BIA) has been widely evaluated in livestock for body composition and physiological assessment, but its incremental value for anemia-risk monitoring in small ruminants remains unclear. This study evaluated BIA as part of an environmentally aware multimodal machine-learning framework for anemia-related monitoring in goats. Data from 81 Spanish male goats were restructured into animal-by-date observations and integrated with objective FAMACHA© classification, blood packed cell volume, gastrointestinal nematode fecal egg count, weather variables, temperature–humidity index, and raster-derived environmental covariates. Objective FAMACHA© was derived from packed cell volume and used as the primary classification endpoint. Binary, three-class, and four-class classification tasks were evaluated using animal-grouped cross-validation to reduce leakage from repeated observations. Binary low-risk versus high-risk classification was the most reliable task, whereas multiclass prediction showed limited resolution among adjacent FAMACHA© categories. A formal ablation analysis showed that BIA-only features achieved a ROC-AUC of 0.672, compared with 0.838 for fecal egg count plus weather/THI and 0.824 for the complete multimodal model. The full model did not significantly outperform the fecal egg count plus weather/THI model (ΔAUC = −0.013; 95% CI: −0.124 to 0.093; p = 0.844). A supplementary matched feature-block analysis likewise did not demonstrate a statistically reliable incremental improvement from adding BIA. Threshold analysis showed that a screening-oriented threshold detected 83.3% of high-risk observations with 71.3% specificity. These findings indicate that parasitological and environmental predictors provided the strongest discriminatory information, whereas the independent incremental predictive benefit of BIA remained unestablished. BIA should therefore be regarded as a potential supplementary physiological sensing modality rather than a validated primary predictor or replacement for established anemia-assessment methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 生物電阻抗分析（BIA）已被廣泛評估應用於家畜的體組成與生理評估，但其對於小型反芻動物貧血風險監測的增量價值（incremental value）仍不明確。本研究評估了BIA作為環境感知多模態機器學習框架的一部分，用於山羊貧血相關監測的可行性。研究整合了來自81隻西班牙公羊的資料，重新建構為「個體-日期」觀察值，並結合客觀的FAMACHA©分類、血液紅血球容積比（packed cell volume）、胃腸道線蟲糞便蟲卵數（fecal egg count）、氣象變數、溫濕指數（THI）以及網格衍生（raster-derived）的環境共變量。客觀的FAMACHA©係由紅血球容積比推導而得，並作為主要的分類終點。本研究採用個體分組交叉驗證（animal-grouped cross-validation）來評估二元、三分類及四分類任務，以減少重複觀察值帶來的資料外洩。二元（低風險對高風險）分類是最為可靠的任務，而多類別預測在相鄰的FAMACHA©類別之間則顯示出有限解析度。正式的消融分析（ablation analysis）顯示，僅使用BIA特徵的ROC-AUC為0.672，相較之下，糞便蟲卵數加氣象／溫濕指數組合的ROC-AUC為0.838，完整多模態模型的ROC-AUC則為0.824。完整模型並未顯著優於糞便蟲卵數加氣象／溫濕指數模型（ΔAUC = −0.013；95% 信賴區間：−0.124 至 0.093；p = 0.844）。補充的匹配特徵區塊分析同樣未顯示加入BIA能帶來具統計學可靠性的增量改善。閾值分析顯示，以篩檢為導向的閾值能偵測出83.3%的高風險觀察值，特異度為71.3%。這些研究結果表明，寄生蟲學與環境預測因子提供了最強的區辨資訊，而BIA獨立的增量預測效益仍未確立。因此，BIA應被視為一種潛在的輔助生理感測模態，而非經過驗證的主要預測因子或既有貧血評估方法的替代方案。

papers.title: Wildlife Surveillance in North-Eastern Italy: Diagnostic Insights and Viral Detection in Gray Wolves and Golden Jackals
papers.abstract: Interfaces among humans, wildlife and domestic animals represent critical hotspots for the emergence and spread of infectious agents. The gray wolf (Canis lupus) and the golden jackal (Canis aureus) are expanding wild canid populations in Italy, whose increasing overlap with anthropized environments may facilitate pathogen transmission. This study investigated mammalian orthoreovirus (MRV), rotavirus A (RVA), canine coronavirus (CCoV), canine parvovirus (CPV2) and feline parvovirus (FPV) in wild canids from north-eastern Italy. The 101 carcasses (83 gray wolves and 18 golden jackals) obtained through passive wildlife surveillance were examined post-mortem. Tissue samples and swabs were screened using molecular assays, and positive samples were characterized and tested for virus isolation. MRV was detected in gray wolves (27.7%) and golden jackals (33.3%), representing the first report and successful isolation from both species. RVA prevalence was 60.2% in gray wolves and 61.1% in golden jackals. CCoV occurred exclusively in gray wolves (12.5%). CPV-2 was found in 10.8% of gray wolves and 35.3% of golden jackals, with FPV accounting for 66.7% of CPV-2-positive golden jackal samples. These findings provide valuable data on the circulation of MRV, RVA, CCoV, and CPV-2/FPV in free-ranging gray wolves and golden jackals and highlight the value of passive surveillance within a One Health framework overall.
papers.abstract_zh: 人類、野生動物與家畜之間的介面是傳染病源產生與傳播的關鍵熱點。義大利的歐亞狼（Canis lupus）與金豺（Canis aureus）野生犬科動物族群正在擴張，其與人類化環境日益重疊的情況可能會促進病原體的傳播。本研究調查了義大利東北部野生犬科動物中的哺乳動物正呼腸孤病毒（MRV）、A型輪狀病毒（RVA）、犬冠狀病毒（CCoV）、犬小病毒（CPV2）及貓小病毒（FPV）。透過被動野生動物監測取得 101 具動物屍體（83 隻歐亞狼和 18 隻金豺）並進行死後檢驗。使用分子檢測法篩檢組織樣本和拭子，並對陽性樣本進行特性鑑定與病毒分離測試。在歐亞狼（27.7%）和金豺（33.3%）中檢測出 MRV，這是這兩種物種的首次通報與成功分離。歐亞狼的 RVA 盛行率為 60.2%，金豺為 61.1%。CCoV 僅發生在歐亞狼中（12.5%）。10.8% 的歐亞狼和 35.3% 的金豺發現 CPV-2，其中 FPV 佔 CPV-2 陽性金豺樣本的 66.7%。這些發現為自由活動的歐亞狼和金豺中 MRV、RVA、CCoV 以及 CPV-2/FPV 的循環提供了寶貴的數據，並突顯了在「同一健康」（One Health）框架下被動監測的整體價值。

papers.title: Dietary Multivitamin Supplementation in Siganus fuscescens: Integrated Effects on Growth Performance, Antioxidant Capacity, and Mitigation of Darkening Syndrome Under High-Lipid Dietary Stress
papers.abstract: Siganus fuscescens, an economically important species in southern China, is noted for its rapid growth and high nutritional value. Nonetheless, the prevalence of darkening syndrome, a condition marked by skin discoloration and significant mortality rates, presents a challenge to aquaculture practices, with its etiology remaining largely unexplored. This study aimed to examine the impacts of varying dietary lipid levels and multivitamin supplementation on the incidence of darkening syndrome in S. fuscescens. Five experimental diets were developed: a low-fat diet containing 10% lipids; a moderate-fat diet with 13% lipids; a moderate-fat diet with 13% lipids supplemented with multivitamins; a high-fat diet containing 16% lipids; and a high-fat diet with 16% lipids supplemented with multivitamins. A 55-day feeding trial was conducted on S. fuscescens specimens. The results indicate that, in this experiment, increasing dietary fat content led to a higher cumulative incidence of darkening syndrome in S. fuscescens. Serological and histological findings suggested that in the 16% lipid diet group, S. fuscescens exhibited liver injury and oxidative stress. Notably, supplementation with multivitamins alleviated these adverse effects. Overall, we recommend using an appropriate dietary fat level and further supplementing with antioxidant multivitamins, which may represent an effective strategy to mitigate darkening syndrome in S. fuscescens.
papers.abstract_zh: 褐藍子魚（*Siganus fuscescens*）是中國南方具有重要經濟價值的物種，以生長迅速和營養價值高而聞名。然而，體色發黑症（darkening syndrome，一種以皮膚變色和高死亡率為特徵的疾病）的盛行對水產養殖實務構成了挑戰，其病因目前仍有待探究。本研究旨在探討不同飼料脂肪水準及多種維生素補充對褐藍子魚體色發黑症發病率的影響。製備了五種實驗飼料：含10%脂肪的低脂飼料；含13%脂肪的中脂飼料；含13%脂肪並補充多種維生素的中脂飼料；含16%脂肪的高脂飼料；以及含16%脂肪並補充多種維生素的高脂飼料。對褐藍子魚進行了為期55天的投餵試驗。結果顯示，在本實驗中，提高飼料脂肪含量導致褐藍子魚體色發黑症的累積發病率增加。血清學與組織學結果表明，在16%脂肪飼料組中，褐藍子魚表現出肝臟損傷與氧化壓力。值得注意的是，補充多種維生素可緩解這些不良影響。總體而言，我們建議採用適當的飼料脂肪水準並進一步補充抗氧化多種維生素，這可能是減輕褐藍子魚體色發黑症的有效策略。

papers.title: Emerging Zoonotic Sporotrichosis in Fortaleza, Brazil: Spatiotemporal Distribution, Exploratory Machine Learning Risk Modeling, and One Health Implications of Sporothrix brasiliensis Detection
papers.abstract: Zoonotic sporotrichosis caused by Sporothrix brasiliensis is an emerging public health threat in Brazil. Under a One Health perspective, this study described the temporal and geographic distribution of recorded feline sporotrichosis detections in Fortaleza (2022–2026), as well as their co-occurrence with human notifications. Additionally, the study explored associations with socio-environmental factors and evaluated predictive performance at both the neighborhood and individual-animal levels. Suspected cats underwent cytology, culture, and species-specific calmodulin PCR. Cases were mapped across 116 neighborhoods, and logistic regression and random forest models were evaluated exploratorily at the neighborhood (61 neighborhoods) and animal (239 cats) levels, using grouped nested cross-validation and Spearman correlations corrected for multiple testing. Of 246 cats, 120 were confirmed, and all 37 isolates analyzed were S. brasiliensis. Neighborhoods with cases rose from one (2022) to 34 (March 2026), with 68 human notifications in 25 neighborhoods. After grouped validation, none of the evaluated predictor–outcome contrasts met the significance criterion after BY adjustment, and the exploratory associations were subject to substantial uncertainty. Consequently, no model demonstrated meaningful discriminative performance (out-of-sample AUC-ROC 0.34–0.50 at the neighborhood level and 0.38–0.47 at the animal level). These results are consistent with the complex, multifactorial nature of the disease, in which host behavior, environmental persistence, and surveillance intensity likely interact. These findings confirm the urban establishment of S. brasiliensis and the need for more complete data and robust analytical approaches. Outbreak control requires integrated One Health strategies: expanded access to diagnosis, cat neutering, and strengthened surveillance.
papers.abstract_zh: 由巴西申克孢子絲菌（*Sporothrix brasiliensis*）引起的人畜共通傳染性孢子絲菌症，是巴西一項新興的公共衛生威脅。本研究基於「同一健康」（One Health）視角，描述了福塔雷薩市（2022–2026年）貓隻孢子絲菌症確診病例的時間與地理分佈，及其與人類通報病例的共現情況。此外，本研究探討了其與社會環境因素的關聯，並在鄰里和個別動物層級評估了預測效能。疑似感染的貓隻接受了細胞學檢查、培養以及物種特異性鈣調蛋白（calmodulin）PCR檢測。病例被繪製在涵蓋116個鄰里的地圖上，並使用分組巢狀交叉驗證（grouped nested cross-validation）及經多重檢定校正的斯皮爾曼相關性（Spearman correlations），在鄰里（61個鄰里）與動物（239隻貓）層級探索性地評估了邏輯斯迴歸與隨機森林模型。在246隻貓中，120隻獲得確診，且所有分析的37株分離株皆為巴西申克孢子絲菌。出現病例的鄰里從1個（2022年）增加至34個（2026年3月），並在25個鄰里中出現68例人類通報。經過分組驗證後，在進行BY校正（Benjamini-Yekutieli adjustment）後，沒有任何評估的預測因子與結果對比達到顯著性標準，且探索性關聯存在高度的不確定性。因此，沒有任何模型展現出有意義的區分效能（鄰里層級的樣本外AUC-ROC為0.34–0.50，動物層級為0.38–0.47）。這些結果與該疾病複雜且多因素的本質一致，宿主行為、環境持久性以及監測強度在此間可能相互作用。這些發現證實了巴西申克孢子絲菌在都市的建立，並凸顯了對更完整數據及穩健分析方法的的需求。疫情控制需要整合的「同一健康」策略：擴大診斷管道、實施貓隻絕育，以及加強監測。

papers.title: Dietary Enterococcus faecalis SZ07 Improves Intestinal Health, Immune Function and Gut Microbiota Homeostasis in Golden Pompano (Trachinotus ovatus)
papers.abstract: Trachinotus ovatus (golden pompano) represents one of the dominant high-value mariculture fish species farmed across coastal regions of China. In intensive farming modes, intestinal damage and immune suppression are frequent issues in golden pompano; the widespread application of antibiotics in disease control has also triggered increasing worries about ecological risks and aquatic product safety. Host-origin probiotics have been widely recognized as a green and safe strategy to mitigate health risks and promote growth in farmed fish. Nevertheless, the regulatory roles and mechanisms of autochthonous E. faecalis strains on the intestinal health of golden pompano are still poorly understood. In this study, a 42-day feeding trial was conducted using golden pompano reared in a large-capacity floating net-cage system. The experimental fish were fed diets supplemented with different concentrations of E. faecalis SZ07 (1 × 105 to 1 × 109 CFU/g feed). Dietary supplementation with SZ07 at suitable doses (1 × 107 to 1 × 108 CFU/g feed) notably improved intestinal tissue structure, elevated the activities of digestive, antioxidant, and immune enzymes, and modulated the mRNA levels of key immune genes in the spleen. Analysis of the gut microbiota revealed that dietary E. faecalis SZ07 reshaped the intestinal microbial community, with an increased abundance of beneficial taxa and a decreased proportion of opportunistic pathogens. Taken together, our results indicate that autochthonous E. faecalis SZ07 acts as an effective probiotic to enhance intestinal health and immune function of golden pompano and offers technical support for the healthy development of its aquaculture industry.
papers.abstract_zh: 卵形鯧鰺（黃鱲鰺）是中國沿海地區養殖的高經濟價值海水魚類之一。在集約化養殖模式下，卵形鯧鰺經常發生腸道損傷與免疫抑制的問題；而疾病防治中抗生素的廣泛使用，也引發了對生態風險和水產品安全的日益擔憂。宿主源益生菌已被廣泛認為是降低養殖魚類健康風險並促進生長的一種綠色安全策略。然而，本土糞腸球菌（*E. faecalis*）菌株對卵形鯧鰺腸道健康的調節作用與機制仍所知有限。本研究利用在大容量浮動網箱系統中養殖的卵形鯧鰺進行了為期 42 天的投餵試驗。實驗魚被餵食添加不同濃度糞腸球菌 SZ07（$1 \times 10^5$ 至 $1 \times 10^9\text{ CFU/g}$ 飼料）的飼料。適當劑量（$1 \times 10^7$ 至 $1 \times 10^8\text{ CFU/g}$ 飼料）的 SZ07 飼料補充劑顯著改善了腸道組織結構，提升了消化酶、抗氧化酶和免疫酶的活性，並調節了脾臟中關鍵免疫基因的 mRNA 表現量。腸道微生物相分析顯示，飼料添加糞腸球菌 SZ07 重塑了腸道微生物群落，增加了有益分類群的豐度，並減少了伺機性病原體的比例。綜上所述，我們的結果表明，本土糞腸球菌 SZ07 作為一種有效的益生菌，能增強卵形鯧鰺的腸道健康與免疫功能，並為其水產養殖業的健康發展提供技術支援。

papers.title: Parthenolide Relieves LPS-Induced Mammary Damage by Regulating Inflammation, Apoptosis, and BloodMilk Barrier in Mice
papers.abstract: Mastitis is a common disease in dairy cows, characterized primarily by mammary inflammation, which induces epithelial cell apoptosis and blood–milk barrier (BMB) disruption, seriously threatening milk quality and yield. Parthenolide (PTL), a bioactive sesquiterpene lactone, exhibits anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. However, its effectiveness in treating mastitis has not yet been conclusively proven. In this study, we established an in vivo mouse model to investigate the mechanisms underlying the protective effects of PTL on LPS-induced mammary gland damage. HE staining and TEM showed that PTL (10 mg/kg) alleviated LPS-induced histopathological and ultrastructural damage in mouse mammary tissues. To be specific, PTL suppressed the LPS-induced increase in the p-NF-κB/NF-κB ratio and IL-1β, IL-6, and TNF-α mRNA levels, indicating that PTL inhibits inflammation via the NF-κB signaling pathway. In addition, PTL also reduced TUNEL-positive cells and the p-p53/p53 ratio, Bax/Bcl-2 ratio, and protein levels of cytochrome c and caspase-3, indicating that PTL inhibited p53-dependent mitochondria-mediated apoptosis in LPS-exposed of mouse mammary tissues. Furthermore, PTL reversed BMB hyperpermeability and the upregulation of MLCK and p-MLC proteins, restored the expression of tight junction (TJ) proteins Claudin-3, occludin, and ZO-1, and corrected ZO-1 distribution abnormalities, indicating that PTL mitigates LPS-induced BMB disruption by regulating MLCK signaling in mouse mammary tissues. In summary, PTL relieves LPS-induced mammary damage in mice by regulating inflammation, apoptosis, and the BMB, which is associated with the inhibition of the NF-κB-p53/MLCK signaling pathway.
papers.abstract_zh: 乳房炎是乳牛常見的疾病，主要特徵為乳腺發育發炎，會誘導上皮細胞凋亡及血乳屏障（BMB）破壞，嚴重威脅牛奶品質與產量。小白菊內酯（PTL）是一種具生物活性的倍半萜內酯，具有抗發炎與抗菌特性。然而，其在治療乳房炎方面的療效尚未獲得確切證實。在本研究中，我們建立了一個範例活體小鼠模型，以探討 PTL 對脂多糖（LPS）誘導的乳腺損傷之保護作用機制。HE 染色與 TEM 顯示，PTL（10 mg/kg）可減輕 LPS 誘導的小鼠乳腺組織組織病理學與超微結構損傷。具體而言，PTL 抑制了 LPS 誘導的 p-NF-κB/NF-κB 比值以及 IL-1β、IL-6 和 TNF-α mRNA 表現量的增加，這表明 PTL 透過 NF-κB 信號傳遞路徑抑制發炎。此外，PTL 還減少了 TUNEL 陽性細胞數、p-p53/p53 比值、Bax/Bcl-2 比值，以及細胞色素 c 和 caspase-3 的蛋白質表現量，這表明 PTL 抑制了 LPS 暴露的小鼠乳腺組織中 p53 依賴性的粒線體介導細胞凋亡。再者，PTL 逆轉了血乳屏障的高通透性以及 MLCK 與 p-MLC 蛋白質的上調，恢復了緊密連接（TJ）蛋白質 Claudin-3、occludin 與 ZO-1 的表現，並校正了 ZO-1 的分佈異常，這表明 PTL 透過調節小鼠乳腺組織中的 MLCK 信號傳遞路徑，減輕了 LPS 誘導的血乳屏障破壞。綜上所述，PTL 透過調節發炎、細胞凋亡與血乳屏障，減輕了 LPS 誘導的小鼠乳腺損傷，這與抑制 NF-κB-p53/MLCK 信號傳遞路徑有關。

papers.title: First Detection of Raccoon Dog and Fox Amdoparvovirus in a Clinically Ill Domestic Dog in Croatia
papers.abstract: Raccoon dog and fox amdoparvovirus (RFAV), classified as Amdoparvovirus carnivoran3, was recently identified in domestic dogs, though its clinical significance remains unclear. This study describes RFAV detection in a 4-year-old female Doberman Pinscher with multisystemic disease, including progressive weight loss, poor coat condition, ocular lesions, hyperkeratosis of the nasal planum and footpads, and marked icterus. Clinical progression and laboratory parameters were monitored during hospitalisation, followed by postmortem pathological assessment. Antemortem and postmortem specimens were tested for amdoparvovirus DNA. PCR products were sequenced and subjected to phylogenetic analysis. Amdoparvovirus DNA was detected in nasal, conjunctival, and rectal swabs, whole blood, urine, and multiple postmortem tissues. Sequencing confirmed the virus as Amdoparvovirus carnivoran3, with the Croatian sequence closely related to a strain recently reported in clinically affected Doberman Pinschers in Serbia. Additionally, 60 archived canine rectal swab samples collected earlier in 2026 were screened for amdoparvoviruses. All retrospectively screened samples tested negative. This study documents the first detection of an RFAV in a domestic dog in Croatia and provides possible clinical and histopathological data on RFAV in domestic dogs. However, these findings do not establish a causal relationship between RFAV infection and the observed clinical signs. Furthermore, the small number of tested archival samples limits the interpretation of the negative results and precludes reliable estimates of RFAV prevalence.
papers.abstract_zh: 浣熊犬及狐狸阿姆多細小病毒（Raccoon dog and fox amdoparvovirus, RFAV）被分類為食肉動物阿姆多細小病毒3型（Amdoparvovirus carnivoran3），最近在家犬體內被檢出，然其臨床意義仍屬未知。本研究描述了一隻4歲雌性杜賓犬感染RFAV的病例，該犬呈現多重系統性疾病，包含進行性體重減輕、毛髮狀況不良、眼部病灶、鼻鏡及足墊過度角化，以及顯著黃疸。本研究於住院期間監測其臨床病程及實驗室參數，隨後進行死後病理評估。針對生前及死後檢體進行阿姆多細小病毒DNA檢測。PCR產物經定序後進行親緣關係分析。在鼻腔、結膜及直腸拭子、全血、尿液及多個死後組織中皆檢測出阿姆多細小病毒DNA。定序結果證實該病毒為食肉動物阿姆多細小病毒3型，該克羅埃西亞序列與最近在塞爾維亞具臨床症狀杜賓犬中報導的病毒株高度相關。此外，本研究亦篩檢了60件於2026年稍早採集之存檔犬隻直腸拭子樣本以檢測阿姆多細小病毒，所有回溯性篩檢樣本均呈陰性。本研究記錄了克羅埃西亞首度在家犬體內檢出RFAV，並提供了RFAV在家犬中的潛在臨床及組織病理學數據。然而，這些發現並未確立RFAV感染與所觀察到的臨床症狀之間的因果關係。此外，受測的存檔樣本數量較少，限制了解釋陰性結果的空間，亦無法可靠地估計RFAV的盛行率。

papers.title: Intact Cell Ultrastructure Is Sufficient for the Intestinal Protective Activity of Canine-Derived Lactobacillus acidophilus Against Dextran Sulfate Sodium-Induced Colitis
papers.abstract: Chronic inflammatory enteropathy is common and clinically challenging in dogs. Probiotics are explored as dietary adjuncts, but how inactivation methods affect strain performance remains unclear. This study compared viable, heat-killed, electron beam-inactivated (3 kGy), and cell-free supernatant (CFS) preparations of canine-origin Lactobacillus acidophilus L1 in a DSS-induced mouse colitis model. Heat-killed L1 retained intact ultrastructure and matched viable cells in attenuating disease activity and colonic injury; electron beam inactivation disrupted the cell surface and produced poorer repair than heat-killed L1 but was superior in maintaining body weight. All treatments lowered DAI versus the model (p < 0.001). Colon length and Zo-1/Occludin mRNA expression were highest in viable and heat-killed groups, which also had the lowest splenic and hepatic indices (p < 0.01). IL-17A fell further in viable and heat-killed groups (p < 0.01); IL-10 rose only in these two groups (p < 0.05). Cecal SCFAs were elevated in DSS and CFS groups despite reduced Dubosiella. Heat-killed bacteria had the lowest cecal SCFAs but the highest MCT1/SMCT1 expression (p < 0.05) and unchanged MCT4 expression, potentially suggesting enhanced epithelial SCFA uptake, although reduced microbial production cannot be excluded. These results indicate that intact bacterial ultrastructure is sufficient for the intestinal protective activity of L. acidophilus L1 in a prophylactic model, and support heat-killed L1 as a promising prophylactic paraprobiotic ingredient for canine gastrointestinal health.
papers.abstract_zh: 慢性發炎性腸病在犬隻中很常見且臨床上深具挑戰性。益生菌被探討作為飲食輔助品，但去活化方法如何影響菌株效能仍不清楚。本研究在葡聚硫酸鈉（DSS）誘發的小鼠結腸炎模型中，比較了犬源嗜酸乳桿菌 L1（Lactobacillus acidophilus L1）的活菌、熱殺死、電子束去活化（3 kGy）及無細胞上清液（CFS）製劑。熱殺死型 L1 保留了完整的超微結構，且在減輕疾病活性與結腸損傷方面與活細胞相當；電子束去活化破壞了細胞表面，其修復效果較熱殺死型 L1 差，但在維持體重方面表現較佳。與模型組相比，所有處理組的疾病活性指數（DAI）均下降（p < 0.001）。結腸長度以及 Zo-1/Occludin mRNA 表現在活菌組和熱殺死組中最高，這兩組也具有最低的脾臟和肝臟指數（p < 0.01）。在活菌組和熱殺死組中，IL-17A 進一步下降（p < 0.01）；IL-10 僅在這兩組中上升（p < 0.05）。儘管 Dubosiella 減少，盲腸短鏈脂肪酸（SCFAs）在 DSS 組和 CFS 組中仍升高。熱殺死菌具有最低的盲腸短鏈脂肪酸，但有最高的 MCT1/SMCT1 表現量（p < 0.05）且 MCT4 表現量未變，這可能暗示其增強了上皮細胞對短鏈脂肪酸的攝取，儘管微生物產量的減少亦不排除。這些結果表明，在預防性模型中，完整的細菌超微結構足以發揮嗜酸乳桿菌 L1 的腸道保護活性，並支持熱殺死型 L1 作為犬類腸道健康之具潛力的預防性副益生菌（paraprobiotic）成分。

papers.title: Effect of Storage Conditions on Equine Herpesvirus-1 DNA Detection in Equine Urine
papers.abstract: Equine herpesvirus-1 (EHV-1) is a major equine pathogen causing myeloencephalopathy, abortion, and respiratory disease. Following the detection of EHV-1 DNA in urine from naturally infected horses, urine has emerged as a potential complementary non-invasive specimen for molecular diagnosis. However, the influence of storage conditions on EHV-1 DNA stability remains unknown. Urine from six healthy horses was experimentally inoculated with EHV-1 (104 copies/µL) and stored at room temperature (25 °C) or under refrigeration (4 °C), with or without a commercial urine preservative, or at −80 °C without preservative. Viral DNA was quantified by qPCR over 30 days, and viral infectivity was explored by cell culture. Detectable EHV-1 DNA declined significantly during the first 24 h at room temperature and under refrigeration and remained relatively stable thereafter. Refrigeration partially improved the preservation of detectable viral DNA, whereas storage at −80 °C provided the greatest stability among the conditions evaluated over the 30-day study period. The commercial preservative provided no consistent benefit. These findings provide preliminary evidence to inform storage practices for equine urine samples intended for EHV-1 molecular diagnosis. Further studies involving naturally infected horses and additional freezing temperatures are needed to establish definitive recommendations for clinical sample handling.
papers.abstract_zh: 馬疱疹病毒第一型（EHV-1）是一種主要的馬匹病原體，會引起脊髓腦病、流產及呼吸道疾病。繼在自然感染馬匹的尿液中檢測出 EHV-1 DNA 後，尿液已成為分子診斷中具潛力的輔助性非侵入性檢體。然而，儲存條件對 EHV-1 DNA 穩定性的影響仍屬未知。本研究將六匹健康馬匹的尿液實驗性接種 EHV-1（10⁴ 複本/微升），並分別置於室溫（25 °C）或冷藏（4 °C）條件下（伴隨或不伴隨商業尿液保存劑），或置於 -80 °C 且無保存劑的條件下儲存。透過 qPCR 在 30 天內對病毒 DNA 進行定量，並利用細胞培養探討病毒感染力。可檢測出的 EHV-1 DNA 在室溫和冷藏的前 24 小時內顯著下降，此後保持相對穩定。冷藏部分改善了可檢測病毒 DNA 的保存，而在評估的 30 天研究期間內，-80 °C 儲存則提供了所測試條件中最佳的穩定性。商業保存劑未提供一致的效益。這些發現為用於 EHV-1 分子診斷的馬匹尿液檢體之儲存實務提供了初步證據。未來需要更多涵蓋自然感染馬匹及其他冷凍溫度的研究，以為臨床檢體處理建立明確的建議。

papers.title: Enzymatic Soybean as Milk Protein Substitute in Formula for Ultra-Early-Weaning Piglets: Effects on Intestinal Health and Stress During Dietary Transition
papers.abstract: Milk formulas for piglets predominantly rely on cow-derived proteins, which are costly and raise biosecurity concerns. As a highly digestible plant protein source, enzymatic soybean (ESB) may offer a viable alternative. This study evaluated the effects of partially replacing whole milk powder (WMP) with ESB in formulas on growth performance, intestinal health, and stress indicators of ultra-early-weaning piglets, followed through the nursery stage on the solid diet. Eighty-four male piglets, weaned on postnatal day 14 (PND 14), were randomly assigned to one of three isonitrogenous milk formulas until PND 24: a milk protein-based formula (MF) or the same formula in which ESB replaced either 20% (PF20) or 40% (PF40) of WMP. Eight piglets per group were sacrificed for sampling on PND 24. Thereafter, the remaining piglets from the MF and PF20 groups, together with twenty additional age-matched, sow-nursed (SN) piglets, received the same solid nursery diet from PND 24 to 52. The results indicated that both PF20 and PF40 piglets exhibited lower ADG, and ADFI than MF piglets, with PF40 piglets showing a greater reduction (approximately 70 g/d in ADG) and higher F/G ratios, along with lower carcass weight, fat percentage, and body mass index (p < 0.05). Moreover, PF40 piglets showed lower sucrase activity and higher mRNA expression of ileal inflammation- and immune-related genes on PND 24. During the nursery phase, intriguingly, MF and PF20 piglets exhibited higher ADG and lower diarrhea index between PND 24 and 31 compared with SN piglets (p < 0.05), which could be associated with lower plasma cortisol and C-reactive protein concentrations in MF and PF20 piglets after the dietary transition on PND 28, with plasma haptoglobin levels being lowest in the PF20 piglets. In conclusion, partial replacement of WMP with ESB in formulas induced early growth retardation and altered intestinal morphology and function in ultra-early weaning piglets. As compared with sow rearing, however, formula-fed piglets showed favorable performance during adaptation to solid nursery feed. Moreover, piglets fed the formula containing a moderate level of ESB exhibited lower stress responses, which indicates that ESB may serve as a feasible protein source in milk formulas for ultra-early-weaned piglets.
papers.abstract_zh: 仔豬代乳 裡多數依賴牛乳來源蛋白，此類蛋白成本高昂且引發生物安全疑慮。去醣基酶解大豆蛋白（enzymatic soybean, ESB）作為一種高消化率的植物性蛋白來源，或許能提供一個可行的替代方案。本研究評估在代乳中以 ESB 部分取代全脂奶粉（whole milk powder, WMP）對超早期離乳仔豬生長性能、腸道健康與壓力指標的影響，並持續追蹤至保育階段的固體飼料期。試驗選用 84 頭於產後第 14 天（PND 14）離乳的公仔豬，隨機分配至三種等氮的代乳配方直至 PND 24：乳蛋白為基礎的代乳（MF），或以此配方分別用 ESB 取代 20%（PF20）或 40%（PF40）之 WMP。每組 8 頭仔豬於 PND 24 犧牲採樣。此後，MF 與 PF20 組剩餘的仔豬，連同 20 頭同日齡、母乳哺育（SN）的對照仔豬，自 PND 24 至 52 共同餵食相同的保育期固體飼料。結果顯示，與 MF 組相比，PF20 及 PF40 組仔豬皆表現出較低的平均日增重（ADG）與平均日採食量（ADFI），其中 PF40 組的降幅更大（ADG 約減少 70 g/d）且飼料增重比（F/G）較高，同時伴隨較低的屠體重、脂肪百分比與身體質量指數（p < 0.05）。此外，PF40 組仔豬在 PND 24 時表現出較低的蔗糖酶活性以及較高的迴腸發炎與免疫相關基因 mRNA 表現量。有趣的是，在保育階段期間，與 SN 組相比，MF 與 PF20 組仔豬在 PND 24 至 31 之間表現出較高的 ADG 與較低的下痢指數（p < 0.05），這可能與 MF 和 PF20 組仔豬在 PND 28 轉換飼糧後具有較低的血漿皮質醇與 C-反應蛋白濃度有關，其中血漿結合珠蛋白（haptoglobin）濃度以 PF20 組最低。總結而言，在代乳中以 ESB 部分取代 WMP 會導致超早期離乳仔豬產生早期生長遲緩，並改變其腸道形態與功能。然而，與母乳哺育相比，餵食代乳的仔豬在適應保育期固體飼料期間表現出良好的性能。此外，餵食含有適度比例 ESB 代乳的仔豬表現出較低的壓力反應，這顯示 ESB 可作為超早期離乳仔豬代乳中一個可行的蛋白質來源。

papers.title: ABCB1 Frameshift Deletion in Skye Terriers With Potential Pharmacogenetic Relevance
papers.abstract: Ivermectin‐associated neurotoxicity is a potentially life‐threatening condition caused by disruption of the ABCB1 encoded P‐glycoprotein drug transporter in certain dog breeds. Skye terriers are considered at increased risk of ivermectin toxicity despite the absence of an identified molecular cause. We searched the Dog10K variant dataset for ABCB1 variants potentially underlying ivermectin sensitivity in Skye terriers and screened an independent cohort of 27 dogs to confirm sequence variants. A 1‐bp frameshift deletion predicted to cause loss of function in ABCB1 was identified in two of three Skye terriers in the Dog10K dataset and was absent from all 1869 non‐Skye‐terrier genomes. The variant had an allele frequency of 16.7% in the independent Skye terrier cohort. This is the first reported ABCB1 variant in Skye terriers and represents a plausible candidate genetic basis for the anecdotally observed ivermectin sensitivity in the breed.
papers.abstract_zh: 伊vermectin（驅蟲敏）相關的神經毒性是一種潛在危及生命的病症，由特定犬種體內由 $ABCB1$ 基因編碼的 P-醣蛋白藥物轉運體功能受損所引起。儘管尚未確認其分子病因，斯凱爹利（Skye terriers）被認為具有較高的伊維菌素毒性風險。我們搜尋了 Dog10K 變異數據集，以尋找可能導致斯凱爹利對伊維菌素敏感的 $ABCB1$ 變異，並篩查了一個包含 27 隻狗的獨立群組以確認序列變異。在 Dog10K 數據集的三隻斯凱爹利中，有兩隻被識別出一個預期會導致 $ABCB1$ 功能喪失的 1-bp 移碼缺失，而在所有 1869 個非斯凱爹利基因組中均不存在此缺失。該變異在獨立的斯凱爹利群組中的等位基因頻率為 16.7%。這是首次報導的斯凱爹利 $ABCB1$ 變異，並為該犬種中觀察到的軼事性伊維菌素敏感性提供了合理的候選基因基礎。

papers.title: FLCN Multi‐Exon Deletion in a Chihuahua With Renal Cysts and Nodular Dermatofibrosis
Molecular modelling study on Piper betle phytocompounds to discover the potential active moiety responsible for xanthine oxidase inhibition in avian gout
papers.abstract: 1. This study investigated the phytochemicals responsible for xanthine oxidase (XO) inhibitory activity in Piper betle L. herb. In silico analysis was performed against the active sites of XO using 32 phytocompounds from P. betle along with the known inhibitor allopurinol used in avian gout treatment.2. Functions including docking score and GLIDE score, ADME analyses using QikProp module and toxicity assessment with ProTox-II server. Molecular dynamics simulations were performed for 100 ns with GROMACS software to evaluate the stability and fluctuations of the protein–ligand complexes.3. The results revealed that 12 phytocompounds of P. betle exhibited higher GLIDE XP docking scores (−6.881 to −4.766 kcal/mol) compared to allopurinol (−4.535 kcal/mol) and 11 phytocompounds showed higher GLIDE energy (−42.822 kcal/mol to −36.706 kcal/mol) than allopurinol (−32.676 kcal/mol). Among these, 4-chromanol and 4-allyl-1,2-diacetoxybenzene were identified as the most potent compounds of P. betle, forming hydrogen bond interactions with XO similar to allopurinol.4. The ADME analyses showed that selected phytocompounds met the ADME descriptors and did not violate Lipinski’s ‘rule of five’ and toxicity assessment yielded satisfactory results. Furthermore, 100 ns MD simulations showed a stable trajectory and less conformational variation (RMSD, RMSF) along with a steady interaction profile observed throughout the simulations. The MM‑GBSA calculations supported the docking studies.5. The data showed that 4-chromanol and 4-allyl-1, 2-diacetoxybenzene phytocompounds present in P. betle might account for antigout activity through XO inhibition, meaning that these could be developed as potential drug molecules.
papers.abstract_zh:
1. 本研究探討了荖葉（*Piper betle* L.）中具有黃嘌呤氧化酶（XO）抑制活性的植物化學成分。利用來自荖葉的 32 種植物化合物以及用於治療鳥類痛風的已知抑制劑别嘌呤醇（allopurinol），針對 XO 的活性位點進行了電腦模擬（in silico）分析。
2. 功能分析包含對接分數（docking score）與 GLIDE 分數、使用 QikProp 模組進行 ADME（吸收、分佈、代謝、排泄）分析，以及透過 ProTox-II 伺服器進行毒性評估。使用 GROMACS 軟體進行 100 奈秒（ns）的分子動力學模擬，以評估蛋白質－配體複合物的穩定性與波動。
3. 結果顯示，與别嘌呤醇（−4.535 kcal/mol）相比，荖葉中有 12 種植物化合物表現出更高的 GLIDE XP 對接分數（−6.881 至 −4.766 kcal/mol）；有 11 種植物化合物表現出比别嘌呤醇（−32.676 kcal/mol）更高的 GLIDE 能量（−42.822 kcal/mol 至 −36.706 kcal/mol）。其中，4-苯并吡喃醇（4-chromanol）與 4-烯丙基-1,2-二乙酰氧基苯（4-allyl-1,2-diacetoxybenzene）被鑑定為荖葉中最具潛力的化合物，能與 XO 形成類似别嘌呤醇的氫鍵相互作用。
4. ADME 分析顯示，所選的植物化合物符合 ADME 描述符且未違反里品斯基「五規則」（Lipinski’s ‘rule of five’），毒性評估也產出了令人滿意的結果。此外，100 奈秒的分子動力學模擬顯示出穩定的軌跡、較小的構象變異（RMSD、RMSF），以及在整個模擬過程中觀察到穩定的相互作用分佈。MM-GBSA 計算結果支持了對接研究。
5. 數據表明，荖葉中存在的 4-苯并吡喃醇與 4-烯丙基-1,2-二乙酰氧基苯等植物化合物，可能透過抑制 XO 發揮抗痛風活性，這意味著它們可被開發為具有潛力的藥物分子。

papers.title: The Chromosomal Organization of Isleria hauxwelli and Its Meaning for the Karyotypic Evolution in Thamnophilidae (Passeriformes)
papers.abstract: The order Passeriformes, the most speciose avian order, includes over 6000 species (~60% of all birds). The Amazon Basin alone hosts > 900 bird species, with Passeriformes representing > 500 of them. The family Thamnophilidae comprises ~200 insectivorous species, accounting for 15% of Neotropical passerine richness. Within Thamnophilinae, Isleria is the least speciose genus, containing only two species. It was erected after phylogenetic analyses revealed Myrmotherula as non‐monophyletic. To advance knowledge of chromosomal evolution in Passeriformes, we analyzed the karyotype of Isleria hauxwelli using molecular cytogenetics. We found a diploid number of 2n = 84 and a fundamental number (FN) of 92. The BOE‐7 probe, corresponding to the ancestral fusion of GGA‐9 with two microchromosomes, maintained that configuration without undergoing fission to produce IHA‐5. The BOE‐14 probe, typically fragmented in all cytogenomically characterized Passeriformes, corresponded to two distinct GGA segments: the R3 portion and a region of unknown homology. This is the first documentation of such chromosomal organization in passerines. The absence of these fissions suggests a possible autapomorphic chromosomal condition within Thamnophilidae. Additionally, a potential fission involving microchromosomes homeologous to probes BOE‐15 and BOE‐16 is suggested: while these probes mark three microchromosome pairs in GGA, they mark four pairs in I. hauxwelli —a feature not yet observed in other passerines. As most Thamnophilidae remain cytogenetically uncharacterized, systematic study of this family is essential to determine whether these rearrangements represent synapomorphies, autapomorphies, or convergent events.
papers.abstract_zh: 雀形目（Passeriformes）是鳥類中物種數最多的目，包含超過 6000 種（約佔所有鳥類的 60%）。僅亞馬遜盆地就棲息了超過 900 種鳥類，其中雀形目就佔了 500 多種。蟻鵙科（Thamnophilidae）包含約 200 種食蟲鳥類，佔新熱帶界雀形目豐富度的 15%。在蟻鵙亞科（Thamnophilinae）中，Isleria 是物種數最少的屬，僅包含兩種。該屬是在系統發生分析顯示微雀鯛屬（Myrmotherula）為並系群之後才建立的。為了推進對雀形目染色體演化的了解，我們運用分子細胞遺傳學分析了赫氏細尾蟻鵙（Isleria hauxwelli）的核型。我們發現其二倍體染色體數為 2n = 84，基本數（FN）為 92。對應於原雞（GGA）第 9 號染色體與兩個微小染色體祖先融合的 BOE-7 探針，維持了該構型而未發生分裂以產生 IHA-5。在所有已進行細胞基因體學表徵的雀形目中通常會斷裂的 BOE-14 探針，則對應於兩個不同的 GGA 片段：R3 部分以及一個同源性未知的區域。這是首次在雀形目中記錄到這種染色體組織形式。這些分裂的缺失暗示了蟻鵙科內部可能存在自近裔性狀（autapomorphic）的染色體狀態。此外，研究亦顯示可能發生涉及與 BOE-15 和 BOE-16 探針同源（homeologous）之微小染色體的斷裂：這些探針在 GGA 中標記了三對微小染色體對，但在赫氏細尾蟻鵙中則標記了四對——這是在其他雀形目中尚未觀察到的特徵。由於大多數蟻鵙科鳥類尚未進行細胞遺傳學表徵，對該科進行系統性研究至關重要，以確定這些重排是共近裔性狀（synapomorphies）、自近裔性狀還是趨同演化事件。

papers.journal: Journal of Animal Breeding and Genetics

papers.title: The mLOS Open-Source Software for Analyzing Length of Stay in Animal Shelters
papers.abstract: Length of stay (LOS) is critical in shelter management and animal welfare. Its assessment by calendar period must account for animals whose stay overlaps with period boundaries. mLOS is an open-source R tool that uses animal-level intake and outcome records to analyze LOS distributions and competing outcomes using survival-analysis methods. A companion Python package, ShelterDataPrep, prepares raw data extracts for analysis. The factors used are calendar period, intake type, and a user-defined animal group. The counting-process formulations left-truncate stays in progress at the beginning of a period and right-censor stays ongoing at period end. Kaplan-Meier estimates the stay distribution, Aalen-Johansen gives cumulative incidence by outcome type, and Cox and Weibull regressions compute the effect of each factor adjusted for others. A run computes in-care stay curves, remaining stay curves, competing outcomes, outcome conditional on tenure, and population-load figures including census. Each is produced for the unified sample and separately by factor. Pooled and per-factor Cox regressions produce hazard ratios while corresponding Weibull regressions produce LOS ratios. Validation includes hand-derived exact tests and simulation fixtures that recover known behavior. The outputs comprise plots, companion CSVs, a JSON with complete results, a consolidated workbook, and an experimental slide deck.
papers.abstract_zh: 住院天數（Length of stay, LOS）對收容所管理與動物福利至關重要。透過日曆期間進行評估時，必須將留宿時間與期間邊界重疊的動物納入考量。mLOS 是一個開源的 R 工具，利用個體層級的入所與出所記錄，並透過存活分析方法來分析 LOS 分配與競爭風險結果。其配套的 Python 套件 ShelterDataPrep 則負責準備供分析使用的原始資料擷取檔。所使用的因子包含日曆期間、入所類型，以及使用者定義的動物群組。計數過程公式將在期間開始時仍在進行中的留宿進行左截尾（left-truncate），並將在期間結束時持續中的留宿進行右設限（right-censor）。Kaplan-Meier 法可用於估算留宿分配，Aalen-Johansen 法能提供依結果類型的累積發生率，Cox 與 Weibull 迴歸則可計算經其他因子調整後的各因子效應。單次執行即可計算在所留宿曲線、剩餘留宿曲線、競爭結果、以留宿期為條件的出所率，以及包含清查數在內的族群負載圖。上述內容皆會針對整合樣本及各因子分別產出。合併與各因子的 Cox 迴歸可產生風險比（hazard ratios），而對應的 Weibull 迴歸則產生 LOS 比。驗證方式包含手算精確檢定以及能還原已知行為的模擬測試裝置。產出成果包含繪圖、配套的 CSV 檔、包含完整結果的 JSON 檔、整合活頁簿，以及實驗性質的簡報檔。

papers.title: Apparent Ca Test Positivity and Crossmatch Reactivity in Donkeys from Italy: Intraspecies and Horse–Donkey Compatibility
papers.abstract: Blood group distribution and serological compatibility are poorly characterized in donkeys. We estimated the apparent Ca positive-test frequency in 84 domestic donkeys and assessed donkey–donkey and horse–donkey crossmatch reactivity. Ca typing was performed using a commercial equine immunochromatographic assay. For donkey–donkey crossmatching, one major and one minor crossmatch were analyzed for each of the 77 Ca-concordant and 34 Ca-discordant pairs. Fifty-six of eighty-four donkeys yielded a positive result with the equine Ca assay (66.7%; 95% CI, 56.1–75.8%). Major combined macroscopic/microscopic reactivity occurred in 18/77 Ca-concordant and 11/34 Ca-discordant pairs, whereas minor combined reactivity occurred in 21/77 and 8/34 pairs, respectively. In crossed random-effects logistic models, the adjusted odds ratios for Ca-discordant versus Ca-concordant pairs were 1.56 (95% CI, 0.64–3.82) for major combined reactivity, 0.82 (95% CI, 0.32–2.10) for minor combined reactivity, and 1.57 (95% CI, 0.41–5.94) for major macroscopic reactivity; the minor macroscopic model was not estimable. Horse–donkey reactions were frequent and direction-dependent. When donkey plasma was tested against horse RBCs, combined reactivity occurred in 80/80 tests in the horse-donor/donkey-recipient dataset and in 76/76 tests in the reciprocal dataset, with macroscopic reactivity in 77/80 (96.3%) and 74/76 (97.4%), respectively. In the reciprocal horse-plasma/donkey-RBC direction, combined reactivity occurred in 53/80 (66.3%) and 51/76 (67.1%) tests, with macroscopic reactivity in 32/80 (40.0%) and 32/76 (42.1%), respectively. Ca concordance was not significantly associated with crossmatch reactivity in the present dataset, and Ca status alone did not account for the observed crossmatch-reactivity pattern.
papers.abstract_zh: Donkey血型分佈與血清學相容性目前尚缺乏充分的特性研究。本研究估算84隻家驢中Ca抗原陽性檢測的表觀頻率，並評估驢－驢及馬－驢的交叉試驗反應性。Ca分型採用商業馬用免疫層析檢驗試劑盒進行。在驢－驢交叉試驗中，77對Ca一致及34對Ca不一致的配對各分析一次主試驗與次試驗。在84隻驢子中，有56隻的馬用Ca檢驗結果呈陽性（66.7%；95%信賴區間，56.1–75.8%）。在77對Ca一致的配對中，有18對發生主要的肉眼／顯微鏡綜合反應，34對Ca不一致的配對中有11對發生；次要綜合反應則分別發生於21對與8對配對中。在交叉隨機效應邏輯斯迴歸模型中，Ca不一致相對於Ca一致配對的調整勝算比為：主要綜合反應1.56（95%信賴區間，0.64–3.82）、次要綜合反應0.82（95%信賴區間，0.32–2.10），以及主要肉眼反應1.57（95%信賴區間，0.41–5.94）；次要肉眼模型則無法估計。馬－驢反應頻繁且具方向相依性。當以驢血漿對抗馬紅血球時，在馬捐贈者／驢接受者資料集中的80個試驗中，全數（80/80）皆發生綜合反應，而在相互對照資料集中的76個試驗中亦全數（76/76）發生，肉眼反應分別佔77/80（96.3%）與74/76（97.4%）。在相反的馬血漿／驢紅血球方向中，綜合反應分別發生於53/80（66.3%）與51/76（67.1%）個試驗中，肉眼反應則分別佔32/80（40.0%）與32/76（42.1%）。在本研究資料集中，Ca一致性與交叉試驗反應性無顯著相關，且單憑Ca狀態無法解釋所觀察到的交叉試驗反應模式。

papers.title: Superior MAP–EtCO2 Target Attainment with Rocuronium-Facilitated Controlled Ventilation in Geriatric Small Dogs: A Retrospective Cohort Study
papers.abstract: Comparative evidence for integrated ventilation–neuromuscular blockade–reversal strategies is limited in geriatric small dogs. This single-center retrospective cohort included 288 dogs aged ≥12 years and weighing ≤7 kg undergoing orthopedic surgery or thoracolumbar hemilaminectomy. Initially planned strategies were spontaneous ventilation without neuromuscular blockade (A), controlled ventilation without blockade (B), rocuronium–controlled ventilation–sugammadex (C), vecuronium–controlled ventilation–sugammadex (D), or vecuronium–controlled ventilation–neostigmine–atropine (E). The primary outcome was the percentage of the entire primary physiologic window with concurrent mean arterial pressure ≥ 60 mmHg and end-tidal carbon dioxide 35–55 mmHg. Adjusted means were A 58.9%, B 59.3%, C 86.6%, D 74.0%, and E 67.8%. Group C exceeded A, B, and D by 27.7 (95% confidence interval, 26.3–29.2), 27.3 (25.9–28.8), and 12.7 (11.2–14.1) percentage points; B and A differed by 0.4 points (−0.8–1.6). Ventilator asynchrony occurred in 3.4% of C versus 73.2% of B. Adjusted mean times to normalized train-of-four ratio ≥ 0.90 were 1.41, 2.31, and 7.43 min in Groups C–E, respectively. Observed early respiratory and hard 48 h event risks were 3.4% and 1.7% in C, 40.7% and 18.6% in A, and 44.6% and 17.9% in B. The rocuronium-facilitated strategy was associated with superior concurrent target attainment; nonrandomized strategy selection precludes causal safety conclusions.
papers.abstract_zh: 針對高齡小型犬整合性通氣－神經肌肉阻斷－拮抗策略的比較性證據相當有限。本單中心回溯性世代研究納入了 288 隻年齡 $\ge$ 12 歲且體重 $\le$ 7 公斤、接受骨科手術或胸腰椎半椎板切除術的犬隻。最初規劃的策略為：無神經肌肉阻斷之自主通氣（A組）、無阻斷之控制性通氣（B組）、羅庫溴銨－控制性通氣－舒更葡糖（C組）、維庫溴銨－控制性通氣－舒更葡糖（D組），或維庫溴銨－控制性通氣－新斯的明－阿托品（E組）。主要評估指標為整個主要生理窗口期間，平均動脈壓 $\ge$ 60 mmHg 且末端呼氣二氧化碳分壓達 35–55 mmHg 同時達標的時間百分比。調整後的平均值分別為：A組 58.9%、B組 59.3%、C組 86.6%、D組 74.0%、E組 67.8%。C組分別比 A、B、D 組高出 27.7（95% 信賴區間，26.3–29.2）、27.3（25.9–28.8）及 12.7（11.2–14.1）個百分點；B組與A組相差 0.4 個百分點（−0.8–1.6）。C組發生呼吸器不同步的比率為 3.4%，B組則為 73.2%。C、D、E 三組調整後達到四個連續刺激（TOF）比值 $\ge$ 0.90 的平均時間分別為 1.41、2.31 和 7.43 分鐘。觀察到的早期呼吸道事件及術後 48 小時內嚴重不良事件風險，C組分別為 3.4% 和 1.7%，A組分別為 40.7% 和 18.6%，B組分別為 44.6% 和 17.9%。羅庫溴銨輔助策略與更佳的同時達標率相關；然而，非隨機化的策略選擇無法得出因果安全性的結論。

papers.title: Integrated Transcriptomic and Metabolomic Analyses Reveal the Whitening of Perirenal Brown Adipose Tissue in Yak Calves
papers.abstract: Brown adipose tissue (BAT) is essential for neonatal thermogenesis; however, in yak, the adipose tissue exhibits age-related changes from a brown-like to a white-like phenotype between postnatal day 1 (P1) and day 30 (P30). This exploratory study aimed to characterize the molecular and metabolic changes underlying this postnatal transition, with a particular focus on thermogenesis and lipid metabolism. Perirenal adipose tissue from yak calves at P1 and P30 was analyzed using phenotypic, transcriptomic (n = 3 per group), and metabolomic (n = 6 per group) approaches. Our results showed that multilocular adipocytes were abundant at P1, whereas unilocular adipocytes were predominant by P30, accompanied by significantly increased triglyceride content (p < 0.05). Transcriptomic and metabolomic analyses identified a total of 1000 differentially expressed genes (DEGs) and 17 differential metabolites between the two stages. From the DEGs, 13 thermogenesis-related genes and 24 lipid metabolism-related genes were selected based on functional relevance, and all 17 differential metabolites were analyzed. Integrative analysis of the transcriptomic and metabolomic datasets further identified 14 key genes related to thermogenesis and lipid metabolism and 6 differential metabolites potentially associated with these metabolic pathways. Among them, CDS2, GPAM, AGPAT2, CPT1C, GADD45B, PLIN1, and metabolites phosphatidylethanolamine (PE), phosphatidic acid (PA), and oxidized phosphatidylserine (PS) may serve as a potential link between lipid deposition and thermogenic metabolism. Fatty acid profiling showed that n-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids (n-3 PUFAs), such as eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA, 20:5 n-3) and docosahexaenoic acid (DHA, 22:6 n-3) were enriched in BAT, while stearic acid (SA, 18:0) and oleic acid (OA, 18:1 n-9) were enriched in WAT. These findings suggest age-related changes in the molecular and metabolic characteristics of postnatal BAT from a thermogenic phenotype toward a lipid-storage state, consistent with a functional transition during adipose tissue development. This provides a molecular framework for understanding BAT phenotypic changes in neonatal yaks and identifies candidate targets for future studies investigating the regulation of thermogenesis and lipid metabolism in plateau ruminants.
papers.abstract_zh: 棕色脂肪組織（BAT）對新生動物的生熱作用至關重要；然而在氂牛中，脂肪組織在出生後第1天（P1）至第30天（P30）之間，會表現出從類似棕色到類似白色表型的年齡相關變化。本探索性研究旨在探討此一出生後轉變背後的分子與代謝變化，特別聚焦於生熱作用與脂質代謝。本研究利用表型、轉錄體（每組 n = 3）及代謝體（每組 n = 6）方法，分析了 P1 與 P30 氂牛犢牛的腎周脂肪組織。結果顯示，P1 時多房性脂肪細胞豐富，而 P30 時則以單房性脂肪細胞為主，並伴隨三酸甘油酯含量顯著增加（p < 0.05）。轉錄體與代謝體分析在兩個階段之間共鑑定出 1000 個差異表達基因（DEGs）與 17 種差異代謝物。從 DEGs 中，根據功能相關性篩選出 13 個與生熱相關的基因以及 24 個與脂質代謝相關的基因，並對全部 17 種差異代謝物進行了分析。轉錄體與代謝體資料集的整合分析進一步鑑定出 14 個與生熱和脂質代謝相關的關鍵基因，以及 6 種可能與這些代謝途徑相關的差異代謝物。其中，CDS2、GPAM、AGPAT2、C1C、GADD45B、PLIN1，以及代謝物磷脂酰乙醇胺（PE）、磷脂酸（PA）和氧化磷脂酰絲胺酸（PS）可能作為脂質沉積與生熱代謝之間的潛在聯繫。脂肪酸分析顯示，n-3 多元不飽和脂肪酸（n-3 PUFAs），如二十碳五烯酸（EPA, 20:5 n-3）和二十二碳六烯酸（DHA, 22:6 n-3）在 BAT 中富集，而硬脂酸（SA, 18:0）和油酸（OA, 18:1 n-9）則在 WAT 中富集。這些發現表明，出生後 BAT 的分子與代謝特徵隨年齡增長從生熱表型向脂質儲存狀態轉變，這與脂肪組織發育過程中的功能轉變一致。本研究為理解新生氂牛 BAT 表型變化提供了分子框架，並為未來研究高原反芻動物生熱及脂質代謝調節的候選標靶提供了依據。

papers.title: Detection and Phylogenetic Characterization of Canine Distemper Virus (Morbillivirus canis) in Wild Foxes and Badgers from Northern Italy in 2021–2026
papers.abstract: Canine distemper virus (CDV) is a highly contagious multisystemic pathogen posing severe threats to wild carnivores and domestic animals. To investigate CDV circulation and lineage diversity in Piacenza Province, Northern Italy, wildlife surveillance was conducted under the Regional Wildlife Monitoring Plan between 2021 and June 2026. Forty-three wild carnivores—comprising red foxes (Vulpes vulpes), European badgers (Meles meles), wolves (Canis lupus), stone martens (Martes foina), and one jackal (Canis aureus)—were evaluated by necropsy, histopathology and molecular assays (RT-qPCR/RT-PCR). Overall, 12 animals (27.9%, 95% CI: 15.3–43.7; six foxes and six badgers) were confirmed to be CDV-positive. No positivity was found before 2024. Positive animals displayed characteristic lesions, including hemorrhagic enteritis, pulmonary hepatization, and footpad hyperkeratosis. Sequencing of the hemagglutinin (H) gene of the four complete H genes obtained revealed that they belonged to clade A of the European/South American 1 lineage, showing the highest nucleotide identity with Alpine CDV strains from Switzerland and Northern Italy. These results confirm the recent circulation of CDV amongst foxes and badgers in Piacenza. Continuous molecular monitoring and integrated cross-border surveillance remain essential for the effective management of transmission at the interface between wildlife and domestic animals.
