papers.abstract_zh: 犬瘟熱病毒（Canine distemper virus, CDV）是一種高度傳染性的多重器官系統病原體，對野生食肉動物和家養動物構成嚴重威脅。為了調查義大利北部皮亞琴察省（Piacenza Province）的 CDV 流行情況與譜系多樣性，本研究於 2021 年至 2026 年 6 月期間，在區域野生動物監測計畫（Regional Wildlife Monitoring Plan）下進行了野生動物監測。共評估了 43 隻野生食肉動物，包含赤狐（Vulpes vulpes）、歐亞獾（Meles meles）、狼（Canis lupus）、石貂（Martes foina）以及 1 隻胡狼（Canis aureus），並透過解剖、組織病理學和分子檢測（RT-qPCR/RT-PCR）進行評估。總體而言，確認有 12 隻動物（27.9%，95% 信賴區間：15.3–43.7；6 隻赤狐和 6 隻歐亞獾）CDV 檢測呈陽性。2024 年之前未發現陽性個體。呈陽性的動物表現出典型病變，包含出血性腸炎、肺實質化和足墊角化過度。對所獲得的 4 個完整血球凝集素（H）基因進行定序顯示，它們屬於歐洲／南美洲 1 型譜系的 A 演化支，與來自瑞士和義大利北部的阿爾卑斯山 CDV 毒株顯示出最高的核苷酸相似性。這些結果證實了 CDV 近期在皮亞琴察的赤狐和歐亞獾族群中傳播。持續的分子監測與整合性跨界監視，對於有效管理野生動物與家養動物交界處的病毒傳播至關重要。

papers.title: Comparison of Selected Therapies Within the Step-Up Therapeutic Approach in Canine Chronic Inflammatory Enteropathy
papers.abstract: Canine chronic inflammatory enteropathy (CIE) frequently requires a sequential therapeutic approach in which treatment is escalated according to clinical response. This prospective, open-label clinical study evaluates selected dietary, antimicrobial, microbiome-directed, and corticosteroid interventions used within a step-up treatment strategy in dogs with CIE under routine clinical conditions. Fifty-six dogs were enrolled. Clinical response was assessed using the Canine Chronic Enteropathy Clinical Activity Index (CCECAI), together with faecal calprotectin, serum folate, and serum cobalamin concentrations. In the dietary stage, both novel-protein and hydrolysed diets significantly reduced CCECAI and faecal calprotectin. Clinical remission, defined as a final CCECAI score ≤ 3, was achieved in 64% and 60% of dogs, respectively. Baseline-adjusted analyses likewise showed no significant between-group differences in CCECAI, faecal calprotectin, or cobalamin. In dogs receiving second-line treatment, both metronidazole and probiotics combined with fibre significantly reduced CCECAI and faecal calprotectin, while baseline-adjusted comparisons demonstrated no significant differences between treatments for the evaluated outcome. In dogs receiving corticosteroid-containing treatment, substantial numerical reductions in CCECAI and faecal calprotectin were observed in both the prednisone-containing and budesonide-containing regimens; however, the very small subgroup sizes and concomitant dietary, probiotic, and fibre interventions precluded definitive conclusions regarding the specific effects or comparative efficacy of the individual corticosteroids. These findings provide real-world clinical evidence supporting a structured step-up approach to canine CIE and provide a rationale for larger, adequately powered controlled studies to determine whether non-antibiotic microbiome-directed strategies and locally acting corticosteroid-containing therapy can reduce reliance on empirical antimicrobial treatment and systemic corticosteroids, thereby minimising the potential adverse consequences associated with these therapies.
papers.abstract_zh: 犬慢性發inflammatory性腸病（CIE）通常需要連續性的治療方法，根據臨床反應逐步升級治療。本前瞻性、開放標籤臨床研究評估了在常規臨床條件下，對CIE犬隻採用逐步升級治療策略中所使用的特定飲食、抗菌劑、微生態調節及皮質類固醇介入措施。共納入五十六隻犬隻。臨床反應透過犬慢性腸病臨床活動指數（CCECAI），以及糞便鈣衛蛋白、血清葉酸和血清鈷胺素濃度進行評估。在飲食階段，新穎蛋白質飲食與水解蛋白飲食皆顯著降低了CCECAI與糞便鈣衛蛋白。達到臨床緩解（定義為最終CCECAI評分 $\le$ 3）的犬隻比例分別為64%和60%。經基準值調整後的分析同樣顯示，兩組在CCECAI、糞便鈣衛蛋白或鈷胺素方面無顯著組間差異。在接受第二線治療的犬隻中，甲硝唑（metronidazole）以及益生菌合併纖維皆顯著降低了CCECAI與糞便鈣衛蛋白，而基準值調整後的比較顯示，各評估結果之治療間無顯著差異。在接受含皮質類固醇治療的犬隻中，含潑尼松（prednisone）及含布地奈德（budesonide）的療程均觀察到CCECAI和糞便鈣衛蛋白在數值上的顯著降低；然而，極小的子群樣本量以及伴隨的飲食、益生菌和纖維介入，使得無法對個別皮質類固醇的具體作用或比較效用得出確切結論。這些發現為犬CIE的結構化逐步升級治療提供了真實世界的臨床證據，並為規模更大、具備足夠統計考驗力的對照研究提供了理論依據，以確定非抗生素微生態調節策略與局部作用之含皮質類固醇治療是否能減少對經驗性抗菌治療及全身性皮質類固醇的依賴，從而將這些療法相關的潛在不良後果降至最低。

papers.title: Locomotor-State Dependence of Neuromodulation During Avian Free Flight
papers.abstract: Complex avian locomotor behaviors depend on the coordinated operation of neural processes involved in sensory perception, decision-making, and motor execution. Exogenous neural stimulation can alter motor output by intervening in neural processes, but its effects may depend on the current locomotor state. Here, we investigated the locomotor-state dependence of formatio reticularis medialis mesencephali (FRM) microstimulation in freely flying pigeons. Individualized stimulation parameters were screened under stable laboratory conditions and kept constant during free-flight experiments. Flight-state features before and during stimulation were extracted, and state–response models were constructed to quantify their associations with stimulation-evoked turning responses. Results showed that flight state during stimulation was more closely associated with turning responses than pre-stimulation state, with acceleration during stimulation making the largest contribution. When acceleration during stimulation was above the individual mean, turning-response dispersion decreased by 32.92%. In addition, pre-stimulation angular velocity was positively associated with acceleration during stimulation, indicating that the pre-stimulation locomotor state contains information related to the consistency of subsequent stimulation-evoked responses. These findings demonstrate that the effects of FRM microstimulation are locomotor-state dependent and provide a basis for identifying appropriate neuromodulation timing and improving response stability under complex locomotor conditions.
papers.abstract_zh: 複雜的鳥類運動行為取決於涉及感覺感知、決策和運動執行的神經過程之協調運作。外源性神經刺激可透過介入神經過程來改變運動輸出，但其效果可能取決於當前的運動狀態。在此，我們研究了自由飛行鴿子中腦內側網狀結構（FRM）微電刺激對運動狀態的依賴性。個別化的刺激參數在穩定的實驗室條件下進行篩選，並在自由飛行實驗中保持恆定。提取刺激前與刺激過程中的飛行狀態特徵，並建立狀態-反應模型來量化其與刺激誘發轉向反應的關聯。結果顯示，與刺激前狀態相比，刺激過程中的飛行狀態與轉向反應的關聯性更高，其中刺激過程中的加速度貢獻最大。當刺激過程中的加速度高於個體平均值時，轉向反應的分散度降低了32.92%。此外，刺激前的角速度與刺激過程中的加速度呈正相關，這表明刺激前的運動狀態包含與隨後刺激誘發反應之一致性相關的資訊。這些發現表明，FRM微電刺激的效果具運動狀態依賴性，並為在複雜運動條件下識別適當的神經調控時機及提高反應穩定性提供了基礎。

papers.title: Peat Pellets as Enrichment Material for Weaned Piglets
papers.abstract: We aimed to explore the effect of 8 mm peat pellets as enrichment material for weaned piglets. A total of 288 piglets were allocated to one of two treatments: peat pellets (PPs) or chopped straw (CS) as edible enrichment. Twelve pigs were housed per pen, with 12 weaner pens per treatment. Pigs were weighed at day 0, 9, 14, and 28 post-weaning. Faecal consistency was recorded 3 times a week. Piglet behaviour was observed at days 8 and 18, and damage on ears and tail were scored weekly. More cups of edible enrichment were provided to PP pens than to CS pens between day 0–14 to ensure ad libitum availability (p = 0.04). On day 18, PP piglets showed greater exploratory interaction with the edible enrichment than CS piglets (p = 0.045). PPs improved performance in the early post-weaning period, resulting in a higher initial feed intake (p = 0.0498) and growth (p = 0.007) of newly weaned piglets between days 0 and 9, and improved faecal scores between days 14 and 28 (p = 0.007). At the end of the study, piglets had improved body weight uniformity (p = 0.04) and tended to have a lower prevalence of tail damage (p = 0.07) when provided with PPs versus CS. In addition, PP piglets tended to spend less time on ear biting (p = 0.06) on day 8 than CS piglets. PPs are proposed as suitable enrichment material and were associated with improved zootechnical performance and faecal consistency in weaned piglets.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討 8 公釐泥炭顆粒（peat pellets）作為離乳仔豬環境豐富化物質（enrichment material）的效果。總計 288 頭仔豬被隨機分配至兩個處理組之一：以泥炭顆粒（PPs）或切碎稻草（CS）作為可食性豐富化物質。每欄飼養 12 頭豬，每個處理組有 12 個離乳豬欄。分別於離乳後第 0、9、14 和 28 天對豬隻進行秤重。每週記錄 3 次糞便性狀。於第 8 天和第 18 天觀察仔豬行為，並每週對耳朵和尾巴的損傷情況進行評分。在第 0 至 14 天期間，泥炭顆粒組（PPs）提供的可食性豐富化物質杯數多於切碎稻草組（CS），以確保採食自由（p = 0.04）。在第 18 天，泥炭顆粒組仔豬對可食性豐富化物質表現出更多的探索性互動（p = 0.045）。泥炭顆粒改善了離乳初期的生長表現，使剛離乳的仔豬在第 0 至 9 天期間具有較高的初始採食量（p = 0.0498）與生長表現（p = 0.007），並改善了第 14 至 28 天期間的糞便評分（p = 0.007）。在試驗結束時，相較於切碎稻草組，提供泥炭顆粒的仔豬具有較佳的體重均勻度（p = 0.04），且尾巴損傷的發生率有較低的趨勢（p = 0.07）。此外，在第 8 天時，泥炭顆粒組仔豬用於咬耳行為的時間有低於切碎稻草組的趨勢（p = 0.06）。本研究認為泥炭顆粒適合作為環境豐富化物質，且有助於提升離乳仔豬的畜牧生產性能與糞便性狀。

papers.title: Cryopreservation of Cavia porcellus L. Spermatozoa: Microscopic Characterization and Viability
papers.abstract: Studies evaluating the effects of cryopreservation on epididymal spermatozoa of Cavia porcellus remain limited. This study compared the effects of rapid and slow freezing protocols on microscopic characteristics, morphometry, and morphometric correlations. Epididymal spermatozoa from twelve guinea pigs were diluted in OptiXcell® extender with 25% egg yolk and equilibrated at 4 °C for 6 h. One aliquot was evaluated, while the other was cryopreserved using rapid (n = 5) or slow (n = 7) protocols. After thawing, motility, viability, plasma membrane functionality, acrosomal and chromatin integrity, and morphometry were assessed; cooling profiles were characterized using linear and cubic regression models. Cryopreservation reduced microscopic parameters compared with refrigerated samples (p < 0.05). Comparison showed no significant differences in motility, viability, acrosomal integrity, or plasma membrane function (p > 0.05), whereas chromatin integrity was higher after slow freezing (p = 0.03). Rapid freezing reduced acrosomal area, acrosomal perimeter, and head length, whereas slow freezing preserved morphometric variables and correlations, although correlation patterns should be interpreted as associations among morphometric traits rather than structural preservation. Both cooling curves were well described by linear and cubic models. Slow freezing was associated with better preservation of chromatin integrity and selected morphometric characteristics.
papers.abstract_zh: 評估冷凍保存對天竺鼠（Cavia porcellus）副睪精子影響的研究仍然有限。本研究比較了快速與慢速冷卻程序對顯微特徵、形態測量學及形態測量相關性的影響。將來自十二隻天竺鼠的副睪精子稀釋於含有 25% 卵黃的 OptiXcell® 稀釋液中，並在 4 °C 下平衡 6 小時。評估其中一份等分試樣，其餘則使用快速（n = 5）或慢速（n = 7）程序進行冷凍保存。解凍後，評估其活動力、存活率、質膜功能、頂體與染色質完整性以及形態測量學；並利用線性與三次迴歸模型來描述冷卻曲線。與冷藏樣本相比，冷凍保存降低了顯微參數（p < 0.05）。比較結果顯示，在活動力、存活率、頂體完整性或質膜功能方面沒有顯著差異（p > 0.05），而慢速冷凍後的染色質完整性較高（p = 0.03）。快速冷凍減少了頂體面積、頂體周長和頭部長度，而慢速冷凍則保留了形態測量變數與相關性，儘管相關性模式應被解釋為形態測量特徵之間的關聯，而非結構上的保存。這兩種冷卻曲線皆能被線性與三次模型良好描述。慢速冷凍與染色質完整性及部分形態測量特徵的較佳保存有關。

papers.title: Primary Erythrophagocytic Low-Grade Splenic T-Cell Lymphoma in a Cat: Clinical Case and Literature Review
papers.abstract: Lymphoma is a common hematopoietic neoplasm in cats; yet hepatosplenic forms remain rare. This report describes a unique case of low-grade erythrophagocytic splenic T-cell lymphoma with suspected peripheral blood involvement in a six-year-old neutered male domestic shorthair cat. The patient presented with severe non-regenerative macrocytic normochromic anemia and moderate splenomegaly. Blood smears revealed mononucleated cells exhibiting erythrophagocytosis. Splenic cytology and flow cytometry were consistent with a reactive process, leading to a presumptive diagnosis of immune-mediated anemia. The condition proved refractory to immunosuppressive therapy with prednisolone and cyclosporine. After splenectomy, histopathology showed diffuse erythrophagocytosis and white pulp hyperplasia. Definitive diagnosis was achieved only by PARR analysis, which demonstrated a monoclonal T-cell receptor gene rearrangement within a polyclonal background. This confirmed a neoplastic T-cell population despite the mature morphology of the lymphocytes. Treatment with chlorambucil and prednisolone resulted in progressive resolution of the anemia. The cat remains alive 13 months after splenectomy. This case highlights the diagnostic challenges of low-grade lymphomas, in which reactive features can mask neoplasia, and underscores the critical role of PARR analysis in differentiating monoclonal T-cell proliferation from complex reactive processes in feline splenic disorders.
papers.abstract_zh: 淋巴瘤是貓常見的造血系統腫瘤，然而肝脾型淋巴瘤仍屬罕見。本病例報告描述了一隻六歲絕育公米克斯貓罹患罕見的低惡性度嗜紅血球性脾臟T細胞淋巴瘤，且疑似侵犯週邊血液的獨特病例。病患求診時呈現嚴重的非再生性大球性正色素性貧血及中度脾臟腫大。血液抹片顯示具有嗜紅血球作用的單核細胞。脾臟細胞學與流式細胞儀檢查結果符合反應性病變，因而初步診斷為免疫媒介性貧血。此病況對 prednisolone 及 cyclosporine 等免疫抑制治療產生抗藥性。脾臟切除術後的組織病理學顯示瀰漫性嗜紅血球作用及白髓增生。最終診斷僅透過 PARR 分析（PCR for antigen receptor rearrangement）才得以確立，該分析在多株性背景中檢測出單株性T細胞受體基因重組。此結果證實了儘管淋巴細胞具有成熟的形態，仍存在腫瘤性T細胞族群。給予 chlorambucil 與 prednisolone 治療後，貧血情況逐漸緩解。該貓在脾臟切除術後十三個月仍存活。本病例突顯了低惡性度淋巴瘤的診斷挑戰，在此類病例中，反應性特徵可能會掩蓋腫瘤，並強調了 PARR 分析在鑑別貓脾臟疾病中的單株性T細胞增生與複雜反應性病變所扮演的關鍵角色。

papers.title: Quantification of Fecal Glucocorticoid Metabolites in Shelter Cats Using LC/MS/MS: Potential Biomarkers of Stress Associated with Shelter Admission
papers.abstract: Cats can experience physiological stress during transitions to unfamiliar environments, such as shelter admission. To enable non-invasive stress assessment in cats, fecal glucocorticoid metabolites were quantified by liquid chromatography–tandem mass spectrometry (LC/MS/MS) with Girard’s reagent T derivatization. Five analytes were targeted: three glucocorticoids (cortisol, cortisone, and corticosterone) and their fecal metabolites, 11β-hydroxyetiocholanolone and 11-oxoetiocholanolone. Thirty-five cats housed at an animal welfare center were classified into a shorter-admission group (<2 weeks after admission, n = 16) or a longer-admission group (≥2 weeks, n = 19). The three parent glucocorticoids showed no detectable peak in any sample, whereas both metabolites were detected in 28 of the 35 samples and were strongly correlated in both the shorter- and longer-admission groups (ρ = 0.9316 and 0.9699, respectively). Both metabolites were significantly higher in the shorter-admission group (p = 0.0036 and 0.0029, respectively), whereas no significant differences were detected by sex or neuter status. In an incubation experiment, concentration changes within 48 h (≤0.12 ng/mg) were smaller than the between-group differences (1.70–2.16 ng/mg). These findings suggest that both metabolites are potential biomarkers of stress associated with shelter admission and that their measurement may provide a practical, non-invasive approach for monitoring stress in shelter cats.
papers.abstract_zh: 貓隻在轉換至陌生環境（例如進入收容所）的過程中，可能會經歷生理壓力。為了對貓隻進行非侵入性壓力評估，本研究利用液相層析串聯質譜儀（LC/MS/MS）結合吉拉德試劑T（Girard's reagent T）衍生化技術，對糞便糖皮質激素代謝物進行了定量分析。研究針對五種分析物：三種糖皮質激素（皮質醇、皮質酮及可體松）及其糞便代謝物 11β-羥基本膽烷醇酮（11β-hydroxyetiocholanolone）與 11-氧代本膽烷醇酮（11-oxoetiocholanolone）。35隻收容於動物福利中心的貓隻被分為較短收容組（入住未滿2週，n = 16）或較長收容組（入住2週或以上，n = 19）。三種母體糖皮質激素在所有樣本中皆未檢測出波峰，而兩種代謝物則在 35 個樣本中的 28 個被檢測到，且在較短與較長收容組中均呈高度相關（分別為 $\rho = 0.9316$ 及 $\rho = 0.9699$）。這兩種代謝物在較短收容組中的濃度均顯著較高（分別為 $p = 0.0036$ 及 $p = 0.0029$），而按性別或絕育狀態分組則未檢測到顯著差異。在培養實驗中，48小時內的濃度變化（$\le 0.12\text{ ng/mg}$）小於組間差異（$1.70\text{–}2.16\text{ ng/mg}$）。這些研究結果表明，這兩種代謝物具備作為收容所入住相關壓力潛在生物標記的潛力，且其測量方法可能為監測收容貓壓力提供一種實用且非侵入性的方法。

papers.title: Comparative Bioaccumulation of Mineral Elements in Soft Tissues, Shells, and Pearls of Sinohyriopsis cumingii (Lea, 1852) Cultured for Non-Nucleated, Visceral Mass-Nucleated, and Mantle-Nucleated Pearls
papers.abstract: The triangle sail mussel Sinohyriopsis cumingii (Lea, 1852) is the world’s leading producer of freshwater pearls. Mineral elements are key components of pearls and affect pearl quality, but their bioaccumulation patterns in the soft tissues, shells, and pearls of this species remain unclear. Inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry was used to compare the bioaccumulation of essential major elements (Na, Mg, K, Ca), essential trace elements (Cr, Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, Cu, Zn, Se, Mo), and non-essential elements (Al, As, Sr, Ag, Cd, Ba, Tl, Pb) in the soft tissues, shells, and pearls of S. cumingii cultured for non-nucleated, visceral mass-nucleated, and mantle-nucleated pearls. Mg, K, Mn, Zn, and Ba were significantly more concentrated in soft tissues than in shells or pearls, whereas Ca and Sr showed the opposite trend (p < 0.05). Principal component analysis based on Zn, Ca, Mg, Sr, and Mn separated soft tissues from shells and pearls, while a second component based on Mo, Fe, Co, and Ni distinguished non-nucleated from visceral mass-nucleated and mantle-nucleated pearl mussels. Ca–Sr and Sr–Ba were consistently positively correlated in soft tissues across all three culture types (p < 0.05). Notably, Na was frequently involved in negative correlations between tissues: in mussels cultured for non-nucleated pearls, shell Na was negatively correlated with soft tissue K and pearl Na with soft tissue Ba (p < 0.05); in those cultured for visceral mass-nucleated pearls, soft tissue Na was negatively correlated with pearl Mn and Zn (p < 0.05); and in those cultured for mantle-nucleated pearls, pearl Na was negatively correlated with shell Zn (p < 0.05). Collectively, these findings elucidate mineral element bioaccumulation in pearl-producing S. cumingii.
papers.abstract_zh: 三角帆蚌（*Sinohyriopsis cumingii* (Lea, 1852)）是全球最重要的淡水珍珠生產物種。礦物元素是珍珠的關鍵組成部分並會影響珍珠品質，然而其在該物種的軟組織、貝殼和珍珠中的生物累積模式仍不清楚。本研究利用感應耦合漿質體質譜儀（ICP-MS），比較無核珍珠、內臟團有核珍珠及外套膜有核珍珠等三種養殖方式下，三角帆蚌軟組織、貝殼和珍珠中必需巨量元素（Na、Mg、K、Ca）、必需微量元素（Cr、Mn、Fe、Co、Ni、Cu、Zn、Se、Mo）以及非必需元素（Al、As、Sr、Ag、Cd、Ba、Tl、Pb）的生物累積情形。結果顯示，Mg、K、Mn、Zn 和 Ba 在軟組織中的濃度顯著高於貝殼或珍珠，而 Ca 和 Sr 則呈現相反趨勢（p < 0.05）。基於 Zn、Ca、Mg、Sr 和 Mn 的主成分分析將軟組織與貝殼及珍珠區分開來，而基於 Mo、Fe、Co 和 Ni 的第二主成分則將無核珍珠蚌與內臟團有核及外套膜有核珍珠蚌區分開來。在所有三種養殖類型中，軟組織內的 Ca–Sr 和 Sr–Ba 均呈現持續的正相關（p < 0.05）。值得注意的是，Na 經常參與組織間的負相關性：在無核珍珠養殖蚌中，貝殼 Na 與軟組織 K、珍珠 Na 與軟組織 Ba 呈負相關（p < 0.05）；在內臟團有核珍珠養殖蚌中，軟組織 Na 與珍珠 Mn 和 Zn 呈負相關（p < 0.05）；在外套膜有核珍珠養殖蚌中，珍珠 Na 與貝殼 Zn 呈負相關（p < 0.05）。綜上所述，這些發現闡明了產珠三角帆蚌中礦物元素的生物累積特徵。

papers.title: A Marine Bivalve (Entodesma navicula) Extract Suppresses the Replication of Influenza Viruses and Flaviviruses in Association with Reduced MLKL Phosphorylation
papers.abstract: Emerging influenza viruses and mosquito-borne flaviviruses continue to challenge animal and public health, highlighting the need for antivirals that remain effective after infection. This study evaluated the in vitro activity of a 70% ethanolic whole-specimen extract of the marine bivalve Entodesma navicula (ENE) against influenza A/Puerto Rico/8/1934 (H1N1; A/PR8), A/Wisconsin/15/2009 (H3N2), influenza B/Florida/78/2015, Zika virus, and dengue virus serotype 2. Antiviral activity was assessed using time-of-addition analysis, viability-based cytopathic-effect assays, reverse-transcription quantitative PCR, infectious virus titration, immunofluorescence, Western blotting, and flow cytometry. In the A/PR8 model, pre- and co-treatment produced no consistent inhibition. By contrast, post-infection ENE suppressed all tested viruses. For A/PR8, Zika virus, and dengue virus, this activity was supported by reduced viral genome abundance, infectious progeny, and viral antigen expression. In A/PR8-infected A549 cells, ENE reduced phosphorylation of receptor-interacting serine/threonine-protein kinase 3 (RIPK3) and mixed lineage kinase domain-like pseudokinase (MLKL). ENE also reduced the proportion of cells positive for phosphorylated MLKL within Zika- and dengue-virus-infected Vero E6 populations. These findings identify E. navicula as an underexplored source of post-infection antiviral bioactivity associated with attenuated necroptosis-related signaling. Isolation of active constituents and causal validation in primary cells and animal models are needed.
papers.abstract_zh: 新興流感病毒與蚊媒黃熱病毒持續對動物與公共衛生造成挑戰，凸顯出開發在感染後仍具療效之抗病毒藥物的必要性。本研究評估了海洋雙殼類光滑舟蛤（Entodesma navicula）全體 70% 乙醇萃取物（ENE）針對 A 型流感病毒 A/Puerto Rico/8/1934（H1N1；A/PR8）、A/Wisconsin/15/2009（H3N2）、B 型流感病毒 B/Florida/78/2015、茲卡病毒及登革熱病毒第二型之體外活性。抗病毒活性之評估採用加藥時間分析、基於細胞存活率之細胞病變效應檢測、反轉錄定量 PCR、感染性病毒滴定、免疫螢光分析、西方墨漬法及流式細胞術。在 A/PR8 模型中，預先治療與共同治療並未產生一致的抑制效果。相對地，感染後投予 ENE 則能抑制所有受測病毒。針對 A/PR8、茲卡病毒與登革熱病毒，此活性獲得病毒基因體豐度降低、感染性子代減少以及病毒抗原表現下降的支持。在 A/PR8 感染之 A549 細胞中，ENE 降低了受體相互作用絲胺酸／蘇胺酸蛋白激酶 3（RIPK3）及混合譜系激酶域樣假激酶（MLKL）的磷酸化。ENE 同時降低了茲卡病毒與登革熱病毒感染之 Vero E6 細胞群中磷酸化 MLKL 陽性細胞的比例。這些發現指出光滑舟蛤是一個尚未被充分開發的抗病毒生物活性來源，其具備感染後抗病毒活性，並與減弱的壞死性細胞凋亡相關訊息傳遞有關。未來仍需分離出活性成分，並在原代細胞及動物模型中進行因果驗證。

papers.title: Development and Application of an eDNA-Based MIRA-LFD Assay for the Detection of the Chinhai Spiny Newt
papers.abstract: The Chinhai spiny newt (Echinotriton chinhaiensis) is a rare amphibian species endemic to China. Its specialized habitat and small size make conventional field surveys and population monitoring not only time-consuming and labor-intensive, but also challenging. To address this challenge, we developed a visual detection method for habitat monitoring by integrating environmental DNA (eDNA) analysis with multi-enzyme isothermal rapid amplification (MIRA) and lateral flow dipstick (LFD) technologies. A specific mitochondrial gene fragment was selected as a target. MIRA primers and probes were designed and optimized through comparative sequence analysis with sympatric species, including crucian carp, bullfrogs, and polar fire shrimp. The assay conditions were subsequently refined by optimizing reaction temperature and test strip development time. Results indicate that using aquatic eDNA as a template, the optimized MIRA system incubated at 37 °C for 30 min, followed by a 20 min LFD development, produces clear and interpretable results. The assay demonstrated a DNA detection limit of 5.1 × 10−4 ng/μL, corresponding to a sensitivity higher than that of conventional PCR. The complete MIRA-LFD procedure can be performed within 50 min, and its identification results are consistent with those from high-throughput sequencing. This established method enables specific, efficient, and rapid detection of the Chinhai spiny newt in aquatic environments. It provides a practical technical tool for habitat surveys of this species, improving efficiency while reducing labor and resource demands. Furthermore, this approach offers a potential reference for habitat studies of other rare animal species.
papers.abstract_zh: 舟山遠口螈（*Echinotriton chinhaiensis*）是中國特有的珍稀兩棲類物種。其特殊的棲息地與微小的體型，使得傳統的野外調查與族群監測不僅耗時費力，且充滿挑戰。為了解決此一挑戰，本研究結合環境DNA（eDNA）分析、多酶恆溫快速擴增（MIRA）與側向流試紙（LFD）技術，開發了一種用於棲地監測的視覺化檢測方法。本研究選擇特定的粒線體基因片段作為標的，透過與同域分佈物種（包括鯽魚、牛蛙和極樂蝦虎魚等）進行序列比對分析，設計並優化了MIRA引子與探針。隨後透過最佳化反應溫度與試紙顯色時間，進一步完善了檢測條件。結果顯示，以水體eDNA作為模板，優化後的MIRA系統在37 °C下溫育30分鐘，接著進行20分鐘的LFD顯色，即可產生清晰且易於判讀的結果。該檢測方法的DNA檢測極限為 5.1 × 10−4 ng/μL，靈敏度高於傳統PCR。完整的MIRA-LFD程序可在50分鐘內完成，其鑑定結果與高通量定序結果一致。此一建立的方法能夠專一、高效且快速地檢測水體環境中的舟山遠口螈，為該物種的棲地調查提供了一項實用的技術工具，在提升效率的同時降低了人力與資源需求。此外，此方法亦可為其他珍稀動物物種的棲地研究提供潛在的參考。

papers.title: Comparative Veterinary Psychopharmacology in Dogs and Cats: Neurotransmitter Targets, Translational Boundaries, and Species-Specific Pharmacokinetics
papers.abstract: Behavioral disorders in companion animals are increasingly being managed with pharmacotherapy. However, prescription practices often rely on extrapolation from human psychiatry without considering species-specific phenotypes, diagnostic frameworks, or pharmacokinetic variability. A structured translational approach is required to align mechanistic plausibility with clinical evidence and interspecies constraints. This review consolidates the current information on the pharmacological modulation of neurotransmitter systems in canine and feline behavioral disorders using a comparative framework. Neurotransmitter circuits are mapped to relevant phenotypes. Controlled clinical evidence supports the use of selected serotonergic agents for specific chronic behavioral indications in dogs, whereas evidence in cats remains scarce and indication-specific. Controlled veterinary evidence is also available for selected agents used in acute or situational behavioral indications and for selegiline in canine cognitive dysfunction. Contrastingly, the broader neurotransmitter–phenotype relationships and emerging pharmacological targets discussed in this review are supported by mechanistic or translational evidence and should not be interpreted as established clinical indications. Cross-species translation is most defensible at the level of conserved receptors and transporters, whereas direct transfer of human diagnostic categories and subjective symptoms is limited in veterinary patients. Species- and drug-specific pharmacokinetic differences, along with limited feline data, necessitate careful dose initiation, titration, and monitoring to mitigate adverse effects and drug interactions. This review provides a structured framework for interpreting psychopharmacological evidence in dogs and cats by integrating pharmacological mechanisms, the design and scope of available clinical studies, translational boundaries, and species- and drug-specific pharmacokinetic considerations. Future research could benefit from standardized outcome measures, expanded feline trials, and pragmatic real-world designs.
papers.abstract_zh: 伴侶動物的行為障礙日益多以藥物治療來管理。然而，處方實務往往依賴人類精神醫學的推論，而未考量物種特異性表型、診斷框架或藥物動力學變異性。我們需要結構化的轉譯方法，將機轉合理性與臨床證據及物種間的限制相結合。本篇文獻綜述運用比較框架，整合了目前關於犬貓行為障礙中神經傳導物質系統藥物調節的資訊。神經傳導物質迴路被對應至相關表型。對照臨床證據支持在犬隻的特定慢性行為適應症中使用選定的血清素能藥物，而在貓隻中的證據仍然稀缺且具適應症特異性。針對急性或情境性行為適應症所使用的特定藥物，以及用於犬隻認知功能障礙的司來吉蘭（selegiline），亦有對照獸醫學證據的支持。相比之下，本綜述中討論的更廣泛之神經傳導物質與表型關係及新興藥物標的，僅獲得機轉或轉譯證據的支持，不應被解讀為已確立的臨床適應症。跨物種轉譯在高度保守的受體和轉運體層面上最具合理性，而在獸醫病患中直接轉移人類的診斷分類和主觀症狀則受到限制。物種與藥物特異性的藥物動力學差異，加上貓科數據有限，使得審慎的劑量起始、滴定與監測成為必要，以減輕不良反應和藥物交互作用。本綜述透過整合藥物機轉、現有臨床研究的設計與範疇、轉譯邊界，以及物種與藥物特異性的藥物動力學考量，為解讀犬貓精神藥理學證據提供了一個結構化框架。未來的研究可受惠於標準化的結果測量指標、擴大貓科動物試驗以及務實的真實世界設計。

papers.title: Juvenile Spontaneous Mediastinal Hemorrhage with Suspect Trauma
papers.abstract: A 6-month-old intact female American Pitbull (Canis lupus familiaris) underwent forensic evaluation for suspected blunt force trauma. Postmortem computed tomography (PMCT) identified pleural hyperattenuating soft tissue attenuating material, consistent with clotted blood, pleural effusion, a large thymus, and moderate to severe cranial mediastinal expansion with mixed fluid and lower-attenuation, soft tissue attenuating material. Histology confirmed thymic hemorrhage, while autopsy identified hemothorax, pleural blood clots, and hemomediastinum, excluding trauma, most consistent with spontaneous idiopathic thymic hemorrhage. This case highlights the utility of identifying hyperattenuating clot formation on PMCT, like the sentinel clot sign, for localizing antemortem hemorrhage and improving antemortem-postmortem correlation in forensic investigations.
papers.abstract_zh: 一隻6個月齡未絕育的美國比特犬（Canis lupus familiaris）因涉嫌遭受鈍器創傷而接受法醫學評估。死後電腦斷層掃描（PMCT）發現胸膜內呈高衰減的軟組織衰減物質（與凝血塊一致）、胸膜 effusion（胸水）、胸腺肥大，以及中度至重度、伴隨混合液體及較低衰減軟組織衰減物質的顱側縱膈腔擴大。組織學檢查證實為胸腺出血，而屍體解剖則發現血胸、胸膜血塊及縱膈腔積血，並排除創傷的可能性，最符合自發性特發性胸腺出血。本病例凸顯了在法醫學調查中，利用 PMCT 識別高衰減血塊形成（如前哨血塊徵象）以定位生前出血及提升生前與死後病灶關聯性的實用價值。

papers.title: Daily and Seasonal Activity Patterns of the Endemic Balkan Snow Vole (Dinaromys bogdanovi) Within a Sympatric Small Mammal Community
papers.abstract: Understanding the temporal ecology of endemic species is important for conservation planning in biodiversity hotspots during global climate change and habitat alteration. We used three years of camera-trap monitoring across two deployment periods to quantify daily and seasonal activity patterns of the endemic Balkan snow vole (Dinaromys bogdanovi) and sympatric terrestrial small mammals in Biokovo Nature Park, Croatia, within the Western Balkan glacial refugia. Dinaromys bogdanovi was predominantly nocturnal, with minor but consistent diurnal activity, and shifted from multimodal nocturnal activity in spring, summer and autumn to a unimodal winter peak. Temporal niche differentiation occurred between D. bogdanovi and the sympatric small mammals during some seasons. These differences were associated with nocturnal peak timing and the greater diurnal activity of D. bogdanovi. In summer, the detected taxa showed greater overlap in predominantly nocturnal activity, consistent with a possible influence of thermal conditions on surface activity, although temperature was not measured. We also provide quantitative activity data for the geographically isolated Dinaric population of Eliomys quercinus. This study demonstrates the value of long-term camera trapping for monitoring cryptic small mammals and provides a baseline for evaluating future changes in activity, habitat use and community interactions, supporting conservation planning for endemic species facing climate change and anthropogenic pressures.
papers.abstract_zh: 了解特有物種的時間生態學，對於全球氣候變遷與棲地改變期間生物多樣性熱點的保育規劃至關重要。我們利用跨越兩個部署期間、為期三年的紅外線自動相機監測，量化克羅埃西亞比奧科沃自然公園（位於西巴爾幹冰河避難所）內特有巴爾幹雪田鼠（Dinaromys bogdanovi）及同域分佈陸域小型哺乳動物的日活性與季節性活性模式。巴爾幹雪田鼠主要為夜行性，伴隨少量但持續的日行性活動，其活性模式從春、夏、秋季的多峰夜間活性，轉變為冬季的單峰高峰。在某些季節中，D. bogdanovi 與同域小型哺乳動物之間出現了時間生態位區隔。這些差異與夜間活性高峰的時間點以及 D. bogdanovi 較高的日行性活動有關。在夏季，被偵測到的類群在主要夜行性活動中展現出較高的重疊度，這與熱環境可能對地表活性產生的影響一致（儘管未實際測量溫度）。我們同時提供了地理隔離的迪納拉林睡鼠（Eliomys quercinus）族群之定量活性數據。本研究展示了長期自動相機監測對於監測隱蔽性小型哺乳動物的價值，並為評估未來活性、棲地利用及社群互動的變遷提供了基準，進而支持面對氣候變遷與人為壓力的特有物種保育規劃。

papers.title: Mineral Composition and Adequacy of Mineral Concentrations in Dog and Cat Diets: A Systematic Review
papers.abstract: Minerals are essential for numerous physiological functions in dogs and cats; however, concerns remain regarding the adequacy and safety of mineral supply across an increasingly diverse range of diets. This systematic review synthesised evidence on mineral composition and adequacy in companion-animal diets, with emphasis on dietary factors influencing mineral variability. A systematic search identified studies published between 2005 and 2025 that evaluated mineral composition, intake or adequacy in conventional commercial, raw-meat-based, plant-based, home-prepared, and therapeutic diets. Seventy-six studies met the inclusion criteria, including 58 analytical studies and 18 studies based on estimated mineral intake or adequacy of mineral levels. Calcium and phosphorus were the most frequently reported macrominerals, and iron, zinc, copper, iodine, and selenium were the most commonly evaluated trace elements. Deficient and excessive mineral levels occurred across dietary categories, with substantial variability in several alternative-diet datasets and some conventional commercial diets. No uniform directional difference in mean mineral concentrations distinguished conventional from alternative diets, while price and commercial positioning did not consistently predict adequacy. Intake-based studies showed that feeding level can alter adequacy despite apparently adequate dietary concentrations. Methodological heterogeneity, limited bioavailability data, and inconsistent toxicological benchmarks constrain interpretation and highlight the need for more standardised assessment approaches.
papers.abstract_zh: 礦物質對貓狗的眾多生理功能至關重要；然而，隨著寵物飲食日益多元，其礦物質供應的充足性與安全性仍備受關注。本系統性文獻回顧綜合了關於伴侶動物飲食中礦物質組成與充足性的證據，並著重於影響礦物質變異性的飲食因素。透過系統性檢索，篩選出2005年至2025年間發表、評估傳統商業飼料、生肉飲食、植物性飲食、鮮食（家庭自製飲食）及處方飲食中礦物質組成、攝取量或充足性的研究。共有76篇研究符合納入標準，包含58篇分析性研究以及18篇基於估計礦物質攝取量或礦物質含量充足性的研究。鈣和磷是最常被報告的巨量礦物質，鐵、鋅、銅、碘和硒則是評估最頻繁的微量元素。各類飲食中皆出現礦物質缺乏與過量的情況，其中數種替代性飲食資料集及部分傳統商業飼料展現出顯著的變異性。平均礦物質濃度並未呈現一致的方向性差異來區分傳統飲食與替代飲食，價格和商業定位也無法一致地預測充足性。基於攝取量的研究顯示，儘管飲食中的礦物質濃度看似充足，但餵食量仍可能改變其充足性。方法學上的異質性、有限的生體可用率數據以及不一致的毒理學基準限制了解讀性，並突顯出建立更標準化評估方法的必要性。

papers.title: Intraocular Pressure in Clinically Normal Alpacas: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Tono-Pen and TonoVet Tonometry
papers.abstract: Intraocular pressure (IOP) is a critical physiological indicator of ocular health in canines, felines, and equines, yet a precise, tool-independent baseline remains inconsistent in South American camelids. This study quantitatively evaluated the comparability and potential bias between Tono-Pen applanation and TonoVet rebound tonometry in clinically normal alpacas (Vicugna pacos). Following a systematic review of the literature published between 1990 and 2026 across MEDLINE, Web of Science, and CAB abstracts, data from six eligible studies encompassing 320 healthy eyes were extracted, including 500 tests. Tono-Pen pooled mean: 15.84 mmHg (95% CI: 14.06–17.62) and TonoVet pooled mean: 15.89 mmHg (95% CI: 13.79–17.99), respectively. Paired comparison demonstrated a clinically negligible pooled mean difference of +0.58 mmHg (95% CI: −1.85 to +3.02) between devices. Subgroup and meta-regression analyses confirmed that tonometer type did not significantly influence IOP measurements (β = −0.36 mmHg; 95% CI: −4.86 to +4.17; p = 0.85), though notable heterogeneity existed (tau2 ≒ 1.74–2.60; I2 > 90%) due to variations in populations and operator techniques. In conclusion, both Tono-Pen and TonoVet yield comparable intraocular pressure measurements. These findings provide an evidence-based pooled estimate of normal intraocular pressure in healthy alpacas, which is crucial for diagnosing ophthalmic pathologies like glaucoma and uveitis in camelid veterinary medicine.
papers.abstract_zh: 眼壓（Intraocular pressure, IOP）是評估犬、貓和馬匹眼部健康的重要生理指標，然而在南美洲駱駝科動物中，精確且不依賴特定工具的基準值仍不一致。本研究量化評估了臨床正常羊駝（Vicugna pacos）使用 Tono-Pen 平面壓平式眼壓計與 TonoVet 反彈式眼壓計之間的具體可比性與潛在偏差。透過系統性回顧 1990 年至 2026 年間發表於 MEDLINE、Web of Science 和 CAB abstracts 的文獻，萃取了包含 6 項符合條件的研究數據，共計涵蓋 320 隻健康眼及 500 次測試。Tono-Pen 合併平均值為 15.84 mmHg（95% 信賴區間：14.06–17.62），TonoVet 合併平均值為 15.89 mmHg（95% 信賴區間：13.79–17.99）。配對比較顯示，兩款儀器間的合併平均差異為 +0.58 mmHg（95% 信賴區間：−1.85 至 +3.02），在臨床上可忽略不計。次群組與統合迴歸分析證實，眼壓計類型並未顯著影響眼壓測量值（β = −0.36 mmHg；95% 信賴區間：−4.86 至 +4.17；p = 0.85），惟族群與操作者技術的差異導致了顯著的異質性（tau2 ≒ 1.74–2.60；I2 > 90%）。總結而言，Tono-Pen 與 TonoVet 皆能產生具可比性的眼壓測量結果。這些發現為健康羊駝的正常眼壓提供了基於證據的合併估算值，這對駱駝科動物獸醫學中診斷如青光眼和葡萄膜炎等眼科病變至關重要。

papers.title: Dietary Stevia-Derived Isochlorogenic Acid Attenuates LPS-Induced Ileal Injury and Is Associated with Altered TLR4/MyD88/NF-κB and Nrf2/HO-1 Gene Expression in Weaned Lambs
papers.abstract: Weaning stress-induced oxidative damage impairs lamb growth and health. This study explored the protective effects of stevia-derived isochlorogenic acid (ICGA) against lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced injury in 48 weaned lambs (50 ± 2 d old, 15 ± 2.30 kg), randomly allocated to four groups. CON and LPS groups received a basal diet; ICGA1 and ICGA2 received a basal diet with 1.5 and 2.0 g/kg ICGA for 14 d. On day 15, LPS (200 μg/kg BW) or saline was injected intraperitoneally. ICGA showed a trend to increase ADG (p > 0.05). ICGA reduced serum IL-6, TNF-α, IL-1β, DAO, D-LA, ET, and COR; elevated immunoglobulins; improved ileal morphology; upregulated tight junction genes and Nrf2/HO-1 pathway genes; and suppressed the TLR4/MyD88/NF-κB pathway. ICGA also modulated gut microbiota. In conclusion, ICGA alleviates inflammation and oxidative stress and improves intestinal barrier function in weaned lambs.
papers.abstract_zh: 離乳壓力誘發的氧化損傷會損害羔羊的生長與健康。本研究探討了甜菊萃取異綠原酸（ICGA）對脂多糖（LPS）誘導損傷的保護作用。試驗選取48隻離乳羔羊（50 ± 2 日齡，15 ± 2.30 公斤），隨機分為四組。CON組和LPS組飼餵基礎日糧；ICGA1組和ICGA2組飼餵添加 1.5 和 2.0 g/kg ICGA 的基礎日糧，持續 14 天。於第 15 天腹腔注射LPS（200 μg/kg 體重）或生理鹽水。結果顯示，ICGA 有增加平均日增重（ADG）的趨勢（p > 0.05）。ICGA 降低了血清中的 IL-6、TNF-α、IL-1β、DAO、D-LA、ET 和 COR 濃度；提高了免疫球蛋白水平；改善了迴腸形態；上調了緊密連接基因及 Nrf2/HO-1 路徑相關基因的表達；並抑制了 TLR4/MyD88/NF-κB 路徑。此外，ICGA 也調節了腸道微生物群。綜上所述，ICGA 可緩解離乳羔羊的發炎與氧化壓力，並改善其腸道屏障功能。

papers.title: Refining the Protocol for Equine Umbilical-Cord-Derived Mesenchymal Stem Cell Isolation: A Pilot Study on Resource Efficiency and Cellular Properties
papers.abstract: Equine mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) are vital tools for preclinical studies and regenerative medicine, due to their multipotent nature and immunomodulatory potential. Wharton’s jelly provides a non-invasive and abundant source of MSCs. However, the isolation from equine umbilical cord remains challenging, as tissue decontamination is difficult and the enzymatic isolation methods often yield variable amounts of cells. In addition, the established protocols are frequently labour-intensive, time-consuming, and costly. In this pilot study we adapted existing protocols with the aim to improve contamination rates, time commitment and costs. A thorough decontamination method and increased collagenase I digestion time from 3 h in the reference method (RM) to 24 h for the novel method (NM) were employed. Trilineage differentiation, RT-qPCR and flow cytometry were used to characterise both groups. Finally, a non-inferiority analysis was performed to confirm the feasibility of the NM. The changes in protocol led to the decrease in overtime and nightshifts, a faster postisolation expansion by reducing the culture duration by 13.5 ± 11 d, and minimised overall contamination rates (6.3% across 64 samples; RM = 3.1%, NM = 9.4%) compared with most published protocols. Consequently, we were able to reduce the costs per sample by 21 ± 21%.
papers.abstract_zh: 馬間葉幹細胞（MSCs）因其具備多向分化潛能與免疫調節特性，是進行臨床前研究與再生醫療的重要工具。華頓膠（Wharton’s jelly）提供了豐富且非侵入性的間葉幹細胞來源。然而，從馬臍帶中分離細胞仍具挑戰性，因為組織去 contaminations（消毒/去除污染）困難，且酵素分離方法往往產出不穩定的細胞數量。此外，既有的實驗流程通常耗費人力、時間且成本高昂。在本先導研究中，我們改良了現有的實驗流程，旨在降低污染率、減少所需時間與成本。我們採用了一套徹底的去污染方法，並將膠原酶 I（collagenase I）的消化時間從參考方法（RM）的 3 小時延長至新方法（NM）的 24 小時。本研究使用三向分化（trilineage differentiation）、即時定量反轉錄聚合酶連鎖反應（RT-qPCR）與流式細胞術（flow cytometry）來對兩組細胞進行特性鑑定。最後，進行了非劣性分析（non-inferiority analysis）以確認新方法的可行性。與多數已發表的實驗流程相比，此流程的修改減少了加班與夜班的需求，縮短了培養時間（減少 13.5 ± 11 天）以加快分離後的擴增速度，並將整體污染率降至最低（64 個樣本中的污染率為 6.3%；RM = 3.1%，NM = 9.4%）。因此，我們成功將每個樣本的成本降低了 21 ± 21%。

papers.title: Multimodal Postmortem Investigation of Fatal Thoracic Metallic Projectile Trauma in a Jindo Dog: Radiographic, Computed Tomographic, Necropsy, and Histopathological Findings
papers.abstract: Metallic projectile injuries in companion animals present complex diagnostic and evidentiary challenges, especially when comprehensive crime scene data and intact projectiles are absent. This report describes the forensic postmortem investigation of an adult male Jindo dog submitted by law enforcement authorities following fatal penetrating trauma in South Korea. Digital radiography identified multiple radiopaque metallic opacities in the left thoracic region, accompanied by severe pleural effusion and subcutaneous emphysema. Postmortem computed tomography (PMCT; 16-slice MDCT, 0.75-mm slice thickness) precisely delineated clustered hyperattenuating metallic fragments embedded in the left thoracic wall, an oblique displaced fracture of the left fourth rib, marked hemopneumothorax with compression atelectasis, and pneumomediastinum, while excluding cranial or abdominal injury. At necropsy, approximately 100 mL of pleural blood was evacuated, and through-and-through pulmonary transcapsular lacerations were identified traversing the right and left cranial lung lobes. Multiple deformed metallic fragments were recovered adjacent to the fractured rib under strict forensic chain-of-custody protocols. Histopathology of pulmonary laceration margins confirmed acute hemorrhage, fibrin deposition, and early neutrophilic margination, establishing an acute antemortem vital reaction (survival interval < 1 h). Histological examination of the cutaneous entry and exit margins revealed mechanical tearing without thermal coagulation or soot residue, consistent with an intermediate-to-distant discharge. The anatomical convergence of lesions supported a right-to-left projectile trajectory, with the left axillary defect presenting features compatible with a shored exit wound. Death was attributed to fatal acute hemopneumothorax and bilateral pulmonary laceration secondary to perforating metallic projectile injury. This case demonstrates the indispensable diagnostic and prosecutorial value of integrating digital radiography, PMCT virtopsy, forensic necropsy, and histopathology in veterinary medicolegal investigations of non-accidental trauma.
papers.abstract_zh: 伴侶動物的金屬彈丸創傷具有複雜的診斷與證據挑戰，特別是在缺乏完整的犯罪現場資料與完整彈丸的情況下。本報告描述了一隻成年雄性珍島犬在南韓發生致命穿透性創傷後，經執法機關移送進行的法醫解剖調查。數位X光攝影顯示左側胸腔有數個放射不透明的金屬陰影，伴隨嚴重的胸水與皮下氣腫。死後電腦斷層掃描（PMCT；16層MDCT，切片厚度0.75公釐）精確描繪出包埋於左側胸壁中的叢聚高衰減金屬碎片、左側第四肋骨斜向位移性骨折、伴隨壓迫性肺萎陷的顯著血氣胸以及縱隔氣腫，同時排除頭部或腹部損傷。在解剖時，抽吸出約100毫升的胸腔血液，並識別出橫跨左右肺葉前端的穿透性肺實質撕裂傷。在嚴格的法醫證據保管鏈（chain-of-custody）規範下，於骨折肋骨旁回收多個變形金屬碎片。肺部撕裂傷邊緣的組織病理學證實有急性出血、纖維蛋白沉積及早期嗜中性球邊緣化，確立了急性生前生命反應（存活時間小於1小時）。皮膚出入口邊緣的組織學檢查顯示機械性撕裂而無熱凝固或煙灰殘留，符合中長距離射擊。病灶的解剖學交會點支持由右至左的彈丸彈道，左側腋下缺損則呈現符合支撐性出口創傷（shored exit wound）的特徵。死因歸咎於穿透性金屬彈丸創傷所導致的致命性急性血氣胸與雙側肺撕裂傷。本案例展示了在非意外創傷的獸醫法醫調查中，整合數位影像X光、PMCT虛擬解剖（virtopsy）、法醫解剖與組織病理學無可替代的診斷與檢方偵辦價值。

papers.title: Comparative Pharmacokinetics of Subcutaneous Tolfenamic Acid Under Two Different Anesthetic Protocols in Cats Undergoing Ovariohysterectomy
papers.abstract: The aim of this research was to determine the effect of different anesthesia protocols on the pharmacokinetics of tolfenamic acid in cats undergoing ovariohysterectomy. The research involved 12 cats that underwent ovariohysterectomy. The cats were randomly divided into two equal groups: one (n = 6) receiving xylazine–ketamine and the other (n = 6) receiving propofol–isoflurane anesthesia. Tolfenamic acid was administered subcutaneously at a dose of 4 mg/kg 30 min prior to ovariohysterectomy in both groups. The plasma samples were analyzed for tolfenamic acid using high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC)-UV. The terminal elimination half-life (t1/2λz), area under the curve (AUC0-last), maximum plasma concentration (Cmax), and time to reach peak plasma concentration (Tmax) values after xylazine–ketamine anesthesia were determined to be 3.30 h, 42.17 h*µg/mL, 6.34 µg/mL, and 2 h, respectively. Tolfenamic acid in the propofol–isoflurane anesthetic group showed shorter t1/2λz and Tmax than the xylazine–ketamine group but a greater Cmax. However, AUC0-last was similar in both anesthesia groups. These results showed that the pharmacokinetics of tolfenamic acid may vary depending on the anesthesia protocol used in ovariohysterectomy. However, there is a need to evaluate the efficacy of tolfenamic acid in cats under both anesthesia regimens.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討不同麻醉方案對接受卵巢子宮切除術貓隻體內托芬那酸（tolfenamic acid）藥物動力學的影響。研究共納入 12 隻接受卵巢子宮切除術的貓，並隨機均分為兩組（每組 n = 6）：一組接受木札辛－氯胺酮（xylazine–ketamine）麻醉，另一組接受丙泊酚－異氟醚（propofol–isoflurane）麻醉。兩組均於術前 30 分鐘以 4 mg/kg 的劑量皮下注射托芬那酸。利用高效液相層析紫外線檢測法（HPLC-UV）分析血漿中的托芬那酸濃度。在木札辛－氯胺酮麻醉組中，末端排除半衰期（$t_{1/2\lambda z}$）、曲線下面積（$AUC_{0\text{-last}}$）、最大血漿濃度（$C_{\max}$）以及達到最高血漿濃度時間（$T_{\max}$）分別為 3.30 h、42.17 h*µg/mL、6.34 µg/mL 和 2 h。與木札辛－氯胺酮組相比，丙泊酚－異氟醚麻醉組的托芬那酸表現出較短的 $t_{1/2\lambda z}$ 和 $T_{\max}$，但 $C_{\max}$ 較高。然而，兩組的 $AUC_{0\text{-last}}$ 相似。這些結果顯示，卵巢子宮切除術中所使用的麻醉方案可能會改變托芬那酸的藥物動力學。不過，仍需進一步評估托芬那酸在這兩種麻醉方案下應用於貓隻的療效。

papers.title: Potential Feasibility and Perspectives of Fecal Microbiota Transplantation for Restoring Gut Function in Giant Pandas
papers.abstract: Although the giant panda (Ailuropoda melanoleuca) relies almost exclusively on bamboo, its carnivore-like gastrointestinal tract has limited capacity for fiber digestion. The gut microbiota contributes to bamboo-derived nutrient utilization, although the extent of this contribution remains limited. Captivity-associated dietary and environmental changes frequently disrupt this microbial ecosystem, resulting in impaired digestive function and reduced physiological resilience. Conventional interventions, including antibiotics and single-strain probiotics, are generally insufficient to restore the complexity and stability of the gut microbiota. Fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT), which reconstructs the gut microbial ecosystem by transferring an intact microbial community, has demonstrated therapeutic potential in humans and various animal models. However, its feasibility in giant pandas remains unclear because their short intestinal tract, absence of fermentation chambers, rapid gastrointestinal transit, and host-mediated ecological filtering substantially limit donor microbiota engraftment. This review evaluates the biological rationale and technical feasibility of oral FMT in giant pandas by integrating evidence from gastrointestinal physiology, microbial ecology, and conservation medicine. This review identifies the principal barriers to microbial engraftment. It synthesizes a giant panda-specific framework from the available literature, encompassing function-oriented donor selection, optimized microbial delivery strategies, and multidimensional efficacy assessment. Collectively, this synthesis provides a theoretical foundation for future FMT research in giant pandas and offers a conceptual reference for microbiota-based interventions in the conservation of endangered wildlife.
papers.abstract_zh: 儘管大貓熊（Ailuropoda melanoleuca）幾乎完全以竹子為主食，但其類似肉食動物的消化道對纖維的消化能力有限。腸道微生物相有助於竹源營養物質的利用，儘管這種貢獻的程度仍然有限。與圈養相關的飲食和環境變化經常會破壞此微生物生態系統，導致消化功能受損以及生理適應力降低。傳統的干預措施（包括抗生素和單菌株益生菌）通常不足以恢復腸道微生物相的複雜性與穩定性。糞便微生物相移植（FMT）透過轉移完整的微生物群落來重建腸道微生物生態系統，已在人類和各種動物模型中展現出治療潛力。然而，其在大貓熊身上的可行性仍不清楚，因為它們短小的消化道、缺乏發酵室、快速的胃腸道蠕動，以及宿主介導的生態過濾，大幅限制了供體微生物的植入。本綜述結合了胃腸道生理學、微生物生態學和保育醫學的證據，評估了大貓熊口服FMT的生物學基礎與技術可行性。本綜述指出了微生物植入的主要障礙，並從現有文獻中綜合出一個大貓熊專屬的框架，包含功能導向的供體選擇、最佳化的微生物遞送策略，以及多維度的效力評估。總體而言，這項綜合分析為未來大貓熊的FMT研究提供了理論基礎，並為瀕危野生動物保育中基於微生物相的干預措施提供了概念性參考。

papers.title: Gill Alterations in Adult Zebrafish Exposed to Avobenzone: Morphometric Profiling and Machine-Learning Analysis
papers.abstract: Gill histopathology is widely used in fish toxicology, but lesion scores and targeted measurements capture only part of the structural information in routine sections. We tested whether a morphometric profile could quantify avobenzone-related changes in adult zebrafish gills. The 40× dataset comprised gill sections from 35 adult zebrafish across five conditions represented in the image dataset: a 4-day solvent-control group and fish exposed to nominal avobenzone concentrations of 3 or 9 μg/L for 4 or 21 days. From 750 fields, quality control and automated segmentation yielded 503 accepted masks; 360 fields (72 per condition) were used in the balanced analysis. Thirty-nine descriptors quantified tissue geometry, interlamellar spaces, branch-like organisation, and thickness heterogeneity. Validation was repeated 30 times with all fields from each fish kept in the same partition. The time-matched 4-day control-versus-exposed comparison reached 89.4 ± 4.1% balanced accuracy. The 3-versus-9 μg/L comparison at 4 days reached 88.7 ± 4.6%, and 4 versus 21 days within the 9 μg/L group reached 88.5 ± 5.0%. Performance for direct five-condition classification was lower (68.4 ± 5.1%). Because 21-day control images were not included, exposure-related inference was restricted to the time-matched 4-day comparison. Morphometric profiling provides a quantitative complement to conventional histopathology while preserving individual fish identity as the grouping unit for image analysis.
papers.abstract_zh: 魚類組織病理學中的鰓部組織學廣泛應用於魚類毒理學，但病灶評分與標靶測量僅能捕捉常規切片中部分結構資訊。我們測試了形態測量學輪廓是否能量化成年斑馬魚鰓部與阿伏苯宗（avobenzone）相關的改變。40倍率數據集包含來自35隻成年斑馬魚的鰓部切片，涵蓋影像數據集中的五種條件：4天溶劑對照組，以及暴露於公稱濃度3或9 μg/L阿伏苯宗4天或21天的魚隻。從750個視野中，經由品質控制與自動分割產生503個可接受的光罩；其中360個視野（每種條件72個）用於平衡分析。39個描述符可用於量化組織幾何形狀、鰓板間隙、樹枝狀組織結構以及厚度異質性。驗證重複進行30次，每隻魚的所有視野均保留在同一分割區中。時間相符的4天對照組與暴露組比較達到 89.4 ± 4.1% 的平衡準確率。在4天時，3與9 μg/L的比較達到 88.7 ± 4.6%，而9 μg/L組內4天與21天的比較達到 88.5 ± 5.0%。直接進行五種條件分類的效能較低（68.4 ± 5.1%）。由於未納入21天對照組影像，與暴露相關的推論僅限於時間相符的4天比較。形態測量學輪廓為傳統組織病理學提供了定量互補，同時將個別魚隻身分保留作為影像分析的分組單位。

papers.title: Conjoined Twins in Guinea Pigs (Cavia porcellus): Case Report
papers.abstract: This study reports a case of conjoined twins in guinea pigs (Cavia porcellus) from the Peru breed, in the Cajamarca region, Peru. A one-year-old female gave birth to normal offspring and a pair of conjoined twins born dead; The latter were carried out with morphological, radiographic and echographic evaluations, and the blood count and serum biochemical profile of the dam were analyzed. The twins presented cephalothoraco–omphalopagus fusion, characterized by a single skull with cyclopia, arhinia and astomy, ventral thoracoabdominal fusion, the pelvis separated and four extremities (four pairs) completely dislocated. Radiographic and ultrasound evaluations identified two hearts and two pairs of kidneys, with preserved gross sonographic morphology and no evident major structural abnormalities. The maternal blood count showed mild hypochromic macrocytosis and mild thrombocytopenia, with the rest of the hematological and biochemical parameters within normal ranges. It was concluded that the hallmarks are compatible with an early developmental disturbance affecting midline structures, although the precise timing and etiology could not be definitively established, which selectively affected the structures of the medial line. This report expands the scarcity of evidence available on serious congenital malformations in guinea pigs.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究報導了一例發生在秘魯卡哈馬卡地區、秘魯品種天竺鼠（Cavia porcellus）的連體雙胞胎病例。一隻一歲大的雌性天竺鼠產下了正常幼獸及一對死產的連體雙胞胎；對後者進行了形態學、X光及超音波評估，並分析了母體的全血細胞計數與血清生化學檢查。雙胞胎呈現頭胸臍聯胎（cephalothoraco–omphalopagus）融合，其特徵為單一顱骨伴隨單眼症、無鼻及無口，腹側胸腹融合，骨盆分離且四肢（四對）完全脫位。X光與超音波評估識別出兩顆心臟與兩對腎臟，其大體超音波形態保存完好且無明顯的主要結構異常。母體全血細胞計數顯示輕度低色素性大紅血球症及輕度血小板減少症，其餘血液學及生化參數均在正常範圍內。結論指出，這些特徵與影響中線結構的早期發育障礙相符，儘管確切的時間點與病因無法確切確立，但其選擇性地影響了中線的結構。本報告補充了關於天竺鼠嚴重先天性畸形現有稀缺的證據。

papers.title: Cardiovascular Responses and Energy Expenditure During a Standardized Training Programme in Three-Year-Old Czech Warmblood Stallions
papers.abstract: Background: Early training represents an important period in the development of young sport horses, yet field-based information on cardiovascular responses and estimated energy expenditure across different exercise modalities remains limited. Objectives: This study aimed to characterize heart rate (HR) responses and estimate energy expenditure in three-year-old Czech Warmblood stallions during an 18-week standardized training programme, with emphasis on exercise modality and temporal variation. Hypothesis: We hypothesized that HR responses and estimated energy expenditure would differ among exercise modalities and vary throughout the training period. Methods: Fourteen three-year-old Czech Warmblood stallions were monitored over 18 weeks, comprising 1003 training sessions across six exercise modalities. Session mean, peak, and minimum HR were recorded, and energy expenditure was estimated using HR-based equations and National Research Council (NRC) recommendations. Linear mixed-effects models assessed associations with exercise modality and monitoring week, accounting for repeated observations within horses. Results: Exercise modality was associated with mean HR (χ2 = 284.64, p < 0.001) and peak HR (χ2 = 122.08, p < 0.001), but not minimum HR (p = 0.066). Monitoring week was associated with all three HR outcomes (p < 0.001), with significant modality × week interactions. Estimated energy expenditure per session differed among exercise modalities (p < 0.001), with the highest model-based values observed during free jumping and horse walker exercise and the lowest during lunging. NRC-based estimates of daily energy expenditure (113.87 ± 11.73 MJ/day) exceeded estimates obtained using the Coenen HR (100.33 ± 6.23 MJ/day) and Coenen O2 (95.78 ± 6.68 MJ/day) methods. Conclusions: Cardiovascular responses and estimated energy expenditure differed among exercise modalities, while temporal HR variation could not be attributed solely to cardiovascular adaptation. Assessment of training load should consider both exercise characteristics and session duration. HR monitoring provides complementary information under field conditions, but HR-derived energy estimates should not be regarded as independently validated measures of energy requirements.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：早期訓練是年輕運動馬發展的重要時期，然而關於不同運動模式下心血管反應與估算能量消耗的實地研究資訊仍然有限。目的：本研究旨在探討三歲捷克溫血種公馬在為期18週的標準化訓練計畫中，心臟速率（HR）的反應及估算能量消耗，並重點關注運動模式與時間變異。假說：我們假設心臟速率反應與估算能量消耗在不同的運動模式間會有所不同，且在整個訓練期間會隨時間而變異。方法：本研究監測了14匹三歲捷克溫血種公馬超過18週的時間，涵蓋了透過六種運動模式進行的1003次訓練課程。記錄了每次訓練的平均、最高和最低心臟速率，並使用基於心臟速率的方程式與美國國家研究委員會（NRC）的建議值來估算能量消耗。利用線性混合效應模型評估與運動模式及監測週數的相關性，同時納入馬匹內部的重複觀察考量。結果：運動模式與平均心臟速率（$\chi^2 = 284.64, p < 0.001$）及最高心臟速率（$\chi^2 = 122.08, p < 0.001$）相關，但與最低心臟速率無關（$p = 0.066$）。監測週數與所有三項心臟速率結果均相關（$p < 0.001$），且具有顯著的「運動模式 $\times$ 週數」交互作用。每次訓練的估算能量消耗在不同運動模式間有所不同（$p < 0.001$），其中以自由跳躍和馬匹漫步機運動的模式模型估算值最高，而以調馬索訓練最低。基於 NRC 的每日能量消耗估算值（$113.87 \pm 11.73 \text{ MJ/day}$），高於使用 Coenen 心臟速率（$100.33 \pm 6.23 \text{ MJ/day}$）及 Coenen $\text{O}_2$（$95.78 \pm 6.68 \text{ MJ/day}$）方法所獲得的估算值。結論：心血管反應與估算能量消耗在不同的運動模式間有所不同，而心臟速率的時間變異不能單純歸因於心血管適應。評估訓練負荷時，應同時考量運動特徵與訓練持續時間。心臟速率監測在實地條件下提供了互補的資訊，但不應將心臟速率推導出的能量估算值視為能量需求的獨立驗證測量標準。

papers.title: Pharmacokinetics of Doramectin After Subcutaneous and Intramuscular Administrations in Siamese Freshwater Crocodiles (Crocodylus siamensis)
papers.abstract: Doramectin (DRM) is a broad-spectrum macrocyclic lactone antiparasitic agent widely used in veterinary medicine. Its pharmacokinetics in reptiles, particularly Siamese freshwater crocodiles (Crocodylus siamensis), remain limited. This study aimed to characterize the pharmacokinetic profiles of DRM following subcutaneous (SC) and intramuscular (IM) administration in Siamese crocodiles. Twenty clinically healthy male crocodiles were randomly allocated into four groups (n = 5 per group) and administered a single dose of DRM at 0.2 or 0.3 mg/kg body weight (b.w.) via either the SC or IM route. Blood samples were collected from pre-dose to 60 days after administration, and plasma DRM concentrations were quantified using a validated high-performance liquid chromatography method with fluorescence detector. Pharmacokinetic parameters were determined by non-compartmental analysis. Plasma DRM concentrations remained quantifiable through day 60 in 19 of 20 animals. Geometric mean maximum plasma concentrations (Cmax) were 14.73 and 20.28 ng/mL following SC administration at 0.2 and 0.3 mg/kg, respectively, and 24.48 and 36.34 ng/mL following IM administration. Significantly higher Cmax values were observed at 0.3 mg/kg for both routes (p < 0.05). Median Tmax values were 11 and 9 days following SC administration and 3 and 4 days following IM administration at 0.2 and 0.3 mg/kg, respectively. The geometric mean terminal elimination half-lives (T1/2λz) were 5.37 and 9.73 days for SC administration and 7.38 and 9.97 days for IM administration at 0.2 and 0.3 mg/kg, respectively. Systemic exposure increased with dose. The geometric mean AUC0–last increased numerically from 368.84 to 491.87 ng × day/mL following SC administration and significantly from 372.45 to 643.97 ng × day/mL following IM administration (p < 0.05). Intramuscular administration resulted in higher Cmax and more rapid attainment of peak plasma concentrations than SC administration. These findings demonstrate prolonged systemic persistence and dose-related pharmacokinetic changes in DRM in freshwater crocodiles and provide species-specific information to support further evaluation of dosage regimens.
papers.abstract_zh: 多拉克汀（Doramectin, DRM）是一種廣效型大環內酯類抗寄生蟲藥物，廣泛應用於獸醫學中。其在爬行動物，特別是暹羅淡水鱷（Crocodylus siamensis）體內的藥代動力學研究仍然相當有限。本研究旨在探討暹羅鱷分別透過皮下（SC）與肌肉（IM）投予 DRM 後的藥代動力學特徵。試驗選用二十隻臨床健康的雄性鱷魚，隨機均分為四組（每組 n = 5），分別透過皮下或肌肉途徑單劑投予 0.2 或 0.3 mg/kg 體重（b.w.）劑量的 DRM。自投藥前至投藥後 60 天採集血液樣本，並使用經過驗證的高效液相層析結合螢光檢測器方法定量血漿中的 DRM 濃度。藥代動力學參數係透過非房室分析法進行測定。在 20 隻動物中有 19 隻的血漿 DRM 濃度持續可被定量至第 60 天。在皮下投予 0.2 與 0.3 mg/kg 劑量後，血漿最高濃度（Cmax）之幾何平均值分別為 14.73 與 20.28 ng/mL；肌肉投予後則分別為 24.48 與 36.34 ng/mL。兩種給藥途徑在 0.3 mg/kg 劑量下皆觀察到顯著較高的 Cmax 值（p < 0.05）。在皮下投予 0.2 與 0.3 mg/kg 後，達到最高血漿濃度之中位數時間（Tmax）分別為 11 天與 9 天；肌肉投予後則分別為 3 天與 4 天。在皮下投予 0.2 與 0.3 mg/kg 後，幾何平均終端排除半衰期（T1/2λz）分別為 5.37 天與 9.73 天；肌肉投予後則分別為 7.38 天與 9.97 天。全身暴露量隨劑量增加而增加。皮下投予後，幾何平均 AUC0–last 從 368.84 數值性增加至 491.87 ng × day/mL；肌肉投予後則從 372.45 顯著增加至 643.97 ng × day/mL（p < 0.05）。與皮下注射相比，肌肉注射可產生更高的 Cmax 且能更快達到血漿峰值濃度。這些研究結果證明了 DRM 在淡水鱷體內具有延長的全身持續性以及劑量相關的藥代動力學變化，並提供了物種特異性資訊以支持未來對劑量方案的進一步評估。

papers.title: Permanent and Regenerative Grazing Systems Are Associated with Distinct Fecal Bacterial and Fungal Microbiota Patterns in Donkeys Under Extensive Pasture Conditions
papers.abstract: This study investigated whether permanent and regenerative (rotational) grazing systems are associated with differences in fecal bacterial and fungal microbiota of donkeys under extensive pasture conditions. Young female donkeys were assigned to permanent or regenerative grazing, and paired fecal samples from eight animals per system were collected before pasture access and at the end of the grazing period. Culture-based microbial counts, parasitological examination, animal performance measurements, forage assessment, and bacterial 16S rRNA gene and fungal ITS amplicon sequencing were performed. Donkeys under regenerative grazing showed higher average daily gain than those under permanent grazing (378.0 ± 57.8 vs. 242.4 ± 65.8 g/day; p < 0.001), whereas culture-based fecal microbial counts and fecal egg counts did not differ significantly between systems. Beta-diversity analyses identified sampling time as a consistent source of variation in both bacterial and fungal communities, whereas associations with grazing system and its interaction with sampling time depended on the distance metric used. Bacterial communities retained a large shared core, whereas fungal communities showed stronger compositional turnover. Longitudinal differential abundance analysis identified 336 bacterial and 66 fungal amplicon sequence variants (ASVs) with significant grazing system × sampling time interactions. More positive temporal responses under regenerative grazing were observed among several Spirochaetota and Neocallimastigomycota ASVs, whereas detected Methanobrevibacter ASVs showed a more positive temporal change under permanent grazing.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討在粗放放牧條件下，長期放牧（permanent）與再生式（輪牧）放牧系統是否與驢糞便細菌及真菌微生物相的差異有關。將年輕母驢分配至長期或再生式放牧系統，並在進入牧場前及放牧期結束時，採集每種系統各八隻動物的配對糞便樣本。進行了基於培養的微生物計數、寄生蟲學檢查、動物生長性能測定、牧草評估，以及細菌 16S rRNA 基因與真菌 ITS 增幅子定序。再生式放牧下之驢隻的平均日增重高於長期放牧（378.0 ± 57.8 對比 242.4 ± 65.8 公克／天；p < 0.001），而基於培養的糞便微生物計數和糞便蟲卵數在各系統間則無顯著差異。貝塔多樣性（beta-diversity）分析指出，採樣時間是細菌與真菌群落變異的一致來源，而與放牧系統及其與採樣時間之交交互作用的關聯性則取決於所使用的距離度量。細菌群落保留了大量共有的核心，而真菌群落則顯示出較強的組成更替。縱向差異豐度分析識別出 336 個細菌及 66 個真菌增幅子序列變異（ASV），具有顯著的放牧系統 × 採樣時間交互作用。在幾個螺旋體門（Spirochaetota）與新麗鞭毛菌門（Neocallimastigomycota）的 ASV 中觀察到再生式放牧具有較正向的時間反應，而檢測到的甲烷短梗菌屬（Methanobrevibacter）ASV 在長期放牧下則顯示出較正向的時間變化。

papers.title: Family-Aware Genome-Wide Association Mapping of Growth and Body-Shape Traits in Bighead Carp (Hypophthalmichthys nobilis)
papers.abstract: Reliable marker–trait associations can support genetic improvement of growth and body conformation in bighead carp (Hypophthalmichthys nobilis). We investigated eight traits in 569 fish assigned to 34 inferred consensus full-sib groups. Genotypes at 89,684 reference-consistent SNP positions were recalled from sequencing alignments and filtered by read depth, genotype quality, and heterozygote-allele balance. Common-mask validation of 274,566 genotype cells supported a 60% pre-imputation call-rate threshold, achieving 94.17% overall, 90.26% non-reference, and 89.04% heterozygote concordance, with hard-dosage r2 = 0.859. The final imputed matrix contained 32,304 SNPs; 9086 LD-pruned SNPs were used to estimate population structure and genomic covariance. Primary mixed-model scans used recalled genotype inputs before Beagle imputation and identified 18 suggestive trait–marker combinations. Candidate analyses using actual observed genotypes supported 17 combinations at within-group permutation FDR < 0.05, representing 16 markers. Grouping, model, and group-omission sensitivity analyses characterized their robustness. Prioritized regions contained developmentally relevant genes, including sulf1, dmrt2, cyp24a1, chst12, efcab7, and anapc7. These family-supported candidates provide targets for replication and functional investigation and may inform genetic improvement and new-variety development in bighead carp.
papers.abstract_zh: 可靠的標記與性狀關聯能支援大頭鰱（Hypophthalmichthys nobilis）生長與體型性狀的遺傳改良。我們調查了隸屬於 34 個推論一致全同胞群體的 569 尾魚之 8 項性狀。從定序比對中重新檢定 89,684 個參考一致性 SNP 位點的基因型，並依讀段深度、基因型品質與雜合子等位基因平衡進行過濾。274,566 個基因型細胞的共同遮罩驗證支援 60% 的填補前檢出率閾值，達到 94.17% 的整體一致性、90.26% 的非參考一致性、89.04% 的雜合子一致性，且硬劑量（hard-dosage）$r^2 = 0.859$。最終填補矩陣包含 32,304 個 SNP；其中 9,086 個經過連鎖不平衡修剪（LD-pruned）的 SNP 用於估計族群結構與基因體共變異。主要混合模型掃描在 Beagle 填補前使用重新檢定的基因型輸入，識別出 18 個暗示性性狀－標記組合。使用實際觀測基因型進行的候選分析在群體內置換錯誤發現率（FDR）$< 0.05$ 的條件下支援 17 個組合，代表 16 個標記。分群、模型及缺群敏感度分析用以表徵其穩健性。優先排序的區域包含具發育相關性的基因，包含 *sulf1*、*dmrt2*、*cyp24a1*、*chst12*、*efcab7* 與 *anapc7*。這些經家族支持的候選標記為複製與功能研究提供了目標，並可為大頭鰱的遺傳改良與新品種培育提供資訊。

papers.title: Bupivacaine Liposomal Injectable Suspension (Nocita®) via Transversus Abdominis Plane (TAP) Block for Management of Pain in Dogs with Acute Pancreatitis: A Pilot Study
papers.abstract: Abdominal pain is one of the most salient features of acute pancreatitis (AP) in dogs. While traditional opioids provide excellent analgesia, they are also associated with significant adverse effects, including ileus. The transversus abdominis plane (TAP) block has been shown to manage pain associated with AP in humans. Ten client-owned dogs with naturally occurring AP were enrolled in a blinded placebo-controlled clinical trial, receiving either a TAP block with bupivacaine liposome injectable suspension (n = 5) or traditional opioid analgesia (n = 5). Rescue analgesia was administered when indicated based on pain score monitoring every 4 h. Each dog was also administered an imaging device to track gastrointestinal transit time (GITT). The total opioid dose during the 72 h study period was significantly lower in the TAP block group (0.18 ± 0.27 mg/kg) compared to the control (0.99 ± 0.50 mg/kg) group (p = 0.01). GITT was prolonged in both the TAP block group (2/3) and the control group (4/5) compared to published references for healthy dogs. Bupivacaine liposomal injectable suspension administered via TAP block may provide sufficient analgesia in dogs with AP while also minimizing their total opioid requirements. Delayed gastric transit was common in both groups, suggesting that factors beyond just opioid administration contribute to gastrointestinal dysmotility in dogs with AP.
papers.abstract_zh: 腹痛是犬急性胰臟炎（AP）最顯著的特徵之一。傳統鴉片類藥物雖然能提供極佳的鎮痛效果，但也伴隨著顯著的不良反應，包括腸阻塞。腹橫肌平面（TAP）阻滯已被證明可用於控制人類AP相關的疼痛。本研究納入了十隻罹患自然發生性AP且有主人的犬隻，進行一項盲法安慰劑對照臨床試驗，分別接受使用微脂體布比卡因注射懸浮液的TAP阻滯（n = 5）或傳統鴉片類藥物鎮痛（n = 5）。每4小時根據疼痛評分監測結果，在有需要時給予救援鎮痛。每隻犬隻亦獲投予一項造影裝置以追蹤胃腸道通過時間（GITT）。在為期72小時的研究期間，TAP阻滯組的總鴉片類藥物劑量（0.18 ± 0.27 mg/kg）顯著低於對照組（0.99 ± 0.50 mg/kg）（p = 0.01）。與健康犬隻的已發表參考值相比，TAP阻滯組（2/3）與對照組（4/5）的GITT均延長。經由TAP阻滯投予微脂體布比卡因注射懸浮液，可能為患有AP的犬隻提供充足的鎮痛效果，同時將其對鴉片類藥物的總需求量降至最低。兩組中延遲的胃通過時間皆很常見，這表明除了鴉片類藥物投予之外的其他因素，也促成了AP犬隻的胃腸道運動障礙。

papers.title: Association Between Pre-Transfusion Systemic Inflammatory Response Syndrome and Transfusion-Associated Adverse Events in Dogs: A Retrospective Study
papers.abstract: Blood transfusion is an important supportive therapy in critically ill dogs, but transfusion reactions (TRs) remain a clinically relevant complication. This retrospective study evaluated whether pre-transfusion systemic inflammatory response syndrome (SIRS) was associated with transfusion-associated adverse events in dogs. Medical records of dogs receiving red-cell-containing blood products at a veterinary referral hospital in the Republic of Korea between December 2023 and May 2026 were reviewed. Among 146 transfusion episodes from 100 dogs, 142 episodes with evaluable primary outcomes were included in the primary outcome analysis. Transfusion-associated adverse events were identified more frequently in the SIRS group than in the No SIRS group (32.7% vs. 11.4%; p = 0.007). In univariable logistic regression, SIRS was associated with increased odds of the primary outcome (OR, 3.78; 95% CI, 1.36–10.51; p = 0.011). In a patient-clustered multivariable generalized estimating equation (GEE) analysis, the adjusted OR remained elevated at 3.57, although the association did not reach statistical significance (95% CI, 0.98–12.98; p = 0.053). Each additional fulfilled SIRS criterion was associated with increased odds of the primary outcome (OR, 1.63; 95% CI, 1.10–2.41; p = 0.014). However, the association was attenuated and was not statistically significant in sensitivity analyses using stricter outcome definitions based on imputability and independent re-adjudication. These findings suggest an association between pre-transfusion SIRS and clinically suspected transfusion-associated adverse events under the broad retrospective primary outcome definition, but the results were sensitive to the level of diagnostic certainty required for outcome classification. The findings should therefore be considered hypothesis-generating and require confirmation in prospective studies using standardized reaction definitions and blinded outcome assessment.
papers.abstract_zh: 輸血是重症犬隻重要的支持性療法，然而輸血反應（transfusion reactions, TRs）仍然是臨床上相關的併發症。這項回顧性研究旨在評估輸血前全身性發炎反應症候群（SIRS）是否與犬隻輸血相關不良事件有關。本研究回顧了 2023 年 12 月至 2026 年 5 月期間，於大韓民國一家獸醫轉診醫院接受含紅血球血液製品犬隻的病歷。在 100 隻犬隻的 146 次輸血病程中，有 142 次具備可評估主要結果的病程被納入主要結果分析中。SIRS 組發生輸血相關不良事件的頻率高於無 SIRS 組（32.7% 對比 11.4%；p = 0.007）。在單變量邏輯斯迴歸中，SIRS 與主要結果發生勝算增加相關（勝算比 [OR]，3.78；95% 信賴區間 [CI]，1.36–10.51；p = 0.011）。在以病患為群集的多變量廣義估計方程式（GEE）分析中，調整後的勝算比仍維持升高至 3.57，儘管該關聯性未達到統計學顯著性（95% CI，0.98–12.98；p = 0.053）。每多符合一項 SIRS 標準，皆與主要結果發生勝算增加相關（OR，1.63；95% CI，1.10–2.41；p = 0.014）。然而，在使用基於歸因性（imputability）及獨立重新判定之更嚴格結果定義的敏感度分析中，此關聯性減弱且無統計學顯著性。這些發現表明，在廣泛的回顧性主要結果定義下，輸血前 SIRS 與臨床懷疑的輸血相關不良事件之間存在關聯性，但結果對結果分類所需的診斷確定性水準相當敏感。因此，這些發現應被視為具假設生成性（hypothesis-generating），並需要在前瞻性研究中使用標準化的反應定義與盲法結果評估來進一步確認。

papers.title: Blood DNA Methylation Responses to Seasonal Environmental Variation in the Giant Panda (Ailuropoda melanoleuca): A Whole-Genome Bisulfite Sequencing Analysis of Multiple Individuals Across Multiple Time Points
papers.abstract: Seasonal environmental variation is a widespread stressor for wildlife and can induce plastic changes in DNA methylation. Blood DNA methylation is an integrative molecular indicator of overall physiological status, yet its seasonal dynamics in the giant panda remain unclear. This study aimed to profile genome-wide blood methylation patterns in giant pandas under natural field conditions and to reveal the epigenetic strategies underlying their seasonal adaptation. Twelve blood samples were collected from three wild-trained giant pandas in the Daxiangling Nature Reserve during winter (n = 6) and summer (n = 6) between 2023 and 2025 and were subjected to whole-genome bisulfite sequencing. The genome-wide mC/C ratio (4.18–4.98%) was dominated by the CG context. Winter–summer comparison identified 7113 differentially methylated regions and 3063 differentially methylated genes. These genes were enriched in transcriptional regulation, cell surface receptor signaling, miRNA metabolism, and MAPK, Ras, and T/B cell receptor signaling pathways. Winter-hypermethylated genes were enriched in both immune defense and energy-consuming processes, whereas winter-hypomethylated genes showed limited enrichment, indicating that hypermethylation-mediated suppression dominates seasonal adaptation. This study reveals, for the first time, a seasonal methylation fingerprint in giant panda blood characterized by a “summer immune enhancement, winter energy conservation” pattern. As sampling occurred in natural habitats, these differences reflect integrated epigenetic responses to temperature, photoperiod, food availability, and pathogen pressure rather than single-factor effects. These findings provide molecular evidence for seasonal adaptation in endangered mammals and candidate markers for captive panda management and wild-release assessment.
papers.abstract_zh: 季節性環境變異是對野生動物普遍存在的壓力源，並能誘導DNA甲基化產生可塑性變化。血液DNA甲基化是整體生理狀態的綜合性分子指標，然而大貓本的血液DNA甲基化季節性動態仍不清楚。本研究旨在描繪自然野外條件下大貓熊全基因組血液甲基化模式，並揭示其季節性適應背後的表觀遺傳策略。於2023年至2025年間，在大相嶺自然保護區內從3隻野化培訓的大貓熊採集了12個血液樣本（冬季n = 6，夏季n = 6），並進行全基因組亞硫酸鹽定序。全基因組mC/C比率（4.18–4.98%）以CG背景為主。冬夏比較共鑑定出7113個差異甲基化區域與3063個差異甲基化基因。這些基因顯著富集於轉錄調控、細胞表面受體訊號傳遞、miRNA代謝，以及MAPK、Ras和T/B細胞受體訊號傳遞路徑。冬季高甲基化基因在免疫防禦與耗能過程中皆有富集，而冬季低甲基化基因則顯示有限的富集，表明高甲基化介導的抑制作用在季節性適應中佔主導地位。本研究首次揭示了大貓熊血液的季節性甲基化特徵，表現出「夏季免疫增強、冬季能量節約」的模式。由於採樣在自然棲息地進行，這些差異反映了對溫度、光週期、食物可利用性及病原體壓力的綜合表觀遺傳反應，而非單一因素的影響。這些發現為瀕危哺乳動物的季節性適應提供了分子證據，並為圈養大貓熊管理與野外放歸評估提供了候選標記。

papers.title: YOLOv11-Pose-Based Tracking Reveals Neuropeptide F Regulation of Agonistic Behavior in Macrobrachium rosenbergii
papers.abstract: The giant freshwater prawn Macrobrachium rosenbergii is inherently aggressive, and this innate trait constitutes a major bottleneck restricting high-density intensive aquaculture. In this study, we developed behavioral phenotyping analysis software integrating YOLOv11-pose and the SORT tracking algorithm to automatically recognize and quantify agonistic behaviors. To validate the reliability of this platform, we used it to investigate the role of neuropeptide F (NPF) through loss- and gain-of-function strategies. The platform successfully captured behavioral differences across treatments and generated results that were consistent with manual observations, confirming its accuracy and utility for automated behavioral analysis. Moreover, it provided additional kinematic metrics that are not accessible through manual observation, offering more comprehensive behavioral quantification. Mechanistically, NPF silencing reduced feed intake, suppressed growth, and disrupted hepatopancreatic glycolysis, suggesting that NPF may modulate aggression at least partly through energy metabolic pathways. Collectively, this study provides a robust tool for behavioral phenotyping in crustaceans, with potential applications for behavior-based management in intensive farming systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型淡水蝦類羅氏沼蝦（*Macrobrachium rosenbergii*）具有天生具侵略性的特質，而此種天生特徵構成了限制高密度集約化水產養殖的主要瓶頸。在本研究中，我們開發了一套整合 YOLOv11-pose 與 SORT 追蹤演算法的行為表現型分析軟體，以自動辨識並量化敵對行為。為了驗證此平台的可靠性，我們透過功能喪失與功能獲得策略，利用該平台探討神經肽 F（NPF）的作用。此平台成功捕捉了各處理組之間的行為差異，且產生的結果與人工觀察結果一致，證實了其用於自動化行為分析的準確性與實用性。此外，它提供了人工觀察無法取得的額外運動學指標，從而提供更全面的行為量化。在機制上，NPF 靜默降低了攝食量、抑制生長，並干擾了肝胰臟的糖解作用，這表明 NPF 至少部分可能透過能量代謝途徑來調控侵略性。總體而言，本研究為甲殼類動物的行為表現型分析提供了強健的工具，並在集約化養殖系統的基於行為管理中具有潛在的應用價值。

papers.title: Association Between Gut Microbiota Dysbiosis and Synovial Inflammation in Carpal Osteoarthritis of Ili Racehorses: A Preliminary Study Integrating Imaging, Synovial Fluid Analysis, and Fecal 16S rRNA Sequencing
papers.abstract: Osteoarthritis (OA) is a leading cause of lameness and premature retirement in racehorses. Gut microbiota may contribute to OA pathogenesis through the gut–joint axis, but this relationship remains unclear in racehorses. This study focused on six OA-affected Ili racehorses and six healthy Ili racehorses from the same region; the Ili horse originated from Yili, Xinjiang, China. OA severity was assessed by clinical examination, lameness grading, radiography, arthroscopy, synovial fluid biomarker analysis, and fecal 16S rRNA gene sequencing. Associations between differential gut microbiota and synovial inflammatory markers were evaluated by Spearman correlation analysis. OA horses exhibited higher lameness scores and typical radiographic findings. Compared with healthy controls, OA horses exhibited significantly higher synovial concentrations of IL-1β, IL-6, TNF-α, total protein, COMP, and MMP-3. Gut microbiota analysis revealed reduced microbial diversity and significant compositional alterations in OA horses. Spearman correlation analysis demonstrated significant associations between these microbial changes and synovial inflammatory mediators as well as cartilage degradation markers. Overall, gut microbiota dysbiosis in Ili racehorses with carpal OA may be associated with synovial inflammation and abnormal cartilage metabolism via the gut–joint axis. However, the experimental scale and the number of animals will be increased as needed for further validation.
papers.abstract_zh: 骨關節炎（OA）是賽馬跛行和提早退役的主要原因。腸道微生物相可能透過腸－關節軸（gut–joint axis）參與骨關節炎的發病機制，但這種關係在賽馬中尚不清楚。本研究聚焦於來自同一地區的6匹罹患骨關節炎的伊犁馬和6匹健康的伊犁馬；伊犁馬源自中國新疆伊犁。骨關節炎的嚴重程度透過臨床檢查、跛行評級、X光檢查、關節鏡檢查、滑液生物標記分析以及糞便16S rRNA基因定序進行評估。透過斯皮爾曼相關分析（Spearman correlation analysis）評估差異腸道微生物相與滑液發炎標記之間的關聯。罹患骨關節炎的馬匹表現出較高的跛行分數和典型的X光檢查結果。與健康對照組相比，罹患骨關節炎的馬匹其滑液中的IL-1β、IL-6、TNF-α、總蛋白、COMP和MMP-3濃度顯著升高。腸道微生物相分析顯示，罹患骨關節炎的馬匹微生物多樣性降低，且組成發生顯著改變。斯皮爾曼相關分析表明，這些微生物變化與滑液發炎介質以及軟骨降解標記之間存在顯著關聯。總體而言，患有腕關節骨關節炎的伊犁馬其腸道微生物相失調，可能透過腸－關節軸與滑液發炎及異常的軟骨代謝有關。然而，未來將視需要擴大實驗規模和動物數量以進行進一步驗證。

papers.title: Sex-Specific DNA Methylation in the Liver of Ancherythroculter nigrocauda, a Fish with Female-Biased Size Dimorphism
papers.abstract: Sexual size dimorphism (SSD) is widespread in teleost fishes, yet the epigenetic mechanisms underlying sex-specific growth remain poorly understood, particularly in non-model species. Here, we performed genome-wide DNA methylation profiling of liver tissue in Ancherythroculter nigrocauda, a species exhibiting female-biased SSD, using the MethylRAD approach. MethylRAD sequencing of five females and five males generated approximately 1.0–1.5 million unique methylated loci per sample. Comparative analysis identified 82,872 differentially methylated sites (DMSs), which clearly separated sexes and were significantly enriched in promoters and CpG islands. Gene ontology analyses revealed that sex-biased methylation preferentially affected pathways related to intracellular signaling, cell adhesion, cytoskeletal organization, and protein modification, processes closely associated with hepatic growth and metabolic regulation. Chromosomal binning uncovered large contiguous male-biased methylation domains on Superscaffold15 and Superscaffold20, consistent with recombination-suppressed regions and suggesting candidate sex-linked loci, with Superscaffold20 supported by prior sex-specific coverage differences. Integration with liver transcriptome data revealed a threshold-dependent regulatory architecture: genes harboring dense methylation clustering (>20 DMS) were approximately six-fold more likely to exhibit sex-biased expression, and directional concordance between methylation and transcription further supported functional coupling. Together, these findings demonstrate that sex-biased DNA methylation in the liver is widespread yet concentrated within regulatory hotspots and discrete chromosomal domains, highlighting epigenetic regulation as a key contributor to hepatic sexual dimorphism and providing new insights into the molecular basis of SSD in teleost fishes.
papers.abstract_zh: 性別體型雙態性（sexual size dimorphism, SSD）在硬骨魚類中普遍存在，然而探討性別特異性生長背後的表觀遺傳機制仍所知有限，特別是在非模式物種中。本研究利用 MethylRAD 方法，對具有雌性偏向性 SSD 的物種黑尾鲌（Ancherythroculter nigrocauda）的肝組織進行了全基因組DNA甲基化圖譜分析。對五個雌性和五個雄性進行的 MethylRAD 定序，每個樣本產生了約 100 萬至 150 萬個獨特的甲基化位點。比較分析識別出 82,872 個差異甲基化位點（DMSs），這些位點能明確區分性別，且在啟動子和 CpG 島中顯著富集。基因本體（Gene Ontology）分析顯示，性別偏向性甲基化主要影響與細胞內信號傳導、細胞黏附、細胞骨架組織和蛋白質修飾相關的途徑，這些過程與肝臟生長和代謝調控密切相關。染色體區段分箱（chromosomal binning）在 Superscaffold15 和 Superscaffold20 上發現了大片連續的雄性偏向性甲基化域，這與重組抑制區域一致，並暗示了候選性別聯鎖位點的存在，其中 Superscaffold20 得到了先前性別特異性覆蓋度差異的支持。與肝臟轉錄體數據的整合揭示了一個閾值依賴的調控架構：含有密集甲基化叢集（>20 個 DMS）的基因表現出性別偏向性表達的可能性約高出六倍，甲基化與轉錄之間的具方向性的一致性進一步支持了功能偶聯。綜上所述，這些發現表明肝臟中的性別偏向性 DNA 甲基化雖然普遍，但集中於調控熱點和獨立的染色體域中，突顯了表觀遺傳調控是促成肝臟性別雙態性的關鍵因素，並為硬骨魚類 SSD 的分子基礎提供了新見解。

papers.title: Respiration Rate Associations with Temperature and Relative Humidity and Preliminary Model-Derived Reference Points in Korean Native Black Goats
papers.abstract: Quantitative evidence on the associations of temperature, relative humidity, and skin temperature (ST) with respiration rate (RR) in Korean native black goats remains limited, including potential sex- and growth-stage differences. Twenty-four goats (six per sex-by-growth-stage group) were repeatedly measured on 35 dates at a single farm over 15–33 °C, yielding 840 repeated animal-date observations. Natural-log-transformed RR was analyzed using a linear mixed-effects model accounting for animal-, date-, and pen-level dependence. Within the observed conditions, each 1 °C increase in temperature and 1 percentage-point increase in relative humidity were associated with 9.23% and 0.79% increases in RR, respectively. At 24 °C, mean relative humidity, and mean baseline body weight, adult goats had higher predicted RR than growing goats, while temperature-associated RR slopes did not clearly differ by sex or growth stage. Adding ST modestly improved in-sample model fit. Model-derived temperatures corresponding to RR criteria of 40, 60, and 80 breaths/min were 21.2–23.1, 25.8–27.7, and 29.0–31.0 °C, respectively, conditional on mean relative humidity and mean baseline body weight. These preliminary population-level reference points are not validated thresholds of heat-stress severity, welfare impairment, or production loss and require external validation in larger, multi-farm studies using independent physiological, behavioural, welfare, and production outcomes.
papers.abstract_zh: 關於韓國本土黑山羊之溫度、相對濕度及皮膚溫度與呼吸頻率關聯性的定量證據仍然有限，且潛在的性別與生長階段差異亦未明。本研究在單一牧場的 15–33 °C 環境下，對 24 隻山羊（每個性別與生長階段組 6 隻）進行了 35 個日期的重複測量，共產生 840 筆重複的動物-日期觀察值。利用線性混合效應模型分析經自然對數轉換的呼吸頻率，並納入動物、日期及欄位層級的相依性。在觀察到的條件下，溫度每升高 1 °C 與相對濕度每增加 1 個百分點，分別與呼吸頻率增加 9.23% 和 0.79% 相關。在 24 °C、平均相對濕度和平均基準體重下，成羊的預測呼吸頻率高於生長羊，而與溫度相關的呼吸頻率斜率在性別或生長階段之間並無明顯差異。加入皮膚溫度可適度提升樣本內模型的配適度。在給定平均相對濕度和平均基準體重的前提下，對應至呼吸頻率標準為每分鐘 40、60 及 80 次的模型推導溫度分別為 21.2–23.1、25.8–27.7 及 29.0–31.0 °C。這些初步的族群層級參考點並非熱緊迫嚴重程度、福利受損或生產損失的已驗證閾值，尚需透過納入獨立生理、行為、福利及生產結果之更大規模、多牧場研究進行外部驗證。

papers.title: Immune Response of the Pacific Oyster Magallana gigas Following Shell Damage
papers.abstract: Shell integrity is a key determinant of health in cultured bivalves; however, its damage may affect physiological and immune processes associated with repair. This study evaluated the effects of a single non-penetrating shell damage on cellular immune responses and immune-related gene expression in the mantle of the Pacific oyster Magallana gigas. Over 14 days post-damage, reactive oxygen species (ROS) and reactive nitrogen species (RNS) production, phagocytic activity, adhesion, and aggregation of hemocytes were assessed. Relative expression of tumor necrosis factor (TNF-1, TNF-2), interleukin-17 (IL-17-3, IL-17-6), and Toll receptor (Toll-1) genes was also determined in mantle tissue. The damage induced predominantly temporal alterations in hemocyte functional activity. During the first two days, ROS production decreased, while RNS production remained unchanged; phagocytic activity increased on day 1 and decreased on day 2. More prolonged changes were observed in hemocyte adhesion and aggregation. Of the genes examined, only TNF-2 showed a significant change, with decreased expression on day 7. These results show that a single non-penetrating shell damage primarily induces a broad stress-associated physiological response, which transiently modulates cellular immune parameters and local regulation mechanisms. By the end of the experiment, most parameters did not differ from the control, although certain changes persisted during shell repair.
papers.abstract_zh: 貝殼完整性是決定養殖雙殼類健康狀況的關鍵因素；然而，其受損可能會影響與修復相關的生理及免疫過程。本研究評估了單次非穿透性貝殼損傷對太平洋牡蠣（Magallana gigas）外套膜中細胞免疫反應及免疫相關基因表現的影響。在損傷後的14天內，評估了血球的活性氧（ROS）與活性氮（RNS）產量、吞噬活性、黏附及聚集作用。同時測定了外套膜組織中腫瘤壞死因子（TNF-1、TNF-2）、介白素-17（IL-17-3、IL-17-6）及Toll受體（Toll-1）基因的相對表現量。損傷主要誘導了血球功能活性的時間性改變。在頭兩天，ROS產量下降，而RNS產量保持不變；吞噬活性在第1天增加，但在第2天下降。血球的黏附和聚集則觀察到較長時間的變化。在所檢測的基因中，僅TNF-2表現出顯著變化，其表現量在第7天下降。這些結果表明，單次非穿透性貝殼損傷主要引發廣泛的壓力相關生理反應，從而短暫調節細胞免疫參數與局部調控機制。到實驗結束時，多數參數與對照組無顯著差異，儘管某些變化在貝殼修復期間仍然持續。

papers.title: Chromosome-Level Genome Assemblies of Darevskia mixta and Darevskia valentini: A Platform for Studying Parthenogenesis in Caucasian Rock Lizards
papers.abstract: Darevskia lizards attract the attention of many biologists due to the emergence of parthenogenetic species within the genus. In this study, we present chromosome-level genome assemblies of Darevskia mixta (Méhely, 1909) and Darevskia valentini (Boettger, 1892), two species whose distant ancestors hybridized and formed a parthenogenetic taxon. Genomic DNA was sequenced using the PacBio platform. Primary genome assemblies were generated from ~60 Gb (D. mixta) and ~35 Gb (D. valentini) of the processed PacBio data using HiFiasm and reference-scaffolded. The final genome sequences of D. mixta and D. valentini each span ~1.4 Gb, comprising 19 (18 autosomes and the Z chromosome) and 20 (18 autosomes and the Z and W chromosomes) scaffolds, with N50 scaffold values of 91.1 and 97.5 Mb, respectively. Both genome sequences contain ~42% repeats and encode ~41 thousand predicted genes. The assemblies share major structural similarity, but feature a number of inversions and translocations relative to each other. The obtained assemblies represent the first quality platform for unraveling the genetic features associated with the emergence and maintenance of parthenogenesis in Darevskia lizards.
