papers.abstract_zh: 岩蜥屬（Darevskia）蜥蜴因該屬內孤雌生殖物種的出現，吸引了許多生物學家的關注。在這項研究中，我們發表了混合岩蜥（Darevskia mixta (Méhely, 1909)）與瓦倫丁岩蜥（Darevskia valentini (Boettger, 1892)）的染色體層級基因組組裝，這兩個物種的遠祖曾發生雜交並形成一個孤雌生殖分類群。基因組DNA使用PacBio平臺進行定序。初步的基因組組裝是利用HiFiasm與參考基因組骨架，分別從約60 Gb（混合岩蜥）與約35 Gb（瓦倫丁岩蜥）經處理的PacBio數據中產生。混合岩蜥與瓦倫丁岩蜥的最終基因組序列長度均約為1.4 Gb，分別包含19個（18條體染色體及Z染色體）與20個（18條體染色體及Z與W染色體）骨架（scaffolds），其N50骨架數值分別為91.1 Mb與97.5 Mb。這兩個基因組序列皆包含約42%的重複序列，並編碼約4.1萬個預測基因。兩者的組裝結果具有主要的結構相似性，但彼此相對存在許多倒位與易位。所獲得的基因組組裝為揭示岩蜥屬中孤雌生殖之出現與維持相關的遺傳特徵，提供了第一個高品質的平臺。

papers.title: Expression Profile of Transfer RNA-Derived Fragments in Chinese Mitten Crab (Eriocheir sinensis) After Challenge with Aeromonas hydrophila
papers.abstract: The Chinese mitten crab (Eriocheir sinensis) is an important cultured crab in China; however, its aquaculture productivity is severely limited by bacterial pathogens, including Aeromonas hydrophila. Transfer RNA-derived fragments (tRFs) are an emerging class of functional small non-coding RNAs that have been implicated in host–pathogen interactions and immune regulation; yet, their roles in the antibacterial defense of crustaceans remain poorly understood. To investigate the immune response of the Chinese mitten crab to A. hydrophila infection, we employed high-throughput sequencing to characterize the expression profiles and functional features of tRFs in crab hemocytes following a bacterial challenge. The results revealed that tRFs exhibited a conserved length distribution (15–20 nt) and subtype composition, with 5′-tRFs representing the dominant subtype in both control and infected groups. Notably, infection specifically induced the abundance of tRF fragments of 35-nt tRF fragments and slightly altered the proportion of tRF subtypes. Differential expression analysis identified 415 significantly upregulated and 3 downregulated tRFs upon A. hydrophila infection, suggesting widespread changes in tRF abundance during infection. Target prediction and functional enrichment analyses were performed for the top 30 differentially expressed tRFs; the predicted targets were significantly associated with VEGF signaling pathway, DNA replication proteins, FoxO signaling pathway, and NF-kappa B signaling pathway. The reliability of the sequencing data was confirmed by stem-loop RT-qPCR validation. Collectively, our findings advance the understanding of tRF expression in crustacean immunity and suggest that tRFs may be associated with the immune response of crabs against bacterial infection, pending functional validation.
papers.abstract_zh: 中華絨螯蟹（*Eriocheir sinensis*）是中國一項重要的養殖蟹類；然而，其水產養殖生產力受到包括嗜水氣單胞菌（*Aeromonas hydrophila*）在內的細菌病原體的嚴重限制。轉移核糖核酸衍生片段（tRFs）是一類新興的功能性小型非編碼RNA，已被證實參與宿主與病原體的交互作用及免疫調節；然而，牠們在甲殼類動物抗菌防禦中的作用仍所知甚少。為了探討中華絨螯蟹對嗜水氣單胞菌感染的免疫反應，我們採用高通量測序技術，對感染後蟹血細胞中tRFs的表達圖譜與功能特徵進行了表徵。結果顯示，tRFs呈現出保守的長度分佈（15–20 nt）和亞型組成，其中5′-tRFs在對照組和感染組中均占主導地位。值得注意的是，感染特異性地誘發了35-nt tRF片段豐度的增加，並輕微改變了tRF亞型的比例。差異表達分析識別出在嗜水氣單胞菌感染後有415個顯著上調和3個顯著下調的tRFs，這表明在感染過程中tRFs的豐度發生了廣泛的變化。對前30個差異表達的tRFs進行了標靶預測與功能富集分析；預測的標靶與VEGF信號通路、DNA複製蛋白、FoxO信號通路及NF-kappa B信號通路顯著相關。測序數據的可靠性已通過莖環RT-qPCR驗證獲得證實。總體而言，我們的研究結果推進了對甲殼類動物免疫中tRF表達的理解，並表明在功能驗證之前，tRFs可能與螃蟹對抗細菌感染的免疫反應有關。

papers.title: Issue Information
Nanoscale Characterization of Microscopically Layered Bone in the Russian Sturgeon Pectoral Fin Spine: A 3D FIB-SEM Study
papers.abstract: Dermal bone, the earliest known form of bone, develops without a cartilage precursor and persists in extant fish species. The pectoral fin spine (PFS) is a dermal bone located at the leading edge of the pectoral fin of sturgeons, where it is exposed to loading associated with locomotion. The peripheral region and dermal osteons of the PFS both appear layered at lower magnification; however, collagen organization in load-bearing fish skeletal elements remains incompletely characterized at the nanoscale. The aim of this study is to characterize the 3D nanostructure of the layered peripheral and osteonal bone forming the PFS in Russian sturgeons using focused ion beam–scanning electron microscopy (FIB-SEM). In the dermal osteons, bone forms concentric layers around a central canal at lower magnification, and at the nanoscale, the calcified collagen fibrils within these layers have preferential orientations that change in a clockwise–anticlockwise fanning pattern, consistent with lamellar bone. In contrast, the examined peripheral bone, which also appears layered at low magnification, is composed mainly of unidirectional calcified collagen fibrils aligned with the long axis of the PFS. Within the examined peripheral volumes, no comparable nanoscale lamellar pattern was detected, and the predominant fibril organization was consistent with parallel-fibered bone. Groups of voids associated with unidentified fibrillar material were also observed in the examined peripheral volumes; the voids were oriented approximately normal to the long axis of the PFS. We conclude that regions appearing layered at lower magnification can differ markedly at the nanoscale, and that the lamellar organization seen in dermal osteons raises questions about its evolutionary origin.
papers.abstract_zh: 真皮骨（dermal bone）已知是最早出現的骨骼形式，其發育不經由軟骨前驅物，且存在於現存的魚類物種中。胸鰭棘（pectoral fin spine, PFS）是一種真皮骨，位於鱘魚胸鰭的前緣，承受與運動相關的負載。在低倍率下，PFS的周邊區域與真皮骨單元（osteons）均呈現層狀結構；然而，承受負載的魚類骨骼元素中，膠原蛋白的組織形式在奈米尺度下仍未被充分解析。本研究旨在利用聚焦離子束掃描式電子顯微鏡（FIB-SEM），解析俄羅斯鱘魚PFS中構成層狀周邊骨與骨單元骨的三維奈米結構。在真皮骨單元中，於低倍率下骨骼繞著中央管形成同心層；而在奈米尺度下，這些層內的鈣化膠原原纖維具有偏好方向，並以順時針與逆時針的扇形模式交替變化，這與板層骨（lamellar bone）一致。相較之下，所檢視的周邊骨在低倍率下雖也呈層狀，但主要由與PFS長軸對齊的單向鈣化膠原原纖維組成。在所檢視的周邊體積中，未檢測到可比擬的奈米尺度板層模式，且主要的原纖維組織與平行纖維骨（parallel-fibered bone）一致。在所檢視的周邊體積中也觀察到位處不明原纖維物質之空洞群，這些空洞的方向大致垂直於PFS的長軸。我們得出結論：在低倍率下看似層狀的區域，在奈米尺度下可能存在顯著差異，且真皮骨單元中所見的板層組織對其演化起源提出了疑問。

papers.title: Why Do Goitered Gazelles Cross the Path of an Approaching Moving Object Instead of Fleeing?
papers.abstract: Animal–vehicle collisions are an important conservation concern. Although many studies examine road mortality and wildlife crossings, less is known about ungulates that run across the path of an approaching vehicle rather than simply fleeing. This study describes this behavior in goitered gazelles (Gazella subgutturosa) and examines its association with four recorded factors: approach category, group size, group composition, and month. In a forward stepwise logistic regression, approach category was associated with crossing behavior (Wald = 22.784, df = 2, p < 0.001). The odds of crossing were higher in the high-category group than in the low-category group (odds ratio = 2.36). However, the categories also differed in object type (cars, motor scooters, and bicycles/pedestrians), so the independent effect of speed cannot be separated from the effect of object type. Group size, group composition, and month did not meet the model’s entry criteria. These observational results identify an association, but do not determine whether path-crossing is a uniquely anti-predator response, a reaction to limited assessment time, or another form of behavior.
papers.abstract_zh: 動物與車輛的碰撞是重要的保育議題。雖然許多研究探討了道路死亡率與野生動物穿越道，但對於有蹄類動物在面對逼近的車輛時，究竟是單純逃逸，還是會奔跑穿過車輛路徑，目前所知甚少。本研究描述了小頭瞪羚（Gazella subgutturosa）的這個行為，並探討其與四個記錄因素（接近類別、群體大小、群體組成和月份）之間的關聯。在逐步向前logistic迴歸分析中，接近類別與穿越行為有關（Wald = 22.784, df = 2, p < 0.001）。高等級群體發生穿越行為的勝算比低等級群體來得高（勝算比 = 2.36）。然而，這些類別在目標物類型（汽車、機車以及腳踏車／行人）上也有所不同，因此速度的獨立效應無法與目標物類型的效應分開。群體大小、群體組成和月份並未符合模型的進入標準。這些觀察結果辨識出了一項關聯，但無法斷定路徑穿越究竟是單純的抗掠食反應、對評估時間有限的反應，還是另一種形式的行為。

papers.title: Age-Related Decrease in Interthalamic Adhesion Thickness in Cats Without Apparent Cognitive Dysfunction
papers.abstract: Feline cognitive dysfunction syndrome (FCDS) is an age-associated disorder for which objective imaging markers remain limited. This study evaluated the association between age and interthalamic adhesion thickness (IAT) in cats without apparent cognitive dysfunction and described IAT across feline life stages. MRI examinations from 112 client-owned cats aged 4 months to 18 years were retrospectively reviewed. Cats were classified as kittens (<1 year), young (1 to < 7 years), mature (7 to <11 years) and senior (≥11 years). Cats with intracranial lesions or reported behavioral changes suggestive of cognitive dysfunction were excluded. Two blinded observers measured IAT on transverse T1W and T2W images. Analyses included linear regression adjusted for brain height, brain width, sex/neuter status, breed group, and scanner; exploratory quadratic age modeling; and comparisons among life stages. Interobserver agreement was high. Age was negatively associated with IAT on T1W (B = −0.071 mm/year) and T2W images (B = −0.067 mm/year; both p < 0.001). This association persisted after multivariable adjustment (T1W: B = −0.074 mm/year; T2W: B = −0.067 mm/year; both p < 0.001) and after excluding kittens or brachycephalic cats. Senior cats had lower IAT than all other life stages on both sequences. A quadratic term suggested a steeper decline at older ages on T1W images only; this finding remains exploratory. These findings support a group-level association between age and IAT, rather than individual-level diagnostic use. Its potential diagnostic value for FCDS requires prospective evaluation with standardized behavioral assessment and age-matched controls.
papers.abstract_zh: 貓認知功能障礙症候群（Feline cognitive dysfunction syndrome, FCDS）是一種與年齡相關的疾病，目前缺乏客觀的影像學標記。本研究旨在評估無明顯認知功能障礙貓隻的年齡與丘腦間黏連厚度（interthalamic adhesion thickness, IAT）之間的關聯，並描述不同貓生長階段的 IAT。本研究回顧性分析了 112 隻年齡介於 4 個月至 18 歲之間、有飼主的貓之 MRI 檢查結果。貓隻被分類為幼貓（<1 歲）、年輕貓（1 歲至 <7 歲）、成年貓（7 歲至 <11 歲）以及高齡貓（≥11 歲）。排除具有顱內病變或被通報有暗示認知功能障礙之行為改變的貓隻。兩位盲性觀察者在橫斷面 T1W 和 T2W 影像上測量 IAT。分析包括經腦高、腦寬、性別／絕育狀態、品種組和掃描儀調整後的線性迴歸；探索性二次年齡建模；以及不同生命階段之間的比較。觀察者間的一致性高。在 T1W 和 T2W 影像上，年齡與 IAT 呈負相關（T1W：B = −0.071 mm/年；T2W：B = −0.067 mm/年；兩者 p < 0.001）。在進行多變數調整後（T1W：B = −0.074 mm/年；T2W：B = −0.067 mm/年；兩者 p < 0.001），以及排除幼貓或短頭貓後，此關聯仍然存在。在兩種造影序列中，高齡貓的 IAT 皆低於其他所有生命階段。二次方程式項顯示，僅在 T1W 影像上，高齡時的下降趨勢更為陡峭；此發現仍屬探索性質。這些發現支持年齡與 IAT 之間存在群體層面的關聯，而非個體層面的診斷用途。其對 FCDS 的潛在診斷價值，尚需透過標準化行為評估與年齡匹配的對照組進行前瞻性評估來確立。

papers.title: Dietary γ-Aminobutyric Acid (GABA) Improves Growth Performance and Increases Plasma Cortisol During Recovery from Short-Term Acute Thermal Exposure in Juvenile Rainbow Trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss)
papers.abstract: γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA) is a functional feed additive that may improve growth and stress resilience. The study evaluated the effects of dietary GABA on growth performance and recovery-phase physiological responses after short-term acute thermal exposure in juvenile rainbow trout. Two hundred twenty-five fish (18.9 ± 0.1 g) were fed five diets for 8 weeks: a control diet containing 68 mg/kg (GABA68) and diets with 108 (GABA108), 149 (GABA149), 183 (GABA183), and 218 (GABA218) mg/kg GABA. Fish were then subjected to short-term acute thermal exposure (20 °C for 2 h) followed by 2 h recovery at 15 °C. Dietary GABA significantly improved weight gain and specific growth rate, with the provisional model-based dietary GABA level for weight gain estimated to be approximately 198–210 mg/kg diet based on broken-line regression models, and increased feed and protein efficiency (p < 0.05). Fish fed the GABA183 and GABA218 diets had significantly higher plasma cortisol concentrations than those fed GABA68 and GABA108 when averaged across temperature treatments, with a significant temperature × GABA interaction (p < 0.05). During recovery, hepatic hsp70α and hsp90βα expression was significantly lower following 20 °C exposure than in fish maintained at 15 °C, whereas dietary GABA and its interaction with temperature had no significant effects on the stress-related genes analyzed. Dietary GABA improved growth performance and feed utilization; however, cortisol measured at a single recovery time point cannot distinguish a stronger stress response, delayed recovery, or altered cortisol clearance and does not demonstrate improved thermal tolerance or a faster recovery rate.
papers.abstract_zh: γ-胺基丁酸（GABA）是一種功能性飼料添加物，可能可改善生長與抗壓能力。本研究評估了飼糧添加GABA對幼虹鱒在短期急性熱暴露後，生長性能及恢復期生理反應的影響。試驗使用225尾魚（18.9 ± 0.1公克），餵食五種飼糧共8週：包含對照組含68 mg/kg GABA（GABA68），以及添加108（GABA108）、149（GABA149）、183（GABA183）與218（GABA218）mg/kg GABA的飼糧。隨後將魚隻暴露於短期急性熱環境（20 °C下2小時），接著在15 °C下恢復2小時。飼糧添加GABA顯著改善了體重增加量與特定生長率，根據折線迴歸模型估算，基於體重增加量的暫定模式化飼糧GABA添加量約為每公斤飼糧198–210 mg/kg，且提高了飼料效率與蛋白質效率（p < 0.05）。跨溫度處理平均而言，餵食GABA183與GABA218飼糧的魚隻，其血漿皮質醇濃度顯著高於餵食GABA68與GABA108的魚隻，且溫度與GABA具有顯著的交互作用（p < 0.05）。在恢復期間，經20 °C暴露後的肝臟 $hsp70\alpha$ 與 $hsp90\beta\alpha$ 表現量顯著低於維持在15 °C的魚隻，而飼糧GABA及其與溫度的交互作用對所分析的壓力相關基因則無顯著影響。飼糧添加GABA改善了生長性能與飼料利用率；然而，在單一恢復時間點測得的皮質醇無法區分是較強的壓力反應、延遲的恢復，還是改變的皮質醇清除率，亦無法證明其具備較佳的耐熱性或更快的恢復速率。

papers.title: Coronavirus Diversity in an Italian Bat Population Sampled During the Pandemic in 2020
papers.abstract: Evolutionary studies have established a correlation between human and bat coronaviruses (CoV), identifying bats as the natural reservoir for Coronaviridae. Over the past two decades, three major zoonotic spillover events have been described: Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome CoV (SARS-CoV) and Middle East Respiratory Syndrome CoV (MERS-CoV), which caused significant global outbreaks, and SARS-CoV-2, which triggered the COVID-19 pandemic. Despite these events, the true diversity of coronavirus species harbored by bats remains largely unmapped, even as the discovery of novel strains continues to accelerate. In this study, we analyzed 37 fecal swab samples collected in Northern Italy, targeting the bat genera Miniopterus, Myotis, and Rhinolophus. Coronaviruses were detected using a pan-coronavirus (Pan-CoV) nested RT-PCR in five bat samples: three tested positive for Alphacoronaviruses (Alpha-CoVs) and two for Betacoronaviruses (Beta-CoVs). Positive samples were subjected to Pan-CoV Illumina next-generation sequencing (NGS), and two samples yielded sufficient read depth for robust contig assembly. Phylogenetic analysis revealed the co-circulation of three distinct Alpha-CoVs within a Miniopterus schreibersii (M. schreibersii) fecal sample and the presence of a SARS-CoV-related strain in a Rhinolophus hipposideros (R. hipposideros) fecal sample. Both the Alpha-CoVs and the Beta-CoVs were most closely related to European strains. These findings confirm the widespread circulation of diverse CoVs in Italian bats and underscore the need for continued molecular epidemiological surveillance to unravel the full extent of CoV heterogeneity in European wildlife.
papers.abstract_zh: 演化研究已確立人類與蝙蝠冠狀病毒（CoV）之間的關聯，並認定蝙蝠為冠狀病毒科（Coronaviridae）的自然宿主。在過去二十年間，已描述了三起主要的動物源性病毒跨物種傳播事件：造成全球重大疫情的嚴重急性呼吸道症候群冠狀病毒（SARS-CoV）與中東呼吸症候群冠狀病毒（MERS-CoV），以及引發 COVID-19 大流行的 SARS-CoV-2。儘管發生了這些事件，蝙蝠所攜帶的冠狀病毒物種的真實多樣性大體上仍未被充分繪製，儘管新毒株的發現持續加速。在本研究中，我們分析了採集自義大利北部、針對蝙蝠屬（Miniopterus、Myotis 和 Rhinolophus）的 37 份糞便拭子樣本。利用泛冠狀病毒（Pan-CoV）巢式 RT-PCR 在五份蝙蝠樣本中檢測出冠狀病毒：三份對阿爾法冠狀病毒（Alpha-CoVs）呈陽性反應，兩份對貝塔冠狀病毒（Beta-CoVs）呈陽性反應。對陽性樣本進行泛冠狀病毒 Illumina 次世代定序（NGS），其中兩份樣本產生了足夠的讀取深度以進行穩健的重疊群（contig）組裝。系統發生樹分析顯示，在一個長翼蝠（Miniopterus schreibersii）糞便樣本中共同傳播著三種不同的阿爾法冠狀病毒，且在一個小菊頭蝠（Rhinolophus hipposideros）糞便樣本中存在與 SARS-CoV 相關的毒株。阿爾法冠狀病毒與貝塔冠狀病毒皆與歐洲毒株的親緣關係最近。這些發現證實了多樣化的冠狀病毒在義大利蝙蝠中廣泛傳播，並強調了持續進行分子流行病學監測的必要性，以揭示歐洲野生動物中冠狀病毒異質性的完整範圍。

papers.title: Effects of Salinity on Growth, Muscle Biochemical Components and Antioxidant Resistance of Planiliza haematocheilus
papers.abstract: This study evaluated the effects of different water salinities (0, 10, 20 [control], 30, and 40; Practical Salinity Scale, dimensionless) over 56 days on growth performance, muscle biochemical composition, and antioxidant responses in serum and liver of Planiliza haematocheilus. After one-week pre-acclimation at 20, juveniles were directly transferred to the experimental salinities; thus, all groups except the 20 control experienced acute salinity transfer followed by 56-day exposure. Therefore, acute transfer stress and subsequent salinity exposure were confounded and could not be separated in this design. Survival was highest at 20 and lowest at 0. Weight gain rate and specific growth rate peaked at 30 and were lowest at 0. Under this direct-transfer protocol, the optimal salinity range for growth and survival was approximately 20–30 for these ~93 g juveniles. Hepatosomatic index differed significantly among salinity groups. Muscle moisture content was negatively correlated with salinity. Crude protein content was highest in the salinity-40 group, whereas crude fat was highest at 20 and lowest at 0; ash content did not differ significantly among treatments. Superoxide dismutase (SOD) activity in serum and liver showed no clear trend with salinity, but most groups differed significantly from the control. Liver SOD activity was highest at 10 and lowest at 30. Serum catalase (CAT) activity did not differ significantly among salinity groups, whereas liver CAT activity tended to decrease and then increase with rising salinity. Salinity had limited effect on serum malondialdehyde (MDA) content, except for a peak at 40, whereas liver MDA content decreased with increasing salinity and was significantly higher in the low-salinity groups. These results indicate that, under the direct-transfer protocol, P. haematocheilus juveniles (initial weight ~93 g) pre-acclimated to 20 and then directly transferred showed optimal growth and survival at 20–30, and that liver antioxidant parameters may serve as sensitive biomarkers of salinity stress. However, because acute transfer stress was confounded with subsequent 56-day salinity exposure, these findings are specific to this direct-transfer protocol and developmental stage and should not be extrapolated to gradual acclimation protocols or smaller juveniles.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究評估了不同水體鹽度（0、10、20 [對照組]、30 與 40；實用鹽度標尺，無因次）對梭魚（*Planiliza haematocheilus*）生長表現、肌肉生化組成，以及血清和肝臟抗氧化反應的影響，試驗為期 56 天。幼魚在鹽度 20 下預馴養一週後，直接移至實驗鹽度；因此，除鹽度 20 對照組外，所有組別皆經歷急性鹽度轉移，隨後進行為期 56 天的暴露。因此，在此實驗設計中，急性轉移緊迫與隨後的鹽度暴露產生了混淆，無法加以區分。存活率以鹽度 20 最高、0 最低。增重率和特定生長率在鹽度 30 時達到峰值，以 0 時最低。在此直接轉移實驗方案下，對於這些約 93 克的幼魚而言，生長與存活的最佳鹽度範圍約為 20–30。肝體比在各鹽度組間有顯著差異。肌肉水分含量與鹽度呈負相關。粗蛋白含量以鹽度 40 組最高，而粗脂肪含量以 20 時最高、0 時最低；灰分含量在各處理組間無顯著差異。血清和肝臟中的超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）活性隨鹽度變化並無明顯趨勢，但多數組別與對照組有顯著差異。肝臟 SOD 活性以 10 時最高、30 時最低。血清過氧化氫酶（CAT）活性在各鹽度組間無顯著差異，而肝臟 CAT 活性隨鹽度上升呈現先降低後升高的趨勢。除在鹽度 40 時出現峰值外，鹽度對血清丙二醛（MDA）含量的影響有限，而肝臟 MDA 含量則隨鹽度增加而降低，且在低鹽度組中顯著較高。這些結果表明，在直接轉移實驗方案下，經鹽度 20 預馴養並直接轉移的梭魚幼魚（初始體重約 93 克）在鹽度 20–30 時表現出最佳的生長與存活，且肝臟抗氧化參數可作為鹽度緊迫的敏感生物標記。然而，由於急性轉移緊迫與隨後 56 天的鹽度暴露產生了混淆，這些發現具體僅適用於此直接轉移方案與發育階段，不應外推至漸進式馴養方案或較小體型的幼魚。

papers.title: Variation in Colostrum Brix Values and Associations Between Initial Body Weight, Colostrum Intake and Piglet Survival from 24 h to Weaning in a Swedish Sow Herd
papers.abstract: Colostrum is essential for neonatal piglet survival, but individual teat measurements may not represent sow-level mean Brix values. Brix refractometry provides an indirect on-farm estimate of colostrum IgG concentration. This exploratory study quantified Brix variation within and between sows and examined associations between initial body weight, sow Brix values, estimated colostrum intake, and survival from approximately 24 h to weaning. Colostrum was sampled from 28 sows in a Swedish high-health herd. A total of 410 teat samples were analysed and 373 piglets were weighed at colostrum sampling and followed until weaning. The mean sow Brix value was 27.6%. Approximately half the variation was attributable to differences between sows, with the remainder occurring between teats within sows. Empirical resampling analysis showed that sampling multiple teats improved the precision of sow-level mean Brix estimates; with five teats, 95.2% of estimates were within ±1.5 Brix percentage points of the observed sow mean. No clear association between sow-level Brix values and survival from 24 h to weaning was detected. Survival was associated with initial body weight, and the association with estimated colostrum intake depended on initial body weight, being strongest for piglets with lower body weight. Given limited sow numbers and single-herd design, these findings require multi-herd validation.
papers.abstract_zh: 初乳對初生仔豬的存活至關重要，但個別乳頭的測量值可能無法代表母豬群體的平均布里克斯（Brix）糖度值。布里克斯折射儀可用於場內間接估算初乳中的 IgG 濃度。本探索性研究量化了母豬體內及母豬之間的布里克斯變異，並檢視了初始體重、母豬布里克斯值、估算初乳攝入量以及從約 24 小時齡至離乳期間存活率之間的關聯。本研究自瑞典一個高健康水準豬場的 28 頭母豬採集初乳樣本，分析了總共 410 個乳頭樣本，並對 373 頭仔豬在採集初乳時進行秤重，並追蹤至離乳。母豬平均布里克斯值為 27.6%。大約一半的變異歸因於母豬間的差異，其餘則發生在同一頭母豬的不同乳頭之間。經驗重抽樣分析顯示，採集多個乳頭可提高母豬層級平均布里克斯估計值的精確度；若採集五個乳頭，95.2% 的估計值落在觀察到的母豬平均值 ±1.5 個布里克斯百分點的範圍內。研究未發現母豬層級布里克斯值與 24 小時齡至離乳存活率之間有明顯的關聯。存活率與初始體重有關，而與估算初乳攝入量的關聯則取決於初始體重，對體重較輕的仔豬影響最強烈。鑑於母豬數量有限且為單一豬場設計，這些結果尚需多豬場的驗證。

papers.title: Comparative Analysis of Bird Collision Prevention Patterned Samples: Avoidance Performance Under Transparent and Reflective Glass Conditions in Flight Tunnel Tests
papers.abstract: The transparency and reflectivity of glass are primary factors contributing to bird collisions, as they prevent birds from recognizing glass surfaces as obstacles. However, the effectiveness of bird collision prevention products is primarily evaluated through transparency-based tunnel tests, which do not adequately account for the reflective conditions commonly found on building glass. We developed an indoor flight tunnel system that simulated sky reflections on glass surfaces and compared avoidance responses to three bird collision prevention patterned samples under both transparent and reflective conditions. A total of 507 wild small passerines were tested, each undergoing a single flight trial. All three patterned samples showed lower avoidance rates under reflective than transparent conditions, but the overall effect of test condition on avoidance was not statistically significant. The frequency of invalid flights increased significantly under reflective conditions. These findings suggest that avoidance responses to bird collision prevention products may vary between transparent and reflective test configurations, although the magnitude of this difference remains uncertain. Incorporating reflective conditions alongside conventional transparency-based tests may therefore provide complementary information for evaluating product performance under different optical conditions.
papers.abstract_zh: 玻璃的透明度與反射率是導致鳥類窗殺的主要因素，因為這會妨礙鳥類將玻璃表面識別為障礙物。然而，防撞產品的有效性評估主要透過基於透明條件的隧道實驗進行，這並未能充分考量建築玻璃常見的反射條件。本研究開發了一套室內飛行隧道系統，可模擬玻璃表面上的天空反射，並在透明與反射條件下，比較鳥類對三種防撞圖案樣本的迴避反應。總共測試了 507 隻野生小型雀形目鳥類，每隻鳥進行單次飛行試驗。在反射條件下，三種圖案樣本的迴避率均低於透明條件，但測試條件對迴避行為的整體影響並未達到統計顯著。無效飛行頻率在反射條件下顯著增加。這些研究結果顯示，鳥類對防撞產品的迴避反應可能會因透明與反射的測試配置而異，儘管此差異的幅度仍不確定。因此，在傳統的透明測試之外納入反射條件，或可為評估產品在不同光學條件下的效能提供互補的資訊。

papers.title: Slipped Capital Femoral Epiphysis in Two Neutered Male Maine Coon Cats: A Case Report
papers.abstract: Slipped capital femoral epiphysis (SCFE), also referred to as spontaneous femoral capital physeal fracture, is an uncommon orthopedic disorder in cats characterized by separation of the femoral capital epiphysis through the proximal femoral physis in the absence of significant trauma. Maine Coon cats, particularly males, appear to be predisposed to this condition. This report describes two neutered male Maine Coon cats, aged 21 and 16 months, presenting with pelvic limb lameness without a known history of significant trauma. The first cat exhibited grade 2 pelvic limb lameness, bilateral pelvic limb muscle atrophy, and pain and crepitus during manipulation of both coxofemoral joints. Radiographic examination revealed bilateral SCFE associated with secondary degenerative changes. The second cat presented with grade 1 pelvic limb lameness, joint laxity, and pain without palpable crepitus. Radiographic examination raised suspicion of right femoral capital physeal separation, which was subsequently confirmed by computed tomography. Both cats underwent femoral head and neck excision (FHNE), with bilateral FHNE performed during a single anesthetic episode in the first cat. Postoperative clinical examinations and owner reports indicated improvement in pelvic limb function and resolution of clinically apparent lameness in both cats. Radiographic examinations performed six months postoperatively documented the surgical changes, with persistent reduction in pelvic limb soft-tissue volume consistent with muscle atrophy. These cases highlight the variable clinical and imaging presentations of SCFE in Maine Coon cats and the complementary roles of radiography and computed tomography in diagnosis. Although clinical improvement was observed following FHNE, the absence of standardized functional assessments limits definitive conclusions regarding the extent of postoperative recovery.
papers.abstract_zh: 股骨頭骺板is滑脫（Slipped capital femoral epiphysis, SCFE），亦稱為自發性股骨頭骺板骨折，是貓少見的骨科疾病，其特徵為在沒有明顯外傷的情況下，股骨頭骨骺透過近端股骨骺板分離。緬因貓，特別是公貓，似乎對此疾病具有易感性。本病例報告描述了兩隻絕育公緬因貓，年齡分別為21個月大與16個月大，主訴為後肢跛行且無已知之顯著外傷史。第一隻貓表現出2級後肢跛行、雙側後肢肌肉萎縮，以及在雙側髖關節操作時出現疼痛與彈響音。放射線學檢查顯示雙側SCFE伴隨繼發性退化性改變。第二隻貓表現出1級後肢跛行、關節鬆弛以及疼痛，無可觸及之彈響音。放射線學檢查懷疑右側股骨頭骺板分離，隨後透過電腦斷層掃描確診。兩隻貓皆接受了股骨頭頸切除術（FHNE），其中第一隻貓在單次麻醉過程中進行了雙側FHNE。術後臨床檢查與飼主回報顯示，兩隻貓的後肢功能均有所改善，且臨床上明顯的跛行消失。術後六個月進行的放射線學檢查記錄了手術變化，並伴隨與肌肉萎縮一致的後肢軟組織體積持續減少。這些病例突顯了緬因貓SCFE多變的臨床與影像學表現，以及放射線學與電腦斷層掃描在診斷中的互補角色。儘管在接受FHNE後觀察到臨床改善，但缺乏標準化的功能評估，限制了對術后恢復程度的明確結論。

papers.title: Computerized Cognitive Enrichment as a Conservation Engagement Tool: Shifting Visitor Perceptions of the Endangered Hawaiian Monk Seal (Neomonachus schauinslandi)
papers.abstract: Public viewing of cognitive enrichment may offer opportunities to connect visitors with endangered species through observation of animal learning and problem-solving. We examined visitor responses to a narrated demonstration involving a Hawaiian monk seal (Neomonachus schauinslandi) using the Enclosure Video Enrichment system at Sea Life Park Hawaiʻi. In this exploratory single-group study, 104 adults completed questionnaires before and immediately after the session. Six agreement items assessed perceptions of cognition, connection, caring, and protection; two questions addressed endangered status and the ability to learn a computer game. Paired responses were analyzed using Wilcoxon signed-rank and exact McNemar tests, with Bonferroni adjustment across eight comparisons. Ratings increased significantly for five agreement items after adjustment, with the largest mean changes in connection and perceived problem-solving. Protection ratings were high initially and did not increase significantly after adjustment. Correct computer-game responses increased while endangered-status knowledge remained high. The single-group design limits causal interpretation and attribution to computerized enrichment specifically. These findings highlight public enrichment demonstrations as a promising setting for conservation education. Future studies should assess whether changes in perceptions and connection persist and contribute to behaviors that support endangered species recovery.
papers.abstract_zh: 公開展示認知豐富化活動（cognitive enrichment），可透過觀察動物的學習與解決問題過程，提供參觀者與瀕危物種連結的機會。我們以夏威夷海洋公園（Sea Life Park Hawaiʻi）使用「圍欄影片豐富化系統」的一場包含解說的夏威夷僧海豹（Neomonachus schauinslandi）示範活動為對象，檢視參觀者的反應。在這項探索性單組研究中，104名成年人在活動前及活動結束後立即填寫了問卷。6個同意度題項評估了對認知、連結、關懷與保育的看法；另有2題探討瀕危狀態及學習電腦遊戲的能力。配對反應以威爾卡森符號等級檢定（Wilcoxon signed-rank test）及精確麥克納馬爾檢定（exact McNemar test）進行分析，並對8項比較進行邦ferroni校正（Bonferroni adjustment）。校正後，有5個同意度題項的評分顯著增加，其中以「連結」和「對解決問題的感知」之平均變化最大。「保育」評分在活動前即已偏高，經校正後未顯著增加。電腦遊戲的正確回答增加，而對瀕危狀態的認知則維持在高水準。單組設計限制了因果推論以及對電腦化豐富化活動的特定歸因。這些發現凸顯了公開的豐富化活動示範作為保育教育之絕佳場域的潛力。未來研究應評估對感知和連結的改變是否能持續，並進一步促進支持瀕危物種復育的行為。

papers.title: Congenital Caudal Vertebral Anomalies in a Pedigree of Beagles
papers.abstract: Despite increased recognition of caudal vertebral anomalies in the domestic dog (Canis lupus familiaris), studies describing tail deformities remain limited. To address this gap in the literature, this study aimed to identify and classify the caudal vertebral anomaly phenotypes in a pedigree of Beagles. Subjects included 67 dogs (36 males and 31 females), aged eight months to eight years old (M= 38.8 ± 25.6 months). All 67 dogs were visually examined, and tails were palpated to determine if they had any kinks, bends, misalignments, or deformities in their tail prior to radiographic assessment. Radiographs of the caudal vertebrae were obtained from 53 dogs and evaluated for congenital anomalies, including block vertebrae, hemivertebrae, brachyury (very short tail), and axial deviations. Of the 53 radiographed dogs, 25 (47.2%) exhibited at least one congenital caudal vertebral anomaly, with block vertebrae being the most common finding (43.4%). Four dogs (7.6%) had mild congenital abnormalities detected radiographically that were not identified during physical examination. Based on pedigree structure, an autosomal recessive trait is suspected. These findings demonstrate a high prevalence of caudal vertebral anomalies within this pedigree of Beagles and emphasize the importance of radiographic evaluation for accurate identification and phenotypic classification.
papers.abstract_zh: 儘管人們對家犬（Canis lupus familiaris）尾椎異常的認知有所增加，但描述尾巴畸形的研究仍然有限。為填補文獻中的這一空白，本研究旨在識別並分類米格犬譜系中的尾椎異常表現型。受試者包括 67 隻犬（36 隻公犬和 31 隻母犬），年齡介於 8 個月至 8 歲之間（平均值 = 38.8 ± 25.6 個月）。所有 67 隻犬均接受視診，並觸診尾巴以確定在進行放射線評估前，其尾巴是否有任何扭結、彎曲、錯位或畸形。本研究取得 53 隻犬的尾椎X光片，並評估其先天性異常，包括融合椎、半椎、短尾（極短尾）及軸向偏斜。在接受X光檢查的 53 隻犬中，有 25 隻（47.2%）表現出至少一種先天性尾椎異常，其中以融合椎最為常見（43.4%）。有 4 隻犬（7.6%）被X光檢查出輕微的先天性異常，但這些異常在身體檢查中未被發現。根據譜系結構，懷疑這是一種體染色體隱性性狀。這些發現證明了此米格犬譜系中尾椎異常的高盛行率，並強調了放射線評估對於準確識別和表現型分類的重要性。

papers.title: Mitochondrial DNA Lineages of Eurasian Otters (Lutra lutra) in Central Anatolia: A Phylogenetic Bridge Between Asia and Europe?
papers.abstract: The Eurasian otter (Lutra lutra), a semi-aquatic carnivore listed as “Near Threatened” by the IUCN (International Union for Conservation of Nature), is widespread across Eurasia but remains poorly studied genetically in various regions. We analyzed the Central Anatolian population along the Kızılırmak River using mitochondrial (mt) DNA from non-invasively collected samples to examine whether Anatolian otters connect phylogenetically typical European and Caucasian lineages and whether Anatolia could have harbored a late-glacial source population for otter migration to Europe via western (Balkan) and/or eastern (east of the Black Sea) routes. Thirty spraints were collected from five localities, including four previously known sites and one newly identified in the Sulakyurt district, northeast of Kırıkkale province. We amplified a short (256 bp) mtD-loop fragment and a longer (820 bp) fragment spanning the Cytb, tRNA-Thr, tRNA-Pro, and D-loop from 14 samples and included all corresponding Lutra lutra mtDNA sequences available in GenBank in our analyses. Six short-fragment samples from Kapulukaya, Kesikköprü, and Kalecik carried the widespread northern Eurasian haplotype Lut1, while eight samples from Kalecik, Kesikköprü, Hirfanlı, and Hamzalı revealed a novel haplotype (H256-TR). The long fragments represented two additional haplotypes (H820-37, H820-38), distributed across the same localities. Median-joining network analysis of the short fragment produced a star-like topology with no clear phylogeographic structuring, whereas the longer fragment resolved two weakly separated phylogenetic groups. Central Anatolian haplotypes were positioned between Far Eastern and northern Eurasian lineages, with H820-38 phylogenetically connecting Caucasian and European haplotypes. This finding is consistent with the hypothesis of possible western and eastern postglacial migration routes from Anatolia to Europe, although broader spatial sampling is needed for confirmation.
papers.abstract_zh: 歐亞水獺（*Lutra lutra*）是一種半水棲食肉動物，被國際自然保護聯盟（IUCN）列為「近危」（Near Threatened）物種。牠們廣泛分佈於歐亞大陸，但在許多地區的遺傳學研究仍然不足。我們利用非侵入性採樣獲得的粒線體（mt）DNA，分析了克孜勒河（Kızılırmak River）沿岸的中安那托利亞族群，以檢視安那托利亞水獺是否連接了具親緣地理學典型特徵的歐洲與高加索譜系，以及安那托利亞是否曾透過西部（巴爾幹）及／或東部（黑海以東）路徑，孕育了供水獺向歐洲遷徙的末次冰期源族群。本研究從五個地點（包含四個已知地點及一個位於克勒克卡萊省東北部蘇拉克尤爾特區的新發現地點）採集了三十個糞便樣本。我們從 14 個樣本中擴增出一個短的（256 bp）mtD-loop 片段，以及一個涵蓋 Cytb、tRNA-Thr、tRNA-Pro 和 D-loop 的較長（820 bp）片段，並將 GenBank 中所有可取得的對應歐亞水來自粒線體 DNA 序列納入分析。來自卡普盧卡亞（Kapulukaya）、克西克科普呂（Kesikköprü）和卡莱吉克（Kalecik）的六個短片段樣本帶有廣泛分佈的歐亞大陸北部單倍型 Lut1，而來自卡莱吉克、克西克科普呂、希爾凡勒（Hirfanlı）和哈姆扎勒（Hamzalı）的八個樣本則揭示了一個新的單倍型（H256-TR）。長片段則代表了另外兩個單倍型（H820-37、H820-38），分佈於相同的採樣地點。短片段的中位數連接網路分析（median-joining network analysis）產生了呈星狀的拓樸結構，且沒有明顯的親緣地理結構；相較之下，較長的片段則解析出兩個微弱分離的親緣演化群。中安那托利亞的單倍型位於遠東與歐亞大陸北部譜系之間，其中 H820-38 在親緣演化上連接了高加索與歐洲的單倍型。此發現與安那托利亞至歐洲存在西部與東部冰期後遷徙路徑的假設一致，儘管仍需更廣泛的空間採樣來加以確認。

papers.title: Effects of One-Step Laparoscopic Abomasopexy and Laparotomic Omentopexy Treatments of Left Displaced Abomasum on Metabolic and Inflammatory Stress Responses, Liver Health and Milk Yield in Multiparous Cows
papers.abstract: Metabolic and inflammatory stress during the postoperative period following left displaced abomasum (LDA) correction poses significant risks to dairy cows’ health and productivity. This study aimed to evaluate the differences in metabolic and inflammatory responses between LDA cows treated with laparoscopic abomasopexy in one-step and left paralumbar fossa omentopexy, focusing on myeloperoxidase (MPO), metabolic- and liver-related biochemical markers, antioxidative response, and milk yield. Sixteen LDA cows were randomly assigned to one-step laparoscopic abomasopexy (LPS, n = 8) or left laparotomic omentopexy (LPT, n = 8), matched by parity and days in milk with healthy cows (CON, n = 8), and evaluated for blood indices and milk production during lactation. Blood samples were collected before (D0) surgery and 1 (D1), 3 (D3), 10 (D10), and 30 (D30) days following surgery, while milk yield was recorded monthly. MPO activity exhibited significantly higher values in both LPS (p < 0.001) and LPT (p < 0.001) cows compared to CON on D1, but also significantly lower values in LPS than in LPT cows (p < 0.001). In addition, both LPS and CON cows displayed significantly lower MPO levels than LPT cows on D3 (p < 0.001; p < 0.001; respectively), D10 (p < 0.001; p < 0.001; respectively), and D30 (p < 0.001; p = 0.008; respectively). Serum paraoxonase-1 (PON1) activity was significantly suppressed on D1 in both the LPS and LPT groups compared to CON cows (p < 0.05); however, overall PON1 activity remained significantly lower in the LPT group throughout the monitoring period (p = 0.016), despite a non-significant treatment × day interaction (p = 0.099). Significant treatment × day interactions were found for total bilirubin concentrations (p = 0.019), aspartate aminotransferase (AST, p < 0.001), and gamma-glutamyl transferase (GGT, p = 0.011) activities. Compared to control, AST and GGT activities were significantly elevated on D1 in both LPS (p = 0.037; p = 0.028, respectively) and LPT (p = 0.007; p = 0.045, respectively), while total bilirubin concentrations showed marked elevation on D1 in the LPT group compared to both CON and LPS cows (p = 0.031). Non-esterified fatty acids, beta-hydroxybutyrate and total bilirubin showed more favorable patterns in the LPS compared to LPT group too. Compared to LPT cows, milk yield was higher in LPS cows on days 30 (p < 0.001), 60 (p = 0.016), and 90 (p = 0.005) of lactation. In conclusion, this study underlines the benefits of laparoscopic abomasopexy in one step during the postoperative period, as it reduced the inflammatory response, could positively impact recovery of milk production, and eventually enhanced liver metabolism in LDA cows. In addition, our results suggest that MPO shows potential for use as an exploratory biomarker for monitoring the scale of postoperative tissue damage in dairy cows.
papers.abstract_zh: 左移第四胃（LDA）整復術後之術後期間的代謝與發炎壓力，對乳牛的健康與生產力構成重大風險。本研究旨在評估接受一步法腹腔鏡第四胃固定術與左側腰部網膜固定術的LDA病牛之間，其代謝與發炎反應的差異，重點關注髓過氧化酶（MPO）、代謝及肝臟相關生化標記、抗氧化反應與乳量。十六頭LDA乳牛隨機分配至一步法腹腔鏡第四胃固定術（LPS，n = 8）或左側剖腹網膜固定術（LPT，n = 8），並依胎次與泌乳天數與健康乳牛（CON，n = 8）進行配對，評估其泌乳期間的血液指標與產乳量。血樣於手術前（D0）以及術後第1（D1）、3（D3）、10（D10）和30（D30）天採集，乳量則每月記錄一次。在D1時，LPS（p < 0.001）與LPT（p < 0.001）乳牛的MPO活性顯著高於CON，但LPS的MPO活性亦顯著低於LPT乳牛（p < 0.001）。此外，在D3（分別為p < 0.001；p < 0.001）、D10（分別為p < 0.001；p < 0.001）及D30（分別為p < 0.001；p = 0.008），LPS與CON乳牛的MPO濃度皆顯著低於LPT乳牛。與CON乳牛相比，LPS與LPT組之血清對氧磷酶-1（PON1）活性在D1時均顯著受到抑制（p < 0.05）；然而，儘管處理與天數的交戶作用無顯著差異（p = 0.099），在整個監測期間，LPT組的整體PON1活性仍顯著較低（p = 0.016）。總膽紅素濃度（p = 0.019）、天門冬胺酸轉胺酶（AST，p < 0.001）及γ-麩胺醯轉移酶（GGT，p = 0.011）活性均呈現顯著的處理×天數互動效應。與對照組相比，LPS（分別為p = 0.037；p = 0.028）與LPT（分別為p = 0.007；p = 0.045）的AST與GGT活性在D1時均顯著升高，而LPT組的總膽紅素濃度在D1時較CON與LPS乳牛明顯升高（p = 0.031）。游離脂肪酸、β-羥丁酸和總膽紅素在LPS組中也表現出比LPT組更為理想的變化模式。與LPT乳牛相比，LPS乳牛在泌乳第30天（p < 0.001）、第60天（p = 0.016）和第90天（p = 0.005）的乳量較高。總結來說，本研究強調了一步法腹腔鏡第四胃固定術在術後期間的益處，因為它能降低發炎反應、對產乳量之恢復產生積極影響，並最終改善LDA乳牛的肝臟代謝。此外，我們的結果顯示，MPO具有作為探索性生物標記的潛力，可用於監測乳牛術後組織損傷的嚴重程度。

papers.title: From Effusion to Diagnosis: Integrating the FIP Effusion Index and Cell Tube Block Immunohistochemistry in a Geriatric Cat
papers.abstract: Feline infectious peritonitis (FIP) can be overlooked in older cats with competing causes of effusion. An older female domestic shorthair cat with hyperthyroidism and a hypertrophic cardiomyopathy phenotype developed abdominal effusion in December 2023. Initial effusion total protein was 5.46 g/dL, the albumin-to-globulin ratio was 0.48 and delta total nucleated cell ratio (ΔTNC) was 60.58, yielding a retrospectively calculated FIP Effusion Index of 126.2. Coronavirus RT-PCR detected FCoV RNA, with M1058L mutation positivity, and cell tube block immunohistochemistry (CTB-IHC) demonstrated viral antigen within macrophages. A second sample collected from scant residual effusion 9 days after the initiation of GS-441524 had a ΔTNC of 2.15 and a FIP Effusion Index of 7.17, despite a higher total protein concentration and a lower albumin-to-globulin ratio. GS-441524 treatment began on 20 December 2023 and ended on 22 March 2024. Abdominal fluid was no longer detected at the assessment on 25 January. No confirmed FIP relapse was documented before death during cardiopulmonary decompensation in January 2026. This case illustrates complementary contributions of the FIP Effusion Index and CTB-IHC, with an exploratory observation of serial FIP Effusion Index change. Threshold comparison is retrospective. The lower index was observed during treatment alongside markedly reduced effusion, but this observation does not establish a treatment effect or validate treatment monitoring.
papers.abstract_zh: 貓傳染性腹膜炎（FIP）在伴隨其他腹水成因的高齡貓中容易被忽略。一隻患有甲狀腺功能亢進及肥厚性心肌病表現型的高齡雌性米克斯貓，於2023年12月出現腹水。初始腹水總蛋白為 5.46 g/dL，白蛋白與球蛋白比值為 0.48， delta 總有核細胞計數比值（ΔTNC）為 60.58，回溯計算出的 FIP 腹水指數為 126.2。冠狀病毒 RT-PCR 檢測出 FCoV RNA，且 M1058L 突變呈陽性，細胞管嵌段免疫組織化學染色（CTB-IHC）證實巨噬細胞內含有病毒抗原。在開始投予 GS-441524 後 9 天採集之微量殘餘腹水的第二個樣本中，儘管總蛋白濃度更高且白蛋白與球蛋白比值更低，其 ΔTNC 為 2.15，FIP 腹水指數為 7.17。GS-441524 治療於 2023 年 12 月 20 日開始，至 2024 年 3 月 22 日結束。於 1月 25 日的評估中已偵測不到腹水。在 2026 年 1 月因心肺代償失調死亡之前，未記錄到確診的 FIP 復發。本病例闡明瞭 FIP 腹水指數與 CTB-IHC 的互補作用，並對連續 FIP 腹水指數的變化進行了探索性觀察。閾值比較為回溯性。較低的指數是在治療期間伴隨腹水顯著減少時觀察到的，但此觀察結果並未確立治療效果或驗證治療監測。

papers.title: Improving Femoral Tunnel Placement in Canine Cranial Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction Using a Novel Adjustable Aiming Device: Evaluation Through Simulated Surgical Trials
papers.abstract: Accurate femoral tunnel placement in canine cranial cruciate ligament (CrCL) reconstruction is challenging because of small joint anatomy and limited dedicated instrumentation. This study evaluated an adjustable femoral tunnel aiming device combined with patient-specific preoperative planning. Thirteen surgeons (six experienced and seven novices) performed simulated tunnel positioning using the device and a freehand technique. Outcomes included aperture positional error, measured as Euclidean distance (ED), angular deviation (AD), positioning time, and intra- and intersurgeon variability. Device-guided positioning reduced EDs (4.1–4.7 mm vs. 5.1–6.2 mm; p = 0.0275) and ADs (6.4–8.2° vs. 10.7–12.6°; p = 0.0038). Neither surgeon experience nor its interaction with technique significantly affected EDs or ADs. The device significantly reduced intrasurgeon variability in both outcomes and intersurgeon ADs variability among experienced surgeons. However, systematic distal bias (3.1–3.4 mm; p < 0.001) was observed with device-guided positioning. These findings support improved positioning accuracy and consistency with the device in simulated canine CrCL reconstruction. Further device refinement and hands-on practice may help address systematic deviations, while additional cadaveric and clinical validation is required before clinical application.
papers.abstract_zh: 由於犬隻關節解剖構造微小且缺乏專用器械，要在犬隻cranial cruciate ligament（CrCL）重建手術中精確定位股骨隧道具有相當大的挑戰性。本研究評估了一款結合病患專屬術前規畫的可調式股骨隧道瞄準器。十三位外科醫師（六位具經驗者與七位新手）使用該器械及徒手技術進行了模擬隧道定位。評估指標包含以歐幾里得距離（ED）測量的開口位置誤差、角度偏差（AD）、定位時間，以及術中與術間變異性。器械輔助定位減少了ED（4.1–4.7 mm 對比 5.1–6.2 mm；p = 0.0275）與AD（6.4–8.2° 對比 10.7–12.6°；p = 0.0038）。外科醫師的經驗及其與技術的互動效應均未顯著影響ED或AD。該器械顯著降低了兩項指標的術中變異性，以及具經驗外科醫師之間的AD變異性。然而，器械輔助定位被觀察到有系統性的遠端偏差（3.1–3.4 mm；p < 0.001）。這些發現支持該器械在模擬犬隻CrCL重建中能提高定位的準確性與一致性。在應用於臨床之前，需要進一步改良器械及實際操作練習來解決系統性偏差問題，並進行額外的遺體與臨床驗證。

papers.title: Seasonal Dynamics of Bat Activity in the Bosphorus Region (Istanbul, Türkiye): Acoustic Evidence for a Potential Migration Corridor Between Europe and Asia
papers.abstract: Long-distance migratory bats may face concentrated risks where movements funnel through geographic corridors, yet migration in southeastern Europe remains poorly documented. Istanbul and the Bosphorus are internationally recognized as a major migration bottleneck for birds, but their importance for bats has not been systematically investigated. We used passive acoustic monitoring at four stations along the Bosphorus from April to November 2022 to characterize bat activity and species occurrence, with detailed seasonal and meteorological analyses focused on Pipistrellus pipistrellus, P. nathusii, and the Nyctalus noctula/N. leisleri acoustic group. Across 3613 station-hour observations and 259,654 bat passes, at least twelve species were identified, including the globally Vulnerable N. lasiopterus. Pipistrellus pipistrellus was active throughout most of the season, whereas 84 to 93% of P. nathusii passes occurred after mid-August, peaking synchronously at all four stations between 26 and 29 September. Season-specific wind associations were weak, not supported by cross-validation, and shared by the resident P. pipistrellus, indicating weather effects on local activity rather than directed movement. These patterns are consistent with seasonal bat migration through the Istanbul–Bosphorus region and support the hypothesis that the strait forms a migration corridor, highlighting its potential importance for conservation and wind-energy planning.
papers.abstract_zh: 長距離遷徙的蝙蝠在移動通過地理走廊時，可能會面臨高度集中的風險，然而東南歐地區的蝙蝠遷徙狀況仍缺乏充分紀錄。伊斯坦堡與博斯普魯斯海峽國際間公認是鳥類的重要遷徙瓶頸，但其對蝙蝠的重要性尚未經過系統性調查。我們於2022年4月至11月期間，在博斯普魯斯海峽沿線的四個測站使用被動式聲學監測，以描述蝙蝠活動與物種出現狀況，並針對伏翼（Pipistrellus pipistrellus）、納氏伏翼（P. nathusii）以及大山蝠／夜蝠（Nyctalus noctula/N. leisleri）聲學類群進行詳細的季節與氣象分析。在3,613個測站-小時的觀測量與259,654次蝙蝠通過記錄中，辨識出至少十二種蝙蝠，其中包括全球易危（Vulnerable）的大魔王山蝠（N. lasiopterus）。伏翼在大部分季節中皆有活動，而84%至93%的納氏伏翼通過記錄則發生在8月中旬之後，並於9月26日至29日間在所有四個測站同步達到高峰。特定季節的風向關聯性微弱、未獲得交叉驗證支持，且與留棲的伏翼相同，這顯示天候對當地活動的影響大於定向移動。這些模式與透過伊斯坦堡-博斯普魯斯地區的季節性蝙蝠遷徙一致，並支持該海峽形成遷徙走廊的假說，凸顯其在保育與風力發電規劃上的潛在重要性。

papers.title: Multi-Fish Tracking in Complex Underwater Environments Using BF-DETR and DAPS-Enhanced BoT-SORT
papers.abstract: Reliable multi-object tracking of fish is essential for individual-level behavior analysis and intelligent aquaculture monitoring. However, degraded underwater imagery, ambiguous boundaries in dense groups, and high inter-individual appearance similarity often lead to missed detections, association errors, and identity switches. We propose BF-DETR-DAPS-BoT-SORT, a tracking-by-detection framework integrating fish detection, identity representation, and trajectory association. BF-DETR incorporates a Fish Morphology Enhancement Module (FMEM) to model local texture, directional structure, and contextual information, and a Boundary-Contrast Separation Module (BCSM) to distinguish adjacent individuals. We further develop the Detail-Aware Part Similarity Network (DAPS), which combines underwater texture enhancement, dual-axis local representations, and part-similarity learning to capture subtle appearance differences under changes in swimming direction. DAPS features are integrated into BoT-SORT for data association. On task-specific datasets constructed from continuous underwater videos, BF-DETR achieved mAP@0.5 and mAP@0.5:0.95 values of 96.63% and 77.53%, respectively. The complete framework achieved MOTA, HOTA, and IDF1 scores of 93.1%, 75.8%, and 91.2%, respectively, with 13 identity switches. Compared with BoT-SORT, HOTA and IDF1 increased by 1.4 and 2.1 percentage points, while identity switches decreased from 18 to 13. These results indicate improved trajectory continuity and identity consistency in complex underwater scenes, supporting reliable individual-level fish behavior analysis.
papers.abstract_zh: 可靠的魚類多物件追蹤對於個體層級的行為分析與智慧化水產養殖監測至關重要。然而，退化的水下影像、密集魚群中模糊的邊界以及個體間高度相似的外觀，經常導致漏檢、關聯錯誤與身分切換。我們提出了一種名為 BF-DETR-DAPS-BoT-SORT 的基於檢測的追蹤（tracking-by-detection）框架，整合了魚類檢測、身分特徵表示與軌跡關聯。BF-DETR 包含用於建模局部紋理、方向結構與上下文資訊的魚類形態增強模組（FMEM），以及用於區分相鄰個體的邊界對比分離模組（BCSM）。我們進一步開發瞭細節感知局部相似性網路（DAPS），其結合了水下紋理增強、雙軸局部特徵表示與局部相似性學習，以捕捉游泳方向改變下的微小外觀差異。DAPS 的特徵被整合至 BoT-SORT 中以進行資料關聯。在從連續水下影片構建的任務專用資料集上，BF-DETR 的 mAP@0.5 與 mAP@0.5:0.95 分別達到 96.63% 與 77.53%。完整的框架實現了 93.1% 的 MOTA、75.8% 的 HOTA 以及 91.2% 的 IDF1 分數，且僅有 13 次身分切換。與 BoT-SORT 相比，HOTA 與 IDF1 分別提升了 1.4 與 2.1 個百分點，而身分切換次數從 18 次減少至 13 次。這些結果顯示出在複雜水下場景中軌跡連續性與身分一致性的提升，為可靠的個體層級魚類行為分析提供了支援。

papers.title: Gut Microbiota Alterations and Intestinal Pathology in Healthy, Moribund, and Recently Dead Mastacembelus Armatus from a Pond Aquaculture System
papers.abstract: Spiny eel (Mastacembelus armatus) pond aquaculture suffers from recurrent nonspecific mortality, yet the associations between gut-microbiota shifts, host histological alterations, and fish physiological status, as well as the potential roles of sediment microbiota, remain unclear. In this study, we collected healthy (H), moribund (M), and recently dead (D) fish, as well as pond sediment (S), and performed histopathological examination and 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing combined with FEAST source-tracking analysis. Histology revealed severe intestinal villus atrophy, epithelial shedding, and extensive hepatic vacuolation in M fish. Results of 16S rRNA sequencing revealed a significant decrease in the alpha diversity (Chao1) of gut microbial richness in M and D groups, compared with healthy (H) (p < 0.05). Healthy guts were dominated by Proteobacteria and the keystone genus Cetobacterium (about 40% relative abundance). In M/D, Cetobacterium nearly disappeared, while Firmicutes and Fusobacteriota became predominant, with potentially opportunistic taxa (Fusobacterium, Clostridiaceae) showing markedly higher relative abundance. Beta-diversity and LEfSe analyses showed overlapping microbial communities between M and D fish, which were distinct from those of healthy (H) fish. FEAST modeling output showed that the conditionally estimated sediment-derived proportion increased from approximately 28% in healthy (H) to ~99% in M fish. Functional profiles predicted by PICRUSt2 shifted from oxidative phosphorylation toward peptidoglycan biosynthesis and peptidase-related functional potentials. Collectively, our results demonstrate strong associations between gut-microbiota disruption, intestinal barrier impairment, and fish physiological decline. We observed associations between damaged intestinal barrier status and increased sediment-attributed fractions of potentially opportunistic microbes within the gut microbiota.
papers.abstract_zh: 刺鳅（Mastacembelus armatus）池塘養殖常遭受反覆發生的非特異性死亡，然而腸道菌相轉變、宿主組織學改變與魚體生理狀態之間的關聯，以及底泥菌相的潛在作用仍不清楚。在本研究中，我們收集了健康（H）、瀕死（M）與剛死亡（D）的魚類以及池塘底泥（S），並進行組織病理學檢查、16S rRNA 擴增子定序，結合 FEAST 來源追蹤分析。組織學顯示，M 組魚類出現嚴重的腸絨毛萎縮、上皮脫落及廣泛的肝細胞空泡化。16S rRNA 定序結果顯示，與健康（H）組相比，M 與 D 組腸道微生物豐富度的阿伐多樣性（Chao1）顯著下降（$p < 0.05$）。健康魚類的腸道以變形菌門（Proteobacteria）和關鍵屬鯨桿菌屬（Cetobacterium，約佔 40% 的相對豐度）為主。在 M/D 組中，鯨桿菌屬幾乎消失，而厚壁菌門（Firmicutes）與梭桿菌門（Fusobacteriota）成為優勢菌群，且潛在條件致病菌群（梭桿菌屬 Fusobacterium、梭菌科 Clostridiaceae）的相對豐度顯著升高。貝塔多樣性與 LEfSe 分析顯示，M 與 D 魚類的微生物群落重疊，且與健康（H）魚類顯著不同。FEAST 模型輸出顯示，經條件估算源自底泥的比例從健康（H）組的大約 28% 增加到 M 組的約 99%。由 PICRUSt2 預測的功能圖譜從氧化磷酸化轉向肽聚醣生物合成及肽酶相關的功能潛能。綜上所述，我們的結果證明了腸道菌相失調、腸道屏障受損與魚體生理衰退之間存在強烈的關聯。我們觀察到受損的腸道狀態與腸道菌群中源自底泥的潛在條件致病菌比例增加具有相關性。

papers.title: Comparative Evaluation of Conventional and Real-Time PCR Assays for the Epidemiological Surveillance and Molecular Characterization of Leptospira in Asymptomatic Stray Dogs
papers.abstract: This study compared serological and molecular approaches for detecting Leptospira spp. using paired blood and urine samples from 124 asymptomatic stray dogs. Blood sera were screened via the microscopic agglutination test (MAT) for ten serovars. Urine samples were analyzed using four PCR assays: a commercial quantitative PCR (qPCR), a lipL32 qPCR, a conventional rrs PCR, and a multiplex PCR (mPCR). Serological exposure was detected in 26 (20.97%) dogs, while commercial qPCR, rrs PCR, lipL32 qPCR, and mPCR assays yielded positive results in 31 (25.00%), 34 (27.42%), 25 (20.16%), and 23 (18.55%) dogs, respectively. Compared with commercial qPCR, the lipL32 qPCR, rrs PCR, and mPCR demonstrated Positive Percentage Agreement (PPA) values of 80.65%, 87.10%, and 67.74%, and Negative Percentage Agreement (NPA) values of 100.00%, 92.47%, and 97.85%. Nineteen urine samples were positive across all four PCR assays. Overall, 42.74% (53/124) of dogs had at least one positive serological or molecular finding, including nine additional conventional PCR-positive findings without reliable sequence confirmation. Sequencing and phylogenetic analysis of 24 samples identified L. interrogans and L. borgpetersenii, representing the first molecular characterization of Leptospira in Bosnia and Herzegovina. The findings demonstrate the complementary value of serological and molecular approaches for Leptospira surveillance while emphasizing the need for cautious interpretation of unconfirmed molecular findings.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究比較了血清學與分子檢測方法，利用124隻無症狀流浪狗的配對血液與尿液樣本來檢測鉤端螺旋體屬（Leptospira spp.）。透過顯微凝集試驗（MAT）篩檢血清中針對十種血清群／血清型的抗體。尿液樣本則使用四種PCR檢測進行分析：商業化即時定量PCR（qPCR）、lipL32 qPCR、傳統rrs PCR及多重PCR（mPCR）。血清學暴露檢出率為26隻（20.97%），而商業化qPCR、rrs qPCR、lipL32 qPCR與mPCR檢測的陽性結果分別為31隻（25.00%）、34（27.42%）、25（20.16%）及23隻（18.55%）。與商業化qPCR相比，lipL32 qPCR、rrs qPCR與mPCR的陽性百分比一致性（PPA）分別為80.65%、87.10%與67.74%，陰性百分比一致性（NPA）則分別為100.00%、92.47%與97.85%。有19個尿液樣本在所有四種PCR檢測中皆呈陽性。整體而言，42.74%（53/124）的犬隻至少有一項血清學或分子檢測呈陽性，其中包括九個缺乏可靠序列確認的傳統PCR陽性結果。對24個樣本進行定序與系統發生樹分析，鑑定出問約氏鉤端螺旋體（L. interrogans）與博格貝特森氏鉤端螺旋體（L. borgpetersenii），這是波士尼亞與赫塞哥維納首次對鉤端螺旋體進行分子特性鑑定。研究結果證明瞭血清學與分子檢測方法在鉤端螺旋體監測上的互補價值，同時強調瞭對未經確認的分子檢測結果進行謹慎判讀的必要性。

papers.title: Shared Call Structure and Fine-Scale Spatial Variation in Calls Attributed to Boesemania microlepis in the Cambodian Mekong River
papers.abstract: Passive acoustic monitoring supports studies of fish activity and habitats in changing tropical rivers, yet cross-site consistency and local variation in calls remain poorly quantified. We monitored four sites (West, Middle, East, and Dock) across approximately 2 km of the Kampi reach of the Cambodian Mekong River. Automated detection and manual review were combined with fish surveys, hydrological observations, and background sound measurements. Published acoustic features and captures at the study sites supported attribution to Boesemania microlepis. At all sites, calls shared pulsed, harmonic structure, with site-median harmonic spacing of 114.8–119.1 Hz; 77.3–94.2% occurred at 16:00–20:00 local time. Rates of confirmed received events across daytime and nighttime recordings were 2.32–6.06 calls per minute of valid recording. Date-paired comparisons showed that Dock’s 95% cumulative-energy frequency was 200.0–235.1 Hz lower than at the other sites. Within-sequence call repetition rates at East were 0.327 and 0.241 calls/s lower than at West and Middle, respectively (Holm-adjusted p < 0.05). Dock’s lower-frequency spectrum coincided with deeper surrounding water, whereas detection and repetition rates followed distinct site patterns. Shared structure and local variation provide a quantitative basis for cross-site identification and habitat monitoring that integrates call features, activity timing, and environmental conditions.
papers.abstract_zh: 被動式聲學監測有助於研究變遷中熱帶河流的魚類活動與棲地，然而其聲音信號在不同樣點間的一致性與區域變異性仍缺乏充分的量化評估。我們在柬埔寨湄公河堪比（Kampi）河段約 2 公里範圍內的四個樣點（西側、中側、東側與碼頭）進行了監測。結合自動偵測與人工審查，並輔以魚類調查、水文觀測及背景噪音測量。已發表的聲學特徵與研究樣點的捕獲紀錄支持將這些聲音歸屬於大鱗結魚（*Boesemania microlepis*）。在所有樣點中，聲音皆具有脈衝式諧波結構，樣點中位數諧波間距為 114.8–119.1 Hz；77.3–94.2% 的聲音發生於當地時間 16:00–20:00。在有效錄音的日間與夜間時段中，經確認的接收事件發生率為每分鐘有效錄音 2.32–6.06 次鳴叫。日期配對比較顯示，碼頭樣點的 95% 累積能量頻率比其他樣點低 200.0–235.1 Hz。東側樣點的序列內鳴叫重複率分別比西側與中側樣點低 0.327 與 0.241 次/秒（經 Holm 法校正之 $p < 0.05$）。碼頭較低的頻譜與周圍較深的水域相吻合，而偵測率與重複率則呈現出不同的樣點模式。共享的結構與區域變異為跨樣點識別及棲地監測提供了量化基礎，並整合了鳴叫特徵、活動時間與環境條件。

papers.title: The Clinical Encounter as a Gateway to One Health: Rethinking Communication Education in Veterinary Curricula
papers.abstract: Communication is an accepted clinical competency in veterinary medicine, taught and increasingly assessed during the veterinarian–client consultation. However, the same encounter is also the profession’s most frequent point of contact with antimicrobial stewardship, zoonotic risk, food safety and public trust in science, and the population- and public-facing communication demanded by the One Health role remains comparatively overlooked in veterinary curricula. This narrative review reframes the clinical consultation not as the boundary of veterinary communication but as its gateway. Synthesizing current literature on communication teaching in veterinary education, it argues that provision is heavily weighted towards the dyadic core and comparatively silent on interprofessional, community, public health and digital communication. On this basis, it proposes an integrated Communication Competency Continuum, in which five transversal competencies (relational, informational, behavior change, risk and audience adaptation) are progressively re-contextualized from the clinical dyad outward to the One Health mandate, anchored in established competency frameworks and made explicitly assessable. Offered as a conceptual contribution rather than a prescription, the continuum is not intended to replace clinical communication training, which should be preserved, but to extend it, so that veterinary communication education matches the breadth of the profession’s role.
papers.abstract_zh: 溝通是獸醫學中公認的臨床能力，在獸醫與客戶的會診過程中會進行教學且日益受到評估。然而，同樣的會診情境也是該專業最常接觸抗生素管理、人畜共通傳染病風險、食品安全及大眾對科學信任的環節，而「健康一體」（One Health）角色所要求的群體及大眾導向溝通，在獸醫課程中卻相對被忽視。本篇敘事性文獻綜述重新界定臨床會診，不將其視為獸醫溝通的界線，而是其入口。透過綜合當前關於獸醫教育中溝通教學的文獻，本文主張現行教育資源重度傾斜於二元對立的核心（dyadic core），而對跨專業、社區、公共衛生及數位溝通相對靜默。基於此，本文提出一個整合的「溝通能力連續體」（Communication Competency Continuum），其中五項橫向能力（關係建立、資訊傳遞、行為改變、風險溝通及受眾調整）從臨床雙向互動逐步向外重新情境化，延伸至「健康一體」的使命，並立基於既有的能力框架中且明確可評估。作為一項概念性貢獻而非處方，此連續體無意取代應被保留的臨床溝通訓練，而是加以擴展，使獸醫溝通教育能與該專業角色的廣度相匹配。

papers.title: Biological Effects of Advanced Platelet-Rich Fibrin+ (A-PRF+)-Conditioned Medium on Primary Equine Corneal Stromal Cells: A Proof-of-Concept Study
papers.abstract: Corneal wound healing largely depends on the activation of stromal fibroblasts, which coordinate extracellular matrix remodeling and tissue regeneration. Although advanced platelet-rich fibrin (A-PRF+) has emerged as a promising biomaterial in regenerative medicine, its biological effects on equine corneal fibroblasts remain poorly understood. In this study, primary equine corneal fibroblasts were isolated from stromal explants and treated with an A-PRF+-conditioned medium. Cell metabolic activity, viability, intracellular reactive oxygen species, wound healing, cell cycle progression, growth factor secretion, and collagen type I expression were evaluated using colorimetric assays, fluorescence imaging, flow cytometry, and ELISA. A-PRF+ significantly enhanced fibroblast metabolic activity, increased intracellular ROS production, accelerated wound closure and cell cycle re-entry, and stimulated the secretion of PDGF-BB, TGF-β1, and VEGF-A. Furthermore, treatment increased the percentage of collagen type I-positive fibroblasts, supporting enhanced extracellular matrix production. Collectively, these findings demonstrate that A-PRF+ exerts beneficial effects on primary equine corneal fibroblasts by stimulating their metabolic, proliferative, migratory, and secretory activities. These results provide an experimental basis for the use of A-PRF+-based eye drops as a regenerative strategy to improve corneal healing in horses.
papers.abstract_zh: 角膜傷口癒合很大程度上取決於基質纖維母細胞的活化，這些細胞負責協調細胞外基質重塑與組織再生。儘管先進富血小板纖維蛋白（A-PRF+）已成為再生醫學中一種極具潛力的生物材料，但其對馬匹角膜纖維母細胞的生物學影響仍所知甚少。在本研究中，我們從基質外植體分離出原代馬匹角膜纖維母細胞，並以 A-PRF+ conditioned medium（A-PRF+ 條件培養基）進行處理。我們利用比色分析法、螢光成像、流式細胞儀與 ELISA（酵素聯結免疫吸附分析法），評估了細胞代謝活性、活力、細胞內活性氧類、傷口癒合、細胞週期進展、生長因子分泌以及第一型膠原蛋白的表現。A-PRF+ 顯著增強了纖維母細胞的代謝活性、增加了細胞內活性氧類的產生、加速了傷口癒合與細胞週期的重新進入，並刺激了 PDGF-BB、TGF-β1 與 VEGF-A 的分泌。此外，處理增加了第一型膠原蛋白陽性纖維母細胞的百分比，支持了增強的細胞外基質產生。總體而言，這些發現表明 A-PRF+ 透過刺激原代馬匹角膜纖維母細胞的代謝、增生、遷移與分泌活性，對其發揮了有益的影響。這些結果為使用基於 A-PRF+ 的眼藥水作為改善馬匹角膜癒合的再生策略提供了實驗基礎。

papers.title: Feeding Behaviour and Faecal Particle Size in Lambs Fed Concentrate-Based Diets with Grass and Maize Silages of Various Feed Values
papers.abstract: Maize silage is increasingly used for ruminants in Nordic countries. We evaluated effects of maize maturity at harvest and maize silage inclusion rate on intake, dietary selection, chewing behaviour and faecal particle size in lambs fed concentrate-based diets. Forty crossbred ram lambs were housed in pairs (five pens per treatment) in a 2 × 2 factorial arrangement. Diets contained 58% concentrate and 42% forage (dry matter (DM) basis); forage was early- (dough stage) or late-harvested (dent stage) maize silage, alone or mixed 50:50 with grass silage. After approximately three weeks on the diets, data were collected over four days, including 24 h of video-recorded behaviour. Daily DM and neutral detergent fibre (NDF) intakes were not affected by diet. Refusals contained more NDF, more particles of 8–19 mm and <1 mm and fewer particles of 1–8 mm than the offered feed; selection for 1–8 mm particles was greatest with late-harvested maize as the sole forage. Lambs fed maize silage as sole forage spent less time eating (daily and per kg DM intake) and had fewer faecal particles <0.212 mm and more of 0.212–0.500 mm than lambs fed grass–maize diets. Maturity and inclusion rate had limited effects on intake and feeding behaviour.
papers.abstract_zh: 青貯玉米在北歐國家 zunehmend（註：此處依語境譯為「日益被廣泛」）被用於反芻動物。本研究評估了收穫時的玉米成熟度與青貯玉米添加比例，對飼喂以精料為主之日糧的羔羊其採食量、日糧選擇、咀嚼行為及糞便粒徑之影響。四十隻雜交公羔羊以兩隻為一組關於欄內（每個處理五欄），採 2 × 2 因子設計。日糧包含 58% 精料與 42% 粗料（以乾物質（DM）計）；粗料為早收（糊熟期）或晚收（乳黃熟期）之青貯玉米，單獨使用或與牧草青貯以 50:50 比例混合。試驗飼糧餵養約三週後，進行為期四天的數據收集，包含 24 小時的錄影行為記錄。每日乾物質與中性洗滌纖維（NDF）採食量不受日糧影響。與所提供的飼料相比，剩餘飼料含有較高的 NDF、較多 8–19 mm 與 <1 mm 的顆粒，以及較少 1–8 mm 的顆粒；當以晚收玉米作為唯一粗料時，對 1–8 mm 顆粒的選擇性最高。與飼喂牧草－玉米混合日糧的羔羊相比，飼喂青貯玉米作為唯一粗料的羔羊，其進食時間較短（每日及每公斤乾物質採食量之進食時間），且糞便中 <0.212 mm 的顆粒較少，0.212–0.500 mm 的顆粒較多。成熟度與添加比例對採食量及進食行為的影響有限。

papers.title: Clinical Veterinarian Perspectives on Euthanasia for Pets
papers.abstract: The euthanasia of pets is a frequent discussion topic in veterinary practice. This study aimed to determine the levels of agreement with euthanasia decisions for pet animals by clinical veterinarians in different clinical scenarios; evaluate the differences in agreement levels according to species (including cats, dogs, and small mammals); and investigate the correlation between these decisions and demographic variables. The study sample consisted of 374 veterinarians actively practicing in clinical veterinary medicine in Türkiye. Data were collected via an online survey administered to the participants. The attitudes of participants toward euthanasia varied according to the animal species and case characteristics. The agreement with euthanasia decisions significantly varied in certain cases based on characteristics, such as the participants’ professional experience, pet ownership status, and prior experience with performing euthanasia. Thus, the euthanasia decision is a multidimensional process in which clinical, ethical, and individual factors are simultaneously evaluated. A detailed examination of the ethical, professional, and individual rationales underlying euthanasia decisions through qualitative studies is warranted based on the case scenarios used in this research, which can benefit pets, veterinarians, and animal owners.
papers.abstract_zh: 寵物安樂死是獸醫實務中經常討論的議題。本研究旨在探討臨床獸醫師對不同臨床情境下寵物安樂死決策的同意程度；評估根據物種（包含貓、狗及小型哺乳動物）而產生的同意程度差異；並調查這些決策與人口統計變項之間的相關性。研究樣本包含 374 名在土耳其從事臨床獸醫實務的現職獸醫師。數據透過對參與者進行的線上問卷調查收集。參與者對安樂死的態度因動物物種和病例特徵而異。在某些情況下，對安樂死決策的同意程度會根據參與者的職業經驗、寵物飼養狀況以及執行安樂死的過往經驗等特徵而有顯著差異。因此，安樂死決策是一個同時評估臨床、倫理和個人因素的多維度過程。基於本研究所使用的病例情境，未來有必要透過質性研究詳細檢視安樂死決策背後的倫理、專業與個人理由，這將能造福寵物、獸醫師及動物飼主。

papers.title: Transcriptomic Analysis Reveals Candidate Genes and Potential Pathways Associated with Spinal Deformity and Conjoined Twin Malformation in Oncorhynchus mykiss Larvae
papers.abstract: Rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss) is a globally cultured cold-water salmonid, yet triploid larvae often develop spinal ventral lordosis and conjoined twin malformations with unclear molecular mechanisms. Here, RNA-seq of 15 dph normal (N), spinal-deformed (SD) and conjoined (CT) triploid larvae yielded 54.13 Gb of valid data, identifying 4292, 3601 and 2699 DEGs for SD vs. N, CT vs. SD and CT vs. N groups, respectively. Five shared disrupted cascades (cell adhesion, neuroactive ligand-receptor interaction, phagosome, cytokine-receptor interaction, and PI3K-Akt signaling) were identified, while potential calcium/MAPK and steroid-biosynthesis-related pathways were predominantly perturbed in SD and CT larvae, respectively. Filtered PPI sub-networks displayed distinct predicted topological phenotype-associated candidate transcripts, with coagulation and complement transcripts forming core hubs in SD larvae and steroid-related transcripts showing weak connectivity in CT groups. Three discriminative transcripts with inverse expression patterns were screened. This study reveals conserved and phenotype-specific transcriptional phenotype-associated candidate transcripts of the two malformations and provides candidate phenotype-associated transcripts for subsequent functional verification of larval malformations. It should be noted that all transcriptomic data originate from whole-larval homogenates; expression signatures of conjoined-twin larvae may be confounded by altered tissue-type proportions rather than malformation-exclusive regulatory mechanisms.
papers.abstract_zh: 虹鱒（Oncorhynchus mykiss）是一種全球養殖的冷水性鮭科魚類，然而三倍體仔魚常出現脊椎腹側前凸與連胎畸形，其分子機制尚不清楚。本研究對孵化後 15 天（dph）正常（N）、脊椎畸形（SD）及連胎（CT）三倍體仔魚進行 RNA-seq，獲得 54.13 Gb 的有效數據，在 SD 對 N、CT 對 SD 及 CT 對 N 組中分別鑑定出 4292、3601 和 2699 個差異表達基因（DEGs）。研究識別出五個共同受損的級聯反應（細胞黏附、神經活性配體-受體相互作用、吞噬體、細胞激素-受體相互作用及 PI3K-Akt 信號傳導），而潛在的鈣/MAPK 和類固醇生物合成相關路徑則分別在 SD 和 CT 仔魚中受到顯著擾動。篩選出的蛋白質-蛋白質相互作用（PPI）子網路顯示出明顯的預測拓樸表型相關候選轉錄本，其中凝血與補體轉錄本在 SD 仔魚中形成核心樞紐，而類固醇相關轉錄本在 CT 組中顯示出較弱的連接性。篩選出了三個具有相反表達模式的鑑別性轉錄本。本研究揭示了這兩種畸形保守且具表型特異性的轉錄表型相關候選轉錄本，並為後續仔魚畸形的功能驗證提供了候選表型相關轉錄本。需要注意的是，所有轉錄體數據均源自全魚勻漿；連胎仔魚的表達特徵可能受到改變的組織類型比例之混淆，而非畸形專屬的調控機制。

papers.title: Assessment of Feeding Intensity in Juvenile Asian Crucian Carp Using Binocular Vision and 2D–3D Spatial Feature Fusion
papers.abstract: Accurate assessment of fish feeding intensity is essential for understanding feeding demand and optimising aquaculture efficiency. Fish feeding behaviour is inherently a 3D spatial activity, yet monocular vision can only provide 2D image information, capturing feature variations on a single projection plane. This makes it incapable of effectively characterising the fish’s positional and behavioural features in 3D space, thereby limiting the accuracy of feeding intensity assessment. Therefore, a binocular vision-based assessment method for fish feeding intensity via 2D and 3D spatial feature fusion is proposed. Binocular fish images are acquired from a lateral perspective. Fish targets are then segmented using image processing techniques, and target feature points are extracted. On this basis, the 2D spatial features of the fish are derived. To address missing feature points caused by fish overlap and occlusion in binocular images, a disparity map-based Missing Point Restoration (MPR) method is proposed for feature restoration and matching. Furthermore, a Weighted Delaunay Triangulation (WDT) algorithm is proposed to ensure accurate 3D feature computation. Notably, the extracted 2D and 3D spatial features have clear physical meanings and can directly characterise feeding-related spatial behaviour, thereby improving the interpretability of feeding intensity assessment. Finally, a classification model based on Tabular Prior-data Fitted Network (TabPFN) is constructed for assessing fish feeding intensity. By extracting 3D spatial features via binocular vision, the proposed method overcomes the inadequacy of 2D features in characterising fish vertical behaviour, effectively compensates for depth-related assessment errors, and improves feeding intensity assessment accuracy. The proposed method was tested on a real fish feeding dataset, achieving an accuracy of 95.92%, precision of 95.97%, recall of 95.95%, specificity of 98.63%, and F1-Score of 95.96%, indicating its potential for fish feeding intensity assessment.
papers.abstract_zh: 準確評估魚類攝食強度對於了解攝食需求和優化水產養殖效率至關重要。魚類攝食行為本質上是一種三維空間活動，然而單眼視覺僅能提供二維影像資訊，捕捉單一投影平面上的特徵變化。這使得它無法有效表徵魚類在三維空間中的位置與行為特徵，進而限制了攝食強度評估的準確性。因此，本文提出了一種基於雙眼視覺並透過二維與三維空間特徵融合的魚類攝食強度評估方法。本研究從側視角度獲取雙眼魚類影像，利用影像處理技術分割魚類目標，並提取目標特徵點。在此基礎上，推導出魚類的二維空間特徵。為解決雙眼影像中因魚體重疊與遮擋而導致的特徵點缺失問題，提出了一種基於視差圖的缺失點修復（MPR）方法進行特徵修復與匹配。此外，提出了一種加權德洛內三角剖分（WDT）演算法，以確保三維特徵計算的準確性。值得注意的是，所提取的二維與三維空間特徵具有明確的物理意義，能夠直接表徵與攝食相關的空間行為，從而提高攝食強度評估的可解釋性。最後，建構基於表格先驗資料擬合網路（TabPFN）的分類模型來評估魚類攝食強度。透過雙眼視覺提取三維空間特徵，該方法克服了二維特徵在表徵魚類垂直行為方面的不足，有效補償了與深度相關的評估誤差，並提高了攝食強度評估的準確性。本方法在真實的魚類攝食資料集上進行了測試，準確率達 95.92%、精確度達 95.97%、召回率達 95.95%、特異度達 98.63%，F1 分數達 95.96%，顯示出其在魚類攝食強度評估中的應用潛力。

papers.title: Grey Squirrel Density and Damage in Relation to the Presence of Predators
papers.abstract: The grey squirrel (Sciurus carolinensis) is an invasive species in Great Britain that causes substantial economic and ecological damage through stripping bark from broadleaf trees. The relationship between grey squirrel abundance and tree damage remains poorly understood, as does the potential role of recovering native predators in mitigating these impacts. We conducted an observational survey of 22 woodland sites across England and Wales with differing occurrences of pine martens (Martes martes) and northern goshawks (Accipiter gentilis), estimating grey squirrel density and quantifying bark-stripping damage. Grey squirrel density varied across sites. No significant relationship was detected between squirrel density and observed tree damage when analyses were restricted to sites where squirrels were present. However, when sites with no detected squirrels were included, squirrel density was positively associated with tree damage. Predator occurrence was associated with significantly lower grey squirrel densities. In contrast, predator presence was not significantly associated with the proportion of trees exhibiting bark-stripping damage. These findings suggest that predators may contribute to grey squirrel population suppression but that bark stripping is influenced by factors beyond contemporary squirrel abundance. Forest management practices that facilitate predator presence should be encouraged to support reduction in grey squirrel density and therefore improve future tree health. Further research should focus on fresh damage assessments and predator-mediated behavioural responses to better understand the mechanisms linking predator recovery, squirrel abundance and tree damage.
papers.abstract_zh: 灰squirrel（Sciurus carolinensis）是英國的外來入侵物種，透過剝除闊葉樹的樹皮，造成重大的經濟與生態損害。灰squirrel的豐度與樹木受損之間的關係目前仍所知有限，原生掠食者的復育在減緩這些衝擊方面可能扮演的角色亦然。我們對英格蘭和威爾斯境內 22 個松貂（Martes martes）與北方蒼鷹（Accipiter gentilis）出現狀況互異的林地進行了觀察調查，估計灰squirrel的密度並量化樹皮剝落的損害。灰squirrel的密度在各地點間有所不同。當分析僅限於有灰squirrel出沒的地點時，squirrel密度與觀察到的樹木受損之間並無顯著關聯。然而，當納入未檢出灰squirrel的地點時，squirrel密度與樹木受損呈正相關。掠食者的出現與顯著較低的灰squirrel密度相關。相對地，掠食者的存在與出現樹皮剝落損害的樹木比例並無顯著相關。這些發現顯示，掠食者可能有助於抑制灰squirrel族群，但樹皮剝落受當前squirrel豐度以外因素的影響。應鼓勵促進掠食者存在的森林管理實務，以支持降低灰squirrel密度，進而改善未來的樹林健康。未來的研究應著重於新近損害評估與掠食者媒介的行為反應，以更深入了解連結掠食者復育、squirrel豐度及樹木受損的機制。

papers.title: Community Member Experiences with Conversation-Based Companion Animal Adoption Policies at a Large, Non-Profit Animal Shelter
papers.abstract: Conversation-based companion animal adoption policies have been used by U.S. animal rehoming organizations since the 1990s. These policies differ from traditional adoption approaches that often use screenings or restrictions to determine adopter suitability. Personal accounts indicate that adopter experiences vary significantly depending on the adoption policies an organization uses and therefore should not be assessed collectively. With recent research indicating that conversation-based policies may lead to more equitable access to the human–animal bond, there is a need to understand how these specific policies are experienced by adopters. This study used a phenomenological approach to understand how adopters perceive conversation-based adoption policies. The researchers conducted semi-structured interviews with 30 community members at the Wisconsin Humane Society Milwaukee Campus. Participants described a consistent adoption experience, highlighting strengths, aspects for improvement, and how they view such policies affecting their community. Moreover, participants identified key aspects of the organization’s adoption policies that both allow for and could be expanded to create more equitable access to the human–animal bond. Animal shelters and rescues should use these findings to optimize community participation in adoption programs and advance animal welfare.
papers.abstract_zh: 美國動物安置組織自1990年代起便開始採用以對話為基礎的伴侶動物領養政策。這些政策不同於傳統的領養方法，傳統方法通常透過資格審查或限制來決定領養人的適任性。個人經歷顯示，領養人的體驗會根據組織所採用的領養政策而有顯著差異，因此不應將其一概而論。鑑於近期的研究表明，以對話為基礎的政策可能會帶來更公平的人與動物連結管道，因此有必要了解領養人對這些特定政策的實際體驗。本研究採用現象學方法，以了解領養人如何看待以對話為基礎的領養政策。研究人員對威斯康辛人道協會密爾瓦基校區的30位社區成員進行了半結構式訪談。參與者描述了一致的領養體驗，並強調了其優勢、待改進之處，以及他們如何看待此類政策對其社區的影響。此外，參與者指出該組織領養政策中的關鍵面向，這些面向既能促成、亦可擴展以創造更公平的人與動物連結管道。動物收容所與救援組織應利用這些研究結果來優化社區對領養計畫的參與，並推進動物福利。

papers.title: Procyanidin Protects Against Polystyrene Microplastic-Induced Male Reproductive Injury Through the NRF2/SLC7A11/GPX4 Pathway
papers.abstract: Polystyrene microplastics (PS-MPs) are ubiquitous environmental contaminants of emerging concern owing to their potential adverse effects on male reproductive health. However, the mechanisms underlying PS-MP-induced reproductive injury remain poorly understood, and effective protective interventions are lacking. Here, we investigated the protective effects of procyanidin (PC), a naturally occurring polyphenolic antioxidant, against PS-MP-induced reproductive injury in mice and elucidated the underlying mechanisms using TM3 Leydig cells. In mice, PC treatment attenuated the PS-MP-induced reductions in serum testosterone levels, sperm concentration, survival, and motility. PC also reduced the incidence of sperm abnormalities and the severity of histopathological lesions in the testes and epididymis. PS-MP exposure increased testicular Fe2+ levels and lipid peroxidation while decreasing GSH levels and GSH-Px, CAT, and T-SOD activities; these changes were reversed by PC. PS-MP exposure also downregulated the expression of NRF2, SLC7A11, and GPX4 and altered the expression of ferroptosis-related markers; PC treatment largely reversed these changes. In TM3 cells, PC reduced PS-MP-induced Fe2+ accumulation and lipid peroxidation, preserved mitochondrial membrane potential, and attenuated mitochondrial permeability transition pore (MPTP) opening. These effects were weakened by Erastin, an inhibitor of system Xc− that suppresses SLC7A11-mediated cystine uptake, and by ML385, an NRF2 inhibitor, suggesting the involvement of ferroptosis-related and NRF2-mediated signaling. Molecular docking predicted potential interactions between PC and NRF2 and SLC7A11. Collectively, these findings indicate that PC protects against PS-MP-induced male reproductive injury, potentially by modulating the NRF2/SLC7A11/GPX4 pathway.
papers.abstract_zh: 聚苯乙烯微塑膠（PS-MPs）是普遍存在的環境汙染物，因其對男性生殖健康的潛在不良影響而日益受到關注。然而，PS-MP誘導生殖損傷的潛在機制仍不甚清楚，且缺乏有效的保護性介入措施。在本研究中，我們探討了原花青素（PC，一種天然的多酚類抗氧化劑）對小鼠PS-MP誘導生殖損傷的保護作用，並使用TM3雷氏細胞闡明其潛在機制。在小鼠中，PC治療減輕了PS-MP引起的血清睪固酮濃度、精子濃度、存活率和活動力的下降。PC還降低了精子異常的發生率，以及睪丸和副睪組織病理學病變的嚴重程度。PS-MP暴露增加了睪丸Fe2+濃度和脂質過氧化，同時降低了GSH濃度以及GSH-Px、CAT和T-SOD活性；這些變化可被PC逆轉。PS-MP暴露還下調了NRF2、SLC7A11和GPX4的表現，並改變了鐵凋亡（ferroptosis）相關標記物的表現；PC治療在很大程度上逆轉了這些變化。在TM3細胞中，PC減少了PS-MP誘導的Fe2+累積和脂質過氧化，維持了粒線體膜電位，並減輕了粒線體通透性轉移孔（MPTP）的開放。這些作用會被Erastin（抑制SLC7A11介導之胱胺酸攝取的系統Xc−抑制劑）以及ML385（一種NRF2抑制劑）所削弱，這表明鐵凋亡相關和NRF2介導的訊息傳遞參與其中。分子模擬對接預測了PC與NRF2和SLC7A11之間的潛在交互作用。綜上所述，這些發現表明PC能保護PS-MP引起的男性生殖損傷，其機制可能透過調控NRF2/SLC7A11/GPX4途徑實現。

papers.title: Development and Preliminary Evaluation of a Teacher-Supervised AI-Assisted Closed-Loop Learning Model for an Undergraduate Animal Physiology Laboratory Course
papers.abstract: Animal Physiology Laboratory requires students to integrate physiological knowledge, experimental procedures, animal handling, real-time signal interpretation, and post-class reflection. To address the fragmentation of conventional laboratory teaching, this study developed an AI-assisted closed-loop learning model integrating online preparation, virtual simulation, predictive interpretation, hands-on animal experimentation, real-time physiological signal acquisition, troubleshooting-oriented review, and teacher-supervised AI-assisted feedback. Two evaluations were conducted at class-level: (1) a non-concurrent historical cohort comparison of students in Animal Science and Veterinary Medicine who entered the university in 2020 or 2021 (pre-reform cohorts) and 2022 or 2023 (post-reform cohorts); and (2) a cluster-randomized comparison involving 386 Veterinary Medicine students from 14 classes, allocated to either traditional teaching (7 classes; n = 190) or the AI-assisted group (7 classes; n = 196). The lab course lasted 8 weeks, while the teaching team, instructional content, laboratory resources, assessment criteria, and grading rubrics were matched between groups. The historical cohorts had higher reported final grades after the curriculum reform in both majors (p < 0.05). In the cluster randomized comparision, baseline prerequisite-course scores were comparable between the traditional and AI-assisted groups (81.93 ± 0.65 vs. 81.13 ± 0.59, p = 0.3807), and the final laboratory scores were higher in the AI-assisted group (94.27 ± 0.27 vs. 89.09 ± 1.16, p < 0.01). Although postrequisite-course scores and score gains from prerequisite to postrequisite courses were slightly higher in the AI-assisted group, neither difference was statistically significant (p = 0.1470 and p = 0.3022, respectively). These findings suggest that the AI-assisted closed-loop learning model can improve course-specific learning performance in veterinary physiology laboratory education. Its longer-term effects on subsequent-course performance require further investigation.
papers.abstract_zh: 動物生理學實驗要求學生整合生理學知識、實驗程序、動物保定、即時訊號判讀與課後反思。為解決傳統實驗教學片段化之問題，本研究開發了一個結合線上預習、虛擬模擬、預測性判讀、實際動物實驗、即時生理訊號擷取、以問題排解為導向的複習，以及教師監督之AI輔助回饋的AI輔助閉環學習模型。本研究進行了兩項班級層級的評估：(1) 非同期歷史世代比較，對象為2020或2021年（改革前世代）與2022或2023年（改革後世代）入學之動物科學系與獸醫學系學生；以及 (2) 叢集隨機比較，納入來自14個班級共386名獸醫學系學生，隨機分派至傳統教學組（7個班，n = 190）或AI輔助組（7個班，n = 196）。實驗課程為期8週，兩組間之教學團隊、教學內容、實驗室資源、評量標準與成績評定規準皆保持一致。課程改革後，兩個系所之歷史世代的期末總成績皆較高（p < 0.05）。在叢集隨機比較中，傳統組與AI輔助組之先修課程基準成績具可比性（81.93 ± 0.65 對 81.13 ± 0.59，p = 0.3807），而AI輔助組的實驗期末成績較高（94.27 ± 0.27 對 89.09 ± 1.16，p < 0.01）。儘管AI輔助組之後續課程成績及從先修至後續課程之成績進步幅度略高，但兩項差異均無統計顯著性（分別為 p = 0.1470 與 p = 0.3022）。這些結果顯示，AI輔助閉環學習模型能提升獸醫生理學實驗教育中特定課程之學習成效，而其對後續課程表現的較長期影響則需要進一步探討。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence and Metazoan Nervous Systems: From Local Processing to Valenced States of the Organism and the Inference of Suffering
papers.abstract: Recognising animals as sentient does not establish whether an individual animal is suffering at a particular time. This structured critical narrative review examines how biological evidence can support that inference. Drawing on evolutionary and comparative neuroscience, animal-welfare research and studies of artificial systems, we examine proposed links among stimulus detection, wider neural modulation, valuation, recurrent integration and consequences for the whole organism. Artificial systems provide comparisons in which learning and adaptive processing can be implemented without independently establishing subjective experience. Their implementation neither establishes feeling nor shows that these functions are unnecessary in conscious animals. Amphioxus, zebrafish, birds, mammals and octopus illustrate distinct questions about neural organisation, internal-state regulation and valuation. Birch et al.’s dimensions guide comparison of possible forms of experience without ranking species on a single scale. Exploratory literature searches, a targeted PubMed audit and a supplementary Scopus coverage check informed source identification and verification. Evidence was appraised separately for each claim, considering alternative explanations, marker validity, dependence among measures, interventions and changes over time. The framework distinguishes capacity for experience, occurrence of a particular state and its welfare significance while assessing confidence in each inference. The proposed biological links organise this assessment; they are not a validated causal sequence or scale of consciousness. Both brief severe experiences and sustained adverse states warrant consideration. AI can extend observation, but its classifications require independent biological validation and evaluation under their intended conditions of use.
papers.abstract_zh: 承認動物具有感知能力，並無法直接判定某個個體動物在特定時間是否正在受苦。本結構化評論性文獻回顧探討生物學證據如何支持此類推論。藉由借鏡演化與比較神經科學、動物福利研究以及人工系統研究，我們檢視了刺激偵測、更廣泛的神經調節、價值評估、遞迴整合以及對整體生物之影響之間所提出的關聯。人工系統提供了比較基準，在這些系統中，學習與適應性處理機製的實作無需先獨立確立主觀體驗。這些系統的實作既未確立感受的存在，亦未顯示這些功能在具意識的動物身上是不必要的。文昌魚、斑馬魚、鳥類、哺乳動物和章魚闡述了關於神經組織、內部狀態調節與價值評估的獨特問題。伯奇（Birch）等人提出的維度有助於比較可能的體驗形式，而無需將物種按單一尺度進行排名的先後順序。探索性文獻搜尋、針對性的 PubMed 審查以及補充性的 Scopus 涵蓋範圍檢查，為資料來源的識別與驗證提供了依據。本研究對每項主張的證據進行個別評估，同時考慮替代解釋、標記的有效性、量測間的相依性、介入措施以及隨時間的變化。此框架區分了體驗能力、特定狀態的發生及其福利意義，並評估了對各項推論的信心水準。所提出的生物學關聯有助於組織這項評估；它們並非已驗證的因果序列或意識量尺。短暫而嚴重的體驗以及持續的不良狀態皆值得關注。人工智慧可以擴展觀測範圍，但其分類結果需要獨立的生物學驗證，並在預期的使用條件下進行評估。

papers.title: Omeprazole Exposure Before Referral in Dogs with Chronic Inflammatory Enteropathy: A Retrospective Observational Single-Centre Study
papers.abstract: Omeprazole, a proton pump inhibitor, is widely used in veterinary medicine, although it may be frequently prescribed for conditions in which evidence of benefit is limited. This retrospective observational single-centre study evaluated omeprazole exposure before referral in dogs subsequently diagnosed with chronic inflammatory enteropathy. Medical records from 151 dogs were reviewed, including omeprazole exposure during the six months preceding referral, documented indication, dose and administration frequency. Indications were classified according to American College of Veterinary Internal Medicine consensus recommendations. Overall, 83/151 dogs (55.0%; 95% CI, 47.0–62.7%) had documented omeprazole exposure within six months of referral. Of these, 30/83 (36.1%; 95% CI, 26.6–46.9%) had a documented consensus-consistent indication, whereas 53/83 (63.9%; 95% CI, 53.1–73.4%) did not. Non-specific gastrointestinal signs were the most common documented indication (42/83; 50.6%), followed by suspected gastrointestinal bleeding or gastrointestinal ulceration or erosion (21/83; 25.3%) and suspected gastro-oesophageal reflux or reflux-associated oesophagitis (9/83; 10.8%). Among dogs with a clearly documented once or twice daily oral dosing regimen, once daily administration was more common than twice daily administration (38/65; 58.5% versus 27/65; 41.5%).
