Omeprazole exposure was common before referral, and a substantial proportion of exposed dogs had no documented indication consistent with ACVIM consensus recommendations. Interpretation was limited by the retrospective design and dependence on the completeness of referring veterinary clinical records.
papers.abstract_zh: 奧美拉唑（omeprazole）作為一種質子幫浦抑制劑（proton pump inhibitor），在獸醫臨床上被廣泛使用，儘管它經常被處方用於其益處證據有限的疾病。本回顧性單中心觀察性研究評估了隨後被診斷為慢性發炎性腸病（chronic inflammatory enteropathy）的犬隻在轉診前的奧美拉唑暴露情況。本研究回顧了 151 隻犬的醫療記錄，包括轉診前六個月內的奧美拉唑暴露情況、記錄在案的適應症、劑量及給藥頻率。適應症根據美國獸醫內科學會（American College of Veterinary Internal Medicine）的共識建議進行分類。整體而言，有 83/151 隻犬（55.0%；95% 信賴區間，47.0–62.7%）在轉診前六個月內有記錄在案的奧美拉唑暴露史。在這些犬隻中，30/83 隻（36.1%；95% 信賴區間，26.6–46.9%）具有符合共識建議的記錄適應症，而 53/83 隻（63.9%；95% 信賴區間，53.1–73.4%）則無。非特異性胃腸道症狀是最常見的記錄適應症（42/83；50.6%），其次為疑似胃腸道出血或胃腸道潰瘍或糜爛（21/83；25.3%），以及疑似胃食道逆流或逆流相關性食道炎（9/83；10.8%）。在具有明確記錄每日一次或每日 zweimal（原文 twice，即每日兩次）口服給藥方案的犬隻中，每日一次給藥比每日兩次給藥更為常見（38/65；58.5% 對比 27/65；41.5%）。奧美拉唑暴露在轉診前相當普遍，且相當大比例的暴露犬隻並無符合 ACVIM 共識建議的記錄適應症。本研究的解讀受限於回顧性設計以及對轉診獸醫臨床記錄完整性的依賴。

papers.title: Diet Formats, Feeding Practices, and Environmental Factors Associated with Overweight, Underweight, and Ideal Body Condition in Household Cats
papers.abstract: This exploratory cross-sectional study analyzed owner-reported survey data from 5653 cats belonging to current and prospective customers of a UK fresh cat food company to identify factors associated with body condition in companion cats and to compare owner classifications made using a structured body condition score (BCS) tool with those made by unguided judgment. Owners classified fewer cats as ideal using the structured BCS tool than by unguided judgment, with lower agreement for underweight than for overweight cats. Multivariable logistic regression models were developed for overweight, underweight, and ideal body condition. A higher proportion of fresh food was associated with greater odds of ideal body condition (OR 1.22, 95% CI: 1.04–1.42), while dry food was associated with overweight (OR 1.83, 95% CI: 1.33–2.51) and wet food with underweight (OR 1.51, 95% CI: 1.06–2.16), though this association was less robust to differing model specifications. Further associations included certain additional calorie sources, feeding practices, treat type, activity, enrichment, household composition, and established demographic factors. These hypothesis-generating findings highlight a gap between structured and unguided owner assessment and identify associations that merit prospective evaluation in a more generally representative population.
papers.abstract_zh: 本探索性橫斷研究分析了來自英國一家鮮食貓糧公司現有及潛在客戶的 5,653 隻貓之飼主回報問卷數據，旨在識別與伴侶貓體態相關的因素，並比較飼主使用結構化體態評分（BCS）工具與憑直覺判斷所作出的分類差異。與憑直覺判斷相比，飼主使用結構化 BCS 工具將較少數目的貓分類為理想體態，且對過輕貓隻的一致性低於過重貓隻。本研究針對過重、過輕及理想體態建立了多變量邏輯斯迴歸模型。較高比例的鮮食與理想體態的高勝算比相關（OR 1.22, 95% CI: 1.04–1.42），而乾糧與過重相關（OR 1.83, 95% CI: 1.33–2.51），濕糧則與過輕相關（OR 1.51, 95% CI: 1.06–2.16），儘管此關聯性對不同模型設定的穩健性較低。其他相關因素包括特定的額外熱量來源、餵食習慣、零食種類、活動量、豐富化環境、家庭組成及既有的的人口統計學因素。這些具假設生成性的研究結果突顯了結構化與非結構化飼主評估之間的落差，並找出了值得在更具代表性的族群中進行前瞻性評估的相關因素。

papers.title: Functional Groups of Summer Copepod Assemblage in the Central Barents Sea
papers.abstract: The functional trait structure of copepod assemblages inhabiting Arctic seas remains poorly investigated. In the present study, we aimed to reveal the spatial pattern of copepod functional groups in the central Barents Sea. One type of water mass (the Barents Sea Water) was identified based on an analysis of water properties. Environmental gradients in oceanographic factors, nutrients, and food conditions were relatively stable. Total abundance ranged from 434 to 1168 ind. m−3, with Oithona similis dominated numerically. Total biomass ranged from 7.1 to 85.9 mg dry mass m−3, with Calanus copepods having the highest contribution. Four copepod groups were delineated based on seven key functional traits (size, trophic group, feeding mode, reproductive strategy, life cycle duration, preferred habitat, and geographic distribution). The most abundant group included Calanus finmarchicus, Pseudocalanus spp., Microcalanus spp., Centropages hamatus, and Copepoda nauplii, which attained high abundances in the northern and south-eastern sub-regions. RLQ, fourth-corner, and redundancy analyses indicated sampling depth as the most important variable explaining spatial variation in diversity, functional diversity, and copepod traits. Water temperature, chlorophyll a concentration, and nutrient levels had a significant impact on particular functional traits, including omnivore–herbivores, omnivores, cruise-feeding, mixed-feeding, long-lived, intermediate-depth dwellers, and Arctic/cosmopolitan taxa. This research provides baseline information on the functional trait structure of copepod populations in the highly productive Arctic region and can be applied to the future monitoring of pelagic assemblages.
papers.abstract_zh: 北極海域橈腳類群聚的功能性特徵結構目前仍缺乏深入研究。在本研究中，我們旨在揭示巴倫支海中部橈腳類功能群的空間格局。基於水文特質分析，辨識出一種水團（巴倫支海水）。海洋學因子、營養鹽與食物條件的環境梯度相對穩定。總豐度介於每立方公尺 434 至 1168 個體，其中小異奇橈腳類（Oithona similis）在數量上佔優勢。總生物量介於每立方公尺 7.1 至 85.9 毫克乾重，並以哲水蚤屬（Calanus）橈腳類的貢獻最高。基於七項關鍵功能特徵（體型、營養群、攝食模式、繁殖策略、生命週期持續時間、偏好棲息地及地理分佈），劃分出四個橈腳類群。數量最豐富的群落包含芬氏哲水蚤（Calanus finmarchicus）、偽哲水蚤屬（Pseudocalanus spp.）、微哲水蚤屬（Microcalanus spp.）、鉤額哲水蚤（Centropages hamatus）及橈腳類無節幼體（nauplii），牠們在北部與東南部次分區達到高豐度。RLQ 分析、fourth-corner 分析與冗餘分析指出，採樣深度是解釋多樣性、功能多樣性及橈腳類特徵空間變異的最重要變數。水溫、葉綠素 a 濃度與營養鹽水平對特定功能特徵具有顯著影響，包括雜食－植食性、雜食性、巡游攝食、混合攝食、長壽、中層水域棲息者，以及北極／世界性分類群。本研究為高度生產力的北極地區中橈腳類族群的功能性特徵結構提供了基礎資料，並可應用於未來的中上層群聚監測。

papers.title: Feasibility of Serum and Faecal Interleukin Assessment in Equine Surgical Colic: A Pilot Study
papers.abstract: Cytokines may provide information about inflammation in equine colic, but their clinical relevance remains uncertain. This pilot study assessed short-term changes in serum and faecal interleukin (IL)-1β, IL-6 and IL-8 in eight horses undergoing colic surgery and compared measurements with six healthy controls. Colic horses were sampled at admission (D0), 24 h (D1) and day 7 (D7); controls provided serum at D0 and faeces at all three time points. Cytokines were assayed using MILLIPLEX and MAGPIX. Admission faeces were unavailable from 3/8 colic horses (37.5%). Serum IL-1β and IL-6 were below detection limits in 29/29 analysed samples (100%) for each cytokine. Serum IL-8 varied markedly without significant temporal change. Thirty-nine faecal extracts were analysed without faecal assay validation. Faecal estimates were generally lower in colic horses, with nominal between-group differences for IL-6 at D1 (p = 0.045), IL-1β at D7 (p = 0.033) and IL-8 at D7 (p = 0.004). No consistent temporal pattern in faecal estimates or significant association between serum and faecal IL-8 was detected. These findings do not establish the usefulness of these cytokines for clinical monitoring and highlight sampling and analytical limitations that should be addressed in larger, clinically diverse cohorts.
papers.abstract_zh: 細胞激素可能有助於了解馬匹腹痛（絞痛）的發炎狀況，但其臨床相關性仍未確定。本先導研究評估了八匹接受腹痛手術的馬匹在短期內血清與糞便中介白素（IL）-1β、IL-6 與 IL-8 的變化，並將測量結果與六匹健康對照馬進行比較。腹痛馬匹於入院時（D0）、24 小時（D1）及第 7 天（D7）進行採樣；對照組於 D0 提供血清，並在所有三個時間點提供糞便。細胞激素使用 MILLIPLEX 與 MAGPIX 進行分析。8 匹腹痛馬中有 3 匹（37.5%）無法取得入院時的糞便。在 29 個分析樣本中，血清 IL-1β 與 IL-6 均低於各自的檢測極限（各占 100%）。血清 IL-8 呈顯著變異，但無顯著的時間變化。共分析了 39 個糞便萃取物，但未進行糞便檢測驗證。腹痛馬的糞便估算值普遍較低，其中 IL-6 在 D1 ($p = 0.045$)、IL-1β 在 D7 ($p = 0.033$) 以及 IL-8 在 D7 ($p = 0.004$) 顯示名義上的組間差異。未發現糞便估算值呈現一致的時間模式，亦未發現血清與糞便 IL-8 之間有顯著的相關性。這些發現未能確立這些細胞激素用於臨床監控的效用，並凸顯了未來在較大且臨床多樣化的族群中應予解決的採樣與分析限制。

papers.title: Evaluation of Digital Tomosynthesis for Detecting Articular Cartilage Lesions in Equine Distal Interphalangeal and Metacarpophalangeal Joints: Comparison with Computed Tomography Arthrography
papers.abstract: Conventional radiography has limited sensitivity for detecting equine cartilage lesions. This prospective ex vivo study compared digital tomosynthesis (DT), computed tomography (CT), digital tomosynthesis arthrography (DTA), and computed tomography arthrography (CTA) for detecting artificial and naturally occurring partial- and full-thickness cartilage lesions in distal interphalangeal and metacarpophalangeal joints. Sixteen distal forelimbs from nine horses were examined under simulated weight-bearing (SWB) and non-weight-bearing (NWB) conditions. Three blinded observers evaluated 24 regions per limb, using gross examination as the reference standard. Sensitivity, specificity, and agreement were calculated, and mixed-effects logistic regression was performed. Gross examination identified lesions in 141 of 384 regions. Mean sensitivities (95% confidence intervals), reported for SWB and NWB, respectively, were highest for CTA [60.8% (56.7–64.9); 57.0% (53.4–60.5)], followed by DTA [14.7% (10.6–18.7); 29.1% (24.5–33.9)], CT [13.0% (9.3–16.7); 15.4% (12.0–18.8)], and DT [0.5% (0.0–1.0); 1.7% (0.9–2.4)]. Mean specificities ranged from 96.8% (95.3–98.4) to 99.7% (99.3–100.0). For agreement with gross examination, CTA had the highest pooled Cohen’s κ. Contrast medium administration was associated with higher odds of true-positive and lower odds of true-negative classification. Weight-bearing did not consistently improve lesion detection. Clinical performance requires evaluation in living horses.
papers.abstract_zh: 傳統X光攝影對於偵測馬匹軟骨病灶的敏感度有限。本前瞻性體外研究比較了數位體層合成（DT）、電腦斷層掃描（CT）、數位體層合成造影（DTA）與電腦斷層造影（CTA）在偵測遠端指關節及掌指關節中，人工製造與自然發生的部分及全層軟骨病灶之效能。本研究檢視來自9匹馬的16隻遠端前肢，分別在模擬負重（SWB）與非負重（NWB）條件下進行檢查。三位採盲法評估的觀察者針對每肢評估24個區域，並以肉眼檢查作為參考標準。計算敏感度、特異度與一致性，並執行混合效應羅吉斯迴歸。肉眼檢查在384個區域中的141個區域識別出病灶。平均敏感度（95%信賴區間）分別以模擬負重及非負重報告，最高者為CTA [60.8% (56.7–64.9)；57.0% (53.4–60.5)]，其次依序為DTA [14.7% (10.6–18.7)；29.1% (24.5–33.9)]、CT [13.0% (9.3–16.7)；15.4% (12.0–18.8)]以及DT [0.5% (0.0–1.0)；1.7% (0.9–2.4)]。平均特異度介於96.8% (95.3–98.4)至99.7% (99.3–100.0)之間。在與肉眼檢查的一致性方面，CTA具有最高的合併柯hen氏kappa值（Cohen's κ）。對比劑之給予與較高的真陽性分類機率及較低的真陰性分類機率相關。負重並未一致性地改善病灶偵測。其臨床效能尚需於活體馬匹中進行評估。

papers.title: Ultrasound-Guided Two-Point Transversus Abdominis Plane in Adult Horses: An Experimental Study Assessing Wall Sensitivity
papers.abstract: Ultrasound-guided transversus abdominis plane blocks may provide somatic analgesia for equine abdominal procedures, but evidence in adult horses remains limited. This prospective, blinded, randomized, paired study evaluated the feasibility, sensory effects, and motor effects of a two-point transversus abdominis plane block in eight healthy, standing, unsedated mares. Each horse received lidocaine 2% (2 mg/kg in 0.1 mL/kg per injection site) on one side and saline on the contralateral side. Responses to standardized mechanical stimulation were assessed at 21 sensory evaluation points per side for 300 min. The block was completed successfully in all horses without visible discomfort or procedural complications. No desensitization occurred on saline-treated sides. Following lidocaine administration, sensory blockade began at a median of 10 min, peaked at 30 min, and lasted a median of 258 (233–260) minutes. Desensitization was significantly greater at the stifle and intermediate horizontal levels than at the coxal tuberosity level. Transient motor impairment occurred in seven of eight horses and was severe in two. The technique produced multi-metameric desensitization, predominantly in the ventrocaudal flank, but limited dorsal coverage and frequent motor impairment may restrict its clinical application. Further dose optimization and clinical safety and efficacy studies are warranted.
papers.abstract_zh: 超音波引導腹橫肌平面阻滯可能為馬匹腹部手術提供軀體鎮痛，但針對成年馬的相關證據仍然有限。本前瞻性、盲化、隨機、配對研究評估了兩點式腹橫肌平面阻滯應用於八匹健康、站立、未鎮靜母馬的可行性、感覺效應與運動效應。每匹馬的一側注射 2% 利多卡因（每注射點 2 毫克/公斤，容積為 0.1 毫升/公斤），對側則注射生理食鹽水。兩側皆於 21 個感覺評估點評估對標準化機械刺激的反應，持續 300 分鐘。所有馬匹皆成功完成阻滯，無明顯不適或手術併發症。生理食鹽水處理側未發生去感覺化。注射利多卡因後，感覺阻滯的中位開始時間為 10 分鐘，於 30 分鐘時達到高峰，中位持續時間為 258（233–260）分鐘。膝部與中間水平面的去感覺化顯著大於髖結節水平面。八匹馬中有七匹發生短暫性運動障礙，其中兩匹為重度。該技術產生了多節段（multi-metameric）的去感覺化，主要集中在腹尾側脅部，但有限的背側覆蓋範圍以及頻繁的運動障礙可能會限制其臨床應用。未來的劑量最佳化以及臨床安全性與療效研究仍有待進行。

papers.title: Fish Responses to Total Dissolved Gas Supersaturation: From the Perspective of Historical Experimental Data in the Upper Yangtze River
papers.abstract: During discharge from high dams, the high-velocity water flows mix with air, causing downstream total dissolved gas (TDG) supersaturation, threatening fish survival. However, a systematic understanding on fish response patterns under the coupled influence of multiple environmental and biological factors remains limited. This study synthesized historical experimental data to explore fish tolerance and avoidance in response to TDG supersaturation in the upper Yangtze River. Economic fish species demonstrated overall stronger tolerance than the rare fish species under all TDG levels. Significant interspecific differences in economic fish tolerance were observed with increasing TDG levels. Aristichthys nobilis demonstrated stronger tolerance than Hypophthalmichthys molitrix. For the rare fish, Procypris rabaudi showed the weakest tolerance. Exposure time, TDG level, species and water temperature were identified as the primary factors influencing fish mortality. Based on these, mortality prediction formulas for rare and economic fish were established, achieving an R2 over 0.59. The avoidance ability of fish increased significantly with increasing TDG levels and reached 50% at 130% TDG. Significant interspecific differences in fish avoidance were observed at a 140% TDG level or above, and Schizothorax prenanti showed the weakest avoidance ability. TDG level was the dominant factor influencing fish avoidance ability, followed by body length. Accordingly, a prediction formula for fish avoidance rates was proposed with an R2 of 0.88. The findings offer critical insights for ecological risk management and the development of fish conservation strategies downstream of high dams.
papers.abstract_zh: 高壩洩洪期間，高速水流與空氣混合，導致下游總溶解氣體（TDG）過飽和，威脅魚類生存。然而，目前對於多種環境與生物因素耦合影響下魚類的反應模式之系統性理解仍然有限。本研究綜合了歷史實驗數據，探討長江上游魚類對TDG過飽和的耐受與迴避反應。在所有TDG水準下，經濟魚類展現出整體較稀有魚類更強的耐受性。隨著TDG水準升高，經濟魚類間的耐受性呈現顯著的物種差異。鱅魚（Aristichthys nobilis）表現出比鰱魚（Hypophthalmichthys molitrix）更強的耐受性。在稀有魚類中，岩原鱅（Procypris rabaudi）的耐受性最弱。暴露時間、TDG水準、物種和水溫被確定為影響魚類死亡率的主要因素。據此，建立了稀有魚類和經濟魚類的死亡率預測公式，其R2均大於0.59。隨著TDG水準升高，魚類的迴避能力顯著增強，並在TDG達130%時達到50%。在TDG達140%或更高水準時，魚類迴避行為呈現顯著的物種差異，其中短鬚裂腹魚（Schizothorax prenanti）的迴避能力最弱。TDG水準是影響魚類迴避能力的主導因素，其次為體長。因此，提出了魚類迴避率的預測公式，其R2為0.88。研究結果為高壩下游的生態風險管理和魚類保育策略的制定提供了關鍵見解。

papers.title: Bimodal Copulatory Locomotion and Ritualized Male–Male Combat in the Amazonian Lancehead (Bothrops atrox): Linking Sexual Size Dimorphism to Reproductive Mechanics and Sexual Conflict
papers.abstract: Reproductive behaviors in secretive Neotropical pitvipers are rarely documented under natural conditions, limiting empirical assessments of sexual selection, locomotor mechanics, and mating systems. Here, we present focal videography and photographic documentation of free-ranging Amazonian Lanceheads (Bothrops atrox) from coastal French Guiana during the rainy season. A prolonged copulation (~3 h) revealed a remarkable bimodal locomotor sequence: the pair moved from terrestrial litter across a 20 m-wide forest stream and back to land without cloacal separation. Video analysis demonstrates female-driven locomotion, wherein the substantially larger female pulls the coupled male through the water column against his counter-directional swimming movements. This behavior illustrates female locomotor dominance under sexual size dimorphism and the widely mechanical resilience of the spine-bearing crotaline hemipenis during forced aquatic displacement. Sequential photographic documentation captures ritualized male–male combat with synchronized vertical displays, anterior-trunk swaying, neck hooking, and topping attempts, confirming that stereotypic motor patterns described in western Amazonia are conserved in eastern Guiana Shield populations. These postural dynamics represent transient physical contests over spatial priority rather than permanent dominance hierarchies. Together, this evidence indicates that empirical validation for female behavioral control during copulation and expands the geographic framework supporting the prolonged mate-searching polygyny hypothesis in B. atrox.
papers.abstract_zh: 隱蔽性高的新熱帶蝮蛇之繁殖行為在自然條件下極少被記錄，這限制了對性擇、移動力學與交配系統的經驗性評估。在此，我們呈現在雨季期間來自法屬圭亞那沿海的自由活動亞馬遜矛頭蝮（Bothrops atrox）之焦點錄影與攝影紀錄。長達約3小時的持續交配揭示了一個顯著的雙峰移動序列：該對蛇在未分離總排泄腔的情況下，從陸地落葉層移動跨越一條寬20公尺的森林溪流，隨後再回到陸地上。影片分析顯示了由雌性主導的移動，其中體型大得多的雌性拖著與其交配的雄性穿過水體，對抗雄性反方向的游泳動作。此行為展現了在性雙形下雌性的移動主導地位，以及具棘刺的蝮亞科半陰莖在被迫進行水域位移期間，其廣泛的機械韌性。連續的攝影紀錄捕捉到儀式化的雄-雄爭鬥，伴隨同步的垂直展示、前軀擺動、頸部勾纏與壓制嘗試，證實了西亞馬遜地區所描述的定型動作模式在東部圭亞那地盾族群中具保守性。這些姿勢動力學代表了爭奪空間優先權的暫時性體力競賽，而非永久的優勢階級。綜上所述，這些證據表明了對交配期間雌性行為控制的實證支持，並擴展了支持亞馬遜矛頭蝮之長期尋偶一夫多妻假說的地理框架。

papers.title: Spatio-Temporal Distribution and Stranding Records of Cetaceans Along the Romanian Black Sea
papers.abstract: This study investigates cetacean occurrence and stranding records along the Romanian Black Sea coast between 2021 and 2025, focusing on the three resident subspecies: Tursiops truncatus ponticus, Delphinus delphis ponticus, and Phocoena phocoena relicta. A total of 1392 live individuals were documented across 188 sighting events, with T. t. ponticus and D. d. ponticus together representing 88.3% of all recorded individuals. The monthly distribution of recorded sighting events differed significantly among subspecies (p < 0.001), as did the distance of recorded sightings from the coastline (p < 0.001). Median distances were 4.40 km for T. t. ponticus, 61.78 km for D. d. ponticus, and 30.44 km for P. p. relicta. During the same period, 76 stranded cetaceans were recorded along the Romanian Black Sea coast, of which 58 were identified to subspecies level. P. p. relicta accounted for 70.7% of identified stranded individuals, compared with 11.7% of live individuals recorded during research cruises. Stranding records were most frequent in August and May, although their monthly distribution did not differ significantly among subspecies. Although both datasets covered the same geographical region and study period, differences in observation methods and sampling effort limit direct comparisons and prevent inferences about mortality rates or population trends. Nevertheless, the observed differences in the spatial and monthly distribution of live sightings, together with the high representation of P. p. relicta among stranded individuals, provide complementary information to support future cetacean monitoring, stranding investigations, and conservation efforts in the Romanian Black Sea.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究探討2021年至2025年間羅馬尼亞黑海沿岸的鯨豚出沒與擱淺記錄，重點關注三種常駐亞種：黑海寬吻海豚（*Tursiops truncatus ponticus*）、黑海短吻真海豚（*Delphinus delphis ponticus*）及黑海港灣鼠海豚（*Phocoena phocoena relicta*）。在188次目擊事件中共記錄到1392隻活體，其中寬吻海豚與真海豚合計佔所有記錄個體的88.3%。各亞種記錄到目擊事件的每月分佈存在顯著差異（p < 0.001），目擊記錄與海岸線的距離亦然（p < 0.001）。寬吻海豚、真海豚和港灣鼠海豚的中位數距離分別為4.40公里、61.78公里及30.44公里。同一期間，羅馬尼亞黑海沿岸共記錄到76隻擱淺鯨豚，其中58隻鑑定至亞種層級。在已鑑定的擱淺個體中，港灣鼠海豚佔70.7%，相較之下，其在研究航次中所記錄的活體個體僅佔11.7%。擱淺記錄以8月和5月最為頻繁，但其每月分佈在各亞種之間並無顯著差異。儘管兩組資料涵蓋相同的地理區域與研究期間，但觀察方法和採樣強度的差異限制了直接比較，且無法推論死亡率或族群趨勢。然而，活體目擊在空間與每月分佈上觀察到的差異，加上港灣鼠海豚在擱淺個體中的高比例，為支援未來羅馬尼亞黑海地區的鯨豚監測、擱淺調查與保育工作提供了互補的資訊。

papers.title: Molecular Identification of Clinostomum chaacci (Digenea: Clinostomidae) Metacercariae Reveals Two New Siluriform Hosts in the Peruvian Amazon
papers.abstract: Clinostomum chaacci Sereno-Uribe, López-Jiménez, González-García, Ortega-Olivares & García-Varela, 2025 is a recently described clinostomid trematode whose metacercariae have been molecularly identified in freshwater fishes from Mexico and South America. In October 2025, 29 siluriform fishes, comprising 18 Pimelodella cristata (Müller & Troschel, 1849) (Heptapteridae) and 11 Rineloricaria morrowi Fowler, 1940 (Loricariidae), were examined from the Nanay River, Loreto, Peru. Eight metacercariae were found encysted in the cephalic integument. The specimens were characterized morphologically and identified through Bayesian phylogenetic analyses of the mitochondrial Cox1 gene and the nuclear 28S rDNA. The new Cox1 sequences from both hosts were identical and nested within the C. chaacci clade, differing by 0.42–5.27% from conspecific isolates, whereas the 28S rDNA sequence differed by only 0–0.08% from reference sequences of C. chaacci. Morphometric data partially overlapped with those of C. chaacci metacercariae previously reported from Peru. The records from P. cristata and R. morrowi represent two new second intermediate hosts and add Loricariidae to the known host spectrum of C. chaacci, providing further evidence that a taxonomically diverse assemblage of fishes participates in its transmission in the western Amazon Basin.
papers.abstract_zh: 查氏斜睪吸蟲（*Clinostomum chaacci* Sereno-Uribe, López-Jiménez, González-García, Ortega-Olivares & García-Varela, 2025）是一種新近描述的斜睪科吸蟲，其囊蚴已透過分子生物學方法在墨西哥和南美洲的淡水魚類中被鑑定。2025年10月，自祕魯洛雷托楠奈河檢查了29尾鯰形目魚類，包含18尾冠狀皮口鯰（*Pimelodella cristata* (Müller & Troschel, 1849)）（七鰓鯰科）與11尾莫氏尖吻甲鯰（*Rineloricaria morrowi* Fowler, 1940）（甲鯰科）。在頭部皮膚中發現8個囊包狀囊蚴。本研究對這些標本進行了形態學特徵描述，並透過粒線體 *Cox1* 基因與核 *28S* rDNA 的貝氏系統發生分析進行鑑定。來自兩個宿主的新 *Cox1* 序列完全相同且嵌入 *C. chaacci* 分支內，與同種分離株相差 0.42–5.27%，而 *28S* rDNA 序列與 *C. chaacci* 的參考序列僅相差 0–0.08%。形態測量數據與先前自祕魯報導的 *C. chaacci* 囊蚴部分重疊。來自冠狀皮口鯰和莫氏尖吻甲鯰的紀錄代表了兩個新的第二中間宿主，並將甲鯰科納入 *C. chaacci* 已知的宿主範圍中，為分類學上多樣化的魚類群落參與其在西亞馬遜盆地的傳播提供了進一步的證據。

papers.title: Long-Term Performance of Biofilters Packed with Manure-Derived Media for Trimethylamine Removal: Operational Responses and Microbial Succession
papers.abstract: Four laboratory-scale biofilters were designed and evaluated for treating trimethylamine (TMA). Each biofilter was measured as being 68 cm in height and 15 cm in diameter. The filter media consisted of various mixtures of dairy manure compost, dairy barn bedding, crushed corn cobs, wood chips, and sawdust. This study aimed to compare the removal efficiencies of TMA achieved by biofilters packed with different media compositions, as well as to analyze the succession patterns in the structure of microbial communities on the media surfaces during operation. Contaminated air streams were artificially generated by bubbling air through a TMA solution, resulting in inlet concentrations ranging from 1.88 to 4.23 mg/m3. Under empty bed residence times (EBRTs) ranging from 42.7 to 28.0 s, all four biofilters achieved removal efficiencies exceeding 60%. However, the performance varied among the biofilters. The biofilter packed with a mixture of matured compost, wood chips, and crushed corn cobs at a volume ratio of 10:9:1 exhibited the highest removal efficiency (>83%). Ammonia was detected at the outlet of the biofilters as a byproduct of microbial TMA degradation, accompanied by the accumulation of ammonium nitrogen in the filter media. Microbial community analysis of the high-performance biofilter revealed a progressive increase in microbial complexity and diversity over 95 days of operation. Glycomyces was the dominant genus throughout the operation and showed a significant positive association with TMA removal efficiency, but its specific role in TMA degradation remains to be experimentally confirmed.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究設計並評估了四座實驗室規模的生物濾床，用於處理三甲胺（TMA）。每座生物濾床的高為 68 公分，直徑為 15 公分。濾材由乳牛糞堆肥、牛舍墊料、碎玉米芯、木屑和鋸木屑的各種混合物組成。本研究旨在比較填充不同濾材成分的生物濾床對三甲胺的去除效率，並分析運行期間濾材表面微生物群落結構的演替模式。受污染氣流是透過將空氣打入三甲胺溶液中人工產生，進氣濃度介於 1.88 至 4.23 mg/m3 之間。在空床停留時間（EBRT）介於 42.7 至 28.0 秒的條件下，四座生物濾床的去除效率均超過 60%。然而，各生物濾床的性能有所差異。以體積比 10:9:1 混合成熟堆肥、木屑和碎玉米芯的生物濾床表現出最高的去除效率（>83%）。在生物濾床出口處檢測到氨氣，作為微生物降解三甲胺的副產物，同時伴隨著濾材中銨態氮的累積。高效生物濾床的微生物群落分析顯示，在為期 95 天的運行過程中，微生物的複雜性和多樣性逐漸增加。糖黴菌屬（Glycomyces）在整個運行期間皆為優勢屬，且與三甲胺去除效率呈顯著正相關，但其在三甲胺降解中的具體作用仍有待實驗進一步證實。

papers.title: Molecular Characterization and Promoter Activity Analysis of the Porcine Convergent Gene Pair ABCF1 and PPP1R10
papers.abstract: The intergenic regions of porcine convergent gene pairs frequently maintain an open chromatin configuration with a permissive transcriptional microenvironment, rendering them promising candidates for genomic safe harbors (GSHs). However, the molecular features and promoter activities of the convergent gene pair ABCF1 and PPP1R10 remain uncharacterized, impeding the utilization of their potential as GSHs. To address this, we systematically predicted cis-regulatory elements (including CpG islands) of the two genes in silico, evaluated the transcriptional activities of serially truncated promoter fragments by dual-luciferase reporter assays in porcine fetal fibroblasts (PFFs) and PK-15 cells, compared their promoter regions across seven species, and characterized the protein architectures and flanking genomic landscapes. The ABCF1 promoter contained canonical TATA, CCAAT, and GC boxes alongside three CpG islands, and its shortest fragment, P217 (−217 to −1 bp), exhibited the highest activity in both cell lines. The PPP1R10 promoter possessed a triple TATA-box arrangement without detectable CpG islands, and its core fragment P211 (−211 to −1 bp) exhibited the highest activity among all truncated fragments in both cell lines and showed numerically higher activity than the simian virus 40 (SV40) promoter in PK-15 cells. No canonical oncogenes were identified within 100 kb upstream or downstream of the intergenic region between the two genes. Both ABCF1 and PPP1R10 are intracellular soluble proteins lacking transmembrane domains. ABCF1 is predominantly composed of α-helices, localizes in the cytoplasm and at the nuclear membrane, and modulates cytoplasmic translation. By contrast, PPP1R10 is enriched in random coils, specifically associates with nuclear chromatin, and participates in the PP1 phosphatase regulatory network. Taken together, our study delineates the core active promoter regions of both genes and highlights the potential of this chromosomal interval as a candidate genomic safe-harbor locus, a hypothesis awaiting further experimental validation.
papers.abstract_zh: 豬基因組中相向轉錄基因對（convergent gene pairs）的基因間區經常維持開放染色質構形與容許性轉錄微環境，使其成為基因組安全港（genomic safe harbors, GSHs）的潛在候選標的。然而，相向轉錄基因對 $ABCF1$ 與 $PPP1R10$ 的分子特徵與啟動子活性尚未被釐清，因而阻礙了其作為 GSH 潛力的利用。為了解決此問題，我們在電腦中系統性預測了這兩個基因的順式作用調控元件（包含 CpG 島），透過雙螢光素酶報導基因檢測，評估了一系列序列截短之啟動子片段在豬胎兒纖維母細胞（PFFs）與 PK-15 細胞中的轉錄活性，比較了它們在七個物種中的啟動子區域，並特徵化了其蛋白質結構與側翼基因組地景。$ABCF1$ 啟動子包含典型 TATA、CCAAT 與 GC 框以及三個 CpG 島，其最短片段 P217（−217 至 −1 bp）在兩種細胞株中皆展現最高活性。$PPP1R10$ 啟動子具有三重 TATA 框排列且偵測不到 CpG 島，其核心片段 P211（−211 至 −1 bp）在兩種細胞株的所有截短片段中展現最高活性，且在 PK-15 細胞中的數值活性高於猿猴病毒 40（SV40）啟動子。在這兩個基因間區上下游 100 kb 範圍內未發現典型致癌基因。$ABCF1$ 與 $PPP1R10$ 皆為缺乏跨膜域的細胞內可溶性蛋白質。$ABCF1$ 主要由 $\alpha$ 螺旋組成，定位於細胞質與核膜，並調節細胞質轉譯。相較之下，$PPP1R10$ 豐富分佈無規則捲曲，特異性結合至核染色質，並參與 PP1 磷酸酶調控網路。綜上所述，本研究描繪了這兩個基因的核心活性啟動子區域，並突顯此染色體區段作為候選基因組安全港位點的潛力，此假說尚待進一步的實驗驗證。

papers.title: Host Factor ANP32A in Avian Influenza Virus Replication and Cross-Species Adaptation: A Narrative Review
papers.abstract: Highly pathogenic avian influenza virus undergoes continuous evolution with strengthened cross-species transmission capacity, posing a severe threat to global public health security. Host acidic nuclear phosphoprotein 32A (ANP32A) acts as a critical host cofactor for activating influenza viral RNA-dependent RNA polymerase, and plays a central role in viral replication and host adaptation. This review systematically elaborates the molecular features of ANP32A, as well as the mechanism by which its leucine-rich repeat (LRR) domain specifically binds to the polymerase basic protein 2 (PB2) subunit and its low-complexity acidic region (LCAR) interacts with polymerase acidic protein (PA) to facilitate the assembly and functional activation of viral polymerase complexes. It also summarizes the influences of species-specific sequence variations and splicing isoforms of ANP32A on the host restriction barrier of cross-species transmission. Further analyses reveal that ANP32A indirectly modulates the transcriptional levels of genes related to interferons, NF-κB and NOD-like receptor pyrin domain-containing 3 (NLRP3) inflammasomes via chromatin epigenetic modification and transcriptional resource competition, remodeling the cellular antiviral microenvironment as a nuclear transcriptional regulator. ANP32A and acidic nuclear phosphoprotein 32B (ANP32B) exert complementary functions to support viral polymerase activity, while acidic nuclear phosphoprotein 32E (ANP32E) only provides weak auxiliary effects on a small subset of mutant influenza strains with its primary physiological function centered on chromatin regulation; the three proteins jointly participate in the regulatory network of viral replication. Drawing on recent advances in cryo-electron microscopy structural biology and CRISPR/Cas9 gene-editing technologies, which are discussed narratively in this review, this review highlights the pivotal hub role of ANP32A in viral host adaptation and cross-species spillover.
papers.abstract_zh: 高病原性禽流感病毒經歷持續演化，具備增強的跨物種傳播能力，對全球公共衛生安全構成嚴峻威脅。宿主酸性核磷蛋白32A（ANP32A）作為活化流感病毒RNA依賴性RNA聚合酶的關鍵宿主輔因子，在病毒複製與宿主適應中扮演核心角色。本綜述系統性地闡述了ANP32A的分子特徵，以及其富含白胺酸重複（LRR）域專一性結合聚合酶基本蛋白2（PB2）次單位，且其低複雜度酸性區域（LCAR）與聚合酶酸性蛋白（PA）相互作用以促進病毒聚合酶複合物之組裝與功能活化的機制。同時總結了ANP32A的物種特異性序列變異與剪接異構物對跨物種傳播之宿主限制障礙的影響。進一步分析顯示，ANP32A作為核轉錄調節因子，透過染色質表觀遺傳修飾與轉錄資源競爭，間接調控干擾素、NF-κB及NOD樣受體含熱蛋白ドメイン3（NLRP3）發炎小體相關基因的轉錄水準，從而重塑細胞的抗病毒微環境。ANP32A與酸性核磷蛋白32B（ANP32B）發揮互補功能以支援病毒聚合酶活性，而酸性核磷蛋白32E（ANP32E）僅對一小部分突變流感病毒株提供微弱的輔助效應，其主要生理功能則集中於染色質調節；此三種蛋白質共同參與病毒複製的調控網路。藉鑑近年冷凍電子顯微鏡結構生物學與CRISPR/Cas9基因編輯技術的進展（本綜述對此進行了敘述性討論），本綜述突顯了ANP32A在病毒宿主適應與跨物種溢出中的關鍵樞紐角色。

papers.title: Gut Bacterial and Fungal Communities of the Tibetan Eared Pheasant (Crossoptilon harmani) Across a Captive–Temple–Wild Gradient: Implications for Ex Situ Conservation
papers.abstract: Gut microbiota influence nutrient acquisition, immune function, and pathogen resistance, yet are rarely considered in ex situ planning. We compared gut bacterial (16S ribosomal RNA; 16S rRNA) and fungal (internal transcribed spacer 1; ITS1) communities of the Tibetan eared pheasant (Crossoptilon harmani), a protected Galliform endemic to the Qinghai–Tibet Plateau, across a management gradient: fully captive (n = 3), wild (n = 7), and free-ranging monastery birds receiving supplementary barley (n = 6); samples were not linked to identified donors, so the kingdoms are compared at group level only. Monastery birds had the numerically highest bacterial Shannon diversity (5.79), above wild (5.54) and captive birds (2.93), although the among-group test was not significant (p = 0.13). Permutational multivariate analysis of variance (PERMANOVA) showed significant bacterial differentiation (Bray–Curtis R2 = 0.309, p = 0.001), driven by the captive group, which showed Lactobacillus dominance (51.4%). Fungal communities also differed significantly (R2 = 0.194, p = 0.008), with no compositional turnover (Jaccard p = 0.447). Birds in natural habitat with supplementary feeding were no more dissimilar from wild birds than wild birds were among themselves, whereas fully captive birds were clearly separated; this pattern warrants testing in replicated, multi-site studies.
papers.abstract_zh: 腸道微生物群會影響營養獲取、免疫功能及病原體抵抗力，但在域外保育規劃中卻極少被納入考量。我們比較了青藏高原特有且受保護的雞形目鳥類——藏馬雞（Crossoptilon harmani）在不同管理梯度下的腸道細菌（16S核糖體RNA；16S rRNA）及真菌（內部轉錄間隔區1；ITS1）群落：完全圈養（n = 3）、野生（n = 7），以及獲得補充大麥的自由活動寺廟鳥類（n = 6）；由於樣本未與個別識別的個體連結，因此各界（kingdoms）僅進行群體層級的比較。寺廟鳥類的細菌香農多樣性（Shannon diversity）數值最高（5.79），高於野生鳥類（5.54）與圈養鳥類（2.93），儘管群組間的檢定未達顯著水準（p = 0.13）。變異數置換多元分析（PERMANOVA）顯示顯著的細菌分化（Bray–Curtis R2 = 0.309，p = 0.001），此差異主要是由呈現乳酸桿菌優勢（51.4%）的圈養組所驅動。真菌群落也呈現顯著差異（R2 = 0.194，p = 0.008），且無組成轉換（Jaccard p = 0.447）。棲息於自然棲地並接受補充餵食的鳥類，與野生鳥類之間的差異並不比野生鳥類彼此間的差異來得大，而完全圈養的鳥類則明顯區隔開來；此一模式有待透過具重複性的多地點研究來進一步驗證。
