papers.title: Short-Term Effects of Meloxicam and Marine-Based Fatty Acid Compounds on Objective Limb Loading and Owner-Reported Outcomes in Dogs with Hip Osteoarthritis: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Trial
papers.abstract: Canine hip osteoarthritis (OA) requires multidimensional assessment. This randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial evaluated 4-week treatment with meloxicam, PCSO-524, EAB-277, meloxicam plus PCSO-524, or placebo in 203 client-owned dogs with naturally occurring hip OA. The principal outcome was index-hindlimb peak vertical force (PVF) measured by force-plate gait analysis. Secondary outcomes included PVF responder status, orthopedic assessment score (OAS), Liverpool Osteoarthritis in Dogs (LOAD), Canine Brief Pain Inventory (CBPI), and safety assessments. The primary baseline-adjusted mean PVF analysis did not demonstrate treatment superiority among groups. A secondary responder analysis using an analysis-stage >5%BW PVF threshold showed that meloxicam had a nominally higher Week 4 responder probability than placebo (relative risk = 4.000; 95% confidence interval, 1.223 to 13.079; p = 0.022), interpreted as supportive rather than confirmatory. Within-group score reductions were observed in LOAD and CBPI pain interference for the combination group, LOAD for PCSO-524, and CBPI pain interference for EAB-277. OAS did not change significantly within any group. Between-group differences in LOAD and CBPI changes were not significant. No consistent group-level laboratory safety concern was detected. These findings support multidimensional assessment while emphasizing that secondary results do not establish treatment superiority.
papers.abstract_zh: 犬髖關節骨關節炎（OA）需要多維度的評估。這項隨機、雙盲、安慰劑對照試驗評估了使用美洛昔康（meloxicam）、PCSO-524、EAB-277、美洛昔康併用 PCSO-524 或安慰劑治療 4 週的效果，對象包含 203 隻患有自然發生之髖關節骨關節炎的飼主自有犬。主要結果為透過測力板步態分析測得的指標後肢峰值垂直力（PVF）。次要結果包括 PVF 應答者狀態、骨科評估分數（OAS）、犬隻骨關節炎量表（LOAD）、犬隻簡明疼痛量表（CBPI）以及安全性評估。主要之基線調整平均 PVF 分析未顯示各組間的治療優越性。使用分析階段 >5%BW PVF 閾值的次要應答者分析顯示，美洛昔康在第 4 週的應答者機率顯著高於安慰劑（相對風險 = 4.000；95% 信賴區間，1.223 至 13.079；p = 0.022），此結果被解讀為支持性而非確證性。在組內分數降低方面，合併治療組的 LOAD 和 CBPI 疼痛干擾分數下降，PCSO-524 組的 LOAD 分數下降，EAB-277 組的 CBPI 疼痛干擾分數下降。OAS 在各組內皆無顯著變化。LOAD 和 CBPI 變化的組間差異則不顯著。未檢測出一致性的群體層級實驗室安全性疑慮。這些發現支持多維度評估，同時強調次要結果並未確立治療的優越性。

papers.title: Diet-Associated Gut Microbiome Divergence Contributes to Phenotypic Differentiation Among Geographically Structured Populations of Rana dybowskii
papers.abstract: Geographic phenotypic variation is a widespread feature of natural populations, often driven by local environmental heterogeneity and trophic interactions. While the gut microbiome is recognized as a key mediator between environmental resources and host physiology, its role in the adaptive differentiation of amphibians remains insufficiently explored. In this study, we employed an integrative approach—combining morphological measurements, DNA metabarcoding for dietary analysis, and 16S rRNA sequencing for gut microbial profiling—to investigate three geographically structured populations (Dandong [DD], Fushun [FS], and Benxi [BX]) of the Dybowski’s frog (Rana dybowskii). The results showed that the morphological characteristics (body weight, head-body length, hindlimb length, etc.) of DD were significantly higher than those of FS and BX. Dietary analysis via gut content DNA metabarcoding identified distinct food structures; notably, the DD population consumed a higher proportion of Dipteran prey (e.g., Smittia). Correspondingly, the gut microbiota showed significant population-level clustering. We identified an enrichment of specific functional bacteria in the DD population, such as Arthrobacter, which is known for its chitin-degrading capabilities, aligning with the consumption of chitin-rich insect prey. Mantel tests further confirmed a strong correlation between dietary composition, microbial community structure, and host morphological traits. These findings suggest that diet-driven gut microbiome variation is consistent with a contributing role in the phenotypic differentiation of R. dybowskii across different habitats, although causal relationships remain to be tested directly. By integrating trophic ecology with microbial landscapes, this study provides new insights into the adaptive evolution and resource management of amphibians in heterogeneous environments.
papers.abstract_zh: 地理表型變異是自然族群中普遍存在的特徵，通常由當地環境異質性和營養交互作用所驅動。儘管腸道微生物已被認為是環境資源與宿主生理之間的重要媒介，但其在兩棲類適應性分化中的作用仍探討不足。在本研究中，我們採用綜合方法——結合形態學測量、用於食性分析的DNA條碼 metabarcoding，以及用於腸道微生物群落分析的16S rRNA定序——來調查分佈於不同地理位置的黑龍江木蛙（*Rana dybowskii*）三個族群（丹東 [DD]、撫順 [FS] 和本溪 [BX]）。結果顯示，DD族群的形態特徵（體重、頭體長、後肢長等）顯著高於FS和BX族群。透過腸道內容物DNA條碼進行的食性分析識別出不同的食物組成結構；值得注意的是，DD族群攝食了更高比例的双翅目獵物（例如搖蚊屬 *Smittia*）。相對地，腸道微生物相也展現出顯著的族群層級分群。我們發現DD族群中特定功能性細菌的富集，例如以分解幾丁質能力聞名的節桿菌屬（*Arthrobacter*），這與其攝食富含幾丁質的昆蟲獵物相呼應。曼特爾檢定（Mantel tests）進一步證實了飲食組成、微生物群落結構與宿主形態特徵之間存在強烈的相關性。這些發現表明，飲食驅動的腸道微生物變異與其在不同棲地中對 *R. dybowskii* 表型分化的潛在貢獻一致，儘管因果關係仍有待直接驗證。本研究透過結合營養生態學與微生物地景，為兩棲類在異質環境中的適應性演化與資源管理提供了新的見解。

papers.title: Identification and Characterization of a Cathepsin B Protease in the Marine Fish Parasite Cryptocaryon irritans
papers.abstract: Cryptocaryon irritans, an obligate ectoparasite, causes cryptocaryoniasis and heavy economic losses to marine aquaculture. Cathepsin B (CatB) is highly expressed in C. irritans theronts and hypothesized to participate in parasite host invasion, yet its biochemical properties and pathogenic roles remain poorly defined. In this study, we performed bioinformatic analysis of the CiCatB gene. Following codon optimization, CiCatB was heterologously expressed in Pichia pastoris, and the biologically active recombinant CiCatB protein was purified. Subcellular localization analysis revealed that CiCatB predominantly localized in the cytoplasm of theronts, with partial signals detected at the cell membrane and in the extracellular space. Enzymatic assays showed that yCiCatB hydrolyzed gelatin and type I collagen from large yellow croaker, with optimum activity at pH 5.0 and stable performance from 28 to 37 °C. Mg2+ increased enzyme activity, while Cu2+ almost completely abolished catalytic activity. Both E-64 and anti-CiCatB serum inhibited enzyme activity. Functional blocking using inhibitor or antiserum markedly reduced parasite recovery following challenge. Our results suggest that CiCatB may contribute to host invasion by degrading host structural proteins, advancing our understanding of C. irritans pathogenicity. CiCatB represents a potential target for exploring control strategies against cryptocaryoniasis.
papers.abstract_zh: 刺激隱核蟲（Cryptocaryon irritans）是一種專性體外寄生蟲，會引發海水養殖業的白點病並造成慘重的經濟損失。組織蛋白酶 B（Cathepsin B, CatB）在刺激隱核蟲幼蟲（theronts）中高度表達，並被假設參與寄生蟲對宿主的侵入，然而其生化特性與致病角色仍待釐清。本研究對 *CiCatB* 基因進行了生物資訊學分析。經密碼子優化後，*CiCatB* 在畢赤酵母（*Pichia pastoris*）中進行異源表達，並純化出具有生物活性的重組 CiCatB 蛋白質。亞細胞定位分析顯示，CiCatB 主要定位於幼蟲的細胞質中，且在細胞膜及細胞外空間偵測到部分訊號。酶學分析表明，重組 yCiCatB 能水解明膠及大黃魚的 I 型膠原蛋白，其最適作用 pH 為 5.0，並在 28 至 37 °C 之間表現穩定。$\text{Mg}^{2+}$ 能提高酶活性，而 $\text{Cu}^{2+}$ 則幾乎完全抑制其催化活性。E-64 與抗 CiCatB 血清皆能抑制其酶活性。使用抑制劑或抗血清進行功能阻斷，可顯著降低攻毒後的寄生蟲回收率。我們的結果顯示，CiCatB 可能透過降解宿主結構蛋白來協助宿主侵入，這有助於深入理解刺激隱核蟲的致病機制。CiCatB 作為探索白點病防治策略的潛在標靶具有重要價值。

papers.title: Mechanisms Linking Human Activities to Habitat Use by Amur Tigers and Amur Leopards Under Differentiated Management
papers.abstract: Human pressures may be associated with predator space use directly or through prey, with variation by season and zoning context. We combined cameras, source-specific patrol observations, and environmental covariates across 18,243 km grids in Northeast China Tiger and Leopard National Park. Hierarchical models estimated predator spatial-use probabilities and prey use intensities using 2024 monthly inputs. Tigers used cameras and patrols, whereas leopard states used cameras only. Spatial-error piecewise SEMs used 500 independently paired state draws and 400 conditional multivariate coefficient simulations per pair. No direct path and two single-prey chains passed the extended descriptive screening rule during snow, compared with four direct paths and one chain in snow-free conditions. The four directional hypotheses received limited, pressure- and species-specific support; seasonal and B–H–M comparisons remained exploratory. Negative net indirect estimates sometimes arose from component signs contrary to the proposed resource-depletion pathway. Opposing farmland–leopard estimates produced an uncertain total rather than evidence of exact cancellation. Six park-wide alternatives examined estimation, covariate, and network assumptions; the original B–H–M models described four snow-free contexts. These conditional patterns support field assessment rather than causal mediation or intervention prescriptions.
papers.abstract_zh: 人類壓力可能直接或透過獵物與掠食動物的空間使用產生關聯，並隨季節與分區情境而有所不同。我們在東北虎豹國家公園橫跨 18,243 個平方公里的網格中，結合了紅外線相機、來源別巡護觀察以及環境共變量。階層模型利用 2024 年的每月輸入資料，估算掠食動物的空間使用機率與獵物使用強度。老虎使用相機與巡護資料，而豹的狀態僅使用相機資料。空間誤差分段結構方程式模型（SEM）每個配對使用了 500 個獨立配對的狀態抽樣，以及 400 次條件式多變量係數模擬。在積雪期間，沒有直接路徑與兩個單一獵物鏈通過擴展的描述性篩選規則，而無雪條件下則有四條直接路徑與一條鏈通過。四項方向性假設僅獲得有限的、具壓力與物種特異性的支持；季節與 B–H–M 比較仍具探索性。負的淨間接估計值有時源自於與提出的資源耗竭路徑相反的組成正負號。相左的農田－豹估計值產生了不確定總量，而非確切抵消的證據。六個全園替代方案檢視了估計、共變量與網路假設；原初的 B–H–M 模型描述了四種無雪情境。這些條件模式支持野外評估，而非因果中介或干預處方。

papers.title: How Driveability Is Conceptualised in Harness Racing: Insights from Trainer and Driver Interviews
papers.abstract: Within harness racing, the concept of driveability has received little scientific attention despite its apparent relevance to training, racing, and horse welfare. This study explored, through semi-structured interviews, how eight Swedish harness-racing trainers and drivers conceptualise driveability and relate it to performance, rein tension, equipment use, and horse welfare. The data were analysed with reflexive thematic analysis. Three themes were developed: (1) calm training is key, (2) one cannot always influence driveability, and (3) equipment is a tool. Participants described a driveable horse as calm, attentive, and responsive to the driver’s signals. The findings suggest that driveability is best understood as a relational and context-dependent concept, shaped by training and ongoing interaction between driver and horse, while also being influenced by individual horse characteristics, situational conditions, and equipment use. Participants described both potential alignment and tension between welfare and performance. These perceived relationships require further investigation through independent assessment of practices and welfare outcomes.
papers.abstract_zh: 在標準bred賽馬（harness racing）領域中，儘管易駕性（driveability）顯然與訓練、競賽及馬匹福利息息相關，卻少有科學研究探討此概念。本研究透過半結構式訪談，探討了八位瑞典標準bred賽馬訓練師與駕駛員如何將易駕性概念化，並將其與表現、勒口張力（rein tension）、馬具使用及馬匹福利連結。資料採用反思性主題分析（reflexive thematic analysis）進行分析，歸納出三個主題：（1）平靜的訓練是關鍵、（2）易駕性並非總是能受人為影響，以及（3）馬具是一項工具。參與者將易駕性良好的馬匹描述為冷靜、專注且對駕駛員訊號有良好反應。研究結果顯示，易駕性最好被理解為一個具關聯性且取決於情境的概念，它由訓練以及駕駛員與馬匹之間的持續互動所形塑，同時也受到馬匹個體特質、情境條件和馬具使用的影響。參與者描述了福利與表現之間潛在的一致性與緊張關係。這些被感知到的關聯性需要透過對實務操作與福利結果的獨立評估來進一步研究。

papers.title: Defining Seasonal Windows of Transmission: A High-Resolution Monthly Risk Map for Leishmania infantum to Optimize Control Strategies in Southwestern Europe
papers.abstract: Zoonotic leishmaniasis, caused by Leishmania infantum, is an emerging public health concern in Southern Europe, where climate change is altering vector phenology. Traditional static risk maps fail to capture critical seasonal transmission dynamics. This study analyzed the monthly risk maps of L. infantum infection across Spain and Portugal, including the Balearic, Canary, Madeira, and Azores archipelagos. We developed Ecological Niche Models (MaxEnt) for the primary vector, Phlebotomus perniciosus, and integrated them with a temperature-dependent parasite development model to generate high-resolution monthly risk maps. The models exhibited high predictive power. In the Iberian Peninsula, human footprint was the primary driver, revealing a marked seasonal expansion of risk towards northern latitudes and higher altitudes during summer (June–September), with potential transmission windows extending into autumn. Conversely, in Macaronesia, temperature was the dominant factor. The Canary Islands and Madeira showed sustained high risk in coastal areas year-round, while the Azores, historically considered non-endemic, displayed climatic suitability hotspots in central islands. These findings confirm the tropicalization of transmission patterns and identify cryptic risk periods. This dynamic approach offers a robust tool for veterinary and public health authorities to transition from static, calendar-based prophylaxis to adaptive, evidence-based control strategies, optimizing resources in a changing climate.
papers.abstract_zh: 由嬰粟利什曼原蟲（Leishmania infantum）引起的人畜共通利什曼病，是南歐日益嚴重的公共衛生問題，當地的氣候變遷正改變著病媒的物候學。傳統的靜態風險地圖無法捕捉關鍵的季節性傳播動態。本研究分析了西班牙和葡萄牙（包含巴利阿里群島、加納利群島、馬德拉群島和亞速爾群島）各地L. infantum感染的每月風險地圖。我們為主要病媒白蛉（Phlebotomus perniciosus）開發了生態棲位模型（MaxEnt），並將其與溫度相依的寄生蟲發育模型相結合，以生成高解析度的每月風險地圖。這些模型展現了高度的預測能力。在伊比利半島，人類足迹是主要的驅動因素，顯示出在夏季（6月至9月）期間，風險向高緯度和高海拔地區顯著的季節性擴張，潛在的傳播窗口甚至延伸至秋季。相反地，在馬卡羅內西亞，溫度是主導因素。加納利群島和馬德拉群島全年都在沿海地區顯示出持續的高風險，而歷史上被認為是非流行區的亞速爾群島，則在中部島嶼顯示出氣候適宜性的熱點。這些發現證實了傳播模式的熱帶化現象，並識別出潛伏的風險時期。這種動態方法為獸醫和公共衛生主管機關提供了一個強大工具，使其能夠從靜態、基於日曆的預防措施，過渡到適應性、基於證據的控制策略，從而在變遷的氣候中優化資源配置。

papers.title: Selected Microelements and Toxic Metals in the Hair of Dairy Cows from the Bishkek Area, Kyrgyzstan
papers.abstract: In Kyrgyzstan, despite heavy environmental pollution, no assessment of dairy cow exposure to trace elements using hair sample analysis has been conducted so far. Therefore, this study aimed to assess the concentrations of selected trace elements, including the essential elements Cu, Fe, Mn, and Zn, as well as Cd, Pb, Hg, and Ni, in the hair of dairy cows in the vicinity of Bishkek—the largest city in Kyrgyzstan. The mean concentrations (±SD) and medians (given in parentheses) for individual elements were as follows (in mg/kg dry weight): Cd: 0.62 ± 0.19 (0.60), Cu: 5.63 ± 1.16 (5.69), Fe: 274.9 ± 169.8 (248.0), Mn: 7.81 ± 6.06 (6.12), Ni: mean and median below the limit of detection, Pb: 3.98 ± 1.47 (3.68), Hg: 0.0051 ± 0.0022 (0.0049), and Zn: 77.94 ± 12.91 (79.65). Statistically significant spatial differences were found for Cd, Fe, Hg, Mn, Pb, and Zn, whereas Cu concentrations did not differ significantly among districts. A statistically significant positive correlation with age was found only for Fe (Rs = 0.39, p = 0.006). The results demonstrate the occurrence and spatial variability of the analyzed elements in the hair of cows from the vicinity of Bishkek. However, further comprehensive studies are needed to determine the sources of contamination and the influence of the element concentrations noted in this study on animal health status, as well as to assess potential risks to human consumers of animal products.
papers.abstract_zh: 在吉爾吉斯，儘管環境汙染嚴重，迄今尚無利用毛髮樣本分析來評估乳牛微量元素暴露的研究。因此，本研究旨在評估吉爾吉斯最大城市比什凱克（Bishkek）周邊地區乳牛毛髮中特定微量元素的濃度，包括必需元素銅（Cu）、鐵（Fe）、錳（Mn）和鋅（Zn），以及鎘（Cd）、鉛（Pb）、汞（Hg）和鎳（Ni）。各元素的平均濃度（±標準差）及中位數（括號內）如下（以毫克/公斤乾重計）：Cd：0.62 ± 0.19 (0.60)、Cu：5.63 ± 1.16 (5.69)、Fe：274.9 ± 169.8 (248.0)、Mn：7.81 ± 6.06 (6.12)、Ni：平均值與中位數皆低於偵測極限、Pb：3.98 ± 1.47 (3.68)、Hg：0.0051 ± 0.0022 (0.0049)，以及 Zn：77.94 ± 12.91 (79.65)。Cd、Fe、Hg、Mn、Pb 和 Zn 在空間分布上具有統計學上的顯著差異，而 Cu 濃度在各區之間則無顯著差異。僅 Fe 與年齡呈統計學上顯著的正相關（Rs = 0.39, p = 0.006）。研究結果顯示比什凱克周邊地區乳牛毛髮中存在所分析的元素及其空間變異性。然而，仍需進行更全面之研究，以確定汙染源、評估本研究所記錄之元素濃度對動物健康狀況的影響，並評估動物產品人類消費者之潛在風險。

papers.title: Assessment of Oral Mucosal Colour in Horses: Initial Application of the Uldahl Standard Across Physiological States
papers.abstract: Assessment of oral mucosal colour is widely used in equine clinical and welfare evaluations, but inconsistent terminology limits comparison between clinical observations and research studies. This study evaluates, as an initial proof-of-concept, the Uldahl Standard for systematically describing mucosal colour and saturation. Gingival and lingual mucosae were assessed in clinically normal horses, healthy horses sedated for routine dental procedures, and horses with severe systemic circulatory compromise. Photographic colour samples validated against in vivo observations were classified using Munsell notation, ISCC-NBS terminology and the Uldahl Standard. Three illustrative cases of tongue discolouration were additionally assessed. Descriptive analyses characterised colour and saturation across physiological states, while clinically normal and sedated horses were compared using exact chi-square tests and logistic regression. Overall, 42 unique colour-saturation combinations were identified. Chromatic diversity increased with physiological compromise. Primary colour differed significantly between clinically normal and sedated horses for both gingival (p = 0.05) and lingual (p = 0.004) mucosae, whereas secondary colour and saturation did not. Grey was significantly associated with physiological state in both gingival (p = 0.05) and lingual (p = 0.03) mucosae. It showed high specificity but low sensitivity, including 100% specificity for lingual grey. Purple occurred only in sedated and systemically compromised horses, while blue occurred only as a secondary colour in systemically compromised horses. The findings demonstrate the feasibility of applying the Uldahl Standard to equine oral mucosal assessment and suggest that primary colour, particularly grey, may provide greater discriminatory information than secondary colour or saturation. Further studies are required to establish the diagnostic relevance of broader colour-saturation patterns.
papers.abstract_zh: 評估口腔黏膜顏色廣泛應用於馬匹臨床與福利評估，然而術語不一致限制了臨床觀察與研究結果之間的比較。本研究作為一項初步的概念驗證，評估了用於系統性描述黏膜顏色與飽和度的烏達爾標準（Uldahl Standard）。研究對象包括臨床正常的馬匹、因常規牙科程序而鎮靜的健康馬匹，以及有嚴重全身性循環障礙的馬匹。經活體觀察驗證的相片顏色樣本，分別以孟瑟爾標色系統（Munsell notation）、ISCC-NBS 術語及烏達爾標準進行分類。另外評估了三個舌部變色的說明性案例。描述性分析用以表徵不同生理狀態下的顏色與飽和度，並利用精確卡方檢定與邏輯斯迴歸比較臨床正常與鎮靜馬匹。整體而言，共識別出 42 種獨特的顏色-飽和度組合。色彩多樣性隨著生理受損程度而增加。就齒齦（$p = 0.05$）與舌（$p = 0.004$）黏膜而言，臨床正常與鎮靜馬匹之間的主要顏色具有顯著差異，而次要顏色與飽和度則否。灰色在齒齦（$p = 0.05$）與舌（$p = 0.03$）黏膜中皆與生理狀態顯著相關。它表現出高特異性但低敏感性，其中舌部灰色的特異性達 100%。紫色僅見於鎮靜及全身受損的馬匹，而藍色僅以次要顏色出現於全身受損的馬匹中。研究結果證明了將烏達爾標準應用於馬匹口腔黏膜評估的可行性，並表明主要顏色（特別是灰色）可能比次要顏色或飽和度提供更具區辨力的資訊。未來需要更多研究來確立更廣泛之顏色-飽和度模式的診斷相關性。

papers.title: Analysis of Consumer Purchasing Behavior in Pet Food Industry: Marketing Mix Strategies Across Dog and Cat Owners
papers.abstract: The global pet food market is influenced by the growing number of cats and dogs, the humanization of pets and the changing expectations of dog and cat owners. This study examines the role of marketing strategies in the dog and cat food market, focusing on the attitudes of Greek survey respondents, recognition of specific food categories, and factors associated with purchasing behavior. Data were collected through an online survey of 526 pet owners and guardians (n = 249 dog owners and n = 277 cat owners). The behavior toward pet foods containing selected premium ingredients was significantly linked to pet type (p = 0.021), the importance attributed to food ingredients (p < 0.001), veterinarian recommendations (p = 0.009), and the availability of scientifically substantiated information (p < 0.001). Among all factors, the importance of ingredients emerged as the factor displaying the strongest statistical association with consumer behavior (p < 0.001). Based on these findings, the study proposes a targeted marketing mix addressing product transparency, pricing, distribution, and promotion. The results contribute to the literature on pet humanization and provide practical guidance for pet food businesses, while highlighting the need for clearer regulatory definitions and scientific substantiation of marketing claims.
papers.abstract_zh: 全球寵物食品市場受到貓狗飼養數量增加、寵物擬人化以及貓狗飼主期望轉變的影響。本研究檢視行銷策略在貓狗食品市場中的角色，重點關注希臘受訪者的態度、對特定食品類別的認知，以及與購買行為相關的因素。資料透過針對 526 名寵物飼主與監護人（249 名狗飼主與 277 名貓飼主）的網路問卷調查蒐集。對含有特定優質成分之寵物食品的行為，與寵物類型（p = 0.021）、賦予食品成分的重要性（p < 0.001）、獸醫推薦（p = 0.009）以及具科學實證資訊的可得性（p < 0.001）呈顯著相關。在所有因素中，成分的重要性是與消費者行為呈現最強統計相關性的因素（p < 0.001）。基於這些發現，本研究提出了針對產品透明度、定價、通路與推廣的標竿行銷組合。研究結果有助於豐富寵物擬人化相關文獻，並為寵物食品企業提供實務指導，同時強調對行銷宣稱進行更清晰的法規定義與科學實證的必要性。

papers.title: Comparative Evaluation of Propofol, Eugenol and MS-222 in Yellowtail Tetra Astyanax lacustris: Anesthetic Efficacy, Physiological Responses and Recovery Dynamics
papers.abstract: In both aquaculture and scientific experimentation, fish handling often requires anesthesia to facilitate immobilization and minimize handling-associated disturbances. This study aimed to compare the anesthetic performance of different anesthetic agents in Astyanax lacustris, assessing induction, recovery, and safety to support protocol selection for tropical freshwater fish. A total of 114 yellowtail tetra Astyanax lacustris were used, including 54 fish in a preliminary experiment and 60 fish in the main experiment, with 10 fish per concentration in each anesthetic treatment during the main experiment. Fish were exposed to different concentrations of propofol (5.0 and 6.5 mg L−1), eugenol (40 and 50 mg L−1), and MS-222 (120 and 130 mg L−1). Anesthetic efficacy and complementary physiological responses were assessed through induction and recovery times, responsiveness during recovery, opercular beat rate (OBR), hematological parameters, and plasma concentrations of glucose, lactate, and cortisol. Data were analyzed using analysis of covariance (ANCOVA) followed by appropriate post hoc tests (p < 0.05). All anesthetics successfully induced stage IV anesthesia at the evaluated concentrations, although distinct induction and recovery profiles were observed. MS-222 promoted significantly faster progression to deep anesthesia and shorter recovery times, whereas propofol induced prolonged recovery and marked reduction in OBR, with residual ventilatory depression after recovery. Eugenol showed an intermediate anesthetic profile associated with pronounced excitation during induction and an altered recovery pattern. Hematological parameters and plasma lactate concentrations did not differ significantly among anesthetic types or concentrations. Plasma glucose concentrations increased at higher anesthetic concentrations, whereas plasma cortisol concentrations differed significantly between propofol and eugenol groups (p < 0.05). Overall, the findings demonstrate that propofol, eugenol, and MS-222 produce distinct anesthetic and ventilatory responses in A. lacustris, highlighting the importance of selecting anesthetic protocols according to the intended experimental or handling procedure.
authors: Bianca da Costa Tavares da Silva
papers.abstract_zh: 在水產養殖與科學實驗中，魚類操作通常需要麻醉以利於固定並將操作相關的干擾減至最低。本研究旨在比較不同麻醉劑在巴西麗脂鯉（Astyanax lacustris）上的麻醉效能，評估其誘導、恢復及安全性，以支援熱帶淡水魚實驗方案的選擇。本研究共使用 114 尾黃尾脂鯉（Astyanax lacustris），包含預備實驗的 54 尾魚及主實驗的 60 尾魚，主實驗中每個麻醉處理的每個濃度組有 10 尾魚。魚隻分別暴露於不同濃度的異丙酚（propofol，5.0 與 6.5 mg L−1）、丁香油（eugenol，40 與 50 mg L−1）及 MS-222（120 與 130 mg L−1）。透過誘導與恢復時間、恢復期間的反應能力、鰓蓋開閉頻率（oper-cular beat rate, OBR）、血液學參數以及血漿中的葡萄糖、乳酸和皮質醇濃度，來評估麻醉效力與互補的生理反應。數據採用共變數分析（ANCOVA）及適當的事後檢定進行分析（p < 0.05）。在所評估的濃度下，所有麻醉劑皆成功誘導出第四期麻醉，儘管觀察到截然不同的誘導與恢復特性。MS-222 促進了顯著較快的深層麻醉進程與較短的恢復時間，而異丙酚則導致延長的恢復期以及 OBR 的顯著降低，且在恢復後仍有殘餘的換氣抑制現象。丁香油則表現出中等的麻醉特性，伴隨誘導期間明顯的興奮反應及改變的恢復模式。血液學參數與血漿乳酸濃度在不同麻醉劑種類或濃度間無顯著差異。血漿葡萄糖濃度在較高麻醉濃度下升高，而血漿皮質醇濃度在異丙酚組與丁香油組之間則有顯著差異（p < 0.05）。總體而言，這些發現表明異丙酚、丁香油和 MS-222 在巴西麗脂鯉中產生了不同的麻醉與換氣反應，突顯了根據預期的實驗或操作程序來選擇麻醉方案的重要性。

papers.title: Sex-Specific Incubation and Body Orientation in the Black-Winged Stilt (Himantopus himantopus): Diel Patterns and Environmental Associations
papers.abstract: Biparental cooperation during incubation is particularly important in harsh environments. We quantified sex-specific incubation contributions and body orientation in Black-winged Stilts (Himantopus himantopus) from one-minute images at 12 nests monitored for 24 h in Saudi Arabia. Incubation partitioning, environmental associations, and sex differences in body orientation relative to the sun and wind were evaluated using nest-level resampling and generalized linear mixed models, with Holm correction for environmental tests. Male incubation share averaged 50.72% (95% CI 47.21–54.35%), without clear evidence of deviation from 50% (p = 0.697). Male contributions varied among two-hour periods (cyclic-shift p = 0.042; parametric-bootstrap likelihood-ratio p = 0.004), whereas the daylight–night difference was inconclusive (p = 0.234). No environmental predictor of incubation partitioning was supported after correction. No clear sex difference was detected in solar-relative orientation (p = 0.154). Although the primary four-direction (p = 0.015) and exploratory eight-direction (p = 0.038) models yielded nominal sex-related differences in wind-relative orientation, these findings were not consistently corroborated by compass-preference-adjusted and episode-onset sensitivity analyses and therefore do not establish a sex-specific wind response. Sex-by-wind-speed interactions were inconclusive (p = 0.071 and 0.172). Overall, near-equal daily incubation contributions can mask temporal variation in parental duties across two-hour periods.
papers.abstract_zh: 雙親在孵卵期間的合作於嚴苛環境中尤為重要。我們透過沙烏地阿拉伯監測的12個巢穴在24小時內拍攝的一分鐘間隔影像，量化了高蹺鴴（Himantopus himantopus）具性別特異性的孵卵貢獻與身體朝向。利用巢穴層級的重抽樣與廣義線性混合模型，評估了孵卵分配、環境關聯性，以及相對於太陽與風向之身體朝向的性別差異，並對環境檢定進行荷姆校正（Holm correction）。雄鳥的孵卵比例平均為 50.72%（95% 信賴區間 47.21–54.35%），沒有明確證據顯示其偏離 50%（$p = 0.697$）。雄鳥的貢獻在不同兩小時區間中有所變異（循環位移 $p = 0.042$；參數拔靴法似然比 $p = 0.004$），而日夜之間的差異則無定論（$p = 0.234$）。經校正後，沒有任何孵卵分配的環境預測因子獲得支持。在相對於太陽的朝向方面，未偵測到明顯的性別差異（$p = 0.154$）。儘管主要的四方位（$p = 0.015$）與探索性的八方位（$p = 0.038$）模型在相對於風向的朝向中得出名義上的性別相關差異，但這些發現並未獲得羅盤偏好調整及事件起始點敏感度分析的一致證實，因此無法確立具性別特異性的風向反應。性別與風速的交互作用則無定論（$p = 0.071$ 與 $0.172$）。整體而言，近乎相等的每日孵卵貢獻可能會掩蓋跨兩小時區間之親職任務的時間變異。

papers.title: Complete Mitochondrial Genome of the Poorly Known Fish Parasinilabeo maculatus (Cypriniformes: Cyprinidae) and Its Phylogenetic Implications
papers.abstract: Parasinilabeo maculatus is a rare cyprinid endemic to China whose phylogenetic position and taxonomy are poorly understood. We present its first complete mitogenome to clarify its phylogenetic placement within Semilabeonini. The circular mitogenome is 16,606 bp and shows the typical vertebrate gene arrangement: 13 protein-coding genes (PCGs), 22 tRNA genes, 2 rRNA genes, and a control region, with the L-strand replication origin (OL) in the WANCY tRNA cluster. It has a pronounced AT bias (58.7%), with AT-skew (0.094) and GC-skew (−0.250), consistent with other cyprinids. Phylogenetic trees reconstructed using ML and BI methods based on concatenated PCGs show similar topologies: (1) placing P. maculatus within Semilabeonini, where it is only provisionally grouped with P. assimilis and P. longicorpus in the full PCG dataset. This placement receives low gene and site concordance (gCF = 15.38%, sCF = 40.57%) and conflicts with the first + second codon position tree, in which P. maculatus is sister to Hongshuia microstomata rather than to its congeners; (2) supporting the monophyly of Semilabeonini and of several genera (e.g., Ptychidio), whereas the monophyly of Parasinilabeo is tentatively resolved at best and is therefore treated here as tentative (see point 1); (3) preliminarily revealing non-monophyly of some genera (e.g., Sinocrossocheilus) based on the current sampling, suggesting that some relationships may not fully match morphological classifications. However, these inferences rest on mtPCGs and limited taxon sampling and require testing with broader taxonomic and genomic sampling. These mitogenomic data provide a genomic resource for taxonomic and conservation studies of Semilabeonini.
papers.abstract_zh: 斑紋副唇魚（Parasinilabeo maculatus）為中國特有的稀有鯉科魚類，其系統發育位置與分類學尚不明確。本研究發表其首個完整的粒線體基因體，以釐清其在半鱯鮈族（Semilabeonini）中的系統發育位置。該環狀粒線體基因體長度為 16,606 bp，並顯示典型的脊椎動物基因排列：包含 13 個蛋白質編碼基因（PCGs）、22 個 tRNA 基因、2 個 rRNA 基因及一個控制區，其中 L 股複製起點（OL）位於 WANCY tRNA 基因簇中。其具有顯著的 AT 偏好性（58.7%），AT 偏斜度（AT-skew）為 0.094，GC 偏斜度（GC-skew）為 -0.250，與其他鯉科魚類一致。基於串接 PCGs 以最大似然法（ML）與貝氏推論（BI）法重建的系統發育樹顯示相似的拓樸結構：（1）將斑紋副唇魚置於半鱯鮈族內，在完整的 PCG 資料集中，它僅暫時與同屬的近緣種 P. assimilis 及 P. longicorpus 分群在一起。此位置獲得較低的基因及位點一致性（gCF = 15.38%, sCF = 40.57%），且與第一加第二密碼子位置的系統發育樹衝突，在該樹中，斑紋副唇魚與小口紅水魚（Hongshuia microstomata）為姊妹群，而非與其同屬物種；（2）支持半鱯鮈族及數個屬（例如：褶唇魚屬 Ptychidio）的單系性，而副唇魚屬（Parasinilabeo）的單系性充其量僅獲初步解析，故在此暫作保留處理（見第 1 點）；（3）基於目前的取樣，初步揭示部分屬（例如：華纓魚屬 Sinocrossocheilus）呈現非單系性，暗示某些親緣關係可能與形態分類不完全相符。然而，這些推論係基於粒線體蛋白質編碼基因（mtPCGs）與有限的分類群取樣，仍有待更廣泛的分類群與基因體取樣來進行驗證。這些粒線體基因體數據為半鱯鮈族的分類學與保育研究提供了基因體資源。

papers.title: Comparative Analysis of Mare Milk and Foal Faecal Microbiota in Kyrgyz Mare–Foal Pairs During the First 21 Days Postpartum
papers.abstract: This pilot study characterised bacterial DNA profiles in 40 milk and 39 faecal samples from eight Kyrgyz mare–foal pairs collected at birth, 24 h, and days 7, 14, and 21 postpartum using V3–V4 16S rRNA gene sequencing. Permutation Friedman tests detected temporal differences in foal faecal Shannon diversity and observed feature counts (Holm-adjusted p = 0.020 for both), but not in milk. Faecal diversity was descriptively lower at 24 h and day 7 than at birth and increased at days 14–21. Animal-blocked weighted UniFrac PERMANOVA detected a temporal effect in faecal DNA profiles (Holm-adjusted p = 0.0028), but not in milk (p = 0.0956). Pair-blocked milk–faecal comparisons were significant at each time point (Holm-adjusted p = 0.0391), although differences in dispersion limit interpretation. Without sequenced negative controls, background contamination cannot be distinguished from genuine milk-associated bacterial DNA; therefore, milk profiles cannot be confidently attributed to resident milk microbiota. Observed taxonomic similarities do not demonstrate microbial transmission or milk-derived foal gut colonisation. Significance in faeces but not milk does not establish a difference between their temporal responses, which was not directly tested. These findings are exploratory and require controlled validation.
papers.abstract_zh: 本先導研究利用 V3–V4 16S rRNA 基因定序，分析了八對吉爾吉斯母馬與幼馬在分娩時、產後 24 小時以及第 7、14、21 天所採集的 40 個乳汁與 39 個糞便樣本中的細菌 DNA 圖譜。置換費利曼檢定（Permutation Friedman tests）偵測到幼馬糞便的 Shannon 多樣性及觀察到的特徵數（observed feature counts）具有時間上的差異（兩者經 Holm 校正後之 $p = 0.020$），但在乳汁中則無此現象。糞便多樣性在 24 小時及第 7 天時在描述性上低於分娩時，並於第 14–21 天增加。以動物區塊化（animal-blocked）的加權 UniFrac PERMANOVA 偵測到糞便 DNA 圖譜具有時間效應（經 Holm 校正後之 $p = 0.0028$），但乳汁中則無（$p = 0.0956$）。以配對區塊化（pair-blocked）進行的乳汁與糞便比較在每個時間點皆具顯著性（經 Holm 校正後之 $p = 0.0391$），儘管離散度（dispersion）的差異限制了解讀性。在沒有定序陰性對照的情況下，背景污染無法與真正的乳汁相關細菌 DNA 區分開來；因此，乳汁圖譜無法確切歸因於常駐乳汁微生物相。觀察到的分類學相似性並未證明微生物傳播或乳汁來源的幼馬腸道定植。糞便具顯著性而乳汁不具顯著性，並不代表兩者的時間反應有差異，本研究並未直接測試此點。這些發現屬於探索性質，需要受控的驗證。

papers.title: Comparative Effects of a Cow Hoof Cover® and Bandaging as Dressing Materials for the Treatment of Digital Dermatitis in Dairy Cows
papers.abstract: Digital dermatitis (DD) contributes to lameness, posing major animal welfare and economic concerns. Corrective trimming, topical antibiotics, and bandaging are widely practised in managing DD. However, the challenges associated with conventional bandaging include water retention and a moist environment, which affect the healing process. This study evaluated the effectiveness of a Cow Hoof Cover® (CHC) for the treatment of DD in dairy cows. A quasi-experimental study was conducted, involving cows affected with active stages of DD (M1 and M2), allocated to CHC (n = 29) and conventional bandaging (n = 27) groups. The standard treatment entailed a Dutch five-step hoof trimming, wound management, application of topical antibiotic containing oxytetracycline (Engemycin 25 mg/mL), and wrapping of the digit using either the CHC or conventional bandaging. All cows received an intramuscular injection of flunixin meglumine (2.2 mg/kg) for pain relief. Primary outcomes were healing of DD lesions (transition from active stages to M0) and restoration of normal gait (locomotion score of 1). All cows were observed weekly until Week 4 after treatment. While alterations in locomotion score were not significantly different between the groups (p = 0.23) during the study period, the CHC group had significantly higher (p < 0.01) proportions of cured cows at week 3 (n = 6, 20.6%) and week 4 (n = 17; 58.6%) compared to the control. None of the CHC-wrapped lesions progressed into the chronic hyperkeratotic or proliferative stage (M4), but such transitions were recorded in four cows in the control group. Overall, the CHC had significantly higher probability of cure (HR = 2.79; 95% CI 1.30–5.97) than the control group. Excluding the treatment group, none of the tested animal characteristics and treatment-related variables influenced the probability of cure. Overall, the CHC offers practical advantages over conventional bandaging; it is quick to apply, durable, and water-resistant, supporting its use for field application and large-scale herd management. However, histological investigation and robust clinical trials are recommended to ascertain whether the CHC promotes a complete cure of active DD lesions.
papers.abstract_zh: 數位 dermatitis（趾間皮炎，DD）會導致跛行，對動物福利及經濟造成重大影響。矯正修蹄、局部使用抗生素及包紮是管理 DD 的常用方法。然而，傳統包紮面臨的挑戰包括水分滯留與潮濕環境，這會影響癒合過程。本研究評估了牛蹄套（Cow Hoof Cover®, CHC）治療乳牛 DD 的有效性。本研究採準實驗設計，將罹患活動期 DD（M1 及 M2）的乳牛分別分配至 CHC 組（n = 29）與傳統包紮組（n = 27）。標準治療包括荷蘭五步驟修蹄法、傷口處理、局部塗抹含土黴素（oxytetracycline，Engemycin 25 mg/mL）的抗生素，並使用 CHC 或傳統包紮法包覆趾部。所有乳牛均肌肉注射 flunixin meglumine（2.2 mg/kg）以緩解疼痛。主要結果為 DD 病灶的癒合（由活動期轉變為 M0）及正常步態的恢復（步態評分為 1）。所有乳牛自治療後起每週觀察一次，持續至第 4 週。儘管研究期間兩組間的步態評分變化無顯著差異（p = 0.23），但與對照組相比，CHC 組在第 3 週（n = 6, 20.6%）與第 4 週（n = 17, 58.6%）的痊癒牛隻比例顯著較高（p < 0.01）。CHC 包覆的病灶均未惡化為慢性角化過度或增生期（M4），但在對照組中有 4 頭牛記錄到此類轉變。整體而言，CHC 組的痊癒機率顯著高於對照組（HR = 2.79；95% CI 1.30–5.97）。除治療組別外，所有測試的動物特徵與治療相關變數均未影響痊癒機率。總體而言，相較於傳統包紮，CHC 具有實用優勢；其操作迅速、耐用且具防水性，支持其應用於田間實務與大規模牛群管理。然而，建議進行組織學研究與嚴謹的臨床試驗，以確認 CHC 是否能促進活動期 DD 病灶的完全痊癒。

papers.title: Codon Usage Bias and Host Adaptation of Canine Circovirus Identified from Various Hosts
papers.abstract: Canine circovirus (CCV) infection could cause immunosuppression in dogs, predisposing them to secondary complications. The virus also shows notable cross-species transmission potential. To investigate codon usage bias (CUB) and host adaptation, 102 CCV sequences from various hosts, including dogs, wolves, foxes, cats, and badgers, were analyzed. The mean GC% of CCV’s complete coding sequences was 50.31% (σ = 0.47), indicating no significant compositional bias. Furthermore, the replication protein (Rep) gene of CCV exhibited significant overrepresentation of T-ending codons and strongly avoided A-ending codons, whereas the capsid protein (Cap) gene displayed a clear codon bias toward A-ending codons and avoidance of G- or C-ending codons. Effective number of codons, parity rule 2, and neutrality analyses collectively indicated that natural selection acted as the primary evolutionary force governing the codon usage bias of CCV. Correspondence analysis (CoA) and correlation analysis demonstrated that other factors such as nucleotide composition and translational preferences could also affect CCV’s CUB. However, geography and genotype should not be ignored. The host adaptation analysis suggests that foxes are the most suitable hosts for CCV. This study provides a foundation for understanding CCV’s host adaptation mechanisms.
papers.abstract_zh: 犬圓環病毒（Canine circovirus, CCV）感染可能會導致犬隻免疫抑制，使其易受次發性併發症感染。該病毒亦展現出顯著的跨物種傳播潛力。為了探討密碼子使用偏好性（codon usage bias, CUB）與宿主適應性，本研究分析了來自包括犬、狼、狐狸、貓和獾等不同宿主的 102 個 CCV 序列。CCV 完整編碼序列的平均 GC% 為 50.31%（σ = 0.47），顯示並無顯著的組成偏好性。此外，CCV 的複製蛋白（Rep）基因表現出顯著過度代表以 T 結尾的密碼子並強烈避免以 A 結尾的密碼子，而外殼蛋白（Cap）基因則顯示出明顯偏好以 A 結尾的密碼子並避免以 G 或 C 結尾的密碼子。有效密碼子數（effective number of codons）、平價規則 2（parity rule 2）及中性分析共同指出，自然選擇是調控 CCV 密碼子使用偏好性的主要演化動力。對應分析（CoA）與相關性分析表明，核苷酸組成和轉譯偏好等其他因素也可能影響 CCV 的 CUB。然而，地理位置和基因型也不容忽視。宿主適應性分析表明，狐狸是 CCV 最適宜的宿主。本研究為理解 CCV 的宿主適應機制奠定了基礎。

papers.title: Inter-Reader and Inter-Modality Agreement for Radiographic and Magnetic Resonance Imaging Subchondral Bone Assessment in the Equine Proximal Phalanx Is Location- and Pattern-Dependent
papers.abstract: Standing low-field magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is widely used for subchondral bone (SCB) assessment of the equine proximal phalanx, but radiography remains the most common first-line imaging modality, and no direct comparison between the two is available for SCB sclerosis and resorption. Fifty-four fetlocks from 52 horses referred for standing MRI were retrospectively assessed at the medial glenoid, sagittal groove and lateral glenoid, using an ordinal scale for sclerosis and a four-type nominal classification for resorption. Seven readers of varied clinical backgrounds performed independent radiographic readings; two board-certified radiologists then established a consensus reading, blinded to MRI. Agreement was quantified with Gwet’s agreement coefficients (inter-reader), weighted and unweighted Cohen’s κ (reader-MRI) and symmetric metrics (consensus-MRI). Inter-reader agreement for sclerosis was location-dependent (Gwet’s agreement coefficient = 0.27–0.73, lowest medially) and substantial-to-almost-perfect for resorption (Gwet’s agreement coefficient ≥ 0.72). The radiographic consensus aligned closely with MRI at the sagittal groove but underestimated marked sclerosis medially and over-called it laterally; fracture-type resorption was reliably detected at the sagittal groove but misclassified medially. Radiography can be relied upon for sagittal groove lesions, but complementary MRI is warranted medially when resorption or clinical suspicion of fracture is present, and to confirm radiographic positive calls laterally.
papers.abstract_zh: 站立式低磁場磁振造影（MRI）廣泛應用於評估馬匹近端趾骨的軟骨下骨（SCB），然而X光攝影仍是最常見的第一線造影方式，且目前尚無這兩種造影方法在評估軟骨下骨硬化與吸收方面的直接比較。本研究回顧性評估了52匹因轉診而接受站立式MRI之馬匹的54個球節，觀察部位包括內側關節盂、矢狀溝與外側關節盂，硬化程度採用順序量表評估，吸收則採用四型名義分類。七位具不同臨床背景的判讀者獨立進行X光判讀；隨後由兩位專科認證放射科醫師在對MRI不知情的情況下建立共識判讀。一致性以格韋特一致性係數（Gwet’s agreement coefficients，評估者間）、加權與未加權柯恩氏 $\kappa$ 值（評估者與MRI）及對稱指標（共識與MRI）進行量化。硬化之評估者間一致性具位置依賴性（格韋特一致性係數 = 0.27–0.73，內側最低），吸收則具顯著至幾乎完全一致（格韋特一致性係數 $\ge$ 0.72）。X光共識結果在矢狀溝處與MRI高度一致，但在內側低估了明顯的硬化並在外側高估；骨折型吸收在矢狀溝可被可靠偵測，但在內側會被誤判。X光攝影可用於矢狀溝病灶之評估，但在內側若出現骨吸收或臨床懷疑有骨折時，則有必要輔以MRI，且外側之X光陽性判讀亦需經MRI確認。

papers.title: Diversity of Helminth Parasites in the Fat Sand Rat, Psammomys obesus Cretzschmar, 1828, from Tunisia
papers.abstract: Psammomys obesus is a diurnal herbivorous rodent widely distributed across the arid regions of North Africa and the Arabian Peninsula. Although it has ecological, agricultural, public health, and biomedical importance, its helminth fauna remains poorly known. This study provides a comprehensive inventory of helminth parasites infecting P. obesus in southern Tunisia and examines variations in parasitism according to host sex, age, body condition, and sampling region. A total of 152 specimens of P. obesus were captured between September 2023 and March 2026 in the Tamaghza and Djebel Dahar regions. Parasitological examination revealed four helminth species: three cestodes, Gerbillitaenia psammomi, Sudarikovina aegyptica, and Mesocestoides sp. larvae, and one nematode, Syphacia sp. Their respective prevalences were 63.8%, 12.5%, 0.7%, and 16.4%. The species are morphologically described, and genetic data and a phylogenetic tree are provided for Syphacia sp. The findings of Mesocestoides and Syphacia species represent new records for P. obesus. Furthermore, S. aegyptica constitutes a new record for Tunisia. Host age and sampling region significantly influenced the occurrence and abundance of G. psammomi, as adults were more likely to be infected and harbored a significantly higher parasite burden than juveniles. In contrast, neither host sex nor body condition was significantly associated with parasite occurrence or abundance. No significant association between parasite occurrence or abundance and the host’s sex, age, or body condition was found for S. aegyptica and Syphacia sp.
papers.abstract_zh: 沙奇鼠（*Psammomys obesus*）是一種日行性草食性囓齒動物，廣泛分佈於北非和阿拉伯半島的乾旱地區。儘管它在生態、農業、公共衛生和生物醫學上具有重要性，但其蠕蟲相（helminth fauna）所知仍十分有限。本研究提供了感染突尼斯南部沙奇鼠之蠕蟲寄生蟲的綜合名錄，並探討了寄生情況隨宿主性別、年齡、身體狀況和採樣地區而產生的變異。本研究於2023年9月至2026年3月間在塔馬格扎（Tamaghza）與傑貝勒達哈爾（Djebel Dahar）地區總共捕獲了152隻沙奇鼠標本。寄生學檢查揭示了四種蠕蟲物種：三種絛蟲（沙奇沙奇絛蟲 *Gerbillitaenia psammomi*、埃及蘇達里科娃絛蟲 *Sudarikovina aegyptica*、中殖孔絛蟲屬 *Mesocestoides* sp. 幼蟲）以及一種線蟲（小毛線蟲屬 *Syphacia* sp.）。牠們各自的盛行率分別為63.8%、12.5%、0.7%和16.4%。本文對這些物種進行了形態學描述，並提供了 *Syphacia* sp. 的基因數據與親緣演化樹。中殖孔絛蟲屬與 *Syphacia* sp. 的發現代表了沙奇鼠的新紀錄；此外，埃及蘇達里科娃絛蟲亦構成了突尼斯的新紀錄。宿主年齡和採樣地區顯著影響了 *G. psammomi* 的出現率與豐度，成鼠比幼鼠更有可能受到感染，且帶有的寄生蟲負荷顯著較高。相較之下，宿主性別或身體狀況與寄生蟲的出現率或豐度皆無顯著關聯。對於埃及蘇達里科娃絛蟲與 *Syphacia* sp. 而言，其寄生蟲的出現率或豐度與宿主的性別、年齡或身體狀況之間亦未發現顯著關聯。

papers.title: The Importance of Alpaca Welfare in Human–Animal Interaction
papers.abstract: Human–animal interaction is considered one of the key determinants not only of animal welfare but also of the safety and ease of contact with humans. The aim of this paper is to review current knowledge on tools of assessment and improvement in human–animal interaction from an alpaca welfare perspective. Because alpaca-specific evidence is limited, the scientific evidence for some of the mechanisms and management strategies discussed is derived from other camelids or other animal species rather than directly from alpacas. Various factors affect the HAI quality, including early human contact, husbandry and veterinary procedures, handling, and training, as well as genetically influenced traits such as temperament variations. The methods used to evaluate the quality of HAI in alpacas mainly included three types of assessment tools: behaviour observation, measuring physiological parameters, and using questionnaires. Tools used to improve the quality of HAI in alpacas can include various techniques based on animal behaviour and learning knowledge, such as socialisation, desensitisation and operant conditioning. Considering human–animal interactions in alpaca husbandry (animals kept for fibre production, animal-assisted interventions or recreational activities) is crucial because it can ensure animal well-being, human safety and production/intervention effectiveness. Negative human–animal interactions can impair alpaca welfare through fear and stress as underlying mechanisms; however, practical applications (proper socialisation, handling, training) to achieve positive HAI and a positive perception of humans by alpacas could be better recognised and used, thereby benefiting their welfare.
papers.abstract_zh: 人與動物互動被認為不僅是動物福利的關鍵決定因素之一，也是確保人類安全及接觸便利性的關鍵。本文旨在從羊駝福利的角度，回顧目前關於人與動物互動評估與改善工具的知識。由於針對羊駝的證據有限，本文討論的部分機制與管理策略之科學證據，並非直接來自羊駝，而是衍生自其他駱駝科動物或其他動物物種。影響人與動物互動品質的因素多元，包含早期人類接觸、飼養與獸醫處置、保定與訓練，以及受基因影響的特性（如氣質差異）。評估羊駝人與動物互動品質的方法主要包含三種評估工具：行為觀察、生理參數測量以及問卷調查。用於改善羊駝人與動物互動品質的工具，可包含基於動物行為與學習知識的各種技術，例如社會化、減敏感及操作制約。在羊駝飼養（為了毛纖維生產、動物輔助介入或休閒活動而飼養的動物）中考量人與動物互動至關重要，因為它能確保動物福祉、人類安全以及生產／介入的成效。負面的人與動物互動會透過恐懼與壓力等潛在機制損害羊駝福利；然而，為了達成正向人與動物互動及羊駝對人類的正向感知，其實務應用（適當的社會化、保定、訓練）應獲得更多的認識與應用，進而造福其福利。

papers.title: Polypropylene Mesh-Augmented Soft-Tissue Reconstruction for Presumed Traumatic Lateral Patellar Luxation in an Adult Pony: A Case Report
papers.abstract: Patellar luxation is uncommon in horses, and traumatic lateral luxation in adult equids has rarely been reported. A 3-year-old, 75 kg female Shetland pony presented with severe right hindlimb lameness and minimal weight bearing approximately 2 weeks after a suspected traumatic event. The right patella was fixed lateral to the femoral trochlea and could not be manually reduced during conscious examination. Radiographs confirmed lateral patellar luxation without apparent osseous deformity. Following general anesthesia and surgical exposure, the patella was manually reduced. Treatment comprised lateral retinacular and fascial release, medial capsular imbrication and extra-articular polypropylene mesh augmentation. No osseous corrective procedure was performed. Radiographs obtained 2 days postoperatively confirmed maintenance of reduction. Partial weight bearing was observed approximately 10 days after surgery. No surgical site complications were observed during hospitalization, and the pony was discharged on postoperative day 12. At telephone follow-up 37 days after surgery, the owner reported that the pony was walking more frequently. An owner-provided video recorded on postoperative day 130 showed no overt lameness during walking; trotting was not assessed, and no further clinical examination or radiography was performed. Mesh-augmented soft-tissue reconstruction was technically feasible in this adult pony, although objective follow-up remained limited.
papers.abstract_zh: 髕骨脫位在馬匹中並不常見，而成馬之外傷性外側脫位則鮮有報導。一隻 3 歲、體重 75 公斤的雌性設特蘭小馬在疑似外傷事件發生約 2 週後就診，表現出嚴重的右後肢跛行且幾乎無法負重。右側髕骨固定於股骨滑車的外側，在清醒狀態下檢查時無法透過徒手復位。X光檢查確診為外側髕骨脫位，且無明顯的骨骼畸形。在全身麻醉與手術顯露後，將髕骨徒手復位。治療包括外側支持帶與筋膜切開、內側關節囊重疊縫合以及關節外聚丙烯網片強化。未進行任何骨骼矯正手術。術後 2 天取得的 X 光片確認維持復位狀態。術後約 10 天觀察到部分負重。住院期間未觀察到手術部位併發症，小馬於術後第 12 天出院。在術後 37 天的電話追蹤中，飼主表示小馬行走頻率增加。飼主提供於術後第 130 天拍攝的影片顯示，行走時無明顯跛行；未評估慢跑，亦未進行進一步的臨床檢查或X光攝影。網片強化的軟組織重建在此成年小馬身上在技術上是可行的，儘管客觀追蹤仍有限。

papers.title: Comparison of Dorsal Quadratus Lumborum and Rectus Sheath Blocks for Canine Ovariectomy: A Randomised Clinical Trial
papers.abstract: This study aimed to compare the analgesic properties of the dorsal quadratus lumborum block (QLB) and the rectus sheath block (RSB) as part of a multimodal analgesic protocol in female dogs undergoing ovariectomy. A total of 57 dogs were included in the study. They were randomly divided into three groups: QLB, RSB or control. All the animals were premedicated with dexmedetomidine 0.125 mg m−2 and methadone 0.1 mg kg−1, induced with propofol and maintained with isoflurane. The blocks were performed using 0.4 mL kg−1 per hemiabdomen of bupivacaine 0.25%. In the intraoperative period, when the heart rate, mean arterial pressure or respiratory rate increased ≥ 20% from baseline, fentanyl 0.002 mg kg−1 was administered as rescue analgesia. During the early postoperative period, pain was assessed using the short form of the Glasgow Composite Pain Scale (GCPS-SF). Methadone 0.2 mg kg−1 was administered if GCPS-SF scores were ≥6/24 as rescue analgesia. No differences were found in fentanyl doses between groups (p = 0.4406). However, a clinically significant reduction of postoperative methadone rescue doses was found in the QLB group compared to the control group (26,32% absolute risk difference, with a 95% confidence interval of 6.64% to 49.10%), but not between QLB-RSB or RSB-control groups. In conclusion, dorsal QLB reduced early postoperative rescue analgesia requirements when included in a multimodal analgesic protocol in female dogs undergoing ovariectomy.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在比較背側腰方肌阻滯（QLB）與腹直肌鞘阻滯（RSB）作為母犬卵巢切除術多模式鎮痛方案一部分的鎮痛特性。本研究共納入 57 隻犬，隨機分為三組：QLB 組、RSB 組或對照組。所有動物均給予術前給藥右美托咪定 0.125 mg m−2 和美沙酮 0.1 mg kg−1，以異丙酚進行麻醉誘導，並以異氟醚維持麻醉。神經阻滯使用 0.25% 布比卡因，劑量為每側腹壁 0.4 mL kg−1。在術中期間，當心率、平均動脈壓或呼吸速率較基準值增加 ≥ 20% 時，給予芬太尼 0.002 mg kg−1 作為救援鎮痛。在術後早期，使用格拉斯哥複合式疼痛量表簡表（GCPS-SF）進行疼痛評估。若 GCPS-SF 分數 ≥ 6/24，則給予美沙酮 0.2 mg kg−1 作為救援鎮痛。各組之間的芬太尼劑量無顯著差異（p = 0.4406）。然而，與對照組相比，QLB 組的術後美沙酮救援劑量出現具臨床意義的減少（絕對風險差為 26.32%，95% 信賴區間為 6.64% 至 49.10%），但 QLB 與 RSB 組之間或 RSB 與對照組之間則無此差異。總結而言，當背側腰方肌阻滯納入接受卵巢切除術母犬的多模式鎮痛方案中時，可減少術後早期的救援鎮痛需求。

papers.title: Improving Explosive Detection Dog Performance in Sealed Parcel Searches Through a Targeted Training Intervention
papers.abstract: Explosive detection dogs are routinely deployed for parcel screening, yet realistic sealed-parcel searches may present challenges not captured by conventional odor-recognition training. In 2025, a black box study of ANSI/ASB Standard 092 identified substantially reduced detection of explosives in tape-sealed parcels, suggesting a potential training gap in this search scenario. This follow-on study evaluated whether brief, progressive training could improve dog performance in sealed-parcel searches. Thirteen operational dog teams participated in trials conducted in Lubbock, Texas, and Miami, Florida. Teams completed a baseline assessment using tape-sealed parcels containing 50 g of C4 or TNT, or distractors, followed by an odor recognition test (ORT) using controlled explosive odor presentations. Following the correction of identified odor-recognition deficiencies, teams completed a training intervention manipulating odor availability through variable parcel venting and requiring progression from odor-source recognition to trained final response. Performance was reassessed using the same parcel configuration. All teams detected C4 during the ORT, whereas only two teams detected TNT. Following intervention, overall sealed-parcel detection sensitivity increased by 35 percentage points (p = 0.0078). C4 detection increased from 38% to 69%, while TNT detection increased from 15% to 54%, although neither individual change reached statistical significance. The results demonstrate that odor recognition does not necessarily translate to effective source localization in sealed parcels and support progressive, operationally representative parcel-search training.
papers.abstract_zh: 偵測爆裂物犬經常被部署用於郵包安檢，然而實際的密封郵包搜索可能會面臨傳統氣味識別訓練所未能涵蓋的挑戰。2025年的一項針對 ANSI/ASB 標準 092 的黑箱研究指出，犬隻對膠帶密封郵包中爆裂物的檢出率顯著降低，這暗示了在此類搜索情境中可能存在訓練上的落差。這項後續研究評估了簡短且漸進式的訓練是否能提升犬隻在密封郵包搜索中的表現。十三組現役工作犬隊參與了在德州拉巴克與佛州邁阿密進行的試驗。各犬隊先使用裝有 50 克 C4、TNT 或干擾物的膠帶密封郵包完成基準評估，隨後使用控制的爆裂物氣味呈現進行氣味識別測試（ORT）。在修正所識別出的氣味識別缺陷後，各犬隊完成了一項訓練介入措施，該措施透過可變的郵包通風來操縱氣味的可及性，並要求從氣味源識別進展至受過訓練的最終反應。隨後使用相同的郵包配置重新評估其表現。所有犬隊在 ORT 期間皆檢出 C4，但僅有兩隊檢出 TNT。在介入措施實施後，整體的密封郵包檢出靈敏度提高了 35 個百分點（p = 0.0078）。C4 檢出率從 38% 提升至 69%，而 TNT 檢出率從 15% 提升至 54%，儘管這兩項個別的變化均未達到統計顯著性。研究結果表明，氣味識別不一定能轉化為密封郵包中有效的氣源定位，並支持進行漸進且具實務代表性的郵包搜索訓練。

papers.title: In Vitro Evaluation of Protected Black Soldier Fly Larvae (Hermetia illucens), Palm Oil, and Rice Bran Oil on Rumen Fermentation and Degradability
papers.abstract: This study evaluated the effects of protected and non-protected black soldier fly larvae oil (BSFLO), palm oil (PO), and rice bran oil (RBO) on ruminal fermentation characteristics and nutrient digestibility using an in vitro gas production technique. A completely randomized design with a 3 × 3 + 1 factorial arrangement was employed, consisting of three oil sources, three oil forms (non-protected, calcium soap, and potassium soap) supplemented at 4% of dry matter, and a control without oil. The results showed that oil supplementation without the basal diet reduced total volatile fatty acid (TVFA) production and ammonia nitrogen (NH3-N) concentration at 24 h, indicating an inhibitory effect of free fatty acids on rumen microorganisms. With the basal diet, TVFA concentrations at 24 h were higher in oil-supplemented treatments compared to the control. Specifically, protected BSFLO in both Ca-soap and K-soap forms showed the numerically highest TVFA concentrations (127.02 and 125.87 mmol, respectively), although these did not differ significantly from those of RBO Ca-soap and K-soap; BSFLO K-soap had a lower TVFA concentration than the control at 48 h. Oil supplementation significantly modified VFA profiles by decreasing the proportion of acetic acid, increasing propionic acid, and consequently lowering the acetate-to-propionate ratio. Ruminal pH was not affected by oil supplementation. While in vitro dry matter degradability was lower in the oil-supplemented treatments than in the control, IVDMD did not show differences between non-protected oil and protected oil treatments. Abomasal simulated digestion was not adversely affected by oil source or protection form. In conclusion, in the presence of a basal diet, BSFLO in Ca-soap and K-soap forms increased TVFA at 24 h, and BSFLO in all forms increased propionate proportions, without compromising rumen stability or abomasal simulated digestion under the conditions tested. These in vitro results indicate protected BSFLO’s potential as a lipid source in ruminant diets and warrant in vivo confirmation.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究利用體外產氣法，評估受保護與未受保護之黑水虻幼蟲油（BSFLO）、棕櫚油（PO）及米糠油（RBO）對瘤胃醱酵特性與養分消化率的影響。採用 3 × 3 + 1 因子排列之完全逢機設計，包含三種油脂來源、三種油脂型態（未受保護、鈣皂及鉀皂，添加量為乾物質的 4%），以及無油脂之對照組。結果顯示，在無基礎日糧的情況下補充油脂，會降低 24 小時的總揮發性脂肪酸（TVFA）產量與氨態氮（NH3-N）濃度，顯示游離脂肪酸對瘤胃微生物具有抑制作用。在有基礎日糧的情況下，油脂補充組在 24 小時的 TVFA 濃度高於對照組。具體而言，鈣皂與鉀皂形式的受保護 BSFLO 其 TVFA 濃度在數值上最高（分別為 127.02 與 125.87 mmol），但與 RBO 鈣皂和鉀皂無顯著差異；在 48 小時時，BSFLO 鉀皂的 TVFA 濃度低於對照組。補充油脂透過降低乙酸比例、增加丙酸比例，進而降低乙酸與丙酸比值，顯著改變了揮發性脂肪酸（VFA）組成。瘤胃 pH 值則不受油脂補充的影響。雖然體外乾物質分解率（IVDMD）在油脂補充組中低於對照組，但未受保護油與受保護油處理組之間的 IVDMD 並無差異。皺胃模擬消化則不受油脂來源或保護形式的不良影響。總結來說，在有基礎日糧的條件下，鈣皂與鉀皂形式的 BSFLO 增加了 24 小時的 TVFA，且所有形式的 BSFLO 皆增加了丙酸比例，在測試條件下並未損及瘤胃穩定性或皺胃模擬消化。這些體外試驗結果顯示，受保護的 BSFLO 具有作為反芻動物日糧脂質來源的潛力，尚需進行活體（in vivo）試驗以進一步確認。

papers.title: Computed Tomography Features of Canine Mammary Tumours: A Retrospective Multicentre Study
papers.abstract: Mammary tumours are among the most common neoplastic disorders in female dogs, and although computed tomography (CT) is widely used for oncological staging, CT evaluation of primary mammary tumours remains relatively underexplored. This multicentre retrospective study aimed to develop a standardised CT reporting protocol using a modified BI-RADS™ lexicon and to evaluate the qualitative and quantitative features associated with malignancy. Pre- and post-contrast CT scans were evaluated for 34 female dogs with 106 histologically confirmed mammary tumours, of which 81 were malignant and 25 were benign. The heterogeneous and rim enhancement patterns were strongly associated with malignant lesions (p < 0.001; 88.9% sensitivity, 40% specificity). Perilesional oedema exhibited high specificity (84%) but low sensitivity (33.3%). A tumour volume >1.90 cm3 was significantly associated with malignancy (p = 0.046). The proposed cumulative scoring system (0–4 points) showed an AUC of 0.711. After accounting for within-dog clustering, the dichotomous high-risk classification (score ≥ 2) remained significantly associated with malignancy (OR = 1.70; 95% CI: 1.11–2.58; p = 0.014). Tumours classified as high-risk (score ≥ 2) showed an 84.2% observed proportion of malignancy, with 82.7% sensitivity and 58% specificity. This CT-based protocol could help to standardise reporting and identify tumours with a higher risk of malignancy.
papers.abstract_zh: 乳腺腫瘍是母犬最常見的腫瘤性疾病之一，儘管電腦斷層掃描（CT）已被廣泛用於腫瘤分期，但對原發性乳腺腫瘍的CT評估仍相對缺乏深入研究。本多中心回顧性研究旨在利用修改版的BI-RADS™詞彙表開發標準化的CT報告協議，並評估與惡性腫瘤相關的定性和定量特徵。本研究評估了34隻母犬共106個經組織學確診的乳腺腫瘍之注射對比劑前後的CT掃描，其中81個為惡性，25個為良性。不均勻顯影與環形顯影模式與惡性病灶具有強烈相關性（p < 0.001；敏感度為88.9%，特異度為40%）。病灶周圍水腫表現出高特異度（84%），但敏感度較低（33.3%）。腫瘤體積大於1.90 cm3與惡性顯著相關（p = 0.046）。所提出的累積評分系統（0–4分）顯示其曲線下面積（AUC）為0.711。在考量犬隻內部的群聚效應後，二分法高風險分類（評分 ≥ 2）與惡性腫瘤仍顯著相關（勝算比 = 1.70；95% 信賴區間：1.11–2.58；p = 0.014）。被歸類為高風險（評分 ≥ 2）的腫瘤顯示出84.2%的惡性觀察比例，其敏感度為82.7%，特異度為58%。這項基於CT的協議有助於標準化報告，並識別出具有較高惡性風險的腫瘤。

papers.title: Utility of Bartonella henselae Recombinant Proteins ATP-β and GroEL for Serodiagnosis of Feline Bartonellosis
papers.abstract: Bartonella species are small, fastidious, Gram-negative intracellular bacteria that are capable of infecting a wide range of mammals, including cats, dogs and humans. Diagnoses of canine, feline, and human bartonellosis by culture, molecular, and serological assays remains challenging. Accurate serodiagnosis of feline bartonellosis is of clinical, epidemiological and zoonotic importance. The utility of Bartonella henselae (Bh) ATP-β, ATP synthase beta subunit, and GroEL, a chaperonin protein, has not previously been reported for diagnosis of feline bartonellosis. The objective of this study was to assess the diagnostic utility of Bh recombinant proteins ATP-β and GroEL using sera samples from Group I: four cats experimentally inoculated with Bh or saline (n = 24); Group II: 34 cats naturally infected with Bh (n = 34); Group III: 33 Bartonella spp. qPCR-negative and IFA-negative control cats (n = 33), and Group IV: 16 Mycoplasma haemofelis qPCR-positive cats (n = 16). Based on the Bh rATP-β, rGroEL, and rATP-β plus rGroEL ELISA results, rGroEL yielded the highest area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.84 (95% CI 0.74–0.94), followed by rATP-β plus rGroEL with an AUC of 0.77 (95% CI 0.65–0.89). The sensitivity and specificity of rGroEL were 50% (95% CI 34–66%) and 91% (95% CI 76–97%), respectively, at an OD cutoff value of 0.1, whereas the sensitivity and specificity of rATP-β plus rGroEL ELISA (combination of rATP-β and rGroEL) were 71% (95% CI 54–83%) and 85% (95% CI 69–93%), respectively, at an OD cutoff value of 0.17. Overall agreement between Bh IFA and rGroEL-based ELISA was 70% (95% CI 58–80%), and overall agreement between Bh IFA and rATP-β plus rGroEL-based ELISA was 78% (95% CI 66–86%). The rATP-β-based ELISA had a poorer AUC (0.61 (95% CI 0.47–0.75)), indicating limited clinical utility for the serodiagnosis of Bh infection in cats. These findings suggest that rGroEL and rATP-β plus rGroEL may serve as reliable ELISA antigens for serodiagnosis of Bartonella infection in cats. Limitations of this study include the small sample size, the moderate sensitivity of ELISA, and its incomplete agreement with Bh IFA and PCR results. Future epitope mapping and bioinformatic screening of the antigenic regions of rATP-β and rGroEL may facilitate the development of a faster, more practical, and more cost-effective alternative to the labor-intensive reference IFA for the serodiagnosis of feline bartonellosis.
papers.abstract_zh: 巴爾頓氏菌屬（Bartonella species）為小型、生長挑剔的革蘭氏陰性細胞內細菌，能夠感染包括貓、狗和人類在內的廣泛哺乳動物。利用培養、分子生物學及血清學檢測來診斷犬、貓和人類的巴爾頓氏菌症仍然深具挑戰性。精準血清學診斷貓巴爾頓氏菌症在臨床、流行病學及人畜共通傳染病學上皆具有重要意義。此前尚未有文獻報導利用韓氏巴爾頓氏菌（Bartonella henselae, Bh）的 ATP-β（ATP合成酶β次單元）及 GroEL（伴護蛋白）來診斷貓巴爾頓氏菌症。本研究旨在評估 Bh 重組蛋白質 ATP-β 與 GroEL 用於血清樣品的診斷效用，樣品來源包括：第一組：四隻經實驗接種 Bh 或生理食鹽水的貓（n = 24）；第二組：34 隻自然感染 Bh 的貓（n = 34）；第三組：33 隻巴爾頓氏菌屬 qPCR 陰性及 IFA 陰性的對照貓（n = 33）；第四組：16 隻血紅素巴東蟲（Mycoplasma haemofelis）qPCR 陽性的貓（n = 16）。根據 Bh rATP-β、rGroEL 以及 rATP-β 加 rGroEL 的 ELISA 結果，rGroEL 產生成效接收者操作特徵曲線下面積（AUC）最高，達 0.84（95% CI 0.74–0.94），其次為 rATP-β 加 rGroEL，AUC 為 0.77（95% CI 0.65–0.89）。在光密度（OD）截斷值為 0.1 時，rGroEL 的敏感度與特異度分別為 50%（95% CI 34–66%）及 91%（95% CI 76–97%）；而在 OD 截斷值為 0.17 時，rATP-β 加 rGroEL ELISA（rATP-β 與 rGroEL 之組合）的敏感度與特異度則分別為 71%（95% CI 54–83%）及 85%（95% CI 69–93%）。Bh IFA 與基於 rGroEL 的 ELISA 之整體一致性為 70%（95% CI 58–80%），而 Bh IFA 與基於 rATP-β 加 rGroEL 的 ELISA 之整體一致性則為 78%（95% CI 66–86%）。基於 rATP-β 的 ELISA 之 AUC 較差（0.61 [95% CI 0.47–0.75]），顯示其在貓 Bh 感染的血清學診斷上臨床效用有限。這些發現表明，rGroEL 以及 rATP-β 加 rGroEL 可作為貓巴爾頓氏菌感染血清學診斷之可靠 ELISA 抗原。本研究的限制包括樣本數較小、ELISA 的敏感度中等，以及其與 Bh IFA 和 PCR 結果的一致性未臻完全。未來對 rATP-β 和 rGroEL 的抗原區域進行表位繪製與生物資訊學篩檢，可能有助於開發出相較於繁勞之參考用 IFA 更快速、更實用且更具成本效益的替代方案，以用於貓巴爾頓氏菌症的血清學診斷。

papers.title: Population Dynamics and Conservation Implications of the Naturally Rewilded Milu Deer in Dongting Lake
papers.abstract: Population dynamic analysis provides a scientific basis for endangered species conservation strategies. The Milu deer (Elaphurus davidianus), endemic to China and once classified as Extinct in the Wild by the IUCN, has become one of the world’s most successful endangered species reintroduction cases since 1985. After naturally dispersing to Dongting Lake in 1998, the species established the world’s only naturally rewilded population, which was further expanded and genetically optimized via artificial population supplementation. Focusing on this naturally rewilded population, this study used 20 years of synchronous survey data (2006–2025) to estimate model parameters via Bayesian inference and nonlinear least squares (NLS). We developed exponential and logistic growth models, analyzed the population’s dynamic characteristics and their influencing factors, simulated growth trends under scenarios with and without population supplementation, and explored the relationships between hydrological factors and population size. The results showed that the population increased from 27 to 400 individuals with an average annual growth rate of 0.16 ± 0.03, with the fitted models indicating that rapid growth is likely to continue in the near term; a total of 26 individuals released in 2016 and 2020 for population supplementation exerted a significant promoting effect on population recovery; flood-season hydrological fluctuations had a significant negative impact on the population, which could be effectively alleviated by targeted conservation measures; the combination of the two methods significantly improved the accuracy and reliability of parameter estimation. In summary, the Milu deer population in Dongting Lake has been successfully reconstructed under the synergistic effect of natural adaptation and targeted conservation measures. This study provides a case reference for the rewilding and recovery of endangered large ungulates in wetland ecosystems, and also serves as a typical successful example for implementing nature-based solutions to protect endangered species and biodiversity.
papers.abstract_zh: 族群動態分析為瀕危物種保育策略提供了科學依據。麋鹿（Elaphurus davidianus）為中國特有物種，曾被世界自然保護聯盟（IUCN）評估為野外滅絕，自1985年起成為全球最成功的瀕危物種再引入案例之一。該物種於1998年自然擴散至洞庭湖後，建立了全球唯一的自然野化族群，並透過人工族群補充進一步擴大與進行遺傳優化。本研究聚焦於此一自然野化族群，利用20年的同步調查數據（2006–2025年），透過貝氏推論與非線性最小平方法（NLS）來估算模型參數。我們建立了指數與邏輯斯生長模型，分析族群動態特徵及其影響因素，模擬有無族群補充情境下的生長趨勢，並探討水文因子與族群大小之間的關係。結果顯示，該族群個體數從27隻增加至400隻，平均年增長率為0.16 ± 0.03，擬合模型顯示其近期內極可能持續快速增長；2016年與2020年為進行族群補充而野放的總計26隻個體，對族群恢復產生了顯著的促進作用；汛期水文波動對族群具有顯著負面影響，透過針對性的保育措施可獲得有效緩解；這兩種方法的結合顯著提高了參數估算的準確性與可靠性。綜上所述，洞庭湖的麋鹿族群在自然適應與精準保育措施的協同作用下已成功重建。本研究為濕地生態系統中瀕危大型有蹄類動物的野化與恢復提供了案例參考，亦為實踐基於自然的解決方案以保護瀕危物種和生物多樣性樹立了典型的成功範例。

papers.title: Associations of Age and Season at First Calving with First-Lactation Curve Shape in Mediterranean Buffaloes
papers.abstract: This study investigated the effects of age at first calving (AFC), calving season and their interaction on first-lactation curves in Italian Mediterranean buffaloes. Test-day milk yield records collected from 2013 to 2023 were fitted using the Wood model. After excluding atypical curves (22.2%) and data editing, the final dataset comprised 46,289 first lactations and 332,333 test-day records. Generalized and linear mixed models assessed Wood parameters, peak milk yield (Milkpeak), days to peak (DIMpeak), and 270-day milk yield (MY270). AFC significantly affected a, c (p < 0.01), Milkpeak and MY270 (p < 0.001), with a, Milkpeak, and MY270 increasing consistently with AFC, whereas c followed a different pattern. Calving season affected all traits (p < 0.001): a, Milkpeak, and MY270 were lower in summer and autumn, while b and DIMpeak were higher in summer and c in winter. The interaction between AFC class and calving season was significant for all variables (p < 0.001, except b and c, p < 0.05; DIMpeak p < 0.01) except a (p = 0.460). At AFC ≤ 30 months, summer-calving buffaloes had lower MY270 and Milkpeak but higher DIMpeak, b and c than spring-calving buffaloes. Year affected all traits (p < 0.001), with values increasing until 2021 before slightly declining. These results indicate that AFC influences the productive level of primiparous animals that exhibit typical lactation curves, while calving season affects both lactation dynamics and production, thus helping farmers optimize first-calving timing.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究探討初產年齡（AFC）、分娩季節及其交互作用對義大利地中海水牛初產泌乳曲線的影響。本研究使用 2013 年至 2023 年收集的定期檢定日產乳量記錄，並以 Wood 模型進行擬合。排除非典型曲線（22.2%）與資料修飾後，最終資料集包含 46,289 個初產泌乳期及 332,333 筆檢定日記錄。本研究利用廣義與線性混合模型評估 Wood 模型參數、產乳量高峰（Milkpeak）、達到高峰天數（DIMpeak）以及 270 日產乳量（MY270）。AFC 顯著影響 $a$、$c$ 參數（$p < 0.01$）、Milkpeak 與 MY270（$p < 0.001$），其中 $a$、Milkpeak 與 MY270 隨著 AFC 增加而持續上升，而 $c$ 則呈現不同的模式。分娩季節影響所有性狀（$p < 0.001$）：夏季與秋季的 $a$、Milkpeak 和 MY270 較低，而夏季的 $b$ 與 DIMpeak 較高，冬季的 $c$ 較高。除 $a$ 參數外（$p = 0.460$），AFC 分級與分娩季節的交互作用對所有變數皆具顯著影響（$p < 0.001$，除 $b$ 與 $c$ 為 $p < 0.05$；DIMpeak 為 $p < 0.01$）。當 $\text{AFC} \le 30$ 個月時，夏季分娩的水牛其 MY270 與 Milkpeak 較低，但 DIMpeak、$b$ 與 $c$ 則高於春季分娩的水牛。年份會影響所有性狀（$p < 0.001$），其數值在 2021 年前持續上升，隨後略有下降。這些結果顯示，AFC 會影響表現出典型泌乳曲線的初產動物之生產水準，而分娩季節則同時影響泌乳動態與產量，進而協助農民優化初產時機。

papers.title: Cat Predation on Bats in an Urban Landscape of Eastern Europe: Twelve Years of Rescue-Centre Records
papers.abstract: Predation by domestic cats is a recognised but poorly quantified threat to bats, and Eastern Europe is almost absent from the evidence. We analysed twelve years (2013–2024) of records of the Ukrainian Bat Rehabilitation Centre, 41,910 bats of 15 species from 258 settlements, to estimate how often a cat was implicated in a find. Among the 4770 bats received in finds of four individuals or fewer, 1.59% (95% CI 1.27–1.99) were cat-related, with no trend over the years. The odds of a cat-related case were four to five times higher for Eptesicus serotinus and Vespertilio murinus than for Nyctalus noctula, and in the activity season seven to ten times higher for these two species and for Pipistrellus kuhlii. The male excess among E. serotinus victims matched the sex composition of the bats received, and age had no effect. Cat attacks were fatal for 54% of the bats concerned, but not more often than injuries of other origin. In one building in Kharkiv, by contrast, cats established inside killed 14.8% of the 1099 bats collected in a single winter, and predation fell to the background level after the cats were killed and the crevices sealed. Cat predation on urban bats thus operates in two regimes, a dispersed background at a stable low rate and localised roost-scale events governed by access, which call for different measures.
papers.abstract_zh: 家貓掠食是對蝙蝠已知但量化不足的威脅，而東歐幾乎完全缺乏相關證據。我們分析了烏克蘭蝙蝠復育中心長達十二年（2013–2024年）的紀錄，涵蓋來自258個聚落、15個物種共41,910隻蝙蝠，以評估貓與蝙蝠被發現事件的關聯頻率。在收容數量為4隻或以下的4,770隻蝙蝠中，有1.59%（95%信賴區間為1.27–1.99）與貓有關，且歷年來無明顯趨勢。生番蝠（*Eptesicus serotinus*）和雙色蝙蝠（*Vespertilio murinus*）遭遇貓相關事件的勝算比（odds）是大水鼠耳蝠（*Nyctalus noctula*）的四到五倍；而在活動季節，這兩種蝙蝠及庫氏伏翼（*Pipistrellus kuhlii*）的勝算比則高出七到十倍。生番蝠受害者中雄性過多之現象，符合所收容蝙蝠的性別組成，且年齡無顯著影響。貓的攻擊導致54%的受害蝙蝠死亡，但其致死率並不高於其他原因造成的傷害。相比之下，在哈爾科夫的一棟建築中，棲息於內部的貓在單一冬季殺死了所收集1,099隻蝙蝠中的14.8%，而在將貓撲殺並封堵縫隙後，掠食率降至背景值。因此，貓對都市蝙蝠的掠食呈現兩種模式：維持在穩定低率的分散式背景掠食，以及由接觸機會決定的局部棲息地規模事件，這兩者需要採取不同的應對措施。

papers.title: The Use of a Detection Dog to Discriminate Between Moss Species to Increase Coverage for Reporting the Presence of a Cryptic Species
papers.abstract: There has been a rise in the use of conservation detection dogs (CDDs); however, they are yet to be noted in science for bryophyte detection. If implemented effectively, this method could have a significant positive impact, particularly due to the need for specialists in the identification of these species. This study aims to determine whether a CDD can be imprinted on a moss species, specifically Hamatocaulis vernicosus, the slender green feather-moss, and used to increase survey coverage in Northern Ireland. To test the capability of the dog on this new odour, a lab-based discrimination trial involving double-blind line-ups was conducted, including moss species that occur in similar habitats and are closely related to H. vernicosus. After the discrimination trial, the dog completed field trials in an area where the species is known to be present. Results show that the dog had 100% accuracy when completing the discrimination trial, showing the dog’s ability to discriminate between the target moss and other moss species used. During the field trial, an indication and positive confirmation of species were achieved within 1 min 34 s of searching. CDDs are clearly on the way to becoming a useful tool in bryophyte projects or projects focussing on other Habitats Regulations Reporting-annexed species, particularly those that are cryptic and time-consuming to survey.
papers.abstract_zh: 保育探測犬（CDD）的使用日益增加，然而其在苔蘚植物偵測方面的應用尚未見於科學文獻。若能有效實施此方法，將能產生顯著的正面影響，特別是因為極需這類物種的鑑定專家。本研究旨在探討是否能訓練保育探測犬辨識特定苔蘚物種——光葉沼苔（*Hamatocaulis vernicosus*），並將其用於增加北愛爾蘭的調查涵蓋範圍。為了測試犬隻對此新氣味的辨識能力，本研究進行了一項基於實驗室的雙盲排隊辨識試驗，其中包含了與光葉沼苔親緣關係相近且生長於相似棲地的苔蘚物種。在辨識試驗結束後，該犬隻在已知該物種存在的區域完成了實地試驗。結果顯示，該犬隻在完成辨識試驗時達到 100% 的準確度，展現出其在目標苔蘚與其他受試苔蘚物種之間進行區分的能力。在實地試驗期間，犬隻在開始搜尋後 1 分 34 秒內即完成物種的標示與正面確認。保育探測犬顯然正逐漸成為苔蘚植物專案，或是針對其他《棲地規範》附錄物種（特別是那些難以辨識且調查耗時的物種）專案中的有用工具。

papers.title: Molecular Characterization and Pathogen-Responsive Expression of Galectin-8 in Starry Flounder (Platichthys stellatus): Preliminary Assessment of Leukocyte ROS Responses
papers.abstract: Galectin-8 is a tandem-repeat member of the galectin family involved in cellular and immune-related processes in vertebrates, but its role in teleost fish remains poorly understood. In this study, galectin-8 (PsGal8) was identified and characterized in starry flounder, and its tissue distribution and expression following viral and bacterial challenges were investigated. The predicted PsGal8 protein contained two carbohydrate recognition domains connected by a linker peptide and possessed conserved carbohydrate-binding motifs characteristic of galectin-8. PsGal8 transcripts were detected in all examined tissues, with the highest expression in the trunk kidney. Following the viral hemorrhagic septicemia virus challenge, significant changes in PsGal8 expression were observed in the liver, intestine, and heart. The Streptococcus parauberis PH0710 challenge also modulated PsGal8 expression, with significant upregulation in the spleen, liver, brain, and intestine at 7 days post-infection. In an exploratory in vitro assay, peripheral blood leukocytes exposed to a recombinant PsGal8-containing preparation showed increased reactive oxygen species fluorescence at concentrations of 5 μg/mL and above. However, the preparation was not fully homogeneous, and its endotoxin content was not quantified. This observation should be considered preliminary. Overall, these findings provide molecular and transcriptional evidence that PsGal8 is responsive to viral and bacterial challenges in starry flounder.
papers.abstract_zh: 半乳糖凝集素-8（Galectin-8）是脊椎動物半乳糖凝集素家族中具串聯重複序列（tandem-repeat）的成員，參與細胞及免疫相關過程，但其在硬骨魚類中的角色仍所知有限。在本研究中，我們鑑定並特性化了星鰈（starry flounder）的半乳糖凝集素-8（PsGal8），並探討其組織分佈以及在病毒和細菌刺激後的表現量。預測的 PsGal8 蛋白質包含兩個由連接胜肽（linker peptide）相連的碳水化合物辨識域（carbohydrate recognition domains），並具有半乳糖凝集素-8特有的保守性碳水化合物結合基元。在所有檢測的組織中皆偵測到 PsGal8 轉錄本，其中以軀幹腎臟的表現量最高。在遭受病毒性出血性敗血症病毒（viral hemorrhagic septicemia virus）感染後，於肝臟、腸道和心臟中觀察到 PsGal8 表現量的顯著變化。副乳房鏈球菌（Streptococcus parauberis）PH0710 的感染亦調控了 PsGal8 的表現，在感染後第 7 天，脾臟、肝臟、大腦和腸道中的表現量呈現顯著上調。在探索性的體外（in vitro）試驗中，暴露於含重組 PsGal8 製劑的外周血白血球在濃度 5 μg/mL 及以上時，顯示出增加的活性氧物種（reactive oxygen species）螢光。然而，該製劑並非完全均質，且其內毒素含量未經定量。此觀察結果應被視為初步的。總體而言，這些發現提供了分子與轉錄層面的證據，表明星鰈的 PsGal8 對病毒和細菌刺激具有反應。

papers.title: Defining a Farmed Animal
papers.abstract: The categorisation of animals as ‘farmed’ determines whether they are included in statistical reporting and thereby the reported scale of animal agriculture. It also determines the degree of protection they are afforded under welfare legislation. However, the boundaries of this category have not been systematically examined. Definitions in law and practice vary across and within countries and are often based on arbitrary lists of taxonomic groups, intended uses, and production methods. Here, we critically explore the concept and identify the essential characteristics of a ‘farmed animal’ as one that: (1) is sustained and/or grown under human control; (2) is kept primarily to produce material goods; and (3) is kept primarily for profit, economic security, or sustenance. This definition supports consistency in a rapidly changing global farming system. However, we argue farmed status should not determine the level of welfare protection an animal receives: instead, welfare protections should reflect animals’ capacities for positive and negative experiences. Our definition provides legislators, researchers, and animal advocacy groups with a basis for revising and aligning their understanding of farmed animals, improving the visibility of excluded animals, and supporting collective action to improve their lives.
papers.abstract_zh: 將動物分類為「經濟動物」（farmed animal）決定了牠們是否會被納入統計報告中，從而決定了所報導之畜牧業規模。這也決定了牠們在福利法規下所能獲得的保護程度。然而，這類別的界限尚未經過系統性的檢視。法律與實務中的定義在各國之間及國內皆不盡相同，且通常基於對分類學群體、預期用途和生產方式的任意清單。在此，我們批判性地探討這個概念，並指出「經濟動物」的基本特徵為：(1) 在人類控制下維持生存及／或生長；(2) 主要為了生產物質商品而飼養；以及 (3) 主要為了利潤、經濟安全或生計而飼養。這一定義有助於在快速變遷的全球養殖系統中保持一致性。然而，我們主張，「經濟動物」的身分不應決定動物所獲得的福利保護水平：相反地，福利保護應反映動物體驗正向與負向經驗的能力。我們的定義為立法者、研究人員和動物權益倡議團體提供了基礎，以修正並統一他們對經濟動物的理解、提高被排除在外之動物的能見度，並支持改善牠們生活的集體行動。

papers.title: Pharmacokinetics of Sulfasalazine and the Temporal Profiles of Sulfapyridine and Its Metabolites Following Nasogastric Administration in Six Healthy Adult Horses
papers.abstract: Sulfasalazine is an azo-linked prodrug of sulfapyridine and 5-aminosalicylic acid that is activated by bacterial azoreductases in the distal gut. Its disposition has not been described in horses, in which extensive hindgut fermentation may influence prodrug activation. This study characterised the concentration-time profile of sulfasalazine and the appearance of sulfapyridine, 5-hydroxy-sulfapyridine and N4-acetyl-sulfapyridine after a single oral dose. Six healthy adult Warmblood horses received sulfasalazine (16 mg/kg) by nasogastric tube, and blood was sampled hourly for 14 h. Sulfasalazine and sulfapyridine were quantified by liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry; both metabolites were assessed semi-quantitatively as peak-area ratios. Sulfasalazine was measurable from 1 h and reached a median maximum concentration of 386.61 ng/mL (Q1–Q3 330.44–504.35) at a median of 5.5 h, then declined steeply. Sulfapyridine remained near the limit of detection for six hours, rose abruptly between 7 and 8 h and peaked at a median of 2794.00 ng/mL (2381.87–3146.14) at 9.0 h, approximately seven-fold above the parent-drug maximum. Both metabolites rose in parallel with sulfapyridine. This timing matches published equine orocaecal transit times, indicating that sulfasalazine reaches the hindgut largely intact and is activated there by microbial azoreduction. Systemic sulfapyridine exposure was substantial and should be considered in any therapeutic use.
papers.abstract_zh: Sulfasalazine 是一種偶氮鍵結的sulfapyridine與 5-aminosalicylic acid 前驅藥，可由遠端腸道中的細菌偶氮還原酶活化。其在馬體內的藥物處置尚未被描述，而在馬體內廣泛的後腸發酵可能會影響前驅藥的活化。本研究旨在特性化單次口服給藥後 sulfasalazine 的濃度-時間曲線，以及 sulfapyridine、5-hydroxy-sulfapyridine 和 N4-acetyl-sulfapyridine 的出現情形。六匹健康的成年溫血馬透過鼻胃管投予 sulfasalazine (16 mg/kg)，並在 14 小時內每小時採血。Sulfasalazine 與 sulfapyridine 以液相層析串聯質譜儀進行定量；兩種代謝物則以波峰面積比進行半定量評估。Sulfasalazine 自 1 小時起可被測得，在中位數 5.5 小時達到中位最高濃度 386.61 ng/mL（Q1–Q3 330.44–504.35），隨後急劇下降。Sulfapyridine 在 6 小時內維持於偵測極限附近，在 7 至 8 小時之間急遽上升，並於 9.0 小時達到中位數 2794.00 ng/mL（2381.87–3146.14）的最高濃度，約為主成分藥物最高值的七倍。兩種代謝物皆與 sulfapyridine 平行上升。此時間點與已發表的馬口盲腸通過時間相符，顯示 sulfasalazine 在很大程度上保持完整地到達後腸，並在該處透過微生物偶氮還原作用被活化。全身性 sulfapyridine 暴露量相當顯著，在任何治療應用中皆應納入考量。

papers.title: Opioid-Sparing Effect of an Ultrasound-Guided Transversus Abdominis Plane Block Added to a Multimodal Analgesic Protocol in Dogs with Acute Pancreatitis: A Matched-Control Pilot Study
papers.abstract: Acute pancreatitis in dogs causes severe abdominal pain, typically managed with systemic opioids, which can impair gastrointestinal motility and delay recovery. This prospective clinical communication evaluated the opioid-sparing effect and clinical outcomes of an ultrasound-guided transversus abdominis plane block added to a multimodal analgesic protocol in dogs with acute pancreatitis. Twelve dogs were allocated into a locoregional block group (n = 6) and a control group managed with opioids (n = 6), matched on five severity scores recorded at admission. The primary outcome was opioid consumption during the first 24 h after enrollment; secondary outcomes were pain during the same period, time to first voluntary food intake, hospitalization length, and inflammatory response. The block group received significantly fewer methadone doses (median 0 vs. 4.5; p = 0.015) and five of six dogs required no methadone beyond the enrollment dose. Cumulative pain scores during the first 24 h were also significantly lower in the block group (p = 0.037). The time to first voluntary food intake was shorter in the block group (12 vs. 48 h; p = 0.02). No significant differences were found in hospitalization length or survival. Adding a transversus abdominis plane block to a multimodal protocol was associated with a marked opioid-sparing effect and promoted earlier voluntary food intake, although these preliminary findings require confirmation in larger studies.
papers.abstract_zh: 犬隻急性胰臟炎會引起劇烈腹痛，通常以全身性類鴉片藥物治療，但此類藥物可能妨礙胃腸道蠕動並延遲復原。本前瞻性臨床通訊旨在評估超音波引導下腹橫肌平面阻斷術納入急性胰臟炎犬隻多模式止痛方案中的類鴉片藥物節省效果及臨床結果。12隻犬隻被分配至局部區域阻斷組（n = 6）與以類鴉片藥物治療的對照組（n = 6），兩組依入院時記錄的五項嚴重程度評分進行配對。主要評估指標為納入後最初24小時內的類鴉片藥物消耗量；次要評估指標包括同期疼痛情況、首次自主攝食時間、住院天數及發炎反應。阻斷組接受的美沙酮劑數顯著較少（中位數 0 比 4.5；p = 0.015），且6隻犬中有5隻在納入劑量後無需額外使用美沙酮。阻斷組在最初24小時內的累積疼痛評分也顯著較低（p = 0.037）。阻斷組的首次自主攝食時間較短（12比48小時；p = 0.02）。住院天數或存活率則無顯著差異。將腹橫肌平面阻斷術加入多模式方案中，與顯著的類鴉片藥物節省效果相關，並能促進較早的自主攝食，惟這些初步結果仍需大型研究進一步確認。
