papers.title: First Mitochondrial Genome of the Critically Endangered Madagascar Pochard (Aythya innotata)
papers.abstract: The Madagascar pochard (Aythya innotata) is one of the world’s rarest birds, with fewer than 50 mature individuals remaining in the wild. Despite its critically endangered status, genetic resources for this species remain extremely limited. In this study, we assembled and annotated the complete mitochondrial genome of A. innotata for the first time. The mitogenome is 16,620 bp in length and contains 13 protein-coding genes (PCGs), 22 transfer RNA genes, two ribosomal RNA genes, and a single control region. The overall nucleotide composition exhibits a significant AT bias (51.81%), with a positive AT-skew (0.14) and a negative GC-skew (–0.36), consistent with other Aythya species. Comparative analysis across eight Aythya species revealed highly conserved genomic features, including gene order, nucleotide composition, and codon usage patterns. Selection pressure analysis indicated that all PCGs have evolved under strong purifying selection (Ka/Ks < 1), with ND3 displaying the highest nucleotide diversity and ATP8 the lowest. Phylogenetic reconstruction based on 13 PCGs indicates that A. innotata, A. baeri, and A. nyroca were most closely related. This newly assembled mitogenome provides essential genetic information for conservation planning, population genetics, and evolutionary studies of this critically endangered species.
papers.abstract_zh: 馬達加斯加潛鴨（Aythya innotata）是世界上最稀有的鳥類之一，野外成熟個體不到50隻。儘管其保育狀況被列為極危，但該物種的遺傳資源仍然極為有限。在本研究中，我們首次組裝並註釋了馬達加斯加潛鴨的完整粒線體基因組。該粒線體基因組全長 16,620 bp，包含 13 個蛋白質編碼基因（PCGs）、22 個轉運核糖核酸基因、2 個核糖核酸基因以及 1 個控制區。整體核苷酸組成呈現顯著的 AT 偏好性（51.81%），具正向的 AT 偏斜（0.14）與負向的 GC 偏斜（–0.36），這與其他潛鴨屬（Aythya）物種一致。對 8 個潛鴨屬物種的比較分析顯示，其基因組特徵高度保守，包括基因順序、核苷酸組成及密碼子使用偏好。選擇壓力分析表明，所有蛋白質編碼基因均在強烈的純化選擇下演化（Ka/Ks < 1），其中 ND3 的核苷酸多樣性最高，ATP8 最低。基於 13 個蛋白質編碼基因重建的系統發生樹顯示，馬達加斯加潛鴨、貝氏潛鴨（A. baeri）和青頭潛鴨（A. nyroca）的親緣關係最近。這個新組裝的粒線體基因組為這個極危物種的保育規劃、族群遺傳學及演化研究提供了重要的遺傳資訊。

papers.title: Fatty Acid Composition and In Vitro Antioxidant, Anti-Inflammatory, and Antibacterial Properties of Unrefined Black Soldier Fly (Hermetia illucens) Larvae Oil
papers.abstract: Black soldier fly (Hermetia illucens) larvae are increasingly used as sustainable feed resources, and recent studies have expanded knowledge of their lipid fraction. This study characterized a single batch of mechanically extracted unrefined black soldier fly larvae oil (HIO), determining its fatty acid composition and assay-defined total phenolic and flavonoid contents (TPC and TFC) and evaluating its in vitro radical-scavenging activity, its effects on inflammatory mediators in LPS-stimulated RAW 264.7 macrophages, and the growth responses of five animal-associated bacterial pathogens. HIO contained 69.12% saturated fatty acids, with lauric acid accounting for 43.44% of the total fatty acids; the TPC and TFC were 2.96 ± 0.20 mg GAE/g and 1.00 ± 0.03 mg QE/g, and the ABTS and DPPH IC50 values were 3.89 ± 0.12% and 4.22 ± 0.21% (v/v), respectively. Within the non-cytotoxic range of 1.563–6.25% (v/v), HIO reduced nitric oxide and pro-inflammatory cytokine production. HIO also reduced bacterial growth in all five strains, with no growth detectable by absorbance at 6.25–12.5% (v/v) depending on the species; these endpoints were not confirmed by viable counts. Exploratory correlation analysis showed concordant concentration–response patterns across the measured domains but, because all variables followed the same concentration gradient within one oil batch, was interpreted descriptively. These findings provide a batch-specific in vitro characterization of unrefined HIO and support its further evaluation as a candidate functional feed ingredient.
papers.abstract_zh: 黑水虻（*Hermetia illucens*）幼蟲作為永續飼料資源的應用日益廣泛，近期研究亦拓展了對其脂質組成的認識。本研究旨在特性化單批次機械萃取之未精製黑水虻幼蟲油（HIO），測定其脂肪酸組成、分析測定定義之總酚與總黃酮含量（TPC與TFC），並評估其體外自由基清除活性、對脂多糖（LPS）刺激之RAW 264.7巨噬細胞中發炎介質的影響，以及對五種動物相關病原菌之生長反應。HIO含有69.12%的飽和脂肪酸，其中月桂酸佔總脂肪酸的43.44%；TPC與TFC分別為2.96 ± 0.20 mg GAE/g和1.00 ± 0.03 mg QE/g，ABTS與DPPH的IC50值則分別為3.89 ± 0.12%和4.22 ± 0.21%（v/v）。在1.563–6.25%（v/v）的非細胞毒性範圍內，HIO能減少一氧化氮及促發炎細胞激素的產生。HIO亦能抑制所有五種菌株的生長，根據菌種不同，在6.25–12.5%（v/v）濃度下以吸光值測定未檢測到生長；這些終點未透過活菌計數進一步確認。探索性相關分析顯示，各測得領域之間具有一致的濃度-反應模式，但由於所有變數皆遵循單一油品批次中的相同濃度梯度，故採描述性解讀。這些發現提供了未精製HIO的批次特異性體外特性，並支持其作為候選機能性飼料成分的進一步評估。

papers.title: Triplophysa lucicauda, a New Species of Tibetan Stone Loach (Nemacheilidae) from Shigatse City, Xizang
papers.abstract: Triplophysa is an important component of high-altitude freshwater fish fauna on the Qinghai Tibet Plateau and adjacent regions, and morphological overlap among closely related species complicates species identification. In this study, we conducted an integrative taxonomic investigation of a Triplophysa population collected from the Peng Chu River in Shigatse, Tibet, China, combining morphological examination, morphometric analysis, and mitochondrial cytochrome b (Cyt b) sequence data, and describe it as a new species, Triplophysa lucicauda sp. nov. The new species is characterized by a unique combination of morphological traits, including a conspicuous bright yellow circular spot on the dorsal surface of the posterior caudal peduncle, as well as distinctive fin positions, fin-ray counts, barbel morphology, and proportional measurements. Based on 34 proportional characters, we analyzed the new species alongside T. microps and T. brevicauda. The first three principal components cumulatively explained 60.75% of the total morphological variation, and canonical variate analysis revealed discriminant structure among species. Both MANOVA and PERMANOVA detected significant overall differences, and all pairwise comparisons remained significant after Benjamini–Hochberg correction; the overall PERMANOVA yielded R2 = 0.2598 and p = 0.0012, whereas the test of multivariate dispersion detected no significant among-group differences (p = 0.6536). The overall classification accuracy of leave-one-out cross-validation with a complete processing pipeline was 72.22%, with six of eight specimens of the new species correctly classified. Bayesian phylogenetic analysis of Cyt b sequences showed that the three sequenced specimens of the new species formed a monophyletic clade with maximum posterior probability support (BPP = 1.000), and the minimum K2P genetic distance between the new species and the comparative lineages was 5.13%. The diagnostic characters, overall morphological differentiation, and molecular lineage evidence jointly support the species validity of T. lucicauda. The discovery of this new species enriches the known diversity of the genus Triplophysa in the Himalayan region.
papers.abstract_zh: 高原條鰍屬（*Triplophysa*）是青藏高原及鄰近地區高海拔淡水魚類區系的重要組成部分，而近緣物種之間的形態重疊使得物種鑑定變得複雜。在本研究中，我們結合形態學檢查、形質測量分析以及線粒體細胞色素 b（Cyt b）序列數據，對採自中國西藏日喀則蓬曲河的一個條鰍屬族群進行了整合分類學研究，並將其描述為一新種——亮尾條鰍（*Triplophysa lucicauda* sp. nov.）。該新種具有獨特的形態特徵組合，包括尾柄後段背部有一顯著的鮮黃色圓斑，以及獨特的鰭位置、鰭條數、鬚部形態和比例測量數據。基於 34 個比例性狀，我們將該新種與微眼條鰍（*T. microps*）和短尾條鰍（*T. brevicauda*）進行了比較分析。前三個主成分累計解釋了 60.75% 的總形態變異，典型變異數分析（CVA）揭示了物種間的判別結構。多變量變異數分析（MANOVA）和置換多元變異數分析（PERMANOVA）均檢測到顯著的整體差異，且所有成對比較在經過 Benjamini–Hochberg 校正後均保持顯著；整體 PERMANOVA 的結果為 $R^2 = 0.2598$，$p = 0.0012$，而多元離散度檢驗未檢測到顯著的組間差異（$p = 0.6536$）。採用完整處理流程的留一交叉驗證（leave-one-out cross-validation）的整體分類準確率為 72.22%，新種的 8 個標本中有 6 個被正確分類。Cyt b 序列的貝氏系統發育分析顯示，該新種的 3 個定序標本形成了一個具最高後驗機率支持的單系群（BPP = 1.000），且該新種與比較譜系之間的最小 K2P 遺傳距離為 5.13%。診斷性特徵、整體形態分化及分子譜系證據共同支持亮尾條鰍的物種有效性。該新種的發現豐富了喜馬拉雅地區高原條鰍屬已知的多樣性。

papers.title: Genome-Wide Association Study of Body Weight and Body Length in the Giant Freshwater Prawn (Macrobrachium rosenbergii)
papers.abstract: The giant freshwater prawn (Macrobrachium rosenbergii) is an economically important aquaculture species; however, few growth-associated polymorphisms have been reported. Whole-genome resequencing (WGS) was performed on 104 farmed prawns from Vietnam, Thailand, and China, and 51,883,592 SNPs were identified for genome-wide association analyses of body weight and body length. At p < 5 × 10−8, six candidate association loci for body weight and one for body length were identified, with the strongest signal on chromosome 33 (p = 3.02 × 10−9); in a parallel mixed-linear model, none of the seven loci reached p < 5 × 10−8, although they remained at least suggestive for their respective traits. Conditional analyses suggested that the two traits share only partially overlapping signals. Lead SNPs from six loci were located within annotated genes (e.g., cell adhesion molecule 3-like); some loci also harbored cuticle-protein, resilin, and P4HA2-like genes as positional clues within the ±200 kb window. These findings provide candidate association loci and candidate genes for validation in larger, independent populations.
papers.abstract_zh: 羅氏沼蝦（Macrobrachium rosenbergii）是一種具經濟重要性的水產養殖物種；然而，與生長相關的多型性報導卻很少。本研究對來自越南、泰國和中國的104隻養殖沼蝦進行全基因組重測序（WGS），鑑定出51,883,592個單核苷酸多型性（SNP），用於體重和體長的全基因組關聯分析。在 $p < 5 \times 10^{-8}$ 的顯著水準下，共鑑定出6個與體重相關及1個與體長相關的候選關聯位點，其中最強的訊號位於第33號染色體上（$p = 3.02 \times 10^{-9}$）；在平行的混合線性模型中，這7個位點均未達到 $p < 5 \times 10^{-8}$ 的標準，但對於各自的性狀仍保持至少具暗示性的關聯。條件分析表明，這兩個性狀僅共享部分重疊的訊號。來自6個位點的前導SNP（lead SNPs）位於已註釋的基因內（例如細胞黏附分子3樣基因）；某些位點在 $\pm 200\text{ kb}$ 窗口內也包含角質蛋白基因、彈性蛋白（resilin）基因以及 P4HA2 樣基因作為位置線索。這些發現為在更大且獨立的群體中進行驗證提供了候選關聯位點與候選基因。

papers.title: Effects of Dietary Supplementation with Liquor Distillers’ Grains with Solubles on Growth Performance, Nutrient Digestibility, Serum Parameters, and Fecal Microbiota of Late-Phase Nursery Yacha Pigs
papers.abstract: This study aimed to investigate the effects of dietary inclusion of liquor distillers’ grains with solubles (LDGS) on growth performance, serum biochemical parameters, immune and antioxidant status, short-chain fatty acid (SCFA) and fecal microbial diversity in late-phase nursery Yacha pigs. The experiment involved 240 healthy 60-day-old pigs with an initial body weight of 23.99 ± 1.00 kg. These pigs were assigned randomly to five treatment groups, each consisting of eight replicate pens and six pigs per pen. The control group (CON) received a basal diet, while the four treatment groups were supplied with basal diets with 2%, 3%, 4% and 5% LDGS, respectively. Compared with the CON group, BUN levels were significantly lower in the 3% supplement group (p < 0.05). These results suggest changes in nitrogen metabolism, but there were no significant differences in ADG or F/G. Meanwhile, compared with the CON group, the 3% group showed significant changes in anti-inflammatory cytokine IL-10 levels, glutathione peroxidase (GSH-Px) activity, and total antioxidant capacity (T-AOC) (p < 0.05). Serum IgG was also significantly higher, but the absolute increase was small. The 3% supplementation group had the highest fecal SCFA concentrations, with acetic acid concentrations significantly elevated relative to the control group (p < 0.05). Regarding microbial diversity, in the 3% and 4% supplementation groups, the relative abundance of butyrate-producing bacteria, such as Terrisporobacter, was significantly higher than that in the control group (p < 0.05), while the relative abundance of the opportunistic pathogen Streptococcus was significantly decreased in the 3%, 4% and 5% groups (p < 0.05). Overall, multiple indicators declined at the 4% or 5% LDGS inclusion level. The 3% dietary LDGS supplementation level led to relatively better gut health and helped maintain balanced anti-inflammatory and antioxidant homeostasis, but ADG and F/G did not differ significantly from the control. Therefore, among the inclusion levels tested, 3% LDGS was associated with favorable overall responses in late-phase nursery Yacha pigs.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討飼糧中添加發酵酒糟（LDGS）對育肥前期崖城豬生長性能、血清生化指標、免疫與抗氧化狀態、短鏈脂肪酸（SCFA）及糞便微生物多樣性的影響。試驗選用 240 頭健康、60 日齡、平均初始體重為 23.99 ± 1.00 公斤的豬隻，隨機分為 5 個處理組，每組 8 個重複欄，每欄 6 頭豬。對照組（CON）飼喂基礎飼糧，4個處理組分別在基礎飼糧中添加 2%、3%、4% 和 5% 的 LDGS。與 CON 組相比，3% 添加組的血清尿素氮（BUN）顯著降低（p < 0.05），結果顯示氮代謝有所改變，但平均日增重（ADG）或料重比（F/G）無顯著差異。同時，與 CON 組相比，3% 添加組的抗發炎細胞激素 IL-10 濃度、麩胱甘肽過氧化酶（GSH-Px）活性及總抗氧化能力（T-AOC）均有顯著變化（p < 0.05）；血清 IgG 濃度也顯著升高，但絕對增幅較小。3% 添加組的糞便 SCFA 濃度最高，其中乙酸濃度顯著高於對照組（p < 0.05）。在微生物多樣性方面，3% 和 4% 添加組中產丁酸菌（如 Terrisporobacter）的相對豐度顯著高於對照組（p < 0.05），而機會致病菌鏈球菌屬（Streptococcus）在 3%、4% 和 5% 添加組中的相對豐度則顯著降低（p < 0.05）。總體而言，多項指標在 LDGS 添加量達 4% 或 5% 時有所下降。飼糧中添加 3% 的 LDGS 可帶來相對較佳的腸道健康，並有助於維持抗發炎與抗氧化的穩態，但 ADG 和 F/G 與對照組相比無顯著差異。因此，在所試驗的添加水準中，3% LDGS 對育肥前期崖城豬的整體生理反應表現最佳。

papers.title: A Preliminary Study of Multidimensional Welfare Assessment and Management Practices in Companion Dogs: Differences According to Owner and Dog Characteristics
papers.abstract: This study assessed companion dog welfare across multiple domains using owner-observable information and examined differences in welfare scores according to owner and dog characteristics. Drawing on the Five Domains Model and previous research, we developed an owner-reported welfare assessment tool covering four domains: environment (16 items), physical health (24 items), behavior and mental state (29 items), and management (17 items). An online survey included 206 adult dog owners. We also compared general dog owners with owners holding training- or animal-assisted-intervention-related qualifications. The mean exploratory composite index was 87.16, with the highest score in the environment domain (92.22) and the lowest in the behavior and mental state domain (80.07). Female owners had significantly higher exploratory composite index values, environment, and management scores than male owners. Selected welfare scores also differed significantly by owner age, dog age, and body weight. No significant differences in the exploratory composite index or domain-specific welfare scores were found between the two groups. Although three individual items showed unadjusted p-values below 0.05, none remained statistically significant after Bonferroni correction. These findings provide preliminary evidence supporting multidimensional, owner-reported assessment of companion dog welfare and management practices. Further testing of the tool’s reliability and validity is warranted.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究利用飼主可觀察到的資訊，從多個面向評估伴侶犬福祉，並檢視福祉分數依飼主與犬隻特徵而產生的差異。基於「五大面向模型」（Five Domains Model）與先前的研究，我們開發了一套涵蓋四個面向的飼主回報福祉評估工具，分別為：環境（16題）、身體健康（24題）、行為與心理狀態（29題）以及管理（17題）。線上問卷共納入206位成年愛犬飼主。我們亦比較了一般狗主人與具備訓練或動物輔助介入相關資格的飼主。平均探索性綜合指數（exploratory composite index）為87.16分，其中以環境面向分數最高（92.22分），行為與心理狀態面向最低（80.07分）。女性飼主的探索性綜合指數、環境及管理面向分數皆顯著高於男性飼主。部分福祉分數亦因飼主年齡、犬隻年齡與體重而有顯著差異。兩組飼主在探索性綜合指數或各面向福祉分數上則無顯著差異。儘管有3個單一題目的未調整p值低於0.05，但在經過邦費羅尼校正（Bonferroni correction）後皆未達統計顯著。這些發現為多面向、飼主回報的伴侶犬福祉與管理實務評估提供了初步證據。該工具的信效度仍有待進一步測試。

papers.title: Udder and Teat Morphology in Relation to Milk Yield in Dairy Mares: Farm-Level Confounding in a Multi-Farm Observational Study
papers.abstract: Mare’s milk carries cultural and economic importance in Central Asia, yet udder and teat morphology in relation to individual milk yield remain poorly characterized, and farm-level confounding inflates apparent associations in multi-farm data. We analyzed 333 mares with complete morphology and yield records across 12 farms. A linear mixed-effects model with farm as a random intercept estimated ICC = 0.747; approximately three-quarters of yield variance occurred between farms. Leave-one-farm-out ICC values ranged from 0.663 to 0.768, indicating that no single farm drove the result. Pooled Pearson correlations attenuated markedly after within-farm demeaning; udder depth showed near-complete attenuation (raw r = −0.503; demeaned r = 0.098). Among udder and teat traits, within-farm correlations were weak, with the largest being for teat length × udder width (r = 0.207; 95% CI: 0.087–0.348) and teat length (r = 0.178; CI: 0.076–0.318). No morphological fixed effect was statistically significant. After farm adjustment, teat length and teat length × udder width are hypothesis-generating traits that warrant prospective evaluation with parity and lactation-stage control.
papers.abstract_zh: 母馬在中亞地區具有文化與經濟重要性，然而有關其乳房與乳頭形態與個別泌乳量之關係的特性描述仍顯不足，且多牧場資料中的牧場層級干擾因素會誇大表面的相關性。我們分析了來自 12 個牧場、共 333 匹具完整形態與產乳記錄的母馬。採用以牧場作為隨機截距的線性混合效應模型，估計出 ICC = 0.747；大約四分之三的產乳量變異發生於牧場之間。逐一排除牧場法（leave-one-farm-out）的 ICC 值介於 0.663 至 0.768 之間，顯示結果並非由單一牧場主導。合併的皮爾森相關係數在進行場內去均值（within-farm demeaning）處理後顯著減弱；乳房深度的相關性呈現近乎完全的衰減（原始 r = −0.503；去均值後 r = 0.098）。在各項乳房與乳頭性狀中，場內相關性皆很弱，其中最大者為乳頭長度 × 乳房寬度（r = 0.207；95% 信賴區間：0.087–0.348）以及乳頭長度（r = 0.178；信賴區間：0.076–0.318）。所有形態固定效應均未達統計顯著水準。在進行牧場調整後，乳頭長度以及乳頭長度 × 乳房寬度可作為具假設生成性質的性狀，值得在控制胎次與泌乳階段的條件下進行前瞻性評估。

papers.title: Comparative Transcriptomic Analysis of Alpaca (Vicugna pacos) Skin Identifies Candidate Genes and Biological Processes Associated with Fiber Color
papers.abstract: The transcriptomic basis of natural fiber-color diversity in alpacas remains incompletely understood. We analyzed skin biopsies from 65 Huacaya alpacas by RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) and integrated phenotypic color categories with instrumental Commission Internationale de l′Éclairage L*a*b* CIELAB measurements, a standardized color space system used to objectively measure and quantify color. Differential expression was assessed using DESeq2 differential-expression analysis package with adjustment for collection batch, sex, and fiber-color category, while L* (lightness), a* (green–red axis), and b* (blue–yellow axis) were examined in separate continuous models. The categorical analysis included 64 samples and 25,405 genes. We identified 4968, 3993, 1469, and 7607 differentially expressed genes in light brown (LB), dark brown (DB), light fawn intensity Y (LFY), and light fawn intensity Z (LFZ), respectively, relative to white (W), with higher expression predominating in pigmented categories. Global transcriptomic structure and gene-level expression patterns were associated with CIELAB parameters, supporting the use of these measurements as complementary quantitative descriptors of fiber color. However, these associations should be interpreted cautiously because of the imbalance between collection batches and the heterogeneous cellular composition of the skin biopsies. Integration of categorical, continuous, and functional evidence prioritized TYR (tyrosinase), TYRP1 (tyrosinase-related protein 1), MITF (melanocyte-inducing transcription factor), EDNRB (endothelin receptor type B), MFSD12 (major facilitator superfamily domain containing 12), and GPR143 (G protein-coupled receptor 143), among other genes. Two regions with unassigned locus (LOC) identifiers in VicPac4 showed evidence consistent with premelanosome protein (PMEL), and a third with OCA2 melanosomal transmembrane protein (OCA2/P), although these identities remained interpretive proposal. Genes with higher expression in pigmented categories were overrepresented in pigmentation and melanosome processes, whereas genes with lower expression were associated with epidermal and keratin-related processes. These findings identify transcriptomic changes associated with natural fiber-color variation and candidates for functional validation.
papers.abstract_zh: 羊駝天然纖維顏色多樣性的轉錄體學基礎目前仍未完全釐清。我們利用RNA定序（RNA-seq）分析了65隻瓦卡亞羊駝（Huacaya alpacas）的皮膚切片，並將表型顏色類別與用於客觀測量和量化顏色的標準化色彩空間系統——國際照明委員會（CIE）L*a*b* CIELAB測量值相結合。我們使用DESeq2差異表現分析套件評估差異表現，並校正了採集批次、性別和纖維顏色類別，同時在獨立的連續模型中檢驗了 L*（明度）、a*（綠－紅軸）和 b*（藍－黃軸）。類別分析包含 64 個樣本和 25,405 個基因。相對於白色（W），我們在淺棕色（LB）、深棕色（DB）、淺黃褐色強度Y（LFY）和淺黃褐色強度Z（LFZ）中分別識別出 4,968、3,993、1,469 和 7,607 個差異表現基因，其中以有色類別中的高表現量居多。整體轉錄體結構與基因層級的表現模式與 CIELAB 參數相關，支持將這些測量值作為纖維顏色的互補定量描述符。然而，由於採集批次之間的失衡以及皮膚切片異質性的細胞組成，這些相關性應謹慎解釋。類別、連續與功能證據的整合篩選出了 TYR（酪胺酸酶）、TYRP1（酪胺酸酶相關蛋白 1）、MITF（黑色素細胞誘發轉錄因子）、EDNRB（内皮素受體B型）、MFSD12（主要協同轉運蛋白超家族結構域包含 12）以及 GPR143（G 蛋白偶聯受體 143）等候選基因。在 VicPac4 中具有未指定基因座（LOC）識別碼的兩個區域顯示出與前黑色素體蛋白（PMEL）一致的證據，第三個區域則與 OCA2 黑色素體跨膜蛋白（OCA2/P）一致，儘管這些身分仍屬於推測性提案。在有色類別中表現量較高的基因在色素沉著和黑色素體過程中顯著過度代表，而表現量較低的基因則與表皮及角蛋白相關過程相關。這些發現識別出了與天然纖維顏色變異相關的轉錄體變化，以及用於功能驗證的候選基因。

papers.title: Intraoperative Ketamine Infusion and Postoperative Pain Trajectories, Rescue Analgesia, and Persistent Postsurgical Pain in Dogs Undergoing Orthopedic Surgery: A Retrospective Cohort Study
papers.abstract: Ketamine is included in multimodal analgesic protocols, but evidence for its benefit on postoperative and persistent pain in dogs is limited. This retrospective cohort study evaluated the association between perianesthetic ketamine infusion and postoperative pain trajectories, rescue analgesia, and signs of persistent postsurgical pain in 508 client-owned dogs undergoing orthopedic surgery (May 2023–June 2024). Signalment, procedure, anesthetic management, pain scores, and rescue opioids during the first 48 postoperative hours were recorded, with findings at recheck ≥ 2 months. Group-based trajectory modeling identified pain trajectories; associations were assessed using multivariable regression, adjusted for confounders. Ketamine was administered to 101 dogs (19.9%) at a median (Q1, Q3) rate of 0.50 (0.33, 0.96) mg/kg/h. Two trajectories were identified: no pain (83.7%) and mild-to-low pain (16.3%). Ketamine infusion was not associated with trajectory membership (adjusted p = 0.22), rescue analgesia (p = 0.44), or opioid requirement (p = 0.07). At recheck, 37.8% of the 251 dogs with follow-up showed persistent pain and/or incomplete limb function, with no association with perianesthetic ketamine infusion (p = 0.15). In dogs undergoing orthopedic surgery and receiving multimodal analgesia, perianesthetic ketamine, at the doses and infusion durations used, was not associated with improved short-term or persistent pain outcomes.
authors: Tatiana Moreira Batista P. R. Azevedo
papers.abstract_zh: 氯胺酮被納入多模式鎮痛方案中，但其對犬術後及持續性疼痛之效益的證據仍屬有限。本回顧性世代研究評估了 508 隻接受骨科手術之飼主所有犬隻（2023年5月至2024年6月）中，圍麻醉期持續輸注氯胺酮與術後疼痛軌跡、救援鎮痛及持續性術後疼痛徵兆之間的關聯。記錄了品種信號、手術程序、麻醉管理、疼痛分數以及術後最初 48 小時內的救援鴉片類藥物，並記錄了術後 $\ge$ 2 個月複診時的發現。利用基於群體的軌跡建模識別疼痛軌跡；使用多變量迴歸評估關聯性，並對干擾因子進行校正。有 101 隻犬（19.9%）投予氯胺酮，其輸注速率之中位數（第一四分位數，第三四分位數）為 0.50 (0.33, 0.96) mg/kg/h。識別出兩種軌跡：無痛（83.7%）及輕度至低度疼痛（16.3%）。輸注氯胺酮與軌跡歸屬（校正後 p = 0.22）、救援鎮痛（p = 0.44）或鴉片類藥物需求（p = 0.07）無顯著關聯。在複診時，251 隻有追蹤紀錄的犬隻中，有 37.8% 表現出持續性疼痛及／或肢體功能不全，且與圍麻醉期輸注氯胺酮無關（p = 0.15）。在接受骨科手術並給予多模式鎮痛的犬隻中，在所使用的劑量與輸注持續時間下，圍麻醉期使用氯胺酮與改善短期或持續性疼痛預後並無關聯。

papers.title: Evaluation of Laryngeal View and Video-Based Percentage of Glottic Opening Scoring in Dogs Using a Video Laryngoscope
papers.abstract: Direct laryngoscopy provides a transient view of the canine larynx that is difficult to document or review. We compared direct and monitor laryngeal views obtained using a video laryngoscope and evaluated the reproducibility of video-based percentage of glottic opening (POGO) scoring in clinical dogs. In a prospective study, an operator assessed modified Cormack–Lehane (C–L) grades by direct line of sight and on the monitor, without repositioning the blade, in 20 dogs. Three blinded raters independently selected optimal frames and scored recorded videos from 19 dogs. Monitor visualization improved C–L grade in eight dogs, was unchanged in 11, and worsened in one (p = 0.03). POGO scoring showed excellent inter-rater reliability (single-measure intraclass correlation coefficient [ICC] = 0.94; average-measure ICC = 0.98), which remained good after excluding dogs with uniform scores of 0% or 100% (single-measure ICC = 0.83), and was strongly associated with monitor C–L grade (Spearman’s ρ = −0.91). Video laryngoscopy facilitates reviewable, quantitative documentation of canine laryngeal views; whether it improves intubation performance requires further study with standardized monitor use.
papers.abstract_zh: 直接喉鏡檢查僅能提供犬隻喉部的短暫視野，難以進行記錄或回顧。本研究比較了使用影像喉鏡獲得的直接與螢幕喉頭視野，並評估了以影像為基礎的聲門開口百分比（POGO）評分在臨床犬隻中的可重複性。在一項前瞻性研究中，操作者在不重新調整鏡片位置的情況下，對 20 隻犬隻分別透過直接視線與螢幕評估改良式 Cormack–Lehane（C–L）分級。三位採盲法評估的評分者獨立選取最佳畫面，並對 19 隻犬隻的錄影畫面進行評分。螢幕顯像使 8 隻犬隻的 C–L 分級獲得改善，11 隻維持不變，1 隻惡化（$p = 0.03$）。POGO 評分顯示出極佳的評分者間信度（單一測量組內相關係數 [ICC] = 0.94；平均測量 ICC = 0.98），在排除評分一致為 0% 或 100% 的犬隻後，仍維持良好的信度（單一測量 ICC = 0.83），且與螢幕 C–L 分級具有強烈的相關性（斯皮爾曼相關係數 $\rho = -0.91$）。影像喉鏡有助於對犬隻喉部視野進行可回顧且具量化性的記錄；其是否能提升插管表現，則需透過標準化螢幕使用進一步研究。

papers.title: Review of Achilles Tendon Rupture in Dogs and a Case Report of a Novel Surgical Repair Technique
papers.abstract: Rupture of the Achilles (common calcaneal) tendon remains one of the most demanding soft-tissue injuries in canine orthopaedic surgery, and recent large-cohort evidence confirms that no single surgical or postoperative strategy is clearly superior across all cases. This article first provides an updated, critical review of the anatomy, aetiology, diagnosis, and surgical management of Achilles tendon rupture in dogs, covering core suture patterns, biological and synthetic augmentation techniques, and postoperative immobilisation strategies, together with their respective biomechanical evidence and clinical limitations. It then presents a clinical case of chronic, complete Achilles tendon rupture in a dog, repaired using a Three-Loop Pulley suture pattern combined with a polypropylene mesh sleeve incorporated directly into the core suture passes—a “mesh-in-stitch” technique—supported by temporary transarticular external skeletal fixation. Over a follow-up period extending to 33 months postoperatively, serial clinical, ultrasonographic, and orthopaedic evaluations showed progressive structural remodelling of the tendon, stable mesh integration, and complete functional recovery without major complications. Taken together, the reviewed literature and this clinical outcome suggest that combining intraoperative mechanical reinforcement with a scaffold for tissue ingrowth may represent a viable option for reconstructing severe, chronically ruptured tendons in dogs.
papers.abstract_zh: 犬隻阿基里斯腱（總跟腱）斷裂仍然是犬類骨科手術中最具挑戰性的軟組織損傷之一，近期的大型世代研究證據確認，並沒有單一的手術或術後策略在所有病例中表現出絕對優勢。本文首先對犬阿基里斯腱斷裂的解剖學、病因學、診斷與手術治療進行了更新且具批判性的文獻回顧，涵蓋核心縫合模式、生物及合成組織補強技術、術後固定策略，以及各自的生物力學證據與臨床侷限性。隨後，本文呈現一例犬隻慢性完全性阿基里斯腱斷裂的臨床病例，使用三迴圈滑車縫合模式（Three-Loop Pulley suture pattern），結合直接融入核心縫合線中的聚丙烯網狀套管（即「網中針（mesh-in-stitch）」技術），並輔以暫時性經關節外固定架進行治療。在長達術後33個月的追蹤期間內，連續的臨床、超音波及骨科評估顯示，肌腱出現漸進式的結構重塑、穩定的網狀物整合，且完全恢復功能且無重大併發症。綜上所述，文獻回顧與此臨床結果顯示，將術中機械性強化與組織生長的支架結合，可能是重建犬隻嚴重慢性肌腱斷裂的可行選項。

papers.title: Administrative Records and Animal Welfare Accountability in Bull-Related Events in Spain
papers.abstract: Event-level documentary scrutiny of animal welfare requires matching each claim to the correct administrative record and linking related records. This study asks how far selected published Spanish records support such scrutiny for bull-related events. We developed a five-step audit: define the claim; identify the required object; determine whether the link applies; classify the evidence; and state the permissible conclusion. It was applied to 20 supplied claim-source units drawn from Ministry of Culture series recording 20,466 professional events in 2012–2025; two Castilla-La Mancha register extracts; and purposively selected documents. Worked examples illustrate four potential misreadings: settlement annotations read as incomplete registrations; a net gain of coded rows read as an equal gain of registration codes; grant provisions and call ceilings read as payments; and schedules or general rules read as evidence of occurrence or compliance. Applicable rules prescribe veterinary examinations and event records. For one bull run, selected sources supported reported occurrence and animal disposition; event-specific authorisation and veterinary links were not assessed. Because permit, veterinary and payment files were not collected, the incomplete chain in the assembled corpus follows from the collection design and does not establish that such records are absent. Candidate linkage fields are proposed for pilot testing.
papers.abstract_zh: 事件級別的動物福利紀錄審查，需要將每個聲明與正確的行政紀錄進行匹配，並連結相關紀錄。本研究探討了部分已出版的西班牙紀錄能在多大程度上支持針對與公牛相關活動的此類審查。我們開發了一套五步驟稽核流程：定義聲明；識別所需的物件；判定連結是否適用；分類證據；以及陳述允許的結論。該流程應用於 20 個提供的聲明-來源單元，這些單元取自文化部記錄 2012–2025 年間 20,466 場專業活動的系列資料、兩份卡斯提亞-拉曼查（Castilla-La Mancha）登記冊摘錄，以及刻意挑選的文件。實例說明瞭四種潛在的誤讀：將結算註解誤讀為未完成的登記；將編碼列的淨增加誤讀為登記代碼的同等增加；將補助規定與徵集上限誤讀為付款；以及將行程表或一般規則誤讀為發生或合規的證據。適用規則規定了獸醫檢查和活動紀錄。對於一場奔牛活動，選定的來源支持了所報告的發生情況和動物處置；活動專屬的授權和獸醫連結則未進行評估。由於未收集許可證、獸醫和付款檔案，所組合語料庫中不完整的鏈結是由於收集設計所致，並不能證明此類紀錄不存在。本文提出了用於試驗測試的候選連結欄位。

papers.title: Infrared Thermography of Periocular Temperature in Cats During Exhibitions: A Pilot Study
papers.abstract: Cat exhibitions may influence cats’ physiological responses, warranting further investigation. This study evaluated infrared thermography (IRT) for assessing periocular temperature in cats under exhibition conditions. Images were obtained from 55 cats: 21 during home visits, 26 at an exhibition, and eight in both settings. Independent groups (n = 47) were compared using linear mixed-effects models; paired observations were analyzed separately. In the main model, adjusted for age, hair length, sex and ambient temperature, periocular temperature was 0.49 °C higher at the exhibition than at home (95% CI −0.07–1.05), but the difference was not statistically significant. In contrast, the unadjusted difference was significant (0.69 °C, 95% CI 0.29–1.08) and remained similar after adjustment for age, hair length and sex (0.64 °C). These variables were not significantly associated with periocular temperature. Ambient temperature was constant at the exhibition and varied only between home households, limiting separation of its effect from that of setting. Subgroup analysis showed a significant difference between settings in males, but not females. Among eight cats assessed in both settings, variability was substantial; results are exploratory. IRT was feasible under exhibition conditions, but larger studies controlling for potential confounders and combining thermography with behavioral and physiological assessments are needed.
papers.abstract_zh: 貓隻貓展可能會影響其生理反應，這值得進一步探討。本研究評估了利用紅外線熱顯像技術（IRT）來評估貓在貓展環境下的眶周溫度。影像取自55隻貓：21隻於家庭訪視時拍攝，26隻於貓展中拍攝，8隻則在兩種環境下皆有拍攝。本研究使用線性混合效應模型比較獨立組別（n = 47）；配對觀察則獨立進行分析。在經年齡、毛長、性別及環境溫度校正的主要模型中，貓展時的眶周溫度比家中高出0.49 °C（95% CI −0.07–1.05），但此差異未達統計顯著。相比之下，未校正的差異具顯著性（0.69 °C，95% CI 0.29–1.08），且在針對年齡、毛長和性別進行校正後仍保持相近（0.64 °C）。這些變數與眶周溫度無顯著相關。環境溫度在貓展中保持恆定，僅在不同家庭之間有所變異，這限制了將其影響與環境設定影響區分開來的可能性。次群組分析顯示，公貓在不同環境設定間有顯著差異，母貓則無。在同時於兩種環境接受評估的8隻貓中，變異性相當大，結果具探索性質。紅外線熱顯像技術在貓展環境下是可行的，但未來需要更大規模、能控制潛在干擾因子，並將熱顯像技術與行為及生理評估相結合的研究。

papers.title: Diversity of Allergenic and Parasitic Mites in the Surroundings of Alpacas (Vicugna pacos)
papers.abstract: Alpaca farming and alpaca-assisted activities are becoming increasingly popular in Poland. However, information on allergenic and parasitic mites occurring in alpaca housing remains scarce. This study aimed to characterize mite diversity in litter and organic material from alpaca barns and to identify taxa of potential veterinary and medical importance. In total, 17 samples were collected from alpaca barns in south-western Poland and examined using the Berlese–Tullgren extraction method followed by microscopic identification. A total of 411 mites were collected, with mites detected in all samples. Astigmatina was the predominant group, while Cheyletidae also constituted a substantial proportion of the acarofauna. Among Astigmatina, the most dominant species were Lepidoglyphus destructor (37.7%), Acarus immobilis (24.6%), and Acarus farris (13.8%), all representing taxa associated with allergenic exposure. Parasitic Chorioptes spp. mites were also detected in barn litter. Mite abundance differed significantly among lower taxonomic groups (negative binomial generalized linear model, χ2 = 38.71, df = 10, p < 0.001), although pairwise post hoc comparisons were not significant after Holm correction. These findings demonstrate the presence of allergenic and parasitic mites in alpaca housing and indicate that barn litter may represent a potential source of exposure relevant to alpaca health and people in close contact with these animals.
papers.abstract_zh: 羊駝養殖與羊駝輔助活動在波蘭日益普及。然而，關於羊駝飼養環境中過敏原及寄生蟎類之資訊仍然匱乏。本研究旨在特性化羊駝畜舍墊料與有機物質中的蟎類多樣性，並識別具潛在獸醫與醫學重要性之分類群。本研究總共自波蘭西南部之羊駝畜舍採集 17 個樣本，使用貝氏－圖爾格倫（Berlese–Tullgren）萃取法進行提取，隨後進行顯微鏡鑑識。總共收集到 411 隻蟎，且所有樣本中皆檢測出蟎類。無氣門亞目（Astigmatina）為優勢類群，同時肉食蟎科（Cheyletidae）亦佔蟎相之相當比例。在無氣門亞目中，優勢度最高之物種為腐食酪蟎（*Lepidoglyphus destructor*，37.7%）、不動酪蟎（*Acarus immobilis*，24.6%）及田野酪蟎（*Acarus farris*，13.8%），均代表與過敏原暴露相關之分類群。於畜舍墊料中亦檢測出寄生性的皮蟎屬（*Chorioptes* spp.）蟎類。各低階分類群間之蟎類豐富度存在顯著差異（負二項廣義線性模型，$\chi^2 = 38.71$，$df = 10$，$p < 0.001$），儘管經過霍姆校正（Holm correction）後，成對事後比較並未達顯著水準。這些發現證明了羊駝飼養環境中存在過敏原及寄生蟎類，並顯示畜舍墊料可能構成與羊駝健康及與這些動物密切接觸之人員相關的潛在暴露源。
